  SELECT MZ_CFMX.CFLSH AS YWLSH,   
         'CF' AS YWLX,
         MZ_CFMX.XH AS MXXH,   
         MZ_CFMX.CFM,
         0 AS SPBZ,    
         MZ_CFMX.YPXH AS XMLSH , 
         MZ_CFMX.YPCD AS CDLSH ,  
         MZ_CFMX.YYTS AS YYTS,   
         MZ_CFMX.JL as sypc ,   
         MZ_CFMX.YCSL as ycjl ,   
         ( MZ_CFMX.SL * MZ_CFMX.FS ) as xmsl,   
         round(MZ_CFMX.DJ,4) as xmdj ,  
         round(MZ_CFMX.JZJE + MZ_CFMX.ZFJE,2 ) AS ZJJE,   
         MZ_CFMX.TSYF AS TSYF,
         MZ_CFK.GHLSH AS GHLSH,
         MZ_CFK.KSBM AS KSBM,
         MZ_CFK.YSBM AS YSBM,
         YK_TYPK.TYPE AS SFXM,
         YK_TYPK.YPMC AS XMMC,
         MZ_CFMX.ZH AS YPZH,
         nvl(MZ_CFK.TSBBZ, 0) AS TSBBZ,
         nvl(MZ_CFMX.SZFBL, 1) AS ZFBL,  
         round(MZ_CFMX.ZFJE,2 ) AS ZFJE,
         MZ_CFK.fplsh as fplsh,
         0.00 as yfjm,
         nvl(MZ_CFMX.YHJE,0) AS YHJE,
         MZ_CFMX.YHLY AS YHLY,
			MZ_CFK.CFSJ AS KDSJ,
			MZ_CFK.CFLB AS CFLB,
			'' AS TJM
    FROM MZ_CFMX ,MZ_CFK,YK_TYPK  
   WHERE MZ_CFK.CFLSH = MZ_CFMX.CFLSH AND
         MZ_CFMX.YPXH = YK_TYPK.YPXH AND
         MZ_CFMX.CFLSH IN ( ) AND
         MZ_CFMX.CFLSH > 0 and
			mz_cfk.brbm =
 AND FPLSH IS NULL
UNION ALL
 SELECT MZ_YJK1.YJLSH AS YWLSH,
        'YJ' AS YWLX,
        0 AS MXXH,
        to_numBer(xzsx) AS CFM,
        0 AS SPBZ,
        MZ_YJK1.BH AS XMLSH, 
        0 AS CDLSH ,
        0 AS YYTS,
        '' AS SYPC,
        '' AS YCJL,
        MZ_YJK1.SL AS XMSL,
        round(MZ_YJK1.DJ,4) AS XMDJ,
        round(MZ_YJK1.JZJE + MZ_YJK1.ZFJE,2) AS ZJJE, 
        '' AS TSYF,
        MZ_YJK1.GHLSH AS GHLSH,
        MZ_YJK1.KSBM AS KSBM,
        MZ_YJK1.YSBM AS YSBM,
        to_number(MZ_YJK1.SFXM) AS SFXM,
        GY_YLSF.FYMC AS XMMC,
        '' AS YPZH,
        nvl(MZ_YJK1.TSBBZ, 0) AS TSBBZ,
        nvl(MZ_YJK1.SZFBL, 1) AS ZFBL  ,  
        round(MZ_YJK1.ZFJE,2 ) AS ZFJE,
         MZ_YJK1.fplsh as fplsh,
         0.00 as yfjm,
         NVL(MZ_YJK1.YHJE,0) AS YHJE,
         MZ_YJK1.YHLY AS YHLY,
			MZ_YJK1.KDRQ AS KDSJ,
			'' AS CFLB,
			MZ_YJK1.TJM AS TJM
   FROM MZ_YJK1,GY_YLSF
  WHERE MZ_YJK1.BH = GY_YLSF.FYXH AND 
        MZ_YJK1.YJLSH IN (  ) AND mz_yjk1.czybm in ('1','2') AND
        MZ_YJK1.YJLSH > 0 and
		  mz_yjk1.brbm =
 AND FPLSH IS NULL
UNION ALL
 SELECT MZ_YJK2.YJLSH AS YWLSH ,
        'YJ' AS YWLX,

global type gf_tz_dbzcl from function_object
end type

forward prototypes
global function integer gf_tz_dbzcl (string as_brbm, string as_jzkh, string as_jydd, ref string as_error)
end prototypes

global function integer gf_tz_dbzcl (string as_brbm, string as_jzkh, string as_jydd, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: gf_tz_dbzcl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 自动处理单边账问题 
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_brbm 	  病人编码
// 	value    	string	as_jzkh 	  就诊卡号
// 	value    	string	as_jydd 	  交易地点
// 	reference	string	as_error	  错误文本
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.07.08     24949
//====================================================================
Long ll_row, ll_rowCount, ll_failCount=0, ll_jllsh
String ls_jsjylsh, ls_jllsh_msg, ls_jydd
Decimal{2} ldc_ylfyze
dateTime ldt_jssj
Integer li_TZYBDBZYS
dataStore lds_zfjyjl
str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
str_tzyb_jsxx lstr_tzyb_jsxx

IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs='EPTZ' THEN
	
	li_TZYBDBZYS = Integer(gf_GetPara(0, "TZYBDBZTS", "15", "台州医保单边账天数")) 
	
	lds_zfjyjl = create dataStore
	lds_zfjyjl.dataObject = 'd_pyyb_zfjyjl'
	lds_zfjyjl.setTransObject(sqlca)
	lds_zfjyjl.retrieve(as_brbm, li_TZYBDBZYS)
	ll_rowCount = lds_zfjyjl.rowCount()
	
	IF ll_rowCount>0 THEN
		
		IF base_info.syscode=10 or base_info.syscode=32 Then
			IF gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx.brxm <> gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzybjk.istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.brxm Then
				IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_zhcx( as_jzkh, as_error)<0 Then
					gf_applog(" 作废状态反交易前，账户查询失败，JLLSH："+String(ll_jllsh)+" 失败原因："+as_error)
					return -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		
		For ll_row=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
			IF base_info.syscode<>32 Then gf_waiting("该病人存在医保单边账问题，正在退费处理("+String(ll_row)+"/"+String(ll_rowCount)+")...", ll_row / ll_rowCount * 100)
			ll_jllsh = lds_zfjyjl.Object.jllsh[ll_row]       // 记录流水号
			ls_jsjylsh = lds_zfjyjl.Object.jsjylsh[ll_row]   // 结算交易流水号
			ldc_ylfyze = lds_zfjyjl.Object.fyze[ll_row]      // 费用总额
			ldt_jssj = lds_zfjyjl.Object.jssj[ll_row]        // 结算时间
						
//			IF base_info.syscode=10 Then
//				ls_jydd = 'MZYS'
//			ELSEIF base_info.syscode=41 Then
//				ls_jydd = 'FZHS'
//			ELSEIF base_info.syscode=5 Then
//				ls_jydd = gstr_jqxx.as_jqm
//				ls_jydd = 'MZSF'
//			ELSEIF base_info.syscode=32 Then
//				ls_jydd = gstr_jqxx.as_jqm
//				ls_jydd = 'ZZCX'
//			END IF

			IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mzdbz_tfcl( as_jzkh, ls_jsjylsh, base_info.userid, ldc_ylfyze, as_jydd, ldt_jssj, lstr_tzyb_jsxx, lstr_yb_jsxx, as_error)<0 THEN
				ll_failCount++
				ls_jllsh_msg += String(ll_jllsh)+","
				gf_applog(" 作废状态反交易失败，JLLSH："+String(ll_jllsh)+" 失败原因："+as_error)
			END IF
		Next
		IF base_info.syscode<>32 Then gf_waiting("该病人存在医保单边账问题，正在退费处理("+String(ll_rowCount)+"/"+String(ll_rowCount)+")...", -1)
			
		IF ll_failCount>0 THEN
			ls_jllsh_msg = Left(ls_jllsh_msg, Len(ls_jllsh_msg) - 1)
			IF base_info.syscode<>32 Then Messagebox("提示", "部分医保单边账处理失败，请联系信息科处理！JLLSH："+ls_jllsh_msg)
		END IF
		
	END IF
	
END IF

Destroy lds_zfjyjl

return 1
end function

private function string of_get_errormessage (string as_returncode);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_get_errormessage()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据错误代码返回错误描述
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_returncode	返回码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//0	交易成功	无错误信息
//-1	系统错误（包括通讯错误）	有错误信息
//-200	未知错误	有错误信息
//-300	报文合法性错误	有错误信息
//-400	业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误篋AT*
罅⒓赐顺龀绦颍
	有错误信息
//-500	业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）	无错误信息，一般以交易结果信息返回


CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_returncode)
	CASE '-1'
		RETURN '系统错误（包括通讯错误）'
		
	CASE '-200'
		RETURN '未知错误'
	CASE '-300'
		RETURN '报文合法性错误'
	CASE '-400'
		RETURN '业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误后立即退出程序）'
	CASE '-500'
		RETURN '业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）'	
	case else
		return ''
END CHOOSE

end function

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
integer li_1 = 0
string ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
if isnull(ad_datavalue) then ad_datavalue = 0
choose case as_datatype
	case 'da','db','dc','dd','di','dh'//，2位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		end if
	case 'de'//3位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		end if
	case 'df','dg'//4位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		end if
end choose
	

end function

subroutine uf_get_ksxx (long al_ksdm, ref string as_ybdm, ref string as_ybmc);select yb_ksdm,yb_ksmc into :as_ybdm,:as_ybmc from YB_KSDZ where ksdm = :al_ksdm;
if isnull(as_ybdm) then as_ybdm = '0'
if isnull(as_ybmc) then as_ybmc = '0'

end subroutine

public function date uf_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的譊AT*
(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
		if len(ls_datavalue)= 8 then
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		end if
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]

	end if

	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dta'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dtb'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)))
			
	
	case else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
		setnull(ldt_datavalue)
		return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if


end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype >= 'da' And ls_datatype < 'dz' THEN
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find]
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF
RETURN Dec(ls_datavalue)

end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyymmdd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
String ls_ip
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\BargaingApplyV3_01055.dll' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\BargaingApplyV3_01055.dll)不存在，请先安装'
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeCfgV3_01055.ini' ) = False Or FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeLogV3_01055.ini' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '下的TradeCfgV3_01055.ini或者TradeLogV3_01055.ini)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\TradeCfgV3_01055.ini", "SYSTEM",  "NativeAddress", "")
	IF is_pyybip <> ls_ip and is_pyybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
		ib_pyybpp = False
		is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和TradeCfgV3_01055.ini的NativeAddress不匹配，请检查"
		ib_init_success = False
		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

//DLL
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\BargaingApplyV4.dll' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\BargaingApplyV4.dll)不存在，请先安装'
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF

//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeCfgV4.ini' ) = False Or FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeLogV4.ini' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '下的TradeCfgV4.ini或者TradeLogV4.ini)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\TradeCfgV4.ini", "SYSTEM",  "NativeAddress", "")
	IF is_pyybip <> ls_ip and is_pyybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
		ib_pyybpp = False
		is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和TradeCfgV4.ini的NativeAddress不匹配，请检查"
		ib_init_success = False
		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
//-------------------------------------------------------------
ib_pyybpp = True
ib_init_success = True

is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )
end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYYMMDD HHMMSS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYYMMDD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYYMMDD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

private function boolean of_receivein_data (string as_xxlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_mc[],ls_format[],ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm
Int li_len[],li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_datarow,li_pos
Long ll_row,ll_find

//返回数据的判断
//if isnull(as_xxt) or trim(as_xxt) = '' then
//	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
//	return false
//end if
ls_xxt = as_xxt
//如果没有错误就继续分解内部消息体内容
//ls_xxlx = ls_xxlx + "_O"
//this.of_get_structure( ls_xxlx,'JG', ls_mc, li_len, ls_format,as_return)
//li_bound = upperbound(ls_mc)
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxlx , 'JG')
li_sum = 0
li_datarow = 0
DO WHILE Len(ls_xxt) > li_sum
	IF Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum+1)) = '' THEN
		RETURN True
	END IF
	li_datarow ++
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ll_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
		IF li_sum = 0 THEN
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%")
		ELSE
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%",li_pos + 2)
		END IF
		IF li_pos <= 0 THEN li_pos = Len(ls_xxt) + 1
		
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum + 1,li_pos - (li_sum + 1) )) //li_len[li_i]))
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[ll_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[ll_row] = li_datarow
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_mc[li_i]
		
		ll_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = 'rowcount'",1,999999)
		
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN ll_find = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[ll_find] = String(li_datarow)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[ll_find] = 's'
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[ll_find] = 'rowcount'
		
		li_sum = li_pos + 1 //li_len[li_i]
	NEXT
LOOP
//ids_receive_in.saveas( "c:\receive_in.txt",text!,true)
RETURN True

end function

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row), 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find])
		ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)

	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +string(al_row))
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row), 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row), 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype >= 'da' And ls_datatype < 'dz' THEN
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find]
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF
RETURN Dec(ls_datavalue)

end function

public function string uf_getstring_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 篋AT*
: u_ybjk.uf_getstring()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为string)，返回string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row), 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 's' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]

	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return ls_datavalue
end function

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);integer li_ds = 0,i
string ls_end

FOR i = 1 TO len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 AND Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	return false
else
	return true
end if

end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);//if len( //as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len) //if not of_if_char(as_string) then //	as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len -1)

//	as_string = as_string + ' '
//end if

//as_string = leftw(left(as_string,ai_len),ai_len)
as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================

IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)
	//	licc_config.port = 100
	//	licc_config.baud= 9600
	//	licc_config.timeout = 6000
	//	setnull(licc_config)
	
	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//判断医保连接的正式和测试是否与程序一致
IF Not ib_pyybpp THEN
	as_return = '医保前置机IP地址不匹配，请检查核对'
	RETURN False
END IF

Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Boolean lb_find
Integer li_last_fgfh_gs
ls_xxt = ''
//在这里判断初始化是否成功
//IF ib_init_success = False THEN
//	as_return = is_init_errormessage
//	RETURN False
//END IF
//ids_send.saveas("c:\send.txt",TEXT!,true)
IF is_init_date <> String(Today(),'yyyymmdd') THEN
	IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_return,ib_yd) THEN
		as_return = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_return
		RETURN False
	END IF
END IF

//返回对应的消息体格式
//this.of_get_structure( is_xxtlx,'QQ', ls_mc, li_len, ls_format,as_return)
//li_bound = upperbound(ls_mc)
//ids_send.SaveAs("c:\send.txt",Text!,False)

li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
//串联所有的消息体
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),ls_datavalue,  as_return) = False THEN RETURN False
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN False
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
		
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		
	END IF
	IF li_i = li_bound THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
	ELSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue + of_get_jklx_fgfh(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
	END IF
	
NEXT

ls_send = '$$' +ls_xxt + '$$'
//gf_applog('拼装消息数据 cpu:' + string(cpu() - ll_cpu))

IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
TRY
	Integer li_xxtlx,li_ret
	Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
	ls_recieve = Space(8000)
	IF ib_yd THEN
		li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(1111,li_jylsh,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
	ELSE
		li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
		li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(li_xxtlx,li_jylsh,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
	END IF
	//	MessageBox(ls_send,ls_recieve)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF ib_yd THEN //And Upper(is_xxtlx) = 'G001' 
		ELSE
			Long ll_pos,ll_pos2
			String ls_error
			ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , 1 )
			ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
			IF ll_pos2 = 0 THEN ll_pos2 = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,3,ll_pos - 3))
				ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1,ll_pos2 - ll_pos - 1)
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_error) THEN ls_error = ''
			as_return = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_error
			IF li_xxtlx = 33 and li_ret < 0 THEN
				ls_error = ''
				ll_pos2 = ll_pos2 + 4
				ll_pos = Pos ( ls_recieve,  '~~',ll_pos2)
				IF ll_pos > 0 And ll_pos > ll_pos2 THEN
					ll_pos2 = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
					ls_error = '~r~n' + Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1, ll_pos2 - ll_pos )
				END IF
				IF ls_error > '' THEN 	as_return = as_return + ls_error
			END IF
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
//gf_applog('发送返回 cpu:' + string(cpu() - ll_cpu))
//把当前发送的内容转移掉
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)

RETURN of_receive_data(ls_recieve,as_return)



end function

public function string of_get_jklx_fgfh (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+string(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	if isnull(ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find]) or ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find] = '' then
		return "~~"
	else
		return ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find]
	end if
else
	return "~~"
end if

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, ref string as_msg);integer li_bound,li_i
long ll_find,ll_row
string ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue
as_data = ''

if ids_send_in.rowcount() <=0 then 
	as_data = ''
	return true
end 
if
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
//串联所有的消息体
for ll_row = 1 to ids_send_in.object.max_datarow[1]
	
	for li_i = 1 to li_bound
		ls_dataname = this.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat =this.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +string(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.rowcount())
		if ll_find < 1 then 			
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + string(ll_row)
			return false			
		end if
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		

		ls_dataformat = this.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		choose case ls_dataformat
			case 's','d','dt'
				if isnull(ls_datavalue) then ls_datavalue = ''
			case 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)		
		end choose
		as_data = as_data + ls_datavalue + '%%'
	next
next

as_data = mid(as_data,1,len(as_data) - 2 )
return true
end function

private function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm //ls_mc[],ls_format[],
Long li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_row,li_find //li_len[],
Boolean lb_return = True
//返回数据的判断
If (IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '')  THEN
	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
	RETURN False
END IF

//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive.Reset()
ids_receive_in.Reset()

ls_xxt = as_xxt
ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt,3)
ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt,1,Len(ls_xxt) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx, 'YD')
String ls_return1	,ls_dataname
Integer li_pos = 0,li_pos_rs
li_sum = 0
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"~~")
	ELSE
		
		IF Pos(ls_xxt,"~~") > Pos(ls_xxt,"%%") And  Pos(ls_xxt,"%%") > 0  THEN
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%")
			li_pos_rs = 2
		ELSE
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"~~")
			li_pos_rs = 1
		END IF
	END IF
	IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
		li_pos = Len(ls_xxt)
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos)) //li_len[li_i]))
	ELSE
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	END IF
	
	ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
	
	ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
	ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname //ls_mc[li_i]
	li_sum = li_pos + li_pos_rs
	ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt ,li_sum) //li_len[li_i]
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		IF of_receivein_data(  This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ),ls_datavalue, ls_return1) = False THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_return1) THEN ls_return1 = ''
			as_return = as_return +ls_return1
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
//ids_receive.saveas("C:\receiv.txt",TEXT!,true)

RETURN lb_return

end function

public function boolean of_yb_date_init (ref string as_error, boolean ab_yd);String ls_InData
Integer li_ret
gf_waiting("正在初始化。。。。。。",10)
is_init_date = String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')
ls_InData = "$$"+Space(3000)+"$$"
gf_waiting("正在本地初始化。。。。。。",30)

li_ret = f_UserBargaingInit("$$$$",ls_InData,is_yljgdm)
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	gf_waiting("本地初始化错误。。。。。。",-1)
	as_error = '本地初始化错误：' + ls_InData
	RETURN False
END IF
gf_waiting("正在异地初始化。。。。。。",70)
//IF ab_yd THEN
li_ret = f_UserBargaingInitV4("$$$$",ls_InData,is_yljgdm)
//ELSE
//END IF
gf_waiting("初始化完成。。。。。。",-1)
//MessageBox(String(li_ret),ls_InData)
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	as_error = '异地初始化错误：' +  ls_InData
	RETURN False
ELSE
	RETURN True
END IF



end function

public function boolean of_constructor ();//
ib_init_success = true
ids_receive = Create u_datastore
ids_receive.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_old = Create u_datastore
ids_send_old.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_old.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in = Create u_datastore
ids_send_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

u_datastore lds_temp
lds_temp = Create u_datastore
lds_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF lds_temp.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS from JKXT.PYYB_JKLXMX WHERE JKFL = 'JG' ") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	lds_temp.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	lds_temp.Retrieve()
END IF


ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,'~' AS FGFH from JKXT.PYYB_JKLXMX") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	Long ll_row,i,li_cd,ll_rowcount,ll_insert
	String ls_jgdm
	ll_rowcount = ids_structre.Retrieve()
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row]) > '0'	THEN //结构
			ls_jgdm = Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row])
			lds_temp.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" + ls_jgdm +"'")
			lds_temp.Filter()
			lds_temp.SetSort("PXXH A")
			lds_temp.Sort()
			
			IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					ll_insert = ids_structre.InsertRow(0)
					ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.MXNR[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxlx[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxlx[i]
					ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_insert] = ''
					ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_insert] = 0
					ids_structre.Object.JGPXXH[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.PXXH[i]
					IF i = lds_temp.RowCount() THEN
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '~~'
					ELSE
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '%%'
					END IF
				NEXT
				ids_structre.DeleteRow(ll_row)
				ll_row --
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				li_cd = 0
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					//					if ids_structre.object.jklx[ll_row] = 'S001' then
					//						messagebox(string(li_cd),string(li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]))
					//					end if
					li_cd = li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
				NEXT
				ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'
				//				IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] > 1 THEN
				//					ids_structre.Object.jgcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				//	if ids_structre.object.jklx[ll_row] = 'S001' then messagebox(string(ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row]),string(li_cd))
				//					li_cd = li_cd * ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row]
				//					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'	
				//				elseif ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = -1 then
				//					ids_structre.Object.jgcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				END IF
				//				if ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_row] = -1 then
				//				else
				//					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				end if
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	ids_structre.SetSort("JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,JGPXXH")
	ids_structre.Sort()
	String ls_jklx_old = ''
	String ls_jkfl_old = ''
	Integer li_pxxh = 0
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
		IF ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row] <> ls_jklx_old Or ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row] <> ls_jkfl_old THEN
			li_pxxh = 0
		END IF
		li_pxxh ++
		ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row] = li_pxxh
		ls_jklx_old = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
		ls_jkfl_old = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
	NEXT
END IF

is_yljgdm = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YB_YYDM_NEW","","医保医院代码")
is_yljgxzqh  = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YLJGSZDXZQH","330399","医疗机构所在地行政区划")
is_pyybip = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YBQZJIPDZ","173.1.0.9","医保前置机IP地址")
is_pyybip1 = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YBQZJIPDZ1","173.1.0.9","医保前置机IP地諨AT* 1")
il_baqy = Integer(gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"BAQY","0","备案启用"))
IF IsNull(is_yljgdm) Or Trim(is_yljgdm) = '' THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医疗结构代码未设置'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

IF IsNull(is_pyybip) Or Trim(is_pyybip) = '' THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保前置机IP地址未设置'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF


//IF Not of_yb_date_init(False ) THEN
//	is_init_errormessage = '本地初始化失败'
//	ib_init_success = False
//END IF
//
//IF Not of_yb_date_init(True) THEN
//	is_init_errormessage = '异地初始化失败'
//	ib_init_success = False
//END IF

IF ib_init_success = False THEN gf_sblogmsg('初始失败:'+is_init_errormessage)

Destroy lds_temp
return ib_init_success

end function

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数组
//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
//编制：张贤彬 7/13/1999
//修改：syc    2006-1-17
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 Or Len(as_knsj) = 24 Or Len(as_knsj) = 22  THEN //
	IF Len(as_knsj) = 22 THEN
		IF This.uf_zhcx_0( as_knsj, as_error) < 0 THEN
			as_error = '获取电子社保卡错误:' + as_error
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
			ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_xzqh = Left(as_knsj,6)
	END IF
	IF Len(as_knsj) = 24 Or Len(as_knsj) = 22  THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	
	istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
	istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
	//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
	//	IF ii_com = 0  Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
	//		li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_zhcx( as_knsj, as_error)
	//	ELSE
	//		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_zhcx( as_knsj, as_error)
	//	END IF
	
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('25')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','10')
	istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
	istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	个人基本信息	composite		否		参照个人基本信息结构体参数
		
		//	7	医疗身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	8	工伤身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	10	预留位	string	10	否		预留
		
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
		of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx) //	个人基本信息
		IF ls_klb <> '3' AND ls_klb <> '6' THEN
			istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh
			IF as_knsj <> istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh THEN
				as_error = '传入医保卡号和医保返回卡号不一致'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
		END IF
		of_get_sfyzjg(istr_yb_zhxx) //身份验证结果
		IF ii_smkjs = 1 And (ls_klb = '2' Or ls_klb = '3') THEN
			This.uf_zhcx_smk( ls_klb, as_knsj, istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.sfzh, istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh, ls_smkerror)
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye
		END IF
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF



end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) = 'PYYB-GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
Long ll_find
IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM' Or Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN //wangyi 20200319 诊断单独拿出来获取
	ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
	ELSE
		RETURN '无'
	END IF
END IF

ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsbmc (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) = 'PYYB-GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
Long ll_find
if as_table = 'MZ_KS' OR as_table = 'GY_KSDM' THEN	
	ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
ELSE	
	ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='PYYB-" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
END IF
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] > '' THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find]
	ELSE
		String ls_dmmc
		CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
			CASE 'GY_KSDM'
				SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :as_tjlxh;
			CASE 'MZ_KS'
				SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh;
		END CHOOSE
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] = ls_dmmc
		RETURN ls_dmmc
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN 'NULL'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_ygxm (string as_ygdm);IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		//    is_error="创建'发药方式'对象失败("+ids_ygdm.is_error+")!"
		RETURN ''
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='" + as_ygdm + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
ELSE
	String ls_ygxm
	SELECT ygxm Into :ls_ygxm From GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		ls_ygxm = as_ygdm
	END IF
	
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	RETURN ls_ygxm
	
END IF


end function

public function decimal of_get_zfbl (str_pyyb_zhxx astr_pyyb_zhxx, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, string as_tsbbm, string as_dfybz, datetime adt_jfrq, ref integer ai_sfdj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	str_pyyb_zhxx	astr_pyyb_zhxx	
// 	value    	string       	as_ypzllb     	
// 	value    	string       	as_zxxmbm     	
// 	value    	string       	as_ywlb       	
// 	value    	string       	as_tsbbm      	
// 	value    	string       	as_dfybz      	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jfrq      	
// 	reference	integer      	ai_sfdj       	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//====================================================================

Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
This.uf_send_init('58')
this.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',astr_pyyb_zhxx.klb)
this.uf_send_add('IC信息',astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('药品诊疗类别',as_ypzllb)
This.uf_send_add('中心项目编码',as_zxxmbm)
This.uf_send_add('医疗待遇类别',astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbrlb)
This.uf_send_add('业务类别',as_ywlb)
This.uf_send_add('疾病编码',as_tsbbm)
This.uf_send_add('单复方标志',as_dfybz)
This.uf_send_add('交易时间',String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd'))
This.uf_send_add('医疗机构类型',is_yljglx)
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ai_sfdj = Integer( This.uf_getstring('收费等级'))
	ldc_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal( '自付比例')
	RETURN ldc_zfbl
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN -1
end function

public function integer of_update_jsmx (str_pyyb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_jssj
ldt_curr = gf_server_date()

ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,2)
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//END IF
////gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq

//	RETURN -1
//END IF
//Process_GetID:
String ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx
Dec{0} ld_zyh,ld_jllsh
//获取病人编码或住院号
SELECT jllsh,brbm,zyh,ywlsh,ywlx INTO :ld_jllsh,:ls_brbm,:ld_zyh,:ls_ywlsh,:ls_ywlx FROM JKXT.PYYB_JSMX
	WHERE JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj AND JSJYLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh  and ZTBZ = 0 And ROWNUM = 1  Using itran_sqlca ;
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)	
UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = 1 Where JSMXLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.JSMXLSH And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
//不管成功与否事务都要下去

UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_JSMX  SET ZTBZ = 1,QRJYLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh,SMKZHZF = :astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje
	Where JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj And JZXLH = :astr_yb_jsxx.JSMXLSH And JSJYLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh AND ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		IF Not IsNull(astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) And astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN
			INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZJJS
				(  QSRQ,JSLB,BRBM,ZYH,ZHZFJE,MXZDH,JYLSH,CBDXZQH,JSJYLSH,YWLSH,YWLX,ZTBZ)
				VALUES (:astr_yb_jsxx.smkqsrq,'XF',:ls_brbm,:ld_zyh,:astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje,:astr_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh, 				   :astr_yb_jsxx.smkjylsh,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh,:astr_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh,:ls_ywlsh,:ls_ywlx,1)
				Using itran_sqlca ;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN 0
			ELSE
				as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN 0
		END IF
	ELSE
		RETURN 0
	END IF
//	RETURN 0
ELSE
	as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF


end function

		JYJSLX,  TSMXBZDM ,:astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh ,:astr_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.fyze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zfze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zlze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.ybfy,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zyzf,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qfx,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.grzfxjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.grzf_xjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjxjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjbxje,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.lnzhzf,

			IF Not IsNull(astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) And astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN

			RETURN 1

public function integer uf_zydj_qx (string as_knsj, string as_zyhm, string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.uf_zydj_qx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:取消住院登记/医保转自费（用户交易40）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_knsj     	
// 	value	string	as_zyhm     	要注销的住院序列号
// 	value	string	as_zydjjylsh	住院登记交易号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.03.28
//====================================================================

String ls_klb,ls_temp,ls_ret[],ls_xzqh
ls_temp = as_knsj
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zydj_cx( as_knsj, as_zydjjylsh, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	if this.uf_Set_instance( as_error) < 0 then return -1
	Long ll_jsdh
	SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_zyhm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_zyhm = as_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('40')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//基本信息
	This.uf_send_add('要注销的住院序列号',as_zyhm )
	This.uf_send_add('住院登记交易号',as_zydjjylsh)
	//
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zydj_bg (string as_jbr, string as_bdlx, long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//住院登记变更
String ls_klb,ls_knsj,ls_zydjjylsh,ls_ryzd
Long ll_ksdm,ll_jsdh
DateTime ldt_cyrq,ldt_syrq,ldt_bqcysj
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch,ls_cyyy
Integer li_cyfs,li_count,li_cur
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
//获取基本信息
SELECT KNXX,BRKS,ZYHM,BRCH,BAHM,ZZYS,CYFS,JSDH
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:li_cyfs,:ll_jsdh
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

SELECT YBJZBH,bqcysj Into :ls_zydjjylsh,:ldt_cyrq From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的住院登记交易号:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(ls_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zydj_bg( al_zyh, as_error ) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	String ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zdmc = '',ls_zddm1,ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3,ls_zszh,ls_zddms[]
	Long ll_row,ll_tes = 0
	SELECT ZSZH Into :ls_zszh From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	//判断是否为生育，若为生育
	IF Not IsNull(ls_zszh) And ls_zszh <> '' THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_tes From BQXT.zy_brry_ye Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		IF ll_tes <= 0 Or IsNull(ll_tes) THEN ll_tes = 0
		SELECT Max(csrq) Into :ldt_syrq From BQXT.zy_brry_ye Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	ELSE
		ll_tes = 0
		SetNull(ldt_syrq)
	END IF
	
	ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
	IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
		as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
	
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('38')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡蠨AT* ','')
	//变更信息
	This.uf_send_add('住院号',ls_zyhm)
	This.uf_send_add('住院登记交易号',ls_zydjjylsh)
	This.uf_send_add('变动类型',as_bdlx)
	//1:入院信息变动 2：出院信息更新
	//如果是入院信息变动则8~18位的信息就是对应入院的各项信息，19，20为空。
	//如果是出院信息更新则11，12，13为出院诊断信息，9，10，11，12，13，19，20不能为空。
	This.uf_send_add('病人床号',ls_brch) //8
	IF as_bdlx = '1' THEN
		//医生信息
		IF ls_ysbm > '' THEN
		ELSE
			ls_ysbm = 'NULL'
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('诊断医生编码',ls_ysbm) //9入院诊断医生编码	string	10	否	
		This.uf_send_add('诊断医生姓名',of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm)) //10入院诊断医生姓名	string	20	否
		//入院诊断
		IF of_get_zy_zdxx(al_zyh,1,ls_zddm1,ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms,ls_ryzd) < 0 THEN
			as_error = '诊断取失败!'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('疾病副诊断及描述',ls_zdmc)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编号',ls_zddm1)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病名称',ls_ryzd)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）2',ls_zddm2)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）3',ls_zddm3)
		//-------诊断增加到10个---------
		IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
			li_count = UpperBound ( ls_zddms )
			IF li_count > 0 THEN
				FOR li_cur = 1 To li_count
					This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur + 3),ls_zddms[li_cur])
				NEXT
			END IF
			IF li_count + 3 < 10 THEN
				FOR li_cur = li_count + 4 To ii_zdsl
					This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur),'')
				NEXT
			END IF
		END IF
		//科室信息
		IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
			IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
				as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('科室编号',ls_ksbm)
		This.uf_send_add('科室名称',ls_ksmc)
		//其他
		This.uf_send_add('胎儿数',String(ll_tes)) //18
		This.uf_send_add('出院日期','') //19
		This.uf_send_add('出院原因','') //20
	ELSEIF as_bdlx = '2' THEN
		IF IsNull(ldt_cyrq) THEN
			ldt_cyrq = gf_Server_date()
			//			as_error = '出院日期为空!'
			//			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//医生信息
		IF ls_ysbm > '' THEN
		ELSE
			ls_ysbm = 'NULL'
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('诊断医生编码',ls_ysbm) //9出院诊断医生编码	string	10	否	
		This.uf_send_add('诊断医生姓名',of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm)) //10出院诊断医生姓名	string	20	否
		//出院诊断
		IF of_get_zy_zdxx(al_zyh,2,ls_zddm1,ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms,ls_ryzd) < 0 THEN
			as_error = '诊断取失败!'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('疾病副诊断及描述',ls_zdmc)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编号',ls_zddm1)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病名称',ls_ryzd)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）2',ls_zddm2)
		This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）3',ls_zddm3)
		//-------诊断增加到10个---------
		IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
			li_count = UpperBound ( ls_zddms )
			IF li_count > 0 THEN
				FOR li_cur = 1 To li_count
					This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur + 3),ls_zddms[li_cur])
				NEXT
			END IF
			IF li_count + 3 < 10 THEN
				FOR li_cur = li_count + 4 To ii_zdsl
					This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur),'')
				NEXT
			END IF
		END IF
		//----------------------------
		//科室信息
		IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
			IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
				as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('科室编号',ls_ksbm)
		This.uf_send_add('科室名称',ls_ksmc)
		//其他
		This.uf_send_add('胎儿数',String(ll_tes)) //18
		//获取出院日期
		This.uf_send_add('出院日期',Date(ldt_cyrq)) //19
		//出院原因
		//	li_cyfs
		ls_cyyy = of_get_dzdmsb('PYYB-GY_DMZD','23',li_cyfs) //	This.uf_send_add('出院原因','') //20(1: 病愈出院 2: 死亡 4: 转院 9: 其他原因)
		IF ls_cyyy > '' And ls_cyyy <> '无' THEN
			IF ls_cyyy = '01' Or ls_cyyy = '1' THEN
				ls_cyyy = '1'
			ELSEIF ls_cyyy = '02' Or ls_cyyy = '2' THEN
				ls_cyyy = '2'
			ELSEIF ls_cyyy = '03' Or ls_cyyy = '4' THEN
				ls_cyyy = '4'
			ELSE
				ls_cyyy = '9'
			END IF
			uf_send_add('出院原因',ls_cyyy)
		ELSE
			uf_send_add('出院原因','9')
		END IF
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr) //经办人	string	20	否
	//生育时间
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_syrq) And Date(ldt_syrq) <> Date(1900,1,1) THEN
		This.uf_send_add('生育时间',Date(ldt_syrq))
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('生育时间','') //	date	10	否		生育专用YyyyMMdd
	END IF
	//
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function long of_get_jbxx (integer ai_yplx, long al_ypxh, long al_ypcd, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk_new_his.of_get_jbxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:取得基本信息的行，如果内存中无基本信息，数据库取得写入
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	integer	ai_yplx	
// 	value	long   	al_ypxh	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  long 行蔇AT*

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2012.02.29
//====================================================================
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_sql
IF Not IsValid(ids_typk) THEN
	ids_typk = Create U_datastore
	ids_typk.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " select YK_TYPK.ypxh,YK_TYPK.YB_DZBH,YK_TYPK.YPJL,YK_TYPK.JLDW,YK_TYPK.YFGG,YK_TYPK.BFGG,"+&
		"YK_TYPK.BFDW,YK_TYPK.YFDW,YK_TYPK.ZJPB,YK_TYPK.TYPE,YK_TYPK.ZXDW,YK_TYPK.KZYP,0.00 as ZFBL,'' as YYXMBM, '1' as YPZLLB,'' AS YYXMMC,'' AS SNTYBM " +&
		" , YK_TYPK.YPSX as ypsx,0 as YPCD FROM YK_TYPK "
	IF ids_typk.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'药品信息'对象失败("+ids_typk.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
IF Not IsValid(ids_ylsf) THEN
	ids_ylsf = Create U_datastore
	ids_ylsf.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)                                                                             // 9              10               11          12
	ls_sql = " select fyxh,YBZXBH,fymc,fydw,FYGB,0 AS KZPB,0 AS TSDZ,0.00 as ZFBL,'' as YYXMBM, '2' as YPZLLB,'' AS YYXMMC,'' AS SNTYBM FROM GY_YLSF  "
	IF ids_ylsf.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_ylsf.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
//IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz) THEN
//
//	ids_yb_tsdz = Create U_datastore
//	ls_sql = " select FYLX,FYXH,YBZXBH,KSSJ,JSSJ FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ  "
//	IF ids_yb_tsdz.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
//		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_yb_tsdz.is_error+")!"
//		RETURN -1
//	else
//		ids_yb_tsdz.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql )
//		ids_yb_tsdz.retrieve()		
//	END IF
//end if

Long ll_find
String ls_ypzllb,ls_yyxmmc,ls_yybh,ls_sntybm
IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN //药品
	ls_yybh = 'Y' + String(al_ypxh) + '#' + String(al_ypcd)
	ll_find = ids_typk.Find(" YYXMBM = '" + ls_yybh + "'",1,9999999)
//	ll_find = ids_typk.Find(" ypxh = " + String(al_ypxh),1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ll_find
	ELSE
		Long ll_ypxh,ll_ypsx
		Integer li_zjpb,li_type,li_kzyp
		Dec{3} ldc_ypjl
		String ls_yb_dzbh,ls_jldw,ls_yfgg,ls_bfgg,ls_bfdw,ls_yfdw,ls_zxdw
		SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,YK_YPCD.YB_DZBH,YPJL,JLDW,YFGG,BFGG,BFDW,YFDW,ZJPB,TYPE,ZXDW,KZYP,YPSX
			INTO :ll_ypxh,:ls_yb_dzbh,:ldc_ypjl,:ls_jldw,:ls_yfgg,:ls_bfgg,:ls_bfdw,:ls_yfdw,:li_zjpb,:li_type,:ls_zxdw,:li_kzyp,:ll_ypsx
			From YPXT.YK_TYPK,YPXT.YK_YPCD Where YK_TYPK.YPXH = :al_ypxh and YK_TYPK.ypxh = YK_YPCD.ypxh and YK_YPCD.ypcd = :al_ypcd using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			SELECT YPZLLB,YYXMMC,SNTYBM Into :ls_ypzllb,:ls_yyxmmc,:ls_sntybm From JKXT.PYYB_YPZLPP Where YYXMBM = :ls_yybh And spjg = '1' And sqlx = '1' using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				IF not isnull(ls_yb_dzbh) and ls_yb_dzbh<> '' and ls_sntybm <> ls_yb_dzbh THEN 
					as_error = '药品：' + string(al_ypxh) + ls_yyxmmc +'匹配目录与药品字典中的市级中心编码不一致，请核对'
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ll_find = ids_typk.InsertRow(0)
				ids_typk.Object.YPXH[ll_find] = ll_ypxh
				ids_typk.Object.YB_DZBH[ll_find] = ls_yb_dzbh
				ids_typk.Object.YPJL[ll_find] = ldc_ypjl
				ids_typk.Object.JLDW[ll_find] = ls_jldw
				ids_typk.Object.YFGG[ll_find] = ls_yfgg
				ids_typk.Object.BFGG[ll_find] = ls_bfgg
				ids_typk.Object.YFDW[ll_find] = ls_yfdw
				ids_typk.Object.BFDW[ll_find] = ls_bfdw
				ids_typk.Object.ZJPB[ll_find] = li_zjpb
				ids_typk.Object.Type[ll_find] = li_type
				ids_typk.Object.ZXDW[ll_find] = ls_zxdw
				ids_typk.Object.KZYP[ll_find] = li_kzyp
				ids_typk.Object.YPZLLB[ll_find] = ls_ypzllb
				ids_typk.Object.YYXMMC[ll_find] = ls_yyxmmc
				ids_typk.Object.SNTYBM[ll_find] = ls_sntybm
				ids_typk.Object.YYXMBM[ll_find] = ls_yybh
				ids_typk.Object.YPSX[ll_find] = ll_ypsx
				ids_typk.Object.YPCD[ll_find] = al_ypcd
				RETURN ll_find
			ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				as_error = '取不到药品匹配信息2:请检查' + ls_yybh + '是否已经匹配，或者审核通过!'
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = '取药品匹配信息出错:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = '取不到药品基本信息:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE //费用
//	ll_find = ids_ylsf.Find("fyxh =" + String(al_ypxh),1,9999999)
	ls_yybh = 'F' + String(al_ypxh)
   ll_find = ids_ylsf.Find(" YYXMBM = '" + ls_yybh + "'",1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ll_find
	ELSE
		Long ll_fyxh
		//		integer li_tsdz = 0 
		Integer li_fygb,li_kzpb = 0
		String ls_ybzxbh,ls_fymc,ls_fydw
		//		select count(1) into :li_tsdz FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ WHERE FYLX = 0 AND FYXH = :al_ypxh;
		SELECT FYXH ,YBZXBH,fymc,FYDW,FYGB Into :ll_fyxh,:ls_ybzxbh,:ls_fymc,:ls_fydw,:li_fygb From XTGL.GY_YLSF Where FYXH = :al_ypxh using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			SELECT a.YPZLLB,b.YPZLSPM,a.SNTYBM Into :ls_ypzllb,:ls_yyxmmc,:ls_sntybm From JKXT.PYYB_YPZLPP a, JKXT.PYYB_YPZLML b
			Where a.YYXMBM = :ls_yybh And a.spjg = '1' And a.sqlx = '1' and a.SNTYBM = b.S_TYBM using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				IF not isnull(ls_ybzxbh) and ls_ybzxbh<> '' and ls_sntybm <> ls_ybzxbh THEN 
					as_error = '费用：' + string(al_ypxh) + ls_yyxmmc +'匹配目录与收费项目中的市级中心编码不一致，请核对'
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ll_find = ids_ylsf.InsertRow(0)
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYXH[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
				ids_ylsf.Object.YBZXBH[ll_find] = ls_ybzxbh
				ids_ylsf.Object.fymc[ll_find] = ls_fymc
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYDW[ll_find] = ls_fydw
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYGB[ll_find] = li_fygb
				ids_ylsf.Object.YPZLLB[ll_find] = ls_ypzllb
				ids_ylsf.Object.YYXMMC[ll_find] = ls_yyxmmc
				ids_ylsf.Object.SNTYBM[ll_find] = ls_sntybm
				ids_ylsf.Object.YYXMBM[ll_find] = ls_yybh
				SELECT KZPB Into :li_kzpb From xtgl.GY_YLSF_KZ Where FYXH = :al_ypxh using itran_sqlca;
				ids_ylsf.Object.KZPB[ll_find] = li_kzpb
				//			if li_tsdz > 0 then
				//				ids_ylsf.object.tsdz[ll_find] = 1
				//			end if
				RETURN ll_find
			ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				as_error = '取不到费用匹配信息2:请检查' + ls_yybh + '是否已经匹配，或者审核通过!'
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = '取费用匹配信息出错:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = '取不到费用基本信息:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

RETURN ll_find
end function
