private function integer of_zy_fymx_sc (long al_zyh, string as_cbrlb, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, ref string as_msg);//IF Not ib_yd THEN
IF adt_zzrq < DateTime(Date('2000.1.1')) THEN
	SetNull(adt_zzrq)
END IF
//zy_fymx
IF IsValid(ids_zyfymx) = False THEN
	ids_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	ids_zyfymx.setworktrans( gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zyfymx_sc'
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql )
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cpu
ll_cpu = CPU()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh,ai_jscs,adt_zzrq)
IF ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 0
END IF
//gf_applog('retrieve ids_zyfymx cpu:' + String(CPU() - ll_cpu) + " zzrq:" + String(adt_zzrq))
String ls_knsj,ls_klb,ls_kzys,ls_ybjzbh,ls_xmzxbh = '',ls_zyhm,ls_brch,ls_ypzllb,ls_dffbz,ls_zzys,ls_bah
Long ll_brks,ll_mxtop,ll_add_row,j,ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert,ll_ret,ll_findcy
Long ll_ypcd,ll_find_yz,ll_jsdh
Integer li_sczs,li_ybfl,li_spbz
Dec{0} ldc_yz_jlxh,ldc_yzzh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ld_fysl,ld_zfje,ld_zje
Dec{4} ld_fydj
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
DateTime ldt_bqrysj
Long ll_cwts,ll_zyljxh
SELECT KNXX,BRKS,ZYHM,BRCH,ZZYS,JSDH Into :ls_knsj,:ll_brks,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_zzys,:ll_jsdh From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh;
SELECT YBJZBH,BQRYSJ Into :ls_ybjzbh,:ldt_bqrysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh;

IF ll_brks = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '病人无当前科室，不能上传明细!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetSort("jlxh A")
ids_zyfymx.Sort()

li_sczs =  Ceiling(ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zyfymx_his'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF IsValid(ids_bqyz) = False THEN
	ids_bqyz = Create U_datastore
	ids_bqyz.setworktrans( gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ids_bqyz.DataObject = 'd_yb_zybqyz'
	ids_bqyz.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset()
ids_bqyz.Retrieve(al_zyh)
//在循环中获取自费比例，接口的xxtlx会被换成为获取自付比例的类型，所以切换到前面来处理 
IF This.of_get_zfbl_zy79( as_cbrlb, as_msg) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//卡类别
IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
END IF
FOR j = 1 To li_sczs
	uf_send_init('33') //住院类交易提交费用明细
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	
	uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm) //5
	uf_send_add('住院登记交易流水号',ls_ybjzbh) //6
	
	IF j * ii_mxts > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop =  ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = j * ii_mxts
	END IF
	
	ll_add_row = 0
	ldc_zjje = 0
	FOR ll_row = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
		//如果费用日期和计费日期小于病区入院时间则取病区入院时间
		IF Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row]) < Date(ldt_bqrysj) THEN
			ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row] = ldt_bqrysj
		END IF
		IF Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]) < Date(ldt_bqrysj) THEN
			ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row] = ldt_bqrysj
		END IF
		ls_bah = ''
		ll_add_row ++
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_rowcount),Integer(ll_row /ll_rowcount * 100))
		//		uf_send_add_in('明细序号',Right('00' + String(ll_add_row),2),ll_add_row)
		ll_zyljxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('明细序号',String(ll_zyljxh),ll_add_row)
		ld_fysl = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		IF ld_fysl < 0 THEN
			uf_send_add_in('退药标记','1',ll_add_row)
		ELSE
			uf_send_add_in('退药标记','0',ll_add_row)
		END IF
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //费用
			
			uf_send_add_in('项目编号','F' + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				//根据匹配的去取  9--12
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				uf_send_add_in('类别标志',ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
				//				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_ylsf.Object.#11[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
				//-------------------------------------------------------------
				uf_send_add_in('项目规格','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目剂型','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('计价单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用量单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				//-------------------------------------------------------------
				//				IF String(ids_ylsf.Object.#9[ll_find]) = '1' THEN
				uf_send_add_in('用药天数',1,ll_add_row)
				//				ELSE
				//					uf_send_add_in('用药天数',0,ll_add_row)
				//				END IF
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报
						SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And YWLSH = :ll_zyljxh And ywlx = 'ZY' And ZTBZ >= 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							IF ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 2 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,ll_add_row)
				END IF
			END IF
			//				
		ELSE //药品
			ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
				uf_send_add_in('类别标志',ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目编号',String(ids_typk.Object.#14[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find] = '' THEN
					uf_send_add_in('项目规格','无',ll_add_row)
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('项目规格',String(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目剂型',of_get_dzdmsb("YK_YPSX",String(ids_typk.Object.#18[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				//				项目剂型
				uf_send_add_in('项目单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.bfdw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('计价单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.bfdw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用量单位',String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				//				IF String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find]) = '2' Or String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find]) = '3' THEN
				//					uf_send_add_in('用药天数','0',ll_add_row)
				//				ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('用药天数','1',ll_add_row)
				//				END IF
				//----------add by sxl 2015-7-1------------------
				//33号交易收费项目列表新增字段30：备案号
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报
						SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And YWLSH = :ll_zyljxh And ywlx = 'ZY' And ZTBZ >= 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							IF ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 2 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,ll_add_row)
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//-----------------------------------------------------------
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到对应的费用信息:YPLX:' +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row]) + " FYXH:" +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//使用zy_fymx的ysgh ，为空则取主治医生
		ls_kzys = ids_zyfymx.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ls_kzys) Or ls_kzys = '' THEN
			ls_kzys = ls_zzys
		END IF
		//
		uf_send_add_in('开药医生编码',ls_kzys,ll_add_row) //开药医生编码	String	20	是
		uf_send_add_in('开药医生姓名',of_get_ygxm(ls_kzys),ll_add_row) //开药医生姓名	String	20	否
		ld_fydj = ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('项目单价',ld_fydj,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('项目数量',ld_fysl,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('项目贴数',1,ll_add_row)
		//				ld_zje = ld_fydj * Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row])
		ld_zje = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('项目总金额',ld_zje,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('医嘱日期',Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('费用发生日期',Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('床号',ls_brch,ll_add_row) //		床号			string	20	是		发生费用时的床号	
		//医嘱序号------------------------
		ldc_yz_jlxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]
		IF ldc_yz_jlxh > 0 THEN
			ll_find_yz = ids_bqyz.Find("jlxh=" + String(ldc_yz_jlxh),1,999999)
		ELSE
			ll_find_yz = 0
		END IF
		
		IF ll_find_yz <= 0 THEN
			uf_send_add_in('用法','无',ll_add_row) //	用法String	40	否		
			uf_send_add_in('用法标准','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('使用对象','0',ll_add_row)
			//用药标志
			uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row)
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] > 0 THEN
				uf_send_add_in('用法',String(ids_bqyz.Object.ycjl[ll_find_yz]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用法标准',of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC',	String(ids_bqyz.Object.sypc[ll_find_yz])),ll_add_row)
				IF ids_bqyz.Object.xmlx[ll_find_yz] = 3 THEN
					uf_send_add_in('用药标志','1',ll_add_row)
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row)
				END IF
				IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 3 THEN
					ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find_yz]
					uf_send_add_in('处方号',String(ldc_yzzh),ll_add_row)
					ll_findcy = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find_yz)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
					IF ll_findcy > 0 THEN
						ls_dffbz = '2'
						//						uf_send_add_in('单复方标志','2',ll_add_row) //单复方标志
					ELSE
						ls_dffbz = '1'
						//						uf_send_add_in('单复方标志','1',ll_add_row) //单复方标志
					END IF
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row)
					ls_dffbz = '0'
					//					uf_send_add_in('单复方标志','0',ll_add_row)
				END IF
			ELSE
				//				uf_send_add_in('用量单位','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用法','无',ll_add_row) //	用法String	40	否		
				uf_send_add_in('用法标准','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row)
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				//				uf_send_add_in('单复方标志','0',ll_add_row)
			END IF
			IF ids_bqyz.Object.yepb[ll_find_yz] = 1 THEN
				uf_send_add_in('使用对象','1',ll_add_row)
			ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('使用对象','0',ll_add_row)
			END IF
		END IF
		uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dffbz,ll_add_row)
		ld_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
		//审批标志 2015-4-27 spbz = 1 非控制的，按0
		li_spbz = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(li_spbz) THEN li_spbz = 0
		IF li_spbz = 1 THEN
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				IF IsNull(ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find]) Or ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find] <= 0 THEN
					li_spbz = 0
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] <= 0 THEN
					li_spbz = 0
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//------------------------------------------
		CHOOSE CASE  li_spbz
			CASE 9,1
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','1',ll_add_row)
				ld_zfbl = 1.00
			CASE 8,2
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',ll_add_row)
			CASE ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',ll_add_row)
		END CHOOSE
		//自负比例 ld_zfbl
		//		ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(as_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,'30','',ls_dffbz,Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]),li_ybfl,as_msg)
		li_ybfl = ids_zyfymx.Object.ybfl[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('自付比例',ld_zfbl,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('预住院标志','0',ll_add_row)
		
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY'
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWMXLSH[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.JSMXLSH[ll_insert] = ls_zyhm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YPZLLB[ll_insert] = ls_ypzllb
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZLBL[ll_insert] = ld_zfbl
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ybfl[ll_insert] = String(li_ybfl)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYJE[ll_insert] = Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DFFBZ[ll_insert] = Integer(ls_dffbz)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZTBZ[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
		ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ld_zfbl
		ld_zfje = Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]) * ld_zfbl
		ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = ld_zfje
	NEXT
	uf_send_add('明细医疗费用总额',ldc_zjje)
	uf_send_add('明细条数',ll_add_row)
	gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
	IF Not  uf_send(as_msg)  THEN
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			ll_cwts = This.uf_getdecimal( '错误记录条数')
			FOR ll_ret = 1 To ll_cwts
				as_msg += This.uf_getstring_in( '医院端明细序号', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "类别" + This.uf_getstring_in( '药品诊疗类别', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "编码" +This.uf_getstring_in( '医院项目编码', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "自付比例" + This.uf_getstring_in( '正确的自付比例', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "自负" + String(This.uf_getdecimal_in( '正确的自负金额', ll_ret))
				as_msg += "," + This.uf_getstring_in( '不能保存的原因代码', ll_ret)
				as_msg += ":"+ This.uf_getstring_in( '不能保存的原因说明', ll_ret)
				//医嘱明细序号	string	20	否		 医院端明细序号
				//药品诊疗类别	string	1	否		参考数据字典
				//医院项目编码	string	20	否		 
				//正确的自付比例	string	20	否		若不能保存的原因为1主健重复，则此域为空
				//正确的自负金额	double	10(2)	否		 
				//不能保存的原因代码	string	1	否		1主健重复  2自付比例错误
				//不能保存的原因说明	string	100	否
			NEXT
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
		ELSE
			as_msg = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error + ' ids_zyfymx:' +ids_zyfymx.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
//ELSE
//END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxsc (long al_zyh, string as_jbr, string as_cbrlb, ref string as_error);Long ll_ybpb,ll_mxbs,ll_count
DateTime ldt_zzrq,ldt_czsj,ldt_scsj
Dec{2} ld_zjje,ld_xjzfze,ld_jjzfze
String ls_jydd,ls_mxcllsh,ls_zyhm = '',ls_knsj ,ls_klb
str_pyyb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx2
Integer li_ret,li_scbz = 0
IF Not IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) THEN
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	
	//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
	
	CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
ELSE
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
		GOTO Process_GetID
	ELSE
		CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
	END IF
END IF

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = 'gtrans_temp_mssql连接失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
//------------------------------------------------
Process_GetID:
//卡内信息判别本地异地，以此判断调用哪个接口
SELECT knxx Into :ls_knsj From zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(ls_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zy_mxsc( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
//	IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'1',al_zyh,as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //入院变更
	ldt_czsj = gf_server_date()
	SELECT SCBZ Into :li_scbz From JKXT.YB_BRJL Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF li_scbz = 1 THEN
		SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "　zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "正在上传明细，不能同步上传!"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	INSERT INTO "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"   ( "ZYH",  "SCBZ",   "SCSJ" )
		Values ( :al_zyh,0,:ldt_czsj)  Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 1,SCSJ = :ldt_czsj Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	END IF
	
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	
	//获取已经做结算的日期
	SELECT Max(jsrq) Into :ldt_zzrq From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx  Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(ldt_zzrq) THEN
			//未做过结算的则取入院日期
			SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
			IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
				as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "获取入院日期失败:" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		ELSE
			ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
		END IF
	ELSEIF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"获取上一次结算日期失败:" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	ldt_zzrq = DateTime(Date(ldt_zzrq),Time(23:59:59))
	
	
	//明细上传--医保做预结算
	DO WHILE Date(ldt_zzrq) < Date(ldt_czsj)
		IF Date(ldt_zzrq) = Date(ldt_czsj) THEN EXIT
		//提交明细
		li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,as_cbrlb,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
				SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
			END IF
			as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			//预结算处理
			IF li_ret > 0 THEN
				
				IF uf_zy_jscl( as_jbr,al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, False, 0,'',  ls_jydd, lstr_yb_jsxx,lstr_yb_jsxx2, as_error) < 0 THEN
					IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
						SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
					END IF
					as_error =  "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +  '医保预结算失败: ' + as_error
					GOTO Error
				ELSE
					//获取对应支付情况
					ll_mxbs = 0
					
					SELECT count(*) Into :ll_mxbs From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 0 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					
					ld_zjje = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zfze
					ld_xjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjxjzf
					ld_jjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjbxje
					
					//判断是否已经预结算过
					SELECT count(*) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					
					gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					IF ll_count > 0 THEN
						UPDATE JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Set czsj = :ldt_czsj,mxbs = :ll_mxbs,zjje = :ld_zjje,xjzfze = :ld_xjzfze,jjzfze = :ld_jjzfze Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					ELSE
						INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze) Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					END IF
					IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					ELSE
						gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
						as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
						GOTO Error
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSEIF li_ret = 0 THEN //无明细
				//判断是否已经预结算过
				SELECT count(*) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				ldt_scsj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),-1),Time(23:59:59))
				ll_mxbs = 0
				ld_zjje = 0
				ld_xjzfze = 0
				ld_jjzfze = 0
				
				SELECT MXBS,ZJJE,XJZFZE,JJZFZE INTO :ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze FROM JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX
					Where zyh = :al_zyh And  jsrq  = :ldt_scsj Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					
				gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX SET CZSJ = :ldt_czsj,MXBS = :ll_mxbs,ZJJE = :ld_zjje,XJZFZE = :ld_xjzfze,JJZFZE = :ld_jjzfze
						Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				ELSE
					INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze) Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				END IF
				IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
					GOTO Error
				END IF
				
			END IF
		END IF
		ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
	LOOP
	
	SetNull(ldt_zzrq)
	li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,as_cbrlb,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)
	
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
			SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		END IF
		as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
		GOTO Error
	ELSEIF li_ret >= 0 THEN
		
		
	END IF
	gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	RETURN li_ret
	
	Error:
	gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public subroutine of_get_sfyzjg (ref str_pyyb_zhxx astr_pyyb_zhxx);//7	医疗身份验证结果
//8	工伤身份验证结果
//9	生育身份验证结果
string ls_ylsfyzjg,ls_gssfyzjg,ls_sysfyzjg
ls_ylsfyzjg = This.uf_getstring('医疗身份验证结果')
ls_gssfyzjg = This.uf_getstring('工伤身份验证结果')
ls_sysfyzjg = This.uf_getstring('生育身份验证结果')
//医疗身份验证结果
//第1位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参保 1：没参保或参保状态无效）  
//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）
//第3位：住院冻结（0正常，1冻结）
//第4位：帐户冻结(保留)
//第5位：门诊待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第6位：规定病种待遇是否享受（0:享受,1不享受）
//第7位：住院待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第8位：家庭病床待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第9位：体检是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第10位：异地安置黑名单冻结（0正常，1冻结）
//第11位：医疗救助是否享受(0:享受,1不螪AT*
)
//第12位：退役军人优抚是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)2020-6-23
//其它位（12-15）：内部预留（返回0）
  
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,1,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.ryhmdfs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,2,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.zydj = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,3,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.zhdj = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,4,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.mzdysfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,5,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.gdbzdysfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,6,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.zydysfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,7,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.jtbcdysfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,8,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.tjsfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,9,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.ydanhmddj = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,10,1)) 
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.yljzsfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,11,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.tyjryfsfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,12,1))
//	工伤身份验证结果	
//第1位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参保 1：没参保或参保状态无效）  
//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）
//第3位：住院冻结
//第4位：基金冻结（单位欠费）
//第5位：工伤待遇是否可以享受(0:已认定,1未认定)
//其它位（6-15）：内部预留（返回0）
//
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_gssfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,1,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_gssfyz.ryhmdfs = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,2,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_gssfyz.zydj = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,3,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_gssfyz.jjdj = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,4,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_gssfyz.gsdysfkyxs = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,5,1))
//	生育身份验证结果	
//第1位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参保 1：没参保或参保状态无效）  
//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）
//第3位：住院冻结
//第4位：基金冻结（单位欠费）
//第5位：生育待遇是否可以享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//其它位（6-15）：内部预留（返回0）
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_sysfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,1,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_sysfyz.ryhmdfs = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,2,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_sysfyz.zydj = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,3,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_sysfyz.jjdj = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,4,1))
astr_pyyb_zhxx.str_pyyb_sysfyz.sydysfkyxs = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,5,1))
end subroutine

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm
long ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh  From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 1;

IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
if ll_jsdh > 1 then
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + '-' + string(ll_jsdh)
end if 
String ls_klb
IF Len(ls_knxx) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zy_delfymx( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	
	SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;
	IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
	ELSE
		as_error = '取不到对应病人的就诊编号信息!'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//本地医保对这个PYYB_FYMXSC判断，其他事PYB_FYMXSC
	SELECT JSMXLSH Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
	IF ls_mxzdh > '' THEN
	ELSE
		as_error = '取不到对应病人的明细帐信息!'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('42')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
	This.uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
	This.uf_send_add('要删除的明细序号列表','')
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0'  THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		//删除预结算信息
		DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH  = :al_zyh  Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//所有明细ztbz 置-1，作废
		UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			RETURN 1
		ELSE
			as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF



end function

public function integer uf_jycx (string as_jylx, string as_jylsh, ref string as_jyjd, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//1	是否有医保卡
//2	IC信息
//3	现金支付方式
//4	银行卡信息
//5	待查询用户交易类型号
//6	待查询的用户交易流水号
//30门诊结算、31挂号退号/门诊退费、32住院登记、36住院结算、37住院退费、40取消住院登记。
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
ib_yd = false
This.uf_send_init( '43')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
This.uf_send_add('现金支窪AT* ','')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('待查询用户交易类型号', as_jylx)
IF as_jylx = '36' OR as_jylx = '37' THEN
	long ll_jsdh
   SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_jylsh = as_jylsh + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
END IF
This.uf_send_add('待查询的用户交易流水号', as_jylsh)
// 	返回参数(RetMsg)
//1	交易状态
//2	错误信息
//3	写医保卡结果
//4	扣银行卡结果
//5	更新后IC卡数据
//6	用户交易是否成功
//7	交易时间
//8	交易结算流水号
//9	交易处于阶段 30，36三个交易分为,其余没有确认交易的则默认为空
//10	该用户交易出口参数
//11	基金分段信息结构体
//12	费用汇总信息结构体
//
IF This.uf_send( as_error) THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring("交易状态") <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring("错误信息")
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF This.uf_getstring("用户交易是否成功") <> '0' THEN
			as_error = "用户交易失败!"
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( '交易时间')
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring("交易结算流水号")
		IF as_jylx = '30' Or as_jylx = '31' Or as_jylx = '36' Or as_jylx = '37' THEN
//			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
			IF as_jylx = '30' Or as_jylx = '36' THEN
				as_jyjd = This.uf_getstring("交易处于阶段") //0:已结算 1:已确认
				IF as_jyjd = '0' THEN
					as_jyjd = '0:已结算'
				ELSE
					as_jyjd = '1:已确认'
				END IF
			END IF
			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhye  = astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
			of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
		END IF
		//12	费用汇总信息结构体
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function boolean uf_ifyb (long al_data, string as_lx);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN false
END IF
Integer li_ybpb
CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_lx)
	CASE 'ZYH'
		SELECT YBPB INTO :li_ybpb FROM ZY_BRRY, GY_BRXZ
			Where ZY_BRRY.BRXZ = GY_BRXZ.BRXZ And ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'BRXZ','JSLX'
		SELECT YBPB Into :li_ybpb From GY_BRXZ Where BRXZ = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'JSDW'
		
END CHOOSE

RETURN li_ybpb = 1

end function

public subroutine of_get_fyhzxx (ref str_pyyb_fyhzxx astr_pyyb_fyhzxx);//费用汇总信息结构体
Long ll_row
ll_row = 1
DO WHILE Not IsNull(This.uf_getstring_in( '发票归类', ll_row))
	astr_pyyb_fyhzxx.fpgl[ll_row] = This.uf_getstring_in( '发票归类', ll_row)
	astr_pyyb_fyhzxx.glmc[ll_row] = This.uf_getstring_in( '归类名称', ll_row)
	astr_pyyb_fyhzxx.zfy[ll_row] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '总费用', ll_row)
	astr_pyyb_fyhzxx.zffy[ll_row] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自费费用', ll_row)
	astr_pyyb_fyhzxx.zf_fy[ll_row] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自负费用', ll_row)
	ll_row ++
LOOP

end subroutine

public function integer uf_zhcx_xs (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);
String ls_klb,ls_xzqh,ls_ret[]
str_yb_smkzh str_yb_smkzh_null
istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh = str_yb_smkzh_null
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
	IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
		ls_xzqh = ls_ret[5]
		istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh = ls_xzqh
		IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
			as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
			ib_yd = False
		ELSE
			as_knsj = 'YBDZPZ' + as_knsj
			ib_yd = True
		END IF
	ELSE
		as_error = '电子凭证信息传入错误'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 OR len(as_knsj) = 24 OR len(as_knsj) = 22  THEN//
   IF Len(as_knsj) = 22 THEN
		IF This.uf_zhcx_0( as_knsj, as_error) < 0 THEN
			as_error = '获取电子社保卡错误:' + as_error
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
			ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_xzqh = Left(as_knsj,6)
	END IF
	IF len(as_knsj) = 24 OR len(as_knsj) = 22 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF

IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zhcx_xs( as_knsj, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE	
	This.uf_send_init('25')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','10')
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	个人基本信息	composite		否		参照个人基本信息结构体参数

		//	7	医疗身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	8	工伤身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身稤AT*
菅橹そ峁�串长度�
15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//	10	预留位	string	10	否		预留
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
		of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx) //	个人基本信息	
		istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh
		IF ls_klb <> '3' AND ls_klb <> '6' THEN
			if as_knsj <> istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh then
				as_error = '传入医保卡号和医保返回卡号不褼AT* '
				RETURN -1
			end if
		END IF
		of_get_sfyzjg(istr_yb_zhxx) //身份验证结果
		IF ii_smkjs = 1 And (ls_klb = '2' or ls_klb = '3') THEN
			string ls_smkerror
			This.uf_zhcx_smk( ls_klb, as_knsj, istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.sfzh, istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh, ls_smkerror) 
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye 
		END IF
		OpenWithParm(w_yb_jbxx_xs,'2')
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF


end function

public function integer uf_get_brxz (string as_cbrlb, ref long al_brxz, ref long al_tgdw);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :as_cbrlb Using itran_sqlca ;

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN

	al_tgdw = Long(Mid(ls_temp,5,4))

end function

public function integer uf_qxybjs (string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, ref string as_error);//结算成功，本地失败
//只有结算交易（30、36）可以通过交易49确认成功或失败，
//退费交易31和37执行后无法回滚也不能被取消，不能调用49交易确认结果，医院只能根据医保执行结果（或根据43交易查询获得的结果）更正内部处理。
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_qrjslsh
Integer li_xxtlx,li_ret
Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '36~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '30~~'
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~-1~~$$'
IF ib_yd THEN
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
ELSE
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
END IF
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	as_error = String(li_ret)
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_recieve = mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = mid(ls_recieve,1,len(ls_recieve) - 2)//去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos -1 )
	RETURN -1
END IF
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
ls_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
IF of_update_jsmx_qx(as_jsjylsh,as_error,ls_qrjslsh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxcx (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm,ls_mxxhlb
long ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh  From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 1;
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;

IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对覦AT* Σ∪说木驼锉嗪判畔 !'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//判断本异地

String ls_klb
IF Len(ls_knxx) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF

IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	String ls_ydklb,ls_mxtjsxh = '',ls_fymxdtxh = ''
	Integer i
	IF Len(ls_knxx) > 30 THEN
		ls_ydklb = '13'
	ELSE
		ls_ydklb = '12'
	END IF
	SELECT Max(MXZDH) Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.YB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
	IF IsNull(ls_mxzdh) THEN ls_mxzdh = ''
	loop1:
	i ++
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_init('Y024')
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('卡类别',ls_ydklb)
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('卡内数据',ls_knxx)
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('就诊编号',ls_ybjzbh)
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('明细誅AT* ',ls_mxzdh)
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('明细提交顺序号',ls_mxtjsxh)
	iu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('费用明细单体序号',ls_fymxdtxh)
	
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//		MessageBox('提示','住院类交易上传费用明细核对完成!' + String(i) + 'ls_mxtjsxh:' + ls_mxtjsxh + ',ls_fymxdtxh:' + ls_fymxdtxh)
		IF Integer(iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring( '结束标志')) = 0 THEN
			ls_mxtjsxh = iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring( '明细提交顺序号')
			ls_fymxdtxh = iu_ybjk_new.uf_getstring( '费用明细单体序号')
			GOTO loop1
		END IF
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//	IF gu_ybjk_new.uf_zy_jscl( al_zyh, ai_jscs, adt_zzrq, ab_jsbz, ai_jslx, as_fplsh, as_jydd, astr_yb_jsxx, as_msg) < 0 then
	//		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
	//		RETURN -1
	//	ELSE
	//		RETURN 1
	//	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT JSMXLSH Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
	IF ls_mxzdh > '' THEN
	ELSE
		as_error = '取不到对应病人的明细帐信息!'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('41')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
	This.uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
	//7	明细序号列表	composite		是		以%%分隔 d_zy_fymx_jlxh
	u_datastore luds_jlxh
	Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_pos,ll_pos1
	Dec{0} ld_jlxh
	luds_jlxh = Create u_datastore
	luds_jlxh.setworktrans( gtrans_temp_mssql)
	luds_jlxh.DataObject = 'd_zy_fymx_jlxh'
	luds_jlxh.SetTransObject( gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ll_count = luds_jlxh.Retrieve(al_zyh )
	
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To  ll_count
		IF ll_cur = ll_count THEN
			ls_mxxhlb += String(luds_jlxh.Object.jlxh[ll_cur])
		ELSE
			ls_mxxhlb += String(luds_jlxh.Object.jlxh[ll_cur]) + "%%"
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	This.uf_send_add('明细序号列表',ls_mxxhlb)
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0'  THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ls_mxxhlb = This.uf_getstring('未上传成功的明细序号列表')
		IF IsNull(ls_mxxhlb) Or ls_mxxhlb = '' THEN
			RETURN 1
		ELSE
			ll_pos = Pos ( ls_mxxhlb, "%%" )
			ll_pos1 = 1
			DO WHILE ll_pos >= 0
				IF ll_pos = 0 THEN
					ld_jlxh = Dec(Mid(ls_mxxhlb,ll_pos1,Len(ls_mxxhlb) - ll_pos1 + 1 ))
				ELSE
					ld_jlxh = Dec(Mid(ls_mxxhlb,ll_pos1,ll_pos - ll_pos1))
					ll_pos1 = ll_pos + 2
				END IF
				//如果明螪AT*
钢行姆祷匚瓷洗�，则ztbz 置-1，重新上传
				gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				UPDATE JKXT.YB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And ywlx = 'ZY' And ywlsh = :ld_jlxh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
					gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				IF ll_pos <= 0 THEN EXIT
				ll_pos = Pos ( ls_mxxhlb, "%%",ll_pos1 )
			LOOP
			gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			as_error = '有明细未上传，请进帐卡上传明细!'
			RETURN 2
			//状态置完后传明细，将未上传的明细上传
			//		this.uf_zy_mxsc(al_zyh, /*string as_jbr*/, /*string as_cbrlb*/, /*ref string as_error */)
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_zy (string as_cbrlb, ref string as_msg);long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
integer li_ybfl
string ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0'
DEC{0} ldc_yzzh

ll_count = ids_zyfymx.rowcount( )
FOR ll_cur = 1 to ll_count
	IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 0 THEN //费用
		ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
			ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
		END IF
		ls_dffbz = '0'
	ELSE
		ls_dffbz = '0'
		ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_cur],as_msg )
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
			ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
		END IF

		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 3 THEN
			ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find]
			ll_find = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_dffbz = '2'
			ELSE
				ls_dffbz = '1'
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(as_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,'30','',ls_dffbz,Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_cur]),li_ybfl,'PT',as_msg)
	ids_zyfymx.object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
	ids_zyfymx.object.ybfl[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
NEXT
RETURN 1
		
end function

public function integer uf_zy_jscl (string as_jbr, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, boolean ab_jsbz, integer ai_jslx, string as_fplsh, string as_jydd, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_msg);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_msg = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
//ab_jsbz true:出院结算 0:预结算
String ls_klb,ls_knsj,ls_xzqh,ls_temp,ls_ret[]
Long ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,JSDH Into :ls_knsj,:ll_jsdh From ZY_BRRY  Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
ls_temp = ls_knsj
//6传入：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|电子凭证令牌
IF left(ls_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (ls_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	ls_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 OR len(ls_knsj) = 24 THEN//OR len(as_knsj) = 22 
	IF len(ls_knsj) = 24 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF Left(ls_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zy_jscl( al_zyh, ai_jscs, adt_zzrq, ab_jsbz, ai_jslx, as_fplsh, as_jydd, astr_yb_jsxx, as_msg) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	Long ll_zyh,ll_RecvCount,ll_brks
	Integer li_cyfs
	String ls_jzbh,ls_zyhm,ls_jsjylsh
	Dec{2} ldc_zjje = 0
	String ls_zzys,ls_mxzdh = ''
	DateTime ldt_cyrq,ldt_jsrq,ldt_bqcysj
	SetNull(ldt_cyrq)
	SELECT KNXX,CYRQ,BRKS,ZZYS,CYFS,ZYHM INTO :ls_knsj,:ldt_cyrq,:ll_brks,:ls_zzys,:li_cyfs,:ls_zyhm
		From ZY_BRRY  Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
	//	SELECT Max(ZZRQ) Into :ldt_scjssj From ZY_ZYJS Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZFPB = 0 ;
	SELECT bqcysj Into :ldt_bqcysj From zy_brry_kz  Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_bqcysj) and date(ldt_bqcysj) > date(1900,1,1) THEN
		ldt_cyrq = ldt_bqcysj
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ldt_cyrq) THEN
		ldt_cyrq = gf_server_date()
	END IF
	
	SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_jzbh From zy_brry_kz Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
	ll_RecvCount = 0
	SELECT Count(*),SUM(ZJJE) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ( JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null ) and ZJJE - NVL(YHJE,0) <> 0 ;
	IF ll_RecvCount > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		SELECT Count(*),SUM(ZJJE) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) and ZJJE - NVL(YHJE,0) <> 0 ;
	END IF
	
	IF ll_RecvCount = 0 THEN
		as_msg = '无结算数据'
		RETURN 0
	END IF
	SELECT Max(JSMXLSH) Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
	IF IsNull(ls_mxzdh) THEN ls_mxzdh = ''
	
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	IF ab_jsbz = False THEN //预结算
		of_reset_jsxx(  astr_pyyb_jsxx )
		This.uf_send_init('34')
		IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
			ls_klb = '2'
		ELSE
			ls_klb = '0'
		END IF
		This.uf_send_init('34')
		This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
		This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
		This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		
		uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
		uf_send_add('住院登记结算交易号',ls_jzbh)
		uf_send_add('本次结算明细条数',ll_RecvCount)
		uf_send_add('出院日期',Date(ldt_cyrq))
		uf_send_add('是否使用个帐支付','0')
		uf_send_add('提交明细的总条数',ll_RecvCount)
		uf_send_add('预住院标志','0')
	ELSE //确认结算	
		//矰AT*
鲈呵氨匦胂鹊饔
38号交易（确认结算前，都会调用预结算，所以提前调用）
		IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'1',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //入院变更
		IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'2',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //出院变更
		//-----------------------------
		//jyjk jyjslx 开始结算
		IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
			ls_klb = '2'
		ELSE
			ls_klb = '0'
		END IF
		This.uf_send_init('36')
		This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
		This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
		This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		
		uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
		uf_send_add('住院登记结算交易号',ls_jzbh)
		uf_send_add('本次结算明细条数',ll_RecvCount)
		uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
		uf_send_add('出院日期',Date(ldt_cyrq))
		uf_send_add('是否使用个帐支付','0')
		uf_send_add('预住院标志','0')
	END IF
	
	IF uf_send(as_msg) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			ldt_jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( "结算日期") //		结算日期	datetime	20	否		 yyyyMMdd hh24miss
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq = ldt_jsrq
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf) //   计算结果信息	composite	 			参照29号交易的计算结果信息
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhye  = astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
			of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd) //	 基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否		参照29号交易的基金分段信息
			//		超限明细列表	composite				参照29号交易礑AT*
某�限明细列�

			//		超限列表结构体参数：
			//序号	名称	类型	长度(精度)	不能为空	值范围	备注
			//1	药品诊疗类型	string	1	否		 参考数据字典
			//2	医院项目编码	string	20	否		 
			//3	超限数量	double	10(2)	否		
			//4	超限自费金额	double	10(2)	否		 
			//5	合计自费金额 	double	10(2)	否		
			//6	超限原因代码	 string	1	否		1:单价限额 2：单次限额 3：单次限量 4：年度限量
			//7	超限原因说明	 string	100	否	
			IF ab_jsbz THEN
				//		费用汇总信息结构体	composite				如下所示：
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh =  This.uf_getstring('住院结算交易交流水号')
				of_get_fyhzxx(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_fyhzxx)
				IF of_insert_jymx( '', al_zyh, ai_jscs, as_fplsh, 'ZY', as_jydd, '36' ,'30',  '', ls_zyhm,astr_pyyb_jsxx, '' , as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
				//做确认交易，确认交易失败仍然认为是失败交易
				
				//				IF This.uf_qrybjs('ZY',astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh ,as_msg,astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh,ls_zyhm) < 0 THEN
				IF This.uf_qrybjs_zy('ZY',astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh ,'1','2',astr_pyyb_jsxx,as_msg,astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh,ls_zyhm) < 0 THEN
					as_msg = '本地医保结算成功，确认失败：' +as_msg
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			istr_pyyb_jsxx = astr_pyyb_jsxx
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

		END IF

	//
	//str_pyyb_ylfyzf lstr_pyyb_ylfyzf
	astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx

   astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhye  = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye// astr_pyyb_mzsfqqstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
	astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx.smkzhye = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye
	istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye  = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye//uf_getdecimal( '市民卡账户余额')
		
	of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
	IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
		IF of_insert_jymx( as_brbm,	0,	0, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.fplsh,ls_ghsf	, as_jydd,	'30' ,ls_jyjslb,ls_tbmbdm, ls_jzxlh,astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,'', as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
		//		IF this.of_update_jsmx( /*str_pyyb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx*/, /*ref string as_error */)
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN

			RETURN -1

		String ls_qrjslsh //
		IF This.uf_qrybjs_mz( ls_ghsf, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jslsh, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq, as_error, ls_qrjslsh, ls_jzxlh) < 0 THEN

		ELSE
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh = ls_qrjslsh
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
//ai_jslx 0:预结算（不保存明细） 1:结算确认


end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_mz (datastore ads_fymx, string as_jylx, string as_jyjslb, string as_jbbm, ref string as_msg);Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Integer li_ybfl
String ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0',ls_cbrlb,ls_lx
Dec{0} ldc_yzzh
ls_cbrlb = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbrlb
ll_count = ads_fymx.RowCount( )
ls_lx = Left(as_jylx,2)
IF ls_lx = 'GH' THEN
	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
			ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,as_jbbm,'0',Date(gf_server_date()),li_ybfl,as_jylx,as_msg)
			IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
			ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'YJ' THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			END IF
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			ls_dffbz = '0'
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
			END IF
			IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' And ads_fymx.Object.sfxm[ll_cur] = 3   THEN
				ll_find = ads_fymx.Find("YWLX ='CF' and YWLSH=" +String(ads_fymx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]) + " and getrow() <> " + String(ll_cur) +& 					" and ( xmlsh <> " + String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + & 					" and xmlsh <> " +  String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and xmlsh <> " +String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) + ")",1,999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ls_dffbz = '2' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
				ELSE
					ls_dffbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,as_jbbm,ls_dffbz,Date(gdt_sysdatetime),li_ybfl,as_jylx,as_msg)
		IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
		ads_fymx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = String(li_ybfl)
	NEXT
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

	//	ll_pz1 = cpu()
	FOR j = 1 To astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.RowCount()
		ls_dfybz = '0' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
		//ldc_ywlsh = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j]
		This.uf_send_add_in('明细单据号码',ls_djhm,j)
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + Round(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[j],2)
		ls_bah = ''
		ls_xmzxbh = ''
		IF FRE*
astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[j] = 'YJ' THEN
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(0,astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[j],0,as_error)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ldc_ywlsh = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j]
				ldc_ywmxxh = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.mxxh[j]
				ls_zlxmbm = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
				ls_ypzllb = ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find]
				ls_xmmc = ids_ylsf.Object.#11[ll_find]
				ls_yyxmbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#9[ll_find]
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#2[ll_find]
				This.uf_send_add_in('单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.#4[ll_find])),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('医院端规格','',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('医院端剂型','',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('处方号',String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j]),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('帖数','1',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('用药天数',0,j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('用法','无',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('用量单位','',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('用法标准','',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('计价单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.#4[ll_find])),j)
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find] = 2 THEN
						IF ldc_ywmxxh > 0 THEN
							SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And YWMXXH = :ldc_ywmxxh And ywlx = 'YJ' And ztbz >= 0 ;
						END IF
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And ywlx = 'YJ' And ztbz >= 0 ;
						END IF
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							//需要备案没有备案的都强制自费;考虑到干部保健和离休不需要备案，如果审批成公费的则按公费 
							//	29号交易收费项目列表新增字段21：备案号modify by sxl 2015-7-7
							IF astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 2 Or astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
						
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,j)
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(1,astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[j],astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.cdlsh[j],as_error)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				This.uf_send_add_in('单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.#8[ll_find])),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('医院端规格',String(ids_typk.Object.#5[ll_find]),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('医院端剂型','',j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('处方号',String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j]),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('帖数',1,j) //String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.cfts[j])
				uf_send_add_in('用药天数','0',j)
				IF astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[j] = 'CF' And (astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.sfxm[j] = 3  ) THEN
					
					ldc_ywlsh = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j]
					ll_find1 = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Find("YWLX ='"+String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[j]) + "' and YWLSH=" +& 						String(ldc_ywlsh) + " and getrow() <> " + String(j) +& 						" and ( xmlsh <> " + String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + & 						" and xmlsh <> " +  String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and xmlsh <> " +String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) + ")",1,999999)
					//	" and ypzh ='" + string(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ypzh[ll_row])+"' " +& 去掉药品组号,很多医生组号没有关注,跟药剂科商量以cflsh为准
					IF ll_find1 > 0 THEN
						ls_dfybz = '2' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
					ELSE
						ls_dfybz = '1'
					END IF
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('计价单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.#11[ll_find])),j)
				ls_zlxmbm = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#2[ll_find]
				ls_yyxmbh = ids_typk.Object.#14[ll_find]
				ls_ypzllb = ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find]
				ls_xmmc = ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find]
				IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ycjl[j]) THEN
					This.uf_send_add_in('用法','无',j)
				ELSE
					This.uf_send_add_in('用法',String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ycjl[j]),j)
				END IF
				This.uf_send_add_in('用量单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.#4[ll_find])),j)
				This.uf_send_add_in('用法标准','',j)
				//----------add by sxl 2015-7-1------------------
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报
						SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And ywlx = 'CF' And ztbz >= 0 ;
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							IF astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 2 Or astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,j)
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//	This.uf_send_add_in('项目医院编号',Long(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_row]),j)
		This.uf_send_add_in('项目医院编号',ls_yyxmbh,j)
		This.uf_send_add_in('项目医院端名称',ls_xmmc,j)
		//		This.uf_send_add_in('项目医院端名称',String(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmmc[j]),j)
		
		uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',ls_ypzllb,j)
		uf_send_add_in('数量',Round(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[j],2),j)
		uf_send_add_in('单价',Round(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmdj[j],4),j)
		uf_send_add_in('项目总金额',Round(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[j],2),j)
		//
		ldc_zfbl = Round(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[j],3)
		ls_ybfl = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ypzh[j]
		//		li_ybfl = //医保分类
		This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dfybz,j)
		CHOOSE CASE  astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j]
			CASE 9,1
				ldc_zfbl = 1.00
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','1',j)
			CASE 8,2
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',j)
			CASE ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',j)
		END CHOOSE
		
		This.uf_send_add_in('自付比例',ldc_zfbl,j)
		IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zyh[ll_insert] = 0
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BRBM[ll_insert] = as_brbm
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[j] //如 'CF','YJ'
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j] //如cflsh,yjlsh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywmxlsh[ll_insert] = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.mxxh[j] //如cfmx.xh yjk2.lsh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jsmxlsh[ll_insert] =  ls_jzxlh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ypzllb[ll_insert] = ls_ypzllb
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zlbl[ll_insert] = ldc_zfbl
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ybfl[ll_insert] = ls_ybfl
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dffbz[ll_insert] = Long(ls_dfybz)
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XMZXBH[ll_insert] = ls_xmzxbh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BALSH[ll_insert] = ls_bah
		END IF
	NEXT
	This.uf_send_add('收费明细医疗费用总额',ldc_zjje)
	
	IF Not uf_send(as_error)  THEN
		
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	//	of_reset_jsxx(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx)
	IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
		astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')
	END IF
	
	//超限提示标记	string	1	是		提示标记(1:有提示信息 0或者其他：无提示信息)
	//规定病种标志	string	1	是		0非特种病结算，1特种病结算
	//结算时间	datetime	20	是		 yyyymmdd hh24miss
	Integer li_cxtsbj,li_gdbzbz
	li_cxtsbj = Integer(This.uf_getstring('超限提示标记'))
	li_gdbzbz = Integer(This.uf_getstring('规定病种标志'))
	astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( '结算时间')
	//计算结果信息	composite	 	否		 
	//基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否		目前默认为空
	//超限明细列表	composite		否		
	//
	//str_pyyb_ylfyzf lstr_pyyb_ylfyzf
	astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
	of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
	astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhye  = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye// astr_pyyb_mzsfqqstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
	istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye  = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye//uf_getdecimal( '市民卡账户余额')
				
	of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
	
	IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
		IF of_insert_jymx( as_brbm,	0,	0, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.fplsh,ls_ghsf	, as_jydd,	'30' ,ls_jyjslb,ls_tbmbdm, ls_jzxlh,astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,'', as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
		
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
		ELSE
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
			as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		String ls_qrjslsh //ls_jzxlh
		//		IF This.uf_qrybjs( ls_ghsf, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jslsh, as_error, ls_qrjslsh,ls_jzxlh) < 0 THEN
		IF This.uf_qrybjs_mz( ls_ghsf, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jslsh, astr_pyyb_mzsfqq,as_error, ls_qrjslsh,ls_jzxlh) < 0 THEN
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh = ''
			//			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh = ls_qrjslsh
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh = ls_qrjslsh
		END IF
		//直接确认
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_mz_tfcl (string as_knsj, string as_jslsh, string as_jbr, decimal adc_ylfyze, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);String ls_klb,ls_xzqh,ls_ret[]
Integer li_ret
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
 	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 OR len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN//OR len(as_knsj) = 22 
	IF len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
//
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','') //modify by sxl 全局变量的控制 2015-10-22
	//	IF ii_com = 0 Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
	//		li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr( as_knsj, as_jslsh, adc_ylfyze, as_jydd, adt_jssj, astr_yb_jsxx, as_error)
	//	ELSE
	//		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = this
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr( as_knsj, as_jslsh, adc_ylfyze, as_jydd, adt_jssj, astr_yb_jsxx, as_error)
	//	END IF
	//	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr( as_knsj, as_jslsh, adc_ylfyze, as_jydd, adt_jssj, astr_yb_jsxx, as_error) < 0 THEN
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
		as_error = is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('31')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易号',as_jslsh)
	This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			Integer li_cftf
			//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
			li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否为重复退费'))
			IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
			
			//不管是否为重复退费，都能让其继续退费
			IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
			ELSE
				as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
				
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.jylx = 'CFTF'
			END IF
			
			//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	否
			//8	退费交易结算日期	datetime	20	否
			//9	退费计算结果信息	composite	 	否
			//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	否
			//ADD BY SXL 2015-12-25
			//			11	市民卡账户支付退款金额	Double	10（2）	否		
			//			12	市民卡清算日期	String	8	否		Yyyymmdd
			//			13	市民卡交易流水号	String	20	否		
			
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算日期')
			IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户支付退款金额')
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = This.uf_getdate('市民卡清算日期')
				IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) Or Date(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
					astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
				END IF
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡交易流水号')
			END IF
			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
			//			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhye = astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
			of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd) //astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq
			of_update_jymx_tp(  as_jslsh, as_jydd,adt_jssj ,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
		END IF
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_get_jzxlh (ref string as_jzxlh, integer ai_jslx, ref string as_error);Decimal{0} ll_Value
Long ll_Count
Long ll_Retry
//判断事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	Process_Begin:
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	
	UPDATE GY_IDENTITY SET VALUE = VALUE + 1
		Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN // update失败，判断是否存在记录
		SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
			Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ll_Count > 0 THEN // 记录存在继续update(最多三次)
			ll_Retry ++
			IF ll_Retry >= 3 THEN
				GOTO Process_Error
			ELSE
				Gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
				GOTO Process_Begin
			END IF
		ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
			INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
				Values ('PYYB_JZXLH',2013080101,2013080101,1) Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN GOTO Process_Error
			ll_Value = 2013080101
			GOTO Process_Success
		END IF
	ELSE
		SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
			Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ll_Count > 0 THEN
		ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
			INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
				Values ('PYYB_JZXLH',2013080101,1,1) Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN GOTO Process_Error
			ll_Value = 2013080101
			GOTO Process_Success
		END IF
	END IF
	
	SetNull(ll_Value)
	SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN GOTO Process_Error
	IF ll_Value < 2013080101 THEN GOTO Process_Error
	
	Process_Success:
	gf_Commit_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
	as_jzxlh = String(ll_Value)
	RETURN 1
	
	Process_Error:
	gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	SetNull(ll_Value)
	SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN
		as_jzxlh = 'PYYB2013080101'
	ELSE
		as_jzxlh = 'PYYB' + String(ll_Value + 1)
	END IF
END IF

RETURN 1
//String ls_paraname,ls_valule

private function integer of_insert_jymx (string as_brbm, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, string as_fplsh, string as_ywly, string as_jydd, string as_jyjk, string as_jyjslx, string as_tsmxbzdm, string as_jzxlh, str_pyyb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, string as_bzxx, ref string as_error);IF al_zyh = 0 And as_brbm > '' THEN
	String ls_brbm
	//	ls_brbm = 'SBPY'+astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx.grbh //病人编号
	IF This.ib_yd THEN
		as_error = '该为异地病人:' +as_brbm + '插入有误！'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = 'SBPY' + astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx.grsbbh
	END IF
	IF ls_brbm <> as_brbm THEN
		String ls_ybrbm = ''
		//有卡号不变，个人编码有变的
		SELECT YBRBM Into :ls_ybrbm From MZXT.MZ_BRDA_YBLS Where XBRBM = :ls_brbm;
		IF ls_ybrbm <> as_brbm Or ls_ybrbm = '' THEN
			as_error = '病人编码不一致:医保端:' + ls_brbm +" HIS端:" + as_brbm
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN 0

public function integer uf_qrybjs (string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh, string as_jzxlh);as_error ='确认出错'
return -1
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send
Integer li_xxtlx,li_ret
Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '36~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '30~~'
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~$$'
//IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_error,false) THEN
//	as_error = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_error
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

IF ib_yd THEN
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
ELSE
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
END IF

//IF li_ret < 0 THEN
//	as_error = String(li_ret)
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	RETURN -1
END IF
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
//IF of_update_jsmx(as_qrjslsh,as_jsjylsh,as_jzxlh,as_error) < 0 THEN
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

//f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,'$$~~~~30~12345678901234~2~HIS数据保存失败$$'，$$0~~~~$$，""）
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer uf_zy_tfcl (string as_knsj, string as_zyhm, string as_czyxm, string as_jydd, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//参保人员住院结算后若发现结算问题，需要通过退费交易处理。退费时生成负记录，重新结算时需重新上传明细。
//调用本交易将住院发生的结算数据通过产生负数方式取消，恢复为未出院状态（住院冻结），只有重新结算后卡才会被解冻。
String ls_klb,ls_jsjylsh,ls_xzqh,ls_temp,ls_ret[]
//SELECT ZY_BRRY_KZ.YBJZBH Into :ls_jzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ,ZY_BRRY Where ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH AND ZY_BRRY.ZYHM = :as_zyhm;
ls_temp = as_knsj
//6传入：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|电子凭证令牌
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
 	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 or len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
	
	IF len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
Long ll_zyh,ll_jsdh
DateTime ldt_jssj
SELECT zyh,jsdh Into :ll_zyh,:ll_jsdh From zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_zyhm Using itran_sqlca;
IF ib_yd = False THEN
	SELECT jssj,qrjylsh Into :ldt_jssj,:ls_jsjylsh From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where zyh =  :ll_zyh And  qrjylsh Is Not Null And ztbz In (1,2) Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	//	SELECT jllsh,mxzdh,jyjk,cbdxzhq,jzbh,ylfyze,jssj,ztbz INTO
	//		:ldc_jllsh,:ls_mxzdh,:ls_jyjk,:ls_cbdxzhq,:ls_jzbh,:ldc_sbfyze,:ldt_min_sfsj,:li_ztbz
	//		From JKXT.yb_jsmx Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And jscs = :ldc_jscs  And rownum = 1;
	Dec{2} ldc_ylfyze
	str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
	Integer li_ztbz
	SELECT ylfyze,jssj,jsjylsh,ztbz Into :ldc_ylfyze,:ldt_jssj,:ls_jsjylsh,:li_ztbz From JKXT.yb_jsmx Where zyh =  :ll_zyh And  jsjylsh Is Not Null And ztbz In (1,2) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取医保信息失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF li_ztbz <> 1 THEN
			as_error = '状态不对' + String(li_ztbz)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr( as_knsj, ls_jsjylsh, ldc_ylfyze, as_jydd, ldt_jssj, lstr_yb_jsxx, as_error) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '异地交易' + as_error
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		as_error = lstr_yb_jsxx.jsjylsh + '成功' + String(lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.ylfyze)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jsjylsh) Or ls_jsjylsh = '' THEN
	as_error = '取结算交易流水号出错'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	as_zyhm = as_zyhm + '-' + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF

This.uf_send_init('37')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院结算交易号',ls_jsjylsh)
This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院号',as_zyhm)
This.uf_send_add('操作员姓名',as_czyxm)

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	//1	交易状态	integer	4	是
	//2	错误信息	string	100	否
	//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否
	//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否
	//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		Integer li_cftf
		//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
		li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否为重复退费'))
		IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
		END IF
		//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	否
		//8	退费交易结算日期	datetime	20	否
		//9	退费计算结果信息	composite	 	否
		//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	否
		//ADD BY SXL 2015-12-25
		//			11	市民卡账户支付退款金额	Double	10（2）	否		
		//			12	市民卡清算日期	String	8	否		Yyyymmdd
		//			13	市民卡交易流水号	String	20	否		
		
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费交易结算日期')
		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
		//		astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhye  = astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
		of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
		IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户支付退款金额')
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = This.uf_getdate('市民卡清算日期')
			IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) Or Date(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
			END IF
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡交易流水号')
		END IF
		of_update_jymx_tp(  ls_jsjylsh, as_jydd, ldt_jssj,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
		
	END IF
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1






end function

public function integer uf_zy_tfcl (string as_knsj, string as_jsjylsh, decimal adc_ylfyze, string as_zyhm, string as_czyxm, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//参保人员住院结算后若发现结算问题，需要通过退费交易处理。退费时生成负记录，重新结算时需重新上传明细。
//调用本交易将住院发生的结算数据通过产生负数方式取消，恢复为未出院状态（住院冻结），只有重新结算后卡才会被解冻。
String ls_klb,ls_xzqh,ls_temp,ls_ret[]
//,ls_knsj,ls_zyhm,ls_jzbh
//SELECT KNXX,ZYHM Into :ls_knsj,:ls_zyhm  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh;

//END IF

ls_temp = as_knsj
//6传入：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|电子凭证令牌
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
 	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 or Len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
	IF len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF

IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_tkqr(as_knsj, as_jsjylsh,adc_ylfyze, as_jydd, adt_jssj, astr_yb_jsxx, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	long ll_jsdh
	SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_zyhm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode  = 100 Or itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF ll_jsdh >= 1 THEN
			ll_jsdh = ll_jsdh + 1
			as_zyhm = as_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
		END IF

	This.uf_send_init('37')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院结算交易号',as_jsjylsh)
	This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院号',as_zyhm)
	This.uf_send_add('操作员姓名',as_czyxm)
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN

		//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否
		//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			Integer li_cftf
			//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
			//			li_cftf = This.uf_getdecimal( '是否为重复退费')
			li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否为重复退费'))
			IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
			IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
			ELSE
				as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'

			//8	退费交易结算日期	datetime	20	否
			//9	退费计算结果信息	composite	 	否

		   astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx

			of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
			IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户支付退款金额')
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = This.uf_getdate('市民卡清算日期')
				IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) Or Date(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
					astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
				END IF
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡交易流水号')
			END IF
//			of_update_jymx_tp(  astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh, as_jydd, astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
         of_update_jymx_tp(  as_jsjylsh, as_jydd, adt_jssj,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
			//			ELSE
			//				as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
			//				RETURN 1
			//			END IF
		END IF
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_mx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error, long al_zyh);//as_klb:12：社保卡（磁卡）13：一卡通的卡（IC卡
//istr_yb_zhxx = istr_yb_zhxx_null
String ls_klb
IF Len(as_knsj) > 30 OR len(as_knsj) = 24 THEN
	IF len(as_knsj) = 24  THEN
	   ls_klb = '3'
	ELSE 
		ls_klb = '2'
	END IF
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN

	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')

	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zhcx( as_knsj, as_error) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1

		RETURN 1

	//	END IF

		Long ll_brxz,ll_tgdw
		String ls_tjlxh,ls_cbrlb
		SELECT brxz,tgdw Into :ll_brxz,:ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		ls_tjlxh = String(ll_brxz) + String(ll_tgdw)
		SELECT DMSB Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'PYYB-GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh;
		istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbrlb = ls_cbrlb
		RETURN 1
	END IF
	RETURN uf_zhcx( as_knsj, as_error)
	
	
	//	str_yb_smkzh str_yb_smkzh_null

	//		//	9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
