public function decimal of_get_zfbl (string as_cbrlb, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, string as_tsbbm, string as_dfybz, date adt_jfrq, ref integer ai_sfdj, string as_jylx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_cbrlb 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ypzllb	
// 	value    	string  	as_zxxmbm	
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlb  	
// 	value    	string  	as_tsbbm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_dfybz 	
// 	value    	date	adt_jfrq 	
// 	reference	integer 	ai_sfdj  	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.04.17
//====================================================================

Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
//This.uf_send_init('58')
//this.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
//this.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
//This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
//This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
//This.uf_send_add('药品诊疗类别',as_ypzllb)
//This.uf_send_add('中心项目编码',as_zxxmbm)
//This.uf_send_add('医疗待遇类别',as_cbrlb)
//This.uf_send_add('业务类别',as_ywlb)
//This.uf_send_add('疾病编码',as_tsbbm)
//This.uf_send_add('单复方标志',as_dfybz)
//This.uf_send_add('交易时间',String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd'))
//This.uf_send_add('医疗机构类型',is_yljglx)
//Long ll_find
//CBRLB, YPZLLB, XMZXLSH, YWLB, DFBZ
Long ll_ret = -100
IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
	SELECT ZFBL,SFDJ INTO :ldc_zfbl,:ai_sfdj FROM jkxt.pyyb_fyypbl WHERE CBRLB = :as_cbrlb AND YPZLLB = :as_ypzllb AND
		XMZXLSH = :as_zxxmbm And YWLB = :as_ywlb And DFBZ = :as_dfybz Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '获取自付比例和收费等级失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_ret = itran_sqlca.SQLCode
END IF

IF ll_ret = 100 Or as_jylx <> 'PT'  THEN
	//	IF as_jylx = 'TSB' THEN
	//		as_tsbbm = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.tsbbm
	//	ELSEIF as_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
	//		as_tsbbm = istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.mxbbm
	//	END IF
	
	String ls_send,ls_recieve
	Long li_ret
	ls_recieve = Space(3000)
	//Long lt_1,lt_2
	//lt_1 = CPU()
	IF IsNull(as_tsbbm) THEN as_tsbbm = ''
	ls_send = "$$0~~~~1~~~~"+as_ypzllb+"~~" +as_zxxmbm + "~~"+as_cbrlb+"~~"+as_ywlb+"~~"+as_tsbbm+"~~"+as_dfybz+"~~"+String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd')+"~~"+is_yljglx+"$$" //$$0~~0~~~~1~~~~"+as_ypzllb 	 	IF is_init_date <> String(Today(),'yyyymmdd') THEN 		IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_error,False) THEN
			as_error = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	//long ll_app1,ll_app2
	//ll_app1 = cpu()
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(58,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
	//ll_app2 = cpu()
	//gf_applog(string(ll_app1) + "医保交易apply:" +  string(ll_app2 - ll_app1))
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_error = String(li_ret)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾
	
	Integer li_pos
	li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
	IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//
	li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
	String ls_return
	ls_return = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	ldc_zfbl = Dec(ls_return)
	ls_recieve = Left(ls_recieve,li_pos - 2)
	li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
	ls_return = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	ai_sfdj = Integer(ls_return)
	IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		INSERT INTO JKXT.PYYB_FYYPBL(CBRLB, YPZLLB, XMZXLSH, YWLB, DFBZ,ZFBL,SFDJ,XZSJ) VALUES
			(:as_cbrlb,:as_ypzllb,:as_zxxmbm,:as_ywlb,:as_dfybz,:ldc_zfbl,:ai_sfdj,SYSDATE) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = '获取自付比例和收费礑AT* ' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
RETURN ldc_zfbl


end function

public function integer uf_mz_gzcl (string as_knsj, string as_jslsh, string as_jbr, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);String ls_klb
IF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
//
IF ib_yd THEN
	return 0
ELSE
	IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
		as_error = is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('31')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易号',as_jslsh)
	This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			Integer li_cftf
			//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退稤AT*

			li_cftf = integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否为重复退费'))
			IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
			
			//不管是否为重复退费，都能让其继续退费
			IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
			ELSE
				as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
			END IF
			//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	否
			//8	退费交易结算日期	datetime	20	否
			//9	退费计算结果信息	composite	 	否
			//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	否
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算日期')
			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
			of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd) //astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq
			of_update_jymx_gz(  as_jslsh, as_jydd,adt_jssj ,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
		END IF
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_zy_gzcl (string as_qrjylsh, string as_knsj, string as_zyhm, string as_czyxm, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//参保人员住院结算后若发现结算问题，需要通过退费交易处理。退费时生成负记录，重新结算时需重新上传明细。
//调用本交易将住院发生的结算数据通过产生负数方式取消，恢复为未出院状态（住院冻结），只有重新结算后卡才会被解冻。
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_klb,ls_xzqh,ls_temp,ls_ret[]

ls_temp = as_knsj
//6传入：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|电子凭证令牌
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
 	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF

IF ib_yd THEN
	as_error = '异地交易'
	RETURN -1
END IF

This.uf_send_init('37')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院结算交易号',as_qrjylsh)
This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院号',as_zyhm)
This.uf_send_add('操作员姓名',as_czyxm)

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	//1	交易状态	integer	4	是
	//2	错误信息	string	100	否
	//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否
	//4	扣银行卡结笵AT*
	string	1	否
	//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		Integer li_cftf
		//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
		li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否为重复退费'))
		IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
		END IF
		//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	否
		//8	退费交易结算日期	datetime	20	否
		//9	退费计算结果信息	composite	 	否
		//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	否
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费交易结算日期')
		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
		of_get_jjfd(astr_pyyb_jsxx.str_pyyb_jjfd)
		of_update_jymx_gz(  as_qrjylsh, as_jydd, adt_jssj,  astr_pyyb_jsxx, as_error)
		
	END IF
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_zydj (ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, date ad_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, string as_zszh, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error, ref transaction atr_trans, boolean ab_commit);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.Script - uf_zydj ( ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, date ad_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error, ref transaction atr_trans, boolean()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.06.05
//====================================================================

String ls_ksbm = '0100',ls_ksmc = '刚入院未分配科室',ls_xzqh,ls_temp,ls_ret[] //默认
String ls_zdmc = '',ls_ryzd = '',ls_zddm1,ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3,ls_klb,ls_zddms[]
Long ll_row,ll_tes,ll_jsdh
ls_temp = as_knsj
IF left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' or pos (as_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '6'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
 	ls_xzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.cbdxzqh
	IF ls_xzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSEIF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
	ls_klb = '2'
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ib_yd = False
	ELSE
		ib_yd = True
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_klb = '0'
	ib_yd = False
END IF
//准生证号
IF IsNull(as_zszh) THEN as_zszh = ''
//判断是否为生育，若为生育
IF as_rylx = '12' Or as_rylx = '15' THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_tes From bqxt.zy_brry_ye Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF ll_tes <= 0 Or IsNull(ll_tes) THEN ll_tes = 0
ELSE
	ll_tes = 0
END IF
//----------------
IF ib_yd THEN
	uf_send_init('YDJY')
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
	iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
	IF iu_ybjk_new.uf_zydj( as_knsj, al_ksdm, al_zyh, DateTime(ad_ryrq), as_zyhm, as_cwhm, as_bahm, as_ysbm,as_zydjjylsh, as_error, atr_trans, ab_commit) < 0 THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	//用于计数，解决住院号码撤销登记不能用问题2017-6-13
	SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
	//	if istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_ylsfyz.zydj = 1 then //如果住院冻结，那么认为是已经有登记在院
	IF atr_trans.SQLCode  = 100 Or atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF ll_jsdh >= 1 THEN
			ll_jsdh = ll_jsdh + 1
			as_zyhm = as_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
		END IF
	END IF
	IF IsNull(as_bahm) THEN as_bahm = ''
	This.uf_send_init('32')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	//基本信息
	This.uf_send_add('住院序列号',as_zyhm ) //5住院序列号	string	20	是		 住院序列号需唯一
	This.uf_send_add('病人档案号',as_bahm) //6病人档案号	string	20	否		
	This.uf_send_add('入院日期',ad_ryrq) //7入院日期	date	10	是		 yyyyMMdd
	//医生信息
	IF as_ysbm > '' THEN
	ELSE
		as_ysbm = 'NULL'
	END IF
	
	This.uf_send_add('入院诊断医生编码',as_ysbm) //8入院诊断医生编码	string	10	否	
	This.uf_send_add('入院诊断医生姓名',of_get_ygxm(as_ysbm)) //9入院诊断医生姓名	string	20	否	
	//诊断获取
	IF of_get_zy_zdxx(al_zyh,1,ls_zddm1,ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms,ls_ryzd) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '诊断取失败!'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('入院疾病编号',ls_zddm1) //10入院疾病编号	string	20	是		疾病编码统一用ICD10
	This.uf_send_add('入院疾病名称',ls_ryzd) //11入院疾病名称	string	50	是		
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）2',ls_zddm2) //12疾病编码（诊断编码）2	string	20	否	
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）3',ls_zddm3) //13疾病编码（诊断编码）3	string	20	否	
	This.uf_send_add('疾病副诊断及描述',ls_zdmc) //14疾病副诊断及描述	string	200	否		
	//-------诊断增加到10个---------
	IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
		Integer li_count,li_cur
		li_count = UpperBound ( ls_zddms )
		IF li_count > 0 THEN
			FOR li_cur = 1 To li_count
				This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur + 3),ls_zddms[li_cur])
			NEXT
		END IF
		IF li_count + 3 < 10 THEN
			FOR li_cur = li_count + 4 To ii_zdsl
				This.uf_send_add('疾病编码' +String(li_cur),'')
			NEXT
		END IF
	END IF
	//----------------------------
	//
	//科室信息
	IF al_ksdm > 0 THEN
		ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(al_ksdm))
		IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
			as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(al_ksdm)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(al_ksdm))
	END IF
	
	This.uf_send_add('入院科室ID',ls_ksbm) //15入院科室ID	string	10	是		 
	This.uf_send_add('入院科室名称',ls_ksmc) //16入院科室名称	string	50	否	
	//其他
	This.uf_send_add('床号',as_cwhm) //17床号	string	20	是		 格式：病区名+床号，如二病区2床
	This.uf_send_add('业务类型','30') //18业务类型	string	3	是		参考数据字典
	This.uf_send_add('入院类型',as_rylx) //19入院类型	string	3	是		1: 普通入院 2: 急诊或抢救入院 3: 转院入院 4：家庭病床5：单病种入院
	This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr) //22经办人	string	20	否		
	//-----是否还要再做判别(家庭病床，转院住院如何获取登记的单号)
	This.uf_send_add('登记单号',as_zszh) //20登记单号	string	20	否		转院住院和家庭病床时上传医保中心登记的单号；住院生育时上传准生证号。
	This.uf_send_add('胎儿数',ll_tes) //21胎儿数	integer	2	是		默认为0.生育时需要输入胎儿数（预留）
	This.uf_send_add('伤害类别',0) //23伤害类别	string	3	是		0正常疾病，1意外伤害（外伤指没有第三方责任人的），2意外伤害（有第三方责任人的）
	//-----------------------------------------------------
	//1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
	//2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
	//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
	//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
	//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
	//6	住院登记交易流水号	string	20	是		HIS必须保存此流水号
	str_pyyb_jsxx lstr_pyyb_jsxx
	String ls_error = '',ls_jyjd
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			IF Pos(as_error,'此住院序列号已被用') > 0  THEN
				IF uf_jycx('32', as_zyhm, ls_jyjd, lstr_pyyb_jsxx,ls_error) < 0 THEN
					if isnull(ls_error) then ls_error = ''
					as_error = as_error + ls_error
				ELSE
					IF lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh > '' THEN
						as_zydjjylsh = lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh
						GOTO YBDJ
					ELSE
						as_error = as_error + '：查询失败'
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			as_zydjjylsh = This.uf_getstring('住院登记交易流水号')
			IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
				istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smkzhye = uf_getdecimal( '市民卡账户余额')
				istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye = uf_getdecimal( '市民卡账户余额')
			END IF
		END IF
		YBDJ: 
		istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
		istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh = as_knsj
		istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
		IF ab_commit THEN
			gf_begin_transaction(atr_trans)
		END IF
		IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
			UPDATE zy_brry Set jsdh = :ll_jsdh Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
			IF ab_commit THEN
				IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
			END IF
		ELSE
			UPDATE zy_brry Set jsdh = 1 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
		END IF
		INSERT INTO "ZY_BRRY_KZ"  ( "ZYH",   "YBJZBH" )
			Values (:al_zyh , :as_zydjjylsh)  Using atr_trans ;
			
		UPDATE ZY_BRRY_KZ Set YBJZBH = :as_zydjjylsh Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
		//保存准生证号
		If (as_rylx = '12' Or as_rylx = '15') And Not IsNull(as_zszh) And as_zszh > '' THEN
			INSERT INTO BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2  ( "ZYH",   "ZSZH" )
				Values (:al_zyh , :as_zszh)  Using atr_trans ;
			UPDATE bqxt.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Set ZSZH = :as_zszh Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
		END IF
		
		IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh  = :al_zyh  Using atr_trans;
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			ELSE
				IF ab_commit THEN
					as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText
					gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)
					RETURN -1
				ELSE
					as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where  zyh = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0  Using atr_trans;
			IF ab_commit THEN  gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
			RETURN 1
		ELSE
			as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText
			IF ab_commit THEN  gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF Pos(as_error,'此住院序列号已被用') > 0  THEN
			IF uf_jycx('32', as_zyhm, ls_jyjd, lstr_pyyb_jsxx,ls_error) < 0 THEN
			   if isnull(ls_error) then ls_error = ''
				as_error = as_error + ls_error
			ELSE
				IF lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh > '' THEN
					as_zydjjylsh = lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh
					GOTO YBDJ
				ELSE
					as_error = as_error + '：查询失败'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF




end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, string as_zszh, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_jsdh,ll_count
//Date ld_ryrq
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_jsrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jfrq_min
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch

SELECT KNXX,BRKS,RYRQ,ZYHM,BRCH,BAHM,ZZYS,jsdh,jsrq
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ldt_ryrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:ll_jsdh,:ldt_jsrq
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(1900,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And Date(ldt_rysj) > Date(2000,1,1) THEN
			
			//判断入院时间，如果计费明细中的最小计费日期比病区入院时间小的，则取zy_brry.ryrq反之取病区入院时间
//			SELECT Min(jfrq) Into :ldt_jfrq_min From bqxt.zy_fymx Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jscs = 0  Using itran_sqlca;
//			
IF Date(ldt_rysj) <= Date(ldt_jfrq_min) THEN
				ldt_ryrq =  DateTime(Date(ldt_rysj))
//			END IF
		END IF
		//		IF Left(ls_knsj,6) = '330399' or len(ls_knsj) < 30 THEN
		//			ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
		//		ELSE
		//			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From bqxt.zy_yybr Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jgbz >= 0 And zy_yybr.yzypb In (1,2);
		//			IF ll_count > 0 THEN //预住院
		//				IF ldt_ryrq > ldt_rysj THEN
		//					ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
		//				END IF
		//			ELSE
		//				ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
		//			END IF
		//		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//if isnull(ll_jsdh)  then 
//else
//	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + right('00' +string(ll_jsdh),2)
//end if
RETURN uf_zydj( ls_knsj, ll_ksdm,al_zyh, Date(ldt_ryrq),ls_zyhm, ls_brch, ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, as_rylx,as_jbr, as_zszh,as_zydjjylsh, as_error)




end function

public function integer uf_zydj (ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, date ad_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, string as_zszh, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
END IF

IF Not IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) THEN
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
END IF
//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock

CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;


IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

RETURN uf_zydj(as_knsj,al_ksdm,al_zyh,ad_ryrq,as_zyhm,as_cwhm,as_bahm,as_ysbm,as_rylx,as_jbr,as_zszh,as_zydjjylsh,as_error,gtrans_temp_mssql,True)

end function

public function decimal of_get_zfbl79 (string as_cbrlb, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, string as_yzmxxh, string as_dfybz, date adt_jfrq, string as_jylx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_cbrlb 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ypzllb	
// 	value    	string  	as_zxxmbm	
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlb  	
// 	value    	string  	as_tsbbm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_dfybz 	
// 	value    	date	adt_jfrq 	
// 	reference	integer 	ai_sfdj  	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.04.17
//====================================================================
Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
//CBRLB, YPZLLB, XMZXLSH, YWLB, DFBZ
Long ll_ret = -100
IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
	SELECT ZFBL INTO :ldc_zfbl FROM jkxt.pyyb_fyypbl WHERE CBRLB = :as_cbrlb AND YPZLLB = :as_ypzllb AND
		XMZXLSH = :as_zxxmbm And YWLB = :as_ywlb And DFBZ = :as_dfybz Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '获取自付比例和收费等级失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_ret = itran_sqlca.SQLCode
END IF

IF ll_ret = 100 Or as_jylx <> 'PT'  THEN
	This.uf_send_init('79')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('待遇类别',as_cbrlb)
	This.uf_send_add('业务类型',as_ywlb)
	
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱明细序号',as_yzmxxh,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',as_ypzllb,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医保中心编码',as_zxxmbm,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',as_dfybz,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd'),1)
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	自付比例列表
		//	1)	医嘱明细序号
		// 2)	自付比列
		
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ldc_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自付比列', 1)
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		INSERT INTO JKXT.PYYB_FYYPBL(CBRLB, YPZLLB, XMZXLSH, YWLB, DFBZ,ZFBL,XZSJ,SFDJ) VALUES
			(:as_cbrlb,:as_ypzllb,:as_zxxmbm,:as_ywlb,:as_dfybz,:ldc_zfbl,SYSDATE,0) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = '插入自付比例失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
RETURN ldc_zfbl
end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_mz79 (ref datastore ads_fymx, string as_jylx, string as_jyjslb, ref string as_msg);Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Integer li_ybfl
String ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0',ls_cbrlb,ls_lx
Dec{0} ldc_yzzh
datetime ldt_curr
ls_cbrlb = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbrlb
ll_count = ads_fymx.RowCount( )
ls_lx = Left(as_jylx,2)
ldt_curr =gf_server_date()

IF ls_lx = 'GH' THEN
	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
			ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl79(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,'gh','0',Date(ldt_curr),as_jylx,as_msg)
			IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
//			ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'YJ' THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			END IF
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			ls_dffbz = '0'
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
			END IF
			IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' And ads_fymx.Object.sfxm[ll_cur] = 3   THEN
				ll_find = ads_fymx.Find("YWLX ='CF' and YWLSH=" +String(ads_fymx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]) + " and getrow() <> " + String(ll_cur) +& 					" and ( xmlsh <> " + String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + & 					" and xmlsh <> " +  String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and xmlsh <> " +String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) + ")",1,999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ls_dffbz = '2' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
				ELSE
					ls_dffbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl79(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,'sf',ls_dffbz,Date(ldt_curr),as_jylx,as_msg)
		IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
//		ads_fymx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = String(li_ybfl)
	NEXT
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_zy79 (string as_cbrlb, ref string as_msg);Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_row,ll_i
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Integer li_ybfl
String ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0',ls_yzmxxh
Dec{0} ldc_yzzh
ll_cur = 0
ll_row = 1
ll_count = ids_zyfymx.RowCount( )
DO WHILE ll_count >= ll_row
	This.uf_send_init('79')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('待遇类别',as_cbrlb)
	This.uf_send_add('业务类型','30')
	ll_i = 0
	FOR ll_cur = ll_row To ll_count
		ll_i ++
		ls_yzmxxh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_cur])
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 0 THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			END IF
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			ls_dffbz = '0'
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_cur],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
			END IF
			
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 3 THEN
				ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find]
				ll_find = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ls_dffbz = '2'
				ELSE
					ls_dffbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱明细序号', ls_yzmxxh, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',ls_ypzllb, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('医保中心编码',ls_xmzxbh, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dffbz, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_cur]),'yyyymmdd'), ll_i)
		
		IF (Mod(ll_cur,100) = 0 And ll_cur > 1 ) or (ll_cur = ll_count) THEN
			ll_row = ll_cur + 1
			GOTO Send
		END IF
		//	ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(as_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,'30','',ls_dffbz,Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_cur]),li_ybfl,'PT',as_msg)
		//	ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
		//	ids_zyfymx.Object.ybfl[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
	NEXT
	Send:
	Long ll_cpu1,ll_cpu2
	ll_cpu1 = CPU()
	IF uf_send(as_msg) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integ:er	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	自付比例列表
		//	1)	医嘱明细序号
		// 2)	自付比列
		ll_cpu2 = CPU()
		gf_applog("79send:" + String(ll_cpu1)+ "--" + String(ll_cpu2) + "as" + String(ll_cpu2 - ll_cpu1) )
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_i
			ls_yzmxxh = This.uf_getstring_in( '医嘱明细序号', ll_cur)
			ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find("jlxh = "+ls_yzmxxh ,1,ll_count)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ld_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '譊AT* ', ll_cur)
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = ld_zfbl
			ELSE
				as_msg = "住院--医嘱明细序号：" + ls_yzmxxh + "找不到这条明细"
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		NEXT
		ids_zyfymx.SaveAs("c:\aa.txt",Text!,True )
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
LOOP
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);IF ii_com = 0 Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
	IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
	ELSE
		gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
		gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
		gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
		gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
		gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
		gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
		gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
	END IF
	CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
		gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsValid(itran_sqlca) = True THEN
		IF itran_sqlca.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
	ELSE
		itran_sqlca = Create Transaction
		itran_sqlca.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
		itran_sqlca.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
		itran_sqlca.Database   = sqlca.Database
		itran_sqlca.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
		itran_sqlca.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
		itran_sqlca.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
		itran_sqlca.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
		itran_sqlca.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
		itran_sqlca.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
	END IF
	CONNECT Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '创建itra_sqlca事务失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

Process_GetID:
IF ii_com = 0 Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
	itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
//	IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = False THEN gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
//	gtrans_temp_mssql = itran_sqlca
	//	IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_new) THEN iu_ybjk_new = gu_ybjk_new
	ibase_info = base_info
	//ELSE
END IF

RETURN 1



end function

public function integer uf_smkjycz (integer ai_jylx, string as_knxx, string as_mxzdh, ref string as_cxjg, ref string as_error);//（K004）市民卡交易冲正 平阳接口中没有
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	IF ib_yd THEN
		uf_send_init('YDJY')
		uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		Integer li_ret
		//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
		//		IF ii_com = 0  Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
		//			li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_smkjycz( ai_jylx,as_knxx, as_mxzdh, as_cxjg,as_error)
		//		ELSE
		//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
		iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
		li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_smkjycz( ai_jylx,as_knxx, as_mxzdh, as_cxjg,as_error)
		//		END IF
		
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	ELSE
		//		RETURN 1
		//	return this.uf_smkzfjs_tf( as_knxx, /*string as_brbm*/, /*decimal ad_zyh*/, /*decimal adc_zfje*/, as_mxzdh, /*datetime adt_jssj*/, /*ref string as_error */)
		String ls_smkzt,ls_smkjylsh, ls_sbm
		Dec{2} ldc_smkzhye
		Date ld_qsrq
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '2' And istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '3' THEN
			as_error = '非市民卡'
			RETURN 0
		ELSEIF istr_yb_zhxx.knsj <> as_knxx THEN
			as_error = '非同一人'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		//	
		//	ls_sbm = Left(as_knxx,Len(as_knxx) - Len(istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh))
		This.uf_send_init('117')
		
		This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必藾AT*

		This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别', istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smklb) //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-籇AT*
3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.brxm)
		This.uf_send_add('明细账单号',as_mxzdh) //明细账单号	20	
		This.uf_send_add('交易类型',String(ai_jylx)) //交易类型	1	1 账户扣款   2账户退款
		
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
				as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.shbzkhm = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
			as_mxzdh = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
			as_cxjg = This.uf_getstring('撤销结果') //撤销结果	1	0：撤销成功 1：撤销失败
			IF as_cxjg = '1' THEN
				as_error = '撤销失败'
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ld_qsrq = RelativeDate(Date(gf_server_date()),-1)
				IF ai_jylx = 1 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS Set ZTBZ = 0 Where QSRQ >= :ld_qsrq And ZTBZ In (1,2) And CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH And  MXZDH = :as_mxzdh Using itran_sqlca;
					IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
					ELSE
						as_error = '撤销更新失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
						gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF ai_jylx = 2 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS Set ZTBZ = 0 Where QSRQ >= :ld_qsrq And ZTBZ = 3 And CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH And  MXZDH = :as_mxzdh  Using itran_sqlca;
					IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
					ELSE
						as_error = '撤销退费更新失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
						gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_smkzfjs (string as_knxx, string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, integer ai_jslx, string as_ywlx, decimal adc_zfje, string as_ywlsh, ref decimal adc_smkzf, ref string as_mxzdh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_ybjk_new_his.uf_smkzfjs()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_knxx 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2014.10.20
//====================================================================

//(113) 自费人员请求费用结算
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	IF ib_yd THEN
		uf_send_init('YDJY')
		uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		Integer li_ret
		//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
		//		IF ii_com = 0  Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
		//			li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_smkzfjs( as_knxx, as_brbm,ad_zyh, ai_jslx, as_ywlx, adc_zfje, as_ywlsh, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, as_error)
		//		ELSE
		//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
		iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
		li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_smkzfjs( as_knxx, as_brbm,ad_zyh, ai_jslx, as_ywlx, adc_zfje, as_ywlsh, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, as_error)
		//		END IF
		
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_smkzt,ls_smkjylsh, ls_sbm
		Dec{2} ldc_smkzhye
		Date ld_qsrq
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '2'  THEN
			as_error = '非市民卡'
			RETURN -1
		ELSEIF istr_yb_zhxx.knsj <> as_knxx THEN
			as_error = '非同一人'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		ls_sbm = Left(as_knxx,Len(as_knxx) - Len(istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh))
		//自负金额如果为负数那么不走市民卡
		IF adc_zfje < 0 THEN
			as_error = '市民卡不支持负金额结算'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
			as_error = is_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF ai_jslx = 0 THEN //预结算
			This.uf_send_init('113')
			This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
			This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
			This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡识别码',ls_sbm) //市民卡类别为1 时必填
			//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh) //市民卡类别为1 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别','1') //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
			IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			ELSE
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			END IF
			This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.xm)
			This.uf_send_add('医保是否结算','1') //1：不结算 2：结算（若市民卡账户余额不足时，医保根据诊间情况请求是否对该笔交易进行医保结算：1不结算，2结算）
			This.uf_send_add('自费支付金额',adc_zfje) //保留2位小数
			IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
				IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
					as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ls_smkzt = This.uf_getstring( '市民卡状态') //1	卡状态(0未启用1正常2挂失7作废8预挂失9注销)
				IF ls_smkzt = '1' THEN
					ldc_smkzhye = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户余额')
					IF ldc_smkzhye >= adc_zfje THEN
						as_mxzdh = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
						adc_smkzf = adc_zfje
					ELSE
						as_error = "市民卡余额不足以支付"
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = '市民卡状态:' + This.of_get_dmmc('29',ls_smkzt)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE //确认扣款
			//2.	(114) 市民卡账户扣款
			//参保地行政区划+明细账单号为一次交易的唯一序号，其中参保地行政区划为报文头中的消息目的地行政区划
			IF of_insert_zjzfjs( True, as_brbm, ad_zyh, as_ywlsh, as_ywlx, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, '', ld_qsrq, '','',as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			
			This.uf_send_init('115')
			This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
			This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
			This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别','1') //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.xm)
			This.uf_send_add('收费发起来源','1') //1：不结算 2：结算（若市民卡账户余额不足时，医保根据诊间情况请求是否对该笔交易进行医保结算：1不结算，2结算）
			This.uf_send_add('明细账单号',as_mxzdh)
			This.uf_send_add('自费支付金额',String(adc_zfje)) //保留2位小数
			IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
				IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
					as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ls_smkzt = This.uf_getstring( '市民卡状态') //1	卡状态(0未启用1正常2挂失7作废8预挂失9注销)
				IF ls_smkzt = '1' THEN
					adc_smkzf = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户支付金额')
					ld_qsrq = This.uf_getdate( "清算日期")
					IF IsNull(ld_qsrq ) Or Date(ld_qsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
						ld_qsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
					END IF
					ls_smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡交易流水号')
					of_insert_zjzfjs( False, as_brbm, ad_zyh, as_ywlsh, as_ywlx, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, ls_smkjylsh, ld_qsrq,'','' ,as_error)
				ELSE
					as_error = '市民卡状态异常:' + This.of_get_dmmc('29',ls_smkzt)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	adc_smkzf = 0.00
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1





end function

String ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx

	WHERE JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj AND JSJYLSH = :as_jsjylsh  and ZTBZ = 0 And ROWNUM = 1  Using itran_sqlca ;

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

update JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC SET ZTBZ = 1 WHERE JSMXLSH =:as_jzxlh using itran_sqlca ; //不管成功与否事务都要下去

	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		IF Not IsNull(astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) And astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN
			INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZJJS
				(  QSRQ,JSLB,BRBM,ZYH,ZHZFJE,MXZDH,JYLSH,CBDXZQH,JSJYLSH,YWLSH,YWLX,ZTBZ)

public function integer uf_zhcx_smk (string as_klb, string as_knxx, string as_sfzh, ref str_yb_smkzh astr_smkzh, ref string as_error);
This.uf_send_init('114')
IF Len(as_knxx) = 24 THEN
	astr_smkzh.smklb = '3'
	as_klb = '3'
ELSE
	astr_smkzh.smklb = '1'
	as_klb = '2'
END IF
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',as_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','')
This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别',astr_smkzh.smklb)
This.uf_send_add('证件类型','1')
This.uf_send_add('证件号码',as_sfzh)

This.uf_send_add('就诊类型','O')
This.uf_send_add('科室类型','3')
This.uf_send_add('刷卡科室代码','0200')
This.uf_send_add('诊疗环节代码','010105')
This.uf_send_add('终端类型','02')

//社会保障卡卡号
//市民卡状态
//市民卡账户余额
//证件类型
//证件号码
//姓名
//手机号码
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	astr_smkzh.shbzksbm  = as_knxx
	astr_smkzh.shbzkkh = This.uf_getstring( '社会保障卡卡号')
	astr_smkzh.smkzt = This.uf_getstring( '市民卡状态')
	astr_smkzh.smkzhye = This.uf_getdecimal( '市民卡账户余额')
	astr_smkzh.zjlx = This.uf_getstring( '证件类型')
	astr_smkzh.zjhm = This.uf_getstring( '证件号码')
	astr_smkzh.xm = This.uf_getstring( '姓名')
	astr_smkzh.sjhm = This.uf_getstring( '手机号码')
	
	astr_smkzh.cbdxzqh = This.uf_getstring( '发卡地区行政区划代码') //	发卡地区行政区划代码
	astr_smkzh.wjrylb = This.uf_getstring( '卫健人员类别') //卫健人员类别
	astr_smkzh.xb = This.uf_getstring( '性别') //性别
	astr_smkzh.csrq = This.uf_getdate( '出生日期') //出生日期
	astr_smkzh.lxdz = This.uf_getstring( '联系地址') //联系地址
	astr_smkzh.zsyid = This.uf_getstring( '主索引ID') //主索引ID
	astr_smkzh.dzjkkid = This.uf_getstring( '电子健康卡ID') //电子健康卡ID
	astr_smkzh.ksbm = This.uf_getstring( '卡识别码') //	卡识别码	32	社保卡识别码
	IF astr_smkzh.smklb <> '3' And  astr_smkzh.ksbm  > ' ' THEN
		astr_smkzh.shbzksbm  = astr_smkzh.ksbm
	END IF
	astr_smkzh.qyzt = This.uf_getstring( '签约状态') //签约状态	1	0 未签约 1市民卡代扣签约 2芝麻信用签约 
	astr_smkzh.kkje = This.uf_getdecimal( '可扣金额') //可扣金额	10	保留2位小数单位
	IF astr_smkzh.qyzt = '1' Or astr_smkzh.qyzt = '2' THEN
		IF astr_smkzh.kkje > astr_smkzh.smkzhye THEN
			astr_smkzh.smkzhye = astr_smkzh.kkje
		END IF
	END IF
	istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh = astr_smkzh
	istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye = astr_smkzh.smkzhye
	
	//	istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.smkzhye = astr_smkzh.smkzhye
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF


end function

public function integer uf_smkzfjs_tf (string as_knxx, string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, decimal adc_zfje, string as_mxzdh, datetime adt_jssj, ref string as_error);//3.	（K003）市民卡账户退款
//ZFTK
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	IF ib_yd THEN
		uf_send_init('YDJY')
		uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		Integer li_ret
		//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
		//		
IF ii_com = 0  Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
		//			li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_smkzfjs_tf( as_knxx, as_brbm,ad_zyh, adc_zfje, as_mxzdh, adt_jssj, as_error)
		//		ELSE
		//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
		iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
		li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_smkzfjs_tf( as_knxx, as_brbm,ad_zyh, adc_zfje, as_mxzdh, adt_jssj, as_error)
		//		END IF
		
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_smkjylsh,ls_jssj,ls_mxzdh
		Dec{2} ldc_smkzf
		Date ld_qsrq
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '2' And istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '3' THEN
			as_error = '非市民卡'
			RETURN -1
		ELSEIF istr_yb_zhxx.knsj <> as_knxx THEN
			as_error = '非同一人'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
			as_error = is_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		This.uf_send_init('116')
		This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		//This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡识别码',ls_sbm) //市民卡类别为1 时必填
		//This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号',istr_yb_zhxx.jzkh) //市民卡类别为1 时必填
		This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
		This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别', istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smklb) //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.brxm)
		This.uf_send_add('明细账单号',as_mxzdh)
		This.uf_send_add('退款金额',adc_zfje) //保留2位小数
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
				as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			//社会保障卡卡号	10	
			//明细账单号	20	
			//市民卡账户退款金额	10	保留2位小数
			//市民卡账户退款流水号	20	
			//清算日期	8	YYYYMMDD
			//			ls_mxzdh = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
			ld_qsrq = This.uf_getdate( '清算日期')
			ldc_smkzf = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户退款紻AT* ')
			ls_smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡账户退款流水号')
			//			IF ls_mxzdh <> as_mxzdh Or ldc_smkzf <> adc_zfje THEN
			//				as_error = '明细账单号:' +ls_mxzdh + '---' + as_mxzdh +';  '+String(ldc_smkzf) + '---' + String(adc_zfje)
			//				//		MessageBox('提示',)
			//			END IF
			IF This.uf_set_instance( as_error ) < 0 THEN
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			adt_jssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),-1))
			ls_jssj = String(adt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			//ADD BY SXL 2014-8-20 增加YB_ZJJS市民卡诊间结算的记录
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			IF IsNull(ad_zyh) THEN ad_zyh = 0
			UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS  Set ZTBZ = 2 Where to_char(QSRQ,'yyyymmdd') >= :ls_jssj And ZTBZ In (1,2)  And ( (BRBM Is Null And ZYH = :ad_zyh) Or (BRBM Is Not Null And BRBM = :as_brbm)) And MXZDH = :as_mxzdh  And CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH Using itran_sqlca ;
			
			INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZJJS
				(  QSRQ,            JSLB,   BRBM,   ZYH,         ZHZFJE,   MXZDH, 				JYLSH,      CBDXZQH,              JSJYLSH,       YWLSH,   YWLX,    ZTBZ,   zfqd,  zfzt,SMKLB)
				SELECT :ld_qsrq,'ZFTK',BRBM,ZYH, :ldc_smkzf * -1,    MXZDH,
				:ls_smkjylsh,  CBDXZQH,   ''   , YWLSH,YWLX,3,zfqd,zfzt,:istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.SMKLB
				FROM JKXT.YB_ZJJS
				WHERE ( (BRBM IS NULL AND ZYH = :ad_zyh) OR (BRBM IS NOT NULL AND BRBM = :as_brbm))  AND to_char(QSRQ,'yyyymmdd') >= :ls_jssj
				//		WHERE brbm = :as_brbm  AND to_char(QSRQ,'yyyymmdd') >= :ls_jssj AND MXZDH = :as_mxzdh
				AND MXZDH = :as_mxzdh AND CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH AND ztbz IN (1,2)
				Using itran_sqlca ;
				
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN 1
			ELSE
				as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows) + '  退款流水号:' + ls_smkjylsh
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				//更新失败，市民卡做退款失败冲正
				String ls_cxjg,ls_error
				This.uf_smkjycz( 2,as_knxx,as_mxzdh, ls_cxjg, ls_error)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		String ls_error_smk
		This.uf_zhcx_smk(istr_yb_zhxx.klb, as_knxx, '', istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh, ls_error_smk)
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

	String ls_error

public function integer uf_qrybjs_mz (string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, ref str_pyyb_mzsfqq astr_pyyb_mzsfqq, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh, string as_jzxlh);
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_ybsfjs,ls_datavalue
Integer li_ret,li_cur //li_xxtlx,
Dec{2} ldc_smkzhzf
//Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
//li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.klb ) And Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj ) THEN
	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj +'~~~~~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
END IF
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '36~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '30~~'
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
//IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_error,false) THEN
//	as_error = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_error
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	ls_ybsfjs = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs
	// 增加市民緿AT*
ㄕ嘶�是否支�
,默认不支付  0：支付  1：不支付（若传过来非'0'或'1'，则默认支付）
	IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf) THEN astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1'
	//modify by sxl 2015-12-16 1:不结算 2:结算（若市民卡账户余额不足时，医保根据诊间情况请求是否对该笔交易进行医保结算：1不结算，2结算）
	IF astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1' THEN //市民卡账户如果不支付，那么医保默认都结算
		astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '2'
		ls_ybsfjs = '2'
	END IF
	//-------------------------------
	IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs) THEN
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb = '2'  THEN
			as_error = '市民卡账户扣款已启用，但是未指定是否医保结算，请重新刷卡结算!'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('医保是否结算','2')
			ls_ybsfjs = '2'
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_ybsfjs = astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs
	END IF
	//		This.uf_send_add('市民卡账户是否支付',astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf)
	ls_send = ls_send + "~~"+ ls_ybsfjs + "~~" + astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + '$$'
IF ib_yd THEN
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
ELSE
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
END IF

ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
	IF li_pos > 0 THEN
		FOR li_cur = 1 To 4
			ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
			li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
		//农保没有市民卡诊间结算
		//	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
		li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
		as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		//		as_error = '报文解析出错' + ls_recieve
		//		RETURN - 1
	ELSE
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1) //	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN //7	市民卡账户支付金额	Double	10（2）	否	
			ldc_smkzhzf = Dec(Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1))
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = 	ldc_smkzhzf
		END IF
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1)
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)) //8	市民卡清算日期	String	8	否		Yyyymmdd 
			
			IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) Or Date(astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
				astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkjylsh = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1) //9	市民卡交易流水号	String	20	否	
		ELSE
			astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkjylsh = ls_recieve
		END IF
	END IF
	
	//	as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
ELSE
	//	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
	li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
	as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF
IF of_update_jsmx(as_qrjslsh,as_jsjylsh,as_jzxlh,astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,'$$~~~~30~12345678901234~2~HIS数据保存失败$$'，$$0~~~~$$，""）
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_qrybjs_zy (string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, string as_smkzhsfzf, string as_ybsfjs, ref str_pyyb_jsxx astr_pyyb_jsxx, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh, string as_jzxlh);
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_ybsfjs,ls_datavalue
Integer li_ret,li_cur //li_xxtlx,
Dec{2} ldc_smkzhzf
//Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
//li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.klb ) And Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj ) THEN
	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj +'~~~~~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
END IF
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN

END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
//IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_error,false) THEN
//	as_error = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_error
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	ls_ybsfjs = as_ybsfjs
	// 增加市民卡账户是否支付,默认不支付  0：支付  1：不支付（若传过来非'0'或'1'，则默认支付）
	IF IsNull(as_smkzhsfzf) THEN as_smkzhsfzf = '1'

	IF as_smkzhsfzf = '1' THEN //市民卡账户如果不支付，那么医保默认都结算
		ls_ybsfjs = '2'
	END IF
	//-------------------------------
	IF IsNull(ls_ybsfjs) THEN
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb = '2'  THEN
			as_error = '市民卡账户扣款已启用，但是未指定是否医保结算，请重新刷卡结算!'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('医保是否结算','2')
			ls_ybsfjs = '2'
		END IF
	END IF
	//		
This.uf_send_add('市民卡账户是否支付',astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf)
	ls_send = ls_send + "~~"+ ls_ybsfjs + "~~" + as_smkzhsfzf
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + '$$'
IF ib_yd THEN
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
ELSE
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)

ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 )
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
	IF li_pos > 0 THEN
		FOR li_cur = 1 To 4
			ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
			li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
		//农保没有市民卡诊间结算
		li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
		as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		//		as_error = '报文解析出错' + ls_recieve
		//		RETURN - 1
	ELSE
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1) //	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN //7	市民卡账户支付金额	Double	10（2）	否	
			ldc_smkzhzf = Dec(Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1))
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = 	ldc_smkzhzf
		END IF
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1)
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,8,2)) //8	市民卡清算日期	String	8	否		Yyyymmdd 
			IF IsNull(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) Or Date(astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
				astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkqsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
		//	IF li_pos > 0 THEN astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1) //9	市民卡交易流水号	String	20	否	
		IF li_pos > 0 THEN
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = Mid(ls_recieve, 1,li_pos - 1) //9	市民卡交易流水号	String	20	否	
		ELSE
			astr_pyyb_jsxx.smkjylsh = ls_recieve
		END IF
	END IF
	//	as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
ELSE
	//	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
	li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
	as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF
IF of_update_jsmx(as_qrjslsh,as_jsjylsh,as_jzxlh,astr_pyyb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,'$$~~~~30~12345678901234~2~HIS数据保存失败$$'，$$0~~~~$$，""）
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_smkjycz_rq (integer ai_jylx, date ad_qsrq, string as_knxx, string as_mxzdh, ref string as_cxjg, ref string as_error);//（K004）市民卡交易冲正
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	IF ib_yd THEN
		uf_send_init('YDJY')
		uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		Integer li_ret
		//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
		//		IF ii_com = 0  Or IsNull(ii_com) THEN
		//			li_ret = gu_ybjk_new.uf_smkjycz_rq( ai_jylx,ad_qsrq,as_knxx, as_mxzdh, as_cxjg,as_error)
		//		ELSE
		//modify by sxl  2017-2-28,gu_ybjk_new 改iu_ybjk_new
		iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
		li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_smkjycz_rq( ai_jylx,ad_qsrq,as_knxx, as_mxzdh, as_cxjg,as_error)
		//		END IF
		
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_smkzt,ls_smkjylsh, ls_sbm
		Dec{2} ldc_smkzhye
		Date ld_qsrq
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '2' And istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '3' THEN
			as_error = '非市民卡'
			RETURN 0
		ELSEIF istr_yb_zhxx.knsj <> as_knxx THEN
			as_error = '非同一人'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		//	
		//	ls_sbm = Left(as_knxx,Len(as_knxx) - Len(istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.kh))
		This.uf_send_init('117')
		
		This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
		This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别', istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.smklb) //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-籇AT*
 6-其他
			This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.brxm)
		This.uf_send_add('明细账单号',as_mxzdh) //明细账单号	20	
		This.uf_send_add('交易类型',String(ai_jylx)) //交易类型	1	1 账户扣款   2账户退款
		
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
				as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.shbzkhm = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
			as_mxzdh = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
			as_cxjg = This.uf_getstring('撤销结果') //撤销结果	1	0：撤销成功 1：撤销失败
			IF as_cxjg = '1' THEN
				as_error = '撤销失败'
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ld_qsrq = RelativeDate(ad_qsrq,-1)
				IF ai_jylx = 1 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS Set ZTBZ = 0 Where QSRQ >= :ld_qsrq And ZTBZ In (1,2) And CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH And  MXZDH = :as_mxzdh Using itran_sqlca;
					IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
					ELSE
						as_error = '撤销更新失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
						gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF ai_jylx = 2 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS Set ZTBZ = 0 Where QSRQ >= :ld_qsrq And ZTBZ = 3 And CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.CBDXZQH And  MXZDH = :as_mxzdh  Using itran_sqlca;
					IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
					ELSE
						as_error = '撤销退费更新失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
						gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx (string as_brbm, decimal adc_ghlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zddm[], ref string as_zdmc);
IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
	ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_mz_zdxx'
	ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF
IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(as_brbm,adc_ghlsh,as_ysbm) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
as_zdmc = ''

IF ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[1]))
	as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = is_mricd10
	as_zdmc = is_mrzdmc
END IF

Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 to ii_zdsl
		ll_zds ++
		IF ll_count >= 2 and ll_cur <= ll_count THEN
			as_zddm[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]) THEN ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur] = ''
			as_zdmc = as_zdmc + ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]+','
		ELSE
			as_zddm[ll_zds] = ''
		END IF
	next
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlb, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zddm2, ref string as_zddm3, ref string as_zdmc, ref string as_zddms[], ref string as_ryzd);//住院病人诊断信息
//ai_zdlb 用于判断是获取入院诊断还是出院诊断 1入院   2出院
//as_ryzd 为入院主诊断，出院主诊断
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
//	IF ai_zdlb = 1 THEN
//		ids_zy_ryzd.SetFilter( "zdlb = 2 or zdlb = 9 or zdlb = 10 or zdlb = 11") //入院诊断
//	ELSEIF ai_zdlb = 2 THEN
//		ids_zy_ryzd.SetFilter( "zdlb = 3 or zdlb = 4 or zdlb = 15 or zdlb = 16 or zdlb = 19 or zdlb = 20")
//	END IF
//	ids_zy_ryzd.Filter( )
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "zdlb asc")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() = 0 THEN
	as_zdmc = ''
	as_zddm1 = is_mricd10
	as_ryzd = is_mrzdmc
//	as_ryzd = '健康体检--无诊断'
//	as_zddm1 = 'Z00.001'
	
	as_zddm2 = ''
	as_zddm3 = ''
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
END IF
as_zdmc = ''
IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 2 THEN
	as_zddm2 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[2]))
	IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2] = ''
	as_zdmc =  ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2]
END IF
IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 3 THEN
	as_zddm3 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[3]))
	IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3] = ''
	as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3]
END IF

IF as_ryzd = '' Or IsNull(as_ryzd) THEN
	as_ryzd = '诊断为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF
if len(as_ryzd) > 100 then as_ryzd = of_midstring(as_ryzd,100)
//诊断增加到10个
IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
	Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
	ll_count = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
	FOR ll_cur = 4 to ii_zdsl
		ll_zds ++
		IF ll_count >= 4 and ll_cur <= ll_count THEN
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
			as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
		ELSE
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = ''
		END IF
	next
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

if ll_count > 0 then
	IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
		IF ib_yd THEN
			uf_send_init('YDJY')

				RETURN -1
			ELSE

			END IF

				This.uf_send_add('姓名',astr_yb_smkzh.xm)
				
				This.uf_send_add('医保明细账单号',str_yb_tkxx[ll_cur].mxzdh) //医保明细账单号	20

public function integer of_insert_zjzfjs (boolean ab_insert, string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, string as_ywlsh, string as_ywlx, decimal ad_zfje, string as_mxzdh, string as_smkjyh, date ad_qsrq, string as_zfqd, string as_zfzt, ref string as_error);//ZFXF
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ad_zyh = 0 And as_brbm > '' THEN
	String ls_brbm
	IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh = is_yljgxzqh THEN
		ls_brbm = 'SBPY'+ istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.grsbbh //病人编号
	ELSE
		as_error = '该为异地社保病人，调用错接口！'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ls_brbm <> as_brbm THEN
		string ls_ybrbm = ''
		SELECT YBRBM into :ls_ybrbm FROM MZXT.MZ_BRDA_YBLS WHERE XBRBM =:ls_brbm; 
		if ls_ybrbm <> as_brbm or ls_ybrbm= '' then
			as_error = '病人编码不一致:医保端:' + ls_brbm +" HIS端:" + as_brbm
			RETURN -1
		end if
	END IF
	
END IF
//IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
//	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
//END IF
//
//gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
////gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
//gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
//gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
//gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
//gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
//gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
//gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
//gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
//gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
//gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
//
//CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
//
//IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
//	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
//Process_GetID:

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
integer li_zfzt
li_zfzt=integer(as_zfzt)
//ADD BY SXL 2014-8-20 增加YB_ZJJS市民卡诊间结算的记录
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ab_insert THEN
		ad_qsrq = date(gf_server_date())
		INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZJJS
			(  QSRQ,JSLB,BRBM,ZYH,ZHZFJE,MXZDH,JYLSH,CBDXZQH,JSJYLSH,YWLSH,YWLX,ZTBZ,ZFQD,ZFZT,SMKLB)
			VALUES (:ad_qsrq,'ZFXF',:as_brbm,:ad_zyh,:ad_zfje,:as_mxzdh,:as_smkjyh,:istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh, 			        '',:as_ywlsh,:as_ywlx,0,:AS_ZFQD,:LI_ZFZT,:istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.SMKLB )
			Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZJJS SET QSRQ = :ad_qsrq,JYLSH = :as_smkjyh,ZTBZ = 1,ZFQD=:AS_ZFQD,ZFZT=:LI_ZFZT
			WHERE BRBM = :as_brbm AND zyh = :ad_zyh AND MXZDH = :as_mxzdh AND CBDXZQH = :istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
			//		(  QSRQ,JSLB,BRBM,ZYH,ZHZFJE,MXZDH,JYLSH,CBDXZQH,JSJYLSH,YWLSH,YWLX,ZTBZ)
			//		VALUES (:ad_qsrq,'ZFXF',:as_brbm,:ad_zyh,:ad_zfje,:as_mxzdh,:as_smkjyh,:istr_yb_zhxx.str_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh,'',:as_ywlsh,:as_ywlx,0)
			Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN 0
	ELSE
		as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_smkzfjs (string as_knxx, string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, integer ai_jslx, string as_ywlx, decimal adc_zfje, string as_ywlsh, decimal adc_ybbxje, decimal adc_fyze, ref decimal adc_smkzf, ref string as_mxzdh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.uf_smkzfjs()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_knxx   	
// 	value    	string 	as_brbm   	
// 	value    	decimal	ad_zyh    	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jslx   	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlx   	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_zfje  	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlsh  	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_ybbxje	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_fyze  	
// 	reference	decimal	adc_smkzf 	
// 	reference	string 	as_mxzdh  	
// 	reference	string 	as_error  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  inte
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2019.10.22
//====================================================================


//(113) 自费人员请求费用结算
IF ii_smkjs = 1 THEN
	IF ib_yd THEN
		uf_send_init('YDJY')
		uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
		uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
		uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		Integer li_ret
		//modify by sxl 全局变量的控制
		iu_ybjk_new.ib_yd = ib_yd
		iu_ybjk_new.iu_pyybjk = This
		li_ret = iu_ybjk_new.uf_smkzfjs( as_knxx, as_brbm,ad_zyh, ai_jslx, as_ywlx, adc_zfje, as_ywlsh, adc_ybbxje,adc_fyze,adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, as_error)
		//		END IF
		
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_smkzt,ls_smkjylsh
		Dec{2} ldc_smkzhye,ldc_jjzfze,ldc_fyze,ldc_wjbxje
		Date ld_qsrq
		boolean lb_zfnl
		IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '2' and istr_yb_zhxx.klb <> '3'  THEN
			as_error = '非市民卡'
			RETURN -1
		ELSEIF istr_yb_zhxx.knsj <> as_knxx THEN
			as_error = '非同一人'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ldc_jjzfze = adc_ybbxje
		ldc_fyze = adc_fyze
		if isnull(ldc_jjzfze) then ldc_jjzfze =  0
		if isnull(ldc_fyze)  then ldc_fyze = 0
		//自负金额如果为负数那么不走市民卡
		IF adc_zfje < 0 THEN
			as_error = '市民卡不支持负金额结算'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
			as_error = is_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF ai_jslx = 0 THEN //预结算
			This.uf_send_init('113')
			This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
			This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
			This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别', istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.SMKLB ) //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
			IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			ELSE
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			END IF
			This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.xm)
			This.uf_send_add('医保是否结算','1') //1：不结算 2：结算（若市民卡账户余额不足时，医保根据诊间情况请求是否对该笔交易进行医保结算：1不结算，2结算）
			This.uf_send_add('自费支付金额',adc_zfje) //保留2位小数
			This.uf_send_add('医保报销金额',String(ldc_jjzfze))//医保报销金额
			This.uf_send_add('费用总额',String(ldc_fyze ))//费用总额
			IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
				IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
					as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				
				ls_smkzt = This.uf_getstring( '市民卡状态') //1	卡状态(0未启用1正常2挂失7作废8预挂失9注销)
				IF ls_smkzt = '1' THEN
					ldc_smkzhye = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户余额')
					lb_zfnl =  This.uf_getstring( '是否具备支付能力') = '0'//	0是1否（在账户余额不足支付时，若卡片已签约代扣等资金渠道，则具备支付能力）
					ldc_wjbxje = uf_getdecimal('卫健报销费用')
					IF ldc_smkzhye >= adc_zfje or lb_zfnl THEN
						as_mxzdh = This.uf_getstring('明细账单号')
						adc_smkzf = adc_zfje
					ELSE
						as_error = "市民卡余额不足以支付"
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = "市民卡余额不足以支付SMK-ZF: " +string(ldc_smkzhye) + '--' + string(adc_zfje)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE //确认扣款
			//2.	(114) 市民卡账户扣款
			//参保地行政区划+明细账单号为一次交易的唯一序号，其中参保地行政区划为报文头中的消息目的地行政区划
			string ls_zfqd,ls_zfzt
			IF of_insert_zjzfjs( True, as_brbm, ad_zyh, as_ywlsh, as_ywlx, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, '', ld_qsrq, ls_zfqd,ls_zfzt,as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			
			This.uf_send_init('115')
			This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',istr_yb_zhxx.klb)
			This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knxx)
			This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			This.uf_send_add('非接卡号','') //市民卡类别为2 时必填
			This.uf_send_add('市民卡类别',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.SMKLB) //1 社会保障市民卡 2 其它类型市民卡
			IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm > '' THEN
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjlx) //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官证4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.zjhm) //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			ELSE
				This.uf_send_add('证件类型','') //1	证件类型：1-身份证2-户口簿3-军官諨AT*
4-护照 5-户籍证明 6-其他
				This.uf_send_add('证件号码','') //18	市民卡类别为2 时必填
			END IF
			This.uf_send_add('姓名',istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh.xm)
			This.uf_send_add('收费发起来源','1') //1：诊间 2：收费窗口
			This.uf_send_add('明细账单号',as_mxzdh)
			This.uf_send_add('自费支付金额',String(adc_zfje)) //保留2位小数
			This.uf_send_add('医保报销金额',String(ldc_jjzfze))//医保报销金额
			This.uf_send_add('费用总额',String(ldc_fyze))//费用总额
			IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
				IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
					as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ls_smkzt = This.uf_getstring( '市民卡状态') //1	卡状态(0未启用1正常2挂失7作废8预挂失9注销)
				IF ls_smkzt = '1' THEN
					adc_smkzf = This.uf_getdecimal('市民卡账户支付金额')
					ld_qsrq = This.uf_getdate( "清算日期")
					IF IsNull(ld_qsrq ) Or Date(ld_qsrq ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
						ld_qsrq = Date(gdt_sysdatetime)
					END IF
					ls_smkjylsh = This.uf_getstring('市民卡交易流水号')
					ldc_wjbxje = This.uf_getdecimal('卫健报销费用')//卫健报销费用	10	保留2位小数单位元，包含在市民卡支付金额中
					ls_zfqd = This.uf_getstring('支付渠道')//支付渠道	2	00市民卡余额01代扣渠道02移动支付03信用支付（信后付）
					ls_zfzt = This.uf_getstring('支付状态')//支付状态	1	0支付成功1用户支付中2支付失败
				
					of_insert_zjzfjs( False, as_brbm, ad_zyh, as_ywlsh, as_ywlx, adc_smkzf, as_mxzdh, ls_smkjylsh, ld_qsrq,ls_zfqd,ls_zfzt,as_error)
				ELSE
					as_error = '市民卡状态异常:' + This.of_get_dmmc('29',ls_smkzt)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	adc_smkzf = 0.00
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

private function string of_get_errormessage (string as_returncode);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_get_errormessage()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据错误代码返回错误描述
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_returncode	返回码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//0	交易成功	无错误信息
//-1	系统错误（包括通讯错误）	有错误信息
//-200	未知错误	有错误信息
//-300	报文合法性错误	有错误信息
//-400	业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误后立即退出程序）	有错误信息
//-500	业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）	无错误信息，一般以交易结果信息返回


CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_returncode)
	CASE '-1'
		RETURN '系统错误（包括通讯错误）'
		
	CASE '-200'
		RETURN '未知错误'
	CASE '-300'
		RETURN '报文合法性错误'
	CASE '-400'
		RETURN '业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误后立即退出程序）'
	CASE '-500'
		RETURN '业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）'	
	case else
		return ''
END CHOOSE

end function

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
Integer li_1 = 0
String ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
IF IsNull(ad_datavalue) THEN RETURN ''
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'da','db','df','dj','dk','dl','dn' //，2位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		END IF
	CASE 'de','dg' //3位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dd','dh','di' //4位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dc'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0')
		END IF
	CASE 'dm'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0')
		END IF
END CHOOSE



end function

public function date uf_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
		if len(ls_datavalue)= 8 then
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		end if
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function
