public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF Not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
			
			
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为datetime类型)，返回发送时的值datetime

// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20

int li_find

datetime ldt_datavalue

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
//		case 'dtb'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		case else
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			setnull(ldt_datavalue)
			return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if

end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyy-mm-dd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描蔇AT*
:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
String ls_ip

//台州市异地
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF ii_tzbyd = 1 THEN
		IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\BargaingApplyV4.dll' ) = False THEN
			is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\BargaingApplyV4.dll)不存在，请先安装'
//			MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			ib_init_success = False
			RETURN
		END IF
		//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
		IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeCfgV4.ini' ) = False THEN
			is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ 'TradeCfgV4.ini)不存在，请先安装'
			ib_init_success = False
//			MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			RETURN
		ELSE
			ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\TradeCfgV4.ini", "SYSTEM",  "NativeAddress", "")
			IF is_tzybip <> ls_ip And is_tzybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
				is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和TradeCfgV4.ini的NativeAddress不匹配，请检查"
				ib_init_success = False
//				MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\MedInterface_TZ.dll' ) = False THEN
			is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\MedInterface_TZ.dll)不存在，请先安装'
//			MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			ib_init_success = False
			RETURN
		END IF
		//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
		IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\MedInterface_TZ.ini' ) = False THEN
			is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置蜠AT* (' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ 'MedInterface_TZ.ini)不存在，请先安装'
			ib_init_success = False
//			MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			RETURN
		ELSE
			ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\MedInterface_TZ.ini", "WEBSERVICE",  "IP1", "")
			IF is_tzsbdybip <> ls_ip And is_tzsbdybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
				is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和MedInterface_TZ.ini的IP1不匹配，请检查"
				ib_init_success = False
//				MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
				RETURN
			END IF
			ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\MedInterface_TZ.ini", "WEBSERVICE",  "IP2", "")
			IF is_tzsbdybip <> ls_ip And is_tzsbdybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
				is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和MedInterface_TZ.ini的IP2不匹配，请检查"
				ib_init_success = False
//				MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\YKTMedInterface.dll' ) = False Or FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\webservice2.dll' ) = False THEN
		is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\webservice2.dll 或YKTMedInterface.dll)不存在，请先安装'
		ib_init_success = False
		RETURN
	END IF
	//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
	IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\EPTradeCfg_YKT.ini' ) = False  THEN
		is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ 'EPTradeCfg_YKT.ini)不存在，请先安装'
		ib_init_success = False
		RETURN
	ELSE
		ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\EPTradeCfg_YKT.ini", "WEBSERVICE",  "IP", "")
		IF is_pyybip <> ls_ip And is_pyybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
			is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和EPTradeCfg_YKT的WEBSERVICE的IP不匹配，请检查"
			ib_init_success = False
			//		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			RETURN
		END IF
		ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\EPTradeCfg_YKT.ini", "WEBSERVICE2",  "IP", "")
		IF is_pyybip <> ls_ip And is_pyybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
			is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和EPTradeCfg_YKT的WEBSERVICE2的IP不匹配，请检查"
			ib_init_success = False
			//		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF

Integer li_xhxh
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	is_jylsh = '0'
ELSE
	SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval Into :li_xhxh From dual Using itran_sqlca;
	is_jylsh = is_yljgdm + String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+String(Now(),'hhmmss')+Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
END IF
ib_init_success = True
//1	交易发起机构代码	string	16	是		详见3.4.2传入报文体说明	
//2	交易发起机构名称	string	50	是		详见3.4.2传入报文体说明	
//3	交易发起机构类型	string	3	是		详见3.4.2传入报文体说明	
//4	交易发起机构统筹区	string	20	是		参考数字字典行政区划代码
is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )

IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '1')
	This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', '')
	This.uf_send_add( '预留1', '')
	This.uf_send_add( '预留2', '')
	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构代码', is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构名称', is_yljgmc_tzsyd)
ELSE
	if ii_gjmqy = 1 AND left(as_xxtlx,1) <> '3' then
		This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构代码', is_yljgdm_gj)
	else
		This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构代码', is_yljgdm)
	end if
	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构名称', is_yljgmc)
END IF
This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构类型', '00')
This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构统筹区', is_yljgxzqh)

end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime窪AT*
袷嚼嘈停�返回指定格式的字符�

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYY-MM-DD HHMMSS
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYY-MM-DD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

public subroutine uf_send_add_in (string as_name, date ad_datavalue, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: uf_send_add_in()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	date   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//    value long     al_row 行
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

long li_row
int li_len[]
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
//if of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'JG',as_name) = 0 then 
//	messagebox('信息窗口','字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
//else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"' and datarow="+string(al_row) +" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send_in.insertrow(0)
	ids_send_in.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = al_row
	ids_send_in.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyy-mm-dd')
	ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
	uf_send_add_in_count(is_mxnr,al_row)
//end if
end subroutine

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +String(al_row))
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function string uf_getstring_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getstring()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为string)，返回string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 's' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回string类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return ls_datavalue
end function

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);Integer li_ds = 0,i
String ls_end

FOR i = 1 To Len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 And Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	RETURN False
ELSE
	RETURN True
END IF


end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);//if len( //as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len) //if not of_if_char(as_string) then //	as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len -1)
//
//	as_string = as_string + ' '
//end if

//as_string = leftw(left(as_string,ai_len),ai_len)
as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================
is_psamid = '100'
return 1
IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)
	//	licc_config.port = 100
	//	licc_config.baud= 9600
	//	licc_config.timeout = 6000
	//	setnull(licc_config)
	
	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
//		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
//		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM緿AT* ...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_jklx_fgfh (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh) ,1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF IsNull(ids_structre.Object.fgfh[ll_find]) Or ids_structre.Object.fgfh[ll_find] = '' THEN
		RETURN "~~"
	ELSE
		RETURN ids_structre.Object.fgfh[ll_find]
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN "~~"
END IF


end function

private function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm //ls_mc[],ls_format[],
Long li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_row,li_find //li_len[],
Boolean lb_return = True
//返回数据的判断
If (IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '')  THEN
	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
	RETURN False
END IF
//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive.Reset()
ids_receive_in.Reset()
ls_xxt = as_xxt
ls_xxt = Midw(ls_xxt,3)
ls_xxt = Midw(ls_xxt,1,Lenw(ls_xxt) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx, 'YD')
String ls_return1	,ls_dataname,ls_fgfh
Integer li_pos = 0,li_pos_rs
li_sum = 0
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	IF Posw(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		li_pos = Posw(ls_xxt,"~~")
	ELSE
		li_pos_rs = 1
		ls_fgfh = This.of_get_jklx_fgfh( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
		IF ls_fgfh = "|" THEN
			IF Posw(ls_xxt,"~~") > Posw(ls_xxt,"|") And  Posw(ls_xxt,"|") > 0  THEN
				li_pos = Posw(ls_xxt,"|")
			ELSE
				li_pos = Posw(ls_xxt,"~~")
			END IF
		ELSE
			li_pos = Posw(ls_xxt,"~~")
		END IF
	END IF
	IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
		li_pos = Lenw(ls_xxt)
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Midw(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos)) //li_len[li_i]))
	ELSE
		IF li_pos > 1 THEN
			IF Trim(Midw(ls_xxt, li_pos - 1,1)) = '^' THEN
				ls_datavalue = Trim(Midw(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos - 2 ))
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Trim(Midw(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos - 1 ))
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_datavalue = Trim(Midw(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos - 1 ))
		END IF
		//		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	END IF
	
	ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
	
	ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
	ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname //ls_mc[li_i]
	li_sum = li_pos + li_pos_rs
	ls_xxt = Midw(ls_xxt ,li_sum) //li_len[li_i]
	IF Posw(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		IF of_receivein_data(  This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ),ls_datavalue, ls_return1,This.of_get_jklx_oldmc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )) = False THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_return1) THEN ls_return1 = ''
			as_return = as_return +ls_return1
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
//IF base_info.UserID = '211240' THEN
//	ids_receive.SaveAs("C:\receiv.txt",Text!,True)
//END IF

RETURN lb_return




end function

public function boolean of_yb_date_init (ref string as_error, boolean ab_yd);Integer li_ret
String ls_InData
gf_waiting("正在省/市异地初始化。。。。。。",30)
TRY
	is_init_date = String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')
	ls_InData = Space(3000)
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州市异地
		IF ii_tzbyd = 1 THEN
			li_ret = f_UserBargaingInitV4("$$$$",ls_InData,is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
			IF li_ret < 0 THEN
				gf_waiting("台州市异地初始化错误。。。。。。",-1)
				as_error = '台州市异地初始化错误:' + ls_InData
				RETURN False
			END IF
		ELSE
			li_ret = f_Init_tz(is_token_tz,is_yljgdm_tzsyd,ls_InData)
			IF li_ret < 0 THEN
				gf_waiting("台州市本地初始化错误。。。。。。",-1)
				as_error = '台州市本地初始化错误：' + ls_InData
				RETURN False
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		li_ret = f_Init('',is_yljgdm,ls_InData)
		IF li_ret < 0 THEN
			gf_waiting("省异地初始化错误。。。。。。",-1)
			as_error = "省异地初始化错误:" + ls_InData
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_error =  '初始化异常出错' +  er2.Text
	gf_waiting("省/市异地初始化错误。。。。。。",-1)
	RETURN False
END TRY
gf_waiting("省/市异地初始化完成。。。。。。",-1)
RETURN True


end function

IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_old.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_old.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in = Create u_datastore
ids_send_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

u_datastore lds_temp
lds_temp = Create u_datastore
lds_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
//区分台州市异地和省异地初始化
String ls_ybfl = 'SEP'
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF ii_tzbyd = 1 THEN
		ls_ybfl = 'TZSYD'
	ELSE
		ls_ybfl = 'TZSBD'
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_ybfl = 'SEP'
END IF

IF lds_temp.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,'^' AS FGFH from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE JKFL = 'JG' AND YBFL = '"+ls_ybfl+"'") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	lds_temp.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	lds_temp.Retrieve()
END IF
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("SELECT JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,'~~' AS FGFH,mxnr as mxnr_old FROM JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL = '"+ls_ybfl+"'") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

IF ib_init_success = True THEN
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	Long ll_row,i,li_cd,ll_rowcount,ll_insert
	String ls_jgdm
	ll_rowcount = ids_structre.Retrieve()
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row]) > '0'	THEN //结构
			ls_jgdm = Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row])
			lds_temp.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" + ls_jgdm +"'")
			lds_temp.Filter()
			lds_temp.SetSort("PXXH A")
			lds_temp.Sort()
			
			IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					ll_insert = ids_structre.InsertRow(0)
					ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.MXNR[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxlx[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxlx[i]
					ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_insert] = ''
					ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_insert] = 0
					ids_structre.Object.JGPXXH[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.PXXH[i]
					IF i = lds_temp.RowCount() THEN
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '~~'
					ELSE
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '|'
					END IF
				NEXT
				ids_structre.DeleteRow(ll_row)
				ll_row --
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				li_cd = 0
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					li_cd = li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
				NEXT
				ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	ids_structre.SetSort("JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,JGPXXH")
	ids_structre.Sort()
	String ls_jklx_old = ''
	String ls_jkfl_old = ''
	Integer li_pxxh = 0
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
		IF ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row] <> ls_jklx_old Or ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row] <> ls_jkfl_old THEN
			li_pxxh = 0
		END IF
		li_pxxh ++
		ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row] = li_pxxh
		ls_jklx_old = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
		ls_jkfl_old = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
	NEXT
END IF
ii_gjmqy = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'SGJBMQY','0','国家编码省接口是否启用：0不启用，1启用'))
is_yljgdm_gj = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YB_GJYLJGBM","H33030200034","医保国家医疗机构编码")
//IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN

//ELSE

IF Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) = '3311'  THEN is_yljgxzqh = '331100'

is_pyybip1 = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"SYBQZJIPDZ1","173.1.0.9","省医保前置机IP地址1")

il_baqy = Integer(gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"BAQY","0","备案启用"))
IF ib_tzsyd THEN

		is_tzsbdybip = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"TZSBDYBQZJIPDZ","10.62.228.10:8899","台州市本地医保前置机IP地址")

	is_yljgmc_tzsyd = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"HOSPITAL1","温州医科大学附属第二医院","医院简称")

 0-旧接口 1-新接口

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return, integer ai_jyfs, string as_jsfxzqh);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
gf_jsrz_tz("台州.开始uf_send()") // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.开始uf_send()
il_time_pre = CPU()
//在这里判断初始化是否成功uf_send_init
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF
IF IsNull(is_xxtlx) Or is_xxtlx = '' THEN
	as_return = '消息体类型为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Boolean lb_find
Integer li_last_fgfh_gs
ls_xxt = ''
//ids_send.saveas("c:\send.txt",TEXT!,true)
if not ib_yktdy then
	IF is_init_date <> String(Today(),'yyyymmdd') THEN
		IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_return,ib_yd) THEN
			as_return = 'f_Init初始化出错' + as_return
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
end if
//返回对应的消息体格式
//this.of_get_structure( is_xxtlx,'QQ', ls_mc, li_len, ls_format,as_return)
//li_bound = upperbound(ls_mc)
//ids_send.SaveAs("c:\send.txt",Text!,False)
Integer li_ret
IF Upper(is_xxtlx) = 'READ' THEN
	ls_recieve = Space(5000)
	li_ret = f_ReadICCard(is_yljgdm,ls_recieve)
	as_return = ls_recieve
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		RETURN False
	ELSE
		RETURN True
	END IF
END IF
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
//串联所有的消息体
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),ls_datavalue,  as_return,This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)) = False THEN RETURN False
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN False
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		
		IF ls_dataname = '卡片类型' Or ls_dataname = '身份凭证信息' Or  ls_dataname = '社会保障卡卡的识别码' Or ls_dataname = '社会保障卡信息' THEN
		ELSE
			ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		END IF
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat		
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		
	END IF
	IF li_i = li_bound THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
	ELSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue + of_get_jklx_fgfh(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
	END IF
	
NEXT

ls_send = '$$' +ls_xxt + '$$'
IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()发送报文构造完成，准备通信历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()发送报文构造完成，准备通信
il_time_pre = CPU()

//台州健康卡调用需要返回报文，作为调用用 2021-3-18 sxl
IF ib_yktdy and (is_xxtlx ='8002' or is_xxtlx = '8003') THEN
	as_return = ls_send
	gf_applog('yktdy:' + string(ib_yktdy) + 'xxt:' + is_xxtlx + '  send:' + ls_send)
	RETURN True
END IF
//--------
TRY
	Integer li_xxtlx
	Blob lb_receive
	ls_recieve = Space(1024 * 32) //每个报文体的总长度不得超过32K字节
	lb_receive = Blob(ls_recieve)
	li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		IF ii_tzbyd = 1 THEN
			li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(li_xxtlx,Integer(is_jylsh),ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
		ELSE
			IF ai_jyfs = 0 THEN //实时结算类交易申请
				li_ret = f_UserApply_tz(li_xxtlx,is_yljgdm_tzsyd,ls_send,is_token_tz,lb_receive)
			ELSE //上传下载类交易申请
				li_ret = f_DataTransApply_tz(li_xxtlx,is_yljgdm_tzsyd,ls_send,is_token_tz,lb_receive)
			END IF
			ls_recieve = String(lb_receive)
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF ai_jyfs = 0 THEN //实时结算类交易申请
		   if ii_gjmqy = 1 then
				li_ret = f_UserApply(li_xxtlx,is_yljgdm_gj,ls_send,as_jsfxzqh + '~~'+ is_jylsh,lb_receive)
			else
				li_ret = f_UserApply(li_xxtlx,is_yljgdm,ls_send,as_jsfxzqh + '~~'+ is_jylsh,lb_receive)
			end if
		ELSE //上传下载类交易申请
			li_ret = f_DataTransApply(li_xxtlx,is_yljgdm,ls_send,as_jsfxzqh,lb_receive)
		END IF
		ls_recieve = String(lb_receive)
	END IF
	SetNull(lb_receive)
	IF base_info.UserID = '209134' Or base_info.UserID = '206183' THEN
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ String(li_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  发送:'+ls_send )
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接收:'+ls_recieve)
	END IF
	
	Long ll_pos,ll_pos2
	String ls_error
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , 1 )
		ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
		IF ll_pos2 = 0 THEN ll_pos2 = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
		IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
			li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,3,ll_pos - 3))
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //wangyi 20191009 台州市异地错误提示不截取
				ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1)
			ELSE
				ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1,ll_pos2 - ll_pos)
			END IF
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_error) THEN ls_error = '' //+ of_get_errormessage( String(li_ret) 		gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()通信出错×               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+ls_error) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()通信出错× 		il_time_pre = CPU() 		as_return = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_error 		RETURN False
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , 1 )
		IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
			li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,3,ll_pos - 3)) //		交易处理结果	数值型	4	是		0：成功 -1：失败
			IF li_ret = 0 THEN
				li_ret = 1
			ELSE
				ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
				IF ll_pos2 = 0 THEN
					ll_pos2 = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
				END IF
				ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1,ll_pos2 - ll_pos - 1) //		错误信息	字符型	200	否	
				
				IF IsNull(ls_error) THEN ls_error = ''
				gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()通信出错×               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+ls_error) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()通信出错×
				il_time_pre = CPU()
				as_return = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_error
				RETURN False
			END IF
		ELSE
			//			IF ll_pos = 0 THEN ll_pos = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
			gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()通信出错×               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+ls_error) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()通信出错×
			il_time_pre = CPU()
			as_return = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_recieve
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()捕捉到错误×             历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+er2.Text) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()捕捉到错误×
	il_time_pre = CPU()
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
gf_jsrz_tz("台州.uf_send()通信成功○               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_send()通信成功○
il_time_pre = CPU()
//gf_applog('发送返回 cpu:' + string(cpu() - ll_cpu))
//把当前发送的内容转移掉
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)

RETURN of_receive_data(ls_recieve,as_return)
end function

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数譊AT*

//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue
as_data = ''

IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_data = ''
	RETURN True
END IF
ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+as_mxnr+"'",1,9999999)
IF ll_num <= 0  THEN
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	RETURN False
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
//串联所有的消息体
FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count //ids_send_in.Object.max_datarow[1]
	
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		IF ls_dataname = '卡片类型' Or ls_dataname = '身份凭证信息' or  ls_dataname = '社会保障卡卡的识别码' or ls_dataname = '社会保障卡信息' THEN
		ELSE
			ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find])
		END IF
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		IF li_i = li_bound THEN
			as_data = as_data + ls_datavalue + '^'
		ELSE
			as_data = as_data + ls_datavalue + '|'
		END IF
	NEXT
NEXT
RETURN True


end function

public function string of_get_jklx_oldmc (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN Lower(ids_structre.Object.mxnr_old[ll_find])
ELSE
	RETURN ''
END IF


end function

	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = al_row

li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = 'datacount' and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())
if li_row <= 0 then 
	li_row = ids_send_in.insertrow(0)
	ids_send_in.object.dataname[li_row] = 'datacount'
	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = 1
	ids_send_in.object.datavalue[li_row] = '0'
	ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
end if

end subroutine

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
ibase_info = base_info


RETURN 1




end function

private function boolean of_receivein_data (string as_xxlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return, string as_mxnr);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_mc[],ls_format[],ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm
String ls_xxtcf
Int li_len[],li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_datarow,li_pos = 0
Long ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert
Long ll_count
String ls_xxtfj[]
//返回数据的判断
//if isnull(as_xxt) or trim(as_xxt) = '' then
//	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
//	return false
//end if
IF as_xxt = '' Or IsNull(as_xxt) THEN RETURN True
ls_xxt = leftw(as_xxt,lenw(as_xxt) - 1)
ll_count = of_splitparm(ls_xxt,ls_xxtfj,'^')
IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
	as_return = '未找到结构体^'
	RETURN False
END IF
//ls_xxt = as_xxt
//如果没有错误就继续分解内部消息体内容
//ls_xxlx = ls_xxlx + "_O"
//this.of_get_structure( ls_xxlx,'JG', ls_mc, li_len, ls_format,as_return)
//li_bound = upperbound(ls_mc)

li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxlx , 'JG')
li_sum = 0
li_datarow = 0

//加一条明细条数
ids_receive_in.InsertRow(1)
ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[1] = '0'
ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = 0
ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[1] = 'datacount'
ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[1] = as_mxnr
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = ll_row
	ls_xxtcf = ls_xxtfj[ll_row]
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		li_pos = posw(ls_xxtcf,'|')
		IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
			ls_datavalue = ls_xxtcf
		ELSE
			
			ls_datavalue = midw(ls_xxtcf,1,li_pos - 1)
			ls_xxtcf = midw(ls_xxtcf,li_pos + 1)
		END IF
		ll_insert = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
		ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[ll_insert] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[ll_insert] = ll_row
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[ll_insert] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[ll_insert] = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_mc[li_i]
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[ll_insert] = as_mxnr
		ll_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = 'rowcount'",1,999999)
		
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN ll_find = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[ll_find] = String(ll_row)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[ll_find] = 's'
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[ll_find] = 'rowcount'
	NEXT
NEXT
//if base_info.userid='211240' then
//	ids_receive_in.saveas( "c:\receive_in.txt",text!,true)
//end if
RETURN True


end 
function

public function long uf_getstring_mxnr (string as_mxnr);//解析的时候，多个结构体调用，获取某个结构体的内容，个数
is_mxnr = as_mxnr
long ll_find
ll_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = Upper ('datacount')  and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())
if ll_find > 0 then 
	return ids_receive_in.object.datarow[ll_find]
else
	return -1
end if

end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

Long		ll_pos ,ll_len

IF as_str = '' Or IsNull(as_str)Or	as_find = as_replace THEN RETURN as_str

ll_len = Lenw(as_replace)
ll_pos = 0
DO
	IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	END IF
	IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
		as_str = Replacew(as_str,ll_pos,Lenw(as_find),as_replace)
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0

//messagebox('',as_str)
RETURN as_str


end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);// 2020.10.26  CJN  报文体内容存在分隔符，需要进行转义   （新旧接口标志 0-旧接口 1-新接口） 
//IF is_SYDXJKQY  = '0' THEN
//	as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','')
//	as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','')

//ELSE
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','&caret;')
IF ii_TZSYBXJKQY=1 Then
ELSE
	as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','&brvbar;')
END IF
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'~~','&tilde;')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'$$','&dollar;')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"'",'')
//END IF

RETURN as_string

end function

end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init_ygyb (string as_xxtlx);//数据库中医保前置机IP地址和C:\SendRcvA.ini的ip地址不匹配，请检查" 是否有需要  is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx) ids_send.Reset() ids_send_in.Reset()
//清空交易头数据

str_tzyg_jyt lstr_jytsrx
istr_jytsrx = lstr_jytsrx

istr_jytsrx.ver = '1.0'
istr_jytsrx.YLJGDM = is_yljgdm
istr_jytsrx.YLJGXZQH = is_yljgxzqh
istr_jytsrx.AGENTIP = is_agentip
istr_jytsrx.AGENTMAC = is_agentmac
istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ''
istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH = ''
istr_jytsrx.SFZH  = ''
istr_jytsrx.CBRXZQH = ''
istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH = ''
istr_jytsrx.XXLXM = is_xxtlx
istr_jytsrx.JYSJ = gf_server_date()
end subroutine

public function integer uf_send_ygyb (string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
Int li_i,li_bound,li_find,li_datalen
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_jgdm,ls_mxnr
//在这里判断初始化是否成功
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN -1
END IF
//返回对应的消息体格式
ls_xxt = ''
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx,'QQ', li_i)
	
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		ls_mxnr = of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
		IF of_get_sendin_ygyb( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'QQ',li_i),ls_datavalue, This.of_get_jklx_len(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i), as_return,ls_mxnr) = False THEN RETURN -1
		
		IF of_get_jklx_xhcs( is_xxtlx,'QQ', li_i) > 1 THEN
			ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "<"+ls_mxnr+">" + ls_datavalue + "</"+ls_mxnr+">"
		ELSE
			ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
		END IF
		
	ELSEIF Lower(ls_dataname) = 'b_packhospital' THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "<PackHospital xmlns='http://schemas.datacontract.org/2004/07/BMI.Engine.Common.Hospital' xmlns:i='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'>"
	ELSEIF Lower(ls_dataname) = 'e_packhospital' THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "</PackHospital>"
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "lower(dataname) = '"+lower(ls_dataname)+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		
		li_datalen = This.of_get_jklx_len(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //li_len[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				of_midstring(ls_datavalue,li_datalen)
				ls_datavalue = ls_datavalue
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + '<'+ls_dataname+'>' + ls_datavalue +'</'+ls_dataname+'>'
	END IF
NEXT

//-------------------------- //cmdHeadXml  消息头----------------
ls_send = "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?><MSG><HEAD>"
ls_send = ls_send +"<VER>"+istr_jytsrx.VER+"</VER>" //版本号
ls_send = ls_send +"<YLJGDM>"+istr_jytsrx.YLJGDM+"</YLJGDM>" //医疗机笵AT*
  ??
ls_send = ls_send +"<YLJGXZQH>"+istr_jytsrx.YLJGXZQH+"</YLJGXZQH>" //医疗机构行政区划
ls_send = ls_send +"<AGENTIP>"+istr_jytsrx.AGENTIP+"</AGENTIP>" //操作设备IP地址
ls_send = ls_send +"<AGENTMAC>"+istr_jytsrx.AGENTMAC+"</AGENTMAC>" //操作设备MAC地址
ls_send = ls_send +"<SBKH>"+istr_jytsrx.SBKH+"</SBKH>" //社保卡号 SBKH-SBKSBH
ls_send = ls_send +"<SBKSBH>"+istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH+"</SBKSBH>" //社保卡识别号
ls_send = ls_send +"<SFZH>"+istr_jytsrx.SFZH+"</SFZH>" //身份证号
ls_send = ls_send +"<CBRXZQH>"+istr_jytsrx.CBRXZQH+"</CBRXZQH>" //参保人行政区号
ls_send = ls_send +"<JZWYBH>"+istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH+"</JZWYBH>" //就诊编号，医院上传挂号时生成的编号
ls_send = ls_send +"<XXLXM>"+istr_jytsrx.XXLXM+"</XXLXM>" //编码，见消息类型
ls_send = ls_send +"<JYSJ>"+String(istr_jytsrx.JYSJ,'yyyymmdd/hhmmss/')+"</JYSJ>" //交易时间（格式：年月日/时分秒/）YYYYMMDD/HHMISS/
ls_send = ls_send +"</HEAD>" //cmdHeadXml  消息头
//------------------------------------------------------------------------	
IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF

//针对下载类或者数据量大业务交易，进行循环调用
Int li_ret
as_return = ''
ls_recieve = Space(4000000)

TRY
	ls_send = ls_send +"<BODY>" +  ls_xxt + "</BODY></MSG>"
	IF IsNull(ls_xxt) THEN ls_xxt = ''
	ls_recieve = Audit4HospitalPortal (	ls_send)
	IF base_info.UserID = '209134' THEN
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','【'+is_xxtlx+'】消息体:'+ls_send)
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','【'+is_xxtlx+'】recieve:'+ls_recieve)
	END IF
	if isnumber(mid(ls_recieve,1,1)) then
		li_ret = integer(mid(ls_recieve,1,1))
	ELSE
		li_ret= -1
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN -1
END TRY
IF li_ret <= 0 THEN
	as_return = istr_jytsrx.XXLXM + '阳光医保发送错误：' + ls_recieve
ELSE
	as_return = istr_jytsrx.XXLXM + ':' + ls_recieve
END IF
RETURN li_ret





end function

public function long of_get_jklx_len (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+string(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_structre.GetItemDecimal(ll_find, "mxcd") //ids_structre.object.mxcd[ll_find]
else
	return -1
end if

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin_ygyb (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, integer ai_len, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);
Integer li_bound,li_i,li_datalen //li_len[],
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_xhcs
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue,ls_xmltitle
as_data = ''
ids_send_in.SetFilter( "upper(mxnr) = '"+upper(as_mxnr)+"'")
ids_send_in.Filter( )

IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	ids_send_in.SetFilter( "")
	ids_send_in.Filter( )
	as_msg = "找不到对应的明细"
	RETURN False
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
ll_xhcs = ids_send_in.Find("dataname = 'datacount' and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(as_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.RowCount())
IF ll_xhcs <= 0  THEN
	ids_send_in.SetFilter( "")
	ids_send_in.Filter( )
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	RETURN False
END IF
ll_xhcs = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_xhcs]

FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_xhcs
	as_data = as_data + "<" + as_jklx + ">" 
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find( "lower(dataname) = '"+lower(ls_dataname)+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		
		li_datalen = This.of_get_jklx_len( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //li_len[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				if len(ls_datavalue) > li_datalen then
					of_midstring(ls_datavalue,li_datalen)
				END IF
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
				ls_datavalue = string(dec(ls_datavalue))
		END CHOOSE
		IF isnull(ls_datavalue) then ls_datavalue = ''
		as_data = as_data + "<"+ ls_dataname+">" + ls_datavalue +"</"+  ls_dataname+">"
	NEXT
	as_data += "</" + as_jklx+ ">"
NEXT
RETURN True

end function

public function long of_get_jklx_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.GetItemNumber( ll_find, "xhcs")
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF


end function

end function

ids_dmzd_dz.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_new'
ids_dmzd_dz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz.RowCount()
	IF IsNull(ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i]) THEN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i] = '' //空处理
NEXT
ids_dmzd_dz_jb = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_jb' //20200319 wangyi 疾病对照单独拿出来
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz_jb.RowCount()
	IF IsNull(ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Object.dmsb_dz[i]) THEN ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Object.dmsb_dz[i] = '' //空处理
NEXT

ids_zfzd = create datastore  //wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
ids_zfzd.dataobject = 'd_zfzd'
ids_zfzd.settransobject( sqlca)
ids_zfzd.retrieve( )

ids_jklx = Create datastore
ids_jklx.DataObject = 'd_yb_jklx'
ids_jklx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF ib_tzsyd = true THEN //台州市异地
	ids_jklx.Retrieve('TZSYD')
ELSE
	ids_jklx.Retrieve('SEP')
END IF
SetNull(idt_jzkssj)
//ii_smkjs = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'SMKZJJS','0','市民卡诊间结算是否启用'))
////ii_smkjs = 1
//ii_zdsl = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZDSL','0','新旧程序切换用'))
ii_mxts = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZYYCSCTS','30','医保住院一次性上传条数'))
ilrr_ydxh[1] = long(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'SLD_XY' , '8472','塑料袋西药'))
ilrr_ydxh[2] = long(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'SLD_ZY' , '8474','塑料袋成药'))
ilrr_ydxh[3] = long(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'SLD_CY' , '8473','塑料袋草药'))
il_czyqdcs = long(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'CZYQRCS' , '5','操作员签入有效时长，天数'))
ii_sfqr = integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'CZYSFQRQY' , '1','操作员签入是否启用:0不启用，1启用')) //省里可以不启用签到
is_mzzz = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'SYD_MZKK' , '9999','省异地门诊诊间扣款工号')
is_zyzz = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'SYD_ZYKK' , '9999','省异地住院自助结算工号')
is_zdfy = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZDFYRQFY',',','指定退费日期费用')
is_sbyxzqh = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"SBJXZQH","330300","市本级上级行政区划代码")
//wangyi 20201126 自费诊断可以历年报销
//is_zfzdbm_cl  = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDBM_CL_SYD','8000000000000004','自费诊断一次性材料省异地编码')
//is_zfzdbm_zl  = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDBM_ZL_SYD','8000000000000003','自费诊断诊疗及服务项目省异地编码')
//is_zfzdbm_xy  = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDBM_XY_SYD','8000000000000001','自费诊断目录外治疗性西药省异地编码')
//is_zfzdbm_zcy = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDBM_ZCY_SYD','8000000000000002','自费诊断目录外治疗性中成药省异地编码')
is_zfzdbm_bkbx = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDBM_BKBX_SYD','9000000000000001,','不可使用个人账户支付省异地编码')
ii_zfzdqy = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFZDQY','1','自费诊断或体检是否启用历年账户支付：0不启用,1启用,2只启用收费3只启用体检'))
ii_zfbmqy = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'ZFBMQY','1','审批为自费的是否启用自费通用码：0不启用,1启用'))
IF ib_tzsyd = true THEN //wangyi 20191009 分诊系统默认收费诊断用上呼吸道感染
	is_tjzddm = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca, 0, 'TJZDDM' , '8371,31809','体检诊断代码')
	IF base_info.syscode = 41 THEN
		is_mricd10 = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,41,'SFMRZDICD10','J06.903','分诊系统收费默认诊断的ICD10')
		is_mrzdmc = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,41,'SFMRZDMC','上呼吸道感染','分诊系统收费默认诊断的名称')
	ELSE
		is_mricd10 = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'SFMRZDICD10','0','收费默认诊断的ICD10')
		is_mrzdmc = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'SFMRZDMC','挂号','收费默认诊断的名称')
	END IF
END IF
string ls_psamid
uf_get_psamid(ls_psamid)
DISCONNECT Using itran_sqlca;
RETURN True
end function

public function integer uf_czy_zc (string as_ygdm[], ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_zc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:省医保操作员注册
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_ygdm[]	本院内部员工代码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx		日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
Long ll_row ,ll_index
string ls_success
u_datastore lds_ygdm
lds_ygdm = Create u_datastore
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_err = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

lds_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
lds_ygdm.DataObject = 'd_ygdm_kz'
lds_ygdm.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
IF lds_ygdm.Retrieve(as_ygdm ) < 1 THEN
	as_err = '员工代码不存在，请重新确认' + lds_ygdm.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

ll_row = lds_ygdm.RowCount( )


//this.uf_send_add( '医疗服务机构编号', '') //测试时，该节点不能传数据
String ls_xm,ls_sfzh,ls_sjhm,ls_ygnm
Long ll_ret,ll_find,ll_row2,ll_index2
String ls_ygdm, ls_sptbm
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_row
	ls_xm = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_ygxm[ll_index]
	ls_sfzh = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_sfzh[ll_index]
	ls_sjhm = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_sjhm[ll_index]
	ls_ygnm = lds_ygdm.Object.ygdm[ll_index]
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州市异地交易码不一样
		This.uf_send_init( '9352')
		uf_send_add('医疗服务机构编号',is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
		uf_send_add('姓名',ls_xm)
		uf_send_add('公民身份号码',ls_sfzh)
		uf_send_add('操作员内部工号',ls_ygnm)
		uf_send_add('联系电话（手机）',ls_sjhm)
		uf_send_add('注册申请日期',String(Today(),'yyyy-mm-dd'))
		uf_send_add('其他说明','')
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_init( '9252')
		this.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('操作员列表')
		uf_send_add_in('姓名',ls_xm,1)
		uf_send_add_in('公民身份号码',ls_sfzh,1)
		uf_send_add_in('操作员内部工号',ls_ygnm,1)
		uf_send_add_in('联系电话（手机）',ls_sjhm,1)
		uf_send_add_in('注册申请日期',String(Today(),'yyyy-mm-dd'),1)
		uf_send_add_in('其他说明','',1)
	END IF	
	
	ls_success += ','+ls_ygnm
	IF Not  This.uf_send( as_err )   THEN  RETURN -1
	
	
	ll_ret = Long( This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果'))
	IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息') + '错误员工代码:'+ls_ygnm
		RETURN -1
	END IF

	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州市异地注册返回解析
		ls_sptbm = This.uf_getstring( '操作员账号')
		ll_find = lds_ygdm.Find( "ygdm = '"+ls_ygnm+"'", 1, 999999)
		IF ll_find > 0  THEN
			lds_ygdm.Object.sptdm[ll_find] = ls_sptbm
		END IF
	ELSE
		ll_row2 = Long(this.uf_getstring_mxnr('操作员统一编码列表'))
		IF ll_row2 = 0 THEN
			as_err = '获取社保返回员工编码失败!' + '错误员工代码:'+ls_ygnm
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_index2 = 1 To ll_row2
			ls_ygdm = This.uf_getstring_in( '操作员内部工号', ll_index2)
			ls_sptbm = This.uf_getstring_in( '操作员账号',ll_index2)
			ll_find = lds_ygdm.Find( "ygdm = '"+ls_ygdm+"'", 1, 999999)
			IF ll_find > 0  THEN
				lds_ygdm.Object.sybdm[ll_find] = ls_sptbm
			END 
IF
		NEXT
	END IF

	
	IF lds_ygdm.Update( ) > 0 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
 		as_err = '已成功注册'+ls_success
	ELSE
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = lds_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_czy_qrqc (date ad_qdrq, string as_czybm, string as_qrlb, long ai_qrqc, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_qrqc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date   	ad_qdrq 	签到日期
// 	value    	string 	as_czybm	操作员编码
// 	value    	string 	as_qrlb 	签入类别 0通用 1门诊 2住院
// 	value    	string 	ai_qrqc 	1 签入  2签出
// 	reference	integer	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx	日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
//if ii_sfqr = 0 then return 1
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_error = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Integer li_Ztbz,li_count
Date ldt_qdrq
DateTime ldt_qdrq_temp,ldt_qdsj
Int ll_ret
String ls_jyzqh,ls_temp,ls_time[],ls_sptbm,ls_sptbm_tz
//ii_sfqr 用于是否启用省异地签入签出
SELECT sybdm,sptdm Into :ls_sptbm,:ls_sptbm_tz From gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :as_czybm Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0   THEN
	as_error =  '获取员工扩展信息失败：' + as_czybm +' sqlcode:' + string(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //查询台州市异地操作员是否注册
	IF isnull(ls_sptbm_tz) or trim(ls_sptbm_tz) = '' then
		as_error = '操作员'+'('+as_czybm+')'+'在市平台未注册，请先进行注册！'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_sptbm = ls_sptbm_tz
ELSE
	IF isnull(ls_sptbm) or trim(ls_sptbm) = '' then
		as_error = '操作员'+'('+as_czybm+')'+'在省平台未注册，请先进行注册！'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF


IF ai_qrqc = 1 THEN
	//time1与time2之间不进行签出提醒
	Time lt_time1,lt_time2
	ls_temp = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,5,'SFYQCSJ','','操作员不进行对账，签退时间段') //gf_getpara(5,'SFYQCSJ','','操作员不进行对账，签退时间段')
	//lt_time1 = time(left(ls_temp,pos(ls_temp,','
	gu_char.uf_splitparm( ls_temp, ls_time)
	IF UpperBound(ls_time) < 2 THEN
	ELSE
		lt_time1 = Time(ls_time[1])
		lt_time2 = Time(ls_time[2])
	END IF

	ldt_qdrq = ad_qdrq
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		SELECT qdrq Into :ldt_qdrq_temp From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Where  czybm = :as_czybm And QRLB = :as_qrlb And ztbz < 3 Order By jlxh Desc  Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT qdrq Into :ldt_qdrq_temp From jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Where  czybm = :as_czybm And QRLB = :as_qrlb And ztbz < 3 Order By jlxh Desc  Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	//签到日期已隔天
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0  THEN
		IF relativedate(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),il_czyqdcs) < ldt_qdrq THEN
			IF Time(Now()) < lt_time1 And Time(Now()) > lt_time2  THEN
				ldt_qdrq = Date(ldt_qdrq_temp)
			ELSE
				as_error = '上次('+String(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),'yyyy-mm-dd')+')签入未签出,请先对账并签退!'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//	date ld_qdrq
	//是否需要判断哪天未签出
	//	select qdrq into :ld_qdrq from jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc wherec qdrq < :ad_qdrq and zybm = :base_info.UserID and ztbz >= 1 And QRLB = :as_qrlb order by qdrq desc Using itran_sqlca; 
	//	if not isnull(ld_qdrq) and ld_qdrq > date(2000,1,1) then
	//		is_jyzqh = ''
	//		as_error = String(ld_qdrq,'YYYYMMDD') + '操作员还未对账或签出,请先对账或签出!'
	//		RETURN -1
	//	end if
	//	ldt_qdrq
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		SELECT ztbz,jyzqh Into :li_Ztbz,:ls_jyzqh From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Where qdrq = :ldt_qdrq_temp And czybm = :as_czybm And QRLB = :as_qrlb   And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT ztbz,jyzqh Into :li_Ztbz,:ls_jyzqh From jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Where qdrq = :ldt_qdrq_temp And czybm = :as_czybm And QRLB = :as_qrlb   And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '查询签入记录失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			INSERT Into jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc(czybm,qdrq,QRLB,ztbz,sptbm) Values (:as_czybm,:ldt_qdrq,:as_qrlb,0,:ls_sptbm) Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			INSERT Into jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc(czybm,qdrq,QRLB,ztbz,sptbm) Values (:as_czybm,:ldt_qdrq,:as_qrlb,0,:ls_sptbm) Using itran_sqlca;
		END IF
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = '插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			This.uf_send_init('9353')
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_init('9253')
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_sptbm)
		This.uf_send_add('签到类型',as_qrlb)
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			ll_ret = Integer (This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果'))
			IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
				as_error = '社保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
			is_jyzqh = This.uf_getstring('日对帐流水号') //交易周期号
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
				UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq And QRLB = :as_qrlb And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			ELSE
				UPDATE jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq And QRLB = :as_qrlb And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '交易周期号:' +is_jyzqh + ';更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		ELSE
			is_jyzqh = ''
			as_error = '操作员签入失败:' + as_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_Ztbz = 0 THEN
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			This.uf_send_init('9353')
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_init('9253')
		END IF
		//覆盖消息头中操作员编码
		
		
		This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_sptbm)
		This.uf_send_add('签到类型',as_qrlb)
		
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			ll_ret = Integer (This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果'))
			IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
				as_error = '社保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			is_jyzqh = This.uf_getstring('日对帐流水号') //交易周期号
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
		ELSE
			IF Pos(as_error,'已经签入' ) > 0 And Pos(as_error,'签入周期号为') > 0 THEN
				is_jyzqh = Mid(as_error,Pos(as_error,'签入周期号为') + 26)
			ELSE
				is_jyzqh = ''
				as_error = '操作员签入失败:' + as_error
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		IF is_jyzqh > '' THEN
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
				UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj ,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq And QRLB = :as_qrlb  And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			ELSE
				UPDATE jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj ,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq And QRLB = :as_qrlb  And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '交易周期号:' +is_jyzqh + ';更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_Ztbz = 1 THEN //已签到,再调用该函数时,则给实例变量赋直
		is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
	END IF
	
END IF


RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_czy_rdz (date adt_dzr, string as_czybm, string as_ywlx, ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_rdz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date  	adt_dzr 	
// 	value    	string	as_czybm	
// 	value    	string	as_ywlx 	
// 	reference	string	as_err  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx	日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
//数据库连接准备
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_err  = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jyzqh,ls_err,ls_czy_sptbm
Date ldt_dzr
ldt_dzr = Date(adt_dzr)

SELECT jyzqh,sptbm  Into :ls_jyzqh,:ls_czy_sptbm From jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr  And czybm = :as_czybm  And ztbz = 1 And qrlb = :as_ywlx Using itran_sqlca;
IF ls_jyzqh = '' Or IsNull(ls_jyzqh) THEN
	as_err = '未取得操作员('+as_czybm+')'+'对应的交易周期号'
	RETURN -1
END IF

	sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj),sum(yl1)
	INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
	:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_hjbjjzf

	UPDATE jkxt.syd_dzxx SET dzsj = sysdate ,
		jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
		DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf  = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj
		Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And ywlx = :as_ywlx And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	INSERT INTO jkxt.syd_dzxx(dzsj,jsjlts ,YBMXJSJLTS ,fyze, zfze , zlze, grxjzf, bxje, tcjjzf , wnzhzf, DNZHZF,dbjzzf, gwybzzf, eyjjzf , lxjjzf, lmjjzf , bzjjzf, mzbzjj 		,czyzh,dzlsh,dzrq,dzlx,ywlx )
		VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj 		,:ls_czy_sptbm,:ls_jyzqh,:ldt_dzr,'1',:as_ywlx  ) Using itran_sqlca;

	IF Long(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果')) < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_dzjg = This.uf_getstring('对账结果标志') //对账结果
	ls_bz = This.uf_getstring('对帐不一致信息') //备注
	String ls_ztbz

		ls_bz = '对账结果一致'
	ELSEIF ls_dzjg = '-1' THEN
		
	END IF
	UPDATE jkxt.syd_dzxx Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And ywlx = :as_ywlx And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :ls_jyzqh  Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
	as_err  = '对账结果:'+ls_dz_ret+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
as_err = ls_dz_ret
IF ls_dzjg <> '0' THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	UPDATE jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = '3',qcsj = sysdate Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr And qrlb = :as_ywlx And czybm = :as_czybm And jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
		as_err  = '对账结果:通过!'+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
END IF


RETURN 1

end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF

IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州市异地直接返回
	RETURN uf_send(as_return,0,is_yljgxzqh)
END IF

Integer li_jyfs,li_xhxh
String ls_jsfxzqh //传入接收方行政区划和发送报文ID，中间用单波浪线‘~’分割
Integer li_xxmddxzqh
String ls_xzqh
Long ll_find
//接收方行政区划：跟机构相关的如对账交易传省平台行政区划‘330000’； 
//跟参保人业务相关的交易:9201传卡识别码前6位，其余交易传9201参保地返回的参保地行政区划代码；
//发送报文ID：医院端唯一的发送报文ID，必须保证本医院内唯一，后续交易作废需要使用到该ID进行处理。
//每笔交易的唯一标识，规则：医院编码（12位）+ 顺序号（18）；
//IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
//	as_return = is_error
//	RETURN false
//END IF
IF Left(is_xxtlx,1) = '3' THEN //上传下载类交易申请
	li_jyfs = 1
	ls_jsfxzqh = '330000'
ELSE //实时结算类交易
	li_xxmddxzqh = of_get_jklx_xxmddxzqh(is_xxtlx)
	
	IF li_xxmddxzqh = 1 THEN
		ls_xzqh =  '330000'
	ELSE
		ll_find = ids_send.Find("dataname='参保地行政区划代码'",1,999999)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_xzqh = ids_send.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		ELSE
			as_return = '未找到参保地行政区划代码'+is_xxtlx
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_xzqh) Or ls_xzqh = '' THEN
		as_return = '参保地行政区划代码为空，请核对' + is_xxtlx
		RETURN False
	END IF
	li_jyfs = 0
	ls_jsfxzqh = ls_xzqh
END IF

IF uf_send(as_return,li_jyfs,ls_jsfxzqh) THEN
	RETURN True
ELSE
	RETURN False
END IF



end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);
IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+String(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

	return ''
end if

if ll_find > 0 then

	return ids_dmzd_dz.object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
else
	if as_dmlb  = '1404' then return ''
	return '无'
end if
end function
