public function string of_get_dzdmsbmc (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
Long ll_find,ll_jlxh
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] > '' THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find]
	ELSE
		String ls_dmmc
		CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
			CASE 'GY_KSDM'
				ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
				SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'MZ_KS'
				SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'YK_YPSX'
				SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		END CHOOSE
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tname[ll_find] = Upper(as_table)
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tjlxh[ll_find] = as_tjlxh
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] = ls_dmmc
		RETURN ls_dmmc
	END IF
ELSE
	CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
		CASE 'GY_KSDM'
			ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
			SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'MZ_KS'
			SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'YK_YPSX'
			SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE else
			ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	END CHOOSE
	If ISNULL(ls_dmmc) THEN ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	RETURN ls_dmmc
END IF

end function

		String ls_yb_dzbh,ls_jldw,ls_yfgg,ls_bfgg,ls_bfdw,ls_yfdw,ls_zxdw,gjypbm
		SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,YK_YPCD.YBBM ,YPJL,JLDW,YFGG,BFGG,BFDW,YFDW,ZJPB,TYPE,ZXDW,KZYP,YK_YPCD.YPCD,yk_typk.ypsx,YK_YPCD.GJYPBM,yk_typk.ypmc
			INTO :ll_ypxh,:ls_yb_dzbh,:ldc_ypjl,:ls_jldw,:ls_yfgg,:ls_bfgg,:ls_bfdw,:ls_yfdw,:li_zjpb,:li_type,:ls_zxdw,
			:li_kzyp,:ll_ypcd,:li_ypsx,:ls_gjybbm,:ls_ypfymc
			FROM YPXT.YK_TYPK,YPXT.YK_YPCD
			Where YK_TYPK.YPXH = :al_ypxh And YK_YPCD.YPXH = YK_TYPK.YPXH And YK_YPCD.YPCD = :al_ypcd Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_yb_dzbh) Or Trim(ls_yb_dzbh) = '' THEN
				IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
					as_error = '药品未维护对应的省编码（' +String(al_ypxh) + "）"+ ls_ypfymc  + "!请联系药库维护!"
					RETURN -1
				ELSE
					CHOOSE CASE li_type
						CASE 1 //西药
							IF li_zjpb = 1 THEN
								ls_yb_dzbh = is_zf_zzxy
							ELSE
								ls_yb_dzbh = is_zf_xy
							END IF
						CASE 2 //成药
							IF li_zjpb = 1 THEN
								ls_yb_dzbh = is_zf_zzzy
							ELSE
								ls_yb_dzbh = is_zf_zy
							END IF
						CASE 3 //草药
							ls_yb_dzbh = is_zf_cy
					END CHOOSE
				END IF
			END IF
			If (IsNull(ls_gjybbm) Or ls_gjybbm = '' ) And ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
				as_error = '药品未维护对应的国家编码（' +String(al_ypxh) + "）"+ ls_ypfymc  + "!荄AT* 肓�系药库维� !"
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ls_ypzllx = '1'
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
				SELECT ypmc,SFXMDJ Into :ls_ybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.TZYB_YPML_SYD Where YPBM = :ls_yb_dzbh Using itran_sqlca;
			ELSE
				SELECT ypmc,SFXMDJ Into :ls_ybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.SYDYB_YPML Where YPBM = :ls_yb_dzbh Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				ls_ypzllx = '2'
				IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
					SELECT XMMC,SFXMDJ Into :ls_ybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.TZYB_ZLML_SYD Where XMBM = :ls_yb_dzbh Using itran_sqlca;
				ELSE
					SELECT XMMC,SFXMDJ Into :ls_ybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.SYDYB_ZLML Where XMBM = :ls_yb_dzbh Using itran_sqlca;
				END IF
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_ybmc) Or Trim(ls_ybmc) = '' THEN
				as_error = 'YP省医保目录中找不到对应的编码（' +String(al_ypxh) + "）"+ ls_yb_dzbh
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			
			SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz From JKXT.YB_TSDZ Where FYLX = 2 And FYXH = :al_ypxh And (YPCD = 0 Or YPCD = :al_ypcd) Using itran_sqlca;
			SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz_lb From JKXT.YB_TSDZ_LB Where FYLX = 2 And FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
			ll_find = ids_typk.InsertRow(0)
			ids_typk.Object.YPXH[ll_find] = ll_ypxh
			ids_typk.Object.YB_DZBH[ll_find] = ls_yb_dzbh
			ids_typk.Object.YPJL[ll_find] = ldc_ypjl
			ids_typk.Object.JLDW[ll_find] = ls_jldw
			ids_typk.Object.YFGG[ll_find] = ls_yfgg
			ids_typk.Object.BFGG[ll_find] = ls_bfgg
			ids_typk.Object.YFDW[ll_find] = ls_yfdw
			ids_typk.Object.BFDW[ll_find] = ls_bfdw
			ids_typk.Object.ZJPB[ll_find] = li_zjpb
			ids_typk.Object.Type[ll_find] = li_type
			ids_typk.Object.ZXDW[ll_find] = ls_zxdw
			ids_typk.Object.KZYP[ll_find] = li_kzyp
			ids_typk.Object.YPCD[ll_find] = ll_ypcd
			ids_typk.Object.ypsx[ll_find] = li_ypsx
			ids_typk.Object.YBMC[ll_find] = ls_ybmc
			ids_typk.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find] = ls_sfxmdj
			ids_typk.Object.ypzllx[ll_find] = ls_ypzllx
			ids_typk.Object.GJYBBM[ll_find] = ls_gjybbm
			IF li_tsdz > 0 THEN
				ids_typk.Object.tsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
			
			IF li_tsdz_lb > 0 THEN
				ids_typk.Object.lbtsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
			RETURN ll_find
		ELSE
			as_error = '取不到药品基本信息:(ypxh' + String(al_ypxh)+')' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE //费用
	ll_find = ids_ylsf.Find("fyxh =" + String(al_ypxh),1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ll_find
	ELSE
		Long ll_fyxh
		Integer li_fygb,li_kzpb = 0
		String ls_fymc,ls_fydw,ls_zlybmc
		SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz From JKXT.YB_TSDZ Where FYLX = 3 And FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
		SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz_lb From JKXT.YB_TSDZ_LB Where FYLX = 3 And FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
		
		SELECT FYXH ,YBBM,fymc,FYDW,FYGB,GJYBBM INTO :ll_fyxh,:ls_ybzxbh,:ls_fymc,:ls_fydw,:li_fygb ,:ls_gjybbm
			From GY_YLSF Where FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllx = '2'
			IF IsNull(ls_YBZXBH) Or Trim(ls_YBZXBH) = '' THEN
				IF li_fygb = 70 THEN //材料
					ls_YBZXBH = is_zf_cl
				ELSE
					ls_YBZXBH = is_zf_zl
				END IF
			END IF
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
				SELECT XMMC,SFXMDJ Into :ls_zlybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.TZYB_ZLML_SYD Where XMBM = :ls_YBZXBH  Using itran_sqlca;
			ELSE
				SELECT XMMC,SFXMDJ Into :ls_zlybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.SYDYB_ZLML Where XMBM = :ls_YBZXBH  Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				ls_ypzllx = '1'
				IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
					SELECT ypmc,SFXMDJ  Into :ls_zlybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.TZYB_YPML_SYD Where YPBM = :ls_YBZXBH Using itran_sqlca;
				ELSE
					SELECT ypmc,SFXMDJ  Into :ls_zlybmc,:ls_sfxmdj From JKXT.SYDYB_YPML Where YPBM = :ls_YBZXBH Using itran_sqlca;
				END IF
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_zlybmc) Or Trim(ls_zlybmc) = '' THEN
				as_error = 'FY省医保目录中找不到对应的编码（' +String(al_ypxh) + "）" + ls_YBZXBH
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ll_find = ids_ylsf.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ylsf.Object.FYXH[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
			ids_ylsf.Object.YBBM[ll_find] = ls_YBZXBH
			ids_ylsf.Object.fymc[ll_find] = ls_fymc
			ids_ylsf.Object.FYDW[ll_find] = ls_fydw
			ids_ylsf.Object.FYGB[ll_find] = li_fygb
			ids_ylsf.Object.YBMC[ll_find] = ls_zlybmc
			ids_ylsf.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find] = ls_sfxmdj
			ids_ylsf.Object.ypzllx[ll_find] = ls_ypzllx
			ids_ylsf.Object.GJYBBM[ll_find] = ls_gjybbm
			SELECT KZPB Into :li_kzpb From GY_YLSF_KZ Where FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
			ids_ylsf.Object.KZPB[ll_find] = li_kzpb
			IF li_tsdz > 0 THEN
				ids_ylsf.Object.tsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
			
			IF li_tsdz_lb > 0 THEN
				ids_ylsf.Object.lbtsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
			RETURN ll_find
		ELSE
			as_error = '取不到费用基本信息:(fyxh'+String(al_ypxh) +')' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	
END IF

RETURN ll_find


end function

public function integer of_get_ygxm (string as_ygdm, ref string as_ygxm, ref string as_sfzh);uf_connect_sqlca_temp()
IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm,sfzh from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		as_ygxm ="创建'ygdm'对象失败("+ids_ygdm.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='" + as_ygdm + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	as_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	as_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find]
ELSE
	String ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh
	SELECT ygxm,sfzh Into :ls_ygxm,:ls_sfzh From GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_ygxm ="获取员工信息失败:" + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
		return  -1
//		ls_ygxm = as_ygdm
	END IF
	
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find] = ls_sfzh
	as_ygxm = ls_ygxm
	as_sfzh = ls_sfzh
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

String ls_csny

astr_yb_grjbxx.zjh = This.uf_getstring('证件号')

astr_yb_grjbxx.cbddwmc = This.uf_getstring('参保地单位名称')
astr_yb_grjbxx.cbylxz = This.uf_getstring('参保医疗险种')
astr_yb_grjbxx.cbrylb = This.uf_getstring('参保人员类别')
astr_yb_grjbxx.fjrylb = This.uf_getstring('附加人员类别')
astr_yb_grjbxx.dnzhye = this.uf_getdecimal('当年账户余额')
astr_yb_grjbxx.lnzhye = this.uf_getdecimal('历年账户余额')

astr_yb_grjbxx.qtzh1mc = This.uf_getstring('其他账户1名称')

astr_yb_grjbxx.qtzh2mc = This.uf_getstring('其他账户2名称')
astr_yb_grjbxx.bnmzybfylj = this.uf_getdecimal('本年门诊医保费用累计')
astr_yb_grjbxx.bnzyybfylj = this.uf_getdecimal('本年住院医保费用累计')
astr_yb_grjbxx.bngdbzybfylj = this.uf_getdecimal('本年规定病种医保费用累计')
astr_yb_grjbxx.bnmzcs = This.uf_getstring('本年门诊次数')
astr_yb_grjbxx.bnzycs = This.uf_getstring('本年住院次数')
astr_yb_grjbxx.fjxx = This.uf_getstring('附加信息')
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	astr_yb_grjbxx.dbdxsb = This.uf_getstring('门诊特殊病编码')
	astr_yb_grjbxx.mztsbbm = This.uf_getstring('门诊特殊病编码')
	astr_yb_grjbxx.szcs = 1023 //台州市
ELSE
	astr_yb_grjbxx.dbdxsb = This.uf_getstring('低保对象标识')
	astr_yb_grjbxx.hjbsfxs = Integer(This.uf_getstring('罕见病备案标识'))
END IF

ls_sfyzjg = This.uf_getstring('身份验证结果')
astr_yb_grjbxx.ryfs = mid(ls_sfyzjg,1,1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.kdj =  mid(ls_sfyzjg,2,1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.dnzhdj = mid(ls_sfyzjg,3,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.wnzhdj = mid(ls_sfyzjg,4,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.zydj = mid(ls_sfyzjg,5,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.cbrysfyx = mid(ls_sfyzjg,6,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.mzdysfxs = mid(ls_sfyzjg,7,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.zydysfxs = mid(ls_sfyzjg,8,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.gdbdysfxs = mid(ls_sfyzjg,9,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.jtbcdysfxs = mid(ls_sfyzjg,10,1) 
astr_yb_grjbxx.hmdlx = mid(ls_sfyzjg,11,2) 
//第1位：人员封锁（0正常，1冻结）；
//第2位：卡被冻结或作废（保留0）；
//第3位：当年账户被冻结；
//第4位：往年帐户被冻结；
//第5位：住院冻结（0：正常 1：住院状态）；
//第6位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参保 1：没参保或参保状态无效）；
//第7位：门诊待遇是否享受（0：享受，1不享受）；
//第8位：住院待遇是否享受（0：享受，1不享受）；
//第9位：规定病待遇是否享受（0：享受，1不享受）；
//第10位：家庭病床待遇是否享受（0：享受，1不享受）；
//第11-12位：黑名单类型（没有黑名单则默认为00）；
//其它位（13-15）：内部预留（返回0）。
of_get_szcs(astr_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm,astr_yb_grjbxx.szcs)



end subroutine

end subroutine

public function integer uf_get_brxz (string as_cbrlb, ref long al_brxz, ref long al_tgdw);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_temp
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'TZSYD_GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :as_cbrlb Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'SYD_GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :as_cbrlb Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	al_brxz = Long(Mid(ls_temp,1,4))
	al_tgdw = Long(Mid(ls_temp,5,4))
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

end function

public function boolean uf_ifyb (long al_data, string as_lx);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN false
END IF
Integer li_ybpb
CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_lx)
	CASE 'ZYH'
		SELECT YBPB INTO :li_ybpb FROM ZY_BRRY, GY_BRXZ
			Where ZY_BRRY.BRXZ = GY_BRXZ.BRXZ And ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'BRXZ','JSLX'
		SELECT YBPB Into :li_ybpb From GY_BRXZ Where BRXZ = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'JSDW'
		
END CHOOSE

RETURN li_ybpb = 1

end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_xs (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);String ls_sbm,ls_kh,ls_dkfs,ls_ret[]
IF IsNull(as_knsj) Or as_knsj = 'YBDK' Or as_knsj = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	//	if this.uf_readcard( as_error) < 0 then
	//      return -1
	//	end if
	//	as_knsj = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj
ELSE
	ls_kh = Right(as_knsj,9)
	ls_sbm = Mid(as_knsj,1,Len(as_knsj) - 9)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = Left(as_knsj,6)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
END IF
This.uf_send_init('9201')
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	This.uf_send_add('医疗类别','')
	// 2020.10.26  CJN  台州市异地按走原接口不变
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
		ls_dkfs = '3' // 5.读卡方式(1) →  (3：令牌)
		as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
		IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
			//6.卡片类型(1) → 身份凭证信息(姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌|参保地行政区|渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号)
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = ls_ret[5]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh = ls_ret[3]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm = ls_ret[1]
			IF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) <= 5 THEN
				ls_ret[6] = ''
				ls_ret[7] = ''
			ELSEIF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) <= 6 THEN
				ls_ret[7] = ''
			END IF
			as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]+ "|" + ls_ret[5] + "|" + ls_ret[7]+"|" +ls_ret[6]
			//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
			IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
			ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
			ELSE
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
			END IF
			as_knsj = as_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
		ELSE
			as_error = '医保电子凭证信息传入错误'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_dkfs = '1'	
	end if
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dkfs = ls_dkfs
	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式',ls_dkfs)
	IF ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
		This.uf_send_add('卡片类型',as_knsj)
		This.uf_send_add('是否有社会保障卡', '0')
	   This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡信息', '')
		This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号','')
		This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码','')
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('卡片类型','1')
		This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡信息', as_knsj)
		This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh)
		This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
	END IF
//	This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', as_knsj)
//	This.uf_send_add('医疗类别','')
//	
//	// 2020.10.26  CJN  台州市异地按走原接口不变
//	
//	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dkfs = '1'
//	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','1')
//	This.uf_send_add('卡片类型','1')
//	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh)
//	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
ELSE
	IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 8 Or base_info.syscode = 15 Or base_info.syscode = 7 THEN
		This.uf_send_add('医疗类别','') //住院没有罕见病，就不传16，否则有些地区不支持医疗类别为16的，返回出错
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('医疗类别','16') //0224调整：增加罕见病门诊16	
	END IF
	// 2020.10.26  CJN  9201 台州省异地和本院一样走新接口
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
		ls_dkfs = '3' // 5.读卡方式(1) →  (3：令牌)
		as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
		IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
			//6.卡片类型(1) → 身份凭证信息(姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌)
			as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = ls_ret[5]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh = ls_ret[3]
			istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm = ls_ret[1]
		ELSE
			as_error = '医保电子凭证信息传入错误'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_dkfs = '1' // 5.读卡方式(1) → (1：读社保卡)
		as_knsj = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh + '|' + istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm
		//		ls_sfpzxx = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh + '|' + istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm
	END IF
	
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dkfs = ls_dkfs
	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式',ls_dkfs)
	This.uf_send_add('卡片类型',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号','')
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码','')
	//	ii_DKFS = 1
	//	CHOOSE CASE ii_DKFS
	//		CASE 1
	//			is_sfpzxx = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh + '|' + istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm
	//			This.uf_send_add('读卡方式', '1') // 5.读卡方式(1) → (1：读社保卡)
	//			This.uf_send_add('卡片类型', is_sfpzxx) // 6.卡片类型(1) → 身份凭证信息(社会保障卡卡号|社会保障卡卡的识别码);
	//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号', '') // 7.社会保障卡卡号 → 预留1
	//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码', '') // 8.社会保障卡卡的识别码 → 预留2
	//		CASE 3
	//			is_sfpzxx = Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm) + '|01|' + Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh) + '令牌'
	//			This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','3') // 5.读卡方式(1) → (3：令牌)
	//			This.uf_send_add('卡片类型', is_sfpzxx) // 6.卡片类型(1) → 身份凭证信息(姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌)
	//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号', '') // 7.社会保障卡卡号 → 预留1
	//			This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码', '') // 8.社会保障卡卡的识别码 → 预留2
	//	END CHOOSE
END IF
//END IF

This.uf_send_add('参保地行政区划代码',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm )
This.uf_send_add('就医地行政区划代码',is_yljgxzqh)
This.uf_send_add('附加信息','')
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号',is_psamid)
This.uf_send_add('卡规范版本','1.00')
This.uf_send_add('证件号',Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh))
This.uf_send_add('姓名',Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm))

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = as_knsj
	of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb)
	OpenWithParm(w_yb_jbxx_xs,'1')
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_mx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error, long al_zyh);Long ll_brxz,ll_tgdw
String ls_tjlxh,ls_cbrlb
SELECT brxz,tgdw Into :ll_brxz,:ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
ls_tjlxh = String(ll_brxz) + String(ll_tgdw)
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT DMSB Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'TZSYD_GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh;
ELSE
	SELECT DMSB Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'SYD_GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh;
END IF
istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.Cbrylb = ls_cbrlb
RETURN 1


end function

public subroutine of_get_szcs (string as_cbdxzqh, ref long al_szcs);SetNull(al_szcs)
CHOOSE CASE as_cbdxzqh
	CASE '330399','330301'
		al_szcs = 960
	CASE '330322'
		al_szcs = 964
	CASE '330324'
		al_szcs = 966
	CASE '330326'
		al_szcs = 967
	CASE '330327'
		al_szcs = 968
	CASE '330328'
		al_szcs = 969
	CASE '330329'
		al_szcs = 970
	CASE '330381'
		al_szcs = 971
	CASE '330382'
		al_szcs = 965
END CHOOSE

end subroutine

public function string of_get_sfxmdj (integer ai_zfbl);
choose case ai_zfbl
	case 0
		return '1' //甲类
	case 1
		return '3' //丙类
	case else
		return '2'
end choose
end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx (string as_brbm, decimal adc_ghlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm, ref string as_zdmc, ref string as_zdms, ref string as_cyzddm[], ref string as_cyzdmc[]);
IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
	ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_mz_zdxx'
END IF

ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(as_brbm,adc_ghlsh,as_ysbm) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
as_zdmc = ''
as_zdms = ''
ib_zfzd = false
Long ll_zdlsh
IF ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
	ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[1]
	if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
		as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
		ib_zfzd = true
		//modify by sxl 20211210:ii_zfzdqy 0不启用,1启用,2只启用收费3只启用体检'
		IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 THEN
			RETURN -2
		END IF
	end if
	
	IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
		as_zddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
	ELSE
		as_zddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ll_zdlsh))
	END IF
	as_zdmc = String(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1])
	as_zdms = String(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1])
ELSE
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //wangyi 20191009 分诊系统默认收费诊断用上呼吸道感染
		as_zddm = is_mricd10
		as_zdmc = is_mrzdmc
	ELSE
		as_zddm = 'Z00.001'
		as_zdmc = '健康体检--无诊断收费处录入'
	END IF
END IF

Long ll_row,i
FOR ll_row = 2 To ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
	//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
	ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_row]
	if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
		as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
		ib_zfzd = true
		//modify by sxl 20211210:ii_zfzdqy 0不启用,1启用,2只启用收费3只启用体检'
		IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 THEN
			RETURN -2
		END IF
	end if

	as_zdms = as_zdms +','	+ ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
	i++
	IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
		as_cyzddm[i] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
		as_cyzdmc[i] = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
	ELSE
		as_cyzddm[i] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ll_zdlsh))
		as_cyzdmc[i] = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
	END IF
NEXT
//if len(as_zdmc) > 100 then as_zdmc = of_midstring1(as_zdmc,100)
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_tfcl (string as_ywlx, string as_mzzyh, string as_jslsh, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_yb_jsxx_syb astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);String ls_jylsh,ls_ywlsh,ls_jzlb,ls_sfybm,ls_ret[]
Integer li_ret
DateTime ldt_now
Decimal{2} ldc_bscfyje
gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.开始uf_tfcl()") // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  褼AT*
奖＝崴闳罩
 市异地\省异地.开始uf_tfcl()
il_time_pre = CPU()
ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	IF base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
		ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
	ELSE
		ls_sfybm = is_mzzz
	END IF
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm , '1', 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('9204')
ELSE
	IF base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
		ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
	ELSE
		ls_sfybm = is_zyzz
	END IF
	
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm, '2', 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('9209')
	Long ll_jsdh
	SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_mzzyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_mzzyh = as_mzzyh + '-' + String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('要作废的住院序列号',as_mzzyh)
END IF
IF isnull(ldc_bscfyje) Then ldc_bscfyje=0
String ls_sfpzxx
//ls_sfpzxx = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.SHBZkkh+'|'+istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm
//uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号', '1')              // 5.社会保障卡卡号 → 读卡方式(1：读卡)
//uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码', ls_sfpzxx)  // 6.社会保障卡卡的识别码 → 身份凭证信息(传入卡号|卡识别码)
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF of_splitparm( istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh > '' And istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm > '' THEN
			ls_sfpzxx = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm +istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh
		ELSE
			ls_sfpzxx = ''
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '0')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_sfpzxx)
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh) //5	社会保障卡卡号
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识盌AT* ', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm ) //6	社会保障卡卡的识别码
	END IF
ELSE
	IF of_splitparm( istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '1' )
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh+'|'+istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
	END IF
END IF
//This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.SHBZkkh) //5	社会保障卡卡号
//This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm ) //6	社会保障卡卡的识别码
This.uf_send_add( '要退费的结算流水号', as_jslsh) //7	要退费的结算流水号
This.uf_send_add( '操作员编号',  base_info.UserID ) //8	操作员编号
This.uf_send_add( '操作员姓名', base_info.username) //9	操作员姓名
This.uf_send_add( '对账流水号', is_jyzqh) //10	对账流水号
This.uf_send_add( '终端机编号', is_psamid) //11	终端机编号
String ls_cbd
ls_cbd = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
IF ls_cbd = '' Or IsNull(ls_cbd) THEN
	ls_cbd = '339900'
END IF
gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送   历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送
il_time_send = CPU()
IF uf_send(as_error,0,ls_cbd) = True THEN
	IF UpperBound(ls_ret) >= 4 THEN
		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,ls_ret[4])
	END IF
	gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()发送成功○               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()发送成功○
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		IF Pos(as_error,'已退费,不允许重复退费') > 0 Or Pos(as_error,'已退') > 0 THEN
			//获取对应的结算信息
			IF This.of_get_jsxx_cftf( as_mzzyh, adt_jssj,as_ywlx, as_jslsh, astr_yb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				istr_yb_jsxx_syb = astr_yb_jsxx
			END IF
			
			RETURN 1
		END IF
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		astr_yb_jsxx.jylsh = is_jylsh
		astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费流水号')
		astr_yb_jsxx.jyjssj = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算时间')
		IF Date(astr_yb_jsxx.jyjssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
			astr_yb_jsxx.jyjssj = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		of_get_syb_jsxx(astr_yb_jsxx)
		istr_yb_jsxx_syb = astr_yb_jsxx
		of_update_jymx_tp(  as_jslsh, as_jydd,adt_jssj ,  astr_yb_jsxx, as_error)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF UpperBound(ls_ret) >= 4 THEN
		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,ls_ret[4])
	END IF
	gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()发送失败×               历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_tfcl()发送失败×
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer of_update_jsmx (string as_jsjylsh, str_yb_jsxx_syb astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_jssj
ldt_curr = gf_server_date()

ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,2)
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx
Dec{0} ld_zyh,ld_jllsh

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.TZYB_FYMXSC_SYD Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ + 1 Where JZBH = :astr_yb_jsxx.JZBH And ztbz in (0,9) Using itran_sqlca ; // 2021.12.30  CJN  27471  结算成功后，更新JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC状态时，ztbz++
	UPDATE JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD  SET ZTBZ = 1,JSLSH = :as_jsjylsh
		Where JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ + 1 Where JZBH = :astr_yb_jsxx.JZBH AND ZTBZ in (0,9)  Using itran_sqlca ;  
	UPDATE JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  SET ZTBZ = 1,JSLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh
		Where JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jsjylsh Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF

end function

public function integer of_get_mrcs (string as_sypc);IF IsValid(ids_sypc) = False THEN
	uf_connect_sqlca_temp()
	ids_sypc = Create u_datastore
	ids_sypc.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_sypc.createfromsql( "SELECT CODE,NAME,MRCS FROM XTGL.GY_SYPC") < 0 THEN
		is_error =  '初始化sypc失败'
		return -1
	END IF
	ids_sypc.settransobject( itran_sqlca)
	ids_sypc.retrieve( )
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_sypc.Find("Upper(code)='" + Upper(as_sypc) ,1,9999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_sypc.Object.MRCS[ll_find]
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxcx (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm,ls_mxxhlb,ls_cbd,ls_lp
Long ll_cnt ,ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH,SBHM,MZJCODE INTO :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh,:ls_cbd,:ls_lp
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 2;
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;

IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的就诊编号信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
uf_send_init('9227')
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF posw(ls_knxx ,'|') > 0 THEN
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx+ "|" + ls_lp+ "|" + ls_cbd + "||"
		//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx  + String(base_info.syscode)
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '3' )
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knxx )
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knxx)
	END IF
END IF
uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
uf_send_add('删除标志','1')
uf_send_add('删除原因','')
uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '要删除的明细序号列表')
This.uf_send_add_in( '明细序号', 'kong', 0)
//
//String ls_cbd
//ls_cbd = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
IF IsNull(ls_cbd) Or ls_cbd = '' THEN
	ls_cbd = '339900'
END IF
IF uf_send(as_error,0,ls_cbd) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0'  THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ll_cnt = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( '删除不成功的明细序号列表')
	IF ll_cnt > 0 THEN
		as_error = '费用明细删除失败。请再次尝试删除！'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH  = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0  Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		END IF
		// 2021.12.07  CJN  27471  删除明细时，增加对ztbz=9的明细进行删除
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			UPDATE JKXT.tzyb_fymxsc_syd Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ in (0,9) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		ELSE
			UPDATE JKXT.sydyb_fymxsc Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ in (0,9) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		END IF
		//		UPDATE JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And ywlx = 'ZY' And jzbh = :ls_ybjzbh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

		SetNull(ls_nr)
		SELECT nr Into :ls_nr From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where id = (SELECT id From ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :ldc_zyh And lx = '7') And dmid = 202 ;

		ls_cyxj = ls_cyxj + '填写日期：' + String(ldt_cyrq,'yyyy年MM月dd日') //填写日期：
		
		IF ll_sypb = 1 THEN
			IF Len(ls_cyxj) >= 10000 THEN
				This.uf_send_add('出院小结',of_midstring(ls_cyxj,9999))
			ELSE
				This.uf_send_add('出院小结',ls_cyxj)
			END IF
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add('出院小结','')
		END IF
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('出院小结','')
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('预留字段1',ls_jtdh)
	This.uf_send_add('预留字段2','')
	This.uf_send_add('预留字段3','')
	This.uf_send_add('预留字段4','')
	This.uf_send_add('预留字段5','')

IF uf_send(as_error,0,ls_cbd) = True THEN

		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1





end function

public function integer of_get_jklx_xxmddxzqh (string as_jklx);Long ll_xzqh
//
IF IsValid(ids_mddxzqh) = False THEN
	ids_mddxzqh = Create u_datastore
	ids_mddxzqh.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_mddxzqh.createfromsql("SELECT JKLX,XXMDDXZQH from jkxt.yb_jklx t Where ybfl = 'SEP' And JKFL = 'QQ'") < 0 THEN
		is_error = '创建消息目的地行政区划失败:'+  ids_mddxzqh.is_error
		Destroy ids_mddxzqh
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ids_mddxzqh.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
	ids_mddxzqh.Retrieve( )
END IF
ll_xzqh = ids_mddxzqh.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx)  + "'",1,99999)
IF ll_xzqh <= 0 THEN
	RETURN  -1
ELSE
	RETURN ids_mddxzqh.Object.xxmddxzqh[ll_xzqh]
END IF

//long ll_xzqh

//
//return ll_xzqh
RETURN 0


end function

public function integer of_jsmx_zf (datetime adt_jysj, string as_jylsh, ref string as_error);

IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
DateTime ldt_jssj
ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',adt_jysj,2)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JYLSH = :as_jylsh And JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj  Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JYLSH = :as_jylsh And JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj  Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF

end functi
on

public function integer of_zy_fymx_sc (long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, ref string as_msg);//IF Not ib_yd THEN
IF adt_zzrq < DateTime(Date('2000.1.1')) THEN
	SetNull(adt_zzrq)
END IF

IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN  -1
END IF
//zy_fymx
IF IsValid(ids_zyfymx) = False THEN
	ids_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	ids_zyfymx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_zyfymxsc_syd'
	ELSE
		// 2021.11.25  CJN  27471  新增剔除jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc中ztbz=9的明细
		IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 THEN
			ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_sydyb_zyfymx_sc_bsc'
		ELSE
			ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_sydyb_zyfymx_sc'
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
Long ll_rowcount
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh ,ai_jscs,adt_zzrq)
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_msg = ids_zyfymx.is_error
	RETURN 0
ELSEIF  ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF

String ls_kzys,ls_ybjzbh,ls_zyhm,ls_brch,ls_ypzllb,ls_dffbz,ls_zzys,ls_bah,ls_cydy,ls_zfxmdj
Long ll_brks,ll_mxtop,ll_add_row,j,ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert,ll_ret,ll_findcy

Dec{0} ldc_yz_jlxh,ldc_yzzh,ldc_zyljxh

Dec{4} ld_fydj,ldc_ycsl
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
String ls_ygxm ,ls_sfzh,ls_cbd,ls_ksmc,ls_ksbm,ls_knsj,ls_lp,ls_gjybbm,ls_gjybbm_ts
DateTime ldt_bqrysj,ldt_jfrq //wangyi 20191012 如果JFRQ比入院时间还要前面，就传入院时间
SELECT BRKS,ZYHM,BRCH,ZZYS,SBHM,JSDH,KNXX,MZJCODE INTO :ll_brks,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_zzys,:ls_cbd,:ll_jsdh,:ls_knsj,:ls_lp
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT YBJZBH,BQRYSJ Into :ls_ybjzbh,:ldt_bqrysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT nvl(Max(fymxxh),0) Into :ll_fymxcount From jkxt.tzyb_fymxsc_syd  Where  ZYH = :al_zyh And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	SELECT nvl(Max(fymxxh),0) Into :ll_fymxcount From jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc  Where  ZYH = :al_zyh And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbd) Or ls_cbd = '' THEN
	as_msg = '获取参保地失败'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ll_brks = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '病人无当前科室，不能上传明细!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ybjzbh) Or Trim(ls_ybjzbh) = '' THEN
	as_msg = '住院登记流水号为空!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
ls_ksmc = This.of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'GY_KSDM', String(ll_brks))

// 2021.12.31  CJN  27471  优先将医保不上传费用插入sydyb_fymxsc表中
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_jsmx_syd'
	ELSE
		ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_sydyb_jsmx'
	END IF
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)

IF This.of_insert_bscfymx( al_zyh, ls_ybjzbh, Ref as_msg) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
ids_zyfymx.RowsDiscard(1, ids_zyfymx.DeletedCount(), DELETE!)
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_msg = ids_zyfymx.is_error
	RETURN 0
ELSEIF  ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetSort("jlxh A")
ids_zyfymx.Sort()
li_sczs =   Ceiling(ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF IsValid(ids_bqyz) = False THEN
	ids_bqyz = Create U_datastore
	ids_bqyz.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_bqyz.DataObject = 'd_yb_zybqyz_syd'
END IF
ids_bqyz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset()
ids_bqyz.Retrieve(al_zyh)

Long ll_beginrow,ll_ypjl,ll_find_zf,ll_clbm
String ls_ycjl,ls_ybbm,ls_ybmc,ls_sfxmdj,ls_cllx,ls_ybbm_ts //,ls_filter

FOR j = 1 To li_sczs
	uf_send_init('9212') //住院类交易提交费用明细
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		IF posw(ls_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj+ "|" + ls_lp+ "|" + ls_cbd + "||"
			//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
			IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
				ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
			ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
				ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
			ELSE
				ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
			END IF
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
			This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '3')
			This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knsj)
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knsj)
		END IF
	END IF
	uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm) //'0122447020170523')
	uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
	IF j * ii_mxts > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop =  ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = j * ii_mxts
	END IF
	
	ll_add_row = 0
	ldc_zjje = 0
	
	ll_beginrow = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '费用明细列表')
	FOR ll_row = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
		ls_bah = ''
		ll_add_row ++
		ldc_yhje = ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		IF ldc_yhje <> 0 THEN
			ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ldc_yhje
			ld_fydj = ldc_zjje_temp / ld_fysl
		ELSE
			ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ld_fydj = ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		END IF
		
		ld_fysl = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + (ldc_zjje_temp )
		gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_rowcount),Integer(ll_row /ll_rowcount * 100))
		ldc_zyljxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('费用明细序号',String(ldc_zyljxh),ll_add_row)
		IF ld_fysl < 0 THEN
			uf_send_add_in('退药标志','1',ll_add_row)
		ELSE
			uf_send_add_in('退药标志','0',ll_add_row)
		END IF
		//医嘱序号------------------------
		ldc_yz_jlxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ldc_yz_jlxh) THEN ldc_yz_jlxh = 0
		//wangyi 20191012 如果JFRQ比入院时间还要前面，就传入院时间
		ldt_jfrq = ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			IF Pos(is_zdfy,',' + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + ',') > 0 And ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200325 指定日期费用
				ldt_jfrq = ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row]
			END IF
		END IF
		IF Date(ldt_jfrq) < Date(ldt_bqrysj) THEN
			ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row] = ldt_bqrysj
			ldt_jfrq = ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]
		END IF
		//-------------
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //费用
			//			uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型','2',ll_add_row)
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				//根据匹配的去取  9--12
				IF ids_ylsf.Object.kzpb[ll_find] = 2 And ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] <> 8 THEN ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_gjybbm = String(ids_ylsf.Object.gjybbm[ll_find])
				//如果是审批成自费，那么传自费编码modify by sxl ii_zfbmqy MODIBY by sxl因自费通用码停用 20211120
				If (ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 1 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9) And ii_zfbmqy = 1 THEN
					IF ls_ypzllb = '1' THEN //如果费用是药品，那么传西药自费编码,
						ls_ybbm = is_zf_xy
					ELSE
						IF ids_ylsf.Object.fygb[ll_find] = 70 THEN
							ls_ybbm = is_zf_cl
						ELSE
							ls_ybbm = is_zf_zl
						END IF
					END IF
					ll_find_zf = ids_zflb.Find( "DMSB = '"+ls_ybbm+"' ", 1,ids_zflb.RowCount())
					//					ls_ybbm = ids_zflb.Object.dmsb[ll_find_zf]
					IF ll_find_zf > 0 THEN
						ls_ybmc = ids_zflb.Object.dmmc[ll_find_zf]
					ELSE
						ls_ybbm = '7000000000000001'
						ls_ybmc = '自费费用'
					END IF
					ls_sfxmdj = '3'
				ELSE
					ls_ybbm = ids_ylsf.Object.ybbm[ll_find]
					ls_ybmc = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ybmc[ll_find])
					ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_ylsf.Object.sfxmdj[ll_find])
					IF ids_ylsf.Object.tsdz[ll_find] > 0 THEN
						//是否有特殊医保对照
						IF This.uf_get_tsdz( 0, Long(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]), 0, ldt_jfrq,ls_ybbm, ls_ybmc, ls_sfxmdj, as_msg)  < 0 THEN
							RETURN -1
						END IF
						//						ll_insert = ids_yb_tsdz.Find("#1 = 3 AND #2=" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + " AND #4 <= datetime('" +&
						//							String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') +&
						//							"') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')",1,9999999)
						//						
						//						IF ll_insert > 0 THEN
						//							ls_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_insert]
						//							ls_ybmc = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#6[ll_insert])
						//							ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#7[ll_insert])
						//						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
				ls_cllx = ''
				//高值材料的编码
				SELECT CLLX,CLBM Into :ls_cllx,:ll_clbm From WZXT.H_WZ_SSFY Where ZYH  = :al_zyh And ZYJLXH = :ldc_zyljxh Using itran_sqlca;
				IF IsNull(ls_cllx) THEN ls_cllx = ''
				IF ls_cllx = 'GZ' THEN
					SELECT ybbm,gjybbm Into :ls_ybbm_ts,:ls_gjybbm_ts From WZXT.H_WZ_GZCLXX Where CLBM = :ll_clbm Using itran_sqlca;
					IF ls_ybbm_ts > '' THEN
						ls_ybbm = ls_ybbm_ts
					END IF
					IF ls_gjybbm_ts > '' THEN
						ls_gjybbm = ls_gjybbm_ts
					END IF
				END IF
				If	(IsNull(ls_gjybbm) Or ls_gjybbm = '') And ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
					as_msg =  String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]) + '，费用未维护国家码，请联系医保科处理!' + String(ldc_zyljxh)
					gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				
				IF ii_gjmqy = 1 And (ls_ypzllb <> '1' Or ls_ybbm = '7000000000000001' Or ls_ybbm = '9000000000000001') THEN
					IF IsNull(ls_gjybbm) THEN ls_gjybbm = ''
					ls_ybbm = ls_ybbm + '##' + ls_gjybbm
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目统一编号', ls_ybbm,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目统一名称', ls_ybmc,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('收费项目等级', ls_sfxmdj,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目医院端名称',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fymc[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				//-------------------------------------------------------------
				uf_send_add_in('医院端规格','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('医院端剂型','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('医院端单位',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每藾AT* ','1',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每次用量','1',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('西药天数','0',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('中草药贴数','1',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('单价',String(ld_fydj,'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				//				uf_send_add_in('单价',String( ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row],'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('数量/克数',String( ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row],'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目总金额',String(ldc_zjje_temp,'0.00'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('剂量单位','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('总剂量','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('包装数量','',ll_add_row)
				ls_cydy = '0'
				ls_dffbz = '0'
			END IF
		ELSE //药品
			//			uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型','1',ll_add_row)
			ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF ids_typk.Object.kzyp[ll_find] = 2 And ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] <> 8 THEN ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_gjybbm = String(ids_typk.Object.gjybbm[ll_find])
				If (ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 1 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9) And ii_zfbmqy = 1 THEN
					IF ls_ypzllb <> '1' THEN
						ls_ybbm = is_zf_fy
					ELSE
						CHOOSE CASE ids_typk.Object.Type[ll_find]
							CASE 1 //西药
								IF ids_typk.Object.zjpb[ll_find] = 1 THEN
									ls_ybbm = is_zf_zzxy
								ELSE
									ls_ybbm = is_zf_xy
								END IF
							CASE 2 //成药
								IF ids_typk.Object.zjpb[ll_find] = 1 THEN
									ls_ybbm = is_zf_zzzy
								ELSE
									ls_ybbm = is_zf_zy
								END IF
							CASE 3 //草药
								ls_ybbm = is_zf_cy
						END CHOOSE
					END IF
					ll_find_zf = ids_zflb.Find( "DMSB = '"+ls_ybbm+"' ", 1,ids_zflb.RowCount())
					//					ls_ybbm = ids_zflb.Object.dmsb[ll_find_zf]
					IF ll_find_zf > 0 THEN
						ls_ybmc = ids_zflb.Object.dmmc[ll_find_zf]
					ELSE
						ls_ybbm = '7000000000000001'
						ls_ybmc = '自费费用'
					END IF
					ls_sfxmdj = '3'
				ELSE
					ls_ybbm = ids_typk.Object.YB_dzbh[ll_find]
					ls_ybmc = String(ids_typk.Object.ybmc[ll_find])
					ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_typk.Object.sfxmdj[ll_find])
					
					IF ids_typk.Object.tsdz[ll_find] > 0 THEN
						//是否有特殊医保对照
						IF This.uf_get_tsdz( 1, Long(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]), Long(ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]), ldt_jfrq,ls_ybbm, ls_ybmc, ls_sfxmdj, as_msg)  < 0 THEN
							RETURN -1
						END IF
						//						ll_insert = ids_yb_tsdz.Find("#1 = 2 AND #2=" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + " AND #8 = "+String(ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row])+" AND #4 <= datetime('" +&
						//							String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') +&
						//							"') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')",1,9999999)
						//						
						//						IF ll_insert > 0 THEN
						//							ls_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_insert]
						//							ls_ybmc = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#6[ll_insert])
						//							ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#7[ll_insert])
						//						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
				//				ls_ybbm = ids_typk.Object.YB_dzbh[ll_find]
				ls_cydy = '0'
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				ldc_ycsl = 1.00
				ldc_mrcs = 1.00
				IF ldc_yz_jlxh > 0 THEN
					ll_find_yz = ids_bqyz.Find("jlxh=" + String(ldc_yz_jlxh),1,999999)
					IF ll_find_yz > 0 THEN
						ldc_ycsl = ids_bqyz.Object.ycsl[ll_find_yz]
						ldc_mrcs = ids_bqyz.Object.mrcs[ll_find_yz]
						IF ids_bqyz.Object.xmlx[ll_find_yz] = 3 THEN
							ls_cydy = '1' //出院带药
						END IF
						IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 3 THEN
							ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find_yz]
							ll_findcy = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find_yz)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
							IF ll_findcy > 0 THEN
								ls_dffbz = '2'
							ELSE
								ls_dffbz = '1'
							END IF
							IF ls_ybbm = '7000000000000001' Or ls_ybbm = '9000000000000001' Or ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] = ilrr_ydxh[1] Or ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] = ilrr_ydxh[2] Or ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] = ilrr_ydxh[3] THEN
								ls_dffbz = '0'
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
				IF ii_gjmqy = 1 And (ls_ypzllb <> '1' Or ls_ybbm = '7000000000000001' Or ls_ybbm = '9000000000000001') THEN
					IF IsNull(ls_gjybbm) THEN ls_gjybbm = ''
					ls_ybbm = ls_ybbm + '##' + ls_gjybbm
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目统一编号',ls_ybbm,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目统一名称',ls_ybmc,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('收费项目等级',ls_sfxmdj,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目医院端名称',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find] = '' THEN
					uf_send_add_in('医院端规格','无',ll_add_row)
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('医院端规格',String(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				END IF
				//of_get_dzdmsb("YK_YPSX",String(ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find]))
				uf_send_add_in('医院端剂型',String(ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('医院端单位',String(ids_typk.Object.bfdw[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每天次数',ldc_mrcs,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每次用量',ldc_ycsl,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('西药天数','1',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('中草药贴数','1',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('单价',String(ld_fydj,'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				//				uf_send_add_in('单价',String( ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row],'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('数量/克数',String( ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row],'0.0000'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目总金额',String( ldc_zjje_temp,'0.00'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('剂量单位',String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('总剂量',String(ids_typk.Object.ypjl[ll_find],'0.00'),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('包装数量','1',ll_add_row)
			END IF
		END IF
		
		uf_send_add_in('医嘱序号',ldc_yz_jlxh,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('给药方式',ls_cydy,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dffbz,ll_add_row)
		//		IF ll_find_yz > 0 THEN
		uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row],'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
		//		ELSE
		//			uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row],'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
		//		END IF		
		uf_send_add_in('项目医院编号',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] ),ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('参考自负比例', String(ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row],'0.0000') ,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('参考自负金额',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row],'0.00'),ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('备案号','',ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('科室代码',ll_brks,ll_add_row)
		uf_send_add_in('科室名称',ls_ksmc,ll_add_row)
		
		//-----------------------------------------------------------
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
			uf_send_add_in('项目包装数量', 0 ,ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('项目最小包装单位','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('项目审批单号', '' ,ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('转化比','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('最小剂量','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('最小剂量单位','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('项目总剂量','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('用药频次', '' ,ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('每天用量','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('用量单位','',ll_add_row)
			ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_brks))
			IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
				as_msg = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_brks)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			uf_send_add_in('预留字段1',ls_ksbm,ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('预留字段2',ls_ksmc,ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('预留字段3','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('预留字段4','',ll_add_row)
			//			if ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] = 31537 and ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row] < 0 then debugbreak() 
			//			IF Pos(is_zdfy,',' + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + ',') > 0 And ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200325 指定日期费用
			//				uf_send_add_in('项目发生时间',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row],'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
			//			ELSE
			//				uf_send_add_in('项目发生时间',String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
			//			END IF
			uf_send_add_in('项目发生时间',String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
		ELSE
			uf_send_add_in('项目发生时间',String(ldt_jfrq,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'),ll_add_row)
		END IF
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到对应的费用信息:YPLX:' +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row]) + " FYXH:" +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//使用zy_fymx的ysgh ，为空则取主治医生
		ls_kzys = ids_zyfymx.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ls_kzys) Or ls_kzys = '' THEN
			ls_kzys = ls_zzys
		END IF
		
		uf_send_add_in('医生服务编码',ls_kzys,ll_add_row) //开药医生编码	String	20	是
		This.of_get_ygxm( ls_kzys,ls_ygxm, ls_sfzh)
		uf_send_add_in('医生姓名','',ll_add_row)
		ld_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
		//审批标志 2015-4-27 spbz = 1 非控制的，按0
		CHOOSE CASE  ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
			CASE 9,1
				uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','1',ll_add_row)
				ld_zfbl = 1.00
			CASE 8,2
				uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','0',ll_add_row)
			CASE ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','0',ll_add_row)
		END CHOOSE
		
		ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		IF ld_zfbl <> 1 THEN
			ldc_zfje = 0.00
			ldc_zlje = ldc_zjje_temp * ld_zfbl
		ELSE
			ldc_zfje = ldc_zjje_temp //ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ldc_zlje = 0.00
		END IF
		ldc_hjzf = ldc_zfje + ldc_zlje
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY'
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ldc_zyljxh //ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fymxxh[ll_insert] = ll_add_row + ll_fymxcount
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zfje
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ldc_zlje
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.hjzf[ll_insert] = ldc_hjzf
		
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmyybh[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] )
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XMYYDMC[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row])
		
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzbh[ll_row] =  ls_ybjzbh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ybbm[ll_row] =  ls_ybbm
	NEXT
	uf_send_add('明细条数',ll_add_row)
	gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
	
	IF Not  uf_send(as_msg,0,ls_cbd)  THEN
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息') + This.uf_getstring('有误收费明细列表')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//		ll_cwts = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( '错误记录条数')  
		ll_cwts = This.uf_Getstring_mxnr( '收费项目明细自负信息')
		FOR ll_ret = 1 To ll_cwts
			ll_find_sc = ids_ybfymx_sc.Find("getrow() >= " +String(ll_beginrow)+" and YWLSH = " + This.uf_getstring_in( '明细序号', ll_ret) ,1,9999)
			IF ll_find_sc > 0 THEN
				ll_find_yz = ids_zyfymx.Find("jlxh = " + This.uf_getstring_in( '明细序号', ll_ret) ,1,9999)
				IF ll_find_yz > 0 THEN
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find_yz] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '正确的自负比例', ll_ret)
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_find_yz] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '合计自负', ll_ret) //dec(this.uf_getstring_in( '合计自负', ll_ret))
				END IF
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '正确的自负比例', ll_ret)
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfje[ll_find_sc] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自费金额（包括超限金额）', ll_ret)
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zlje[ll_find_sc] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自理金额', ll_ret)
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.hjzf[ll_find_sc] = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '合计自负', ll_ret)
				IF IsNull(ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bkbyysm[ll_find_sc]) THEN ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bkbyysm[ll_find_sc] = ''
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bkbyysm[ll_find_sc] = ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bkbyysm[ll_find_sc] + This.uf_getstring_in( '超限说明',ll_ret)
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
		ELSE
			as_msg = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error + ' ids_zyfymx:' +ids_zyfymx.is_error
			gf_sblog('c:\sblog','更新住院明细' +as_msg)
			ROLLBACK Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxsc (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);Long ll_ybpb,ll_mxbs,ll_count,ll_bscbs
DateTime ldt_zzrq,ldt_czsj,ldt_scsj
Dec{2} ld_zjje,ld_xjzfze,ld_jjzfze,ldc_bscje
String ls_jydd,ls_mxcllsh,ls_zyhm = '',ls_knsj ,ls_klb
str_yb_jsxx_syb lstr_yb_jsxx
Integer li_ret,li_scbz = 0

IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

//卡内信息判别本地异地，以此判断调用哪个接口
SELECT knxx Into :ls_knsj From zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
This.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knsj
ldt_czsj = gf_server_date()
SELECT SCBZ Into :li_scbz From JKXT.YB_BRJL Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF li_scbz = 1 THEN
	SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "　zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "正在上传明细，不能同步上传!"
	GOTO Error
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
INSERT INTO "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"   ( "ZYH",  "SCBZ",   "SCSJ" )
	Values ( :al_zyh,0,:ldt_czsj)  Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 1,SCSJ = :ldt_czsj Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
END IF

gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)

//获取已经做结算的日期
SELECT Max(jsrq) Into :ldt_zzrq From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx  Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF IsNull(ldt_zzrq) THEN
		//未做过结算的则取入院日期
		SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "获取入院日期失败:" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
			GOTO Error
		END IF
	ELSE
		ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
	END IF
ELSEIF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"获取上一次结算日期失败:" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
	GOTO Error
END IF
ldt_zzrq = DateTime(Date(ldt_zzrq),Time(23:59:59))

//20200827 wangyi 增加指定项目一定限额后，自动拆分，限额外部分强制自费上传
li_ret = of_zy_fymx_fycxcf(al_zyh, as_error) //对超过控制限额的指定费用进行拆分。
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
		SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where ZYH = :al_zyh using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	END IF
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"拆分住院限额费用明细失败。" + as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF
li_ret = of_zy_fymx_cf(al_zyh, as_error) //材料限额拆分
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
		SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where ZYH = :al_zyh using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	END IF
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"拆分材料费用明细失败。" + as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF

//明细上传--医保做预结算
DO WHILE Date(ldt_zzrq) < Date(ldt_czsj)
	IF Date(ldt_zzrq) = Date(ldt_czsj) THEN EXIT
	//提交明细
	li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
			SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		END IF
		as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
		GOTO Error
	ELSE
		//预结算处理
		IF li_ret > 0 THEN
			IF uf_zy_jscl( al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, False, 'NULL', ls_jydd, lstr_yb_jsxx, as_error) < 0 THEN
				IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
					SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
				END IF
				as_error =  "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +  '医保预结算失败: ' + as_error
				GOTO Error
			ELSE
				//获取对应支付情况
				ll_mxbs = 0
				IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
					SELECT count(1) Into :ll_mxbs From JKXT.TZYB_FYMXSC_SYD Where  ZTBZ = 0 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					SELECT count(1) Into :ll_bscbs From JKXT.TZYB_FYMXSC_SYD Where  ZTBZ = 9 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				ELSE
					SELECT count(1) Into :ll_mxbs From JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 0 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
					SELECT count(1) Into :ll_bscbs From JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 9 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				END IF
				
				ld_zjje = lstr_yb_jsxx.fyze
				ld_xjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.grxjzf
				ld_jjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.hjbxje
				ldc_bscje = lstr_yb_jsxx.bscfyje
				//判断是否已经预结算过
				SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				
				gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Set czsj = :ldt_czsj,mxbs = :ll_mxbs,zjje = :ld_zjje,xjzfze = :ld_xjzfze,jjzfze = :ld_jjzfze,bscje = :ldc_bscje,bscbs = :ll_bscbs
					 Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				ELSE
					INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze,bscje ,bscbs ) 
					 Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze,:ldc_bscje,:ll_bscbs) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				END IF
				IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSEIF li_ret = 0 THEN //无明细
			//判断是否已经预结算过
			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			ldt_scsj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),-1),Time(23:59:59))
			ll_mxbs = 0
			ld_zjje = 0
			ld_xjzfze = 0
			ld_jjzfze = 0
			ldc_bscje = 0
			ll_bscbs = 0
			SELECT MXBS,ZJJE,XJZFZE,JJZFZE,bscje,bscbs 
			  INTO :ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze,:ldc_bscje,:ll_bscbs
			  FROM JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX
				Where zyh = :al_zyh And  jsrq  = :ldt_scsj Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				
			gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				UPDATE JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Set czsj = :ldt_czsj,mxbs = :ll_mxbs,zjje = :ld_zjje,xjzfze = :ld_xjzfze,jjzfze = :ld_jjzfze,bscje = :ldc_bscje,bscbs = :ll_bscbs
				 Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			ELSE
				INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze,bscje ,bscbs ) 
				 Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze,:ldc_bscje,:ll_bscbs) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			END IF
//			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
//				UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX SET CZSJ = :ldt_czsj,MXBS = :ll_mxbs,ZJJE = :ld_zjje,XJZFZE = :ld_xjzfze,JJZFZE = :ld_jjzfze
//					Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//			ELSE
//				INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze) Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//			END IF
			IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			ELSE
				gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			
		END IF
	END IF
	ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
LOOP

SetNull(ldt_zzrq)
li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)

IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
		SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
	END IF
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF li_ret >= 0 THEN
	
	
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
RETURN li_ret

Error:
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)

RETURN -1


end function

public function integer uf_zydj_cx (string as_zyhm, string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//住院登记撤消

Date ldt_today
String ls_err
ldt_today = Date(gf_server_date())

IF as_zyhm = '' Or IsNull(as_zyhm) THEN
	as_error = '住院号错误,请重新核对后再进行操作!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//IF as_jzbh = '' Or IsNull(as_jzbh ) THEN
//	as_error = '医保登记流水号（ybjzbh）为空'
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ldt_today,base_info.UserID , '2', 1, ls_err) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_err
	RETURN -1
END IF
Long ll_jsdh
Dec{0} ldc_zyh
String ls_cbd,ls_jyjg
Int li_ret
SELECT jsdh,zyh Into :ll_jsdh,:ldc_zyh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_zyhm Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_cbd = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
IF ls_cbd = '' Or IsNull(ls_cbd) THEN
	ls_cbd = '339900'
END IF
//add by sxl 撤销登记，如果病人在院登记，但是没有获取到住院登记流水号，那么做一次交易查询
//istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zydj = '1' And
If (IsNull(as_jzbh) Or as_jzbh = '' ) THEN
	IF ll_jsdh >= 1 THEN
		ll_jsdh = ll_jsdh + 1
		as_zyhm = as_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	ELSE
		ll_jsdh = 1
	END IF
	str_yb_jsxx_syb lstr_yb_jsxx
	IF This.uf_jycx('9205', as_zyhm, ls_cbd, ls_jyjg,lstr_yb_jsxx , as_error) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '交易查询失败：' + as_error
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州代码字典不一样
			IF ls_jyjg = '9' THEN //0	已结算	2	已退费	1	已确认	9	无记录
				as_error = '交易查询记录不存在：' + as_zyhm
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ls_jyjg = '0' THEN //0	没记录	1	已结算/已退费/已登记入院
				as_error = '交易查询记录不存在：' + as_zyhm
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		as_jzbh = lstr_yb_jsxx.JSLSh
		UPDATE bqxt.zy_brry_kz Set ybjzbh = :as_jzbh Where zyh = :ldc_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		UPDATE bqxt.zy_brry Set jsdh = :ll_jsdh Where zyh = :ldc_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_zyhm = as_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
END IF
IF as_jzbh = '' Or IsNull(as_jzbh ) THEN
	as_error = '医保登记流水号（ybjzbh）为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init( '9211')
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF posw(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	END IF
END IF
uf_send_add('住院序列号',as_zyhm) //'0122447020170523'
uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',as_jzbh)
uf_send_add('操作员编号',base_info.UserID)
uf_send_add('操作员姓名',base_info.username)

IF uf_send(as_error,0,ls_cbd) = True THEN
	li_ret = Integer(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果'))
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息') + '。附加信息'+This.uf_getstring( '附加信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_fymxsc_syd Set ztbz = -1 Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And ztbz in ( 0 ,9) Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		UPDATE jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc Set ztbz = -1 Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And ztbz in (0,9) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	DELETE jkxt.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
	//	update bqxt.zy_brry set jsdh = :ll_jsdh where zyh = :ldc_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	//	update zy_brry_kz set ybjzbh = ''  where  ZYH = :ll_zyh using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	//	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	//		gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	//	ELSE
	//		gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	//	END IF
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

end function

public function integer uf_zy_jscl (long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, boolean ab_jsbz, string as_fplsh, string as_jydd, ref str_yb_jsxx_syb astr_sydyb_jsxx, ref string as_msg);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_msg = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_err
//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Today(),base_info.UserID , '2', 1, ls_err) < 0 THEN
		as_msg = ls_err
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Today(),is_zyzz , '2', 1, ls_err) < 0 THEN
		as_msg = ls_err
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

//ab_jsbz true:出院结算 0:预结算

Long ll_RecvCount,ll_upcount,ll_jsdh,ll_bsccont
String ls_jzbh,ls_zyhm,ls_knsj,ls_cbdxzqh,ls_ybkh,ls_sbm,ls_lp
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_scjssj,ldt_cyrq,ldt_jsrq
Dec ldc_zjje
SetNull(ldt_scjssj)
SetNull(ldt_cyrq)
SetNull(ls_cbdxzqh)
SELECT KNXX,RYRQ,CYRQ,ZYHM,SBHM,YBKH,ZHBZ,JSDH,MZJCODE Into :ls_knsj,:ldt_ryrq,:ldt_cyrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_cbdxzqh,:ls_ybkh,:ls_sbm,:ll_jsdh,:ls_lp 
  From bqxt.ZY_BRRY  Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT Max(ZZRQ) Into :ldt_scjssj From ZY_ZYJS Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZFPB = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ls_cbdxzqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdxzqh) = '' THEN
	as_msg = '获取行政区划失败'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_scjssj) THEN
	ldt_scjssj = ldt_ryrq
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_cyrq) THEN
	ldt_cyrq = gf_server_date()
END IF
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_jzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;

// 2021.11.25  CJN  27471  剔除医保不上传费用（jkxt.tzyb_fymxsc_syd.ztbz=9或jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc.ztbz=9）； 获取医保不上传费用的总金额
ll_RecvCount = 0
SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE - nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ( JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null ) and zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) Using itran_sqlca;
IF ii_YBBSCFYQY=1 Then
	// 获取医保不上传费用的总金额
	Select SUM(ZJJE - nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) into :astr_sydyb_jsxx.bscfyje,:ll_bsccont FROM BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ( JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null ) and zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And jlxh In (Select ywlsh From jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc Where zyh = :al_zyh AND ywlx = 'ZY' and jzbh=:ls_jzbh and ztbz =9) Using itran_sqlca;  
END IF
IF ll_RecvCount > 0 THEN
ELSE
	SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE - nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) and zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ii_YBBSCFYQY=1 Then
		// 获取医保不上传费用的总金额
		Select SUM(ZJJE - nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) into :astr_sydyb_jsxx.bscfyje ,:ll_bsccont FROM BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) and zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And jlxh In (Select ywlsh From jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc Where zyh = :al_zyh AND ywlx = 'ZY' and jzbh=:ls_jzbh and ztbz =9) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
IF isnull(astr_sydyb_jsxx.bscfyje) Then astr_sydyb_jsxx.bscfyje=0
if isnull(ll_bsccont ) then ll_bsccont = 0.00
ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - astr_sydyb_jsxx.bscfyje
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_upcount From jkxt.tzyb_fymxsc_syd Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jzbh = :ls_jzbh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca;	
ELSE
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_upcount From jkxt.sydyb_fymxsc Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jzbh = :ls_jzbh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca;	
END IF
//IF ll_RecvCount = 0 THEN
//	as_msg = '无结算数据'
//	RETURN 0
//END IF
IF ll_upcount = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '无结算数据'
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	ll_RecvCount = ll_upcount
END IF
IF ab_jsbz = False THEN //预结算
	This.uf_send_init('9207')
ELSE //确认结算	
//	IF ls_cbdxzqh <> '232900' THEN
		IF uf_zydj_bg( '1',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //入院变更
		IF uf_zydj_bg( '2',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //出院变更
//	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('9208')
	//	
	//	String ls_pasm //在初始化的时候已取
	//	IF This.uf_get_psamid( ls_pasm) < 0 THEN
	//	END IF
	uf_send_add('对帐流水号',is_jyzqh)
	uf_send_add('终端机编号',is_psamid)
	uf_send_add('TAC','')
	uf_send_add('支付令牌','') //台州特有
END IF
string ls_ret[]
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF posw(ls_knsj,'|') > 0 then
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj+ "|" + ls_lp+ "|" + ls_cbdxzqh + "||"
		//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '0')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', '')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', ls_knsj)
	ELSE
		uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knsj)
		uf_send_add('社会保障卡緿AT* ',ls_ybkh) //
		uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码',ls_sbm)
	END IF
ELSE	
	IF of_splitparm( ls_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 3 THEN
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + '|' + ls_lp
		istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knsj
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '1' )
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', ls_ybkh+'|'+ls_sbm)
	END IF
END IF
uf_send_add('参保地行政区划代码',ls_cbdxzqh)
uf_send_add('就医地行政区划代码',is_yljgxzqh)

uf_send_add('操作员编号',base_info.UserID)
uf_send_add('操作员姓名',base_info.username)
uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm) //'0122447020170523')
uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_jzbh)
uf_send_add('本次结算明细条数',ll_RecvCount)
astr_sydyb_jsxx.jylsh = is_jylsh
astr_sydyb_jsxx.jzbh =  ls_jzbh
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
ELSE
	IF ab_jsbz THEN
		IF This.of_insert_jymx( '' , al_zyh, ai_jscs, ls_zyhm,'ZY', as_jydd,'11', '',is_jylsh, astr_sydyb_jsxx, as_msg)<0 then return -1
	END IF
END IF

IF uf_send(as_msg) = True THEN
	
	if upperbound(ls_ret) >= 3 and ab_jsbz then
		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,ls_lp)
	end if
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
		as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		ldt_jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( "结算时间") //		结算日期	datetime	20	否		 yyyyMMdd hh24miss
		This.of_reset_jsxx( astr_sydyb_jsxx)
		astr_sydyb_jsxx.jyjssj = ldt_jsrq
		IF DATE(astr_sydyb_jsxx.jyjssj) < DATE(2000,1,1) THEN
			astr_sydyb_jsxx.jyjssj = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		astr_sydyb_jsxx.jyts = ll_RecvCount
		This.of_get_syb_jsxx( astr_sydyb_jsxx)
		IF ab_jsbz THEN
			astr_sydyb_jsxx.ywlx = 'ZY'
			astr_sydyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')			
			IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州多一步交易确认
				is_jylsh = astr_sydyb_jsxx.jslsh
				IF This.of_insert_jymx( '' , al_zyh, ai_jscs, ls_zyhm,'ZY', as_jydd,'21', '',is_jylsh, astr_sydyb_jsxx, as_msg)<0 THen return -1
				IF This.uf_qrybjs( ls_knsj, 'ZY' , is_jylsh, as_msg, is_jylsh) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF This.of_update_jsmx( is_jylsh, astr_sydyb_jsxx,as_msg) < 0 THEN
				as_msg = '医保结算成功 ' + as_msg
			END IF
		END IF
		istr_yb_jsxx_syb = astr_sydyb_jsxx
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
RETURN 1



end function

public function integer uf_jycx (string as_jylx, string as_jylsh, string as_cbd, ref string as_jyjg, ref str_yb_jsxx_syb astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//9216号交易：交易结果查询
This.uf_send_init( '9216')
//5	交易类型号	string	4	是	9203，9204，9205，9208，9209	查询范围：门诊结算，门诊退费，住院登记，住院结算，住院退费
//6	待查询的用户序列号	string	20	是		门诊传门诊序列号，住院传住院序列号
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	IF posw(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '3')
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
END IF
This.uf_send_add('交易类型号',as_jylx)
IF as_jylx >= '9205' And as_jylx < '9209' THEN
	Long ll_jsdh
	SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_jylsh;
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_jylsh = as_jylsh + '-' + String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
END IF
This.uf_send_add('待查询的用户序列号',as_jylsh)
IF This.uf_send( as_error,0,as_cbd) THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring("交易处理结果") <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring("错误信息")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	as_jyjg = This.uf_getstring("交易状态") //		3	交易状态	string	2	是		参考数字字典交易状态,0:没记录，1：业务执行成功	代码值调整
	astr_yb_jsxx.jyjssj = This.uf_getdatetime( '交易时间') //		4	交易时间	date	20	是		格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss	
	
	astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring("交易流水号") //		5	交易流水号	string	30	是		查询住院登记结果时返回的是住院登记流水号，查询门诊结算、住院结算时返回结算流水号，查询退费时返回退费结算流水号	长度由20调整为30
	IF as_jylx <> '9205' THEN
		of_get_syb_jsxx(astr_yb_jsxx)
	END IF
	//		6	该用户交易出口参数	composite		否		参考门诊预结算传出参数中的计算结果信息结构体说明	
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public function integer uf_jyzf (datetime adt_jssj, string as_jylsh, string as_jylx, string as_cbd, ref string as_error);//4.1.19.	9247号交易：交易作废（新增交易）

		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE

	RETURN -1
END IF
IF This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
	as_error = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息')
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(adt_jssj) Or Date(adt_jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
		adt_jssj  = DateTime(Date(gf_server_date()))
	END IF
	IF as_jylx <> '9205' THEN of_jsmx_zf(adt_jssj,as_jylsh,as_error)
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public function integer uf_readcard (ref string as_error, ref string as_return[]);str_yb_grjbxx_syb Lstr_yb_grjbxx_syb
istr_yb_grjbxx_syb = Lstr_yb_grjbxx_syb
This.uf_send_init( 'READ')

	This.of_splitparm( as_error, as_return, "|")
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = as_return[1]
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh = as_return[2]
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = as_return[3]
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = as_return[4]

	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm = as_return[5]
	is_psamid = as_return[10]
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
//HospCode：传入医疗机构编号
//retMsg：返回的信息
//当函数执行成功时，该输出参数为读出的社保卡基本信息各数据项，
//依次为：发卡地区行政区划代码（卡识别码前6位）、
//社会保障号码、卡号、卡识别码、姓名、卡复位信息（仅取历史字节）、
//规范版本、发卡日期、卡有效期、终端机编号、终端设备号。
//各数据项之间以"|"分割，且最后一个数据项以"|"结尾。
//例如：639900|111111198101011110|X00000019|639900D15600000500BF7C7A48FB4966|张三|00814E43238697159900BF7C7A|1.00|20101001|20201001|410100813475|终端设备号|。
//=0 --成功，没有任何警告，返回信息在retMsg中。
//>0 --成功，但是有警告信息，警告信息在retMsg。
//<0 --失败，错误信息在retMsg中。


end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, date adt_ryrq, string as_zyhm, ref string as_error);//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_err1
//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Today(),base_info.UserID , '2', 1, ls_err1) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_err1
	RETURN -1
END IF

DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jsrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch //,ls_kssj

	INTO :ll_ksdm,:ldt_ryrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:ldt_jsrq,

	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(1900,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
//		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From bqxt.zy_yybr Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jgbz >= 0 And zy_yybr.yzypb In (1,2) Using itran_sqlca;
//		IF ll_count > 0 THEN //预住院
//			
IF ldt_ryrq > ldt_rysj THEN
//				ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
//			END IF
//		ELSE
			ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
//		END IF
	END IF
END IF

//开始业务数据填充
String ls_ksbm = '0100',ls_ksmc = '刚入院未分配科室' //默认
String ls_zdmc = '',ls_zddm1 ,ls_error
Long ll_row
String ls_mllx ,ls_jylsh,ls_err,ls_ysxm,ls_sfzh
Date ldt_today

ldt_today = Date(gf_server_date())

//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ldt_today,base_info.UserID , '2', 1, ls_err) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_err
	RETURN -1
END IF


String ls_yllb ,ls_zzzysqh,ls_rylx //入院类型暂时默认为普通入院
ls_yllb = '21' //暂时当做普通住院处理
IF ls_yllb = '23' THEN
	//	医疗类别为23转院住院时传入参保地的转院申请编号
ELSE
	ls_zzzysqh = ''
	ls_rylx = '1'
END IF

//医生基本信息
IF of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm,ls_ysxm,ls_sfzh) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_ysxm
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_zddms[],ls_ryzd,ls_zdmcs[],ls_klb,ls_sfpzxx,ls_ret[]

IF of_get_zy_zdxx(al_zyh,1,ls_zddm1,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms,ls_zdmcs,ls_ryzd) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '诊断取失败!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//科室信息
IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
	ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('SYD_GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
	IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
		as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
END IF


This.uf_send_init('9205')
ls_klb = '1'
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN	
	IF of_splitparm( istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh > '' And istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm > '' THEN
			ls_sfpzxx = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm + istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh
		ELSE
			ls_sfpzxx = ''
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add('是否有社会保障卡', '0')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息',ls_sfpzxx)
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		this.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
		uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh ) //Right(ls_knsj,9)) //
		uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm ) //Left(ls_knsj,Len(ls_knsj ) - 9))
	END IF	
ELSE
	IF of_splitparm( istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
		ls_klb = '3'
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', '1' )
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh+'|'+istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
	END IF

uf_send_add('参保地行政区划代码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ) //Left(ls_knsj,6))

uf_send_add('转诊转院申请单编号',ls_zzzysqh)

uf_send_add('病案号',ls_bahm)

uf_send_add('入院诊断医生服务编码',ls_ysbm)
uf_send_add('入院诊断医生姓名',ls_ysxm)
uf_send_add('入院疾病代码',ls_zddm1)
uf_send_add('入院疾病名称',ls_ryzd)
uf_send_add('入院病情描述',ls_zdmc)
uf_send_add('入院科室代码',ls_ksbm)
