uf_send_add('操作员姓名',base_info.username)
uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')
uf_send_add('外伤标识','')
uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '次要诊断列表')
Long ll_cur
ll_count = UpperBound(ls_zddms)
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		This.uf_send_add_in( '次要诊断编码', ls_zddms[ll_cur], ll_cur )
		This.uf_send_add_in( '次要诊断名称', ls_zdmcs[ll_cur], ll_cur )
	NEXT
ELSE
	This.uf_send_add_in( '次要诊断编码', ls_zddm1, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( '次要诊断名称', ls_ryzd, 1)
END IF
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zydj = '1' THEN
	IF MessageBox('提示','病人处于住院登记状态，是否继续登记?',question!,yesno!,2)  = 2 THEN
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSE
	//用于计数，解决住院号码撤销登记不能用问题2017-6-13
	IF ll_jsdh >= 1 THEN
		ll_jsdh = ll_jsdh + 1
		ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
	//
END IF
Int li_ret
String ls_zylsh
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	li_ret = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果'))
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_error = '错误号：'+String(li_ret) + This.uf_getstring( '错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		UPDATE ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = :ll_jsdh Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			as_error = '更新jsdh失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		UPDATE ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = 1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	ls_zylsh = This.uf_getstring( '住院登记流水号')
	//存交易id，可作废使用
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		INSERT INTO JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD(JSLSH, DZLSH,YWLX,ZYH,JSCS,   JSSJ,    YLRYLB,     CBDXZQH , 			YLLB,    JYLSH, JSTS , JYID,    GRBH,     ZTBZ,DKFS)
			VALUES(:ls_zylsh,:is_jyzqh,'DJ',:al_zyh,0,SYSDATE,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb ,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm , 			:ls_yllb,:is_jylsh,0,:as_zyhm, :istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.GRBH,  -9,:ls_klb) Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX(JSLSH, DZLSH,YWLX,ZYH,JSCS,   JSSJ,    YLRYLB,     CBDXZQH , 			YLLB,    JYLSH, JSTS , JYID,    GRBH,     ZTBZ,DKFS)
			VALUES(:ls_zylsh,:is_jyzqh,'DJ',:al_zyh,0,SYSDATE,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb ,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm , 			:ls_yllb,:is_jylsh,0,:as_zyhm, :istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.GRBH,  -9,:ls_klb) Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF

	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	//------------------------------------------
	INSERT INTO "ZY_BRRY_KZ"  ( "ZYH",   "YBJZBH" )
		Values (:al_zyh , :ls_zylsh)  Using itran_sqlca ;
	
	UPDATE ZY_BRRY_KZ Set YBJZBH = :ls_zylsh Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH  = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		ELSE
			as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
		UPDATE JKXT.SYDYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where  ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ in (0,9)  Using itran_sqlca;
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1





end function

	as_error = ls_ysxm

		as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText
		IF ab_commit THEN gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)

	END IF
	
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1




end function

public function string of_get_dmmc (string as_dmlb, string as_dmsb);long ll_find

ll_find = ids_dmzd_jk.find("dmlb='" + as_dmlb + "' and dmsb = '" +as_dmsb + "'",1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_dmzd_jk.object.dmmc[ll_find]
else
	return '无'
end if
end function

public function integer uf_czy_zx (string as_ygdm[], ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_zc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:台州市医保操作员注销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_ygdm[]	本院内部员工代码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	wy		日期: 2019.02.11
//====================================================================
Long ll_row ,ll_index
String ls_success
u_datastore lds_ygdm
lds_ygdm = Create u_datastore

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_err = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
lds_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
lds_ygdm.DataObject = 'd_ygdm_kz'
lds_ygdm.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
IF lds_ygdm.Retrieve(as_ygdm ) < 1 THEN
	as_err = '员工代码不存在，请重新确认' + lds_ygdm.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

ll_row = lds_ygdm.RowCount( )

Long ll_ret,ll_find,ll_row2,ll_index2
String ls_sptdm,ls_ygnm,ls_czyzh
SELECT sptdm Into :ls_czyzh From XTGL.gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :base_info.UserID Using itran_sqlca;
IF ls_czyzh = '' Or IsNull(ls_czyzh) THEN
	ls_czyzh = base_info.UserID
END IF
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_row
	This.uf_send_init( '9256')
	ls_ygnm = lds_ygdm.Object.ygdm[ll_index]
	ls_sptdm = lds_ygdm.Object.sptdm[ll_index]
	//9	医疗服务机构编号	string	12	是		
	//10	操作员账号	string	20	是		
	//11	注销原因	string	100	是		
	//12	注销人	string	20	是		
	//13	注销时间	string 	10	是		格式：yyyy-mm-dd
	uf_send_add('医疗服务机构编号',is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
	uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_sptdm) //3310992000140001
	uf_send_add('注销原因','作废')
	uf_send_add('注销人', ls_czyzh) //ls_czyzh
	uf_send_add('注销时间',String(Today(),'yyyy-mm-dd'))
	
	ls_success += ','+ls_ygnm
	IF Not  This.uf_send( as_err )   THEN  RETURN -1
	
	
	ll_ret = Long( This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果'))
	IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息') + '错误员工代码:'+ls_ygnm
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ll_find = lds_ygdm.Find( "ygdm = '"+ls_ygnm+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find > 0  THEN
		lds_ygdm.Object.sptdm[ll_find] = ''
	END IF
	
	IF lds_ygdm.Update( ) > 0 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = '已成功注销'+ls_success
	ELSE
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = lds_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_qrybjs (string as_knsj, string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh);IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_ret[],ls_sfpzxx
Integer li_ret
Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
//ls_xxt = '1~~331022D15600000500007946E24082EDJ00026975~~~~~~331099200014~~台州市妇女儿童医院~~00~~331099~~44734727~~0~~9203~~'

IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
	ls_sfpzxx = as_knsj
	ls_send = '$$3~~' + as_knsj + '~~~~~~' + is_yljgdm_tzsyd + '~~' + is_yljgmc_tzsyd + '~~00~~' + is_yljgxzqh + '~~' + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
else
	ls_sfpzxx = '' 
	ls_send = '$$1~~' + as_knsj + '~~~~~~' + is_yljgdm_tzsyd + '~~' + is_yljgmc_tzsyd + '~~00~~' + is_yljgxzqh + '~~' + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
end if
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '9208~~'+ls_sfpzxx+'$$'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '9203~~'+ls_sfpzxx+'$$'
END IF
li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(9206,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm_tzsyd)

if upperbound(ls_ret) >= 4 then
	gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,ls_ret[4])
end if
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)//$$0~~44734785~$$
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 2)
END IF
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1)
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_czy_rdz_tz (date adt_dzr, string as_czybm, string as_ywlx, ref string as_err);//台州操作员日对账
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_err  = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jyzqh,ls_err,ls_czy_sptbm
Date ldt_dzr
ldt_dzr = Date(adt_dzr)

SELECT jyzqh,sptbm  Into :ls_jyzqh,:ls_czy_sptbm From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr  And czybm = :as_czybm  And ztbz = 1 And qrlb = :as_ywlx Using itran_sqlca;
IF ls_jyzqh = '' Or IsNull(ls_jyzqh) THEN
	as_err = '未取得操作员('+as_czybm+')'+'对应的交易周期号'
	RETURN -1
END IF

is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
//ldc_zffy 自费费用  zffy2 自负费用
Dec ldc_ylfze,ldc_zlfy,ldc_zffy,ldc_zffy2,ldc_xjzf
Long ll_row

Dec ldc_fyze,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_grxjzf,ldc_bxje,ldc_tcjjzf,ldc_wnzhzf,ldc_dnzhzf,ldc_dbjzzf,ldc_gwybzzf,ldc_eyjjzf,ldc_lxjjzf,ldc_lmjjzf,ldc_bzjjzf,ldc_mzbzjj,ldc_yfbzjj,ldc_syjjzf
Long ll_jsjlts,ll_ybmxjsjlts //结算记录条数，医保明细结算记录条数
//统计本地金额信息lsyb_jsmx
//select sum(ylzfy),sum(zlfy),sum(zffy ),sum(zffy2),sum(xjzf),SUM(hjbxje) into :ldc_ylfze,:ldc_zlfy,:ldc_zffy,:ldc_zffy2,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_bxje from jkxt.sydyb_jsmx where czybm = :as_czybm and jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh and ywlx = :as_ywlx using itran_sqlca;
SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
	sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj),sum(yl1),sum(yl2)
	INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
	:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfbzjj,:ldc_syjjzf
	FROM  JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD
	Where ztbz > 0 And dzlsh = :ls_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;
// and ywlx = :as_ywlx
//查询本地对账信息表中，是否存在记录lsyb_dzxx 
SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From jkxt.tzyb_dzxx  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr And  ywlx = :as_ywlx And  czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;

IF IsNull(ll_jsjlts ) THEN  ll_jsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ll_ybmxjsjlts) THEN  ll_ybmxjsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_fyze) THEN  ldc_fyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zfze ) THEN  ldc_zfze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zlze) THEN  ldc_zlze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_grxjzf) THEN  ldc_grxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_bxje) THEN  ldc_bxje = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tcjjzf) THEN  ldc_tcjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_wnzhzf) THEN  ldc_wnzhzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_dnzhzf) THEN  ldc_dnzhzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_dbjzzf) THEN  ldc_dbjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gwybzzf) THEN  ldc_gwybzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_eyjjzf) THEN  ldc_eyjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lxjjzf) THEN  ldc_lxjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lmjjzf) THEN  ldc_lmjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_bzjjzf) THEN  ldc_bzjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_mzbzjj) THEN  ldc_mzbzjj = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_yfbzjj) THEN  ldc_yfbzjj = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_syjjzf) THEN  ldc_syjjzf = 0

//插入对账信息表，本地数据
IF ll_row > 0 THEN //存在记录则新增，否则理解为帐未平或失败，重新发起对账
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_dzxx SET dzsj = sysdate ,
		jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
		DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj, 
		yfjzjj = :ldc_yfbzjj, syjjzf = :ldc_syjjzf
		Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And ywlx = :as_ywlx And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	INSERT INTO jkxt.tzyb_dzxx(dzsj,jsjlts ,YBMXJSJLTS ,fyze, zfze , zlze, grxjzf, bxje, tcjjzf , wnzhzf, DNZHZF,dbjzzf, gwybzzf, eyjjzf , lxjjzf, lmjjzf , bzjjzf, mzbzjj,yfjzjj 		,syjjzf,czyzh,dzlsh,dzrq,dzlx,ywlx )
		VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfbzjj 		,:ldc_syjjzf,:ls_czy_sptbm,:ls_jyzqh,:ldt_dzr,'1',:as_ywlx  ) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
END IF


String ls_dzjg,ls_bz,ls_dz_ret
//准备发起对账
This.uf_send_init('9354')
This.uf_send_add('对帐日期',String(adt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd') )
This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_czy_sptbm)
This.uf_send_add('对帐流水号',ls_jyzqh)

This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '对帐信息')
This.uf_send_add_in('结算记录条数', ll_jsjlts ,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('医保明细结算记录条数', ll_ybmxjsjlts,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('费用总额', ldc_fyze,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('自费总额（非医保）', ldc_zfze ,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('自理总额��目录内自负比例部分� ', ldc_zlze,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('个人现金支付', ldc_grxjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('报销金额', ldc_bxje,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('统筹基金支付', ldc_tcjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('往年帐户支付', ldc_wnzhzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('当年帐户支付', ldc_dnzhzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('大病救助支付', ldc_dbjzzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('公务员补助支付', ldc_gwybzzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('二乙基金支付', ldc_eyjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('离休基金支付', ldc_lxjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('劳模基金支付', ldc_lmjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('补助基金支付', ldc_bzjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('医疗救助基金', ldc_mzbzjj,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('优抚补助基金', ldc_yfbzjj,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('生育基金支付', ldc_syjjzf,1)

IF uf_send(as_err) = True THEN
	IF Long(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果')) < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_dzjg = This.uf_getstring('对账结果标志') //对账结果
	ls_bz = This.uf_getstring('对帐不一致信息') //备注
	String ls_ztbz
	IF ls_dzjg = '0' THEN
		ls_bz = '对账结果一致'
	ELSEIF ls_dzjg = '-1' THEN
		
	END IF
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_dzxx Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And ywlx = :as_ywlx And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :ls_jyzqh  Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
	as_err  = '对账结果:'+ls_dz_ret+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
as_err = ls_dz_ret
IF ls_dzjg <> '0' THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc Set ztbz = '3',qcsj = sysdate Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr And qrlb = :as_ywlx And czybm = :as_czybm And jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
		as_err  = '对账结果:通过!'+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
END IF


RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_get_jsxx_cftf (string as_ywlsh, datetime adt_jssj, string as_ywlx, ref string as_jylsh, ref str_yb_jsxx_syb astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1

String ls_jssj
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_jssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')

	SELECT JSSJ,  					   YWLX,					JSLSH,  				 JYLSH,  				GDBZBJ  ,

		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX

ELSE

			FYZE,          			 ZFZE,       	   ZLZE,            ZYZF,			 		QFBZ,				 HJBXJE,		 GRXJZF,
			TCJJZF,          WNZHZF,        DNZHZF,           DBJZZF,        GWYBZZF,     EYJJZF,

		:astr_yb_jsxx.fyze,:astr_yb_jsxx.zfze,:astr_yb_jsxx.ZLZE,:astr_yb_jsxx.ZYZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.QFBZ,:astr_yb_jsxx.HJBXJE,:astr_yb_jsxx.GRXJZF,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.TCJJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.wnzhzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.DNZHZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.DBJZZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.GWYBZZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.EYJJZF,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.LXJJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.LMJJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.BZJJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.MZBZJJ,//:astr_yb_jsxx.GRZFXJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.GRZLXJZF,:astr_yb_jsxx.GRZFUXJZF,

private function integer uf_syd_mxsc (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref decimal adc_ywlsh, ref string as_error, str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_syd_mxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:省异地业务数据明细上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_knsj  	
// 	value    	string 	as_brbm  	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jslx

	string	3	否		参考数字字典规定病种标记

//12	病种审批号	string	20	否		预留	_
//13	门诊序列号	string	20	是		就医地定点机构自定义的唯一就诊序列号

//16	主要诊断	string	1000	否			长度由255调整为1000

//23	操作员姓名	string	50	否			长度由20调整为50
//24	医疗费用总额	double	12（2）	是		医疗费用总额=自费总额+自理总额+医保费用总额	
//25	自费总额（非医保）	double	12（2）	是	0	指按规定不允许进入社保各项基金结算范围的全自费费用，包括丙类药品、丙类诊疗项目、丙类服务设施和超限价部分。

//27	医保费用总额	double	12（2）	是		进入门诊统筹可报稤AT*
	
//28	费用明细数量	integer	5	是		本次就诊药品、诊疗费用明细条数	
//29	费用明细列表	composite				药品、费用明细列表	
//30	附加信息	string	100	否			
//31	对账流水号	number	30	是		与操作员管理中对账流水号相同	
//32	终端机编号	string	12	是		读卡机具内装载的社会保障PSAM卡编号；各交易发起机构现有社会保障卡接口系统无法获取到PSAM卡编号的可以暂时传入“0”

//34	次要诊断列表	composite				详见下面次要诊断列表参数	新增指标
//-----------------------------------
//1	读卡类型	字符型	3	是		参考数字字典读卡类型  01	读社保卡 03	支付令牌√ 02	扫二维码

//4	就诊时间	字符型	20	是		格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss
//5	科室编码	字符型	4	是		参考数字字典科室

//6	科室名称	字符型	100	是		
//7	医生服务编码	字符型	50	否		省统一医保医师编号
//8	医生姓名	字符型	50	否		
//9	主要病情描述	字符型	1024	是		
//10	主要疾病编码	字符型	20	是		
//11	主要糄AT*
	字符型	100	是		
//12	特殊结算类型	字符型	3	是		参考数字字典特殊结算类型

//13	待遇类型	字符型	3	是		参考数字字典待遇类型

//14	拨付类型	字符型	3	是		参考数字字典拨付类型

//15	待遇申请单号	字符型	20	否		收费类型为（5）规定病时传规定病种备案号；医疗类型为（1）生育时传生育备案号；其他传空
//16	操作员编号	字符型	20	否		
//17	操作员姓名	字符型	50	否		
//18	次要诊断列表	结构体		否		详见下面次要诊断列表参数

//20	费用明细列表	结构体		是		
//21	暂不支付盌AT*
	字符型	1	否		0或者空标志处方上传后能进行线上支付；1标识暂不能进行线上支付，需要医院端发起可支付通知（8012交易），比如皮试为阴性相应的抗生素才能支付。
//22	移动支付类型	字符型		是	1，2	1：移动付；2：扫码付。传入参数第2个字段为社保卡时，必须传入1，如果是二维码或支付令牌时，根据实际情况传入1或2。
//23	预留2	字符型		否		


String ls_sbm,ls_kh

String ls_cbdxzqh
Long ll_find1
Integer li_ret
DateTime ldt_now
Dec{0} ldrr_cflsh_sb[],ldrr_yjlsh_sb[]
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
ls_kh = Right(as_knsj,9) //社会保障卡卡号
ls_sbm = Mid(as_knsj,1,Len(as_knsj) - 9) //社会保障卡卡的识别码

	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)

	RETURN -1
END IF

	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

	as_error = '交易费用明细无数据!YWLSH:' + String(adc_ywlsh)
	//		astr_pyyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SaveAs("c:\mzfymx.txt",Text!,True)

	ls_ysxm = '未知'
	ls_yszh = '未知'
ELSE
	IF of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh) < 0 THEN
		as_error = ls_ysxm
		RETURN -1

ll_rowcount = uf_getstring_mxnr('收费项目明细自负信息')
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ll_findmzfymx = 0
	ls_mxxh = uf_getstring_in('明细序号',ll_row)
	ll_findmzfymx = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Find("getrow()="+String(ls_mxxh),1,99999)
	IF ll_findmzfymx > 0 THEN
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('正确的自负比例',ll_row)
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('合计自负',ll_row)
	END IF
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自费金额（包括超限金额）',ll_row)
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自理金额',ll_row)
	//	uf_getstring_in('超限说明',ll_row)
NEXT
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_mz_jscl (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, ref string as_error);//5	社会保障卡卡号	string	9	是			
//6	社会保障卡卡的识别码	string	50	是			
//7	参保地行政区划代码	string	20	否

//10	规定病种标记	string	3	否		参考数字字典规定病种标记

//15	疾病名称	string	100	是			长度由50调整为100
//16	主要诊断	string	1000	否			长度由255调整为1000
//17	就诊时间	date	20	是		格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss	
//18	科室代码	string	10	否			
//19	科室名称	string	50	否			
//20	医生服务编码	string	50	否		省统一医保医师编号	长度由20调整为50

//22	操作员编号	string	20	否

//25	自费总额（非医保）	double	12（2）	是	0	指按规定不允许进入社保各项基金结算范围的全自费费用，包括丙类药品、丙类诊疗项目、丙类服务设施和超限价部分。

//33	TAC	string	8	否		预结算时为空。	新增指标

		CHOOSE CASE  astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j]
			CASE 9,1
				This.uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','1',j)
			CASE 8,2
				This.uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','0',j)
			CASE ELSE
				This.uf_send_add_in('是否符合限用','0',j)
		END CHOOSE
		
		IF astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[j] = 1 THEN //全自费
			//			ldc_zfze = ldc_zfze + ldc_zjje
			ldc_zfze = ldc_zfze + astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[j]
		ELSEIF astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[j] = 0 THEN //全医保
			
		ELSE
			ldc_zlze = ldc_zlze + astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[j] * astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[j]
		END IF
		
		IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zyh[ll_insert] = 0
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BRBM[ll_insert] = as_brbm
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[j] //如 'CF','YJ'
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[j] //如cflsh,yjlsh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fymxxh[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.mxxh[j] //如cfmx.xh yjk2.lsh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfje[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XMYYBH[ll_insert] = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[j])
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XMYYDMC[ll_insert] = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmmc[j]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzbh[ll_insert] = is_jylsh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ybbm[ll_insert] = ls_ybbm
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
ldc_ybfyze = ldc_zjje - ldc_zlze - ldc_zfze
uf_send_add('医疗费用总额',ldc_zjje)
uf_send_add('自费总额（非医保）',ldc_zfze)
uf_send_add('自理总额（乙类目录）',ldc_zlze)
uf_send_add('医保费用总额',ldc_ybfyze)
uf_send_add('费用明细数量',ll_rowcount)

// 2020.10.26  CJN （新旧接口标志 0-旧接口 1-新接口）
//IF is_sydxjkqy = '0' THEN
//	uf_send_add('附加信息', '')
//ELSE
// 2020.10.26  CJN  9202、9203_MXSC 使用“附加信息”字段传输医师等级
String ls_YGJB, ls_YSDJ
SELECT YGJB Into :ls_YGJB From GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm Using sqlca;
ls_YSDJ = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_DMZD', '27', ls_YGJB)
IF IsNull(ls_YSDJ) Or ls_YSDJ = '' Or ls_YSDJ = '无' THEN
	ls_YSDJ = '01'
END IF
uf_send_add('附加信息', ls_YSDJ) // () → 医师等级(主治医师：01， 副主任医生：02， 主任医师：03， 专家：04)
//END IF

uf_send_add('对账流水号',is_jyzqh)
uf_send_add('终端机编号',is_psamid)
uf_send_add('TAC','')
Long ll_row
uf_send_add_in_mxnr('次要诊断列表')
IF UpperBound(ls_cyzdbm) > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To UpperBound(ls_cyzdbm)
		IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //20191009 wangyi 台州市异地健康体检控制
			IF ls_cyzdbm[ll_row] = '' Or IsNull(ls_cyzdbm[ll_row]) THEN
				as_error = ls_cyzdmc[ll_row] + ' 诊断不能医保结算！'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		
		This.uf_send_add_in('次要诊断编码',ls_cyzdbm[ll_row],ll_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('次要诊断名称',ls_cyzdmc[ll_row],ll_row)
	NEXT
ELSE
	This.uf_send_add_in('次要诊断编码',ls_jbbm,ll_row)
	This.uf_send_add_in('次要诊断名称',ls_jbmc,ll_row)
END IF

String ls_error
Dec{2} ldc_jjzf
ldc_jjzf = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyts = ll_rowcount

IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州把这段代码放在 uf_send()之后，取【结算流水号】作为查询条件
ELSE
	IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jzbh =  is_jylsh
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jylsh =  is_jylsh
		IF of_insert_jymx( as_brbm,  0,	0, astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh,ls_ghsf,as_jydd,ls_yllb,ls_gdbdm, is_jylsh,astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
		ELSE
			as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

//gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()内容构造结束，准备发送历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()内容构造结束，准备发送
il_time_send = CPU()
IF Not  uf_send(as_error)  THEN
	IF ls_klb = '3' THEN
		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],ls_cbdxzqh,ls_ret[4])
	END IF
	//	gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()发送失败×            历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()发送失败×
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ls_klb = '3' THEN
	gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],ls_cbdxzqh,ls_ret[4])
END IF
//gf_jsrz_tz("市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()发送成功○            历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send)) // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市异地\省异地.uf_mz_jscl()发送成功○
IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
	as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
	IF  This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息') > ''  THEN
		as_error = as_error + This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息')
	END IF
	RETURN -1
END IF
//结算流水号	string	30	是		
//规定病结算标志	string	3	是		参考数字字典规定病结算标志
//提示标记	string	1	是		预留，默认给0
//提示信息	string	200	否		预留
//交易结算时间	date	20	是		格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss
//糄AT*
扑憬峁�信�
	composite				详见下面计算结果信息结构体参数说明
//收费项目明细自负信息	composite				只返回就医地上传的参考自负比例与参保地自负比例不一致的费用明细列表；详见下面收费项目明细自负信息结构体参数说明
//有误收费项目明细返回信息	composite				详见下面有误收费项目明细结构体参数说明
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.ywlx = ls_ghsf
//astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')
String ls_jslsh
ls_jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jslsh = ls_jslsh
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.gdbjsbz = This.uf_getstring('规定病结算标志')
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj = This.uf_getdatetime( '交易结算时间')
IF Date(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj = ldt_now
END IF
of_get_syb_jsxx(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb)
istr_yb_jsxx_syb = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	IF ldc_jjzf <> astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje THEN
		as_error = '预结薉AT* ' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致'
		IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_now, is_jylsh, '9203', ls_cbdxzqh, ls_error) > 0 THEN
			as_error = '预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致;已作废'
		ELSE
			as_error = '预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致;作废失败' +ls_error
		END IF
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州多一步交易确认
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jzbh =  ls_jslsh
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jylsh =  ls_jslsh
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_ybfymx_sc.RowCount( )
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzbh[ll_row] = ls_jslsh
		NEXT
		IF of_insert_jymx( as_brbm,  0,	0, astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh,ls_ghsf,as_jydd,ls_yllb,ls_gdbdm, ls_jslsh,astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
		ELSE
			as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		String ls_qrjslsh
		IF This.uf_qrybjs( as_knsj, ls_ghsf, ls_jslsh, as_error, ls_qrjslsh) > 0 THEN
			This.of_update_jsmx( ls_qrjslsh, astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error)
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		This.of_update_jsmx( is_jylsh, astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error)
	END IF
END IF
Long ll_findmzfymx
ll_rowcount = 0
ll_rowcount = uf_getstring_mxnr('收费项目明细自负信息')
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ll_findmzfymx = 0
	ls_mxxh = uf_getstring_in('明细序号',ll_row)
	ll_findmzfymx = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Find("getrow()="+String(ls_mxxh),1,99999)
	IF ll_findmzfymx > 0 THEN
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('正确的自负比例',ll_row)
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('合计自负',ll_row)
	END IF
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自费金额（包括超限金额）',ll_row)
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自理金额',ll_row)
	//	uf_getstring_in('超限说明',ll_row)
NEXT
RETURN 1



end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb_jbbm (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM' or  Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
IF ib_tzsyd = True And Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM' THEN //WANGYI 20191011 诊断为体检，返回空，不让结算医保
	IF Pos(is_tjzddm,as_tjlxh) > 0 THEN
		RETURN ''
	END IF
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlb, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zdmc, ref string as_zddms[], ref string as_zdmcs[], ref string as_ryzd);//住院病人诊断信息
//ai_zdlb 用于判断是获取入院诊断还是出院诊断 1入院   2出院  3生育
//as_ryzd 为入院主诊断，出院主诊断
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "zdlb asc")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF

Long ll_row,ll_sypb = 0
String ls_sybm
IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
		as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	ELSE
		as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	END IF
	as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	as_zdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	
	IF ai_zdlb = 3 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 to ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
			ls_sybm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'GY_JBBM_SY',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row] ) )
			IF ls_sybm = '无' THEN
			ELSE
				ll_sypb = 1
				as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row]))
				as_zddm1 = ls_sybm + ',' + as_zddm1
				as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_row])
				as_zdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_row])
				EXIT
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = ''
	as_ryzd = ''
	as_zdmc = ''
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() = 0 THEN
	as_zdmc = ''
	as_ryzd = '健康体检--无诊断'
	as_zddm1 = 'Z00.001'
END IF
IF as_ryzd = '' Or IsNull(as_ryzd) THEN
	as_ryzd = '诊断为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 2  THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_count
		ll_zds ++
		IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
		ELSE
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
		END IF
		as_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
		as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
	NEXT
END IF

IF ai_zdlb = 3 and ll_sypb = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200312 生育
	as_ryzd = '没有生育对照的诊断，不能医保生育登记！'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Len(as_zdmc) >= 100 THEN
	as_zdmc = of_midstring(as_zdmc,99)
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_yljg_rdz (date adt_dzr, string as_dzlx, ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_yljg_rdz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date  	adt_dzr 	
// 	value    	string	as_dzlx 	0：全部 2：省内跨市就医，3：跨省住院就医，4：跨省门诊就医，5：罕见病门诊
// 	reference	string	as_err  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx	日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
//数据库连接准备
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_err  = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jyzqh,ls_err,ls_czy_sptbm,ls_cbd_2
Date ldt_dzr
DateTime ldt_dzr_start ,ldt_dzr_end
ldt_dzr = Date(adt_dzr)
ldt_dzr_start = DateTime(ldt_dzr,Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_dzr_end = DateTime(ldt_dzr,Time('23:59:59'))
ls_cbd_2 = left(is_sbyxzqh,2)
is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
//ldc_zffy 自费费用  zffy2 自负费用
Dec ldc_ylfze,ldc_zlfy,ldc_zffy,ldc_zffy2,ldc_xjzf
Long ll_row

Dec ldc_fyze,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_grxjzf,ldc_bxje,ldc_tcjjzf,ldc_wnzhzf,ldc_dnzhzf,ldc_dbjzzf,ldc_gwybzzf,ldc_eyjjzf,ldc_lxjjzf,ldc_lmjjzf,ldc_bzjjzf,ldc_mzbzjj,ldc_yfjzjj,ldc_syjjzf
Long ll_jsjlts,ll_ybmxjsjlts //结算记录条数，医保明细结算记录条数
//统计本地金额信息lsyb_jsmx
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj),sum(yl1),sum(yl2)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfjzjj,:ldc_syjjzf
		FROM  JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '0' THEN //全部日对账
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16'  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '2' THEN //省内跨市就医
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) = :ls_cbd_2  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '3' THEN //跨省住院就医
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) <> :ls_cbd_2 and ywlx ='ZY' Using itran_sqlca;

	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),

		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) <> :ls_cbd_2 and ywlx <> 'ZY'  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '5' THEN //罕见病
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf + yl1),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb='16' Using itran_sqlca;
END IF

IF IsNull(ll_jsjlts ) THEN  ll_jsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ll_ybmxjsjlts) THEN  ll_ybmxjsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_fyze) THEN  ldc_fyze = 0

IF IsNull(ldc_dbjzzf) THEN  ldc_dbjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gwybzzf) THEN  ldc_gwybzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_eyjjzf) THEN  ldc_eyjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lxjjzf) THEN  ldc_lxjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lmjjzf) THEN  ldc_lmjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_bzjjzf) THEN  ldc_bzjjzf = 0

IF IsNull(ldc_yfjzjj) THEN  ldc_yfjzjj = 0

string ls_err_temp
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From JKXT.tzyb_dzxx  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2'   Using itran_sqlca;

			DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf  = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj
