			VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj 			,'','0',:ldt_dzr,'2',''  ) Using itran_sqlca;
		ls_err_temp  = '本地对账信息插入数据失败'
	END IF
ELSE
	//查询本地对账信息表中，是否存在记录lsyb_dzxx 
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From JKXT.syd_dzxx  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = :as_dzlx   Using itran_sqlca;
	//插入对账信息表，本地数据
	IF ll_row > 0 THEN //存在记录则新增，否则理解为帐未平或失败，重新发起对账
		UPDATE jkxt.syd_dzxx SET dzsj = sysdate ,
			jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
			DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf  = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj
			Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = :as_dzlx   Using itran_sqlca;
		ls_err_temp = '本地对账信息更新数据失败'
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO jkxt.syd_dzxx(dzsj,jsjlts ,YBMXJSJLTS ,fyze, zfze , zlze, grxjzf, bxje, tcjjzf , wnzhzf, DNZHZF,dbjzzf, gwybzzf, eyjjzf , lxjjzf, lmjjzf , bzjjzf, mzbzjj 			,czyzh,dzlsh,dzrq,dzlx,ywlx )
			VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj 			,'','0',:ldt_dzr,:as_dzlx,''  ) Using itran_sqlca;
		ls_err_temp  = '本地对账信息插菵AT* '
	END IF
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_err  = ls_err_temp + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
		
String ls_dzjg,ls_bz,ls_dz_ret
//准备发起对账
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	This.uf_send_init('9314')
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('对帐信息' )
	This.uf_send_add_in('结算记录条数', ll_jsjlts,1 )
	This.uf_send_add_in('医保明细结算记录条数', ll_ybmxjsjlts,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('费用总额', ldc_fyze,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('自费总额（非医保）', ldc_zfze,1 )
	This.uf_send_add_in('自理总额（目录内自负比例部分）', ldc_zlze,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('个人现金支付', ldc_grxjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('报销金额', ldc_bxje,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('统筹基金支付', ldc_tcjjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('往年帐户支付', ldc_wnzhzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('当年帐户支付', ldc_dnzhzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('大病救助支付', ldc_dbjzzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('公务员补助支付', ldc_gwybzzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('二乙基金支付', ldc_eyjjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('离休基金支付', ldc_lxjjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('劳模基金支付', ldc_lmjjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('补助基金支付', ldc_bzjjzf,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医疗救助基金', ldc_mzbzjj,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('优抚补助基金', ldc_yfjzjj,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('生育基金支付', ldc_syjjzf,1)
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('9214')
//	IF as_dzlx = '4' THEN
//		This.uf_send_add('异地结算类型','5')
//	ELSE //IF as_dzlx = '2' THEN
//		This.uf_send_add('异地结算类型','0')
//	END IF
   This.uf_send_add('异地结算类型',as_dzlx)
	This.uf_send_add('结算记录条数', ll_jsjlts )
	This.uf_send_add('医保明细结算记录条数', ll_ybmxjsjlts)
	This.uf_send_add('费用总额', ldc_fyze)
	This.uf_send_add('自费总额（非医保）', ldc_zfze )
	This.uf_send_add('自理总额（目录内自负比例部分）', ldc_zlze)
	This.uf_send_add('个人现金支付', ldc_grxjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('报销金额', ldc_bxje)
	This.uf_send_add('统筹基金支付', ldc_tcjjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('往年帐户支付', ldc_wnzhzf)
	This.uf_send_add('当年帐户支付', ldc_dnzhzf)
	This.uf_send_add('大病救助支付', ldc_dbjzzf)
	This.uf_send_add('公务员补助支付', ldc_gwybzzf)
	This.uf_send_add('二乙基金支付', ldc_eyjjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('离休基金支付', ldc_lxjjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('劳模基金支付', ldc_lmjjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('补助基金支付', ldc_bzjjzf)
	This.uf_send_add('民政补助基金', ldc_mzbzjj)
END IF
This.uf_send_add('对帐日期',String(adt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd') )



IF uf_send(as_err) = True THEN
	IF Long(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果')) < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_dzjg = trim(This.uf_getstring('对账结果标志')) //对账结果
	ls_bz = This.uf_getstring('对帐不一致信息') //备注
	String ls_ztbz
	IF ls_dzjg = '0' THEN
		ls_bz = '对账结果一致'
	ELSEIF ls_dzjg = '-1' THEN
		
	END IF
	IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.tzyb_dzxx Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2' Using itran_sqlca;// :as_dzlx 
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.syd_dzxx Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = :as_dzlx  Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
	as_err  = '对账结果:'+ls_dz_ret+ '对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF

as_err = ls_dz_ret
IF ls_dzjg <> '0' THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	RETURN 1
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_fycxcf (long al_zyh, ref string as_msg);//wangyi 20200820 指定费用超限拆分of_zy_fymx_fycxcf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl, ldc_fyxe, ldc_yhje, ldc_yhdj, ldc_yhcfje
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_zflj_cq //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

//拆分限额超限费用。限额设置取自GY_YLSF_KZ.zycxzfxe
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_fycxcf_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0, fyxe。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje�
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的限额控制费用有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ldc_fyxe = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxe[ll_row]
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		ldc_yhje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		ldc_yhdj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) / ldc_fysl //计算加上优惠金额
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
//						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_yhcfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限强制自费', 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				
END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用限额控制,退费先自费', 100)
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_yhcfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF lds_fymx_cf.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	as_msg = "住院费用明细zy_fymx保存失败。" + lds_fymx_cf.is_error
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_cf (long al_zyh, ref string as_msg);//复制u_ybjk_new_his.of_zy_fymx_cf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_fylj_cg, ldc_fylj_cl
Decimal{2} ldc_zflj_cq, ldc_zflj_cg, ldc_zflj_cl //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

idc_zgxe_cq = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CQDXLJZGXE", "30000", "分类编码为CQ的医用材料单项累计最高限额"))
idc_zgxe_cg = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CGDXLJZGXE", "20000", "分类编码为CG的医用材料单项累计最高限额"))
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then idc_zgxe_cl = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CLLJZGXE", "40000", "分类编码为CL的医用材料累计最高限额"))    // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  获取CL材料最高限额

//Long ll_brxz, ll_tgdw
//SELECT brxz, tgdw Into :ll_brxz, :ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
//	as_msg = "该病人的参保性质获取失败。"
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

//IF ll_brxz = 6024 And ll_tgdw = 3003 THEN
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_LXBRCWF", "55", "离休病人床位费记账金额")) //离休病人床位费记账55元
//ELSE
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_PTBRCWF", "45", "普通病人床位费记账金额")) //普通病人床位费记账45元
//END IF

//拆分CQ类医用材料费用。先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，单项累计最高限额为3万。
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cq_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算礑AT*
摹�spbz = 9的、CQ类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

//拆分CG类医用材料费用。先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，单项累计最高限额为2万。
u_datastore lds_fymx_cg //未上传明细未结算的CG类的住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cg = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cg.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cg_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cg.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cg.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cg //已上传明细未结算的CG类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cg = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cg.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cg_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cg.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cg.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cg_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CG类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cg_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cg.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cg.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cg.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cg.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cg.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cg = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl)  THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cg > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cg
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  拆分CL类医用材料费用
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then
	//拆分CL类医用材料费用。单价在200元以上的，先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，累计最高限额为4万。
	u_datastore lds_fymx_cl //未上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymx_cl = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymx_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cl_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新增BM字段
	lds_fymx_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ll_count = lds_fymx_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)

	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl //已上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
		lds_fymxsc_cl = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_syd' //bm, fyje（CL类已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新增BM字段，并对BM字段进行GroupBy
		lds_fymxsc_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CG类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_tf_syd'  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 强制自费金额减去优惠金额
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
		
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ls_bm = lds_fymx_cl.Object.bm[ll_row]
			ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
			ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
			ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
			ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
			ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
			li_spbz = lds_fymx_cl.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
			IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0         // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)  
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
						ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
					END IF
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//					ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//					IF IsNull(ldc_fylj_cl) THEN
//						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
//						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
//					END IF
					IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
//						ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
//						ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//							IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//							END IF
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
							ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
							IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
							END IF
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
						ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + ldc_xelj
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
					ELSE
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						IF ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
							ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zfje
							lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						ELSE
							IF ldc_zflj_cl > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
								ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
								IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
									ls_bz = ''
								END IF
								lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
								
								ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cl
								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//								IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//									ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//								END IF
								ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆稤AT* ,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//								ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
//								lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计(1-zfbl)*zjje
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_rylx 	
// 	reference	string	as_jzbh 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.08.18   25180
//====================================================================

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_count
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jsrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch //,ls_kssj
String ls_grbh,ls_shsbkh,ls_xzqh,ls_ylbxkh
SELECT KNXX,BRKS,RYRQ,ZYHM,BRCH,BAHM,ZZYS,JSRQ
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ldt_ryrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:ldt_jsrq
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(1900,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ls_knsj = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj
			ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
	END IF
END IF

return uf_zydj( ls_knsj, ll_ksdm, al_zyh, date(ldt_ryrq), ls_zyhm, ls_brch,ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, as_rylx , as_jzbh, as_error,itran_sqlca, true)

end function

public function integer uf_get_tsdz (integer ai_yplx, long al_ypxh, long al_ypcd, datetime adt_jfrq, ref string as_ybbm, ref string as_ybmc, ref string as_sfxmdj, ref string as_error);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_sql
IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz) THEN
	ids_yb_tsdz = Create U_datastore
	ids_yb_tsdz.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " SELECT a.FYLX,a.FYXH,a.YBZXBH,a.KSSJ,a.JSSJ,b.YPMC,b.SFXMDJ,a.YPCD FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ a,JKXT.SYDYB_YPML b WHERE a.FYLX = 2 AND a.YBZXBH = b.ypbm "
	ls_sql += " UNION ALL SELECT c.FYLX,c.FYXH,c.YBZXBH,c.KSSJ,c.JSSJ,d.XMMC,d.SFXMDJ,c.YPCD FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ c,JKXT.SYDYB_ZLML d WHERE c.FYLX = 3 And c.YBZXBH = d.XMBM "
	IF ids_yb_tsdz.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'特殊对照'对象失败("+ids_yb_tsdz.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		// 2021.11.22  CJN  27403  特殊对照改为单次插入，而非直接全表检索
		IF ii_ybtsdzgjqy = 0 THEN
			ids_yb_tsdz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
			ids_yb_tsdz.Retrieve()
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
String ls_filter_tsdz
Long ll_Find_tsdz,ll_tscount
IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN // 药品
	ls_filter_tsdz = "#1 = 2 AND #2 = " + String(al_ypxh) + " AND #8 = " + String(al_ypcd)
ELSE // 费用
	ls_filter_tsdz = "#1 = 3 AND #2 = " + String(al_ypxh)
END IF
IF ii_ybtsdzgjqy = 1 THEN // 2021.11.22  CJN  27403  特殊对照 数据插入
	IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz_temp) THEN
		ids_yb_tsdz_temp = create u_datastore
		ids_yb_tsdz_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
		ids_yb_tsdz_temp.DataObject = "d_sydtsdz_fyxh"
	END IF
	ll_Find_tsdz = ids_yb_tsdz.Find(ls_filter_tsdz, 1, 9999999)
	IF ll_Find_tsdz <= 0 THEN
		ids_yb_tsdz_temp.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
		IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN // 药品
			ll_tscount = ids_yb_tsdz_temp.Retrieve(2, al_ypxh)
		ELSE
			ll_tscount = ids_yb_tsdz_temp.Retrieve(3, al_ypxh)
		END IF
		IF ll_tscount < 0 THEN
			as_error = ids_yb_tsdz_temp.is_error
			return -1
		ELSEIF ll_tscount > 0 THEN
			ids_yb_tsdz_temp.RowsCopy(1, ll_tscount, Primary!, ids_yb_tsdz, 1, Primary!)
		ELSE
			RETURN 0
		END IF
		//		IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN // 药品
		//			SELECT a.YBZXBH, a.KSSJ, a.JSSJ, b.YPMC, b.SFXMDJ INTO :ls_YBZXBH, :ldt_kssj, :ldt_jssj, :ls_ybmc, :ls_sfxmdj
		//				From JKXT.YB_TSDZ a,JKXT.SYDYB_YPML b Where a.FYLX = 2 And a.FYXH = :al_ypxh And a.YPCD = :al_ypcd Using itran_sqlca;
		//		ELSE // 费用
		//			SELECT c.YBZXBH, c.KSSJ, c.JSSJ, d.XMMC, d.SFXMDJ INTO :ls_YBZXBH, :ldt_kssj, :ldt_jssj, :ls_ybmc, :ls_sfxmdj
		//				From JKXT.YB_TSDZ c,JKXT.SYDYB_ZLML d Where c.FYLX = 3 And c.FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
		//		END IF
		//		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		//			IF IsNull(ls_YBZXBH) Or ls_YBZXBH = '' THEN
		//				as_error = '(fylx'+String(ai_yplx)+'),(fyxh'+String(al_ypxh) +'),(ypcd'+String(al_ypcd)+') 特殊对照未维护医保编码，请联系医保处维护！'
		//				RETURN -1
		//			END IF
		//			IF IsNull(ldt_kssj) THEN
		//				as_error = '(fylx'+String(ai_yplx)+'),(fyxh'+String(al_ypxh) +'),(ypcd'+String(al_ypcd)+') 特殊对照未维护开始时间，请联系医保处维护！'
		//				RETURN -1
		//			END IF

		//				as_error = '(fylx'+String(ai_yplx)+'),(fyxh'+String(al_ypxh) +'),(ypcd'+String(al_ypcd)+') 特殊对照未维护结束时间，请联系医保处维护！'
		//				RETURN -1
		//			END IF
		//			IF IsNull(ls_ybmc) THEN ls_ybmc = ''
		//			IF IsNull(ls_sfxmdj) THEN ls_sfxmdj = ''
		//			ll_find = ids_yb_tsdz.InsertRow(0)
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.FYLX[ll_find] = ai_yplx
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.FYXH[ll_find] = al_ypxh
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.YBZXBH[ll_find] = ls_YBZXBH
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.KSSJ[ll_find] = ldt_kssj
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.JSSJ[ll_find] = ldt_jssj
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.XMMC[ll_find] = ls_ybmc
		//			ids_yb_tsdz.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find] = ls_sfxmdj

教厥舛哉栈�本信�
:(fylx'+String(ai_yplx)+'),(fyxh'+String(al_ypxh) +'),(ypcd'+String(al_ypcd)+')' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText 		//			RETURN -1 		//		END IF 	END IF
END IF

ls_filter_tsdz = ls_filter_tsdz + " AND #4 <= datetime('" + String(adt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss')
ls_filter_tsdz = ls_filter_tsdz +  "') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(adt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')"
ll_Find_tsdz = ids_yb_tsdz.Find(ls_filter_tsdz,1,999999)
IF ll_Find_tsdz > 0 THEN
	as_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_Find_tsdz]
	as_ybmc = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#6[ll_Find_tsdz])
	as_sfxmdj = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#7[ll_Find_tsdz])
	RETURN 1
END IF
RETURN 0



end function

public function integer of_insert_bscfymx (long al_zyh, string as_ybjzbh, ref string as_msg);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.of_insert_bscfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 插菵AT*
胍奖２簧洗�项目明细�

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long    	al_zyh   	
// 	value    	string  	as_ybjzbh

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

         round(MZ_CFMX.DJ,4) as xmdj ,  
         round(MZ_CFMX.JZJE + MZ_CFMX.ZFJE,2 ) AS ZJJE,   
         MZ_CFMX.TSYF AS TSYF,
         MZ_CFK.GHLSH AS GHLSH,

         nvl(MZ_CFMX.SZFBL, 1) AS ZFBL,  
         round(MZ_CFMX.ZFJE,2 ) AS ZFJE,
         MZ_CFK.fplsh as fplsh,
         0.00 as yfjm,
         nvl(MZ_CFMX.YHJE,0) AS YHJE,

         MZ_CFMX.JZJE AS JZJE,
         TO_NUMBER(MZ_CFK.YFKSM) AS ZXKS,
         '0' as czybm,
			'CF'||to_char(MZ_CFMX.CFLSH)||'XH'||to_char(MZ_CFMX.XH) as wsfllsh,

			to_char(YK_TYPK.TYPE) AS XMLB

   WHERE MZ_CFK.CFLSH = MZ_CFMX.CFLSH AND
         MZ_CFMX.YPXH = YK_TYPK.YPXH AND

         MZ_CFMX.CFLSH > 0 AND
			nvl(MZ_CFK.FYBZ,'c') <> 'z'

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);//if len( //as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len) //if not of_if_char(as_string) then //	as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len -1) //

RETURN as_string

public function integer uf_zhcx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);//5	读卡方式	string	2	是		参考数字字典读卡方式
//
//6	卡片类型	string	3	是		参考数字字典卡片类型
//7	社会保障卡卡号	string	9	是			
//8	社会保障卡卡的识别码	string	50	是			
//9	参保地行政区划代码	string	20	否		参考数字字典行政区划代码
//
//10	就医地行政区划代码	string	20	否		参考数字字典行政区划代码
//
//11	医疗类别	string	3	否		参考数字字典医疗类别
//12	附加信息	string	200	否			
//13	终端机编号	string	12	是		读卡机具内装载的社会保障PSAM卡编号；各交易发起机构现有社会保障卡接口系统无法获取到PSAM卡编号的可以暂时传入"0"	
//14	卡规范版本	string	4	否		卡片版本信息编辑的号码。	新增指标
//15	证件号	string	20	否			新增指标
//16	姓名	string	50	否			新增指标
//20210713zbq修改
IF ib_yktdy THEN
	RETURN uf_zhcx_ykt(as_knsj,as_error)
END IF
String ls_sbm,ls_kh,ls_dkfs,ls_ret[],ls_knsj_ykt
IF IsNull(as_knsj) Or as_knsj = 'YBDK' Or Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	//	if this.uf_readcard( as_error) < 0 then
	//      return -1
	//	end if
	//	as_knsj = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj
ELSE
	ls_kh = Right(as_knsj,9)
	ls_sbm = Mid(as_knsj,1,Len(as_knsj) - 9)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = Left(as_knsj,6)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
END IF
This.uf_send_init('8001')

IF Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_dkfs = '3' // 5.读卡方式(1) →  (3：令牌)
	as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
	IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
		//6.卡片类型(1) → 身份凭证信息(姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌|参保地行政区|渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号)
		istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = ls_ret[5]
		istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
		istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh = ls_ret[3]
		istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm = ls_ret[1]
		IF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) <= 5 THEN
			ls_ret[6] = ''
			ls_ret[7] = ''
		ELSEIF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) <= 6 THEN
			ls_ret[7] = ''
		END IF
		as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]+ "|" + ls_ret[5] + "|" + ls_ret[7]+"|" +ls_ret[6]
		//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		as_knsj = as_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
	ELSE
		as_error = '医保电子凭证信息传入错误'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSEIF ib_yktdy THEN
	//		姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌|参保地行政区|渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号
	//		as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]+ "|" + ls_ret[5] + "|" + ls_ret[7]+"|" +ls_ret[6]
	
	ls_knsj_ykt =  as_knsj + "||"
ELSE
	ls_dkfs = '1'
END IF
istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dkfs = ls_dkfs
IF ls_dkfs = '3'  THEN
	This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '0')
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号/读卡方式',ls_dkfs)
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码/身份凭证信息',as_knsj)
ELSE
	IF ib_yktdy THEN
		This.uf_send_add( '是否有社会保障卡', '3')
		This.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', ls_knsj_ykt)
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号/读卡方式',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh)
	This.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码/身份凭证信息',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
END IF

This.uf_send_add('参保地行政区划代码',istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm )
This.uf_send_add('就医地行政区划代码',is_yljgxzqh)
This.uf_send_add('附加信息','')
This.uf_send_add('医疗类别','')
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号',is_psamid)
This.uf_send_add('卡规范版本','1.00')
This.uf_send_add('证件号',Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh))
This.uf_send_add('姓名',Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm))
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF  ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
		This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( )
		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],ls_ret[5],ls_ret[4])
	END IF
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dkfs = ls_dkfs
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = as_knsj
	of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb)
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF







end function

public function boolean uf_init (ref string as_error);//add by sxl 去掉全局变量
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN False
END IF
//将constructor移到uf_ini里
IF This.of_constructor( ) = False THEN  RETURN False
ii_jbbd = Integer(gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,0,'SJBMLDZMS','0','0用省异地，1同本地疾病目录'))
//----------------------------------------------------------------
ids_dmzd_jk = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_jk.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
IF ids_dmzd_jk.createfromsql(" SELECT JLXH,DMLB,DMSB,DMMC,DMJC FROM XTGL.GY_DMZD_JK WHERE JKLX = 'YB'") < 0 THEN
	as_error = "创建'接口代码字典'对象失败("+ids_dmzd_jk.is_error+")!"
	RETURN False
END IF

ids_dmzd_jk.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_jk.Retrieve()
Long i
ids_dmzd_dz = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_dz.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_new'
ids_dmzd_dz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz.RowCount()
	IF IsNull(ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i]) THEN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i] = '' //空处理
NEXT
ids_dmzd_dz_jb = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_jb' //20200319 wangyi 疾病对照单独拿出来
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz_jb.RowCount()

public function integer uf_czy_zc (string as_ygdm[], ref string as_err);//zbq20210726
//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_zc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:省医保操作员注册
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_ygdm[]	本院内部员工代码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx		日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
Long ll_row ,ll_index
string ls_success
u_datastore lds_ygdm
lds_ygdm = Create u_datastore
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_err = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

lds_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
lds_ygdm.DataObject = 'd_ygdm_kz' //表已改
lds_ygdm.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
IF lds_ygdm.Retrieve(as_ygdm ) < 1 THEN
	as_err = '员工代码不存在，请重新确认' + lds_ygdm.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

ll_row = lds_ygdm.RowCount( )


//this.uf_send_add( '医疗服务机构编号', '') //测试时，该节点不能传数据
String ls_xm,ls_sfzh,ls_sjhm,ls_ygnm
Long ll_ret,ll_find,ll_row2,ll_index2
String ls_ygdm, ls_sptbm
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_row
	ls_xm = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_ygxm[ll_index]
	ls_sfzh = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_sfzh[ll_index]
	ls_sjhm = lds_ygdm.Object.gy_ygdm_sjhm[ll_index]
	ls_ygnm = lds_ygdm.Object.ygdm[ll_index]
		This.uf_send_init( '8051')
		//uf_send_add('医疗服务机构编号',is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
		uf_send_add('姓名',ls_xm)
		uf_send_add('公民身份号码',ls_sfzh)
		uf_send_add('操作员内部工号',ls_ygnm)
		uf_send_add('联系电话（手机）',ls_sjhm)
		uf_send_add('注册申请日期',String(Today(),'yyyy-mm-dd'))
		uf_send_add('其他说明','')

	
	ls_success += ','+ls_ygnm
	IF Not  This.uf_send( as_err )   THEN  RETURN -1
	
	
	ll_ret = Long( This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果'))
	IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息') + '错误员工代码:'+ls_ygnm
		RETURN -1
	END IF


		ls_sptbm = This.uf_getstring( '操作员账号')
		ll_find = lds_ygdm.Find( "ygdm = '"+ls_ygnm+"'", 1, 999999)
		IF ll_find > 0  THEN
			lds_ygdm.Object.sbddm[ll_find] = ls_sptbm
		END IF


	
	IF lds_ygdm.Update( ) > 0 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
 		as_err = '已成功注册'+ls_success
	ELSE
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = lds_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_czy_rdz (date adt_dzr, string as_czybm, string as_ywlx, ref string as_err);//====================================================================

	as_err = '未取得操作员('+as_czybm+')'+'对应的交易周期号'

SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
	sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj),sum(yl1)
	INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,

SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From jkxt.syd_dzxx  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr And  ywlx = :as_ywlx And  czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表修改？？

IF IsNull(ll_ybmxjsjlts) THEN  ll_ybmxjsjlts = 0

IF IsNull(ldc_lxjjzf) THEN  ldc_lxjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lmjjzf) THEN  ldc_lmjjzf = 0

IF ll_row > 0 THEN //存在记录则新增，否则理解为帐未平或失败，重新发起对账
	UPDATE jkxt.syd_dzxx SET dzsj = sysdate ,
		jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
		DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf  = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj
		Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And ywlx = :as_ywlx And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表修改？？
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF

		VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj 		,:ls_czy_sptbm,:ls_jyzqh,:ldt_dzr,'1',:as_ywlx  ) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText

		RETURN -1

		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF

String ls_dzjg,ls_bz,ls_dz_ret
//准备发起对账
This.uf_send_init('9254')
This.uf_send_add('对帐日期',String(adt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd') )
This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_czy_sptbm)

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN //台州市异地直接返回
	RETURN uf_send(as_return,0,is_yljgxzqh)
END IF

Integer li_jyfs,li_xhxh
String ls_jsfxzqh //传入接收方行政区划和发送报文ID，中间用单波浪线‘~’分割
Integer li_xxmddxzqh
String ls_xzqh
Long ll_find
//接收方行政区划：跟机构相关的如对账交易传省平台行政区划‘330000’； 
//跟参保人业务相关的交易:9201传卡识别码前6位，其余交易传9201参保地返回的参保地行政区划代码；
//发送报文ID：医院端唯一的发送报文ID，必须保证本医院内唯一，后续交易作废需要使用到该ID进行处理。
//每笔交易的唯一标识，规则：医院编翫AT*
12位）+ 顺序号（18）；
//IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
//	as_return = is_error
//	RETURN false
//END IF
IF Left(is_xxtlx,1) = '3' THEN //上传下载类交易申请
	li_jyfs = 1
	ls_jsfxzqh = '330000'
ELSE //实时结算类交易
	li_xxmddxzqh = of_get_jklx_xxmddxzqh(is_xxtlx)
	
	IF li_xxmddxzqh = 1 THEN
		ls_xzqh =  '330000'
	ELSE
		ll_find = ids_send.Find("dataname='参保地行政区划代码'",1,999999)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_xzqh = ids_send.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		ELSE
			as_return = '未找到参保地行政区划代码'+is_xxtlx
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_xzqh) Or ls_xzqh = '' THEN
		as_return = '参保地行政区划代码为空，请核对' + is_xxtlx
		RETURN False
	END IF
	li_jyfs = 0
	ls_jsfxzqh = ls_xzqh
END IF

IF uf_send(as_return,li_jyfs,ls_jsfxzqh) THEN
	RETURN True
ELSE
	RETURN False
END IF



end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);
IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''

END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+String(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, string as_dmmc);//取对照表GY_DMZD中的，不同DMLB的，DMMC的医保对照
//如 药品的剂型 ml 获取对应的医保对照信息
if UPPER(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' then
	return ''
end if

ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.find("Upper(tname)='" + UPPER(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + string(as_dmlb) + " and Upper(dmmc) ='"+Upper(as_dmmc)+"'",1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then

	return ids_dmzd_dz.object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
else
	if as_dmlb  = '1404' then return ''
	return '无'
end if
end function
