public function integer uf_czy_zx (string as_ygdm[], ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_zc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:台州市医保操作员注销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_ygdm[]	本院内部员工代码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	wy		日期: 2019.02.11
//====================================================================
//20210726zbq
Long ll_row ,ll_index
String ls_success
u_datastore lds_ygdm
lds_ygdm = Create u_datastore

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_err = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
lds_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
lds_ygdm.DataObject = 'd_ygdm_kz'//表已改
lds_ygdm.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
IF lds_ygdm.Retrieve(as_ygdm ) < 1 THEN
	as_err = '员工代码不存在，请重新确认' + lds_ygdm.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

ll_row = lds_ygdm.RowCount( )

Long ll_ret,ll_find,ll_row2,ll_index2
String ls_sptdm,ls_ygnm,ls_czyzh
SELECT sbddm In
to :ls_czyzh From XTGL.gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :base_info.UserID Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
IF ls_czyzh = '' Or IsNull(ls_czyzh) THEN
	ls_czyzh = base_info.UserID
END IF
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_row
	This.uf_send_init( '8054')
	ls_ygnm = lds_ygdm.Object.ygdm[ll_index]
	ls_sptdm = lds_ygdm.Object.sbddm[ll_index]
	//9	医疗服务机构编号	string	12	是		
	//10	操作员账号	string	20	是		
	//11	注销原因	string	100	是		
	//12	注销人	string	20	是		
	//13	注销时间	string 	10	是		格式：yyyy-mm-dd
	//uf_send_add('医疗服务机构编号',is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
	uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_sptdm) //3310992000140001
	uf_send_add('注销原因','作废')
	uf_send_add('注销人', ls_czyzh) //ls_czyzh
	uf_send_add('注销时间',String(Today(),'yyyy-mm-dd'))
	
	ls_success += ','+ls_ygnm
	IF Not  This.uf_send( as_err )   THEN  RETURN -1
	
	
	ll_ret = Long( This.uf_getstring( '交易处理结果'))
	IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring( '错误信息') + '错误员工代码:'+ls_ygnm
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ll_find = lds_ygdm.Find( "ygdm = '"+ls_ygnm+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find > 0  THEN
		lds_ygdm.Object.sbddm[ll_find] = ''
	END IF
	
	IF lds_ygdm.Update( ) > 0 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = '已成功注销'+ls_success
	ELSE
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
		as_err = lds_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_qrybjs (string as_knsj, string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh);//20210715zbq修改
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_ret[],ls_sfpzxx
Integer li_ret
Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
Boolean lb_receive
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
Integer li_pos
//ls_xxt = '1~~331022D15600000500007946E24082EDJ00026975~~~~~~331099200014~~台州市妇女儿童医院~~00~~331099~~44734727~~0~~9203~~'


//IF of_splitparm( istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 Then
IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 4 THEN
	ls_sfpzxx = as_knsj
	ls_send = '$$0~~' + as_knsj + '~~~~~~' + is_yljgdm_tzsyd + '~~' + is_yljgmc_tzsyd + '~~00~~' + is_yljgxzqh + '~~' + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
else
	ls_sfpzxx = '' 
	ls_send = '$$1~~' + as_knsj + '~~~~~~' + is_yljgdm_tzsyd + '~~' + is_yljgmc_tzsyd + '~~00~~' + is_yljgxzqh + '~~' + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
end if
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '8008~~'+ls_sfpzxx+'$$'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '8003~~'+ls_sfpzxx+'$$'
END IF
//li_ret = f_UserBargaingApplyV4(8006,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm_tzsyd)
li_ret = f_UserApply_tz(8006, is_yljgdm_tzsyd, ls_send, is_token_tzsbd, ls_recieve)

if upperbound(ls_ret) >= 4 then
	gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,ls_ret[3],istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,ls_ret[4])
end if

// 2021.08.25  CJN  25399  业务确认8006接口的报文解析方式修改
//ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)//$$0~~44734785~$$
//ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾
li_pos = PosW(ls_recieve, "$$")
ls_recieve = MidW(ls_recieve, li_pos+2, Len(ls_recieve))//$$0~~44734785~$$
li_pos = PosW(ls_recieve, "$$", li_pos+2)
ls_recieve = MidW(ls_recieve,1, li_pos - 1) //去掉$$开头以及结尾



li_pos = PosW(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(MidW(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF PosW(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = MidW(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  PosW(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = MidW(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(MidW(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = MidW(ls_recieve,li_pos + 2)
END IF
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
as_qrjslsh = MidW(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1)
IF isnull(as_qrjslsh) or Len(Trim(as_qrjslsh))<=0 Then
	as_error = '业务确认失败，确认交易流水号为空！'
	return -1
ELSEIF not isnumber(trim(as_qrjslsh)) then //Len(Trim(as_qrjslsh))<>9 Then
	as_error = '业务确认失败，确认交易流水号有误：' + as_qrjslsh
	return -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

		FROM JKXT.tzyb_jsmx_sbd
	Where JSSJ >= to_date(:ls_jssj,'yyyymmdd') And JSSJ < SYSDATE And YWLX IN ('SF','GH') And JYID = :as_ywlsh And ztbz = 3 Using itran_sqlca;

private function integer uf_syd_mxsc (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref decimal adc_ywlsh, ref string as_error, str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_syd_mxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:省异地业务数据明细上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_knsj  	
// 	value    	string 	as_brbm  	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jslx  	
// 	value    	string 	as_jylx   业务类型	
// 	value    	string 	as_jydd  	
// 	reference	decimal	adc_ywlsh	业务流水号
// 	reference	string 	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zf		日期: 2020.01.07
//====================================================================

							SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And YWMXXH = :ldc_ywmxxh And ywlx = 'YJ' And ztbz >= 0 ;

						END IF
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							//需要备案没有备案的都强制自费;考虑到干部保健和离休不需要备案，如果审批成公费的则按公费 
							//	29号交易收费项目列表新增字段21：备案号modify by sxl 2015-7-7
							IF astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 2 Or astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 9

					END IF

				IF (astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 1 Or astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.SPBZ[j] = 9) and ii_zfbmqy = 1  THEN

					ELSE

							ls_ybbm = is_zf_cl
						ELSE
							ls_ybbm = is_zf_zl
						END IF
					END IF
					//					IF ids_ylsf.Object.fygb[ll_find] = 70 THEN
					//						ls_ybbm = is_zf_cl
					//					ELSE
					//						ls_ybbm = is_zf_zl

					This.uf_send_add_in('预留字段3','',j)

				//					IF ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报

	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
	as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
	IF  This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息') > ''  THEN
		as_error = as_error + This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息')
	END IF
	RETURN -1
END IF
//结算流水号	string	30	是		
//规定病结算标志	string	3	是		参考数字字典规定病结算标志
//提示标记	string	1	是		预留，默认给0
//提示信息	string	200	否		预留
//交易结算时间	date	20	是		格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss
//计算结果信息	composite				详见下面计算结果信息结构体参数说明
//收费项目明细自负信息	composite				只返回就医地上传的参考自负比例与参保地自负比例不一致的费用明细列表；详见下面收费项目明细自负信息结构体参数说明
//有误收费项目明细返回信息	composite				详见下面有误收费项目明细结构体参数说明
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.ywlx = ls_ghsf
//astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')
String ls_jslsh
ls_jslsh = This.uf_getstring('结算流水号')

astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj = This.uf_getdatetime( '交易结算时间')
IF Date(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jyjssj = ldt_now
END IF
of_get_syb_jsxx(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb)
istr_yb_jsxx_syb = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	IF ldc_jjzf <> astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje THEN
		as_error = '预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致'
		IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_now, is_jylsh, '8003', ls_cbdxzqh, ls_error) > 0 THEN
			as_error = '预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致;已作废'
		ELSE
			as_error = '预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.hjbxje)+'的金额不一致;作废失败' +ls_error
		END IF
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
 //台州多一步交易确认
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jzbh =  ls_jslsh
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb.jylsh =  ls_jslsh
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_ybfymx_sc.RowCount( )
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzbh[ll_row] = ls_jslsh
		NEXT
		IF of_insert_jymx( as_brbm,  0,	0, astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh,ls_ghsf,as_jydd,ls_yllb,ls_gdbdm, ls_jslsh,astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
		ELSE
			as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		String ls_qrjslsh
		IF This.uf_qrybjs( as_knsj, ls_ghsf, ls_jslsh, as_error, ls_qrjslsh) > 0 THEN
			This.of_update_jsmx( ls_qrjslsh, astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx_syb, as_error)
		ELSE
			RETURN -1
		END IF

END IF
Long ll_findmzfymx
ll_rowcount = 0
ll_rowcount = uf_getstring_mxnr('收费项目明细自负信息')
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ll_findmzfymx = 0
	ls_mxxh = uf_getstring_in('明细序号',ll_row)
	ll_findmzfymx = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Find("getrow()="+String(ls_mxxh),1,99999)
	IF ll_findmzfymx > 0 THEN
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('正确的自负比例',ll_row)
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_findmzfymx] = uf_getdecimal_in('合计自负',ll_row)
	END IF
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自费金额（包括超限金额）',ll_row)
	//	uf_getdecimal_in('自理金额',ll_row)
	//	uf_getstring_in('超限说明',ll_row)
NEXT
RETURN 1




end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb_jbbm (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM' or  Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
IF ib_tzsyd = True And Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM' THEN //WANGYI 20191011 诊断为体检，返回空，不让结算医保
	IF Pos(is_tjzddm,as_tjlxh) > 0 THEN
		RETURN ''
	END IF
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlb, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zdmc, ref string as_zddms[], ref string as_zdmcs[], ref string as_ryzd);//住院病人诊断信息
//ai_zdlb 用于判断是获取入院诊断还是出院诊断 1入院   2出院  3生育
//as_ryzd 为入院主诊断，出院主诊断
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "zdlb asc")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF

Long ll_row,ll_sypb = 0
String ls_sybm
IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
		as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	ELSE
		as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	END IF
	as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	as_zdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	
	IF ai_zdlb = 3 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 to ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
			ls_sybm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'GY_JBBM_SY',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row] ) )
			IF ls_sybm = '无' THEN
			ELSE
				ll_sypb = 1
				as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row]))
				as_zddm1 = ls_sybm + ',' + as_zddm1
				as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_row])
				as_zdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_row])
				EXIT
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = ''
	as_ryzd = ''
	as_zdmc = ''
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() = 0 THEN
	as_zdmc = ''
	as_ryzd = '健康体检--无诊断'
	as_zddm1 = 'Z00.001'
END IF
IF as_ryzd = '' Or IsNull(as_ryzd) THEN
	as_ryzd = '诊断为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 2  THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_count
		ll_zds ++
		IF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
		ELSE
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
		END IF
		as_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
		as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
	NEXT
END IF

IF ai_zdlb = 3 and ll_sypb = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200312 生育
	as_ryzd = '没有生育对照的诊断，不能医保生育登记！'
	RETURN -1
END IF


IF Len(as_zdmc) >= 100 THEN
	as_zdmc = of_midstring(as_zdmc,99)
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_yljg_rdz (date adt_dzr, string as_dzlx, ref string as_err);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_yljg_rdz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date  	adt_dzr 	
// 	value    	string	as_dzlx 	0：全部 2：省内跨市就医，3：跨省住院就医，4：跨省门诊就医，5：罕见病门诊
// 	reference	string	as_err  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx	日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
//数据库连接准备
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_err  = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jyzqh,ls_err,ls_czy_sptbm,ls_cbd_2
Date ldt_dzr
DateTime ldt_dzr_start ,ldt_dzr_end
ldt_dzr = Date(adt_dzr)
ldt_dzr_start = DateTime(ldt_dzr,Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_dzr_end = DateTime(ldt_dzr,Time('23:59:59'))
ls_cbd_2 = left(is_sbyxzqh,2)
is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
//ldc_zffy 自费费用  zffy2 自负费用
Dec ldc_ylfze,ldc_zlfy,ldc_zffy,ldc_zffy2,ldc_xjzf
Long ll_row

Dec ldc_fyze,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_grxjzf,ldc_bxje,ldc_tcjjzf,ldc_wnzhzf,ldc_dnzhzf,ldc_dbjzzf,ldc_gwybzzf,ldc_eyjjzf,ldc_lxjjzf,ldc_lmjjzf,ldc_bzjjzf,ldc_mzbzjj,ldc_yfjzjj,ldc_syjjzf
Long ll_jsjlts,ll_ybmxjsjlts //结算记录条数，医保明细结算记录条数
//统计本地金额信息lsyb_jsmx
IF ib_tzsyd = True THEN
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(yljzjj),sum(yfbz),sum(sbjjzf)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfjzjj,:ldc_syjjzf
		FROM  JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SbD
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '0' THEN //全部日对账
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16'  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '2' THEN //省内跨市就医
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) = :ls_cbd_2  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_dzlx = '3' THEN //跨省住院就医
	SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
		sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(mzbzjj)
		INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) <> :ls_cbd_2 and ywlx ='ZY' Using itran_sqlca;

		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb <> '16' and substr(cbdxzqh,1,2) <> :ls_cbd_2 and ywlx <> 'ZY'  Using itran_sqlca;

		:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj
		FROM  JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		Where ztbz > 0 And jssj >= :ldt_dzr_start  And jssj <= :ldt_dzr_end And yllb='16' Using itran_sqlca;
END IF

//	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From JKXT.tzyb_dzxx  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2'   Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From JKXT.tzyb_dzxx_sbd  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2'   Using itran_sqlca;
IF ll_row > 0 THEN //存在记录则新增，否则理解为帐未平或失败，重新发起对账
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd SET dzsj = sysdate ,
		jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
		DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf  = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj
		Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2'   Using itran_sqlca;
	ls_err_temp = '本地对账信息更新数据失败'
ELSE
	INSERT INTO jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd(dzsj,jsjlts ,YBMXJSJLTS ,fyze, zfze , zlze, grxjzf, bxje, tcjjzf , wnzhzf, DNZHZF,dbjzzf, gwybzzf, eyjjzf , lxjjzf, lmjjzf , bzjjzf, mzbzjj 		,czyzh,dzlsh,dzrq,dzlx,ywlx)
		VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj 		,'','0',:ldt_dzr,'2',0) Using itran_sqlca;
	ls_err_temp  = '本地对账信息插入数据失败'
END IF
	
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_err  = ls_err_temp + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
		
String ls_dzjg,ls_bz,ls_dz_ret
//准备发起对账

IF uf_send(as_err) = True THEN
	IF Long(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果')) < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF

	ls_bz = This.uf_getstring('对帐不一致信息') //备注

		ls_bz = '对账结果一致'
	ELSEIF ls_dzjg = '-1' THEN
		
	END IF

		UPDATE JKXT.tzyb_dzxx_sbd Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And dzlx = '2' Using itran_sqlca;// :as_dzlx

//	END IF

public function integer of_zy_fymx_fycxcf (long al_zyh, ref string as_msg);//wangyi 20200820 指禗AT*
ǚ延贸�限拆分of_zy_fymx_fycxcf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl, ldc_fyxe, ldc_yhje, ldc_yhdj, ldc_yhcfje
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_zflj_cq //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

//拆分限额超限费用。限额设置取自GY_YLSF_KZ.zycxzfxe
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_fycxcf_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0, fyxe。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的限额控制费用有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ldc_fyxe = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxe[ll_row]
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		ldc_yhje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		ldc_yhdj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) / ldc_fysl //计算加上优惠金额
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未矰AT*
�过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
//						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_yhcfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限强制自费', 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用限额控制,退费先自费', 100)
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_yhcfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF lds_fymx_cf.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	as_msg = "住院费用明细zy_fymx保存失败。" + lds_fymx_cf.is_error
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_cf (long al_zyh, ref string as_msg);//复制u_ybjk_new_his.of_zy_fymx_cf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_fylj_cg, ldc_fylj_cl
Decimal{2} ldc_zflj_cq, ldc_zflj_cg, ldc_zflj_cl //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

idc_zgxe_cq = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CQDXLJZGXE", "30000", "分类编码为CQ的医用材料单项累计最高限额"))
idc_zgxe_cg = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CGDXLJZGXE", "20000", "分类编码为CG的医用材料单项累计最高限额"))
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then idc_zgxe_cl = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CLLJZGXE", "40000", "分类编码为CL的医用材料累计最高限额"))    // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  获取CL材料最高限额

//Long ll_brxz, ll_tgdw
//SELECT brxz, tgdw Into :ll_brxz, :ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
//	as_msg = "该病人的参保性质获取失败。"
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

//IF ll_brxz = 6024 And ll_tgdw = 3003 THEN
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_LXBRCWF", "55", "离休病人床位费记账金额")) //离休病人床位费记账55元
//ELSE
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_PTBRCWF", "45", "普通病人床位费记账金额")) //普通病人床蜠AT*
45元
//END IF

//拆分CQ类医用材料费用。先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，单项累计最高限额为3万。
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cq_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CQ类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

//拆分CG类医用材料费用。先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，单项累计最高限额为2万。
u_datastore lds_fymx_cg //未上传明细未结算的CG类的住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cg = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cg.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cg_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cg.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cg.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cg //已上传明细未结算的CG类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cg = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cg.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cg_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计礑AT*
姆延孟薅睿
(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cg.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cg.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cg_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CG类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cg_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cg.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cg.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cg.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cg.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cg.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cg.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cg = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl)  THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费��累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cg > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cg
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  拆分CL类医用材料费用
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then
	//拆分CL类医用材料费用。单价在200元以上的，先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，累计最高限额为4万。
	u_datastore lds_fymx_cl //未上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymx_cl = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymx_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cl_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新增BM字段
	lds_fymx_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ll_count = lds_fymx_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)

	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl //已上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
		lds_fymxsc_cl = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_syd' //bm, fyje（CL类已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新訢AT*
鯞M字段，并对BM字段进行GroupBy
		lds_fymxsc_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CG类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_tf_syd'  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 强制自费金额减去优惠金额
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
		
		
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ls_bm = lds_fymx_cl.Object.bm[ll_row]
			ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
			ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
			ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
			ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
			ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
			li_spbz = lds_fymx_cl.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
			IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0         // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)  
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
						ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
					END IF
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//					ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//					IF IsNull(ldc_fylj_cl) THEN
//						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
//						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
//					END IF
					IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
//						ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
//						ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//							IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//							END IF
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
							ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
							IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
							END IF
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制譊AT*
苑眩瑂pbz = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
						ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + ldc_xelj
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
					ELSE
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_msg = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						IF ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
							ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zfje
							lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						ELSE
							IF ldc_zflj_cl > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
								ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
								IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
									ls_bz = ''
								END IF
								lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
								
								ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cl
								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//								IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//									ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//								END IF
								ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//								ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
//								lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计(1-zfbl)*zjje
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//								ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
//								lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							END IF
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_msg = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF
//拆分床位费。床位费超过限额部分强制自费。普通病人记账45元，离休病人记账55元。离休配偶算在普通病人中。

end function
