public function integer uf_czy_qrqc (date ad_qdrq, string as_czybm, long ai_qrqc, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his.uf_czy_qrqc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date   	ad_qdrq 	签到日期
// 	value    	string 	as_czybm	操作员编码
// 	value    	string 	as_qrlb 	签入类别 0通用 1门诊 2住院
// 	value    	string 	ai_qrqc 	1 签入  2签出
// 	reference	integer	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	hlx	日期: 2017.04.12
//====================================================================
//if ii_sfqr = 0 then return 1
//20210715zbq修改
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_error = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Integer li_Ztbz,li_count
Date ldt_qdrq
DateTime ldt_qdrq_temp,ldt_qdsj
Int ll_ret
String ls_jyzqh,ls_temp,ls_time[],ls_sptbm,ls_sptbm_tz
//ii_sfqr 用于是否启用省异地签入签出
SELECT sybdm,sbddm Into :ls_sptbm,:ls_sptbm_tz From xtgl.gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :as_czybm Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0   THEN
	as_error =  '获取员工扩展信息失败：' + as_czybm +' sqlcode:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF IsNull(ls_sptbm_tz) Or Trim(ls_sptbm_tz) = '' THEN
	as_error = '操作员'+'('+as_czybm+')'+'在市平台未注册，请先进行注册！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_sptbm = ls_sptbm_tz




IF ai_qrqc = 1 THEN
	//time1与time2之间不进行签出提醒
	Time lt_time1,lt_time2
	ls_temp = gf_getpara_eas(itran_sqlca,5,'SFYQCSJ','','操作员不进行对账，签退时间段') //gf_getpara(5,'SFYQCSJ','','操作员不进行对账，签退时间段')
	//lt_time1 = time(left(ls_temp,pos(ls_temp,','
	gu_char.uf_splitparm( ls_temp, ls_time)
	IF UpperBound(ls_time) < 2 THEN
	ELSE
		lt_time1 = Time(ls_time[1])
		lt_time2 = Time(ls_time[2])
	END IF
	
	ldt_qdrq = ad_qdrq
	
	SELECT qdrq Into :ldt_qdrq_temp From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Where  czybm = :as_czybm And ztbz < 3 Order By jlxh Desc  Using itran_sqlca;//20210715zbq表已改
	
	//签到日期已隔天
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0  THEN
		IF RelativeDate(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),il_czyqdcs) < ldt_qdrq THEN
			IF Time(Now()) < lt_time1 And Time(Now()) > lt_time2  THEN
				ldt_qdrq = Date(ldt_qdrq_temp)
			ELSE
				as_error = '上次('+String(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),'yyyy-mm-dd')+')签入未签出,请先对账并签退!'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//	date ld_qdrq
	//是否需要判断哪天未签出
	//	select qdrq into :ld_qdrq from jkxt.sydyb_czy_qrqc wherec qdrq < :ad_qdrq and zybm = :base_info.UserID and ztbz >= 1 And QRLB = :as_qrlb order by qdrq desc Using itran_sqlca; 
	//	if not isnull(ld_qdrq) and ld_qdrq > date(2000,1,1) then
	//		is_jyzqh = ''
	//		as_error = String(ld_qdrq,'YYYYMMDD') + '操作员还未对账或签出,请先对账或签出!'
	//		RETURN -1
	//	end if
	//	ldt_qdrq
	
	SELECT ztbz,jyzqh Into :li_Ztbz,:ls_jyzqh From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Where qdrq = :ldt_qdrq_temp And czybm = :as_czybm    And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
//20210715zbq已改
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '查询签入记录失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		
		INSERT Into jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd(czybm,qdrq,ztbz,sptbm) Values (:as_czybm,:ldt_qdrq,0,:ls_sptbm) Using itran_sqlca;
		//20210715zbq表已改
		
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = '插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
		
		This.uf_send_init('8052')
		
		This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_sptbm)
		//This.uf_send_add('签到类型',as_qrlb)
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			ll_ret = Integer (This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果'))
			IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
				as_error = '社保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
			is_jyzqh = This.uf_getstring('日对帐流水号') //交易周期号
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			
			UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq  And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			//20210715zbq表已改
			
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '交易周期号:' +is_jyzqh + ';更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		ELSE
			is_jyzqh = ''
			as_error = '操作员签入失败:' + as_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_Ztbz = 0 THEN
		This.uf_send_init('8052')
		
		//覆盖消息头中操作员编码
		
		
		This.uf_send_add('操作员誅AT* ',ls_sptbm)
		//	This.uf_send_add('签到类型',as_qrlb)
		
		IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
			ll_ret = Integer (This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果'))
			IF ll_ret < 0 THEN
				as_error = '社保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			is_jyzqh = This.uf_getstring('日对帐流水号') //交易周期号
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
		ELSE
			IF Pos(as_error,'已经签入' ) > 0 And Pos(as_error,'签入周期号为') > 0 THEN
				is_jyzqh = Mid(as_error,Pos(as_error,'签入周期号为') + 26)
			ELSE
				is_jyzqh = ''
				as_error = '操作员签入失败:' + as_error
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		IF is_jyzqh > '' THEN
			ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('签到时间')
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			
			UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Set ztbz = 1,qrsj = :ldt_qdsj ,jyzqh = :is_jyzqh,sptbm = :ls_sptbm Where czybm = :as_czybm And qdrq = :ldt_qdrq   And ztbz <> 3 Using itran_sqlca;
			
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '交易周期号:' +is_jyzqh + ';更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_Ztbz = 1 THEN //已签到,再调用该函数时,则给实例变量赋直
		is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
	END IF
	
END IF


RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_czy_rdz_tz (date adt_dzr, string as_czybm, ref string as_err);//台州操作员日对账
//20210726zbq
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_err  = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jyzqh,ls_err,ls_czy_sptbm
Date ldt_dzr
ldt_dzr = Date(adt_dzr)

SELECT jyzqh,sptbm  Into :ls_jyzqh,:ls_czy_sptbm From jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr  And czybm = :as_czybm  And ztbz = 1  Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
IF ls_jyzqh = '' Or IsNull(ls_jyzqh) THEN
	as_err = '未取得操作员('+as_czybm+')'+'对应的交易周期号'
	RETURN -1
END IF

is_jyzqh = ls_jyzqh
//ldc_zffy 自费费用  zffy2 自负费用
Dec ldc_ylfze,ldc_zlfy,ldc_zffy,ldc_zffy2,ldc_xjzf
Long ll_row

Dec ldc_fyze,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_grxjzf,ldc_bxje,ldc_tcjjzf,ldc_wnzhzf,ldc_dnzhzf,ldc_dbjzzf,ldc_gwybzzf,ldc_eyjjzf,ldc_lxjjzf,ldc_lmjjzf,ldc_bzjjzf,ldc_mzbzjj,ldc_yfbzjj,ldc_syjjzf
Long ll_jsjlts,ll_ybmxjsjlts //结算记录条数，医保明细结算记录条数
//统计本地金额信息lsyb_jsmx
//select sum(ylzfy),sum(zlfy),sum(zffy ),sum(zffy2),sum(xjzf),SUM(hjbxje) into :ldc_ylfze,:ldc_zlfy,:ldc_zffy,:ldc_zffy2,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_bxje from jkxt.sydyb_jsmx where czybm = :as_czybm and jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh and ywlx = :as_ywlx using itran_sqlca;
SELECT count(1) ,sum(JSTS) ,sum(fyze),sum(zfze),sum(zlze),sum(grxjzf),sum(hjbxje),sum(tcjjzf),sum(wnzhzf),
	sum(dnzhzf),sum(dbjzzf),sum(gwybzzf),sum(eyjjzf),sum(lxjjzf),sum(lmjjzf),sum(bzjjzf),sum(yljzjj),sum(yfbz),sum(SYJJZF) //sum(yljzjj),sum(yfbz),sum(SYJJZF) 字段修改
	INTO :ll_jsjlts,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,
	:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfbzjj,:ldc_syjjzf
	FROM  JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SbD
	Where ztbz > 0 And dzlsh = :ls_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
// and ywlx = :as_ywlx
//查询本地对账信息表中，是否存在记录lsyb_dzxx 
SELECT count(1) Into :ll_row From jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd  Where  dzrq  = :ldt_dzr  And  czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表已改

IF IsNull(ll_jsjlts ) THEN  ll_jsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ll_ybmxjsjlts) THEN  ll_ybmxjsjlts = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_fyze) THEN  ldc_fyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zfze ) THEN  ldc_zfze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zlze) THEN  ldc_zlze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_grxjzf) THEN  ldc_grxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_bxje) THEN  ldc_bxje = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tcjjzf) THEN  ldc_tcjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_wnzhzf) THEN  ldc_wnzhzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_dnzhzf) THEN  ldc_dnzhzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_dbjzzf) THEN  ldc_dbjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gwybzzf) THEN  ldc_gwybzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_eyjjzf) THEN  ldc_eyjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lxjjzf) THEN  ldc_lxjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_lmjjzf) THEN  ldc_lmjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_bzjjzf) THEN  ldc_bzjjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_mzbzjj) THEN  ldc_mzbzjj = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_yfbzjj) THEN  ldc_yfbzjj = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_syjjzf) THEN  ldc_syjjzf = 0

//插入对账信息表，本地数据
IF ll_row > 0 THEN //存在记录则新增，否则理解为帐未平或失败，重新发起对账
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd SET dzsj = sysdate ,
		jsjlts = :ll_jsjlts , ybmxjsjlts  = :ll_ybmxjsjlts ,fyze = :ldc_fyze, zfze  = :ldc_zfze , zlze  = :ldc_zlze, grxjzf  = :ldc_grxjzf, bxje = :ldc_bxje, tcjjzf = :ldc_tcjjzf, wnzhzf  = :ldc_wnzhzf,
		DNZHZF = :ldc_dnzhzf, dbjzzf = :ldc_dbjzzf, gwybzzf  = :ldc_gwybzzf, eyjjzf = :ldc_eyjjzf, lxjjzf  = :ldc_lxjjzf, lmjjzf = :ldc_lmjjzf, bzjjzf = :ldc_bzjjzf, mzbzjj  = :ldc_mzbzjj, 
		yfjzjj = :ldc_yfbzjj, syjjzf = :ldc_syjjzf
		Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr  And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :is_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	INSERT INTO jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd(dzsj,jsjlts ,YBMXJSJLTS ,fyze, zfze , zlze, grxjzf, bxje, tcjjzf , wnzhzf, DNZHZF,dbjzzf, gwybzzf, eyjjzf , lxjjzf, lmjjzf , bzjjzf, mzbzjj,yfjzjj 		,syjjzf,czyzh,dzlsh,dzrq,dzlx,ywlx )
		VALUES(sysdate ,:ll_jsjlts ,:ll_ybmxjsjlts,:ldc_fyze,:ldc_zfze ,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_grxjzf,:ldc_bxje,:ldc_tcjjzf,:ldc_wnzhzf,:ldc_dnzhzf,:ldc_dbjzzf,:ldc_gwybzzf,:ldc_eyjjzf,:ldc_lxjjzf,:ldc_lmjjzf,:ldc_bzjjzf,:ldc_mzbzjj,:ldc_yfbzjj 		,:ldc_syjjzf,:ls_czy_sptbm,:ls_jyzqh,:ldt_dzr,'1' ,0 ) Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_err  = '本地对账信息插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
END IF


String ls_dzjg,ls_bz,ls_dz_ret
//准备发起对账
This.uf_send_init('8053')
This.uf_send_add('对帐日期',String(adt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd') )
This.uf_send_add('操作员账号',ls_czy_sptbm)
This.uf_send_add('对帐流水号',ls_jyzqh)
 
This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '对帐信息')
This.uf_send_add_in('结算记录条数', ll_jsjlts ,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('医保明细结算记录条数', ll_ybmxjsjlts,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('费用总额', ldc_fyze,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('自费总额（非医保）', ldc_zfze ,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('自理总额（目录内自负比例部分）', ldc_zlze,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('个人现金支付', ldc_grxjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('报销金额', ldc_bxje,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('统筹基金支付', ldc_tcjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('往年帐户支付', ldc_wnzhzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('当年帐户支付', ldc_dnzhzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('大病救助支付', ldc_dbjzzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('公务员补助支付', ldc_gwybzzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('二乙基金支付', ldc_eyjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('离休基金支付', ldc_lxjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('劳模基金支付', ldc_lmjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('补助基金支付', ldc_bzjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('医疗救助基金', ldc_mzbzjj,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('优抚补助基金', ldc_yfbzjj,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('生育基金支付', ldc_syjjzf,1)
This.uf_send_add_in('预留字段1', '',1)
This.uf_send_add_in('预留字段2', '',1)
This.uf_send_add_in('预留字段3', '',1)
This.uf_send_add_in('预留字段4', '',1)


IF uf_send(as_err) = True THEN
	IF Long(This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果')) < 0 THEN
		as_err = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_dzjg = This.uf_getstring('对账结果标志') //对账结果
	ls_bz = This.uf_getstring('对帐不一致信息') //备注
	String ls_ztbz
	IF ls_dzjg = '1' THEN
		ls_bz = '对账结果一致'
	ELSEIF ls_dzjg = '-1' THEN
		
	END IF
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_dzxx_sbd Set dzjgbz = :ls_dzjg ,dzbyzxx = :ls_bz,dzsj = sysdate Where dzrq = :ldt_dzr And czyzh = :ls_czy_sptbm And dzlsh = :ls_jyzqh  Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
	as_err  = '对账结果:'+ls_dz_ret+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
as_err = ls_dz_ret
IF ls_dzjg <> '1' THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	UPDATE jkxt.tzyb_czy_qrqc_sbd Set ztbz = '3',qcsj = sysdate Where qdrq = :ldt_dzr  And czybm = :as_czybm And jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh Using itran_sqlca;//表已改
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
		as_err  = '对账结果:通过!'+'(操作员编码：'+as_czybm +'对账日:'+String(ldt_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd')+');本地更新数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
END IF


RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxtf (long al_zyh, decimal adc_fymxjlxh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his_tz.uf_zy_mxtf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院明细退费
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long   	al_zyh      	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_fymxjlxh	
// 	reference	string 	as_error    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	cjn		日期: 2021.08.02
//====================================================================
String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm,ls_mxxhlb,ls_fysl, ls_bcgyy
Long ll_cnt ,ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh  From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 2;
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;
Select fysl into :ls_fysl From bqxt.zy_fymx where zyh=:al_zyh and jlxh=:adc_fymxjlxh Using sqlca;

IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的就诊编号信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF  ls_fysl > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的费用明细序号!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF

uf_send_init('8013')
this.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡信息', '')
uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)	
uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '要退费的明细序号列表')
This.uf_send_add_in( '要退费的费用明细序号', String(adc_fymxjlxh), 1)
This.uf_send_add_in( '要退费得药品/诊疗数量', ls_fysl, 1)


String ls_cbd
ls_cbd = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
IF IsNull(ls_cbd) Or ls_cbd = '' THEN
	ls_cbd = '339900'
END IF
IF uf_send(as_error,0,ls_cbd) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0'  THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ll_cnt = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( '退费不成功的明细序号列表')
	IF ll_cnt > 0 THEN
		ls_bcgyy = this.uf_getString('不成功的原因')
		as_error = '费用明细退费失败，失败原因：'+ls_bcgyy
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		DELETE From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where zyh=:al_zyh and jlxh=:adc_fymxjlxh  Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
		Delete From jkxt.tzyb_fymxsc_sbd Where zyh = :al_zyh and ywlsh=:adc_fymxjlxh And ztbz = 0  Using gtrans_temp_mssql; 
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		ELSE
			as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer uf_ygyb_jzxx (string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, decimal ad_ghlsh, ref string as_return);IF uf_set_instance(as_return ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init_ygyb('3100')
String ls_sfzh,ls_ybkh,ls_sbkh,ls_SBKSBH,ls_cbrxzqh
Long ll_jslb
IF ad_zyh > 0 THEN
	SELECT brxz,knxx,sbhm,ybkh,zhbz,sfzh Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_cbrxzqh,:ls_sbkh,:ls_SBKSBH,:ls_sfzh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ad_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ls_SBKSBH) Or ls_SBKSBH = '' THEN
		ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
	
END IF
ELSE
	SELECT jslb,jzkh,sfzh Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_sfzh From mzxt.mz_Brda Where brbm = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
	ls_sbkh = Right(ls_ybkh,9)
	ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
	IF  istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_sbkh THEN
		ls_cbrxzqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
	ELSE
		ls_cbrxzqh = Left(ls_ybkh,6)
	END IF
END IF
integer li_ybpb
select ybpb into :li_ybpb from xtgl.gy_brxz where brxz = :ll_jslb using itran_sqlca;
if li_ybpb <> 1 then
	as_return = '非医保病菵AT* '
	return 1
end if
istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ls_sbkh + '-' + ls_SBKSBH
istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH = ls_SBKSBH
istr_jytsrx.sfzh  = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh
istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH = String(ad_ghlsh)
istr_jytsrx.cbrxzqh = ls_cbrxzqh
This.uf_send_add( 'SFZH', ls_sfzh)
RETURN This.uf_send_ygyb( as_return)

end function

public function integer uf_ybyg_mzsh (datastore ads_yzmx, str_ygyb_jzxx astr_ygyb_jzxx, string as_brbm, string as_ywlx, ref string as_return);return 1
IF uf_set_instance(as_return ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF ads_yzmx.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_return = '明细为空'
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
	IF ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_cfmx' THEN
		as_return = '处方ads_yzmx的dataobject:有误'+ String(ads_yzmx.DataObject)
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
	IF ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_yjk2_list' And ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
		as_return = '医技ads_yzmx的dataobject:有误'+ String(ads_yzmx.DataObject)
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF

String ls_sfzh,ls_ybkh,ls_sbkh,ls_SBKSBH,ls_cbrxzqh
Long ll_jslb,ll_find
Integer li_ybpb,li_brxb
SELECT jslb,jzkh,sfzh,brxb Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_sfzh,:li_brxb From mzxt.mz_Brda Where brbm = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_brxb <> 1 And li_brxb <> 2 THEN li_brxb = -1
ls_sbkh = Right(ls_ybkh,9)
ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_sbkh THEN
	as_return = '未正确获取病人医保账户信息，请重新读卡再试'
	RETURN 1
END IF
ls_cbrxzqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm
SELECT ybpb Into :li_ybpb From xtgl.gy_brxz Where brxz = :ll_jslb Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_ybpb <> 1 THEN
	as_return = '非医保病人'
	RETURN 1
END IF

String ls_ysbm,ls_brxm,ls_ysxx,ls_yzid,ls_zw,ls_ksbm,ls_yllb = '12'
DateTime ldt_now,ldt_csny
Long ll_row,ll_count,ll_ygjb,ll_ygzw,ll_fyxh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ldc_ybnje,ldc_zje,ldc_ybje,ldc_sl
dec{4} ldc_dj,ldc_zfbl
Dec{0} ldc_ghlsh,ldc_ywlsh
ldt_csny = Datetime(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.csrq, Time(String('00:00:00', 'hh:mm:ss')))
ls_brxm = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm
ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
ldc_ghlsh = astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh
ls_ysbm = astr_ygyb_jzxx.ysgh
ls_ysxx =  of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'MZ_KS',astr_ygyb_jzxx.KSBM  )+'|'+ astr_ygyb_jzxx.ysxm
ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'MZ_KS',astr_ygyb_jzxx.KSBM )
ls_yllb = astr_ygyb_jzxx.jzlx
//12	普通门诊
//	15	门诊特殊病
//	42	工伤康复
//	43	老工伤复发
//	51	生育门诊
select ygjb,ygzw into :ll_ygjb,:ll_ygzw from gy_ygdm where ygdm = :ls_ysbm using itran_sqlca;
if isnull(ll_ygjb) then
	ll_ygjb =1
else
	choose case right(string(ll_ygjb),1)
		case '1'
			ll_ygjb = 4
		case '2'
			ll_ygjb = 3
		case '3'
			ll_ygjb = 2
		case else
			ll_ygjb = 1
	end choose
end if
if not isnull(ll_ygzw) then
	select dmmc into :ls_zw from xtgl.gy_dmzd where dmlb=26 and dmsb=:ll_ygzw using itran_sqlca;
end if
if isnull(ls_zw) or ls_zw ='' then ls_zw = '0'
string ls_yyxmmc,ls_ypzllb,ls_jbbm,ls_jylx,ls_ybbm,ls_sypc
if ls_yllb = '15' then
	ls_jbbm =  istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.mztsbbm
	ls_jylx = 'TSB'
else
	ls_jbbm = ''
	ls_jylx = 'PT'
end if

ll_count = ads_yzmx.RowCount()
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	//获取自付比例
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
			ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.YPXH[ll_row]
		   ls_yzid = String(ldc_ywlsh)+'Y' + String(Integer(ads_yzmx.Object.PXXH[ll_row]))
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(1, ll_fyxh,long(ads_yzmx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]),as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = this.of_get_zfbl(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb, string(ids_typk.object.YPZLLB[ll_find]),  string(ids_typk.object.#2[ll_find]),ls_yllb, ls_yzid, '0', date(ldt_now), ls_jylx, ls_jbbm, as_return)
			IF isnull(ldc_zfbl) or ldc_zfbl < 0 then ldc_zfbl = 1.00
			ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
		else
			IF Lower(ads_yzmx.DataObject) = 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.FYXH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'F' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row])
			ELSE
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.BH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'FF' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row])
			END IF
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(0, ll_fyxh,0,as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 0
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb, string(ids_ylsf.object.YPZLLB[ll_find]) , string(ids_ylsf.object.#2[ll_find]),ls_yllb, ls_yzid, '0', date(ldt_now), ls_jylx, ls_jbbm, as_return)
			if isnull(ldc_zfbl) or ldc_zfbl < 0 then ldc_zfbl= 1
			ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
		end if
	next
	This.uf_send_init_ygyb('3200')
	istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ls_sbkh + '-' + ls_SBKSBH
	istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH = ls_SBKSBH
	istr_jytsrx.sfzh  = ls_sfzh
	istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH = String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh)
	istr_jytsrx.cbrxzqh = ls_cbrxzqh
	
	This.uf_send_add('YSBM', ls_ysbm)
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaimDetailSet')
	ldc_zjje = 0.00
	ldc_ybnje = 0.00
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.cflsh[ll_row]
			ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.YPXH[ll_row]
			ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.ypsl[ll_row]
			ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.ypdj[ll_row]
			ldc_zje = round(dec(ads_yzmx.Object.cfts[ll_row]) * ldc_sl * ldc_dj,2)
		   ls_yzid = String(ldc_ywlsh)+'Y' + String(Integer(ads_yzmx.Object.PXXH[ll_row]))
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(1, ll_fyxh,long(ads_yzmx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]),as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			ls_ybbm = string(ids_typk.object.SNTYBM[ll_find])
			select YPZLSTYBM into :ls_ybbm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml where ypzxlsh = :ls_ybbm using itran_sqlca;
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF003', string(ads_yzmx.Object.cfts[ll_row]), ll_row) //帖数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKA609', ldc_sl, ll_row) //包装数量
			
			if string(ids_typk.object.#13[ll_find]) = '2' then
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '0', ll_row)//		项目类型
				ls_ypzllb = '0'
			else
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '1', ll_row)//		项目类型
				ls_ypzllb = '1'
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
			ldc_ybje = ldc_zje * ( 1 - ldc_zfbl)
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ELIGIBLE_AMOUNT', ldc_ybje, ll_row) //	医保内金额
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', ls_yzid, ll_row) //		   	明细ID
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_ID', ls_ybbm , ll_row)//		项目编码
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_NAME', String(ads_yzmx.Object.ypmc[ll_row]), ll_row)//				项目名称
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'NUMBERS', ldc_sl, ll_row)//			NUMBERS 	数量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'PRICE', ldc_dj, ll_row)//				单价
			ls_sypc = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC',	String(ads_yzmx.Object.GYPC[ll_row]))
			if ls_sypc = '无'  or ls_sypc = '' or isnull(ls_sypc) then
				ls_sypc = '0'
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'FREQUENCY_INTERVAL',ls_sypc , ll_row) //	用药频次	见用药频次字典表，非空
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'Specification', '0', ll_row)//	规格
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE', string(ads_yzmx.Object.dcyl[ll_row]), ll_row)//	 	每次用量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_DAYS', String(ads_yzmx.Object.YYTS[ll_row]), ll_row)//	用药天数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_UNIT',string(ids_typk.object.#7[ll_find]) , ll_row)//包装单位
		
		ELSE
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
			IF Lower(ads_yzmx.DataObject) = 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
				ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.FYXH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'F' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row])
				ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.xmdj[ll_row]
				ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.xmsl[ll_row]
			ELSE
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.BH[ll_row]
				ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'FF' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row])
				ls_yyxmmc = ads_yzmx.Object.pm[ll_row]
				ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.DJ[ll_row]
				ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.sl[ll_row]
			END IF
			ldc_zje = ads_yzmx.Object.zfje[ll_row] + ads_yzmx.Object.jzje[ll_row]
			if isnull(ldc_zje) then
				ldc_zje = round(ldc_sl * ldc_dj,2)
			end if
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(0, ll_fyxh,0,as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF003', '1', ll_row) //帖数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKA609', '1', ll_row) //包装数量
			ldc_zfbl = ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
			ldc_ybje = ldc_zje * ( 1 - ldc_zfbl)
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ELIGIBLE_AMOUNT', ldc_ybje, ll_row) //	医保内金额
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'FREQUENCY_INTERVAL', '61', ll_row) //	用药频次	见用药频次字典表，非空
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', ls_yzid, ll_row) //		   	明细ID
			
			ls_ybbm = string(ids_ylsf.object.SNTYBM[ll_find])
			select YPZLSTYBM into :ls_ybbm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml where ypzxlsh = :ls_ybbm using itran_sqlca;
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_ID', ls_ybbm, ll_row)//	项目编码
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_NAME',ls_yyxmmc, ll_row)//	项目名称
			if string(ids_ylsf.object.#6[ll_find]) = '2' then
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '0', ll_row)//		项目类型
			else
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '1', ll_row)//		项目类型
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'NUMBERS', ldc_sl, ll_row)//数量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'PRICE', ldc_dj, ll_row)//				单价
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'Specification', '0', ll_row)//	规格
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE', '1', ll_row)//	 	每次用量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_DAYS', '1', ll_row)//	用药天数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_UNIT',string(ids_ylsf.object.#4[ll_find]) , ll_row)//				包装单位
		END IF
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ldc_zje
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ApprovalNumber', '0', ll_row) //预留三
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKC227', '0', ll_row) //预留二
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'COSTS', ldc_zje, ll_row) //总费用
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF005', ls_ysbm, ll_row) //医师编码
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'DEPTNAME', ls_ysxx, ll_row) //科室名称|医生姓名；本明细科室名称为心胸外科，医生姓名为李四，应该传值：心胸外科|李四
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_DATE',String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), ll_row) //	服务日期
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'PhysicianLevel', string(ll_ygjb), ll_row) //				医师级别
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_PhysicianAP', ls_zw, ll_row) //				医师行政职务
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ZZZ_Flag', '0', ll_row) //				计费标记
	NEXT
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaim')
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BENEFIT_GROUP_ID', '1', 1) //人员类别
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BENEFIT_TYPE', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BMI_CONVERED_AMOUNT', ldc_ybnje, 1) //医保内金额
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'CKC892', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	//获取诊断
	String ls_zddm,ls_zdmc[],ls_zdms,ls_zdqt_icd[],ls_fzd
	This.of_get_mz_zdxx_ygyb(as_brbm,ldc_ghlsh, ls_ysbm, ls_zddm,ls_zdqt_icd, ls_zdmc, ls_zdms)
	ll_count = UpperBound(ls_zdqt_icd)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			IF ll_row = 1 THEN
				ls_fzd = ls_zdqt_icd[1]
			ELSE
				ls_fzd = '|' + ls_zdqt_icd[ll_row]
			END IF
		NEXT
		ls_zdms = Mid(ls_zdms,1,Pos(ls_zdms,',') - 1)
	ELSE
		ls_fzd = ls_zddm
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_IN', ls_zddm, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_OUT', '', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_TOTHER', ls_fzd, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'GENDER', li_brxb, 1) //性别
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HOSPITAL_ID', is_yljgdm, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HOSPITAL_LEVEL', '4', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_AREA_CODE', ls_ksbm, 1) //HS_AREA_CODE	病区	非空科室对照
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_DIAGNOSIS_IN_NAME', ls_zdms, 1) //入院诊断中文名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_DIAGNOSIS_OUT_NAME', '', 1) //入院诊断中文名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_IN_NUMBER', '', 1)//HS_IN_NUMBER	病案号
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_NUMBER', String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh), 1)//HS_NUMBER	住院号\门诊号
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_PATIENT_NAME', ls_brxm, 1) //姓名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_STATUS', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HospitalType', '1', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh) +'-' +is_yljgdm , 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IN_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IsLactation', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IsPregnant', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'MEDICAL_TYPE', ls_yllb, 1)//就医方式
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'OUT_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'PATIENT_BIRTH', String(ldt_csny,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'PatientBenefitGroupCode','-1', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Patient_IDStr', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.grbh , 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'SETTLE_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'TOTAL_COST', ldc_zjje, 1) //总金额
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'UNUSUAL_FLAG', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_AACT007', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_AACT008', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_BAC021', '0', 1)
	integer li_ret
	li_ret = This.uf_send_ygyb(as_return)
	if li_ret = 3 then
		as_return ='阳光医保审核不合理，请修改！'
		return -1
	else
		return li_ret
	end if
ELSE
	as_return = '无需上传明细'
	RETURN 1
END IF



end function

public function decimal of_get_zfbl (string as_cbrlb, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, ref string as_yzmxxh, string as_dfybz, date adt_jfrq, string as_jylx, string as_jbbm, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_cbrlb 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ypzllb	
// 	value    	string  	as_zxxmbm	
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlb  	
// 	value    	string  	as_tsbbm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_dfybz 	
// 	value    	date	adt_jfrq 	
// 	reference	integer 	ai_sfdj  	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.04.17
//====================================================================
Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
Long ll_ret = -100
IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
	SELECT ZFBL INTO :ldc_zfbl FROM jkxt.tzyb_ypzlzfbl WHERE YPZLBZ = :as_ypzllb AND	YPZLZXBM = :as_zxxmbm Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '获取自付比例和收费等级失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_ret = itran_sqlca.SQLCode
END IF

String ls_jbbm = ''
//IF as_jylx = 'TSB' THEN //特殊病疾病编码
//	ls_jbbm = as_jbbm
//END IF

IF ll_ret = 100 Or as_jylx <> 'PT'  THEN
	This.uf_send_init('8104')
	This.uf_send_add('参保人员类别', as_cbrlb)
	This.uf_send_add('医疗类别',as_ywlb)//as_ywlb
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码',as_jbbm) //7	疾病编码	string	20	否		如果是规定病报销则需要传入规定病编码，其余可为空
	this.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '项目列表')
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱明细序号',as_yzmxxh,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',as_ypzllb,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('项目统一编号',as_zxxmbm,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',as_dfybz,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd'),1)
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	自付比例列表
		//	1)	医嘱明细序号
		// 2)	自付比列
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ldc_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自付比列', 1)
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN ldc_zfbl
end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx_ygyb (string as_brbm, decimal adc_ghlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zddm[], ref string as_zdmcs[], ref string as_zdmc);
IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
	ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_mz_zdxx'
	ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF
IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(as_brbm,adc_ghlsh,as_ysbm) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
as_zdmc = ''
ib_zfzd = false

Long ll_zdlsh
IF ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
	ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[1]
	if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
		as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
		ib_zfzd = true
//		RETURN -2
	end if
	
	as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
	as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = is_mricd10
	as_zdmc = is_mrzdmc
END IF
//1	疾病编码	string	20	否		疾睤AT*
”嗦氩捎肐CD10。
//2	疾病名称	string	300	否		
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 2 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 to ll_count
		//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
		ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_cur]
		if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
			as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]
			ib_zfzd = true
//			RETURN -2
		end if
		
		ll_zds ++
		as_zddm[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
		IF IsNull(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]) THEN ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur] = ''
		as_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]
		as_zdmc = as_zdmc + ',' + ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur] 
	next
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_get_yszgzsbm (string as_ygdm, ref string as_ygxm, ref string as_zgzsbm, ref string as_gjybdm, ref string as_error);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm,'' as zgzsbm, '' as gjybdm from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建员工信息对象失败：" + ids_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='" + as_ygdm + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	as_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	as_zgzsbm = ids_ygdm.Object.zgzsbm[ll_find]
	as_gjybdm = ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find]
	as_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	String ls_ygxm,ls_zgzsbm,ls_gjybdm
	SELECT ygxm Into :ls_ygxm From GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		ls_ygxm = as_ygdm
	END IF
	//	医生证书号,项目贯标编码
	SELECT ZGZSBM,GJYBDM Into :ls_zgzsbm,:ls_gjybdm From XTGL.GY_YGDM_KZ  Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF IsNull(ls_zgzsbm) Or ls_zgzsbm = '' THEN
		SELECT zgzsbm Into :ls_zgzsbm From jkxt.yb_yssb Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_zgzsbm) Or ls_zgzsbm = '' THEN
		as_error = as_ygdm + '医师资格证书编码未维护，请联系医务处!'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_gjybdm) Or ls_gjybdm = '' THEN
		as_error = as_ygdm + '国家医师编码未维护，请先维护!'
		ls_gjybdm = ''
//		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	ids_ygdm.Object.zgzsbm[ll_find] = ls_zgzsbm
	ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find] = ls_gjybdm
	as_ygxm = ls_ygxm
	as_zgzsbm = ls_zgzsbm
	as_gjybdm = ls_gjybdm
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_get_dkfs (ref string as_knsj);		as_knsj+="|"+istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dzpzlp+"|"+istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm+"|"+''+"|"+''
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		as_knsj = as_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
	return 1	
end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his_tz.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 传参加入入院类型和准生证号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_rylx 	
// 	reference	string	as_jzbh 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.08.18   25180
//====================================================================

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_count
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jsrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch //,ls_kssj
String ls_grbh,ls_shsbkh,ls_xzqh,ls_ylbxkh
SELECT KNXX,BRKS,RYRQ,ZYHM,BRCH,BAHM,ZZYS,JSRQ
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ldt_ryrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:ldt_jsrq
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(1900,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ls_knsj = istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj
			ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
	END IF
END IF

return uf_zydj( ls_knsj, ll_ksdm, al_zyh, date(ldt_ryrq), ls_zyhm, ls_brch,ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, as_rylx , as_jzbh, as_error,itran_sqlca, true)

end function

public subroutine uf_set_ykt (boolean ab_ykt);ib_yktdy =  ab_ykt
end subroutine

public function integer of_get_gjbm (string as_ybbm, ref string as_gjbm);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
//	as_gjbm = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_gjm = ''
select gjypbm Into :ls_gjm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml Where   ypzxlsh  = :as_ybbm or ypzlstybm = :as_ybbm  Using itran_sqlca;
if isnull(ls_gjm)  then ls_gjm= ''
IF ls_gjm > '' THEN
	as_gjbm = ls_gjm
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer of_get_jzxlh (ref string as_jzxlh, integer ai_jslx, ref string as_error);Decimal{0} ll_Value
Long ll_Count
Long ll_Retry
//判断事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	Process_Begin:
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	
	UPDATE GY_IDENTITY SET VALUE = VALUE + 1
		Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN // update失败，判断是否存在记录
		SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
			Where TNAME = 'PYYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;

public function integer uf_zhcx_ykt (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);
String ls_sbm,ls_kh,ls_zjh,ls_xm
IF IsNull(as_knsj) Or as_knsj = 'YBDK' Or Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	as_error = '请传入正确卡号，暂不支持电子医保卡和医保电子凭证'
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ls_kh = Right(as_knsj,9)
	ls_sbm = Mid(as_knsj,1,Len(as_knsj) - 9)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm = Left(as_knsj,6)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = as_knsj
	//根据卡号本地获取参保地，证件号，姓名
	This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( )
	SELECT 	brxm,	brxb,		grbh,sfzh,csny,cbdxzqmc,cbdxzqh,cbrlb, tsbdm
		INTO :istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xm,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.xb,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.grbh,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zjh,
		:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.csrq,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhmc,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbdxzqhdm ,
		:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrylb ,:istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.mztsbbm
		From jkxt.yb_Brjbxx Where knsj = :as_knsj Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = as_knsj + "获取账户信息失败：" + String (itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.brnl = Year(Date(gf_server_date ())) -  Year(istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.csrq)
	//	astr_yb_grjbxx.cbddwdm = This.uf_getstring('参保地单位代码')
	//	astr_yb_grjbxx.cbddwmc = This.uf_getstring('参保地单位名称')
	//	astr_yb_grjbxx.cbylxz = This.uf_getstring('参保医疗险种')
	
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.szcs = 1023 //台州市	
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.ryfs = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.kdj =  '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.dnzhdj = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.wnzhdj = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zydj = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.cbrysfyx = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.mzdysfxs = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.zydysfxs = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.gdbdysfxs = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.jtbcdysfxs = '0'
	istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.hmdlx = '00'
END IF

RETURN 1








end function

public function integer uf_receive_ykt (string as_xxtlx, string as_brbm, string ls_ghsf, string as_recxxt, decimal adc_zfje, ref string as_error, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq);This.uf_send_init(as_xxtlx)
string ls_receive,ls_error
long ll_pos,ll_pos2
integer li_ret
ls_receive = as_recxxt
ll_pos = Pos (ls_receive, '~~' , 1 )
IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
	li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_receive,3,ll_pos - 3)) //		交易处理结果	数值型	4	是		0：成功 -1：失败
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		li_ret = 1
	ELSE
		ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_receive, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
		IF ll_pos2 = 0 THEN
			ll_pos2 = Len(ls_receive) - 2
		END IF
		ls_error = Mid(ls_receive,ll_pos + 1,ll_pos2 - ll_pos - 1) //		错误信息	字符型	200	否	
		
		IF IsNull(ls_error) THEN ls_error = ''
		as_error = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_receive
	RETURN -1
END IF
if not this.uf_receive_data(ls_receive,as_error) then return -1

IF This.uf_getstring('交易处理结果') <> '0' THEN
	as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
	IF  This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息') > ''  THEN
		as_error = as_error + This.uf_getstring('有误收费项目明细返回信息')
	END IF
	RETURN -1
END IF

//有误收费项目明细返回信息	composite				详见下面有误收费项目明细结构体参数说明

public function integer of_insert_bscfymx (long al_zyh, string as_ybjzbh, ref string as_msg);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_sybjk_his_tz.of_insert_bscfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 插入医保不上传项目明细到 sydyb_fymxsc 表中
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long    	al_zyh   	
// 	value    	string  	as_ybjzbh	
// 	reference	String  	as_msg   	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.12.31    27471  28141  插入医保不上传项目明细到 tzyb_fymxsc_sbd 表中
//====================================================================
Long ll_row, ll_rowCOunt, ll_insert
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.rowCount()

IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 and ll_rowcount>0 Then 
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setTransOBject( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.reset()
	
	For ll_row=ll_rowcount to 1 Step -1
		IF gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row], ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row], ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row], Ref as_msg) > 0 THEN
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY'
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fymxxh[ll_insert] = 0
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = 1.00
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfje[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = 0.00
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.hjzf[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
				
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmyybh[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row] )
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XMYYDMC[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row])
			
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 9  // 不上传明细的状态标志为9
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzbh[ll_insert] =  as_ybjzbh

			ids_zyfymx.deleteRow(ll_row)
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update()=1 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		as_msg = "不上传明细保存失败：" + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
		return -1
	END IF
END IF

return 1
end function

end on

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
Integer li_1 = 0
String ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
IF IsNull(ad_datavalue) THEN RETURN ''
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'da','db','df','dj','dk','dl','dn' //，2位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		END IF
	CASE 'de','dg' //3位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dd','dh','di' //4位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dc'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0')
		END IF
	CASE 'dm'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0')
		END IF
END CHOOSE



end function

public function date uf_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
		if len(ls_datavalue)= 8 then
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		end if
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF Not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
			
			
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该譊AT*
侄伪匦胛猟ecimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function string uf_getstring (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getstring()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为string)，返回string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("lower(dataname) = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 's' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回string类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return ls_datavalue
end function

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字稤AT*

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYY-MM-DD HHMMSS
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYY-MM-DD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +String(al_row))
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

private function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm //ls_mc[],ls_format[],
Long li_bound,li_i,li_row,li_find //li_len[],
Boolean lb_return = True
sailjson ljson
ljson = Create sailjson
ljson.parse(as_xxt)

//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive.Reset()
ids_receive_in.Reset()
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx, 'YD')
String ls_return1	,ls_dataname,ls_fgfh

FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	ls_dataname = Upper(ls_dataname)
	IF ls_dataname = 'BKA111' And is_xxtlx = '7014' THEN CONTINUE
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		IF of_receivein_data(  This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ),ls_datavalue, ls_return1,This.of_get_jklx_oldmc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )) = False THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_return1) THEN ls_return1 = ''
			as_return = as_return +ls_return1
			RETURN False
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_datavalue = ljson.getattribute(ls_dataname)
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	END IF
NEXT

RETURN lb_return



end function

public function boolean of_constructor ();ib_init_success = True
IF uf_set_instance(is_init_errormessage) < 0 THEN ib_init_success = False

ids_receive = Create u_datastore
ids_receive.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_old = Create u_datastore
ids_send_old.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_old.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in = Create u_datastore
ids_send_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

u_datastore lds_temp
lds_temp = Create u_datastore
lds_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF lds_temp.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,',' AS FGFH from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE JKFL = 'JG' AND YBFL = 'SEP' ") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	lds_temp.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	lds_temp.Retrieve()
END IF
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("SELECT JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,',' AS FGFH,mxnr as mxnr_old FROM JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL = 'SEP'") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF


IF ib_init_success = True THEN
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	Long ll_row,i,li_cd,ll_rowcount,ll_insert
	String ls_jgdm
	ll_rowcount = ids_structre.Retrieve()
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row]) > '0' THEN //结构
			ls_jgdm = Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row])
			lds_temp.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" + ls_jgdm +"'")
			lds_temp.Filter()
			lds_temp.SetSort("PXXH A")
			lds_temp.Sort()
			
			IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					ll_insert = ids_structre.InsertRow(0)
					ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.MXNR[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxlx[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxlx[i]
					ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_insert] = ''
					ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_insert] = 0
					ids_structre.Object.JGPXXH[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.PXXH[i]
//					IF i = lds_temp.RowCount() THEN
//						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '~~'
//					ELSE
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = ','
//					END IF
				NEXT
				ids_structre.DeleteRow(ll_row)
				ll_row --
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				li_cd = 0
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					li_cd = li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
				NEXT
				ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	ids_structre.SetSort("JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,JGPXXH")
	ids_structre.Sort()
	String ls_jklx_old = ''
	String ls_jkfl_old = ''
	Integer li_pxxh = 0
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
		IF ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row] <> ls_jklx_old Or ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row] <> ls_jkfl_old THEN
			li_pxxh = 0
		END IF
		li_pxxh ++
		ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row] = li_pxxh
		ls_jklx_old = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
		ls_jkfl_old = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
	NEXT
END IF

ids_dmzd_dz = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_dz.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_new'
ids_dmzd_dz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz.RowCount()
	IF IsNull(ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i]) THEN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[i] = '' //空处理
NEXT
ids_dmzd_dz_jb = Create u_datastore
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.DataObject = 'd_yb_dmzd_dz_jb' //20200319 wangyi 疾病对照单独拿出来
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Retrieve()
FOR i = 1 To ids_dmzd_dz_jb.RowCount()

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数组
//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue
as_data = ''

IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_data = ''
	RETURN True
END IF
ll_num = ids_send_in.find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+upper(as_mxnr)+"'",1,9999999)
if ll_num <= 0  then
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	return false
end if
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
li_count = ids_send_in.object.datarow[ll_num]
//串联所有的消息体
FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count //ids_send_in.Object.max_datarow[1]
	
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
//		ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find])
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		ls_dataname = Upper(ls_dataname)
		if li_i = li_bound then
			as_data = as_data + This.uf_setattribute(ls_dataname,ls_datavalue) + '},{'
		else
			as_data = as_data + This.uf_setattribute(ls_dataname,ls_datavalue) + ','
		end if
	NEXT
	
	if ll_row = li_count then 
		as_data = '[{' + mid(as_data,1 , len(as_data) - 2) + ']'
	end if
NEXT
RETURN True

end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
ibase_info = base_info


RETURN 1

end function

private function boolean of_receivein_data (string as_xxlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return, string as_mxnr);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_mc[],ls_format[],ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm
string ls_xxtcf
Int li_len[],li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_datarow,li_pos=0
Long ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert
long ll_count
string ls_xxtfj[]
//返回数据的判断
//if isnull(as_xxt) or trim(as_xxt) = '' then
//	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
//	return false
//end if
if as_xxt='' or isnull(as_xxt) then return true
ls_xxt = left(as_xxt,len(as_xxt) - 1)
ll_count = of_splitparm(ls_xxt,ls_xxtfj,'^')
if ll_count<=0 then
	as_return = '未找到结笵AT* 固錨'
	return false
end if
//ls_xxt = as_xxt
//如果没有错误就继续分解内部消息体内容
//ls_xxlx = ls_xxlx + "_O"
//this.of_get_structure( ls_xxlx,'JG', ls_mc, li_len, ls_format,as_return)
//li_bound = upperbound(ls_mc)

li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxlx , 'JG')
li_sum = 0
li_datarow = 0

//加一条明细条数
ids_receive_in.InsertRow(1)
ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[1] ='0'
ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = 0
ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[1] = 'datacount'
ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[1] = as_mxnr
for ll_row = 1 to ll_count
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = ll_row
	ls_xxtcf = ls_xxtfj[ll_row]
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		li_pos= pos(ls_xxtcf,'|')
		if li_pos<=0 then
			ls_datavalue = ls_xxtcf
		else
			
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_xxtcf,1,li_pos - 1)
			ls_xxtcf = mid(ls_xxtcf,li_pos + 1)
		end if
		ll_insert = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
		ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[ll_insert] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[ll_insert] = ll_row
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[ll_insert] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[ll_insert] = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_mc[li_i]
		
		ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[ll_insert] = as_mxnr
		ll_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = 'rowcount'",1,999999)
		
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN ll_find = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[ll_find] = String(ll_row)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[ll_find] = 's'
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[ll_find] = 'rowcount'
	next
next
//if base_info.userid='211240' then
//	ids_receive_in.saveas( "c:\receive_in.txt",text!,true)
//end if
RETURN True

end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

long		ll_pos ,ll_len

If as_str = '' or isnull(as_str)  &
or	as_find = as_replace then return as_str

ll_len = len(as_replace)

Do 
	
	if ll_pos + ll_len = 0 then
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	else
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	end if
	If ll_pos > 0 then 
		as_str = replace(as_str,ll_pos,len(as_find),as_replace)
	end iF

Loop while ll_pos > 0 

//messagebox('',as_str)
return as_str 

end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'{','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'}','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'[','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,']','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'"','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,':','')
return as_string
end function

public function string uf_setattribute (string as_key, any any_value);//========================================================
//设置json键值
//--------------------------------------------------------
//参数：	as_key	键名
//			any_value 键值
//--------------------------------------------------------
//返回值:生成JSON的K-V内容
//--------------------------------------------------------
//注意：本函数只是生成JSON的K:V内容,
//值为Date类型则返回kv的字符串的"yyyy-mm-dd"
//值为DateTime类型则返回kv的字符串的"yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss"
//	譬如
//			"AA":"字符串内容"
//			"AA":数字内容
//			"AA":true
//			"AA":null
//			等等
//--------------------------------------------------------
// wangyi 20200610
//========================================================
string ls_str
IF isnull(any_value) Then
	ls_str = '"'+as_key+'":null'
	return ls_str
End IF
string ls_type
ls_type =lower(className(any_value))
Choose Case ls_type
	Case "string"
		if Pos(any_value, '[', 1) > 0 then
			ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':"+string(any_value)
		else
			ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':'"+string(any_value)+"'"
		end if
	case "uint","unsingedint","unsingedinteger","int","integer","ulong","unsingedlong","long","longlong","dec","decimal","double","real","byte"
		ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':"+string(any_value)+''
	case "date"
		ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':'"+string(any_value,"yyyy-mm-dd")+"'"
	case "datetime"
		ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':'"+string(any_value,"yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss")+"'"
	case "time"
		ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':'"+string(any_value,"hh:mm:ss")+"'"
	case "boolean"
		boolean lb_val
		lb_val = any_value
		if lb_val Then
			ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':true"
		else
			ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':false"
		end if
	Case else
		ls_str = "'"+as_key+"':'不支持的数据类型："+ls_type+"'"
End Choose
return ls_str
end function

end function

public function integer uf_write_log (string as_text, integer al_rclx);//gf_write_log()
integer li_FileNum

If IsNull(as_Text) Then as_Text = ''
as_Text = '//' + String(Now(),"yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss") + "~r~n" + as_Text

li_FileNum = FileOpen("d:\zfsclog\zfsc_"+string(gf_server_date(),'yyyymmdd')+".log", LineMode!, Write!, LockWrite!, Append!)

If al_rclx = 1 Then 
	FileWrite (li_FileNum, "" )
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"//==============================================================================")
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"// " + String(Today(),"yyyy.mm.dd") + " " + String(Now(),"hh:mm:ss") + " **自费上传开始**") 
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"//------------------------------------------------------------------------------~r~n")
End If

//FileWrite (li_FileNum, "~r~n" )
do
	FileWrite (li_FileNum, as_Text )
	as_text=trim(mid(as_text,32765,len(as_text)))
loop while len(as_text)>32765
if len(as_Text)>0 then FileWrite (li_FileNum, as_Text )

If al_rclx = 2 Then 
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"~r~n//------------------------------------------------------------------------------")
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"// " + String(Today(),"yyyy.mm.dd") + " " + String(Now(),"hh:mm:ss") + " **自费上传结束**") 
	FileWrite(li_FileNum,"//==============================================================================")
	FileWrite (li_FileNum, "" )
End If

FileClose(li_FileNum)

return 1

end function
