public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);
IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+String(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function integer of_zfsc_fymx_zy (long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, ref string as_msg);IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN  -1
END IF
//zy_fymx
IF IsValid(ids_zyfymx) = False THEN
	ids_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	ids_zyfymx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_zfsc_zyfymx'
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
Long ll_rowcount
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh ,ai_jscs)
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_msg = ids_zyfymx.is_error
	RETURN -1
ELSEIF  ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF

String ls_zyhm,ls_brch,ls_zzys,ls_ksmc,ls_fphm,ls_ypzllb,ls_dffbz,ls_kzys
Long ll_brks,j,ll_mxtop,ll_add_row,ll_beginrow,ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert,ll_ret
Long ll_ypcd,ll_find_yz,ll_fymxcount,ll_find_sc,ll_cwts,ll_findcy
Integer li_sczs
Dec{0} ldc_yz_jlxh,ldc_yzzh,ldc_zyljxh
Dec{2} ldc_yhje,ldc_zjje_temp,ld_fysl,ldc_zfje,ldc_zlje,ldc_hjzf,ldc_mrcs
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Dec{4} ld_fydj,ldc_ycsl
String ls_ycjl,ls_ybbm,ls_ybmc,ls_sfxmdj,ls_ygxm ,ls_sfzh,ls_ksbm
String ls_cfh,ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_zjl,ls_yldw,ls_sypc,ls_bzdw

SELECT BRKS,ZYHM,BRCH,ZZYS Into :ll_brks,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_zzys From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
select fphm into :ls_fphm from zy_zyjs Where ZYH = :al_zyh and jscs=:ai_jscs Using itran_sqlca;

IF ll_brks = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '病人无当前科室，不能上传明细!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_ksmc = This.of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'GY_KSDM', String(ll_brks))
ids_zyfymx.SetSort("jlxh A")
ids_zyfymx.Sort()

li_sczs = Ceiling(ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_zfsc_fymx_sc'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF IsValid(ids_bqyz) = False THEN
	ids_bqyz = Create U_datastore
	ids_bqyz.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_bqyz.DataObject = 'd_yb_zybqyz_syd'
END IF
ids_bqyz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset()
ids_bqyz.Retrieve(al_zyh)


FOR j = 1 To li_sczs
	uf_send_init('7012')
	IF j * ii_mxts > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop =  ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = j * ii_mxts
	END IF
	ll_add_row = 0
	ll_beginrow = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'LS_DT')
	FOR ll_row = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
		ll_add_row ++
		ldc_yhje = ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		IF ldc_yhje <> 0 THEN
			ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ldc_yhje 
			ld_fydj = ldc_zjje_temp / ld_fysl
		ELSE
			ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ld_fydj = ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		END IF
		
		ld_fysl = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_zyljxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		//医嘱序号------------------------
		ldc_yz_jlxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ldc_yz_jlxh) THEN 
			ldc_yz_jlxh = 0
			ls_cfh = String(ldc_zyljxh)
		ELSE
			ls_cfh = String(ldc_yz_jlxh)
		END IF
		ls_sypc = 'st'
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				//根据匹配的去取  9--12
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_ybbm = ids_ylsf.Object.ybbm[ll_find]
				ls_ybmc = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ybmc[ll_find])
				ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_ylsf.Object.sfxmdj[ll_find])
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				ldc_ycsl = 1.00
				ldc_mrcs = 1.00
				ls_sypc = 'st'
				IF ids_ylsf.Object.tsdz[ll_find] > 0 THEN
					//是否有特殊医保对照
					ll_insert = ids_yb_tsdz.Find("#1 = 0 AND #2=" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + " AND #4 <= datetime('" +& 						String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row],'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') +& 						"') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row],'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')",1,9999999)
					
					IF ll_insert > 0 THEN
						ls_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_insert]
						ls_ybmc = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#6[ll_insert])
						ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#7[ll_insert])
					END IF
				END IF
				ls_dw = String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])
				ls_gg = '无'	
				ls_jx = '无'	
				ls_zjl = ''	
				ls_yldw = '无'	
			END IF
		ELSE //药品
			//			uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型','1',ll_add_row)
			ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_ybbm = ids_typk.Object.YB_dzbh[ll_find]
				ls_ybmc = String(ids_typk.Object.ybmc[ll_find])
				ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_typk.Object.sfxmdj[ll_find])
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				ldc_ycsl = 1.00
				ldc_mrcs = 1.00
				
				IF ids_typk.Object.tsdz[ll_find] > 0 THEN
					//是否有特殊医保对照
					ll_insert = ids_yb_tsdz.Find("#1 = 2 AND #2=" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + " AND #8 = "+String(ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row])+" AND #4 <= datetime('" +& 						String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row],'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') +& 						"') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row],'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')",1,9999999)
					
					IF ll_insert > 0 THEN
						ls_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_insert]
						ls_ybmc = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#6[ll_insert])
						ls_sfxmdj = String(ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#7[ll_insert])
					END IF
				END IF
				IF ldc_yz_jlxh > 0 THEN
					ll_find_yz = ids_bqyz.Find("jlxh=" + String(ldc_yz_jlxh),1,999999)
					IF ll_find_yz > 0 THEN
						ldc_ycsl = ids_bqyz.Object.ycsl[ll_find_yz]
						ldc_mrcs = ids_bqyz.Object.mrcs[ll_find_yz]
						ls_sypc = ids_bqyz.Object.sypc[ll_find_yz]
						IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 3 THEN
							ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find_yz]
							ll_findcy = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find_yz)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
							IF ll_findcy > 0 THEN
								ls_dffbz = '2'
							ELSE
								ls_dffbz = '1'
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
				ls_dw = String(ids_typk.Object.bfdw[ll_find])
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find] = '' THEN
					ls_gg = '无'
				ELSE
					ls_gg = String(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find])
				END IF
				ls_jx = String(ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find])
				ls_zjl = String(ids_typk.Object.ypjl[ll_find],'0.00')
				ls_yldw = String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find])	
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_sypc = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC_SYD',ls_sypc)
		
		uf_send_add_in("AKC190","ZY" + ls_fphm,ll_add_row) //1.		AKC190	就诊号	字符型	20	是	医疗机构内部唯一的流水号，与就诊信息[D01]中的就诊号对应	
		uf_send_add_in("BKE002",String(ldc_zyljxh),ll_add_row) //2.		BKE002	费用明细序号	字符型	20	是	医院端唯一流水号	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC220",ls_cfh,ll_add_row) //3.		AKC220	处方号	字符型	50	是	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE003",ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row) //4.		AKE003	药品诊疗类型	字符型	3	是	参见代码表药品诊疗类型
	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE001",ls_ybbm,ll_add_row) //5.		AKE001	项目编码	字符型	20	是	省统一目录编码	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE006",String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]),ll_add_row) //6.		AKE006	项目名称	字符型	256	是	医院端目录名称	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC225",String(ld_fydj,'0.0000'),ll_add_row) //7.		AKC225	单价	数值型	16,4	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC226",String( ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row],'0.0000'),ll_add_row) //8.		AKC226	数量	数值型	16,4	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE134",'1',ll_add_row) //9.		AKE134	贴数	数值型	16,4	是	中草药按实际上传，非中草药传1	
		uf_send_add_in("AAE019",String(ldc_zjje_temp,'0.00'),ll_add_row) //10.		AAE019	金额	数值型	16,2	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA067",ls_dw,ll_add_row) //11.		AKA067	单位	字符型	50	否	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA074",ls_gg,ll_add_row) //12.		AKA074	规格	字符型	100	否			
		uf_send_add_in("AKA070",ls_jx,ll_add_row) //13.		AKA070	剂型	字符型	100	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKA066",ls_dffbz,ll_add_row)//14.		AKA066	单复方标志	字符型	1	是	0：非草药 1：草药单方 2：草药复方	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE130",ls_bzdw,ll_add_row) //15.		AKE130	包装单位（标准单位）	字符型	50	否	按中心目录的单位传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE113",1,ll_add_row) //16.		AKE113	包装数量（标准数量）	数值型	16,4	否	按折算后的数量传。 
		uf_send_add_in("AKE116",ls_zjl,ll_add_row) //17.		AKE116	总剂量	数值型	16,4	否			
		uf_send_add_in("AKE118",'',ll_add_row) //18.		AKE118	最小剂量单位	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE131",ls_yldw,ll_add_row) //19.		AKE131	用量单位	字符型	50	否	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA072",ls_sypc,ll_add_row) //20.		AKA072	使用频次	字符型	3	否	参见代码表使用频次
	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA071",ldc_ycsl,ll_add_row) //21.		AKA071	每次用量	数值型	16,4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("BKE344",ldc_mrcs,ll_add_row) //22.		BKE344	每天次数	数值型	4	否	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC229",'1',ll_add_row) //23.		AKC229	用药天数	数值型	4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("BKE347","0",ll_add_row) //24.		BKE347	药品电子监管码	字符型	32	否		
		ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_brks))
		IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
			as_msg = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_brks)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		uf_send_add_in("AKF001",ls_ksbm,ll_add_row) //25.		AKF001	开方科室编码	字符型	20	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AAE386",ls_ksmc,ll_add_row) //26.		AAE386	开方科室名称	字符型	50	否		

		//使用zy_fymx的ysgh ，为空则取主治医生
		ls_kzys = ids_zyfymx.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ls_kzys) Or ls_kzys = '' THEN
			ls_kzys = ls_zzys
		END IF
		This.of_get_ygxm( ls_kzys,ls_ygxm, ls_sfzh)
		ld_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]	
		uf_send_add_in("BKE001",ls_kzys,ll_add_row) //27.		BKE001	医生服务编码	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE021",ls_ygxm,ll_add_row)//28.		AKE021	开具医生姓名	字符型	50	否	

		
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jscs[ll_insert] = ai_jscs
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY'
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ls_fphm //ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fymxxh[ll_insert] = String(ldc_zyljxh)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.cfh[ll_insert] = ls_cfh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ypzllx[ll_insert] = integer(ls_ypzllb)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmbm[ll_insert] = ls_ybbm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dj[ll_insert] = ld_fydj
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.sl[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ts[ll_insert] = 1
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.je[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje_temp
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dw[ll_insert] = ls_dw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.gg[ll_insert] = ls_gg
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jx[ll_insert] = ls_jx
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dffbz[ll_insert] = integer(ls_dffbz)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bzdw[ll_insert] = ls_bzdw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bzsl[ll_insert] = 1
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zjl[ll_insert] = integer(ls_zjl)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zxjldw[ll_insert] = ''
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.yldw[ll_insert] = ls_yldw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.sypc[ll_insert] = ls_sypc
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.mcyl[ll_insert] = ldc_ycsl
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.mtcs[ll_insert] = ldc_mrcs
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.yyts[ll_insert] = 1
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ypdzjgm[ll_insert] = "0"
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ksbm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ksmc[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ysbm[ll_insert] = ls_kzys
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ysxm[ll_insert] = ls_ygxm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
		
	NEXT
	
	uf_send_add('COUNT',ll_add_row)
	
	
	//调用交易
	String ls_result
	IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
		
		String ls_error
		ls_error = This.uf_getstring("BKA111") // BKA111	错误说明	字符型	1000	是	一条记录多个错误则错误说明组合在一起。
		
		IF ls_error > '' THEN
			is_error += "[7012]发票号码:" + ls_fphm + ":" + ls_error
			GOTO err
		END IF
		
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
		ELSE
			is_error = '更新住院明细 ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
			GOTO err
		END IF
		
	else
		goto err
	End If
	
NEXT

RETURN 1


err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)

Return -1
end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_result);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//在这里判断初始化是否成功uf_send_init
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	is_error = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF
IF IsNull(is_xxtlx) Or is_xxtlx = '' THEN
	is_error = '消息体类型为空'
	
RETURN False
END IF
Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Boolean lb_find
Integer li_last_fgfh_gs
sailjson ljson_data,ljson_header,ljson_send,ljson_rec
ljson_send   = Create sailjson
ljson_header = Create sailjson
ljson_data   = Create sailjson
ljson_rec    = Create sailjson
ls_xxt = ''
is_error = ''

//返回对应的消息体格式
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
//串联所有的消息体
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
		IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),ls_datavalue,  is_error, ls_dataname) = False THEN RETURN False
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		
IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				is_error = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN False
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
		
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		
	END IF
	ls_dataname = Upper(ls_dataname)
	IF li_i = li_bound THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + This.uf_setattribute(ls_dataname,ls_datavalue)
	ELSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + This.uf_setattribute(ls_dataname,ls_datavalue) + of_get_jklx_fgfh(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
	END IF
NEXT
ls_xxt = '[{' + ls_xxt + '}]'

//wangyi 20200610
//参数代码	参数名称	参数类型	参数长度	是否必填	备注
//ver	版本号	字符型	 8	是	报文标准对应的版本号，当前为V1.0
//orgNo	交易发起方	字符型	  10	是	医疗机构编码
//orgName	交易发起方名称	字符型	  100	是	
//id	任务流水号	字符型	30	否	从7001号交易下载的任务流水号
//inPut	报文体	json	不限	是	详见3.联机交易,内容可重复

//生成Data json
ljson_send.setattribute( 'ver', is_ver)
ljson_send.setattribute( 'orgNo', is_yljgdm )
ljson_send.setattribute( 'orgName',is_yljgmc)
ljson_send.setattribute( 'id', is_id)
ljson_send.setattribute( 'inPut', ls_xxt)
ls_s
end = ljson_send.getformatjson( '')

//签名
String ls_signature
ls_signature = of_signature(ls_send)

//调用交易
DateTime ldt_server
String ls_nonceStr //调用方随机生成的 32 位字符串
String ls_url

ldt_server = gf_server_date()

IF is_xxtlx = '7001' THEN
	ls_url = is_url
ELSE
	ls_url = is_url2 + is_xxtlx
END IF

uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + "入参:::::url=" + ls_url + ",报文=" + ls_send,0)

ls_send = gf_replacestr(ls_send,'"','$')
ls_send = gf_replacestr(ls_send,'$','\"')

String ls_error,ls_data
Integer li_ret

TRY
	n_wscommon ln_wscommon
	ln_wscommon = Create n_wscommon
	
	ljson_header.setattribute( 'appKey', is_appkey)
	ljson_header.setattribute( 'time', is_time )
	ljson_header.setattribute( 'nonceStr',is_nonceStr)
	ljson_header.setattribute( 'signature', ls_signature)
	ljson_header.setattribute( 'encodeType', "1")
	ls_data = ljson_header.getformatjson( '')
	ls_data = gf_replacestr(ls_data,'"','$')
	ls_data = gf_replacestr(ls_data,'$','\"')
	
	ljson_data.setattribute( 'Method', 'Post')
	ljson_data.setattribute( 'Url', ls_url )
	ljson_data.setattribute( 'Data',ls_send)
	ljson_data.setattribute( 'ContentType', "application/json")
	ljson_data.setattribute( 'Header', ls_data)
	ls_data = ljson_data.getformatjson( '')
	li_ret = ln_wscommon.uf_doaction( "COMMON",'DoHttpMethod', ls_data, ls_recieve)
	IF li_ret = 1 THEN
		uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + "出参:::::" + ls_recieve,0)
		
		//解析json字符串
		String ls_success, ls_code, ls_cmd, ls_param, ls_output
		String ls_resultDes, ls_fphm //, ls_result
		Long ll_p1, ll_p2
		
		ljson_rec.parse(ls_recieve)
		ls_success = String(ljson_rec.getattribute("success"))
		ls_code = String(ljson_rec.getattribute("code"))
		ls_resultDes = String(ljson_rec.getattribute("resultDes"))
//		ls_result = String(ljson_rec.getattribute("result"))
		
		ll_p1 = Pos(ls_recieve, '[', 1)
		ll_p2 = Pos(ls_recieve, ']', ll_p1 + 1)
		as_result = Mid(ls_recieve, ll_p1 + 1, ll_p2 - ll_p1 - 1)
		
		IF Lower(ls_success) = 'true' THEN
			IF IsNull(as_result) Or as_result = '' THEN RETURN True
//			IF IsNull(is_error) Or is_error = '' THEN
//				RETURN True
//			END IF
		ELSE
			//失败的话解析具体失败信息
			is_error = '调用交易失败:' + ls_code + ls_resultDes
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
	ELSE
		is_error = is_xxtlx + '调用接口失败，失败原因：'+ls_recieve
		uf_write_log(is_error,0)
		RETURN False
	END IF
	
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	is_error = "调用DoAction失败：" + er2.Text  + " input=" + ls_data
	RETURN False
END TRY
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)

IF IsValid(ln_wscommon) THEN Destroy ln_wscommon
RETURN of_receive_data(as_result,is_error)



end function

public function integer of_zfsc_7013 (string as_jzh);//7013 号交易： 费用明细删除
//1. AKC190 就诊号 字符型 20 是 医疗机构内部唯一的流水号
//2. BKE100 发票号码 字符型 50 是

uf_send_init('7013')
String ls_body, ls_signature, ls_fplsh,ls_ywlx,ls_fphm
String ls_input,ls_output
String ls_out_code

ls_ywlx = mid(as_jzh,1,2)
ls_fplsh = mid(as_jzh,3)
IF ls_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN 
	select sjpjh into :ls_fphm from mzxt.mz_fpk where fplsh=:ls_fplsh ;
else
	ls_fphm = ls_fplsh
end if
//交易体body
//ls_body =  '[{"AKC190":"' + as_fphm + '","BKE100":"' + as_fphm +'"}]'
uf_send_add('AKC190',as_jzh)
uf_send_add('BKE100',ls_fphm)

String ls_result
IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
	
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ls_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX SET ZTBZ = -1 Where YWLX IN ('CF','YJ') And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ztbz=1 Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX SET ZTBZ = -1 Where YWLX = :ls_ywlx And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ztbz=1 Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF

	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		is_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		GOTO err
	END IF

	Return 1
ELSE
	goto err
END IF

err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)

Return -1
end function

public function integer of_zfsc_7014 (string as_jzh, integer ai_num);//7014 号交易： 上传自费信息确认
//1. AKC190 就诊号 字符型 20 是 医疗机构内部唯一的流水号
//2. BKE100 发票号码 字符型 50 是

uf_send_init('7014')
String ls_body, ls_signature,ls_ywlx,ls_fplsh,ls_fphm
String ls_input,ls_output
String ls_out_code


ls_ywlx = mid(as_jzh,1,2)
ls_fplsh = mid(as_jzh,3)
IF ls_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN 
	select sjpjh into :ls_fphm from mzxt.mz_fpk where fplsh=:ls_fplsh ;
else
	ls_fphm = ls_fplsh
end if
//交易体body
uf_send_add('AKC190',as_jzh)
uf_send_add('BKE100',ls_fphm)
uf_send_add('COUNT',ai_num)

String ls_result
IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
	
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ls_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX SET ZTBZ = 2 Where YWLX IN ('CF','YJ') And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ztbz=1 Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX SET ZTBZ = 2 Where YWLX = :ls_ywlx And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ztbz=1 Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF

	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		is_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		GOTO err
	END IF
	
	Return 1
ELSE
	goto err
END IF

err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)
this.of_zfsc_7013( as_jzh)

Return -1
end function

public function integer of_zfsc_fymx_mz (string as_fplsh, ref string as_error);//7012 号交易：LDT 费用明细列表[D04]

Long ll_i, ll_find, ll_find1, ll_insert, ll_rowcount, ll_mxtop, ll_beginrow, ll_add_row
String ls_ybbm, ls_ypzllx,ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh
String ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_bzdw,ls_zxjldw,ls_yldw,ls_sypc
Integer li_sczs,j,li_mrcs,li_cyts = 1 //草药贴数
String ls_dffbz = '0' //单复方标志 0：非草药 1：草药单方 2：草药复方
Dec{0} ldc_ywlsh
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_fysl,ldc_ypjl,ldc_zjl

IF IsValid(ids_mz_sfmx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_sfmx = Create u_DataStore
	ids_mz_sfmx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_mz_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_zfsc_mz_sfmx'
END IF
ids_mz_sfmx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ll_rowcount = ids_mz_sfmx.Retrieve(as_fplsh)

IF ll_rowcount <= 0 THEN
	as_error = ids_mz_sfmx.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_zfsc_fymx_sc'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_ybfymx_sc.reset( )

li_sczs = Ceiling(ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
FOR j = 1 To li_sczs
	uf_send_init('7012')
	IF j * ii_mxts > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop =  ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = j * ii_mxts
	END IF
	ll_add_row = 0
	ll_beginrow = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'LS_DT')
	FOR ll_i = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
		ll_add_row ++

		ll_find = of_get_jbxx(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.yplx[ll_i],ids_mz_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_i],ids_mz_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[ll_i],as_error)
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ldc_fysl = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_i]
			ldc_fydj = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.xmdj[ll_i]
			ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'MZ_KS',ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ksbm[ll_i] )
			IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '无' THEN ls_ksbm = '0200'
			ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'MZ_KS',ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ksbm[ll_i] )
			IF ls_ksmc <= '' THEN
				as_error = '未找到对应的科室名称 MZ_KS ' +ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ksbm[ll_i]
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ysbm[ll_i]) Or ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ysbm[ll_i] = '' THEN
				ls_ysxm = '未知'
				ls_yszh = '未知'
			ELSE
				IF of_get_ygxm(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ysbm[ll_i],ls_ysxm,ls_yszh) < 0 THEN
					as_error = ls_ysxm
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			
			IF ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_i] = 'CF' THEN
				ls_ypzllx = String(ids_typk.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_ybbm = String(ids_typk.Object.#2[ll_find])
				ldc_ypjl  = Dec(ids_typk.Object.ypjl[ll_find])
				ls_dw = String(ids_typk.Object.yfdw[ll_find])
				ls_gg = String(ids_typk.Object.yfgg[ll_find])
				ls_jx = '无'
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				ls_bzdw = String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find])
				ls_zxjldw = of_get_dzdmsb("GY_DMZD",'1404',ls_bzdw)
				ls_yldw   = of_get_dzdmsb("GY_DMZD",'1404',ls_bzdw)
				ls_sypc   = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC_SYD',String(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_i]))
				
				IF ids_mz_sfmx.Object.sfxm[ll_i] = 3 THEN //草药
					ldc_ywlsh = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_i]
					ll_find1 = ids_mz_sfmx.Find("YWLX ='CF' and SFXM=3 AND YWLSH=" + String(ldc_ywlsh) + " and getrow() <> " + String(ll_i) + & 						" and ( xmlsh <> " + String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and xmlsh <> " +  String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and xmlsh <> " +String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) + ")",1,999999)
					IF ll_find1 > 0 THEN
						ls_dffbz = '2' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
					ELSE
						ls_dffbz = '1'
					END IF
					SELECT cyts Into :li_cyts From YPXT.mz_Cfk Where cflsh = :ldc_ywlsh Using itran_sqlca;
					IF Lower(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find]) = 'g' Or Lower(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find]) = 'kg' THEN
						ldc_fysl = ldc_fysl * ldc_ypjl / li_cyts //单贴数量
						ldc_fydj = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_i] / (ldc_fysl * li_cyts)
					ELSE
						ldc_fysl = ldc_fysl / li_cyts
					END IF
					ldc_zjl = ldc_fysl * li_cyts
				ELSE
					ldc_zjl = ldc_fysl * ldc_ypjl * li_cyts
				END IF
				
				IF ids_mz_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_i] > '' THEN
					li_mrcs = of_get_mrcs(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_i] )
					IF li_mrcs < 0 THEN
						as_error = is_error
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSE
					li_mrcs = 1
				END IF
			ELSE //YJ
				ls_ypzllx = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ypzllx[ll_find])
				ls_ybbm = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#2[ll_find])
				ls_dffbz = '0' //单复方标志 0：非草药 1：草药单方 2：草药复方
				li_cyts = 1 //草药贴数
				ldc_zjl = 1 //总剂量
				li_mrcs = 1 //每日次数
				ls_dw = String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])
				ls_gg = ''
				ls_jx = ''
				ls_bzdw = "1"
				ldc_zjl = 1
				ls_zxjldw = '1'
				ls_yldw = String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])
				ls_sypc = "61"
				li_mrcs = 1
			END IF
		END IF
		//                                             序号	指标	名称	类型	长度（精度）	不能为空	备注
		uf_send_add_in("AKC190","MZ" + as_fplsh,ll_add_row) //1.		AKC190	就诊号	字符型	20	是	医疗机构内部唯一的流水号，与就诊信息[D01]中的就诊号对应	
		uf_send_add_in("BKE002",String(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.JLLSH[ll_i]),ll_add_row) //2.		BKE002	费用明细序号	字符型	20	是	医院端唯一流水号	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC220",String(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_i]),ll_add_row) //3.		AKC220	处方号	字符型	50	是		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE003",ls_ypzllx,ll_add_row) //4.		AKE003	药品诊疗类型	字符型	3	是	参见代码表药品诊疗类型
		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE001",ls_ybbm,ll_add_row) //5.		AKE001	项目编码	字符型	20	是	省统一目录编码	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE006",ids_mz_sfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_i],ll_add_row) //6.		AKE006	项目名称	字符型	256	是	医院端目录名称	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC225",ldc_fydj,ll_add_row) //7.		AKC225	单价	数值型	16,4	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKC226",ldc_fysl,ll_add_row) //8.		AKC226	数量	数值型	16,4	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE134",li_cyts,ll_add_row) //9.		AKE134	贴数	数值型	16,4	是	中草药按实际上传，非中草药传1	
		uf_send_add_in("AAE019",ids_mz_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_i],ll_add_row) //10.		AAE019	金额	数值型	16,2	是	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA067",ls_dw,ll_add_row) //11.		AKA067	单位	字符型	50	否	按医院端实际传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKA074",ls_gg,ll_add_row) //12.		AKA074	规格	字符型	100	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKA070",ls_jx,ll_add_row) //13.		AKA070	剂型	字符型	100	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKA066",ls_dffbz,ll_add_row)//14.		AKA066	单复方标志	字符型	1	是	0：非草药 1：草药单方 2：草药复方	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE130",ls_bzdw,ll_add_row) //15.		AKE130	包装单位（标准单位）	字符型	50	否	按中心目录的单位传	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE113",1,ll_add_row) //16.		AKE113	包装数量（标准数量）	数值型	16,4	否	按折算后的数量传。 	
		uf_send_add_in("AKE116",ldc_zjl,ll_add_row) //17.		AKE116	总剂量	数值型	16,4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE118",ls_zxjldw,ll_add_row) //18.		AKE118	最小剂量单位	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE131",ls_yldw,ll_add_row) //19.		AKE131	用量单位	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKA072",ls_sypc,ll_add_row) //20.		AKA072	使用频次	字符型	3	否	参见代码表使用频次
		
		uf_send_add_in("AKA071",Dec(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ycjl[ll_i]),ll_add_row) //21.		AKA071	每次用量	数諨AT*
	16,4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("BKE344",li_mrcs,ll_add_row) //22.		BKE344	每天次数	数值型	4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKC229",String(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.yyts[ll_i]),ll_add_row) //23.		AKC229	用药天数	数值型	4	否		
		uf_send_add_in("BKE347","0",ll_add_row) //24.		BKE347	药品电子监管码	字符型	32	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKF001",ls_ksbm,ll_add_row) //25.		AKF001	开方科室编码	字符型	20	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AAE386",ls_ksmc,ll_add_row) //26.		AAE386	开方科室名称	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("BKE001",ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ysbm[ll_i],ll_add_row) //27.		BKE001	医生服务编码	字符型	50	否		
		uf_send_add_in("AKE021",ls_ysxm,ll_add_row)//28.		AKE021	开具医生姓名	字符型	50	否		
		
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.brbm[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.brbm[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jscs[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = as_fplsh //ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.fymxxh[ll_insert] = string(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.JLLSH[ll_i])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.cfh[ll_insert] = string(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_i])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ypzllx[ll_insert] = integer(ls_ypzllx)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmbm[ll_insert] = ls_ybbm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dj[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.sl[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ts[ll_insert] = li_cyts
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.je[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.zjje[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dw[ll_insert] = ls_dw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.gg[ll_insert] = ls_gg
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jx[ll_insert] = ls_jx
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.dffbz[ll_insert] = integer(ls_dffbz)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bzdw[ll_insert] = ls_bzdw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.bzsl[ll_insert] = 1
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zjl[ll_insert] = ldc_zjl
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zxjldw[ll_insert] = ls_zxjldw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.yldw[ll_insert] = ls_yldw
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.sypc[ll_insert] = ls_sypc
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.mcyl[ll_insert] = Dec(ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ycjl[ll_i])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.mtcs[ll_insert] = li_mrcs
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.yyts[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.yyts[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ypdzjgm[ll_insert] = "0"
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ksbm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ksmc[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ysbm[ll_insert] = ids_mz_sfmx.Object.ysbm[ll_i]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ysxm[ll_insert] = ls_ysxm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
	NEXT
	uf_send_add('COUNT',ll_add_row)
	
	//调用交易
	String ls_result
	IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
		
		String ls_error
		ls_error = This.uf_getstring("BKA111") // BKA111	错误说明	字符型	1000	是	一条记录多个错误则错误说明组合在一起。
		
		IF ls_error > '' THEN
			is_error += "[7012]发票号码:" + as_fplsh + ":" + ls_error
			GOTO err
		END IF
		
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
		ELSE
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
			as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
	else
		goto err
	End If
	
NEXT	
	

RETURN 1


err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)

Return -1






end function

public function integer of_zfsc_7011 (string as_fplsh, string as_sfrq, string as_sfzh, decimal ad_zjje, integer ai_type, string as_jylx);//7011 号交易： 自费就诊费用信息上传
//1. COUNT 本次就诊总条数 数值型 4 是
//2. LS_DT1 就诊详细信息列表 结构体 是 参见 D01
//ai_type 1：门诊 2：住院

uf_send_init('7011')
Integer	li_count
String ls_sfrq,ls_fplsh

//ls_sfrq = String(adt_sfrq, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
IF ai_type = 1 THEN //门诊
	choose case as_jylx
		case 'GH'
			ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
			IF of_zfsc_jzxx_gh(ls_fplsh) < 0 THEN GOTO err
		CASE 'SF'
			ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
			IF of_zfsc_jzxx_mz(ls_fplsh) < 0 THEN GOTO err
		CASE ELSE //7001获取菵AT*

			SELECT fplsh INTO :ls_fplsh FROM mzxt.mz_fpk Where sjpjh = :as_fplsh And to_char(kpsj,'yyyy-mm-dd') = :as_sfrq And xmzje = :ad_zjje;
			//收费
			IF ls_fplsh > '' THEN
				IF of_zfsc_jzxx_mz(ls_fplsh) < 0 THEN GOTO err
			ELSE
				ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
				IF of_zfsc_jzxx_gh(ls_fplsh) < 0 THEN GOTO err
			END IF
	END CHOOSE
	
ELSEIF ai_type = 2 THEN //住院
	ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
	SELECT count(1) INTO :li_count FROM BQXT.zy_zyjs
		Where fphm = :ls_fplsh And to_char(jsrq,'yyyy-mm-dd') = :as_sfrq And fyhj = :ad_zjje;
	IF li_count > 0 THEN //收费
		IF of_zfsc_jzxx_zy(ls_fplsh, '0') < 0 THEN GOTO err
	ELSE //退费
		IF of_zfsc_jzxx_zy(ls_fplsh, '2') < 0 THEN GOTO err
	END IF
END IF

uf_send_add('COUNT',1)
 
//调用交易
String ls_result
IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
	String ls_error
	Datetime ldt_curr,ldt_scsj
	
	ldt_curr = gf_server_date()
	ldt_scsj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,12)
	ls_error = This.uf_getstring("BKA111") // BKA111	错误说明	字符蠨AT*
	1000	是	一条记录多个错误则错误说明组合在一起。
	
	IF ls_error > '' THEN
		is_error += "[7011]发票号码:" + ls_fplsh + ":" + ls_error
		GOTO err
	END IF
	
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSC  SET ZTBZ = 1 Where SCSJ  >= :ldt_scsj And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh and ztbz=0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		is_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		GOTO err
	END IF
	
ELSE
	GOTO err
END IF

RETURN 1

err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
DELETE FROM JKXT.YB_ZFSC Where SCSJ  >= :ldt_scsj And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ztbz=0 Using itran_sqlca ;
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)

RETURN -1



end function

public function integer of_zfsc_7012 (string as_fplsh, string as_sfrq, string as_sfzh, decimal ad_zjje, integer ai_type, string as_jylx);//7012 号交易： 费用明细批量上传
//1. COUNT 本次费用明细条数 数值型 4 是
//2. LS_DT 费用明细列表 结构体 是 参见 D04

uf_send_init('7012')
Integer	li_count,li_num, li_return,li_jscs
String ls_sfrq,ls_brbm,ls_fplsh
Boolean lb_wcbz
Dec{0} ldc_zyh

//ls_sfrq = String(adt_sfrq, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
IF ai_type = 1 THEN
	CHOOSE CASE as_jylx
		CASE 'GH'
			ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
			SELECT brbm Into :ls_brbm From mzxt.mz_ghxx Where to_char(ghlsh) = :ls_fplsh;
			IF of_zfsc_fymx_gh(ls_fplsh,li_num,is_error) < 0 THEN GOTO err
		CASE 'SF'
			ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
			SELECT grbm Into :ls_brbm From mzxt.mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh;
//			IF of_zfsc_fymx_mz(ls_fplsh,li_num,is_error) < 0 THEN GOTO err
			IF of_zfsc_fymx_mz(ls_fplsh,is_error) < 0 THEN
				GOTO err
			ELSE
				GOTO mzzy
			END IF
			
		CASE ELSE
			SELECT fplsh,grbm Into :ls_fplsh,:ls_brbm From mzxt.mz_fpk Where sjpjh = :as_fplsh And to_char(kpsj,'yyyy-mm-dd') = :as_sfrq And xmzje = :ad_zjje;
			//收费
			IF ls_fplsh > '' THEN
				IF of_zfsc_fymx_mz(ls_fplsh,is_error) < 0 THEN
					GOTO err
				ELSE
					GOTO mzzy
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
				IF of_zfsc_fymx_gh(ls_fplsh,li_num,is_error) < 0 THEN GOTO err
			END IF
	END CHOOSE
END IF
IF ai_type = 2 THEN
	ls_fplsh = as_fplsh
	SELECT zyh,jscs Into :ldc_zyh,:li_jscs From zy_zyjs Where (fphm = :ls_fplsh) and to_char(jsrq,'yyyy-mm-dd') = :as_sfrq;
	IF of_zfsc_fymx_zy(ldc_zyh,li_jscs,is_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO err
	ELSE
		mzzy:
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		if ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
			UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
		else
			UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where brbm = :ls_brbm And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
		end if
		
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		ELSE
			is_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			GOTO err
		END IF
		
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF


uf_send_add('COUNT',li_num)

//调用交易
String ls_result
IF uf_send(ls_result) = True THEN
	
	String ls_error
	ls_error = This.uf_getstring("BKA111") // BKA111	错误说明	字符型	1000	是	一条记录多个错误则错误说明组合在一起。
	
	IF ls_error > '' THEN
		is_error += "[7012]发票号码:" + ls_fplsh + ":" + ls_error
		GOTO err
	END IF
	
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where brbm = :ls_brbm And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		is_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		GOTO err
	END IF
	
ELSE
	GOTO err
END IF

RETURN 1

err:
//MessageBox("提示",as_error)
uf_write_log(is_xxtlx + " 错误:::::" + is_error ,0)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
	DELETE From JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	DELETE From JKXT.YB_ZFSCMX Where brbm = :ls_brbm And YWLSH = :ls_fplsh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)

RETURN -1



end function

private function string of_get_errormessage (string as_returncode);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_get_errormessage()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据错误代码返回错误描述
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_returncode	返回码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//0	交易成功	无错误信息
//-1	系统错误（包括通讯错误）	有错误信息
//-200	未知错误	有错误信息
//-300	报文合法性错误	有错误信息
//-400	业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误后立即退出程序）	有错误信息
//-500	业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）	无错误信息，一般以交易结果信息返回


CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_returncode)
	CASE '-1'
		RETURN '系统错误（包括通讯错误）'
		
	CASE '-200'
		RETURN '未知错误'
	CASE '-300'
		RETURN '报文合法性错误'
	CASE '-400'
		RETURN '业务错误（不可执行的错误，碰到错误后立即退出程序）'
	CASE '-500'
		RETURN '业务错误（可执行的错误，程序运行完，最后返回相应的信息）'	
	case else
		return ''
END CHOOSE

end function

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
Integer li_1 = 0
String ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
IF IsNull(ad_datavalue) THEN RETURN ''
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'da','db','df','dj','dk','dl','dn' //�2位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		END IF
	CASE 'de','dg' //3位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dd','dh','di' //4位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dc'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0')
		END IF
	CASE 'dm'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0')
		END IF
END CHOOSE



end function

public subroutine uf_get_ksxx (long al_ksdm, ref string as_ybdm, ref string as_ybmc);select yb_ksdm,yb_ksmc into :as_ybdm,:as_ybmc from BQXT.YB_KSDZ where ksdm = :al_ksdm;
if isnull(as_ybdm) then as_ybdm = '0'
if isnull(as_ybmc) then as_ybmc = '0'

end subroutine

public function date uf_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
		if len(ls_datavalue)= 8 then
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		end if
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function date uf_getdate_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'd' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类蠨AT* ('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dta'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dtb'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)))
			
	
	case else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
		setnull(ldt_datavalue)
		return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if


end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为datetime类型)，返回发送时的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================


int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
//		case 'dtb'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		case else
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			setnull(ldt_datavalue)
			return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if

end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyymmdd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
String ls_ip
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\YDZFMedInterface.dll' ) = False Or FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\webservice2.dll' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\webservice2.dll 或YDZFMedInterface.dll)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\EPTradeCfg_YDZF.ini' ) = False  THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ 'EPTradeCfg_YDZF.ini)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\EPTradeCfg_YDZF.ini", "WEBSERVICE",  "IP", "")
	IF is_pyybip <> ls_ip And is_pyybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
		is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和EPTradeCfg_YDZF的WEBSERVICE的IP不匹配，请检查"
		ib_init_success = False
		//		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF

IF is_init_date <> String(Today(),'yyyymmdd') THEN
	IF Not of_yb_date_init(is_error) THEN
		is_init_errormessage = 'f_Init初始化出错:' + is_error
		ib_init_success = False
		return
	END IF
END IF

Integer li_xhxh
SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval Into :li_xhxh From dual Using itran_sqlca;
is_jylsh = String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+String(Now(),'hhmmss')+Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
ib_init_success = True
is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )
//IF ib_sydzf_zlb THEN
//	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构代码', is_yljgdm)
//	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构名称', is_yljgmc)
//
//	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构类型', '00')
//	This.uf_send_add( '交易发起机构统筹区', is_yljgxzqh)
//END IF
end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYY-MM-DD HHMMSS
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYY-MM-DD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

public subroutine uf_send_add_in (string as_name, date ad_datavalue, long al_row);//====================================================================

private function integer of_get_index (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: of_get_index()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	获取字段名所在的位置
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx   		消息体类型
// 	value	string	as_name	字段名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 20011.8.4
//====================================================================
ids_structre.SetFilter( "")
ids_structre.Filter( )
Long ll_find

ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" + Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + Upper(as_jkfl) + "' and Upper(mxnr)='" + Upper(as_name) + "'",1,999999)

IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.Object.pxxh[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find])
		ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)

	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +string(al_row))
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存訢AT* ('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);integer li_ds = 0,i
string ls_end

FOR i = 1 TO len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 AND Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	return false
else
	return true
end if

end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);//if len( //as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len) //if not of_if_char(as_string) then //	as_string = mid(as_string,1,ai_len -1) //
//	as_string = as_string + ' '
//end if

//as_string = leftw(left(as_string,ai_len),ai_len)
as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================
is_psamid = '100'
return 1
IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)
	//	licc_config.port = 100
	//	licc_config.baud= 9600
	//	licc_config.timeout = 6000
	//	setnull(licc_config)
	
	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
//		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
//		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function
