public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2017-10-10
//====================================================================

//ib_yktdy = False
String ls_ip
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\BargaingApplyV3_01044.dll' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\BargaingApplyV3_01044.dll)不存在，请先安装'
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\TradeCfgV3_01044.ini' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医保的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '下的TradeCfgV3_01044.ini)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\TradeCfgV3_01044.ini", "SYSTEM",  "NativeAddress", "")
	IF is_tzybip <> ls_ip And is_tzybip1 <> ls_ip THEN
		is_init_errormessage = "数据库中医保前置机IP地址和TradeCfgV3_01044.ini的NativeAddress不匹配，请检查"
		ib_init_success = False
		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
ib_init_success = True

is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )

end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式yyyymmdd hh24miss
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYYMMDD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYYMMDD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

public subroutine uf_send_add_in (string as_name, date ad_datavalue, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: uf_send_add_in()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	date   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//    value long     al_row 行
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Long li_row
Int li_len[]
DateTime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置

//插入要发送的数据
//as_name = Lower(as_name)
IF LEFT(is_xxtlx,1) = '3' AND LEN(is_xxtlx) = 4 THEN
//		return ids_structre.object.mxnr[ll_find]
	ELSE
		as_name = lower(as_name)
	END IF
li_row = ids_send_in.Find("dataname = '"+as_name+"' and datrow="+String(al_row)+" and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.RowCount())
IF li_row <= 0 THEN li_row = ids_send_in.InsertRow(0)
ids_send_in.Object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
ids_send_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = al_row
ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(ad_datavalue,'yyyymmdd')
ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
uf_send_add_in_count(is_mxnr,al_row)


end subroutine

// 函数: uf_send_add_in()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容

//返回对应的字段位置
//if of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'JG',as_name) = 0 then 
//	messagebox('信息窗口','字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
//else
	//插入要发送的数据
//as_name = lower(as_name)
IF LEFT(is_xxtlx,1) = '3' AND LEN(is_xxtlx) = 4 THEN
//		return ids_structre.object.mxnr[ll_find]
	ELSE
		as_name = lower(as_name)
	END IF
li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"' and datarow="+string(al_row)+" and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())

ids_send_in.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row]  = al_row
ids_send_in.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyymmdd/hhmmss/')
ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
uf_send_add_in_count(is_mxnr,al_row)
//end if
end subroutine

private function integer of_get_index (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: of_get_index()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	获取字段名所在的位置
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx   		消息体类型
// 	value	string	as_name	字段名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 20011.8.4
//====================================================================
ids_structre.SetFilter( "")
ids_structre.Filter( )
Long ll_find

ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" + Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + Upper(as_jkfl) + "' and Upper(mxnr)='" + Upper(as_name) + "'",1,999999)


IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.Object.pxxh[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF


end function

public function string of_get_jklx_format (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+string(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_structre.object.mxlx[ll_find]
else
	return ''
end if

end function

public function string of_get_jklx_mc (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+string(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	IF (LEFT(as_jklx,1) = '3' AND LEN(as_jklx) = 4) or upper(as_jklx) = upper('HospitalClaim') or upper(as_jklx) = upper('ClaimDetailHospital') THEN
		return ids_structre.object.mxnr[ll_find]
	ELSE
		return lower(ids_structre.object.mxnr[ll_find])
	END IF
else
	return ''
end if

end function

ids_structre.filter()

return ids_structre.rowcount()

end function

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +string(al_row))
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);integer li_ds = 0,i
string ls_end

FOR i = 1 TO len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 AND Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	return false
else
	return true
end if

end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================

IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)
	//	licc_config.port = 100
	//	licc_config.baud= 9600
	//	licc_config.timeout = 6000
	//	setnull(licc_config)
	
	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = space(38)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		//gf_rtxmsg("读取PSAM卡失败")
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.开始uf_send()")  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市盌AT*
.开始uf_send()
il_time_pre = CPU()
//医保init是否正确
IF Not ib_init_success THEN
	as_return = '医保初始化出错：' + is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF

Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Boolean lb_find
Integer li_last_fgfh_gs
ls_xxt = ''
IF is_init_date <> String(Today(),'yyyymmdd') THEN
	IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_return) THEN
		as_return = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_return
		RETURN False
	END IF
END IF
//返回对应的消息体格式
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
//串联所有的消息体
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),ls_datavalue,  as_return) = False THEN RETURN False
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN False
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
	END IF
	IF li_i = li_bound THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
	ELSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue + of_get_jklx_fgfh(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
	END IF
NEXT
ls_send = '$$' +ls_xxt + '$$'
IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
//台州健康卡调用需要返回报文，作为调用用 2021-3-18 sxl
IF ib_yktdy and (is_xxtlx ='29' or is_xxtlx = '30') THEN
	as_return = ls_send
	gf_applog('tkydy:' + string(ib_yktdy) + '  send:' + ls_send)
	RETURN True
END IF
//--------

gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_send()发送报文构造完成，准备通信      历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_send()发送报文构造完成，准备通信
il_time_pre = CPU()
TRY
	Integer li_xxtlx,li_ret
	Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
	ls_recieve = Space(8000)
	li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
	
	li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(li_xxtlx,li_jylsh,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)
	//	IF base_info.userid = '209134' THEN
	//		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ string(li_xxtlx)+']  发送:'+ls_send )
	//		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接收:'+ls_recieve)
	//	END IF
	//	MessageBox(ls_send,ls_recieve)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		il_time_pre = CPU()
		Long ll_pos,ll_pos2
		String ls_error
		IF li_xxtlx = 52 THEN //台州匹配目录上传错误信息另外取
			ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , 1 )
			ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
			ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos2 + 1 )
			ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
			ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos2 + 1 )
			li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,3,ll_pos - 3))
			ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1,Len(ls_recieve) - ll_pos - 2)
		ELSE
			ll_pos = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , 1 )
			ll_pos2 = Pos (ls_recieve, '~~' , ll_pos + 1 )
			IF ll_pos2 = 0 THEN ll_pos2 = Len(ls_recieve) - 2
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				li_ret = Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,3,ll_pos - 3))
				ls_error = Mid(ls_recieve,ll_pos + 1,ll_pos2 - ll_pos)
			END IF
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_error) THEN ls_error = '' //+ of_get_errormessage( String(li_ret) 		gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_send()通信出错×                      历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+ls_error)  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_send()通信出错× 		il_time_pre = CPU() 		as_return = '社保出错：代码' +String(li_ret) + ';'+ ls_error 		RETURN False
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_send()捕捉到错误×                    历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre)+" 错误："+er2.Text)  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_send()捕捉到错误×
	il_time_pre = CPU()
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_send()通信成功○                      历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_send()通信成功○
il_time_pre = CPU()
//把当前发送的内容转移掉
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)

RETURN of_receive_data(ls_recieve,as_return)

end function

public function string of_get_jklx_fgfh (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+string(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	if isnull(ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find]) or ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find] = '' then
		return "~~"
	else
		return ids_structre.object.fgfh[ll_find]
	end if
else
	return "~~"
end if

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, ref string as_msg);Integer li_bound,li_i
Long ll_find,ll_row
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue
as_data = ''

IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_data = ''
	RETURN True
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
//串联所有的消息体
FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_send_in.Object.max_datarow[1]
	
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','dta','dtb'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		as_data = as_data + ls_datavalue + '%%'
	NEXT
NEXT

as_data = Mid(as_data,1,Len(as_data) - 2 )
RETURN True

end function

private function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm //ls_mc[],ls_format[],
Long li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_row,li_find //li_len[],
Boolean lb_return = True
//返回数据的判断
If (IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '')  THEN
	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
	RETURN False
END IF

//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive.Reset()
ids_receive_in.Reset()

ls_xxt = as_xxt
ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt,3)
ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt,1,Len(ls_xxt) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx, 'YD')
String ls_return1	,ls_dataname
Integer li_pos = 0,li_pos_rs
li_sum = 0
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"~~")
	ELSE
		
		IF Pos(ls_xxt,"~~") > Pos(ls_xxt,"%%") And  Pos(ls_xxt,"%%") > 0  THEN
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%")
			li_pos_rs = 2
		ELSE
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"~~")
			li_pos_rs = 1
		END IF
	END IF
	IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
		li_pos = Len(ls_xxt)
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos)) //li_len[li_i]))
	ELSE
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	END IF
	
	ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
	
	ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
	ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname //ls_mc[li_i]
	li_sum = li_pos + li_pos_rs
	ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt ,li_sum) //li_len[li_i]
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN
		IF of_receivein_data(  This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ),ls_datavalue, ls_return1,This.of_get_jklx_oldmc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )) = False THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_return1) THEN ls_return1 = ''
			as_return = as_return +ls_return1
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

RETURN lb_return

end function

ib_init_success = true
ids_receive = Create u_datastore
ids_receive.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_old = Create u_datastore
ids_send_old.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)

	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send_in = Create u_datastore

	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore

	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'

IF lds_temp.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE JKFL = 'JG' AND YBFL = 'EPTZ' ") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	lds_temp.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	lds_temp.Retrieve()
END IF


ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,'~' AS FGFH,mxnr as mxnr_old from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL = 'EPTZ' ") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	Long ll_row,i,li_cd,ll_rowcount,ll_insert
	String ls_jgdm
	ll_rowcount = ids_structre.Retrieve()
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row]) > '0'	THEN //结构
			ls_jgdm = Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row])
			lds_temp.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" + ls_jgdm +"'")
			lds_temp.Filter()
			lds_temp.SetSort("PXXH A")
			lds_temp.Sort()
			
			IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					ll_insert = ids_structre.InsertRow(0)
					ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_insert] = ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row]
					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.MXNR[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
					ids_structre.Object.mxlx[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.mxlx[i]
					ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_insert] = ''
					ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_insert] = 0
					ids_structre.Object.JGPXXH[ll_insert] = lds_temp.Object.PXXH[i]
					IF i = lds_temp.RowCount() THEN
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '~~'
					ELSE
						ids_structre.Object.FGFH[ll_insert] = '%%'
					END IF
				NEXT
				ids_structre.DeleteRow(ll_row)
				ll_row --
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				li_cd = 0
				
				FOR i = 1 To lds_temp.RowCount()
					//					if ids_structre.object.jklx[ll_row] = 'S001' then
					//						messagebox(string(li_cd),string(li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]))
					//					end if
					li_cd = li_cd + lds_temp.Object.mxcd[i]
				NEXT
				ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'
				//				IF ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] > 1 THEN
				//					ids_structre.Object.jgcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				//	if ids_structre.object.jklx[ll_row] = 'S001' then messagebox(string(ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row]),string(li_cd))
				//					li_cd = li_cd * ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row]
				//					ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'	
				//				elseif ids_structre.Object.XHCS[ll_row] = -1 then
				//					ids_structre.Object.jgcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				END IF
				//				if ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_row] = -1 then
				//				else
				//					ids_structre.Object.mxcd[ll_row] = li_cd
				//				end if
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	ids_structre.SetSort("JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,JGPXXH")
	ids_structre.Sort()
	String ls_jklx_old = ''
	String ls_jkfl_old = ''
	Integer li_pxxh = 0
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
		IF ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row] <> ls_jklx_old Or ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row] <> ls_jkfl_old THEN
			li_pxxh = 0
		END IF
		li_pxxh ++
		ids_structre.Object.PXXH[ll_row] = li_pxxh
		ls_jklx_old = ids_structre.Object.JKLX[ll_row]
		ls_jkfl_old = ids_structre.Object.JKFL[ll_row]
	NEXT
END IF

is_yljgdm = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YB_YYDM_NEW","","医保医院代码")
is_yljgdm_tzsyd = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"TZSYD_YYDM_NEW",'331099200014',"台州市异地医保医院代码")
is_yljgxzqh  = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YLJGSZDXZQH","330399","医疗机构所在地行政区划")

is_tzybip = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YBQZJIPDZ","173.1.0.9","医保前置机IP地址")
is_tzybip1 = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YBQZJIPDZ1","173.1.0.9","医保前置机IP地址1")
il_baqy = Integer(gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"BAQY","0","备案启用"))
is_tzsbj = gf_getpara(0,'TZSBJXZQH','331001,331002,331003,331004,331099','台州市本级行政区划')
SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('userenv', 'ip_address') client_ip into :is_agentip  FROM DUAL using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(is_yljgdm) Or Trim(is_yljgdm) = '' THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '医疗结构代码未设置'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

IF IsNull(is_tzybip) Or Trim(is_tzybip) = '' THEN

IF ib_init_success = False THEN gf_sblogmsg('初始失败:'+is_init_errormessage)

Destroy lds_temp

end function

public function string of_get_jklx_oldmc (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF left(as_jklx,1) = '3' and len(as_jklx) = 4 then
		RETURN ids_structre.Object.mxnr_old[ll_find]
	else
		RETURN Lower(ids_structre.Object.mxnr_old[ll_find])
	end if
ELSE
	RETURN ''
END IF


end function

private function boolean of_receivein_data (string as_xxlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return, string as_mxnr);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
is_mxnr = as_mxnr

String ls_mc[],ls_format[],ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm
Int li_len[],li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_datarow,li_pos
Long ll_row,ll_find

//返回数据的判断
ls_xxt = as_xxt

li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxlx , 'JG')
li_sum = 0
li_datarow = 0
//加一条明细条数
ids_receive_in.InsertRow(1)
ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[1] ='0'
ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = 0
ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[1] = 'datacount'
ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[1] = as_mxnr
DO WHILE Len(ls_xxt) > li_sum
	IF Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum+1)) = '' THEN
		RETURN True
	END IF
	li_datarow ++
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = li_datarow
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ll_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
		IF li_sum = 0 THEN
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%")
		ELSE
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"%%",li_pos + 2)
		END IF
		IF li_pos <= 0 THEN li_pos = Len(ls_xxt) + 1
		
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum + 1,li_pos - (li_sum + 1) )) //li_len[li_i]))
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[ll_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[ll_row] = li_datarow
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[ll_row] = as_mxnr
		ll_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = 'rowcount'",1,999999)
		
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN ll_find = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[ll_find] = String(li_datarow)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[ll_find] = 's'
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[ll_find] = 'rowcount'
		
		li_sum = li_pos + 1 //li_len[li_i]
	NEXT
LOOP
//ids_receive_in.saveas( "c:\receive_in.txt",text!,true)
RETURN True

end function

public function long uf_getstring_mxnr (string as_mxnr);//解析的时候，多个结构体调用，获取某个结构体的内容，个数
is_mxnr = as_mxnr
long ll_find
ll_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = Upper ('datacount')  and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())
if ll_find > 0 then 
	return ids_receive_in.object.datarow[ll_find]
else
	return -1
end if

end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 	 	  = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
RETURN 1




end function

		is_error = '创建临时事务失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	//	
IF Not IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) THEN
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	//	END IF
	//	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
	//	else
	//	
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	//		gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
	//		
	//		CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
	//	end if
	String ls_error
	IF uf_set_instance(ls_error) < 0 THEN
		is_error = ls_error
		RETURN -2
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数组
//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

long		ll_pos ,ll_len

If as_str = '' or isnull(as_str)  &
or	as_find = as_replace then return as_str

ll_len = len(as_replace)

Do 
	
	if ll_pos + ll_len = 0 then
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	else
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	end if
	If ll_pos > 0 then 
		as_str = replace(as_str,ll_pos,len(as_find),as_replace)
	end iF

Loop while ll_pos > 0 

//messagebox('',as_str)
return as_str 

end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'~~','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'$$','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"'",'')
return as_string
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add_in_count (string as_mxnr, long al_row);int li_row
li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = 'datacount' and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())
if li_row > 0 then 
	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = al_row
end if

end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_add_in_mxnr (string as_mxnr);int li_row
is_mxnr = as_mxnr

li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = 'datacount' and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(is_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())
if li_row <= 0 then 
	li_row = ids_send_in.insertrow(0)
	ids_send_in.object.dataname[li_row] = 'datacount'
	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = 1
	ids_send_in.object.datavalue[li_row] = '0'
	ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
end if

end subroutine

public function integer of_makefile (string as_fname, string as_txt, ref string as_err);// return :  0 : exist  >0 :make a empty(line mode)  <0 : can't make  integer li_FileNum=0 li_FileNum = FileOpen(as_fname,LineMode!, Write!, LockWrite!, Replace!   )

	filewrite(li_FileNum,as_txt)
else
	FileClose(li_FileNum)
	as_err = "创建文件：" + as_fname + " 失败！"
	return -1
end if
if FileClose(li_FileNum)<>1 then
	if FileClose(li_FileNum)<>1 then
		li_FileNum = -1
	end if
end if


if not fileexists(as_fname) then li_FileNum = -1
	
return li_FileNum
end function

public function long of_get_jklx_len (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);long ll_find
ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()

if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_structre.GetItemDecimal(ll_find, "mxcd") //ids_structre.object.mxcd[ll_find]
else
	return -1
end if

end function

public function long of_get_jklx_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.GetItemNumber( ll_find, "xhcs")
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF


end function

public function integer of_get_jklx_xht_count (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl);Long ll_temp

ids_structre.Filter()

IF ll_temp = 1 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.RowCount()
ELSE
	RETURN ids_structre.RowCount() + 1
END IF


end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin_ygyb (string as_jklx, ref string as_data, integer ai_len, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);
Integer li_bound,li_i,li_datalen //li_len[],
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_xhcs
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue,ls_xmltitle
as_data = ''
ids_send_in.SetFilter( "upper(mxnr) = '"+upper(as_mxnr)+"'")
ids_send_in.Filter( )

IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	ids_send_in.SetFilter( "")
	ids_send_in.Filter( )
	as_msg = "找不到对应的明细"
	RETURN False
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
ll_xhcs = ids_send_in.Find("dataname = 'datacount' and upper(datamxnr)='"+upper(as_mxnr)+"'",1,ids_send_in.RowCount())
IF ll_xhcs <= 0  THEN
	ids_send_in.SetFilter( "")
	ids_send_in.Filter( )
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	RETURN False
END IF
ll_xhcs = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_xhcs]

FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_xhcs
	as_data = as_data + "<" + as_jklx + ">" 
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find( "lower(dataname) = '"+lower(ls_dataname)+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		
		li_datalen = This.of_get_jklx_len( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //li_len[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				if len(ls_datavalue) > li_datalen then
					of_midstring(ls_datavalue,li_datalen)
				END IF
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
				ls_datavalue = string(dec(ls_datavalue))
		END CHOOSE
		IF isnull(ls_datavalue) then ls_datavalue = ''
		as_data = as_data + "<"+ ls_dataname+">" + ls_datavalue +"</"+  ls_dataname+">"
	NEXT
	as_data += "</" + as_jklx+ ">"
NEXT
RETURN True

end function

public function integer uf_send_ygyb (ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
Int li_i,li_bound,li_find,li_datalen
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_jgdm,ls_mxnr
//在这里判断初始化是否成功
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN -1
END IF
//返回对应的消息体格式
ls_xxt = ''
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx,'QQ', li_i)
	
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
		ls_mxnr = of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
		IF of_get_sendin_ygyb( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'QQ',li_i),ls_datavalue, This.of_get_jklx_len(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i), as_return,ls_mxnr) = False THEN RETURN -1
		
		IF of_get_jklx_xhcs( is_xxtlx,'QQ', li_i) > 1 THEN
			ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "<"+ls_mxnr+">" + ls_datavalue + "</"+ls_mxnr+">"
		ELSE
			ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
		END IF
		
	ELSEIF Lower(ls_dataname) = 'b_packhospital' THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "<PackHospital xmlns='http://schemas.datacontract.org/2004/07/BMI.Engine.Common.Hospital' xmlns:i='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance'>"
	ELSEIF Lower(ls_dataname) = 'e_packhospital' THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + "</PackHospital>"
	ELSE
		ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		li_find = ids_send.Find( "lower(dataname) = '"+lower(ls_dataname)+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
		IF li_find < 1 THEN
			IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
				ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
				li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
				ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
				ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
			ELSE
				as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
		
		li_datalen = This.of_get_jklx_len(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //li_len[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				of_midstring(ls_datavalue,li_datalen)
				ls_datavalue = ls_datavalue
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
		END CHOOSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + '<'+ls_dataname+'>' + ls_datavalue +'</'+ls_dataname+'>'
	END IF
NEXT

//-------------------------- //cmdHeadXml  消息头----------------
ls_send = "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='UTF-8'?><MSG><HEAD>"
ls_send = ls_send +"<VER>"+istr_jytsrx.VER+"</VER>" //版本号
ls_send = ls_send +"<YLJGDM>"+istr_jytsrx.YLJGDM+"</YLJGDM>" //医疗机构代码  ??
ls_send = ls_send +"<YLJGXZQH>"+istr_jytsrx.YLJGXZQH+"</YLJGXZQH>" //医疗机构行政区划
ls_send = ls_send +"<AGENTIP>"+istr_jytsrx.AGENTIP+"</AGENTIP>" //操作设备IP地址
ls_send = ls_send +"<AGENTMAC>"+istr_jytsrx.AGENTMAC+"</AGENTMAC>" //操作设备MAC地址
ls_send = ls_send +"<SBKH>"+istr_jytsrx.SBKH+"</SBKH>" //社保卡号 SBKH-SBKSBH
ls_send = ls_send +"<SBKSBH>"+istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH+"</SBKSBH>" //社保卡识别号
ls_send = ls_send +"<SFZH>"+istr_jytsrx.SFZH+"</SFZH>" //身份证号
ls_send = ls_send +"<CBRXZQH>"+istr_jytsrx.CBRXZQH+"</CBRXZQH>" //参保人行政区号
ls_send = ls_send +"<JZWYBH>"+istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH+"</JZWYBH>" //就诊编号，医院上传挂号时生成的编号
ls_send = ls_send +"<XXLXM>"+istr_jytsrx.XXLXM+"</XXLXM>" //编码，见消息类型
ls_send = ls_send +"<JYSJ>"+String(istr_jytsrx.JYSJ,'yyyymmdd/hhmmss/')+"</JYSJ>" //交易时间（格式：年月日/时分秒/）YYYYMMDD/HHMISS/
ls_send = ls_send +"</HEAD>" //cmdHeadXml  消息头
//------------------------------------------------------------------------	
IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF

//针对下载类或者数据量大业务交易，进行循环调用
Int li_ret
as_return = ''
ls_recieve = Space(4000000)

TRY
	ls_send = ls_send +"<BODY>" +  ls_xxt + "</BODY></MSG>"
	IF IsNull(ls_xxt) THEN ls_xxt = ''
	ls_recieve = Audit4HospitalPortal (	ls_send)
	IF base_info.UserID = '209134' THEN
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','【'+is_xxtlx+'】消息体:'+ls_send)
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','【'+is_xxtlx+'】recieve:'+ls_recieve)
	END IF
	if isnumber(mid(ls_recieve,1,1)) then
		li_ret = integer(mid(ls_recieve,1,1))
	ELSE
		li_ret= -1
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN -1
END TRY
IF li_ret <= 0 THEN
	as_return = istr_jytsrx.XXLXM + '阳光医保发送错误：' + ls_recieve
ELSE
	as_return = istr_jytsrx.XXLXM + ':' + ls_recieve
END IF
RETURN li_ret





end function

public function string of_get_dmmc (string as_dmlb, string as_dmsb);long ll_find

ll_find = ids_dmzd_jk.find("dmlb='" + as_dmlb + "' and dmsb = '" +as_dmsb + "'",1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_dmzd_jk.object.dmmc[ll_find]
else
	return '无'
end if
end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);
if UPPER(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' then
	return ''
end if

long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.find("Upper(tname)='" + UPPER(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + string(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+string(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then

	return ids_dmzd_dz.object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
else
	return '无'
end if
end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, string as_dmmc);//取对照表GY_DMZD中的，不同DMLB的，DMMC的医保对照
//如 药品的剂型 ml 获取对应的医保对照信息
if UPPER(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' then
	return ''
end if

long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.find("Upper(tname)='" + UPPER(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + string(as_dmlb) + " and Upper(dmmc) ='"+Upper(as_dmmc)+"'",1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then

	return ids_dmzd_dz.object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
else
//	if as_dmlb  = '1404' then return '501004'
	if as_dmlb  = '1404' then return '次'
	return '无'
end if
end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM' Or Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN //wangyi 20200319 诊断单独拿出来获取
//	IF Pos(is_tjzddm,as_tjlxh) > 0 THEN //WANGYI 20190515 诊断为体检，返回空，不让结算医保
//		RETURN ''
//	
END IF
	
	ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
	ELSE
		RETURN '无'
	END IF
END IF

ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_KSDM' THEN
		RETURN ''
	ELSE
		RETURN '无'
	END IF
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsbmc (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] > '' THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find]
	ELSE
		String ls_dmmc
		CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
			CASE 'GY_KSDM'
				SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :as_tjlxh;
			CASE 'MZ_KS'
				SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh;
			CASE 'YK_YPSX'
				SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		END CHOOSE
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tname[ll_find] = Upper(as_table)
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tjlxh[ll_find] = as_tjlxh
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] = ls_dmmc
		RETURN ls_dmmc
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN 'NULL'
END IF

end function

public function long of_get_jbxx (integer ai_yplx, long al_ypxh, long al_ypcd, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk_new_his.of_get_jbxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:取得基本信息的行，如果内存中无基本信息，数据库取得写入
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	integer	ai_yplx	
// 	value	long   	al_ypxh	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  long 行数
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2012.02.29
//====================================================================
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_sql
IF Not IsValid(ids_typk) THEN
	ids_typk = Create u_datastore
	ids_typk.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " select YK_TYPK.ypxh,YK_TYPK.YB_DZBH,YK_TYPK.YPJL,YK_TYPK.JLDW,YK_TYPK.YFGG,YK_TYPK.BFGG,"+&
		"YK_TYPK.BFDW,YK_TYPK.YFDW,YK_TYPK.ZJPB,YK_TYPK.TYPE,YK_TYPK.ZXDW,YK_TYPK.KZYP,0.00 as ZFBL,'' as YYXMBM, '1' as YPZLLB,'' AS YYXMMC,'' AS SNTYBM " +&
		" , YK_TYPK.YPSX as ypsx,0 as YPCD , '' as GJYPBM FROM YK_TYPK "
	IF ids_typk.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'药品信息'对象失败("+ids_typk.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
IF Not IsValid(ids_ylsf) THEN
	ids_ylsf = Create u_datastore
	ids_ylsf.setworktrans( itran_sqlca) // 9              10               11          12
	ls_sql = " select fyxh,YBZXBH,fymc,fydw,FYGB,0 AS KZPB,0 AS TSDZ,0.00 as ZFBL,'' as YYXMBM, '2' as YPZLLB,'' AS YYXMMC,'' AS SNTYBM , GJYBBM FROM GY_YLSF  "
	IF ids_ylsf.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_ylsf.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
//IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz) THEN
//
//	ids_yb_tsdz = Create U_datastore
//	ls_sql = " select FYLX,FYXH,YBZXBH,KSSJ,JSSJ FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ  "
//	IF ids_yb_tsdz.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
//		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_yb_tsdz.is_error+")!"
//		RETURN -1
//	else
//		ids_yb_tsdz.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql )
//		ids_yb_tsdz.retrieve()		
//	END IF
//end if

Long ll_find
String ls_ypzllb,ls_yyxmmc,ls_yybh,ls_sntybm,ls_gjybbm = ''
IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN //药品
	ls_yybh = 'Y' + String(al_ypxh) + '#' + String(al_ypcd)
	ll_find = ids_typk.Find(" YYXMBM = '" + ls_yybh + "'",1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ll_find
	ELSE
		Long ll_ypxh,ll_ypsx
		Integer li_zjpb,li_type,li_kzyp
		Dec{3} ldc_ypjl
		String ls_yb_dzbh,ls_jldw,ls_yfgg,ls_bfgg,ls_bfdw,ls_yfdw,ls_zxdw,ls_ypmc
		IF al_ypcd = 0 THEN
			SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,YK_YPCD.YB_DZBH,YPJL,JLDW,YFGG,BFGG,BFDW,YFDW,ZJPB,TYPE,ZXDW,KZYP,YPSX,YK_YPCD.YPCD,GJYPBM,YK_TYPK.YPMC
				INTO :ll_ypxh,:ls_yb_dzbh,:ldc_ypjl,:ls_jldw,:ls_yfgg,:ls_bfgg,:ls_bfdw,:ls_yfdw,:li_zjpb,:li_type,:ls_zxdw,:li_kzyp,:ll_ypsx,:al_ypcd,:ls_gjybbm,:ls_ypmc
				FROM YPXT.YK_TYPK,YPXT.YK_YPCD
				Where YK_TYPK.YPXH = :al_ypxh And YK_TYPK.YPXH = YK_YPCD.YPXH And YK_YPCD.ZFPB = 0 And rownum = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,YK_YPCD.YB_DZBH,YPJL,JLDW,YFGG,BFGG,BFDW,YFDW,ZJPB,TYPE,ZXDW,KZYP,YPSX,GJYPBM,YK_TYPK.YPMC
				INTO :ll_ypxh,:ls_yb_dzbh,:ldc_ypjl,:ls_jldw,:ls_yfgg,:ls_bfgg,:ls_bfdw,:ls_yfdw,:li_zjpb,:li_type,:ls_zxdw,:li_kzyp,:ll_ypsx,:ls_gjybbm,:ls_ypmc
				FROM YPXT.YK_TYPK,YPXT.YK_YPCD
				Where YK_TYPK.YPXH = :al_ypxh And YK_TYPK.YPXH = YK_YPCD.YPXH And YK_YPCD.YPCD = :al_ypcd Using itran_sqlca;
		END IF
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
				IF IsNull(ls_gjybbm) Or Trim(ls_gjybbm) = '' THEN
					ls_gjybbm = ''
//					as_error = '药品：'  + ls_ypmc +' 对应的国家编码未维护，请核对。' + String(al_ypxh)
//					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			SELECT YPZLLB,YYXMMC,SNTYBM Into :ls_ypzllb,:ls_yyxmmc,:ls_sntybm From JKXT.PYYB_YPZLPP Where YYXMBM = :ls_yybh And spjg = '1' And sqlx = '1' Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				IF Not IsNull(ls_yb_dzbh) And ls_yb_dzbh <> '' And ls_sntybm <> ls_yb_dzbh THEN
					as_error = '药品：' + String(al_ypxh) + ls_yyxmmc +'匹配目录与药品字典中的市级中心编码不一致，请核对'
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ll_find = ids_typk.InsertRow(0)
				ids_typk.Object.YPXH[ll_find] = ll_ypxh
				ids_typk.Object.YB_DZBH[ll_find] = ls_yb_dzbh
				ids_typk.Object.YPJL[ll_find] = ldc_ypjl
				ids_typk.Object.JLDW[ll_find] = ls_jldw
				ids_typk.Object.YFGG[ll_find] = ls_yfgg
				ids_typk.Object.BFGG[ll_find] = ls_bfgg
				ids_typk.Object.YFDW[ll_find] = ls_yfdw
				ids_typk.Object.BFDW[ll_find] = ls_bfdw
				ids_typk.Object.ZJPB[ll_find] = li_zjpb
				ids_typk.Object.Type[ll_find] = li_type
				ids_typk.Object.ZXDW[ll_find] = ls_zxdw
				ids_typk.Object.KZYP[ll_find] = li_kzyp
				ids_typk.Object.YPZLLB[ll_find] = ls_ypzllb
				ids_typk.Object.YYXMMC[ll_find] = ls_yyxmmc
				ids_typk.Object.SNTYBM[ll_find] = ls_sntybm
				ids_typk.Object.YYXMBM[ll_find] = ls_yybh
				ids_typk.Object.YPSX[ll_find] = ll_ypsx
				ids_typk.Object.YPCD[ll_find] = al_ypcd
				ids_typk.Object.GJYPBM[ll_find] = ls_gjybbm
				RETURN ll_find
			ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				as_error = ls_ypmc + ' 取不到药品匹配信息2:请检查' + ls_yybh + '是否已经匹配，或者审核通过!' + String(al_ypxh)
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = ls_ypmc + ' 取药品匹配信息出错:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + String(al_ypxh)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = String(al_ypxh) + ' 取不到药品基本信息:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText 
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE //费用
	ls_yybh = 'F' + String(al_ypxh)
	ll_find = ids_ylsf.Find(" YYXMBM = '" + ls_yybh + "'",1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ll_find
	ELSE
		Long ll_fyxh
		//		integer li_tsdz = 0 
		Integer li_fygb,li_kzpb = 0
		String ls_ybzxbh,ls_fymc,ls_fydw
		SELECT FYXH ,YBZXBH,FYMC,FYDW,FYGB,GJYBBM INTO :ll_fyxh,:ls_ybzxbh,:ls_fymc,:ls_fydw,:li_fygb,:ls_gjybbm
			From XTGL.GY_YLSF Where FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
				IF IsNull(ls_gjybbm) Or Trim(ls_gjybbm) = '' THEN
					ls_gjybbm = ''
//					as_error = '费用：'  + ls_fymc +' 对应的国家编码未维护，请核对。' + String(al_ypxh)
//					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			SELECT a.YPZLLB,b.YPZLMC,a.SNTYBM INTO :ls_ypzllb,:ls_yyxmmc,:ls_sntybm FROM JKXT.PYYB_YPZLPP a, JKXT.TZYB_YPZLML b
				Where a.YYXMBM = :ls_yybh And a.spjg = '1' And a.sqlx = '1' And a.SNTYBM = b.YPZXLSH Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				IF Not IsNull(ls_ybzxbh) And ls_ybzxbh <> '' And ls_sntybm <> ls_ybzxbh THEN
					as_error = '费用：' + String(al_ypxh) + ls_yyxmmc +'匹配目录与收费项目中的市级中心编码不一致，请核对'
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ll_find = ids_ylsf.InsertRow(0)
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYXH[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
				ids_ylsf.Object.YBZXBH[ll_find] = ls_ybzxbh
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYMC[ll_find] = ls_fymc
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYDW[ll_find] = ls_fydw
				ids_ylsf.Object.FYGB[ll_find] = li_fygb
				ids_ylsf.Object.YPZLLB[ll_find] = ls_ypzllb
				ids_ylsf.Object.YYXMMC[ll_find] = ls_yyxmmc
				ids_ylsf.Object.SNTYBM[ll_find] = ls_sntybm
				ids_ylsf.Object.YYXMBM[ll_find] = ls_yybh
				ids_ylsf.Object.GJYBBM[ll_find] = ls_gjybbm
				SELECT KZPB Into :li_kzpb From XTGL.GY_YLSF_KZ Where FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
				ids_ylsf.Object.KZPB[ll_find] = li_kzpb
				//			if li_tsdz > 0 then
				//				ids_ylsf.object.tsdz[ll_find] = 1
				//			end if
				RETURN ll_find
			ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				as_error = ls_fymc + ' 取不到费用匹配信息2:请检查' + ls_yybh + '是否已经匹配，或者审核通过!'
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = ls_fymc + ' 取费用匹配信息出错:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + ls_yybh
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = ' 取不到费用基本信息:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + ls_yybh
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

RETURN ll_find

end function

public function integer of_get_jzxlh (ref string as_jzxlh, integer ai_jslx, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已测

Decimal{0} ll_Value
Long ll_Count
Long ll_Retry
//判断事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	Process_Begin:
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	
	UPDATE GY_IDENTITY SET VALUE = VALUE + 1
		Where TNAME = 'TZYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN // update失败，判断是否存在记录
		SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
			Where TNAME = 'TZYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ll_Count > 0 THEN // 记录存在继续update(最多三次)
			ll_Retry ++
			IF ll_Retry >= 3 THEN
				GOTO Process_Error
			ELSE
				Gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
				GOTO Process_Begin
			END IF
		ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
			INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
				Values ('TZYB_JZXLH',2018100101,2018100101,1) Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN GOTO Process_Error
			ll_Value = 2018100101
			GOTO Process_Success
		END IF
	ELSE
		SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
			Where TNAME = 'TZYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ll_Count > 0 THEN
		ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
			INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
				Values ('TZYB_JZXLH',2018100101,1,1) Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN GOTO Process_Error
			ll_Value = 2018100101
			GOTO Process_Success
		END IF
	END IF
	
	SetNull(ll_Value)
	SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'TZYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN GOTO Process_Error
	IF ll_Value < 2018100101 THEN GOTO Process_Error
	
	Process_Success:
	gf_Commit_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
	as_jzxlh = String(ll_Value)
	RETURN 1
	
	Process_Error:
	gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	SetNull(ll_Value)
	SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'TZYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN
		as_jzxlh = 'TZYB2018100101'
	ELSE
		as_jzxlh = 'TZYB' + String(ll_Value + 1)
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer uf_get_brxz (string as_cbrlb, ref long al_brxz, ref long al_tgdw);

public function boolean uf_ifyb (long al_data, string as_lx);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN false
END IF
Integer li_ybpb
CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_lx)
	CASE 'ZYH'
		SELECT YBPB INTO :li_ybpb FROM ZY_BRRY, GY_BRXZ
			Where ZY_BRRY.BRXZ = GY_BRXZ.BRXZ And ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'BRXZ','JSLX'
		SELECT YBPB Into :li_ybpb From GY_BRXZ Where BRXZ = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'JSDW'
		
END CHOOSE

RETURN li_ybpb = 1

end function

public function integer uf_zhcx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);istr_yb_zhxx = istr_yb_zhxx_null
String ls_klb,ls_ret[],ls_knsj

IF ib_yd THEN
	
ELSE
//	if 'YBDZPZ'
	IF Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
		ls_klb = '5'
		as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
		IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
			//增加渠道ID、渠道授权码(QrCode)，渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh = ls_ret[5]
			//例身份凭证信息：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌|参保地行政区|渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
			IF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) = 6 THEN
				ls_ret[7] = ''
			END IF
			as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]+ "|" + ls_ret[5] + "|" + ls_ret[7]+"|" +ls_ret[6]
			//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
			IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
			ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
			ELSE
				as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
			END IF
			as_knsj = as_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
			istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
		ELSE
			as_error = '电子凭证信息传入错误'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSEIF ib_yktdy THEN
		ls_klb = '3'		
		ls_knsj = as_knsj
		as_knsj = '1|' + left(ls_knsj,len(ls_knsj) - 9) + "|" + right(ls_knsj,9)
	ELSE
		ls_klb = '1'
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('22')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','10')
	This.uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')
	
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		if ls_klb = '3' then
			as_knsj = ls_knsj
		end if
		//1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//6	个人基本信息	composite		否		参照个人基本信息结构体参数
		//7	医疗身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//8	工伤身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
		//10	预留位	string	10	否		预留
		
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
		istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
		of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx) //	个人基本信息
		of_get_sfyzjg(istr_yb_zhxx) //身份验证结果
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF




end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_mx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error, long al_zyh);//as_klb:12：社保卡（磁卡）13：一卡通的卡（IC卡

Long ll_brxz,ll_tgdw
String ls_tjlxh,ls_cbrlb
SELECT brxz,tgdw Into :ll_brxz,:ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
ls_tjlxh = String(ll_brxz) + String(ll_tgdw)
IF Pos(is_tzsbj , Left(as_knsj,6)) = 0 THEN  //台州市异地判断
	ib_yd = true
	SELECT DMSB Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'TZSYD_GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh;
ELSE
	ib_yd = false
	SELECT DMSB Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh;
END IF

IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbrlb = ls_cbrlb
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

String ls_klb,ls_ret[]
ls_klb = '1'
IF Left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
	IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
		//增加渠道ID、渠道授权码(QrCode)，渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
		istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh = ls_ret[5]
		//例身份凭证信息：姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌|参保地行政区|渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
		IF UpperBound ( ls_ret ) = 6 THEN
			ls_ret[7] = ''
		END IF
		as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]+ "|" + ls_ret[5] + "|" + ls_ret[7]+"|" +ls_ret[6]
		//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			as_knsj = as_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		as_knsj = as_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)
		istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.dzpzlp = ls_ret[4]
	ELSE
		as_error = '电子凭证信息传入错误'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE		
	ls_klb = '1'
END IF

//str_yb_smkzh str_yb_smkzh_null
//istr_yb_zhxx.str_pyyb_grjbxx.str_yb_smkzh = str_yb_smkzh_null
This.uf_send_init('22')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('读卡方式','10')
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	//1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
	//2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
	//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
	//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
	//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
	//6	个人基本信息	composite		否		参照个人基本信息结构体参数
	//7	医疗身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
	//8	工伤身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
	//9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
	//10	预留位	string	10	否		预留
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	istr_yb_zhxx.knsj = as_knsj
	istr_yb_zhxx.klb = ls_klb
	of_get_grjbxx(istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx) //	个人基本信息
	of_get_sfyzjg(istr_yb_zhxx) //身份验证结果
	OpenWithParm(w_yb_jbxx_xs,'2')
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF

end function

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//wangyi 20180921
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm,ls_zflp,ls_cbd
Long ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH,MZJCODE,sbhm INTO :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh  ,:ls_zflp,:ls_cbd
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 1;
	
IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//IF Pos(is_tzsbj , Left(ls_knxx,6)) = 0 THEN //台州市异地判断
IF Pos(is_tzsbj , ls_cbd) = 0 THEN //台州市异地判断
	ib_yd = True
	RETURN gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_zy_mxcx( al_zyh, as_error)
ELSE
	ib_yd = False
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + '-' + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
String ls_klb
ls_klb = '0'
IF Pos(ls_knxx,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	//姓名|证件类型|证件号码|  令牌|参保地行政区|  渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
	//渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
	ls_knxx = ls_knxx + '|' + ls_zflp + '|' +ls_cbd+'||'
	//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
	IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
	ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
	ELSE
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
	END IF
	ls_knxx = ls_knxx  + String(base_info.syscode)
END IF
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;
IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的就诊编号信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//本地医保对这个PYYB_FYMXSC判断，其他事PYB_FYMXSC
SELECT JSMXLSH Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
IF ls_mxzdh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人礑AT* 拿飨刚市畔 !'
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init('42')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
This.uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
This.uf_send_add('要删除的明细序号列表','')

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0'  THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	//删除预结算信息
	DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH  = :al_zyh  Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//所有明细ztbz 置-1，作废
	UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF




end function

public function integer uf_zydj_bg (string as_jbr, string as_bdlx, long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//住院登记变更
String ls_klb,ls_knsj,ls_zydjjylsh,ls_ryzd,ls_jtdh,ls_brxm
Long ll_ksdm,ll_jsdh,ll_sypb = 0
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_cyrq,ldt_syrq,ldt_fzrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch,ls_cyyy,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh,ls_zflp,ls_cbd
Integer li_cyfs,li_count,li_cur
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
//获取基本信息
 SELECT 	KNXX,		BRKS,		CYRQ,			ZYHM,		BRCH,		BAHM,		ZZYS,		CYFS,		JSDH,		JTDH,		BRXM,	 MZJCODE, SBHM
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ldt_cyrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:li_cyfs,:ll_jsdh,:ls_jtdh,:ls_brxm,:ls_zflp,:ls_cbd
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Pos(is_tzsbj , Left(ls_knsj,6)) = 0 THEN //台州市异地判断
	ib_yd = True
	RETURN gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_zydj_bg( as_bdlx,al_zyh, as_error)
ELSE
	ib_yd = False
END IF

SELECT YBJZBH,bqrysj Into :ls_zydjjylsh,:ldt_ryrq From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的住院登记交易号:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1

ls_klb = '0'
IF pos(ls_knsj,'|') > 0 then
	ls_klb = '5'
	//姓名|证件类型|证件号码|  令牌|参保地行政区|  渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
	//渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
	ls_knsj = ls_knsj + '|' + ls_zflp + '|' +ls_cbd+'||' 
	//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
	IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
	ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
	ELSE
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
	END IF
	ls_knsj = ls_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)		
end if
String ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zdmc = '',ls_zddm1,ls_zszh,ls_zddms[],ls_zddmcs[],ls_zddm2,ls_zddm3
Long ll_row,ll_tes = 0
String ls_cyxj = '',ls_nr = ''
Dec ldc_zyh
ldc_zyh = al_zyh * 100
SetNull(ldt_fzrq)
SELECT ZSZH,FZRQ Into :ls_zszh,:ldt_fzrq From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//判断是否为生育，若为生育
IF Not IsNull(ls_zszh) And ls_zszh <> '' THEN
	ll_sypb = 1
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_tes From BQXT.zy_brry_ye Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF ll_tes <= 0 Or IsNull(ll_tes) THEN ll_tes = 0
	SELECT Max(csrq) Into :ldt_syrq From BQXT.zy_brry_ye Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
ELSE
	ll_tes = 0
	SetNull(ldt_syrq)
	SetNull(ldt_fzrq)
END IF
IF ll_sypb = 1 and ll_tes = 0 THEN
	SELECT Max(JSSJ) Into :ldt_syrq From BQXT.SM_SSJL Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
	IF IsNull(ldt_syrq) Or Date(ldt_syrq) = Date(1900,1,1) THEN ldt_syrq = ldt_fzrq
	IF ls_zszh = '0' THEN 
		ls_zszh = ''
		SetNull(ldt_fzrq)
	END IF
END IF

//ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
//IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
//	as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
//	RETURN -1

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
This.uf_send_init('38')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
//变更信息
This.uf_send_add('住院号',ls_zyhm)
This.uf_send_add('住院登记交易号',ls_zydjjylsh)
This.uf_send_add('变动类型',as_bdlx) //7	变动类型	String	1	是		1:入院信息变动 2：出院信息更新
//如果是入院信息变动则8~18位的信息就是对应入院的各项信息，19，20为空。
//如果是出院信息更新则11，12，13为出院诊断信息，9，10，11，12，13，19，20不能为空。
This.uf_send_add('病人床号',ls_brch) //8
//医生信息
IF ls_ysbm > '' THEN
ELSE
	ls_ysbm = 'NULL'
END IF
ls_ysxm = of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh)
This.uf_send_add('诊断医生姓名',ls_ysxm) //9	诊断医生姓名	string	20	否

IF as_bdlx = '1' THEN

			as_error = '生育诊断取失败!' + ls_ryzd

			RETURN -1

	IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
		li_count = UpperBound ( ls_zddms )
		IF li_count > 0 THEN
			FOR li_cur = 1 To li_count
				ls_zddm2 = ls_zddm2 + ls_zddms[li_cur] + '%%' + ls_zddmcs[li_cur] + '%%'
			NEXT
			ls_zddm2 = Mid(ls_zddm2,1,Len(ls_zddm2)-2)
		END IF
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('次要诊断疾病列表',ls_zddm2)
	//科室信息
	IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
		ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
		IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
			as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('科室编号',ls_ksbm)
	This.uf_send_add('科室名称',ls_ksmc)
	//其他
	This.uf_send_add('胎儿数',String(ll_tes)) //15	胎儿数	integer	2	是		默认为0.生育时需要输入胎儿数
	This.uf_send_add('出院日期','') //16	出院日期	date	10	否		YyyyMMdd

	This.uf_send_add('出院小结','')

		RETURN -1

	IF ll_sypb = 1 THEN

			as_error = '诊断取失败!'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('疾病副诊断及描述',ls_zdmc)
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编号',ls_zddm1)
	This.uf_send_add('疾病名称',ls_ryzd)
	//	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）2',ls_zddm2)
	//	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码（诊断编码）3',ls_zddm3)
	//	//-------诊断增加到10个---------
	ls_zddm2 = ''
	IF ii_zdsl > 0 THEN
		li_count = UpperBound ( ls_zddms )
		IF li_count > 0 THEN
			FOR li_cur = 1 To li_count
				ls_zddm2 = ls_zddm2 + ls_zddms[li_cur] + '%%' + ls_zddmcs[li_cur]
			NEXT
		END IF
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('次要诊断疾病列表',ls_zddm2)
	//----------------------------
	//科室信息
	IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
		ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
		IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
			as_error = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)

		ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))

	//出院原因
	//	li_cyfs
	ls_cyyy = of_get_dzdmsb('TZYB-GY_DMZD','23',li_cyfs) //	This.uf_send_add('出院原因','') //20(1: 病愈出院 2: 死亡 4: 转院 9: 其他原因)
	IF ls_cyyy > '' And ls_cyyy <> '无' THEN
		IF ls_cyyy = '01' Or ls_cyyy = '1' THEN
			ls_cyyy = '1'

	//20200512 wangyi 出院小结里必须含姓名、病区、床号、住院号信息
	ls_cyxj = '姓名：' + ls_brxm + '~r~n' //姓名：
	SetNull(ls_nr)
	select gy_ksdm.ksmc into :ls_nr from gy_ksdm,zy_brry where zy_brry.brbq = gy_ksdm.ksdm and zy_brry.zyh = :al_zyh ;

	SetNull(ls_nr)
	SELECT nr Into :ls_nr From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where id = (SELECT id From ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :ldc_zyh And lx = '7') And dmid = 193 ;
	IF IsNull(ls_nr) THEN ls_nr = ''
	ls_cyxj = ls_cyxj + '出院诊断：' + ls_nr + '~r~n' //出院诊断： 193
	
	SetNull(ls_nr)
	SELECT nr Into :ls_nr From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where id = (SELECT id From ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :ldc_zyh And lx = '7') And dmid = 194 ;
	IF IsNull(ls_nr) THEN ls_nr = ''
	ls_cyxj = ls_cyxj + '入院情况：' + ls_nr + '~r~n' //入院情况： 194
	
	SetNull(ls_nr)
	SELECT nr Into :ls_nr From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where id = (SELECT id From ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :ldc_zyh And lx = '7') And dmid = 77 ;

	IF IsNull(ls_nr) THEN ls_nr = ''

	//出院医嘱：

to :ls_nr From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where id = (SELECT id From ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :ldc_zyh And lx = '7') And dmid = 202 ;

//23	出院小结	string	10000	否		
//24	预留1	string	100	否		预留字段
//25	预留2	string	100	否		预留字段
//26	预留3	string	100	否		预留字段

This.uf_send_add('计划生育服务证号',ls_zszh)

This.uf_send_add('预留2','')
This.uf_send_add('预留3','')
This.uf_send_add('预留4','')
This.uf_send_add('预留5','')
//
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function
