public function integer uf_zy_mxcx (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已窪AT*

String ls_knxx ,ls_ybjzbh,ls_mxzdh,ls_zyhm,ls_mxxhlb,ls_zflp,ls_cbd
Long ll_jsdh
SELECT KNXX,ZYHM,JSDH,MZJCODE,SBHM Into :ls_knxx,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh ,:ls_zflp,:ls_cbd
From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh And CYPB <= 1;
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where  ZYH = :al_zyh;

IF ls_knxx > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的卡信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF  ls_ybjzbh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的就诊编号信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//判断本异地

String ls_klb
ls_klb = '0'
IF Pos(ls_knxx,'|') > 0 THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	//姓名|证件类型|证件号码|  令牌|参保地行政区|  渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
	//渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
	ls_knxx = ls_knxx + '|' + ls_zflp + '|' +ls_cbd+'||'
	//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
	IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
	ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
	ELSE
		ls_knxx = ls_knxx + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
	END IF
	ls_knxx = ls_knxx  + String(base_info.syscode)
END IF

SELECT JSMXLSH Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
IF ls_mxzdh > '' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '取不到对应病人的明细帐信息!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
This.uf_send_init('41')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knxx)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
This.uf_send_add('住院登记流水号',ls_ybjzbh)
//7	明细序号列表	composite		是		以%%分隔 d_zy_fymx_jlxh
u_datastore luds_jlxh
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_pos,ll_pos1
Dec{0} ld_jlxh
luds_jlxh = Create u_datastore
luds_jlxh.DataObject = 'd_zy_fymx_jlxh'
luds_jlxh.SetTransObject( gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = luds_jlxh.Retrieve(al_zyh )

FOR ll_cur = 1 To  ll_count
	IF ll_cur = ll_count THEN
		ls_mxxhlb += String(luds_jlxh.Object.jlxh[ll_cur])
	ELSE
		ls_mxxhlb += String(luds_jlxh.Object.jlxh[ll_cur]) + "%%"
	END IF
NEXT

This.uf_send_add('明细序号列表',ls_mxxhlb)

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0'  THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_mxxhlb = This.uf_getstring('未上传成功的明细序号列表')
	IF IsNull(ls_mxxhlb) Or ls_mxxhlb = '' THEN
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Pos ( ls_mxxhlb, "%%" )
		ll_pos1 = 1
		DO WHILE ll_pos >= 0
			IF ll_pos = 0 THEN
				ld_jlxh = Dec(Mid(ls_mxxhlb,ll_pos1,Len(ls_mxxhlb) - ll_pos1 + 1 ))
			ELSE
				ld_jlxh = Dec(Mid(ls_mxxhlb,ll_pos1,ll_pos - ll_pos1))
				ll_pos1 = ll_pos + 2
			END IF
			//如果明细中心返回未上传，则ztbz 置-1，重新上传
			gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			UPDATE JKXT.YB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And ywlx = 'ZY' And ywlsh = :ld_jlxh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF ll_pos <= 0 THEN EXIT
			ll_pos = Pos ( ls_mxxhlb, "%%",ll_pos1 )
		LOOP
		gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		as_error = '有明细未上传，请进帐卡上传明细!'
		RETURN 2
		//状态置完后传明细，将未上传的明细上传
		//		this.uf_zy_mxsc(al_zyh, /*string as_jbr*/, /*string as_cbrlb*/, /*ref string as_error */)
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zydj_qx (string as_knsj, string as_zyhm, string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.uf_zydj_qx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:取消住院登记/医保转自费（用户交易40）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_knsj     	
// 	value	string	as_zyhm     	要注销的住院序列号
// 	value	string	as_zydjjylsh	住院登记交易号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.03.28
//====================================================================
IF Pos(is_tzsbj , Left(as_knsj,6)) = 0 THEN //台州市异地判断
	ib_yd = True
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = as_knsj
	RETURN gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_zydj_cx( as_zyhm, as_zydjjylsh, as_error)
ELSE
	ib_yd = False
END IF

String ls_klb
ls_klb = '1'

IF This.uf_Set_instance( as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
Long ll_jsdh
SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_zyhm Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	as_zyhm = as_zyhm + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
END IF

//住院登记交易号位空则查询医保登记状态，如果成功取结算流水号
IF as_zydjjylsh = '' Or IsNull(as_zydjjylsh) THEN
	String ls_jyjd
	IF uf_jycx('32', as_zyhm, ls_jyjd, istr_tzyb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
		MessageBox('提示',"<住院登记交易号>为空，查询失败：" + as_error)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		as_zydjjylsh = istr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh
	END IF
END IF

IF Pos(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj,'|') > 0 or left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
ELSE
	ls_klb = '1'
END IF
This.uf_send_init('40')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
//基本信息
This.uf_send_add('要注销的住院序列号',as_zyhm )
This.uf_send_add('住院登记交易号',as_zydjjylsh)
//
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlb, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zdmc, ref string as_zddms[], ref string as_zddmcs[], ref string as_ryzd);//住院病人诊断信息
//ai_zdlb 用于判断是获取入院诊断还是出院诊断 1入院   2出院  3生育
//as_ryzd 为入院主诊断，出院主诊断
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
//	IF ai_zdlb = 1 THEN
//		ids_zy_ryzd.SetFilter( "zdlb = 2 or zdlb = 9 or zdlb = 10 or zdlb = 11") //入院诊断
//	ELSEIF ai_zdlb = 2 THEN
//		ids_zy_ryzd.SetFilter( "zdlb = 3 or zdlb = 4 or zdlb = 15 or zdlb = 16 or zdlb = 19 or zdlb = 20")
//	END IF
//	ids_zy_ryzd.Filter( )
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "zdlb asc")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF

String ls_sybm
Long ll_row,ll_sypb = 0
IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	//wangyi 20200312 生育
	IF ai_zdlb = 3 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 to ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
			ls_sybm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'GY_JBBM_SY',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row] ) )
			IF ls_sybm = '无' THEN
			ELSE
				ll_sypb = 1
				as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_row]))
				as_zddm1 = ls_sybm + ',' + as_zddm1
				as_ryzd = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_row])
				EXIT
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = ''
	as_ryzd = ''
END IF
as_zdmc = ''
//IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 2 THEN
//	as_zddm2 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[2]))
//	IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2] = ''
//	as_zdmc =  ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[2]
//ELSE
//	as_zddm2 = ''
//END IF
//IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() >= 3 THEN
//	as_zddm3 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[3]))
//	IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3] = ''
//	as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[3]
//ELSE
//	as_zddm3 = ''
//END IF

IF ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount() = 0 THEN
	as_zdmc = ''
	as_ryzd = is_mrzdmc
	as_zddm1 = is_mricd10
END IF
IF as_ryzd = '' Or IsNull(as_ryzd) THEN
	as_ryzd = '诊断为空'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ai_zdlb = 3 and ll_sypb = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200312 生育
	as_ryzd = '没有生育对照的诊断，不能医保生育登记！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//诊断增加到10个

Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 2 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 to ll_count
		ll_zds ++
		IF ll_count >= 4 and ll_cur <= ll_count THEN
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_cur]))
			IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur] = ''
			as_zdmc = as_zdmc +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_cur]
		ELSE
			as_zddms[ll_zds] = ''
		END IF
	next
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx (string as_brbm, decimal adc_ghlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm1, ref string as_zddm[], ref string as_zdmcs[], ref string as_zdmc);
IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
	ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_mz_zdxx'
	ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF
IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(as_brbm,adc_ghlsh,as_ysbm) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
as_zdmc = ''
ib_zfzd = false

Long ll_zdlsh
IF ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount() >= 1 THEN
	//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
	ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[1]
	if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
		as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
		//modify by sxl 20211210:ii_zfzdqy 0不启用,1启用,2只启用收费3只启用体检'
		IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 THEN
			RETURN -2
		END IF
	end if
	
	as_zddm1 = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
	as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[1]
ELSE
	as_zddm1 = is_mricd10
	as_zdmc = is_mrzdmc
END IF
//1	疾病编码	string	20	否		疾病编码采用ICD10。
//2	疾病名称	string	300	否		
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_zds = 0
ll_count = ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 2 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 2 to ll_count
		//wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
		ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_cur]
		if ids_zfzd.find("srdm='" + string(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 then
			as_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]
			ib_zfzd = true
			//modify by sxl 20211210:ii_zfzdqy 0不启用,1启用,2只启用收稤AT*
3只启用体检' 			IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 THEN 				RETURN -2 			END IF 		end if
		
		ll_zds ++
		as_zddm[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
		IF IsNull(ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]) THEN ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur] = ''
		as_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur]
		as_zdmc = as_zdmc + ',' + ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_cur] 
	next
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function string of_get_ygxm (string as_ygdm, ref string as_ygxm, ref string as_sfzh);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_sfzh = is_error
	RETURN ''
END IF
IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm,sfzh, '' as gjybdm from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		as_sfzh = "创建员工信息对象失败：" + ids_ygdm.is_error
		RETURN ''
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='" + as_ygdm + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	as_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	IF ii_gjmqy = 1  THEN
		as_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find]
	ELSE
		as_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find]
	END IF
	RETURN ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
ELSE
	String ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,ls_gjybdm
	SELECT ygxm Into :ls_ygxm From GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		ls_ygxm = as_ygdm
	END IF
	//	医生证书号,项目贯标编码
	SELECT ZGZSBM,GJYBDM Into :ls_sfzh,:ls_gjybdm From XTGL.GY_YGDM_KZ  Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or ls_sfzh = '' THEN
		SELECT zgzsbm Into :ls_sfzh From jkxt.yb_yssb Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or ls_sfzh = '' THEN
		as_sfzh = as_ygdm + '医师资格证书编码未维护，请联系医务处!'
		RETURN ''
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_gjybdm) Or ls_gjybdm = '' THEN
		as_sfzh = as_ygdm + '国家医师编码未维护，请先维护!'
		ls_gjybdm = ''
//		RETURN ''
	END IF
	ls_gjybdm = ls_sfzh + ',' + ls_gjybdm
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find] = ls_sfzh
	ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find] = ls_gjybdm
	as_ygxm = ls_ygxm
	IF ii_gjmqy = 1  THEN
		as_sfzh = ls_gjybdm
	ELSE
		as_sfzh = ls_sfzh
	END IF
	RETURN ls_ygxm
END IF





end function

//Dec{2} ldc_smkzhzf
//Dec{0} li_jylsh = 0
//li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb = '5' THEN
	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj+'~~~~~~'
ELSE
	//IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.klb ) And Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj ) THEN
	//	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj +'~~~~~~'
	//ELSE
	ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
END IF
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '36~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '30~~'
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~'
//IF Not of_yb_date_init(as_error,false) THEN
//	as_error = 'f_UserBargaingInit初始化出错' + as_error
//	RETURN -1
//END IF

ls_send = ls_send + '$$'

li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)


ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF

//	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
IF of_update_jsmx(as_qrjslsh,as_jsjylsh,as_jzxlh,astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,'$$~~~~30~12345678901234~2~HIS数据保存失败$$'，$$0~~~~$$，""）
RETURN 1


end function

	Where JSSJ  >= :ldt_jssj And JZXLH = :astr_yb_jsxx.JSMXLSH And JSJYLSH = :astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh AND ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;

public function integer uf_mz_tfcl (string as_knsj, string as_jslsh, string as_jbr, decimal adc_ylfyze, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已改
String ls_klb
Integer li_ret
gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.开始uf_mz_tfcl()")  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.开始uf_mz_tfcl()
il_time_pre = CPU()
ls_klb = '1'
//IF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
//	ls_klb = '2'
//ELSE
//	ls_klb = '0'
//END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF Pos(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj,'|') > 0 or left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
ELSE
	ls_klb = '1'
END IF
This.uf_send_init('31')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易号',as_jslsh)
This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')

gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送       历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送
il_time_send = CPU()
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		Integer li_cftf
		//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
		li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否重复退费'))
		IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
		
		//不管是否为重复退费，都能让其继续退费
		IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
		END IF
		
		//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	是	
		//8	退费结算日期	datetime	20	是	
		//9	计算结果信息	composite	 	否	
		//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否	
		
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算日期')
		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf) 
		of_get_jjfd(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_jjfd) //astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq
		of_update_jymx_tp(  as_jslsh, as_jydd,adt_jssj ,  astr_tzyb_jsxx, as_error)
	END IF
	gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()发送成功○                   历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()发送成功○
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()发送失败×                   历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mz_tfcl()发送失败×
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_update_jymx_tp (string as_jsjylsh, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, str_tzyb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_jssj_end

ldt_curr = gf_server_date()
as_jydd = gf_midstring(as_jydd,20)

IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

string ls_jssj
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_jssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),1),Time(23:59:59))
adt_jssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),-1))//,Time(adt_jssj)
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_JSMX  Set ZTBZ = 2 Where JSSJ >= :adt_jssj AND JSSJ <= :ldt_jssj_end And QRJYLSH = :as_jsjylsh  Using itran_sqlca ;

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	INSERT INTO JKXT.PYYB_JSMX
		( JSSJ,          YWLX,           YWLSH,         BRBM,         ZYH,        JSCS,           JYJK, 		JYJSLX,             TSMXBZDM,              JSJYLSH,              QRJYLSH,     FYZE, ZFZE,ZLZE,YBFY,              ZYZF, 		QFX,              GRZFXJZF,              GRZF_XJZF,              HJXJZF,             HJBXJE,              LNZHZF, 		DNZHZF,              TCJJZF,              DBBZZF,              GWYBZZF,              LXJJZF,              EYJJZF,
		LMYLBZZF,            BZXX,              ZTBZ,              JYDD,
		GRBH,                CBRLB,               JSHDNGZYE,           JSHLNGZYE,          MZTCYBFY ,    JZXLH ,    SMKZHZF,MZTCQFX,
		GRZF,JMJJZF, DXSJJZF, WCNRJJZF, XNHJJZF, QTJJZF, QTZFS1, QTZFS2, QTZFS3, BZJJZF,DQBM)
		SELECT :ldt_curr ,   YWLX,     YWLSH,   BRBM,   ZYH,    JSCS,       JYJK,
		JYJSLX,  TSMXBZDM ,:astr_yb_jsxx.jslsh ,:astr_yb_jsxx.qrjslsh,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.fyze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zfze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zlze,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.ybfy,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zyzf,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qfx,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.grzfxjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.grzf_xjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjxjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjbxje,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.lnzhzf,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.dnzhzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.tcjjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.dbbzzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.gwybzzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.lxjjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.eyjjzf,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.lmylbzzf,NULL,3,:as_jydd,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx.grsbbh,CBRLB,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.jshdnzhye,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.jshlnzhye,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.mztcybfy,JZXLH,:astr_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje * -1,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.mztcqfx,
		:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.grzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.dezfbz,0,0,0,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.gsjjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.syjjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.mztcjjzf,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.mzbz,:astr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.yfjz,DQBM
		From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_jssj AND JSSJ <= :ldt_jssj_end And QRJYLSH = :as_jsjylsh Using itran_sqlca ;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows > 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF


end function

public function integer uf_zydj (ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, date ad_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_ywlx, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, string as_zszh, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
END IF

IF Not IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) THEN
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
END IF
//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock

CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;


IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

RETURN uf_zydj(as_knsj,al_ksdm,al_zyh,ad_ryrq,as_zyhm,as_cwhm,as_bahm,as_ysbm,as_ywlx,as_rylx,as_jbr,as_zszh,as_zydjjylsh,as_error,gtrans_temp_mssql,True)

end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, string as_ywlx, string as_rylx, string as_jbr, string as_zszh, ref string as_zydjjylsh, ref string as_error);//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_jsdh,ll_count
//Date ld_ryrq
datetime ldt_ryrq,ldt_jsrq,ldt_rysj
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch

SELECT KNXX,BRKS,RYRQ,ZYHM,BRCH,BAHM,ZZYS,jsdh,jsrq
	INTO :ls_knsj,:ll_ksdm,:ldt_ryrq,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_bahm,:ls_ysbm,:ll_jsdh,:ldt_jsrq
	From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(1900,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF Left(ls_knsj,6) = '330399' or len(ls_knsj) < 30 THEN
			ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
		ELSE
			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From bqxt.zy_yybr Where ZYH = :al_zyh And jgbz >= 0 And zy_yybr.yzypb In (1,2);
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN //预住院
				IF ldt_ryrq > ldt_rysj THEN
					ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//if isnull(ll_jsdh)  then 
//else
//	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + right('00' +string(ll_jsdh),2)
//end if
RETURN uf_zydj( ls_knsj, ll_ksdm,al_zyh, date(ldt_ryrq),ls_zyhm, ls_brch, ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, as_ywlx, as_rylx,as_jbr, as_zszh,as_zydjjylsh, as_error)

end function

private function integer of_zy_fymx_sc (long al_zyh, string as_cbrlb, string as_ywlb, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, ref string as_msg);//wangyi 20180921
IF adt_zzrq < DateTime(Date('2000.1.1')) THEN
	SetNull(adt_zzrq)
END IF
//zy_fymx
IF IsValid(ids_zyfymx) = False THEN
	ids_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zyfymx_sc'
END IF

ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql )
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cpu
ll_cpu = CPU()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh,ai_jscs,adt_zzrq)
IF ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 0
END IF
//gf_applog('retrieve ids_zyfymx cpu:' + String(CPU() - ll_cpu) + " zzrq:" + String(adt_zzrq))
String ls_knsj,ls_klb,ls_kzys,ls_ybjzbh,ls_xmzxbh = '',ls_zyhm,ls_brch,ls_ypzllb,ls_dffbz,ls_zzys,ls_bah
Long ll_brks,ll_mxtop,ll_add_row,j,ll_row,ll_find,ll_insert,ll_ret,ll_findcy
Long ll_ypcd,ll_find_yz,ll_jsdh,ll_ksdm,ll_cwts,ll_zyljxh
Integer li_sczs,li_ybfl,li_spbz
Dec{0} ldc_yz_jlxh,ldc_yzzh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ld_fysl,ld_zfje,ld_zje,ldc_zjje_temp,ldc_yhje
Dec{4} ld_fydj
Dec{3} ld_zfbl 
String ls_ysxm,ls_yszh,ls_jlxh,ls_ksmc,ls_ksbm,ls_gjybbm = '',ls_yyxmbh = '',ls_zflp,ls_cbd
SELECT KNXX,BRKS,ZYHM,BRCH,ZZYS,JSDH ,MZJCODE, SBHM
Into :ls_knsj,:ll_brks,:ls_zyhm,:ls_brch,:ls_zzys,:ll_jsdh,:ls_zflp,:ls_cbd 
From ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh;
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_ybjzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh;

IF ll_brks = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '病人无当前科室，不能上传明细!'
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetSort("jlxh A")
ids_zyfymx.Sort()

li_sczs =  Ceiling(ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_zyfymx_his'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF IsValid(ids_bqyz) = False THEN
	ids_bqyz = Create U_datastore
	ids_bqyz.DataObject = 'd_yb_zybqyz'
	ids_bqyz.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset()
ids_bqyz.Retrieve(al_zyh)
//对应的业务类别，医保住院、生育住院、工伤住院
IF This.of_get_zfbl_zy79(al_zyh, as_cbrlb, as_ywlb ,as_msg) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//卡类别
ls_klb = '0'
IF pos(ls_knsj,'|') > 0 then
	ls_klb = '5'
	//姓名|证件类型|证件号码|  令牌|参保地行政区|  渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
	//渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
	ls_knsj = ls_knsj + '|' + ls_zflp + '|' +ls_cbd+'||' 
	//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
	IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
	ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
	ELSE
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
	END IF
	ls_knsj = ls_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)		
end if

FOR j = 1 To li_sczs
	uf_send_init('33') //住院类交易提交费用明细
	uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	
	uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm) //5	住院序列号	string	20	是	
	uf_send_add('住院登记交易流水号',ls_ybjzbh) //6	住院登记交易流水号	string	20	是		住院登记成功返回
	uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '医嘱费用列表结构体')
	
	IF j * ii_mxts > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop =  ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = j * ii_mxts
	END IF
	
	ll_add_row = 0
	ldc_zjje = 0
	FOR ll_row = (j - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
		ls_bah = ''
		ll_add_row ++
		ldc_yhje = ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje_temp = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ldc_yhje
		ld_fysl = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ld_fydj = ldc_zjje_temp / ld_fysl
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ldc_zjje_temp
		//		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_rowcount),Integer(ll_row /ll_rowcount * 100))
		ls_jlxh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row])
		ll_zyljxh = Long(ls_jlxh)
		uf_send_add_in('明细序号',ls_jlxh,ll_add_row)
		IF ld_fysl < 0 THEN
			uf_send_add_in('退药标记','1',ll_add_row) //2	退药标记	string	1	是		1:退药，0正常
		ELSE
			uf_send_add_in('退药标记','0',ll_add_row)
		END IF
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //费用
			
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_yyxmbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#9[ll_find]
				ls_gjybbm = ids_ylsf.Object.#13[ll_find]
				IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
					ls_yyxmbh = ls_yyxmbh +',' + ls_gjybbm
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目编号',ls_yyxmbh,ll_add_row) //5	项目编号	string	20	是		VC20：贯标编码格式：项目编号,项目贯标编码
				//根据匹配的去取  9--12
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				uf_send_add_in('类别标志',ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row) //4	类别标志	string	1	是	1，2	1药品，2诊疗
				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]),ll_add_row) //6	项目名称	string	80	是		 医院项目名称
				//				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_ylsf.Object.#11[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
				//-------------------------------------------------------------
				uf_send_add_in('项目规格','无',ll_add_row) //7	项目规格	string	60	否		 医院规格药品必传
				uf_send_add_in('项目剂型','无',ll_add_row) //8	项目剂型	string	20	否		 医院剂型药品必传
				uf_send_add_in('项目单位', String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find]),ll_add_row) //9	项目单位	string	10	是	
				//uf_send_add_in('计价单位',of_get_dzdmsb("PYYB-GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_ylsf.Object.fydw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用量单位','',ll_add_row) //33	用量单位	string	3	否		新增指标。参考7.4相关数字字典7.4.19单位。
				//-------------------------------------------------------------
				//				IF String(ids_ylsf.Object.#9[ll_find]) = '1' THEN
				uf_send_add_in('用药天数',0,ll_add_row) //18	用药天数	double	4（2）	是		如果是药品需上传用药天数，诊疗默认取0
				uf_send_add_in('转化比','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量单位','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目总剂量','',ll_add_row)
				//				ELSE
				//					uf_send_add_in('用药天数',0,ll_add_row)
				//				END IF
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报
						SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And YWLSH = :ll_zyljxh And ywlx = 'ZY' And ZTBZ >= 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							IF ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 2 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,ll_add_row) //26	备案号	string	1	否		无备案号传空
				END IF
			END IF
			//				
		ELSE //药品
			ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
				uf_send_add_in('类别标志',ls_ypzllb,ll_add_row)
				ls_yyxmbh = String(ids_typk.Object.#14[ll_find])
				ls_gjybbm = String(ids_typk.Object.#20[ll_find])
				IF ii_gjmqy = 1 THEN
					ls_yyxmbh = ls_yyxmbh +',' + ls_gjybbm
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目编号',ls_yyxmbh,ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目名称',String(ids_typk.Object.#16[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find] = '' THEN
					uf_send_add_in('项目规格','无',ll_add_row)
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('项目规格',String(ids_typk.Object.bfgg[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				END IF
				uf_send_add_in('项目剂型',of_get_dzdmsb("YK_YPSX",String(ids_typk.Object.#18[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				//				项目剂型
				uf_send_add_in('项目单位',String(ids_typk.Object.bfdw[ll_find]),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('转化比','',ll_add_row) //27	转化比	double	10（4）	否		新增指标
				//				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量',String(ids_typk.Object.ypjl[ll_find]),ll_add_row)//28	最小剂量	double	10（4）	否		新增指标
				//				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量单位',of_get_dzdmsb("GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)//29	最小剂量单位	string	3	否		新增指标。参考7.4相关数字字典7.4.19单位。
				
				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('最小剂量单位','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('项目总剂量','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用量单位','',ll_add_row) //of_get_dzdmsb("GY_DMZD",'1404',String(ids_typk.Object.jldw[ll_find])),ll_add_row)
				//				IF String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find]) = '2' Or String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find]) = '3' THEN
				//					uf_send_add_in('用药天数','0',ll_add_row)
				//				ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('用药天数','1',ll_add_row)
				//				END IF
				//----------add by sxl 2015-7-1------------------
				//33号交易收费项目列表新增字段30：备案号
				IF il_baqy = 1 THEN
					IF ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] = 2 THEN //备案上报
						SELECT BALSH Into :ls_bah From JKXT.YB_BASYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And YWLSH = :ll_zyljxh And ywlx = 'ZY' And ZTBZ >= 0 Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
						IF IsNull(ls_bah) THEN ls_bah = ''
						IF ls_bah = '' THEN
							IF ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 2 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 8 THEN
							ELSE
								ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row] = 9
							END IF
						END IF
					END IF
					This.uf_send_add_in('备案号',ls_bah,ll_add_row)
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//-----------------------------------------------------------
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到对应的费用信息:YPLX:' +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row]) + " FYXH:" +String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//33号住院明细上传增加第34位《科室编码》，第35位《科室名称》以及5个预留字段。
		ll_ksdm = ids_zyfymx.Object.fyks[ll_row]
		IF ll_ksdm > 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
			IF ls_ksbm <= '' THEN
				as_msg = '取不到对应的科室'+String(ll_ksdm)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM',String(ll_ksdm))
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add_in('科室编码',ls_ksbm,ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('科室名称',ls_ksmc,ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('预留1','',ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('预留2','',ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('预留3','',ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('预留4','',ll_add_row)
		This.uf_send_add_in('预留5','',ll_add_row)
		
		//使用zy_fymx的ysgh ，为空则取主治医生
		ls_kzys = ids_zyfymx.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ls_kzys) Or ls_kzys = '' THEN
			ls_kzys = ls_zzys
		END IF
		IF of_get_ygxm(ls_kzys,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh) = '' THEN //获取医生姓名、身份证号
			as_msg = ls_yszh
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		//
		uf_send_add_in('开药医生证书号',ls_yszh,ll_add_row) //22	开药医生证书号	String	20	是		开药医生证书号
		uf_send_add_in('开药医生',ls_ysxm,ll_add_row) //23	开药医生	String	20	否		开药医生姓名
		//		ld_fydj = ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('项目单价',ld_fydj,ll_add_row) //12	项目单价	double	10(4)	是		 中草药必须传每一味单价
		uf_send_add_in('项目数量',ld_fysl,ll_add_row) //13	项目数量	double	8(2)	是		 如果是退药则数量为负
		uf_send_add_in('项目贴数',1,ll_add_row) //14	项目贴数	double	6(2)	是		 不是中草药默认给1
		//				ld_zje = ld_fydj * Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[ll_row])
		ld_zje = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('项目总金额',ld_zje,ll_add_row) //15	项目总金额	double	10(4)	是		 总金额=单价*数量*帖数
		uf_send_add_in('医嘱日期',Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row]),ll_add_row) //10	医嘱日期	date	10	是		 
		IF Pos(is_zdfy,',' + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + ',') > 0 And ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN //wangyi 20200325 指定日期费用
			uf_send_add_in('费用发生日期',Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyrq[ll_row]),ll_add_row)
		ELSE
			uf_send_add_in('费用发生日期',Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]),ll_add_row) //17	费用发生日期	date	10	是		YyyyMMdd
		END IF
		uf_send_add_in('床号',ls_brch,ll_add_row) //21	床号	string	20	是		发生费用时的床号
		//医嘱序号------------------------
		ldc_yz_jlxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]
		IF ldc_yz_jlxh > 0 THEN
			ll_find_yz = ids_bqyz.Find("jlxh=" + String(ldc_yz_jlxh),1,999999)
		ELSE
			ll_find_yz = 0
		END IF
		
		IF ll_find_yz <= 0 THEN
			uf_send_add_in('用法','无',ll_add_row) //24	用法	String	40	否	
			//uf_send_add_in('用法标准','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('用药频次','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('每次用量','',ll_add_row)
			uf_send_add_in('使用对象','0',ll_add_row) //19	使用对象	String	1	是	0，1	生育住院时需区分大人还是婴儿使用费用，1 婴儿 0大人。其余住院默认给0
			//用药标志
			uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row) //3	用药标志	string	1	是		0：普通 1：出院带药 2：抢救
			uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row) //11	处方号	 String	20	否		中草药必须传
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] > 0 THEN
				uf_send_add_in('用法',String(ids_bqyz.Object.ycjl[ll_find_yz]),ll_add_row)
				IF ids_bqyz.Object.xmlx[ll_find_yz] = 3 THEN
					uf_send_add_in('用药标志','1',ll_add_row)
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row)
				END IF
				
				uf_send_add_in('用药频次',of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC',	String(ids_bqyz.Object.sypc[ll_find_yz])),ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每次用量',String(ids_bqyz.Object.ycjl[ll_find_yz]),ll_add_row)
				
				IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 3 THEN
					ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find_yz]
					uf_send_add_in('处方号',String(ldc_yzzh),ll_add_row)
					ll_findcy = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find_yz)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
					IF ll_findcy > 0 THEN
						ls_dffbz = '2'
					ELSE
						ls_dffbz = '1'
					END IF
				ELSE
					uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row)
					ls_dffbz = '0'
				END IF
				
			ELSE
				//				uf_send_add_in('用量单位','无',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用药标志','0',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('用法','无',ll_add_row) //	用法String	40	否	
				uf_send_add_in('用药频次','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('每次用量','',ll_add_row)
				uf_send_add_in('处方号','',ll_add_row)
				ls_dffbz = '0'
				//				uf_send_add_in('单复方标志','0',ll_add_row)
			END IF
			IF ids_bqyz.Object.yepb[ll_find_yz] = 1 THEN
				uf_send_add_in('使用对象','1',ll_add_row)
			ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('使用对象','0',ll_add_row)
			END IF
		END IF
		uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dffbz,ll_add_row) //20	单复方标志	string	1	是	0，1，2	单复方标志(N1:0非草药(不存在单复方)，1草药单方，2草药复方)
		ld_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
		//审批标志 2015-4-27 spbz = 1 非控制的，按0
		li_spbz = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(li_spbz) THEN li_spbz = 0
		IF li_spbz = 1 THEN
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				IF IsNull(ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find]) Or ids_ylsf.Object.#6[ll_find] <= 0 THEN
					li_spbz = 0
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF IsNull(ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find]) Or ids_typk.Object.#12[ll_find] <= 0 THEN
					li_spbz = 0
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//------------------------------------------
		CHOOSE CASE  li_spbz
			CASE 9,1
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','1',ll_add_row) //25	超限自费标志	string	1	是		病人自愿自费使用的药品诊疗目录通过该标志来与正常使用目录区分：0:正常 1：超限自费
				ld_zfbl = 1.00
			CASE 8,2
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',ll_add_row)
			CASE ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('超限自费标志','0',ll_add_row)
		END CHOOSE
		//自负比例 ld_zfbl
		//		ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(as_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,'30','',ls_dffbz,Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]),li_ybfl,as_msg)
		li_ybfl = ids_zyfymx.Object.ybfl[ll_row]
		uf_send_add_in('自付比例',ld_zfbl,ll_add_row) //16	自付比例	double	5（4）	是	
		//uf_send_add_in('预住院标志','0',ll_add_row)		
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY'
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWMXLSH[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.JSMXLSH[ll_insert] = ls_zyhm
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YPZLLB[ll_insert] = ls_ypzllb
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZLBL[ll_insert] = ld_zfbl
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ybfl[ll_insert] = String(li_ybfl)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYJE[ll_insert] = Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row])
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DFFBZ[ll_insert] = Integer(ls_dffbz)
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZTBZ[ll_insert] = 0
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SPBZ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]
		ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ld_zfbl
		ld_zfje = Dec(ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row]) * ld_zfbl
		ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = ld_zfje
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.xmzxbh[ll_insert] = ls_xmzxbh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.gjybbm[ll_insert] = ls_gjybbm
	NEXT
	//uf_send_add('明细医疗费用总额',ldc_zjje)
	uf_send_add('明细条数',ll_add_row)
	gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
	IF Not  uf_send(as_msg)  THEN
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			ll_cwts = This.uf_getdecimal( '错误记录条数')
			This.uf_getstring_mxnr( '无法保存的流水号列表')
			FOR ll_ret = 1 To ll_cwts
				as_msg += This.uf_getstring_in( '医嘱明细序号', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "类别" + This.uf_getstring_in( '药品诊疗类别', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "编码" +This.uf_getstring_in( '医院项目编码', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "自付比例" + This.uf_getstring_in( '正确的自付比例', ll_ret)
				as_msg += "自负" + String(This.uf_getdecimal_in( '正确的自负金额', ll_ret))
				as_msg += "," + This.uf_getstring_in( '不能保存的原因代码', ll_ret)
				as_msg += ":"+ This.uf_getstring_in( '不能保存的原因说明', ll_ret)
				//1	医嘱明细序号	string	20	否		 医院端明细序号
				//2	药品诊疗类别	string	1	否		1 药品 2诊疗
				//3	医院项目编码	string	20	否		 
				//4	正确的自负比例	string	20	否		若不能保存的原因为1主健重复，则此域为空
				//5	正确的自负金额	double	10(2)	否		 
				//6	不能保存的原因代码	string	1	否		1主健重复 2自负比例错误
				//7	不能保存的原因说明	string	100	否		
			NEXT
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1 THEN
			COMMIT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
		ELSE
			as_msg = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error + ' ids_zyfymx:' +ids_zyfymx.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
//ELSE
//END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_jscl (string as_jbr, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, boolean ab_jsbz, integer ai_jslx, string as_fplsh, string as_jydd, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_msg);//wangyi 20180921
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_msg = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
//ab_jsbz true:出院结算 0:预结算
Long ll_zyh,ll_RecvCount,ll_brks,ll_jsdh
Integer li_cyfs
String ls_klb,ls_knsj,ls_jzbh,ls_zyhm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_zszh='',ls_ywlx = '21'
Dec{2} ldc_zjje = 0
String ls_zzys,ls_mxzdh = '',ls_temp,ls_zflp,ls_cbd
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_scjssj,ldt_cyrq,ldt_jsrq
SetNull(ldt_scjssj)
SetNull(ldt_cyrq)
SELECT	 KNXX,  RYRQ,   CYRQ,		BRKS,		ZZYS,		CYFS,		ZYHM,		JSDH ,  MZJCODE,  SBHM
Into :ls_knsj,:ldt_ryrq,:ldt_cyrq,:ll_brks,:ls_zzys,:li_cyfs,:ls_zyhm,:ll_jsdh,:ls_zflp,:ls_cbd
From ZY_BRRY  Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
SELECT Max(ZZRQ) Into :ldt_scjssj From ZY_ZYJS Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZFPB = 0 ;
//IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
//	ls_klb = '2'
//ELSE
//	ls_klb = '0'
//END IF
ls_klb = '0'
IF IsNull(ldt_scjssj) THEN
	ldt_scjssj = ldt_ryrq
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_cyrq) THEN
	ldt_cyrq = gf_server_date()
END IF

SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_jzbh From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
ll_RecvCount = 0
SELECT Count(*),SUM(ZJJE) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ( JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null ) ;
IF ll_RecvCount > 0 THEN
ELSE
	SELECT Count(*),SUM(ZJJE) Into :ll_RecvCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs);
END IF
SELECT ZSZH Into :ls_zszh From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh ;
IF Not IsNull(ls_zszh) And ls_zszh <> '' THEN
	ls_ywlx = '52'
ELSE
	ls_ywlx = '21'
END IF

IF ll_RecvCount = 0 THEN
	as_msg = '无结算数据'
	RETURN 0
END IF
SELECT Max(JSMXLSH) Into :ls_mxzdh From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 ;
IF IsNull(ls_mxzdh) THEN ls_mxzdh = ''

IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	ls_zyhm = ls_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF
IF ab_jsbz THEN
	ls_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
ELSE
	IF Pos(ls_knsj,'|') > 0 THEN
		//姓名|证件类型|证件号码|  罝AT*
钆苵参保地行政区|  渠道ID|渠道授权码|渠道编码|点位编号。
		//渠道编码（窗口、自助机、诊间），点位编号（按医院对窗口、自助机、诊室的实际编号进行传入），
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj + '|' + ls_zflp + '|' +ls_cbd+'||' 
		//渠道编码：窗口（ZJA06B07C36D70）、自助机（ZJA06B07C36D71）、诊间（ZJA06B07C36D72）
		IF base_info.syscode = 32 THEN
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D71|"
		ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D70|"
		ELSE
			ls_knsj = ls_knsj + "|ZJA06B07C36D72|"
		END IF
		ls_knsj = ls_knsj  + String(base_info.syscode)		
	END IF
END IF
IF Pos(ls_knsj,'|') > 0  THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
//	ls_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
ELSE
	ls_klb = '1'
END IF
IF ab_jsbz = False THEN //预结算
	of_reset_jsxx(  astr_tzyb_jsxx ) 
	This.uf_send_init('34')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	
	//5	住院序列号	string	20	是		 
	//6	住院登记结算交易号	string	20	是		该交易号由住院登记交易返回。
	//7	本次结算明细条数	integer	10	是		为已经通过交易33提交到中心库中明细记录的条数.
	//8	出院日期	data	10	是		
	//9	是否使用个帐支付	String	1	是		（台州用这个控制是否使用帐户，0不使用帐户，1为使用帐户）
	//10	终端机编号	string	12	是		读卡机具内装载的社会保障PSAM卡编号；各交易发起机构现有社会保障卡接口系统无法获取到PSAM卡编号的可以暂时传入"0"
	uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
	uf_send_add('住院登记结算交易号',ls_jzbh)
	uf_send_add('本次结算明细条数',ll_RecvCount)
	uf_send_add('出院日期',Date(ldt_cyrq))
	uf_send_add('是否使用个帐支付','0')
//	uf_send_add('提交明细的总条数',ll_RecvCount)
//	uf_send_add('预住院标志','0')
	uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')
ELSE //确认结算	
	//出院前必须先调用38号交易（确认结算前，都会调用预结算，所以提前调用）
	IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'1',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //入院变更
	IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'2',al_zyh,as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //出院变更
	//-----------------------------
	//jyjk jyjslx 开始结算
	ls_klb = '1'
//	IF Len(ls_knsj) > 30 THEN
//		ls_klb = '2'
//	ELSE
//		ls_klb = '0'
//	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('36')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息',ls_knsj)
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	
//5	住院序列号	string	20	是		 
//6	住院登记结算交易号	string	20	是		该交易由住院登记交易返回
//7	本次结算明细条数	integer	10	是		 
//8	经办人	string	20	否		 
//9	出院日期	data	10	是		
//10	是否使用个帐支付	String	1	是		（台州用这个控制是否使用帐户，0不使用帐户，1为使用帐户）
//11	终端机编号	string	12	是		读卡机具内装载的社会保障PSAM卡编号；各交易发起机构现有社会保障卡接口系统无法获取到PSAM卡编号的可以暂时传入"0"
	uf_send_add('住院序列号',ls_zyhm)
	uf_send_add('住院登记结算交易号',ls_jzbh)
	uf_send_add('本次结算明细条数',ll_RecvCount)
	uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
	uf_send_add('出院日期',Date(ldt_cyrq))
	uf_send_add('是否使用个帐支付','0')
	uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')
	uf_send_add('支付令牌','')
END IF

IF uf_send(as_msg) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		ldt_jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( "结算日期") //6	结算日期	datetime	20	否		 yyyyMMdd hh24miss
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq = ldt_jsrq
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx
		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf) //   计算结果信息	composite	 			参照29号交易的计算结果信息
		//astr_tzyb_jsxx.smkzhye  = astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
		of_get_jjfd(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_jjfd) //	 基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否		参照29号交易的基金分段信息
		//		超限明细列表	composite				参照29号交易的超限明细列表
		//		超限列表结构体参数：
		//序号	名称	类型	长度(精度)	不能为空	值范围	备注
		//1	药品诊疗类型	string	1	否		 参考数据字典
		//2	医院项目编码	string	20	否		 
		//3	超限数量	double	10(2)	否		
		//4	超限自费金额	double	10(2)	否		 
		//5	合计自费金额 	double	10(2)	否		
		//6	超限原因碊AT*
	 string	1	否		1:单价限额 2：单次限额 3：单次限量 4：年度限量
		//7	超限原因说明	 string	100	否	
		IF ab_jsbz THEN
			//		费用汇总信息结构体	composite				如下所示：
			astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh =  This.uf_getstring('住院结算交易交流水号')
//			of_get_fyhzxx(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_fyhzxx)  20180927
			IF of_insert_jymx( '', al_zyh, ai_jscs, as_fplsh, 'ZY', as_jydd, '36' ,ls_ywlx,  '', ls_zyhm,astr_tzyb_jsxx, '' , as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			//做确认交易，确认交易失败仍然认为是失败交易
			
			//				IF This.uf_qrybjs('ZY',astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh ,as_msg,astr_tzyb_jsxx.qrjslsh,ls_zyhm) < 0 THEN
			IF This.uf_qrybjs_zy('ZY',astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh ,'2',astr_tzyb_jsxx,as_msg,astr_tzyb_jsxx.qrjslsh,ls_zyhm) < 0 THEN
				as_msg = '台州本地医保结算成功，确认失败：' +as_msg
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		istr_tzyb_jsxx = astr_tzyb_jsxx
	END IF
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public function decimal of_get_zfbl (str_tzyb_zhxx astr_tzyb_zhxx, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, string as_tsbbm, string as_dfybz, datetime adt_jfrq, ref integer ai_sfdj, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已改
//====================================================================
// 事件: u_tzybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	str_tzyb_zhxx	astr_tzyb_zhxx	
// 	value    	string       	as_ypzllb     	
// 	value    	string       	as_zxxmbm

// 	value    	string       	as_dfybz      	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jfrq      	
// 	reference	integer      	ai_sfdj       	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//====================================================================

Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
This.uf_send_init('58')
this.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
this.uf_send_add('IC信息',astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.kh)
This.uf_send_add('螪AT* 纸鹬Ц斗绞 ','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')

This.uf_send_add('中心项目编码',as_zxxmbm)

This.uf_send_add('单复方标志',as_dfybz)

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	ai_sfdj = Integer( This.uf_getstring('收费等级'))
	ldc_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal( '自付比例')

public function integer uf_jycx (string as_jylx, string as_jylsh, ref string as_jyjd, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已改
//1	是否有医保卡	string	1	是	1,0,2	0无卡，1有卡
//2	IC信息	string	300	否		
//3	现金支付方式	string	1	否		现金支付方式（1现金、2电子钱包、3银行借记卡，其它值默认为1）
//4	银行卡信息	string	50	否		暂时设定50个长度
//5	待查询用户交易类型号	string	2	是	30，31，32，36，37,40	可以查询的用户交易类型号有:30、31、32、36、37、40
//6	待查询的用户交易流水号	string	20	是		对应门诊序列号，住院序列号
//30门诊结算、31挂号退号/门诊退费、32住院登记、36住院结算、37住院退费、40取消住院登记。
This.uf_send_init('43')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')

This.uf_send_add('待查询用户交易类型号', as_jylx)
IF as_jylx = '36' OR as_jylx = '37' THEN
	long ll_jsdh
   SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyhm = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取jsdh失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
		as_jylsh = as_jylsh + '-'+String(ll_jsdh)
	END IF
END IF
This.uf_send_add('待查询的用户交易流水号', as_jylsh)
// 	返回参数(RetMsg)
//1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
//2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
//3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
//6	用户交易是否成功	string	2	是		0成功，-1失败
//7	交易时间	datetime	20	否		 
//8	交易结算流水号	double	16	否		
//9	交易处于阶段	String	3	否		30，36三个交易分为0:已结算 1：已确认 其余没有确认交易的则默认为空
//10	该用户交易出口参数	composite	 			如果查询的交易为30，31，36，37返回的为计算结构体，请参考门诊预结算计算结果，其他交易返回为空
//11	基金分段信息结构体	composite	 			参照29号交易的基金分段信息
//12	费用汇总信息结构体	composite				参考36号交易的费用汇总信息结构体
//
IF This.uf_send( as_error) THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring("交易状态") <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring("错误信息")
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		IF This.uf_getstring("用户交易是否成功") <> '0' THEN
			as_error = "用户交易失败!"
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq = This.uf_getdatetime( '交易时间')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring("交易结算流水号")
		IF as_jylx = '30' Or as_jylx = '31' Or as_jylx = '36' Or as_jylx = '37' THEN
//			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
			IF as_jylx = '30' Or as_jylx = '36' THEN
				as_jyjd = This.uf_getstring("交易处于阶段") //0:已结算 1:已确认
				IF as_jyjd = '0' THEN
					as_jyjd = '0:已结算'
				ELSE
					as_jyjd = '1:已确认'
				END IF
			END IF
			of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf)
//			astr_tzyb_jsxx.smkzhye  = astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.qtzfs3
			of_get_jjfd(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_jjfd)
		END IF
		//12	费用汇总信息结构体
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_qrybjs_zy (string as_jylx, string as_jsjylsh, string as_ybsfjs, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref string as_error, ref string as_qrjslsh, string as_jzxlh);//wangyi 已改
IF  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'GH' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'SF' Or  Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_recieve,ls_send,ls_ybsfjs,ls_datavalue
Integer li_ret,li_cur //li_xxtlx,
//li_xxtlx = Integer(is_xxtlx)
ls_recieve = Space(3000)
//IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.klb ) And Not IsNull(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj ) THEN
//	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj +'~~~~~~'
//ELSE
//	ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
//END IF

IF istr_yb_zhxx.klb = '5' THEN
	ls_send = '$$'+istr_yb_zhxx.klb+'~~'+istr_yb_zhxx.knsj+'~~~~~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = '$$0~~~~~~~~'
END IF
IF Mid(as_jylx,1,2) = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_send = ls_send + '36~~'
ELSE
	ls_send = ls_send + '30~~'
END IF
ls_send = ls_send + as_jsjylsh + '~~0~~$$'

li_ret = f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,ls_send,ls_recieve,is_yljgdm)

ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,3)
ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,1,Len(ls_recieve) - 2) //去掉$$开头以及结尾

Integer li_pos
li_pos = Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",1)
IF Integer(Mid(ls_recieve,1,li_pos - 1) ) < 0 THEN
	IF Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) > 0 THEN
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 ,  Pos(ls_recieve,"~~",li_pos + 1) - li_pos - 1 )
	ELSE
		as_error = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1 )
	END IF
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//	ls_datavalue = trim(mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos  -1 )) //li_len[li_i]))
	ls_recieve = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
END IF

//	6	交易流水号	string	20	是		唯一确定本次医保确认交易
li_pos = LastPos(ls_recieve,"~~")
as_qrjslsh = Mid(ls_recieve,li_pos + 1)
IF of_update_jsmx(as_qrjslsh,as_jsjylsh,as_jzxlh,astr_tzyb_jsxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//f_UserBargaingApply(49,0,'$$~~~~30~12345678901234~2~HIS数据保存失败$$'，$$0~~~~$$，""）
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxsc (long al_zyh, string as_jbr, string as_cbrlb, string as_ywlx, ref string as_error);//wangyi 20180921
Long ll_ybpb,ll_mxbs,ll_count
DateTime ldt_zzrq,ldt_czsj,ldt_scsj
Dec{2} ld_zjje,ld_xjzfze,ld_jjzfze
String ls_jydd,ls_mxcllsh,ls_zyhm = '',ls_knsj
str_tzyb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx2
Integer li_ret,li_scbz = 0
IF Not IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) THEN
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	
	//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
	
	CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
ELSE
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
		GOTO Process_GetID
	ELSE
		CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
	END IF
END IF

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = 'gtrans_temp_mssql连接失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
//------------------------------------------------
Process_GetID:
//卡内信息判别本地异地，以此判断调用哪个接口
SELECT knxx Into :ls_knsj From zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF Pos(is_tzsbj , Left(ls_knsj,6)) = 0 THEN //台州市异地判断
	ib_yd = True
	RETURN gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_zy_mxsc( al_zyh,as_error)
ELSE
	ib_yd = False
END IF

//	IF uf_zydj_bg(as_jbr,'1',al_zyh,as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1 //入院变更
ldt_czsj = gf_server_date()
SELECT SCBZ Into :li_scbz From JKXT.YB_BRJL Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
IF li_scbz = 1 THEN
	SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "　zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "正在上传明细，不能同步上传!"
	GOTO Error
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
INSERT INTO "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"   ( "ZYH",  "SCBZ",   "SCSJ" )
	Values ( :al_zyh,0,:ldt_czsj)  Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 1,SCSJ = :ldt_czsj Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
END IF

gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)

//获取已经做结算的日期
SELECT Max(jsrq) Into :ldt_zzrq From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx  Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF IsNull(ldt_zzrq) THEN
		//未做过结算的则取入院日期
		SELECT ryrq,zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm + "获取菵AT* 朐喝掌谑О :" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
			GOTO Error
		END IF
	ELSE
		ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
	END IF
ELSEIF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh) + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"获取上一次结算日期失败:" +gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
	GOTO Error
END IF
ldt_zzrq = DateTime(Date(ldt_zzrq),Time(23:59:59))


//明细上传--医保做预结算
DO WHILE Date(ldt_zzrq) < Date(ldt_czsj)
	IF Date(ldt_zzrq) = Date(ldt_czsj) THEN EXIT
	//提交明细
	li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,as_cbrlb,as_ywlx,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
			SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
		END IF
		as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
		GOTO Error
	ELSE
		//预结算处理
		IF li_ret > 0 THEN
			
			IF uf_zy_jscl( as_jbr,al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, False, 0,'',  ls_jydd, lstr_yb_jsxx,lstr_yb_jsxx2, as_error) < 0 THEN
				IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
					SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
				END IF
				as_error =  "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +  '医保预结算失败: ' + as_error
				GOTO Error
			ELSE
				//获取对应支付情况
				ll_mxbs = 0
				
				SELECT count(*) Into :ll_mxbs From JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 0 And zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				
				ld_zjje = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.zfze
				ld_xjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjxjzf
				ld_jjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf.hjbxje
				
				//判断是否已经预结算过
				SELECT count(*) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				
				gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					UPDATE JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Set czsj = :ldt_czsj,mxbs = :ll_mxbs,zjje = :ld_zjje,xjzfze = :ld_xjzfze,jjzfze = :ld_jjzfze Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				ELSE
					INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze) Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				END IF
				IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
					as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSEIF li_ret = 0 THEN //无明细
			//判断是否已经预结算过
			SELECT count(*) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			ldt_scsj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),-1),Time(23:59:59))
			ll_mxbs = 0
			ld_zjje = 0
			ld_xjzfze = 0
			ld_jjzfze = 0
			
			SELECT MXBS,ZJJE,XJZFZE,JJZFZE INTO :ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze FROM JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX
				Where zyh = :al_zyh And  jsrq  = :ldt_scsj Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
				
			gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX SET CZSJ = :ldt_czsj,MXBS = :ll_mxbs,ZJJE = :ld_zjje,XJZFZE = :ld_xjzfze,JJZFZE = :ld_jjzfze
					Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			ELSE
				INSERT Into JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(zyh,jsrq,czsj,mxbs,zjje,xjzfze,jjzfze) Values (:al_zyh,:ldt_zzrq,:ldt_czsj,:ll_mxbs,:ld_zjje,:ld_xjzfze,:ld_jjzfze) Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
			END IF
			IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
			ELSE
				gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
				as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText + String(gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			
		END IF
	END IF
	ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
LOOP

SetNull(ldt_zzrq)
li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh,as_cbrlb,as_ywlx,0,ldt_zzrq,as_error)

IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
		SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh;
	END IF
	as_error = "zyh:" +String(al_zyh)  + "zyhm:" + ls_zyhm +"上传明细失败" + as_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF li_ret >= 0 THEN
	
	
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
RETURN li_ret

Error:
gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)

RETURN -1




end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_zy79 (long al_zyh, string as_cbrlb, string as_ywlb, ref string as_msg);//wangyi 20180921
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_row,ll_i
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Integer li_ybfl
String ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0',ls_yzmxxh
Dec{0} ldc_yzzh
ll_cur = 0
ll_row = 1
ll_count = ids_zyfymx.RowCount( )

string ls_zddm1,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms[],ls_zddmcs[],ls_ryzd
IF of_get_zy_zdxx(al_zyh,1,ls_zddm1,ls_zdmc,ls_zddms,ls_zddmcs,ls_ryzd) < 0 THEN
	as_msg = '诊断取失败!'
	RETURN -1
END IF
DO WHILE ll_count >= ll_row
	This.uf_send_init('79')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有褼AT* ','0')
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('待遇类别',as_cbrlb)
	This.uf_send_add('业务类型',as_ywlb)
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码',ls_zddm1) //7	疾病编码	string	20	否		如果是规定病报销则需要传入规定病编码，其余可为空
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '项目列表')
	ll_i = 0
	FOR ll_cur = ll_row To ll_count
		ll_i ++
		ls_yzmxxh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_cur])
		IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 0 THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			END IF
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			ls_dffbz = '0'
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_cur],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
			END IF
			
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_cur] = 3 THEN
				ldc_yzzh = ids_bqyz.Object.yzzh[ll_find]
				ll_find = ids_bqyz.Find( "yzzh ="+String(ldc_yzzh)+" and getrow() <> "+String(ll_find)+" and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and ypxh <> "+String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) , 1, 999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ls_dffbz = '2'
				ELSE
					ls_dffbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱明细序号', ls_yzmxxh, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',ls_ypzllb, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('医保中心编码',ls_xmzxbh, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',ls_dffbz, ll_i)
		This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_cur]),'yyyymmdd'), ll_i)
		
		IF (Mod(ll_cur,100) = 0 And ll_cur > 1 ) or (ll_cur = ll_count) THEN
			ll_row = ll_cur + 1
			GOTO Send
		END IF
		//	ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl(as_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,'30','',ls_dffbz,Date(ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_cur]),li_ybfl,'PT',as_msg)
		//	ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
		//	ids_zyfymx.Object.ybfl[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
	NEXT
	Send:
	Long ll_cpu1,ll_cpu2
	ll_cpu1 = CPU()
	IF uf_send(as_msg) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integ:er	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC緿AT*
	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	自付比例列表
		//	1)	医嘱明细序号
		// 2)	自付比列
		ll_cpu2 = CPU()
		gf_applog("79send:" + String(ll_cpu1)+ "--" + String(ll_cpu2) + "as" + String(ll_cpu2 - ll_cpu1) )
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_msg = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_i
			ls_yzmxxh = This.uf_getstring_in( '医嘱明细序号', ll_cur)
			ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find("jlxh = "+ls_yzmxxh ,1,ll_count)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ld_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自付比列', ll_cur)
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = ld_zfbl
			ELSE
				as_msg = "住院--医嘱明细序号：" + ls_yzmxxh + "找不到这条明细"
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_msg) THEN as_msg = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
LOOP
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_mz_gzcl (string as_knsj, string as_jslsh, string as_jbr, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已改
String ls_klb
ls_klb = '1'
//IF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
//	ls_klb = '2'
//ELSE
//	ls_klb = '0'
//END IF


IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init('31')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易号',as_jslsh)
This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')

IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		Integer li_cftf
		//6	是否重复退费	integer	1	是		0正常退费;1结算单已经被退;
		li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否重复退费'))
		IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
		
		//不管是否为重复退费，都能让其继续退费
		IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
		END IF
		//7	退费交易流薉AT*
	string	20	是	
		//8	退费结算日期	datetime	20	是	
		//9	计算结果信息	composite	 	否	
		//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否	

//		astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx 20180927
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算日期')
//		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf) 20180927
		of_get_jjfd(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_jjfd) //astr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq
		of_update_jymx_gz(  as_jslsh, as_jydd,adt_jssj ,  astr_tzyb_jsxx, as_error)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine of_get_sfyzjg (ref str_tzyb_zhxx astr_tzyb_zhxx);//wangyi 已测
//7	医疗身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
//8	工伤身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度蜠AT*
15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果
//9	生育身份验证结果	string	15	是		身份验证结果串长度为15位，部分位预留。医院可以对身份验证结果

string ls_ylsfyzjg,ls_gssfyzjg,ls_sysfyzjg

ls_gssfyzjg = This.uf_getstring('工伤身份验证结果')

//医疗身份验证结果
//第1位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参保 1：没参保或参保状态无效）  
//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）
//第3位：住院冻结（0正常，1冻结）
//第4位：帐户冻结(保留)
//第5位：门诊待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第6位：规定病种待遇是否享受（0:享受,1不享受）
//第7位：住院待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第8位：家庭病床待遇是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//第9位：体检是否享受(0:享受,1不享受)
//其它位（10-15）：内部预留（返回0）
astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_ylsfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,1,1))
astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_ylsfyz.ryhmdfs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,2,1))

astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_ylsfyz.tjsfxs = integer(mid(ls_ylsfyzjg,9,1))

//	工伤身份验证结果	
//第1位：参保人员是否有效（0：正常参盌AT*
 1：没参保或参保状态无效）  
//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）
//第3位：住院冻结
//第4位：基金冻结（单位欠费）
//第5位：工伤待遇是否可以享受(0:已认定,1未认定)
//其它位（6-15）：内部预留（返回0）
astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_gssfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,1,1))
astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_gssfyz.ryhmdfs = integer(mid(ls_gssfyzjg,2,1))

//	生育身份验证结果

//第2位：人员黑名单封锁（0正常，1冻结）

//第4位：基金冻结（单位欠费）

astr_tzyb_zhxx.str_tzyb_sysfyz.cbrysfyx = integer(mid(ls_sysfyzjg,1,1))

public function integer uf_gh_jscl (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref str_tzyb_mzsfqq astr_tzyb_mzsfqq, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, ref str_yb_mzghqq_new astr_yb_mzghqq, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已测
String ls_ghsf,ls_klb
Boolean lb_jsbz = False
Integer li_ret

ls_klb = '1'
ls_ghsf = Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ls_ghsf
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ai_jslx = 1  Or ai_jslx = 0 THEN
	IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN lb_jsbz = True //true:结算 false:预结算
ELSE
	as_error = 'ai_jslx:'+String(ai_jslx)
	RETURN -1
END IF

as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
IF as_jylx = 'PT' Or as_jylx = 'TSB' Or as_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+as_jylx
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_rowcount,ll_mxtop,ll_insert
Integer li_sczs
ll_rowcount = astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount <= 0 THEN
	IF IsNull( astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.fplsh) THEN  astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'NULL'
	as_error = '交易费用明细无数据!FPLSH:' + astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.fplsh
	//		astr_tzyb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SaveAs("c:\mzfymx.txt",Text!,True)
	RETURN -1
END IF
