public function decimal of_get_zfbl79 (string as_cbrlb, string as_ypzllb, string as_zxxmbm, string as_ywlb, string as_yzmxxh, string as_dfybz, date adt_jfrq, string as_jylx, string as_jbbm, ref string as_error);//wangyi 已改
//====================================================================
// 事件: u_pyybjk_his.of_get_zfbl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_cbrlb 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ypzllb	
// 	value    	string  	as_zxxmbm	
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlb  	
// 	value    	string  	as_tsbbm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_dfybz 	
// 	value    	date	adt_jfrq 	
// 	reference	integer 	ai_sfdj  	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2013.04.17
//====================================================================
Dec{3} ldc_zfbl
//CBRLB, YPZLLB, XMZXLSH, YWLB, DFBZ
Long ll_ret = -100
IF as_jylx = 'PT' THEN
	SELECT ZFBL INTO :ldc_zfbl FROM jkxt.tzyb_ypzlzfbl WHERE YPZLBZ = :as_ypzllb AND	YPZLZXBM = :as_zxxmbm Using itran_sqlca;
		
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
		as_error = '获取自付比例和收费等级失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_ret = itran_sqlca.SQLCode
END IF

String ls_jbbm = ''
//IF as_jylx = 'TSB' THEN //特殊病疾病编码
//	ls_jbbm = as_jbbm
//END IF

IF ll_ret = 100 Or as_jylx <> 'PT'  THEN
	This.uf_send_init('79')
	This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	This.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	This.uf_send_add('待遇类别',as_cbrlb)
	This.uf_send_add('业务类型',as_ywlb)//as_ywlb
	This.uf_send_add('疾病编码',as_jbbm) //7	疾病编码	string	20	否		如果是规定病报销则需要传入规定病编码，其余可为空
	this.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '项目列表')
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱明细序号',as_yzmxxh,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('药品诊疗类型',as_ypzllb,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医保中心编码',as_zxxmbm,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('单复方标志',as_dfybz,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('医嘱时间',String(adt_jfrq,'yyyymmdd'),1)
	IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
		//	1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败
		//	2	错误信息	string	100	否		 
		//	3	写医保卡结果	string	1	否		写医保卡结果：0表示不写或写卡成功，其他表示写卡错误信息
		//	4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
		//	5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
		//	6	自付比例列表
		//	1)	医嘱明细序号
		// 2)	自付比列
		IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
			as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ldc_zfbl = This.uf_getdecimal_in( '自付比列', 1)
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN ldc_zfbl
end function

public function integer of_get_zfbl_mz79 (ref datastore ads_fymx, string as_jylx, string as_jyjslb, string as_jbbm, ref string as_msg);Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_find
Dec{3} ld_zfbl
Integer li_ybfl
String ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,ls_dffbz = '0',ls_cbrlb,ls_lx
Dec{0} ldc_yzzh
datetime ldt_curr
ls_cbrlb = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbrlb
ll_count = ads_fymx.RowCount( )
ls_lx = Left(as_jylx,2)
ldt_curr =gf_server_date()

IF ls_lx = 'GH' THEN
	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.fyxh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
			ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl79(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,'gh','0',Date(ldt_curr),as_jylx,as_jbbm,as_msg)
			IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
//			ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur] = li_ybfl
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'YJ' THEN //费用
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],0,as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.#10[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_ylsf.Object.#12[ll_find]
			END 
IF
			ls_dffbz = '0'
		ELSE
			ls_dffbz = '0'
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx( 1, ads_fymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur],ads_fymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur],as_msg )
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN RETURN -1
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ls_ypzllb = String(ids_typk.Object.#15[ll_find])
				ls_xmzxbh = ids_typk.Object.#17[ll_find]
			END IF
			IF ads_fymx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' And ads_fymx.Object.sfxm[ll_cur] = 3   THEN
				ll_find = ads_fymx.Find("YWLX ='CF' and YWLSH=" +String(ads_fymx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]) + " and getrow() <> " + String(ll_cur) +& 					" and ( xmlsh <> " + String(ilrr_ydxh[1]) + & 					" and xmlsh <> " +  String(ilrr_ydxh[2]) + " and xmlsh <> " +String(ilrr_ydxh[3]) + ")",1,999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ls_dffbz = '2' //0:非草药 1:草药单方 2:草药复方
				ELSE
					ls_dffbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		ld_zfbl = of_get_zfbl79(ls_cbrlb,ls_ypzllb,ls_xmzxbh,as_jyjslb,'SF',ls_dffbz,Date(ldt_curr),as_jylx,as_jbbm,as_msg)
		IF ld_zfbl < 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		ads_fymx.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ld_zfbl
//		ads_fymx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = String(li_ybfl)
	NEXT
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer uf_ygyb_jzxx (string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, decimal ad_ghlsh, ref string as_return);IF uf_set_instance(as_return ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init_ygyb('3100')
String ls_sfzh,ls_ybkh,ls_sbkh,ls_SBKSBH,ls_cbrxzqh
Long ll_jslb
IF ad_zyh > 0 THEN
	SELECT brxz,knxx,sbhm,ybkh,zhbz,sfzh Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_cbrxzqh,:ls_sbkh,:ls_SBKSBH,:ls_sfzh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ad_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ls_SBKSBH) Or ls_SBKSBH = '' THEN
		ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT jslb,jzkh,sfzh Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_sfzh From mzxt.mz_Brda Where brbm = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
	ls_sbkh = Right(ls_ybkh,9)
	ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
	IF  istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.kh = ls_sbkh THEN
		ls_cbrxzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
	ELSE
		ls_cbrxzqh = Left(ls_ybkh,6)
	END IF
END IF
integer li_ybpb
select ybpb into :li_ybpb from xtgl.gy_brxz where brxz = :ll_jslb using itran_sqlca;
if li_ybpb <> 1 then
	as_return = '非医保病人'
	return 1
end if
istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ls_sbkh + '-' + ls_SBKSBH
istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH = ls_SBKSBH
istr_jytsrx.sfzh  = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.sfzh
istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH = String(ad_ghlsh)
istr_jytsrx.cbrxzqh = ls_cbrxzqh
This.uf_send_add( 'SFZH', ls_sfzh)
RETURN This.uf_send_ygyb( as_return)




end function

public function integer uf_ybyg_mzsh (datastore ads_yzmx, str_ygyb_jzxx astr_ygyb_jzxx, string as_brbm, string as_ywlx, ref string as_return);IF uf_set_instance(as_return ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF ads_yzmx.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_return = '明细为空'
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
	IF ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_cfmx' THEN
		as_return = '处方ads_yzmx的dataobject:有误'+ String(ads_yzmx.DataObject)
		RETURN 1
	END IF
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
	IF ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_yjk2_list' And ads_yzmx.DataObject <> 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
		as_return = '医技ads_yzmx的dataobject:有误'+ String(ads_yzmx.DataObject)
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF

String ls_sfzh,ls_ybkh,ls_sbkh,ls_SBKSBH,ls_cbrxzqh
Long ll_jslb,ll_find
Integer li_ybpb,li_brxb
SELECT jslb,jzkh,sfzh,brxb Into :ll_jslb,:ls_ybkh,:ls_sfzh,:li_brxb From mzxt.mz_Brda Where brbm = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_brxb <> 1 And li_brxb <> 2 THEN li_brxb = -1
ls_sbkh = Right(ls_ybkh,9)
ls_SBKSBH = Mid(ls_ybkh,1,Len(ls_ybkh) - 9 )
IF istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.kh = ls_sbkh THEN
	as_return = '未正确获取病人医保账户信息，请重新读卡再试'
	RETURN 1
END IF
ls_cbrxzqh = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh
SELECT ybpb Into :li_ybpb From xtgl.gy_brxz Where brxz = :ll_jslb Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_ybpb <> 1 THEN
	as_return = '非医保病人'
	RETURN 1
END IF

String ls_ysbm,ls_brxm,ls_ysxx,ls_yzid,ls_zw,ls_ksbm,ls_yllb = '12'
DateTime ldt_now,ldt_csny
Long ll_row,ll_count,ll_ygjb,ll_ygzw,ll_fyxh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ldc_ybnje,ldc_zje,ldc_ybje,ldc_sl
dec{4} ldc_dj,ldc_zfbl
Dec{0} ldc_ghlsh,ldc_ywlsh
ldt_csny = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.csny
ls_brxm = istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.brxm
ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
ldc_ghlsh = astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh
ls_ysbm = astr_ygyb_jzxx.ysgh
ls_ysxx =  of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'MZ_KS',astr_ygyb_jzxx.KSBM  )+'|'+ astr_ygyb_jzxx.ysxm
ls_ksbm = of_get_dzdmsb( 'MZ_KS',astr_ygyb_jzxx.KSBM )
ls_yllb = astr_ygyb_jzxx.jzlx
//12	普通门诊
//	15	门诊特殊病
//	42	工伤康复
//	43	老工伤复发
//	51	生育门诊
select ygjb,ygzw into :ll_ygjb,:ll_ygzw from gy_ygdm where ygdm = :ls_ysbm using itran_sqlca;
if isnull(ll_ygjb) then
	ll_ygjb =1
else
	choose case right(string(ll_ygjb),1)
		case '1'
			ll_ygjb = 4
		case '2'
			ll_ygjb = 3
		case '3'
			ll_ygjb = 2
		case else
			ll_ygjb = 1
	end choose
end if
if not isnull(ll_ygzw) then
	select dmmc into :ls_zw from xtgl.gy_dmzd where dmlb=26 and dmsb=:ll_ygzw using itran_sqlca;
end if
if isnull(ls_zw) or ls_zw ='' then ls_zw = '0'
string ls_yyxmmc,ls_ypzllb,ls_jbbm,ls_jylx,ls_ybbm,ls_sypc
if ls_yllb = '15' then
	ls_jbbm =  istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.tsbbm
	ls_jylx = 'TSB'
else
	ls_jbbm = ''
	ls_jylx = 'PT'
end if

ll_count = ads_yzmx.RowCount()
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	//获取自付比例
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
			ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.YPXH[ll_row]
		   ls_yzid = String(ldc_ywlsh)+'Y' + String(Integer(ads_yzmx.Object.PXXH[ll_row]))
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(1, ll_fyxh,long(ads_yzmx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]),as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = this.of_get_zfbl79(istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbrlb, string(ids_typk.object.YPZLLB[ll_find]),  string(ids_typk.object.#2[ll_find]),ls_yllb, ls_yzid, '0', date(ldt_now), ls_jylx, ls_jbbm, as_return)
			IF isnull(ldc_zfbl) or ldc_zfbl < 0 then ldc_zfbl = 1.00
			ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
		else
			IF Lower(ads_yzmx.DataObject) = 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.FYXH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'F' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row])
			ELSE
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.BH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'FF' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row])
			END IF
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(0, ll_fyxh,0,as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 0
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = of_get_zfbl79(istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbrlb, string(ids_ylsf.object.YPZLLB[ll_find]) , string(ids_ylsf.object.#2[ll_find]),ls_yllb, ls_yzid, '0', date(ldt_now), ls_jylx, ls_jbbm, as_return)
			if isnull(ldc_zfbl) or ldc_zfbl < 0 then ldc_zfbl= 1
			ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
		end if
	next
	This.uf_send_init_ygyb('3200')
	istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ls_sbkh + '-' + ls_SBKSBH
	istr_jytsrx.SBKSBH = ls_SBKSBH
	istr_jytsrx.sfzh  = ls_sfzh
	istr_jytsrx.JZWYBH = String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh)
	istr_jytsrx.cbrxzqh = ls_cbrxzqh
	
	This.uf_send_add('YSBM', ls_ysbm)
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaimDetailSet')
	ldc_zjje = 0.00
	ldc_ybnje = 0.00
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		IF as_ywlx = 'CF'  THEN
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.cflsh[ll_row]
			ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.YPXH[ll_row]
			ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.ypsl[ll_row]
			ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.ypdj[ll_row]
			ldc_zje = round(dec(ads_yzmx.Object.cfts[ll_row]) * ldc_sl * ldc_dj,2)
		   ls_yzid = String(ldc_ywlsh)+'Y' + String(Integer(ads_yzmx.Object.PXXH[ll_row]))
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(1, ll_fyxh,long(ads_yzmx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]),as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			ls_ybbm = string(ids_typk.object.SNTYBM[ll_find])
			select YPZLSTYBM into :ls_ybbm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml where ypzxlsh = :ls_ybbm using itran_sqlca;
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF003', string(ads_yzmx.Object.cfts[ll_row]), ll_row) //帖数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKA609', ldc_sl, ll_row) //包装数量
			
			if string(ids_typk.object.#13[ll_find]) = '2' then
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '0', ll_row)//		项目类型
				ls_ypzllb = '0'
			else
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '1', ll_row)//		项目类型
				ls_ypzllb = '1'
			end if
			ldc_zfbl = ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
			ldc_ybje = ldc_zje * ( 1 - ldc_zfbl)
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ELIGIBLE_AMOUNT', ldc_ybje, ll_row) //	医保内金额
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', ls_yzid, ll_row) //		   	明细ID
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_ID', ls_ybbm , ll_row)//		项目编码
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_NAME', String(ads_yzmx.Object.ypmc[ll_row]), ll_row)//				项目名称
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'NUMBERS', ldc_sl, ll_row)//			NUMBERS 	数量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'PRICE', ldc_dj, ll_row)//				单价
			ls_sypc = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_SYPC',	String(ads_yzmx.Object.GYPC[ll_row]))
			if ls_sypc = '无'  or ls_sypc = '' or isnull(ls_sypc) then
				ls_sypc = '0'
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'FREQUENCY_INTERVAL',ls_sypc , ll_row) //	用药频次	见用药频次字典表，非空
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'Specification', '0', ll_row)//	规格
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE', string(ads_yzmx.Object.dcyl[ll_row]), ll_row)//	 	每次用量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_DAYS', String(ads_yzmx.Object.YYTS[ll_row]), ll_row)//	用药天数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_UNIT',string(ids_typk.object.#7[ll_find]) , ll_row)//包装单位
		
		ELSE
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
			IF Lower(ads_yzmx.DataObject) = 'd_mzys_yjmx' THEN
				ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.FYXH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'F' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.yjlsh[ll_row])
				ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.xmdj[ll_row]
				ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.xmsl[ll_row]
			ELSE
				ll_fyxh = ads_yzmx.Object.BH[ll_row]
				ldc_ywlsh = ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row]
				ls_yzid = 'FF' + String(ads_yzmx.Object.LSH[ll_row])
				ls_yyxmmc = ads_yzmx.Object.pm[ll_row]
				ldc_dj = ads_yzmx.Object.DJ[ll_row]
				ldc_sl = ads_yzmx.Object.sl[ll_row]
			END IF
			ldc_zje = ads_yzmx.Object.zfje[ll_row] + ads_yzmx.Object.jzje[ll_row]
			if isnull(ldc_zje) then
				ldc_zje = round(ldc_sl * ldc_dj,2)
			end if
			ll_find = of_get_jbxx(0, ll_fyxh,0,as_return)
			if ll_find < 0 then
				return 1
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF003', '1', ll_row) //帖数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKA609', '1', ll_row) //包装数量
			ldc_zfbl = ads_yzmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
			ldc_ybje = ldc_zje * ( 1 - ldc_zfbl)
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ELIGIBLE_AMOUNT', ldc_ybje, ll_row) //	医保内金额
			ldc_ybnje = ldc_ybnje + ldc_ybje
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'FREQUENCY_INTERVAL', '61', ll_row) //	用药频次	见用药频次字典表，非空
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', ls_yzid, ll_row) //		   	明细ID
			
			ls_ybbm = string(ids_ylsf.object.SNTYBM[ll_find])
			select YPZLSTYBM into :ls_ybbm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml where ypzxlsh = :ls_ybbm using itran_sqlca;
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_ID', ls_ybbm, ll_row)//	项目编码
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_NAME',ls_yyxmmc, ll_row)//	项目名称
			if string(ids_ylsf.object.#6[ll_find]) = '2' then
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '0', ll_row)//		项目类型
			else
				This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_TYPE', '1', ll_row)//		项目类型
			end if
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'NUMBERS', ldc_sl, ll_row)//数量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'PRICE', ldc_dj, ll_row)//				单价
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'Specification', '0', ll_row)//	规格
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE', '1', ll_row)//	 	每次用量
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_DAYS', '1', ll_row)//	用药天数
			This.uf_send_add_in( 'USAGE_UNIT',string(ids_ylsf.object.#4[ll_find]) , ll_row)//				包装单位
		END IF
		ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ldc_zje
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ApprovalNumber', '0', ll_row) //预留三
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'BKC227', '0', ll_row) //预留二
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'COSTS', ldc_zje, ll_row) //总费用
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'AKF005', ls_ysbm, ll_row) //医师编码
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'DEPTNAME', ls_ysxx, ll_row) //科室名称|医生姓名；本明细科室名称为心胸外科，医生姓名为李四，应该传值：心胸外科|李四
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ITEM_DATE',String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), ll_row) //	服务日期
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'PhysicianLevel', string(ll_ygjb), ll_row) //				医师级别
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_PhysicianAP', ls_zw, ll_row) //				医师行政职务
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'ZZZ_Flag', '0', ll_row) //				计费标记
	NEXT
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaim')
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BENEFIT_GROUP_ID', '1', 1) //人员类别
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BENEFIT_TYPE', istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.cbrlb, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'BMI_CONVERED_AMOUNT', ldc_ybnje, 1) //医保内金额
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'CKC892', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	//获取诊断
	String ls_zddm,ls_zdmc[],ls_zdms,ls_zdqt_icd[],ls_fzd
	This.of_get_mz_zdxx(as_brbm,ldc_ghlsh, ls_ysbm, ls_zddm,ls_zdqt_icd, ls_zdmc, ls_zdms)
	ll_count = UpperBound(ls_zdqt_icd)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			IF ll_row = 1 THEN
				ls_fzd = ls_zdqt_icd[1]
			ELSE
				ls_fzd = '|' + ls_zdqt_icd[ll_row]
			END IF
		NEXT
		ls_zdms = Mid(ls_zdms,1,Pos(ls_zdms,',') - 1)
	ELSE
		ls_fzd = ls_zddm
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_IN', ls_zddm, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_OUT', '', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'DIAGNOSIS_TOTHER', ls_fzd, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'GENDER', li_brxb, 1) //性别
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HOSPITAL_ID', is_yljgdm, 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HOSPITAL_LEVEL', '4', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_AREA_CODE', ls_ksbm, 1) //HS_AREA_CODE	病区	非空科室对照
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_DIAGNOSIS_IN_NAME', ls_zdms, 1) //入院诊断中文名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_DIAGNOSIS_OUT_NAME', '', 1) //入院诊断中文名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_IN_NUMBER', '', 1)//HS_IN_NUMBER	病案号
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_NUMBER', String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh), 1)//HS_NUMBER	住院号\门诊号
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_PATIENT_NAME', ls_brxm, 1) //姓名
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HS_STATUS', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'HospitalType', '1', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'ID', String(astr_ygyb_jzxx.ghlsh) +'-' +is_yljgdm , 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IN_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IsLactation', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'IsPregnant', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'MEDICAL_TYPE', ls_yllb, 1)//就医方式
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'OUT_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'PATIENT_BIRTH', String(ldt_csny,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'PatientBenefitGroupCode','-1', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Patient_IDStr', istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx.grsbbh , 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'SETTLE_DATE', String(ldt_now,'yyyy-mm-dd'), 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'TOTAL_COST', ldc_zjje, 1) //总金额
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'UNUSUAL_FLAG', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_AACT007', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_AACT008', '0', 1)
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'Z_BAC021', '0', 1)
	integer li_ret
	li_ret = This.uf_send_ygyb(as_return)
	if li_ret = 3 then
		as_return ='阳光医保审核不合理，请修改！'
		return -1
	else
		return li_ret
	end if
ELSE
	as_return = '无需上传明细'
	RETURN 1
END IF



end function

public function integer uf_ygyb_zyyzsh (datawindow ads_zyyz, ref string as_return);IF uf_set_instance(as_return ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
Long ll_brxz,ll_tgdw
dec{0} ll_zyh
String ls_tjlxh,ls_cbrlb,ls_cblx,ls_ybknje,ls_djsj
DateTime ldt_djsj,ldt_ryrq,ldt_cyrq,ldt_csny,ldt_now
String ls_ryzd,ls_cyzd,ls_qtzd,ls_ddjgid,ls_ddjgdj,ls_bqmc
Long ll_ryzdxh,ll_cyzdxh,ll_brbq,ll_bahm,ll_brks,ll_find,ll_jsdh
Integer li_brxb,ll_cypb
String ls_brxb,ls_bahm,ls_brxm,ls_cypb,ls_ddjglx
String ls_id,ls_ryrq,ls_prq,ls_yq,ls_jyfs,ls_cyrq,ls_csny
String ls_cbrtsyb,ls_grbm,ls_now,ls_zfy,ls_ydjy,ls_ksmc,ls_jb
if ads_zyyz.RowCount() <= 0 then return 1
ll_zyh = ads_zyyz.Object.zyh[1]
string ls_sbkh,ls_SBKSBH,ls_sfzh,ls_cbrxzqh,ls_zyhm

istr_jytsrx.SBKH  = ls_sbkh + '-' + ls_SBKSBH

//明细信息表

Dec{2} ldc_zfy,ldc_ycsl,ldc_fydj,ldc_zjje,ldc_ybje
ldc_zjje = 0.00
ldc_ybje = 0.00
uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaimDetailSet')
FOR ll_row = 1 To ads_zyyz.RowCount()
	uf_send_add_in('AKF003','1',ll_row) //帖数	默认0
	ls_ysgh = ads_zyyz.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
	uf_send_add_in('AKF005',ls_ysgh,ll_row) //医师编码	非空
	uf_send_add_in('ApprovalNumber','0',ll_row) //预留三	默认0, 非空
	uf_send_add_in('BKA609','1',ll_row) // 包装数量	默认1, 非空对应金保结算接口KCC6.EKD059 
	uf_send_add_in('BKC227','0',ll_row) //预留二	默认0，非空
	ldc_ycsl = ads_zyyz.Object.ycsl[ll_row]
	ldc_fydj = ads_zyyz.Object.ypdj[ll_row]

	ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje + ldc_zfy
	uf_send_add_in('COSTS',String(ldc_zfy),ll_row) //总费用
	
	SELECT ygxm,ygzw,ygjb Into :ls_ygxm,:ll_ygzw,:ll_ygjb From XTGL.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysgh using itran_sqlca;
	ls_ksys = ls_ksmc+'|'+ls_ygxm

	IF ll_yplx = 0 THEN
		ll_find = this.of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_zyyz.Object.ypxh[ll_row], 0, as_return)

//		uf_send_add_in('ITEM_ID',String(ads_zyyz.Object.ypxh[ll_row]),ll_row) // 项目编码

	ELSE
		ll_find = this.of_get_jbxx( 0, ads_zyyz.Object.ypxh[ll_row], 0, as_return)

		ls_xmlx = ids_typk.object.ypzllb[ll_find]
		ls_bfdw = ids_typk.object.bfdw[ll_find]

	END IF
	
   select YPZLSTYBM into :ls_ybbm from jkxt.tzyb_ypzlml where ypzxlsh = :ls_ybbm using itran_sqlca;

	if ls_xmlx = '2' then

	end if

	ELSE
		ls_bfdw = '0'
	END IF

	IF Right(String(ll_ygjb),1) = '1' THEN
		ls_jb = '4' //正高
	ELSEIF Right(String(ll_ygjb),1) = '2' THEN

	IF ll_yplx = 0 THEN
		ls_gg = '0'
	ELSE
		ls_gg = ids_typk.object.BFGG[ll_find]
		IF ls_gg > '' THEN
		ELSE
			ls_gg = '0'
		END IF
	END IF
	uf_send_add_in('Specification',ls_gg,ll_row) //规格

	uf_send_add_in('USAGE_DAYS','0',ll_row) //用药天数
	uf_send_add_in('ZZZ_Flag','0',ll_row) //计费标记	默认0

	IF ls_ygzw > '' THEN
	ELSE
		ls_ygzw = '0'
	END IF
	uf_send_add_in('Z_PhysicianAP',ls_ygzw,ll_row)
	
NEXT
uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'HospitalClaim')

	INTO :ldt_djsj,:li_brxb,:ll_brbq,:ll_bahm,:ls_brxm,:ll_cypb,:ldt_ryrq,:ldt_cyrq,:ldt_csny,:ls_grbm,:ll_brks,:ll_brxz,:ll_tgdw,:ls_zzys
	From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh using itran_sqlca;
ls_tjlxh = String(ll_brxz) + String(ll_tgdw)
SELECT dmsb Into :ls_cbrlb From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'GY_TGDW' And TJLXH = :ls_tjlxh using itran_sqlca;

SELECT ksmc Into :ls_ksmc From XTGL.gy_ksdm Where ksdm = :ll_brks using itran_sqlca;

ls_brxb = String(li_brxb)
ls_ddjgdj = '4'

ls_cypb = String(ll_cypb)


uf_send_add_in('BENEFIT_GROUP_ID',ls_cbrlb,1) //人员类别

uf_send_add_in('Z_AACT008','0',1) //预留二

integer li_ret
li_ret = This.uf_send_ygyb(as_return)
if li_ret = 3 then
	as_return ='阳光医保审核不合理，请修改！'
	return -1
else
	return 1
end if




end function

		uf_send_add_in( '住院民政补助支付', Dec(luds_dzxx.Object.qtzfs3[ll_row]), 1)
		uf_send_add_in( '住院优抚救助支付', Dec(luds_dzxx.Object.bzzf[ll_row]), 1)
		uf_send_add_in( '住院工伤基金支付', Dec(luds_dzxx.Object.qtjjzf[ll_row]), 1)
		uf_send_add_in( '住院生育基金支付', Dec(luds_dzxx.Object.qtzfs1[ll_row]), 1)
		uf_send_add_in( '住院门诊统筹基金支付', Dec(luds_dzxx.Object.qtzfs2[ll_row]), 1)
	END IF
NEXT
IF uf_send(as_return)  THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring("交易状态") <> '0' THEN
		as_return = This.uf_getstring("错误信息")
		lb_return = False
	ELSE
		as_dzjg = This.uf_getstring("对帐成功标志") //6	对帐成功标志	string	2	是		0：对帐成功标志-1：表示医保中心的数据和医疗机构对帐数据不一致
		IF as_dzjg <> '0' THEN
			as_return = This.uf_getstring("对帐不一致信息")
		
END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	lb_return = False
END IF
RETURN lb_return

end function

This.uf_send_add('疾病副诊断及描述',ls_zdmc) //11	疾病副诊断及描述	string	200	否	
////-------诊断增加到10个---------

//1	交易状态	integer	4	是		交易状态：0成功，小于0失败

//4	扣银行卡结果	string	1	否		0表示不扣或扣成功
//5	更新后IC卡数据	string	300	否		预留
//6	住院登记交易流水号	string	20	是		HIS必须保存此流水号
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	as_zydjjylsh = This.uf_getstring('住院登记交易流水号')

		IF ab_commit THEN
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
		END IF

	INSERT INTO "ZY_BRRY_KZ"  ( "ZYH",   "YBJZBH" )

//	END IF
	
	IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN

				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText

			END IF
		END IF
		UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where  zyh = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0  Using atr_trans;

		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = atr_trans.SQLErrText
		IF ab_commit THEN  gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	//登记失败后查询医保登记状态，如果成功则返回1
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF




end function

public function integer uf_mzdbz_tfcl (string as_knsj, string as_jslsh, string as_jbr, decimal adc_ylfyze, string as_jydd, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_tzyb_jsxx astr_tzyb_jsxx, ref str_yb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_tzybjk_his.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:用于单边账退费
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_knsj       	
// 	value    	string       	as_jslsh      	
// 	value    	string       	as_jbr        	
// 	value    	decimal      	adc_ylfyze    	
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd       	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jssj      	
// 	reference	str_tzyb_jsxx	astr_tzyb_jsxx	
// 	reference	str_yb_jsxx  	astr_yb_jsxx  	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2021.06.30
//====================================================================

//wangyi 已改
String ls_klb
Integer li_ret,li_ztbz

DateTime ldt_jssj_end


string ls_jssj
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_jssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),1),Time(23:59:59))
adt_jssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),-1))//,Time(adt_jssj)

select ztbz into:li_ztbz from jkxt.PYYB_JSMX  Where JSSJ >= :adt_jssj AND JSSJ <= :ldt_jssj_end And QRJYLSH = :as_jslsh ;
if li_ztbz<>99 then
	as_error='流水号：['+as_jslsh+']的交易不是单边账，不能发起单边账退费!'
	return -1
end if
gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.开始uf_mzdbz_tfcl()")  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.开始uf_mzdbz_tfcl()
il_time_pre = CPU()
ls_klb = '1'
//IF Len(as_knsj) > 30 THEN
//	ls_klb = '2'
//ELSE
//	ls_klb = '0'
//END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF Pos(istr_yb_zhxx.knsj,'|') > 0 or left(as_knsj,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
	ls_klb = '5'
	as_knsj = istr_yb_zhxx.knsj
ELSE
	ls_klb = '1'
END IF
This.uf_send_init('31')
This.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡',ls_klb)
This.uf_send_add('IC信息',as_knsj)
This.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
This.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
This.uf_send_add('要作废的结算交易号',as_jslsh)
This.uf_send_add('经办人',as_jbr)
This.uf_send_add('终端机编号','0')

gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送       历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_pre))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()内容构造结束，准备发送
il_time_send = CPU()
IF uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	IF This.uf_getstring('交易状态') <> '0' THEN
		as_error = This.uf_getstring('错误信息')
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		Integer li_cftf
		//6	是否为重复退费	int	1	否 0正常退费，1结算单在医保接口已经被退费过
		li_cftf = Integer(This.uf_getstring( '是否重复退费'))
		IF IsNull(li_cftf) THEN li_cftf = 0
		
		//不管是否为重复退费，都能让其继续退费
		IF li_cftf = 0 THEN
		ELSE
			as_error = '结算单在医保接口已经被退费过'
		END IF
		
		//7	退费交易流水号	string	20	是	
		//8	退稤AT*
	datetime	20	是	
		//9	计算结果信息	composite	 	否	
		//10	基金分段信息结构体	composite	 	否	
		
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx = This.istr_yb_zhxx.str_tzyb_grjbxx
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.qrjslsh = This.uf_getstring('退费交易流水号')
		astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq  = This.uf_getdatetime('退费结算日期')
		of_get_ylfyzf(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_yb_ylfyzf) 
		of_get_jjfd(astr_tzyb_jsxx.str_tzyb_jjfd) //astr_tzyb_jsxx.jsrq
		of_update_jymx_tpdbz(  as_jslsh, as_jydd, as_jbr,adt_jssj ,  astr_tzyb_jsxx, as_error)
	END IF
	gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()发送成功○                   历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()发送成功○
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_jsrz_tz("市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()发送失败×                   历时："+String(CPU() - il_time_send))  // 2021.05.13  CJN  24544  医保结算日志 市本地.uf_mzdbz_tfcl()发送失败×
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_update_jymx_ztbz (string as_jsjylsh, datetime adt_jssj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_tzybjk_his.of_update_jymx_ztbz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:反交易又失败时对JKXT.PYYB_JSMX的ZTBZ，作如99处理
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_jsjylsh  	    	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jssj    	
// 	reference	string       	as_error    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2021.06.30
//====================================================================

DateTime ldt_jssj_end,ldt_jssj
String ls_bzxx


IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

string ls_jssj
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_jssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),1),Time(23:59:59))
adt_jssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),-1))//,Time(adt_jssj)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

ls_bzxx = "reTraFail"
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Then
	ls_bzxx += "MZSF"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 10 Then
	ls_bzxx += "MZYS"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 32 Then
	ls_bzxx += "ZZCX"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 41 Then
	ls_bzxx += "FZHS"
ELSE
	ls_bzxx += String(base_info.syscode)
END IF
ldt_jssj= DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),1))
ls_bzxx += string(ldt_jssj, 'yyyymmdd')+String(now(),'hhmm')+"|"


UPDATE JKXT.PYYB_JSMX  Set ZTBZ = 99, BZXX=BZXX||:ls_bzxx Where JSSJ >= :adt_jssj AND JSSJ <= :ldt_jssj_end And QRJYLSH = :as_jsjylsh  Using itran_sqlca ;

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	of_dbzrz("诊间单边账处理,流水号："+as_jsjylsh)//写日志
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	as_error = "JKXT.PYYB_JSMX的ZTBZ，99处理失败"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF


end function

public function integer of_update_jymx_tpdbz (string as_jsjylsh, string as_jydd, string as_jbr, datetime adt_jssj, str_tzyb_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_tzybjk_his.of_update_jymx_tpdbz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:用于单边账插入负记录
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_jsjylsh  	
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd     	
// 	value    	string       	as_jbr      	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jssj    	
// 	value    	str_tzyb_jsxx	astr_yb_jsxx	
// 	reference	string       	as_error  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 譊AT*
:	zbq		日期: 2021.06.30
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_jssj_end,ldt_jssj

ldt_curr = gf_server_date()
as_jydd = gf_midstring(as_jydd,20)

IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

string ls_jssj, ls_bzxx
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_jssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),1),Time(23:59:59))
adt_jssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_jssj),-1))//,Time(adt_jssj)
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

ls_bzxx = "HandSuccess"
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Then
	ls_bzxx += as_jbr + "MZSF"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 10 Then
	ls_bzxx += as_jbr + "MZYS"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 32 Then
	ls_bzxx += as_jbr + "ZZCX"
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 41 Then
	ls_bzxx += as_jbr + "FZHS"
ELSE
	ls_bzxx += as_jbr + String(base_info.syscode)

	END IF

	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1

public subroutine of_dbzrz (string as_errtext);//====================================================================
// 事件: Function - of_dbzrz()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 记录台州诊间结算流程的日志，记录在 log_dbzrz.txt 文件内
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_errtext	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2021.07.13    22392
//====================================================================


Integer li_FileNum 

IF gi_pyyq = 1 and Pos(base_info.hospital, '台州')>0 THEN 

	li_FileNum = FileOpen("log_dbzrz.txt", LineMode!, Write!, LockWrite!, Append!)
	
	
	FileWrite(li_FileNum, "【"+String(Today(),"yyyy.mm.dd")+" "+String(Now(),"hh:mm:ss")+"】  " + as_errtext)
	FileClose(li_FileNum)
	
END IF
end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作誅AT*
:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
integer li_1 = 0
string ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
if isnull(ad_datavalue) then ad_datavalue = 0
choose case as_datatype
	case 'da','db','dc','df','dj','dk','dl','dn'//，2位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		end if
	case 'de','dg'//3位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		end if
	case 'dd','dh','di'//4位小数
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		else
			return string(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		end if
	case 'dm'
		if ad_datavalue < 0 then
			return '-'+string(integer(ad_datavalue))
		else
			return string(integer(ad_datavalue))
		end if
end choose


end function

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式yyyymmdd hh24miss
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'yyyyMMddhhmmss')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYYMMDD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	获取字段名所在的位置
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx   		消息体类型

//====================================================================

IF ll_find > 0 THEN

end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

long		ll_pos ,ll_len

If as_str = '' or isnull(as_str) or	as_find = as_replace then return as_str

ll_len = len(as_replace)

Do 
	
	if ll_pos + ll_len = 0 then
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	else
		ll_pos = pos(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	end if
	If ll_pos > 0 then 
		as_str = replace(as_str,ll_pos,len(as_find),as_replace)
	end iF

Loop while ll_pos > 0 

//messagebox('',as_str)
return as_str 

end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'~~','')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'$$','')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"'",'')
return as_string
end function

public function boolean uf_constructor (ref string as_error);IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN	RETURN False
ib_init_success = true

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化健康一卡通接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive = Create u_datastore
ids_receive.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化健康一卡通接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化健康一卡通接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF
ids_receive_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,'|' AS FGFH,mxnr as mxnr_old from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL = 'TZYKT' ") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化健康一卡通接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
ELSE
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
	Long ll_row,ll_rowcount
	ll_rowcount = ids_structre.Retrieve()
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
		IF Upper(ids_structre.Object.jgdm[ll_row]) > '0'	THEN //结构
			ids_structre.Object.MXNR[ll_row] = '循环体'			
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

is_yljgxzqh  = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"YLJGSZDXZQH","330399","医疗机构所在地行政区划")
is_tzyktip = gf_getpara_Eas(itran_sqlca,0,"TZYKTQZJIPDZ","192.168.82.14","台州一卡通前置机IP地址")
is_jkksfsc = gf_GetPara(0,"JKKSFSC","0","健康卡是否上传中心")

IF IsNull(is_tzyktip) Or Trim(is_tzyktip) = '' THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '健康一卡通前置机IP地址未设置'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

//IF ib_init_success = False THEN gf_sblogmsg('初始失败:'+is_init_errormessage)
as_error = is_init_errormessage

ids_yktqd = Create u_datastore //一卡通清单
ids_yktqd.dataobject = 'd_tzykt_yktqd'
ids_yktqd.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )


DISCONNECT Using itran_sqlca;
return ib_init_success

end function

public function date of_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function date of_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dtb' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +string(al_row))
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime of_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'dta' then //日期格式为YYYYMMDDHHNNSS/
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
		ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,11,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,13,2)

		return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
		setnull(ldt_datavalue)
		return ldt_datavalue
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if


end function

public function datetime of_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dta' THEN //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,11,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,13,2)

		RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
		SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
		RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal of_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

private function string of_get_errormessage (string as_returncode);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_get_errormessage()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据错误代码返回错误描述
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_returncode	返回码
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//返回值	定义
//0	操作成功
//-1	交易输入数据（函数输入）无效
//-2	网络故障
//-3	发送数据失败
//-4	接收数据失败
//-5	服务器返回数据无效
//-8	解析接收数据、组织返回数据失败
//-99	未知错误


CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_returncode)
	CASE '-1'
		RETURN '交易输入数据（函数输入）无效'
	CASE '-2'
		RETURN '网络故障'
	CASE '-3'
		RETURN '发送数据失败'
	CASE '-4'
		RETURN '接收数据失败'
	CASE '-5'
		RETURN '服务器返回数据无效'	
	CASE '-8'
		RETURN '解析接收数据、组织返回数据失败'
	CASE '-99'
		RETURN '未知错误'	
	case else
		return '代码：' + as_returncode
END CHOOSE

end function

public function integer uf_ykt_xzgzmy (ref string as_error);//下载工作密钥
//终端需于每天开展业务前下载工作密钥（工作密钥市民卡后台每天0点定时进行更新），并更新到相关设备中。
//InType（交易类型）：ZJ012

//序号	参考长度	数据项
//1	6	返回码
//2	20	柜员号
//3	32	工作密钥，16字符的pik+16字符的mak
//4	16	校验位
//5	14	服务端时间，yyyymmddhhmmss
string ls_fhm,ls_gyh,ls_gzmy,ls_jyw
datetime ldt_ffdsj

This.uf_send_init('ZJ012')
IF this.uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	
	ls_fhm = This.of_getstring('返回码')
	ls_gyh = This.of_getstring('柜员号')
	ls_gzmy = This.of_getstring('工作密钥')
	ls_jyw = This.of_getstring('校验位')
	ldt_ffdsj = This.of_getdatetime('服务端时间')
	
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF
end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 	 	  = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
RETURN 1




end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//医保init是否正确
IF Not ib_init_success THEN
	as_return = '健康一卡通初始化出错：' + is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF

Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Boolean lb_find
Integer li_last_fgfh_gs
ls_xxt = ''
//返回对应的消息体格式
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
//串联所有的消息体
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //  ls_mc[li_i]
	ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
	//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
	li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
	IF li_find < 1 THEN
		IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
			ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
			ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
			li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
			ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
			ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
		ELSE
			as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
	ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
	ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
	ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
		CASE 's','dta','dtb'
			IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
			ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
	END CHOOSE

	IF li_i = li_bound THEN
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue
	ELSE
		ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_datavalue + of_get_jklx_fgfh(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
	END IF
NEXT
ls_send = ls_xxt
IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
	IF is_xxtlx = 'ZJ012' then //ZJ012下载工作密钥传参为空
	else
		as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
		RETURN False
	end if
END IF

TRY
	String ls_xxtlx
	Integer li_ret
	ls_recieve = Space(4000)
	ls_xxtlx = is_xxtlx
	li_ret = SMK_JY(ls_xxtlx,ls_send,ls_recieve)
	IF base_info.userid = '206183' THEN
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ ls_xxtlx +']  发送:'+ls_send )
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接收:'+ls_recieve)
	END IF
//	MessageBox(ls_send,ls_recieve)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN //返回值小于零
		as_return = '健康卡出错：' + this.of_get_errormessage(String(li_ret))
		RETURN False
	ELSEIF mid(ls_recieve,1,6) <> '000000' THEN //SMK_JY返回=0，但是前六位不为'000000'
		Long ll_count
		String ls_parm[]
		ll_count = This.uf_splitparm( trim(ls_recieve), ls_parm)
		IF ll_count < 2 THEN //返回少于两项
			as_return = '返回信息有误，请重试!'
		ELSE
			as_return = '健康卡出错：' + ls_parm[1] + ';'+ ls_parm[2]
		END IF
		RETURN False
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY

RETURN uf_receive_data(ls_recieve,as_return)
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyy-mm-dd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2017-10-10
//====================================================================
String ls_ip
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\SMK_JY.dll' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '健康一卡通的动态链接库(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '\SMK_JY.dll)不存在，请先安装'
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
//判断ini是否存在，判断ip是否匹配
IF FileExists(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+'\Treatment.ini' ) = False THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '健康一卡通的配置文件(' + gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+ '下的Treatment.ini)不存在，请先安装'
	ib_init_success = False
	MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_ip = ProfileString(gu_api.uf_getcurrentappdirectory()+"\Treatment.ini", "TransMachine_Config",  "addr", "")
	IF is_tzyktip <> ls_ip THEN
		is_init_errormessage = "数据库中健康一卡通前置机IP地址和Treatment.ini的addr不匹配，请检查"
		ib_init_success = False
		MessageBox('提示',is_init_errormessage)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
ib_init_success = True

is_xxtlx = Upper(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )
end subroutine

private function boolean uf_receive_data (string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

String ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve
Long li_bound,li_i,li_row,li_find 
Boolean lb_return = True
//返回数据的判断
If (IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '')  THEN
	as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
	RETURN False
END IF

//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive.Reset()
ids_receive_in.Reset()

ls_xxt = as_xxt
li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx, 'YD')
String ls_return1	,ls_dataname
Integer li_pos = 0
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
	
	IF Pos(ls_dataname, '循环体') > 0  THEN //只有ZJ061输出用到结构体，剩下的ls_xxt全部拿来分析
		IF uf_receivein_data(  This.of_get_jklx_jgdm( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i ),ls_xxt, ls_return1,This.of_get_jklx_oldmc( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )) = False THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_return1) THEN ls_return1 = ''
			as_return = as_return +ls_return1
			RETURN False
		END IF
		
		RETURN True
		EXIT
	ELSE
		li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"|")
		IF li_pos <= 0 THEN
			li_pos = Len(ls_xxt)
			ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos)) 
		ELSE
			ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt, 1,li_pos - 1 )) 
		END IF
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( is_xxtlx, 'YD',li_i )
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ls_xxt = Mid(ls_xxt ,li_pos + 1) //li_len[li_i]
	END IF
NEXT

RETURN lb_return

end function

private function boolean uf_receivein_data (string as_xxlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return, string as_mxnr);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.of_receive_data()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	分解社保返回的消息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   			社保直接返回的内容
// 	value    	string	as_xxlx  			消息类型
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
is_mxnr = as_mxnr

String ls_mc[],ls_format[],ls_datavalue,ls_datatype,ls_xxt,ls_recieve,ls_xxfhm
Int li_len[],li_bound,li_i,li_sum,li_datarow,li_pos
Long ll_row,ll_find

//返回数据的判断
ls_xxt = as_xxt

li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxlx , 'JG') //=4
li_sum = 0
li_datarow = 0
//加一条明细条数
ids_receive_in.InsertRow(1)
ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[1] ='0'
ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = 0
ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[1] = 'datacount'
ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[1] = as_mxnr
DO WHILE Len(ls_xxt) > li_sum
	IF Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum+1)) = '' THEN
		RETURN True
	END IF
	li_datarow ++
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[1] = li_datarow
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ll_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
		IF li_sum = 0 THEN
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"|")
		ELSE
			li_pos = Pos(ls_xxt,"|",li_pos + 1)
		END IF
		IF li_pos <= 0 THEN li_pos = Len(ls_xxt) + 1
		
		ls_datavalue = Trim(Mid(ls_xxt,li_sum + 1,li_pos - (li_sum + 1) )) //li_len[li_i]))
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[ll_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[ll_row] = li_datarow
		
		ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[ll_row] = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxlx, 'JG', li_i) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ids_receive_in.object.datamxnr[ll_row] = as_mxnr
		ll_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = 'rowcount'",1,999999)
		
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN ll_find = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[ll_find] = String(li_datarow)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[ll_find] = 's'
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[ll_find] = 'rowcount'
		
		li_sum = li_pos
	NEXT
LOOP
RETURN True

end function

public function integer uf_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[]);Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,'|',li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,'|',li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter
end function

public function integer uf_yktbrda_insert (ref string as_error);integer li_ret,li_kzt
string ls_error,ls_sfrz

li_kzt = istr_tzykt_smkxx.kzt //卡状态（0未发卡；1正常；2挂失；8预挂失；9注销）
ls_sfrz = istr_tzykt_smkxx.sfzrzbs //0已认证 代表实名，1未认证 代表非实名

if is_jkksfsc = '0' then
	return 1
end if

if li_kzt = 0 then
	
//	li_ret = uf_yktxk_xjkkxx(istr_tzykt_jkkxx, as_error) //写健康卡信息
//	ls_error = '写健康卡:' + as_error + ';'
//	if li_ret > 0 then
//		return -1
//	end if

//	if ls_sfrz = '0' then
		li_ret = uf_ykt_fkqq(istr_tzykt_smkxx, as_error) // 发卡请求
		ls_error = '发卡请求:' + as_error + ';'
//	end if

	if li_ret > 0 then
		li_ret = uf_ykt_fkqr(istr_tzykt_smkxx, as_error) // 发卡确认
		ls_error = '发卡确认:' + as_error + ';'
		if li_ret > 0 then
			return 1
		else
			li_ret = uf_ykt_fkcx(istr_tzykt_smkxx, as_error) //发卡撤销
			ls_error = ls_error + '发卡撤销:' + as_error + ';'
		end if
	end if
	as_error = ls_error
	if is_jkksfsc = '0' then
		return 1
	else
		return -1
	end if
else
	as_error = '緿AT* ㄗ刺�有误，非新卡� '
end if
return -1

end function

public function string of_get_errormessage_jkk (integer ai_errcode);String ls_ErrStr;

Choose Case ai_ErrCode
Case 0
	ls_ErrStr = "成功";
Case -200001
	ls_ErrStr = "打开读卡器端口失败";
Case -200003
	ls_ErrStr = "读卡器端口无效";
Case -200010
	ls_ErrStr = "寻卡失败";
Case -200011
	ls_ErrStr = "寻卡成功，获取卡序列号失败";
Case -200015

public function integer uf_yktcx_xxcx (str_tzykt_smkxx astr_tzykt_smkxx, ref string as_error);//市民卡信息查询
//InType（交易类型）：ZJ061
String ls_fhm,ls_gyh,ls_hjjd,ls_hjsq
Integer li_ksl

This.uf_send_init('ZJ061')
//This.uf_send_add('证件类型', as_zjlx)
//This.uf_send_add('证件号码', as_zjhm)
//This.uf_send_add('姓名', as_xm)
This.uf_send_add('证件类型',astr_tzykt_smkxx.zjlx)
This.uf_send_add('证件号翫AT* ',astr_tzykt_smkxx.zjhm) //330304198904123033
This.uf_send_add('姓名',astr_tzykt_smkxx.xm) //王毅

IF This.uf_send(as_error) = True THEN
	//序号	参考长度	数据项
	//1	6	返回码
	//2	20	柜员号
	//3	32	户籍所在乡镇（街道）
	//4	32	户籍所在村（社区）
	//5	2	卡数量
	//	...	
	//6	20	市民卡卡号
	//7	3	卡类型（100全功能卡；252 健康卡）
	//8	1	卡状态（1正常；2挂失；8预挂失；9注销）
	//9	8	卡余额
	//		重复6-9
	ls_fhm = This.of_getstring('返回码')
	ls_gyh = This.of_getstring('柜员号')
	ls_hjjd = This.of_getstring('户籍所在乡镇（街道）')
	ls_hjsq = This.of_getstring('户籍所在村（社区）')
	li_ksl = This.of_getdecimal('卡数量')
	
	astr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old = ''
	Integer li_row
	IF li_ksl > 0 THEN
		FOR li_row = 1 To li_ksl
			ids_yktqd.Object.yktkh[li_row] = This.of_getstring_in('市民卡卡号',li_row)
			ids_yktqd.Object.klx[li_row] = This.of_getstring_in('卡类型',li_row)
			ids_yktqd.Object.kzt[li_row] = This.of_getdecimal_in('卡状态',li_row)
			ids_yktqd.Object.kye[li_row] = This.of_getdecimal_in('卡余额',li_row)
			IF ids_yktqd.Object.klx[li_row] = '252' And ids_yktqd.Object.kzt[li_row] <> 9 THEN
				astr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old = ids_yktqd.Object.yktkh[li_row]
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	RETURN -1
END IF


end function

public function integer uf_yktbrda_update (string as_jzkh_old, ref string as_error);Integer li_ret,li_kzt
String ls_error

li_kzt = istr_tzykt_smkxx.kzt //卡状态（0未发卡；1正常�2挂失；8预挂失；9注销）

IF li_kzt = 0 THEN
	li_ret = uf_yktxk_xjkkxx(as_error) //写健康卡信息
	ls_error = '写健康卡:' + as_error + ';'
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	li_ret = uf_yktcx_xxcx(istr_tzykt_smkxx, as_error) // 查询市民卡信息
	IF li_ret > 0 THEN
		if isnull(istr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old) or istr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old = '' then
		else
			if istr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old <> as_jzkh_old then
				IF  MessageBox("询问","一卡通本地卡号与中心不符，本地:"+as_jzkh_old+",中心:" + istr_tzykt_smkxx.kh_old + ",是否确定换卡？", Exclamation!, OKCancel!, 2) = 2 THEN
					RETURN -1
				end if
			end if
			li_ret = uf_ykt_bk(istr_tzykt_smkxx, as_error) // 补卡
			ls_error = '换卡:' + as_error + ';'
			IF li_ret = 1 THEN RETURN 1
		end if	
	END IF
	as_error = ls_error
ELSE
	as_error = '卡状态有误，非新卡！'
END IF
if is_jkksfsc = '0' then 
	RETURN 1
else
	RETURN -1
end if

end function

public function integer uf_yktxk_xjkkxx (ref string as_error);//uf_yktxk_xjkkxx 本地写健康卡信息

string ls_xxt,ls_dzxx
long ll_return
ls_xxt = ''
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.kh + '|' //1	20	健康卡卡号
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.name + '|' //2	20	姓名
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + string(istr_tzykt_jkkxx.csny,'yyyymmdd') + '|' //3	8	出生日期
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.xb + '|' //4	1	性别
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.zjlx + '|' //5	2	证件类型
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.lxdh + '|' //6	16	联系电话
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + istr_tzykt_jkkxx.zjhm + '|' //7	32	证件号码
ls_dzxx = istr_tzykt_jkkxx.dz //8	48	地址
ls_dzxx=gf_midstring(ls_dzxx,48)
ls_xxt = ls_xxt + ls_dzxx
//gf_applog(ls_xxt)
if ls_xxt = '' or isnull(ls_xxt) then
	as_error = '信息不全请填写完整！'
	return -1
end if

ll_return = WriteTreatmentCardInfo (ls_xxt) 
if ll_return = 0 then
	return 1
else
	as_error = of_get_errormessage_jkk(ll_return)
	return -1
end if

end function

public function boolean wf_changebrxx (string as_sfzh, integer as_count);//*************************************************************************************//
// Function  : 根据身份证号计算病人信息：性别、年龄、生日
//
// Parameter : as_sfzh
//
// Return    : 是否成功(Boolean)
//
// Author    : Zheng Xiao guang
// Created   : 
// Modified  : 
// Log       : 
//*************************************************************************************//
Long     ll_Row,ll_brnl
Integer  li_Len
String   ls_brxb   // 病人性别
String   ls_csny   // 出生年月
DateTime ldt_csny,ldt_sysdate

li_Len = Len(as_sfzh)

IF li_Len = 0 THEN
	RETURN True
ELSEIF li_Len = 15 THEN
	ls_brxb = Mid(as_sfzh,15)
	ls_csny = Mid(as_sfzh,7,6)
	ls_csny = Mid(ls_csny,1,2) + "." + Mid(ls_csny,3,2) + "." + Mid(ls_csny,5,2)
	ls_csny = "19" + ls_csny  // 对于15位身份证号码默认为19xx年
ELSEIF li_Len = 17 THEN
	ls_brxb = Mid(as_sfzh,17,1)
	ls_csny = Mid(as_sfzh,7,8)
	ls_csny = Mid(ls_csny,1,4) + "." + Mid(ls_csny,5,2) + "." + Mid(ls_csny,7,2)
ELSE
	RETURN False
END IF	

IF NOT IsDate(ls_csny) THEN RETURN False

ldt_csny = DateTime(Date(ls_csny))
ldt_SysDate = datetime(gf_server_date())

IF Date(ldt_csny) > Date(ldt_SysDate) THEN RETURN False  // 出生日期大于当前日期
IF Year(Date(ldt_SysDate)) - Year(Date(ldt_csny)) > 120 THEN RETURN False
if as_count  = 0 then
	IF Mod(Integer(ls_brxb),2) = 1 THEN
		tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.brxb[1] = 1
	ELSE
		tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.brxb[1] = 2
	END IF
else
	IF IsNull(ldt_csny) THEN
	   SetNull(ll_brnl)
   ELSE
	/* 出生年月大于系统日期为无效出生年月 */
		IF Date(ldt_csny) > Date(ldt_SysDate) THEN RETURN False
	
		ll_brnl = Year(Date(ldt_SysDate)) - Year(Date(ldt_csny))
		
		IF ll_brnl > 120 THEN RETURN False
  END IF
  tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.brnl[1] = ll_brnl
end if 
RETURN True


end function

event oncomm(string strdata);
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	TRY
		IF Len(strdata) > 0 THEN
			String ls_str
			ls_str = Trim(String(strdata))
			ls_str = Mid(ls_str,1,Pos(ls_str,'&')-1)
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.knsj[1] = ls_str
			//wf_getzhxx(ls_str)
			This.PostEvent("ue_key")
		ELSE
			MessageBox('错误','农保卡扫描出错')
		END IF
	Catch(runtimeerror er2)
		MessageBox('错误',er2.Text)
	END TRY
END IF
end event

ls_input	 = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.knsj[1]				
wf_getzhxx(ls_input)

type dw_1 from datawindow within tabpage_1
event key pbm_dwnkey
integer width = 2359
integer height = 1740
integer taborder = 20
string dataobject = "d_pyyb_zhxx_xs"
boolean border = false
boolean livescroll = true
end type

event key;//====================================================================
// Function: key for dw_1()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Description: 病人刷卡或者输入卡信息的过程
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Arguments: 
//		keycode     	key     		
//		unsignedlong	keyflags		
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Returns:  long
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Author:	Michael		Date: 2007.07.09
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Modify History: 
//	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// WYFEY @2000 - 2007 XXJSK
//====================================================================
//IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
IF Not IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) THEN
	MessageBox('医保提示','医保接口的实例未声明！')
	RETURN
END IF
String ls_input,ls_name
ls_name = dw_1.GetColumnName()
IF Key = keyenter! THEN
	CHOOSE CASE	ls_name
		CASE	'knsj'
			//====================================================================
			// 数据准备
			//====================================================================
			dw_1.AcceptText()
			ls_input	 = dw_1.Object.knsj[1]
			
			IF Right(ls_input,4) = '*=-*' THEN //医保一卡通插入
				String ls_cardno,ls_cardid,ls_initorgno,ls_error
				
				IF uo_1.iu_sbiccreader.uf_sbreadcard( ls_cardno,ls_cardid,ls_initorgno,ls_error) THEN
					ls_input = ls_cardid + ls_cardno
				ELSE
					MessageBox("医保提示", '一卡通读写失败:' + ls_error)
					RETURN
				END IF
			END IF
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.knsj[1] = ls_input
			wf_getzhxx(ls_input)
	END CHOOSE
END IF
//END IF





end event

event getfocus;//tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.object.knsj[1] = ''
end event

	MessageBox('提示','请先选择病人')
	RETURN
END IF

	MessageBox('医保结算失败py:', ls_error )

	messagebox('提示','退费成功' + lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh)

		MessageBox('提示',ls_error)

		MessageBox('提示','交易结算:' +ls_jyjd+ "      交易流水号:" + String(lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jslsh) + "~r~n交易时间:" +String(lstr_pyyb_jsxx.jsrq ) )
	END IF

event clicked;IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_pyybjk.ib_yd THEN
	String ls_zyjzbh,ls_zyh
	Long ll_zyh
	ls_zyh = sle_zyh.Text
	
	ll_zyh = Long (ls_zyh)
	ls_zyjzbh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_1.Object.zyjzbh[1]
	
	IF ls_zyjzbh > '' And ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		gf_begin_transaction( sqlca )
		UPDATE ZY_BRRY_KZ Set YBJZBH = :ls_zyjzbh Where ZYH = :ll_zyh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction( sqlca )
			MessageBox('提示','就诊编号更新成功!就诊编号:' +ls_zyjzbh)
		ELSE
			ls_zyh = sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction( sqlca )
			MessageBox('提示','就诊编号更新失败!' +ls_zyh)
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示','就诊编号或病人无效!')
	END IF
END IF



end event

event clicked;cb_1.Event Clicked( )
string ls_jsbz,ls_jsjylshm,ls_return
ls_jsbz = '1'
ls_jsjylshm = '0'
Long ll_jymxts_temp,ll_jymxts,ll_cur
String ls_cbdjslsh,ls_cbd,ls_fhkxx,ls_jylx,ls_xm
DO WHILE ls_jsbz = '1'
	lu_sybjk.uf_send_init('9261')
	lu_sybjk.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡号','T00010809')
	lu_sybjk.uf_send_add('社会保障卡卡的识别码','120000D1560000051017A6A19FE0E608')
	lu_sybjk.uf_send_add('已下载最大就诊流水号',ls_jsjylshm)
	//发送消息
	IF lu_sybjk.uf_send(ls_return,0,'120000') THEN
		ls_jsbz = lu_sybjk.uf_getstring("是否还有需下载的记录") //0：下载完毕1：还需下载
		ll_jymxts_temp = Long(lu_sybjk.uf_getstring("本次下载记录条数"))
		ll_jymxts = lu_sybjk.uf_getstring_mxnr('就诊信息列表')
		if ll_jymxts = -1 then exit
		IF ll_jymxts <> ll_jymxts_temp THEN
			MessageBox('提示','中心下载条数:' +String(ll_jymxts_temp)+'  与本地解析不一致:' + String(ll_jymxts))
		END IF
		
		gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',0)
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_jymxts
//			1	就诊流水号
//			2	两定机构名称
//			3	疾病代码（ICD10）
//			4	疾病名称
//			5	病情描述
//			6	就诊日期/入院日期
//			7	就医方式

			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)
			ls_jsjylshm = lu_sybjk.uf_getstring_in( "就诊流水号",ll_cur)
			ls_cbdjslsh = lu_sybjk.uf_getstring_in( "两定机构名称",ll_cur)
			ls_cbd = lu_sybjk.uf_getstring_in( "疾病代码（ICD10）",ll_cur)

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

//====================================================================

//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'

CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'da','db','df','dj','dk','dl','dn' //，2位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		END IF
	CASE 'de','dg' //3位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dd','dh','di' //4位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		ELSE
