public function date uf_getdate (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function date uf_getdate_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定礑AT*
(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'd' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+Lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF Not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
			
			
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为datetime类型)，返回发送时的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================


int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD HHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
//		case 'dtb'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		case else
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			setnull(ldt_datavalue)
			return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if

end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回发送时的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	xums		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+lower(as_name)+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'da' or ls_datatype = 'db' or ls_datatype = 'dc' or ls_datatype = 'dd' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
//	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyy-mm-dd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.1.18
//====================================================================
ib_init_success = True
Int li_xhxh
DateTime ldt_server
String ls_datetime
ljson_send = Create sailjson
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
//SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval Into :li_xhxh From dual Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval,to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),sysdate Into :li_xhxh,:ls_datetime,:ldt_server From dual Using itran_sqlca;
if isnull(ls_datetime) or ls_datetime = '' or itran_sqlca.sqlcode <> 0 then
	if isnull(ls_datetime) then ls_datetime  =''
	is_error = '获取发送序列ID失败:' + string(itran_sqlca.sqlcode ) +  itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext + 'datetime:' + ls_datetime
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
end if
//is_jylsh = is_yljgdm + String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+String(Now(),'hhmmss')+Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
is_jylsh = is_yljgdm + ls_datetime + Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
is_xxtlx = Lower(as_xxtlx)
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )
istr_jytsrx.infno = is_xxtlx //1	infno	交易编号	                  字符型	4		Y	交易编号详见接口列表
istr_jytsrx.msgid = is_jylsh //2	msgid	发送方报文ID	            字符型	30		Y	定点医药机构编号(12)+时间(14)+顺序号(4)时间格式：yyyyMMddHHmmss
istr_jytsrx.mdtrtarea_admvs =  is_yljgxzqh //3	mdtrtarea_admvs	就医地医保区划	字符型	6		Y	
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = is_yljgxzqh //4	insuplc_admdvs	参保地医保区划	   字符型	6			如果交易输入中含有人员编号，此项必填，可通过【1101】人员信息获取交易取得
istr_jytsrx.recer_sys_code = 'FSI_LOCAL' //5	recer_sys_code	接收方系统代码	   字符型	10		Y	用于多套系统接入，区分不同系统使用
istr_jytsrx.dev_no = '1' //6	dev_no	设备编号	               字符型	100	
istr_jytsrx.dev_safe_info = '' //7	dev_safe_info	设备安全信息	   字符型	2000	
istr_jytsrx.cainfo = '' //8	cainfo	数字签名信息	         字符型	1024	
istr_jytsrx.signtype = 'SM3' //9	signtype	签名类型						字符型	10			建议使用SM2、SM3
istr_jytsrx.infver = is_bbh //10	infver	接口版本号					字符型	6		Y	例如："V1.0"，版本号由医保下发通知。
istr_jytsrx.opter_type = '1' //11	opter_type	经办人类别							3	Y	Y	1-经办人；2-自助终端；3-移动终端
IF IsNull(base_info.UserID) Or base_info.UserID = '' THEN
	istr_jytsrx.opter = '9999'
ELSE
	istr_jytsrx.opter = base_info.UserID //12	opter	经办人							字符型	30		Y	按地方要求传入经办人/终端编号
END IF
IF IsNull(base_info.username) Or base_info.username = '' THEN
	SELECT YGXM Into :istr_jytsrx.opter_name From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :istr_jytsrx.opter Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	istr_jytsrx.opter_name = base_info.username //13	opter_name	经办人姓名				字符型	50		Y	按地方要求传入经办人姓名/终端名称
END IF
istr_jytsrx.inf_time = ldt_server //14	inf_time	交易时间					日期时间型	19		Y	
istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_code = is_yljgdm //15	fixmedins_code	定点医药机构编号	字符型	12		Y	
istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_name = is_yljgmc //16	fixmedins_name	定点医药机构名称	字符型	20		Y	
//is_jyzqh = "661026"
istr_jytsrx.sign_no = is_jyzqh //17	sign_no	交易签到流水号				字符型	30			通过签到【9001】交易获取



end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据datetime格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('dta','dtb')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYY-MM-DD HHMMSS
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYY-MM-DD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYY-MM-DD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

	//as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send_in.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"' and datarow=" + string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'",1,ids_send_in.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send_in.insertrow(0)
	ids_send_in.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send_in.object.datarow[li_row] = al_row
	ids_send_in.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue)
	ids_send_in.object.datamxnr[li_row] = is_mxnr
	uf_send_add_in_count(is_mxnr,al_row)
//end if
end subroutine

// 函数: of_get_index()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	获取字段名所在的位置
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx   		消息体类型
// 	value	string	as_name	字段名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 20011.8.4
//====================================================================
ids_structre.SetFilter( "")
ids_structre.Filter( )
Long ll_find

ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" + Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + Upper(as_jkfl) + "' and Upper(mxnr)='" + Upper(as_name) + "'",1,999999)

IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.Object.pxxh[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF
end function

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		
END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +String(al_row))
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function string uf_getstring_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getstring()

int li_find

if li_find > 0 then

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);Integer li_ds = 0,i
String ls_end

FOR i = 1 To Len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 And Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	RETURN False
ELSE
	RETURN True
END IF


end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);
as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================
is_psamid = '100'
return 1
IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)

	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数组
//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

end if

end subroutine

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
ibase_info = base_info


RETURN 1




end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

Long		ll_pos ,ll_len

IF as_str = '' Or IsNull(as_str)Or	as_find = as_replace THEN RETURN as_str

ll_len = Lenw(as_replace)
ll_pos = 0
DO
	IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	END IF
	IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
		as_str = Replacew(as_str,ll_pos,Lenw(as_find),as_replace)
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
RETURN as_str


end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','&caret;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','&brvbar;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'~~','&tilde;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'$$','&dollar;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"'",'')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"\",'\\\\')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'"','\"')
RETURN as_string

end function

public function boolean of_constructor ();ib_init_success = True
ids_receive = Create u_datastore
ids_receive.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_send = Create u_datastore
ids_send.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send.createfromsql("select ''dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF


ids_send_in = Create u_datastore
ids_send_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_send_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF
ids_send_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

ids_receive_in = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_in.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_in.createfromsql("select '' dataname,'' datavalue,'' datatype, 0 datarow,'' as datamxnr from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_in.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")



ids_receive_mxnr = Create u_datastore
ids_receive_mxnr.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_receive_mxnr.createfromsql("select '' dataname, 0 dataxhcs  from dual") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

ids_receive_mxnr.createcomputedcol('footer',"max(datarow)","max_datarow")

u_datastore lds_temp
lds_temp = Create u_datastore
lds_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
ids_structre = Create u_datastore
ids_structre.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)


//IF lds_temp.createfromsql("select JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS from JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE JKFL = 'JG' AND YBFL = 'ZHYL'") = -1 THEN
//	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
//	ib_init_success = False
//ELSE
//	lds_temp.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca )
//	lds_temp.Retrieve()
//END IF
IF ids_structre.createfromsql("SELECT JKLX,JKFL,PXXH,MXNR,MXCD,MXLX,JGDM,XHCS,MXSM,0 AS JGPXXH,0 as JGCD,mxnr as mxnr_old FROM JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL = 'ZHYL'") = -1 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = '初始化社保接口失败'
	ib_init_success = False
END IF

IF ib_init_success = True THEN
	ids_structre.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
	ids_structre.Retrieve()
end if

return ib_init_success
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);
int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据
	as_name = lower(as_name)
	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())
	if li_row <= 0 then li_row = ids_send.insertrow(0)
	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyy-mm-dd')
end if
end subroutine

	RETURN 0
END IF
end function

	ls_dataname = 	This.of_get_send_mc(ll_row)
	ls_datavalue = This.of_get_send_value(ls_dataname,ll_row)
	ljson_send.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
NEXT

lsjson = This.of_get_sendin(is_xxtlx)
ljson_send.setattribute( 'input',lsjson) //18	input	交易输入							字符型	40000	Y

	ls_data = ljson_send.getformatjson('',True)

	ls_data = ljson_send.getformatjson('')
END IF

RETURN ls_data






















end function

	ELSE

	END IF

		is_error = '创建临时事务失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE

	//	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN

	//

	//	end if
	String ls_error
	IF uf_set_instance(ls_error) < 0 THEN

	END IF

end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transacti
on
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
ibase_info = base_info


RETURN 1




end function

end subroutine

public function sailjson of_get_sendin (string as_jklx);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count,li_jdnum,li_jd,li_mxnr_sl,li_start
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxsm,ls_data[],ls_xmsm[]
sailjson lsjson,lsjson2[]
lsjson = Create sailjson
IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	RETURN lsjson
END IF
li_mxnr_sl= 0
li_start = 1
li_jdnum = of_get_sendin_mxnr_count() //节点数
FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdnum
	ls_xmsm[li_jd] = of_get_sendin_mxnr(li_jd) //获取节点
	ids_send_in.SetFilter("")
	ids_send_in.Filter()
	ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+ls_xmsm[li_jd]+"'",1,9999999)
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'QQ' ,ls_xmsm[li_jd])//36 11
	li_mxnr_sl += li_bound
	li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
	FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count
		lsjson2[ll_row] = Create sailjson
		FOR li_i = li_start To li_mxnr_sl
			ls_dataname = 	This.of_get_sendin_mc( as_jklx, 'QQ',li_i)
			ls_datavalue = This.of_get_sendin_value(ls_dataname,ll_row)
			lsjson2[ll_row].setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
		NEXT
		ls_data[ll_row] = lsjson2[ll_row].getformatjson('')
	NEXT
	li_start = li_mxnr_sl +1 //第二个节点 在第一个节点的最大pxxh 开始
	IF of_get_xhcs(as_jklx,'QQ',ls_xmsm[li_jd]) THEN //判断是否是数组
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], ls_data)
		ib_sz = True
	ELSE
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], lsjson2[1])
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN  lsjson


end function

public function string of_get_sendin_mc (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()

IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN Lower(ids_structre.Object.mxnr[ll_find])
ELSE
	RETURN ''
END IF

end function

ids_structre.filter()

return ids_structre.rowcount()

end function

public function integer of_receive_head (sailjson as_xxt);Int li_row,li_bound,li_i,li_datavalue
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue


li_bound = of_get_jklx_count('1001','YD')
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc( '1001','YD',li_i )
	IF This.of_get_jklx_format( '1001','YD',li_i ) = 's' THEN
		ls_datavalue = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname)
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
		MessageBox(ls_dataname,ls_datavalue)
	ELSE
		li_datavalue = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname)
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
		MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_receivein_data (string as_xxtlx, sailjson as_xxt);Int li_row,li_bound,li_i,li_jd,li_datavalue,li_xh,li_mxnr_sl,li_start
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_data
sailjson lsjson[]
String ls_return[],ls_classname
// 2.声明游标
DECLARE cur_jdmc CURSOR FOR
	SELECT  mxsm,XHCS  From JKXT.YB_JKLXMX Where jklx = :as_xxtlx And jkfl = 'YD' And ybfl = 'ZHYL'  Order By pxxh    Using itran_sqlca;
// 3.打开游标
OPEN cur_jdmc;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	CLOSE cur_jdmc;
	RETURN 0
END IF
// 4.移动游标，获取数据。
String ls_mxsm[]
Int li_xhcs[],li_jdcount
li_jdcount = 1
FETCH cur_jdmc Into :ls_mxsm[li_jdcount], :li_xhcs[li_jdcount];
DO WHILE itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0
	li_jdcount++
	FETCH cur_jdmc Into :ls_mxsm[li_jdcount], :li_xhcs[li_jdcount];
LOOP
// 5.关闭游标
CLOSE cur_jdmc;
li_jdcount = li_jdcount -1

FOR li_i = 1 To li_jdcount
	IF ids_receive_mxnr.Find("dataname='"+ls_mxsm[li_i]+"'",1,99999) <= 0 THEN
		li_row = ids_receive_mxnr.InsertRow(0)
		ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_mxsm[li_i]
		ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataxhcs[li_row] = li_xhcs[li_i]
	END IF
NEXT
li_mxnr_sl = 0
li_start = 1
FOR li_jd = 1 To ids_receive_mxnr.RowCount()
	IF ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataxhcs[li_jd] > 0 THEN //数组
		ls_classname=classname(as_xxt.getattribute(ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd]))
		ls_return = as_xxt.getattribute(ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd])
		li_bound = of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD',ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd])
		li_mxnr_sl+= li_bound
		FOR li_xh = 1 To UpperBound(ls_return)
			lsjson[li_xh] = create sailjson
			lsjson[li_xh].setattribute(ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd],ls_return[li_xh])
			ls_data = lsjson[li_xh].getformatjson('')
			lsjson[li_xh] = lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd])		
			FOR li_i = li_start To li_mxnr_sl
				li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
				ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i )
				IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
					ls_datavalue = lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_dataname)
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
					ids_receive_in.Object.xmnr[li_row]= ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd]
					MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(ls_datavalue))
				ELSE
					ls_datavalue = lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_dataname)
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
					ids_receive_in.Object.xmnr[li_row]= ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd]
					MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
				END IF
			NEXT
			
		NEXT
		li_start = li_mxnr_sl +1 //第二个节点 在第一个节点的最大pxxh 开始
	ELSE
		lsjson[li_jd] = as_xxt.getattribute(ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd])
	END IF
	
	ls_data = lsjson[li_jd].getformatjson('')
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD',ids_receive_mxnr.Object.dataname[li_jd])
	li_mxnr_sl+= li_bound
	FOR li_i = li_start To li_mxnr_sl
		li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
		ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i )
		IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
			ls_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_dataname)
			ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
			ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
			MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(ls_datavalue))
		ELSE
			li_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_dataname)
			ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
			ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
			MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
		END IF
	NEXT
	li_start = li_mxnr_sl +1 //第二个节点 在第一个节点的最大pxxh 开始
NEXT
RETURN 1



end function

public function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxtlx, sailjson as_xxt, string as_return);sailjson lsjson

//返回数据的判断
IF of_get_xhcs(as_xxtlx,'YD') THEN  //有循环
	If (IsNull(as_xxt.getformatjson('',True)) Or Trim(as_xxt.getformatjson('',True)) = '')  THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
ELSE
	If (IsNull(as_xxt.getformatjson('')) Or Trim(as_xxt.getformatjson('')) = '')  THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
END IF
//分解社保直接返回的消息体
ids_receive_in.Reset()
ids_receive.Reset()


of_receive_head(as_xxt)
lsjson = as_xxt.getattribute('output')
of_receivein_data(as_xxtlx,lsjson)
RETURN True

end function

public function boolean of_get_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_mxnr);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and (mxsm)='"+as_mxnr+"'",1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	if ids_structre.object.XHCS[ll_find]=1 then 
		return true
	else
		return  false
	end if
END IF



end function

public function boolean of_get_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ids_structre.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "'")
ids_structre.Filter()
FOR ll_find = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
	IF ids_structre.Object.xhcs[ll_find] > 0 THEN
		RETURN True
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN False





end function

	String ls_brbm,ls_fplsh,ls_zfdjh
	Dec{0} ldc_jylsh,ldc_yjlsh
	Long ll_jkfs,ll_zjly
	Dec{2} ldc_zfje
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ldc_yjlsh = 0
		SetNull(ls_zfdjh)
		ls_fplsh = luds_hsdx.Object.fplsh[ll_row]
		SELECT yjlsh Into :ldc_yjlsh From mz_yjk1 Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh Using sqlca;
		IF ldc_yjlsh > 0 THEN
			SELECT z.jkfs,z.zjly,z.zfje * -1 INTO :ll_jkfs,:ll_zjly,:ldc_zfje  FROM h_mz_zhjymx z,h_mz_zhjymx_gl g
				Where z.jylsh = g.jylsh And g.ywly = 'YJ' And g.ywlsh = :ldc_yjlsh;
			IF ll_jkfs = 7 THEN
				ls_zfdjh = String(ll_zjly)
			END IF
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				UPDATE h_fp_zffs Set zffs = :ll_jkfs,zfdjh = :ls_zfdjh,zfje = :ldc_zfje Where  fplsh = :ls_fplsh And xh = 1;
				IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "成功。。"  )
					COMMIT Using sqlca;
				ELSE
					gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "失败：" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
					ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh + "失败：获取zffs失败" + sqlca.SQLErrText )
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

end event

public function sailjson of_get_sendin (string as_jklx);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count,li_jdnum,li_jd,li_mxnr_sl,li_start
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxsm,ls_data[],ls_xmsm[]
sailjson lsjson,lsjson2[]
lsjson = Create sailjson
IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	RETURN lsjson
END IF
li_mxnr_sl = 0
li_start = 1
li_jdnum = of_get_sendin_mxnr_count() //节点数
FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdnum
	ls_xmsm[li_jd] = of_get_sendin_mxnr(li_jd) //获取节点
	ids_send_in.SetFilter("")
	ids_send_in.Filter()
	ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+ls_xmsm[li_jd]+"'",1,9999999)
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'QQ' ,ls_xmsm[li_jd]) //36 11
	li_mxnr_sl += li_bound
	li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
	FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count
		lsjson2[ll_row] = Create sailjson
		FOR li_i = li_start To li_mxnr_sl
			ls_dataname = 	This.of_get_sendin_mc( as_jklx, 'QQ',li_i)
			ls_datavalue = This.of_get_sendin_value(ls_dataname,ll_row)
			lsjson2[ll_row].setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
		NEXT
		ls_data[ll_row] = lsjson2[ll_row].getformatjson('')
	NEXT
	li_start = li_mxnr_sl +1 //第二个节点 在第一个节点的最大pxxh 开始
	IF of_get_xhcs(as_jklx,'QQ',ls_xmsm[li_jd]) THEN //判断是否是数组
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], ls_data)
		ib_sz = True
	ELSE
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], lsjson2[1])
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN  lsjson




end function

	RETURN ''
END IF

end function

public function boolean of_get_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ids_structre.SetFilter("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "'")
ids_structre.Filter()
FOR ll_find = 1 To ids_structre.RowCount()
	IF ids_structre.Object.xhcs[ll_find] > 0 THEN
		RETURN True
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN False





end function

public function boolean of_get_xhcs (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_mxnr);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and (mxnr_old)='"+as_mxnr+"'",1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	if ids_structre.object.XHCS[ll_find] > 0 then 
		return true
	else
		return  false
	end if
END IF



end function

public function string uf_send ();

	ls_dataname = 	This.of_get_send_mc(ll_row)
	ls_datavalue = This.of_get_send_value(ls_dataname,ll_row)
	ljson_send.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
NEXT

lsjson = This.of_get_sendin(is_xxtlx)
ljson_send.setattribute( 'input',lsjson) //18	input	交易输入							字符型	40000	Y	
IF ib_sz THEN
	ls_data = ljson_send.getformatjson('',True)
ELSE
	ls_data = ljson_send.getformatjson('')
END IF

ll_rec = ZJ_Hmac_SM3("H33040200035",'I2HBy2XnCHvaYEl','0',ls_data,ref ls_return)
RETURN ls_data
end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return, string as_jsfxzqh);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，默认0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zhyl		日期: 2022.1.18
//====================================================================
//在这里判断初始化是否成功uf_send_init
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF
IF IsNull(is_xxtlx) Or is_xxtlx = '' THEN
	as_return = '消息体类型为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
TRY
	ib_sz = False
	Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_recieve,ls_mxnr,ls_jmc, ls_temp
	Long ll_xhcs
	Boolean lb_xhcs
	sailjson ls_json_exp_content
	ls_json_exp_content = Create sailjson
	ls_send = ''
	IF Not IsValid(ljson_send) THEN
		ljson_send = Create sailjson
	END IF
	ljson_send.SetNull( )
	ljson_send.setattribute('infno', Upper(istr_jytsrx.infno) )
	ljson_send.setattribute('msgid', istr_jytsrx.msgid )
	ljson_send.setattribute('mdtrtarea_admvs', istr_jytsrx.mdtrtarea_admvs )
	ljson_send.setattribute('insuplc_admdvs', istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs )
	ljson_send.setattribute('recer_sys_code', istr_jytsrx.recer_sys_code )
	ljson_send.setattribute('dev_no', istr_jytsrx.dev_no )
	ljson_send.setattribute('dev_safe_info', istr_jytsrx.dev_safe_info )
	ljson_send.setattribute('cainfo', istr_jytsrx.cainfo )
	ljson_send.setattribute('signtype', istr_jytsrx.signtype )
	ljson_send.setattribute('infver', istr_jytsrx.infver )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter_type', istr_jytsrx.opter_type )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter', istr_jytsrx.opter  )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter_name', istr_jytsrx.opter_name)
	ljson_send.setattribute('inf_time', String(istr_jytsrx.inf_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'))
	ljson_send.setattribute('fixmedins_code', istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_code)
	ljson_send.setattribute('fixmedins_name', istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_name)
	IF is_xxtlx = '9001'  THEN
		istr_jytsrx.sign_no = '1'
	ELSE
		istr_jytsrx.sign_no = is_jyzqh
	END IF
	ljson_send.setattribute('sign_no', istr_jytsrx.sign_no)
	
	//返回对应的消息体格式
	Integer li_ret
	li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
	IF li_bound = 0 THEN
		as_return = '【' + is_xxtlx + '】未维护对应的接口明细'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson ,lsjson_data
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson_data = Create sailjson
	//串联所有的消息体
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', 1) = '无' THEN //5101
	ELSE
		FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
			ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				ls_mxnr = This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
				IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),lsjson, as_return,ls_mxnr) = False THEN
					RETURN False
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
				//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
				li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
				IF li_find < 1 THEN
					IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
						ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
						ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
						li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
						ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
						ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
					ELSE
						as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
						RETURN False
					END IF
				END IF
				ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
				ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
				
				IF  ls_dataformat = 'json' Or ls_dataformat = 'jsons' THEN
				ELSE
					if is_xxtlx = '3202' and lower(ls_dataname) = 'file_qury_no' then
					else
						ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
					end if
				END IF
				
				CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
					CASE 's','d','dt','json'
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
					CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = '0'
					CASE ELSE
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				END CHOOSE
				lb_xhcs = of_get_xhcs_value(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i), ll_xhcs)
				IF lb_xhcs And ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
					lsjson.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
				ELSE
					IF ls_dataformat = 'json' And ls_datavalue > "" THEN
						ls_json_exp_content.parse_sb(ls_datavalue)
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_json_exp_content)
					ELSEIF ls_dataformat = 'jsons' THEN
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, "")
						ls_temp = ls_datavalue
					ELSE
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF lsjson_data.getformatjson('') = '{}' THEN
	ELSE
		lsjson.setattribute( 'data',lsjson_data)
	END IF
	
	ljson_send.setattribute( 'input',lsjson)
	IF ib_sz THEN
		ls_send = ljson_send.getformatjson('',True)
	ELSE
		ls_send = ljson_send.getformatjson('')
	END IF
	
	// JSON 数组暂时使用
	IF is_xxtlx = '3101' Or is_xxtlx = '3102' THEN
		Integer li_pos
		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, "patient_dtos")
		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, ":", li_pos)
		ls_send = Left(ls_send, li_pos) + ls_temp + Right(ls_send, Len(ls_send) - (li_pos+2))
		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, "rule_ids")
		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, ":", li_pos)
		ls_send = Left(ls_send, li_pos) + "null" + Right(ls_send, Len(ls_send) - (li_pos+2))
	END IF
	
	is_send = ls_send
	IF is_xxtlx = '3202' THEN
		gf_sblog('c:\sblog3202','接口号：['+ Upper(is_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  发送:'+ls_send )
		RETURN True
	END IF
	gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ Upper(is_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  发送:'+ls_send )
	IF IsValid(lsjson) THEN  Destroy lsjson
	IF IsValid(lsjson_data) THEN Destroy lsjson_data
	IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
		as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	//加密
	ls_jmc = Space(1024)
	li_ret = ZJ_Hmac_SM3( is_yljgdm, is_secret,'', ls_send, ls_jmc)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_return = ls_jmc
		RETURN False
	END IF
	//post 发送
	ls_recieve = Space(1024 * 32)
	li_ret = This.uf_post( ls_send,ls_jmc, ls_recieve)
	gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ Upper(is_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  返回:'+ls_recieve )
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_return = ls_recieve
		RETURN False
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
//把当前发送的内容转移掉
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)
RETURN of_receive_data(is_xxtlx,ls_recieve,as_return)
end function

public function string of_get_jklx_mxsm (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_name);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and lower(mxnr)='"+as_name+"'",1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN (ids_structre.Object.mxsm[ll_find])
ELSE
	RETURN ''
END IF

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref sailjson as_json, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue,ls_data[]
Dec ldc_datavalue
as_msg = ''
sailjson ls_json,ls_json_exp_content
ls_json = Create sailjson
ls_json_exp_content = Create sailjson
IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_msg = ''
	RETURN True
END IF
ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+as_mxnr+"'",1,9999999)
IF ll_num <= 0  THEN
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	RETURN False
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
//串联所有的消息体
FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count
	ls_json.SetNull()
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find("datamxnr='"+as_mxnr+"'" + " and dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		IF li_count=1 and isnull(ls_datavalue) Then continue;
		if  ls_dataformat = 'json' then
		else
			ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		end if	
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt','json'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN
					ls_datavalue = '0'
				ELSE
					ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
				END IF
		END CHOOSE
		IF ls_dataformat = 'json' and ls_datavalue>"" THEN
			ls_json_exp_content.parse_sb(ls_datavalue)
			ls_json.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_json_exp_content)
		ELSE
			ls_json.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
		END IF
	NEXT
	ls_data[ll_row] = ls_json.getformatjson('')
	
	IF of_Get_xhcs(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_mxnr) THEN //of_Get_xhcs(as_jklx,'JG') THEN
		ib_sz = True
		as_json.setattribute(as_mxnr, ls_data)
	ELSE
		as_json.setattribute(as_mxnr, ls_json)
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN True





end function

String ls_url_post

	soapconnection ln_soapconn
	ln_soapconn = Create soapconnection
	ls_url_post = is_url_post + '?WSDL'
	li_ret = ln_soapconn.CreateInstance(in_commontoolsoap, "commontoolsoap",is_url_post)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '创建连接POST,WEBS失败!URL=' + is_url_post + " ret=" + String(li_ret)
		IF IsValid(ln_soapconn) THEN Destroy ln_soapconn
		RETURN -5
	END IF
END IF

TRY

		as_return = is_xxtlx + '获取对应的接口地址出错！'
		RETURN -1

	IF Pos(as_jmc,":") > 0 THEN
		as_jmc = Mid(as_jmc,Pos(as_jmc,":"))

	li_ret =  in_commontoolsoap.dohttpmethodsep( ls_url_send,'Post',as_send, ls_hearder, "application/json-patch+json",as_return)
//	lb_return = blob(as_return)
//	lb_return = ToAnsi(as_return)

//	long ll_UTF8_size
//long ll_Unicode_Byte_size, ll_Unicode_size
//setnull(lblb null)
//1l UTF8 size = len(ablb UTF8)
////获取转换后需要的内存空间1l Unicode wchar size = MultiByteTowidechar(cp UTf8, 0, ablb UTF8, 1l UTF8 size, lblb null, @)if ll Unicode wchar size <1 thenreturn 
//end if
//1l Unicode Byte size =ll Unicode wchar size *2ablb Unicode =blob(space(ll Unicode Byte size))
////开始转换11 unicode wchar size = MultiByteTowidechar(cp uTf8, 0, ablb UTF8, 1l UTF8 size, ablb Unicode, ll unicode Byte size)if 1l Unicode wchar size < 1 thenreturn 0
//end if
//return ll Unicode Byte size	
	
	is_post_return = as_return
	//	gf_sblog('c:\sblog',"url_send:  " + ls_url_send + 'asend: ' + as_send + 'hearder:' + ls_hearder)
	//	{"Method":"Post","Url":"http://202.202.3.58:8088/api/DiagScreen/DiagroomCallNum","Data":"{'diagroomid':'LB-8','mode':'0'}","Header":"application/json","ContentType":"application/json"}
	RETURN li_ret
Catch (Throwable err) // 异常捕捉
	as_return = "调用POST失败：" + err.Text  + ' URL=' + is_url_post + " input=" + as_send
	RETURN -4
END TRls_datatype

dataname = ' 堾datatype __get_attribute_item 堾datavalue 数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型(
字段名不存在( ls_datatype ls_datavalue ids_receive lower(dataname) = '

堾datavalue
数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回string类型( 消息体类型: 返回的数据,字段名不存在( ls_datatype ls_datavalue
Y
RETURN 1

public function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxtlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);TRY
	//返回数据的判断
	IF IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '' THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson,lsjson2,lsjson_a,lsjson_a2
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson.parse_sb(as_xxt)
	Int li_jdcount,li_jd,li_row,li_rec
	Decimal li_datavalue
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr
	Any lany_return[]
	Boolean lb_xht = False,lb_xhcs
	Long ll_xhcs
	//分解社保直接返回的消息体
	ids_receive_in.Reset()
	ids_receive.Reset()
	ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
	li_rec = of_receive_head(lsjson,as_return)
	IF li_rec < 0 THEN
		IF li_rec = -2 THEN
			as_return = as_xxt
		END IF
		RETURN False
	END IF
	IF This.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '医保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('err_msg')
		RETURN False
	END IF
	
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',1 ) = '无' THEN //接口没有返回值
		IF as_xxtlx = '2507' THEN
			li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
			ls_datavalue = lsjson.getattribute('output')
			ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] = 'output'
			ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
			ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = 's'
		END IF
		RETURN True
	END IF
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mxcd(as_xxtlx,'YD',1 ) = -1 THEN //接口没有节点
		lany_return = lsjson.getattribute('output')
		IF UpperBound(lany_return) > 0 THEN
			IF Not IsValid(lsjson2) THEN
				lsjson2 = Create sailjson
				lsjson2.setattribute( This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(as_xxtlx, 'YD', 1), lany_return)
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_return = '无返回数据!'
			RETURN False
		END IF
	ELSE
		lsjson2 = lsjson.getattribute('output')
	END IF
	//li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count_data(is_xxtlx,'YD') //data部分无循环
	li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD')
	IF li_jdcount > 0 THEN
		FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount
			ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd )
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				lb_xht = True
			ELSE
				lb_xhcs = False
				ll_xhcs = 0
				lb_xhcs = of_get_xhcs_value(as_xxtlx, 'YD', This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd), ll_xhcs)
				IF Not lb_xhcs THEN ll_xhcs = 0
				IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
					IF Not IsValid(lsjson_a2) THEN
						lsjson_a2 = lsjson2
					END IF
				ELSE
					IF Not IsValid(lsjson_a) THEN
						lsjson_a = lsjson2.getattribute( 'data')
					END IF
				END IF
				li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
				IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
					IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
						ls_datavalue = lsjson_a2.getattribute(ls_dataname)
					ELSE
						ls_datavalue = lsjson_a.getattribute(ls_dataname)
					END IF
					//					ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
					//					ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					//					ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
				ELSE
					
IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
						li_datavalue = lsjson_a2.getattribute(ls_dataname)
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
					ELSE
						li_datavalue = lsjson_a.getattribute(ls_dataname)
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
					END IF
				END IF
				ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
				ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
				ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF lb_xht THEN li_rec = of_receivein_data(as_xxtlx,lsjson2,as_return)
		IF li_rec = -1 THEN //20220130zbq
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
RETURN True

end function

public function string of_get_ip ();String ls_computer,ls_ip
Blob{4} lb_hostaddress
//获取IP
GetHost(ls_computer, lb_hostaddress)
ls_ip = String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,1,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,2,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,3,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,4,1))))

return ls_ip
end function

public function string of_getmac ();//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl.of_getmac()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取本机mac地址
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2022.01.19
//====================================================================
string ls_mac
int li_pos 
ls_mac = getlocalmac()
li_pos = pos(ls_mac,':',1)
do while li_pos>0
	ls_mac = replace(ls_mac,li_pos,1,"-")
	li_pos = pos(ls_mac,':',li_pos+1)
loop
return ls_mac
end function

ids_structre.setfilter("")
ids_structre.filter()
ids_structre.setfilter("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + Upper(as_jkfl) + "' and (jgdm='' or isnull(jgdm)) ")
ids_structre.filter()

return ids_structre.rowcount()

end function

public function integer of_receivein_data (string as_xxtlx, sailjson as_xxt, ref string as_return);Int li_row,li_i,li_jd,li_xh,li_mxnr_sl,li_jdcount,li_start, li_upperBound
decimal li_datavalue
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr,ls_jdname,ls_jgdm,ls_classname
sailjson lsjson[], lJson_data
Any lany_return[], laArr_data[],la_data
boolean lb_exists

li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx,'YD')
FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount //节点数
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
	ls_mxnr = This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
	//加一条明细条数
	li_start = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
	ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_start] = '0'
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = 0
	ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_start] = 'datacount'
	ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_start] = ls_mxnr
	//
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN //不为data的节点
		IF of_get_xhcs(is_xxtlx,'YD',ls_mxnr) THEN //是数组
		   if ib_ydzf then
				la_data = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr,lb_exists)
				IF Not lb_exists THEN
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			end if
			ls_classname= classname(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr))  //20220130zbq
			if isnull(ls_classname) then 
				as_return='无返回数据'
				return -1
			end if
			lany_return = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr)
			ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			li_mxnr_sl = This.of_get_jklx_count(ls_jgdm,'JG') //获取节点内的参数数量
			FOR li_xh = 1 To UpperBound(lany_return) //循环数组内的次数
				ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = li_xh
				lsjson[li_xh] = lany_return[li_xh]
				FOR li_i = 1 To li_mxnr_sl
					li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
					ls_jdname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i )
					IF This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
						
						ls_datavalue = String(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname))
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(ls_datavalue))
					ELSE
						IF isnull(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname)) Then
							setnull(li_datavalue)
						ELSE
							li_datavalue = Dec(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname))
						END IF
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(li_datavalue))
					END IF
				NEXT
			NEXT
		ELSE //不是数组
			ls_classname= classname(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr))  //gqj
			if isnull(ls_classname) then continue
			lsjson[li_jd] = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr)
			ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			li_mxnr_sl = This.of_get_jklx_count(ls_jgdm,'JG')
			ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = 1
			FOR li_i = 1 To li_mxnr_sl
				li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
				ls_jdname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i )
				IF This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
					ls_datavalue = String(lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname))
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
					ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
				//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(ls_datavalue))
				ELSEIF This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 'json' Then
					IF this.of_get_xhcs(ls_jgdm, 'JG') THen  // json数组
						li_upperBound = lsjson[li_jd].getArray(ls_jdname, ref laArr_data)
						IF li_upperBound>0 Then
							For li_xh=1 to li_upperBound Step 1
								IF li_xh<>1 Then li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
								lJson_data = laArr_data[li_xh]
								IF isnull(lJson_data) Then
									ls_datavalue = ''
								ELSE
									ls_datavalue = lJson_data.getformatjson('')
								END IF
								ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
								ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
								ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
								ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
								ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
							Next
						END IF
					ELSE
						lJson_data = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)
						IF isnull(lJson_data) Then
							ls_datavalue = ''
						ELSE
							ls_datavalue = lJson_data.getformatjson('')
						END IF
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
					END IF
				ELSE
					IF isnull(lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)) Then
						setnull(li_datavalue)
					ELSE
						li_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)
					END IF
					ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i))
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
					ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
				//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(li_datavalue))
				END IF
			NEXT
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

//li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count_data(is_xxtlx,'YD') //data部分
//IF li_jdcount > 0 THEN
//	lsjson_a = as_xxt.getattribute('data')
//	FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount
//		li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
//		ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx,'YD',li_i )
//		IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
//			ls_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_dataname)
//			ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
//			ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
//			ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_i)
//			MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(ls_datavalue))
//		ELSE
//			li_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_dataname)
//			ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
//			ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
//			ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_i)
//			MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
//		END IF
//	NEXT	
//END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_receive_head (sailjson as_xxt, ref string as_return);Int li_row,li_bound,li_i,li_datavalue
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue
Any lany_rec
Boolean lb_exists
lany_rec = as_xxt.getattribute('infcode',lb_exists)
IF Not lb_exists THEN
	RETURN -2
END IF
IF String(lany_rec) <> '0' THEN //Or as_xxt.getattribute('infcode') = ''
	as_return = String(as_xxt.getattribute('err_msg'))
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF is_xxtlx = '7104' Or is_xxtlx = '7101' Or is_xxtlx = '7160' Or is_xxtlx = '7161' THEN
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count('1002','YD')
ELSE
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count('1001','YD')
END IF

//li_bound = of_get_jklx_count('1001','YD') //hw 2023/03/13 注释
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc( '1001','YD',li_i )
	IF ls_dataname = '' Or IsNull(ls_dataname) THEN
		as_return = "1001接口应答不存在序号为"+String(li_i)+"的mxnr"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF This.of_get_jklx_format( '1001','YD',li_i ) = 's' THEN
		ls_datavalue = String(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname))
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( '1001', 'YD',li_i )
		//MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(ls_datavalue))
	ELSE
		li_datavalue = Dec(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname))
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( '1001', 'YD',li_i )
		//MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
	END IF
	IF ls_dataname = 'infcode' And li_datavalue <> 0 THEN
		as_return = String(as_xxt.getattribute('err_msg'))
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
NEXT
RETURN 1




end function

public function long of_get_jklx_mxcd (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, integer ai_pxxh);Long ll_find
ids_structre.SetFilter("")
ids_structre.Filter()
ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" +Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + as_jkfl + "' and pxxh="+String(ai_pxxh),1,99999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.GetItemNumber( ll_find, "mxcd")
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF


end function
