public subroutine reset ();st_item lst_items[]
char lc[]

item_list = lst_items
items_idx = '|'
jsonstr = ''
jsonc = lc
idx = 0
jsonlen = 0
end subroutine

public function any getitem (string item_name);any la_item_value
int i

setnull(la_item_value)
i = _get_idx(item_name)
if i > 0 then la_item_value = item_list[i].value

return la_item_value
end function

public function integer delitem (string item_name);int li_idx,i
st_item lst_items[]

li_idx = _get_idx(item_name)
if li_idx < 1 then return -1

for i = 1 to li_idx - 1
	lst_items[i] = item_list[i]
next
for i = li_idx + 1 to upperbound(item_list)
	lst_items[i - 1] = item_list[i]
next

item_list = lst_items
_regenerate_items_idx()

return 0
end function

public function integer setdata (string item_name, any data);return setdatarow(item_name,data,1,data.dynamic rowcount())
end function

public function integer setdatarow (any data, long row);long i
st_data_col lst_col[]
st_item lst_item[]

if _get_data_col(data,lst_col) < 0 then return -1
if  _trans_data_row(data,row,lst_col,lst_item) < 0 then return -1
for i = 1 to upperbound(lst_item)
	item_list[upperbound(item_list) + 1] = lst_item[i]
next
_regenerate_items_idx()

return 0

end function

public function integer setdatarow (string item_name, any data, long row);n_json ljson

ljson = create n_json
ljson.date_format = date_format
ljson.time_format = time_format
ljson.datetime_format = datetime_format
ljson.item_name_style = item_name_style
ljson.pretty_stringify = pretty_stringify
ljson.setdatarow(data,row)

return setitem(item_name,ljson)
end function

private function integer _get_idx (string item_name);long ll_pos1,ll_pos2

ll_pos1 = pos(items_idx,'|'+item_name+':')
if ll_pos1 < 1 then return -1

ll_pos1 += len(item_name) + 2
ll_pos2 = pos(items_idx,'|',ll_pos1+1)

return integer(mid(items_idx, ll_pos1, ll_pos2 - ll_pos1))

end function

private function string _trans_name (string item_name);string ls_name
char lc[],lc_name[]
long i,j
boolean lb_trans_flag

//命名规则转换
choose case item_name_style //user_name
	case STYLE_UPPER //USER_NAME
		ls_name = upper(item_name)
	case STYLE_LOWER //user_name
		ls_name = lower(item_name)
	case STYLE_CAMEL //userName
		lc = item_name
		for i = 1 to upperbound(lc)
			if lc[i] = '_' then 
				lb_trans_flag = true
				continue
			end if
			j ++
			if lb_trans_flag then
				lc_name[j] = upper(string(lc[i]))
				lb_trans_flag = false
			else
				lc_name[j] = lower(string(lc[i]))
			end if
		next
		ls_name = lc_name
	case STYLE_PASCAL //UserName
		lc = item_name
		lb_trans_flag = true
		for i = 1 to upperbound(lc)
			if lc[i] = '_' then 
				lb_trans_flag = true
				continue
			end if
			j ++
			if lb_trans_flag then
				lc_name[j] = upper(string(lc[i]))
				lb_trans_flag = false
			else
				lc_name[j] = lower(string(lc[i]))
			end if
		next
		ls_name = lc_name
	case else
		return item_name
end choose

return ls_name
end function

public function integer setdatarow (string item_name, any data, long begin_row, long end_row);long i,j
n_json ljson_list[]
st_data_col lst_col[]
st_item lst_item[],lst_null[]

if _get_data_col(data,lst_col) < 0 then return -1
for i = begin_row to end_row
	lst_item = lst_null
	if _trans_data_row(data,i,lst_col,lst_item) < 0 then return -1
	j += 1
	ljson_list[j] = create n_json
	ljson_list[j].date_format = date_format
	ljson_list[j].time_format = time_format
	ljson_list[j].datetime_format = datetime_format
	ljson_list[j].item_name_style = item_name_style
	ljson_list[j].pretty_stringify = pretty_stringify
	ljson_list[j].item_list = lst_item
	ljson_list[j]._regenerate_items_idx()
next

return setitem(item_name,ljson_list)

end function

private subroutine _skip ();char c

do 
   idx += 1
   c = jsonc[idx]
loop while _check_spc(c)

end subroutine

private function integer _parse_list (ref any value[]);long i
any la_list[],la_value_list[]

_skip()
do until jsonc[idx] = ']'
	i += 1
	if _parse_value(la_list[i]) < 0 then return -1
	
	_skip()
	if jsonc[idx] = ',' then _skip()
loop
value = la_list

return 0
end function

private function integer _parse_value (ref any value);string ls_value
n_json ljson
any la_value,la_list[]
long ll_pos
long i
char lc_value[]

choose case jsonc[idx]
	case '{'
		ljson = create n_json
		if _parse_json(ljson) < 0 then return -1
		la_value = ljson
	case '['
		if _parse_list(la_list) < 0 then return -1
		la_value = la_list
	case '"'
		idx += 1
		do 
until jsonc[idx] = '"' or idx > jsonlen
			if asc(jsonc[idx]) > 127 then
				//防止汉字GBK编码后半部分包含\等特殊符号 MXL 20200326
				i ++
				lc_value[i] = jsonc[idx]
				i ++
				lc_value[i] = jsonc[idx + 1]
				idx += 2
				continue
			end if
			if jsonc[idx] = '\' then 
				idx += 1
				if not (jsonc[idx] = '"' or jsonc[idx] = '\') then
					i ++
					choose case jsonc[idx]
						case 't'
							lc_value[i] = '~t'
						case 'r'
							lc_value[i] = '~r'
						case 'n'
							lc_value[i] = '~n'
						case 'f'
							lc_value[i] = '~f'
						case 'b'
							lc_value[i] = '~b'
						case 'u'
							lc_value[i] = '\'
							i ++
							lc_value[i] = jsonc[idx]
						case else
							return -1
					end choose
					idx += 1
					continue
				end if
			end if
			i ++
			lc_value[i] = jsonc[idx]
			idx += 1
		loop
		ls_value = lc_value
		la_value = ls_value
	case '0' to '9','+','-',&
		   't','f',&
		   'n'
		do until jsonc[idx] = ',' or jsonc[idx] = ']' or jsonc[idx] = '}' or _check_spc(jsonc[idx]) or idx > jsonlen
			i ++
			lc_value[i] = jsonc[idx]
			idx += 1
		loop
		ls_value = lc_value
		idx -= 1
		if isnumber(ls_value) then
			if pos(ls_value,'E') > 0 or pos(ls_value,'e') > 0 then
				la_value = double(ls_value)
			elseif pos(ls_value,'.') > 0 then
				la_value = dec(ls_value)
			else
				la_value = long(ls_value)
			end if
		else
			choose case ls_value
				case 'true'
					la_value = true
				case 'false'
					la_value = false
				case 'null'
					setnull(la_value)
				case else
					return -1
			end choose
		end if
	case else
		return -1
end choose
value = la_value

return 0
end function

private subroutine _regenerate_items_idx ();int i

items_idx = '|'
for i = 1 to upperbound(item_list)
	items_idx += item_list[i].name + ':' + string(i) + '|'
next

end subroutine

public function integer setitem (string item_name, any item_value);st_item lst_item
int li_idx
any la_item_value

_trans_value(item_value)
li_idx = _get_idx(item_name)

if li_idx < 0 then 
	lst_item.name = item_name
	lst_item.value = item_value
	li_idx = upperbound(item_list)+1
	item_list[li_idx] = lst_item
	items_idx += item_name+':'+string(li_idx)+'|'
else
	item_list[li_idx].value = item_value
end if

return li_idx
end function

public function long exportdatarow (any data);long ll_row
int i
string ls_colname,ls_coltype
string ls_item_name
any la_item_value
string ls_cls
string ls_value,ls_date,ls_time,ls_datetime

if upperbound(data) >= 0 then return -1
choose case data.dynamic typeof()
	case DataWindow!,DataStore!
	case else
		return -1
end choose

ll_row = data.dynamic insertrow(0)
for i = 1 to upperbound(item_list)
	ls_item_name = item_list[i].name
	la_item_value = item_list[i].value
	if upperbound(la_item_value) >= 0 then continue
	ls_colname = data.dynamic describe(ls_item_name+".name")
	if ls_colname = '!' or ls_colname = '?' or ls_colname = '' or isnull(ls_colname) then continue
	ls_coltype = data.dynamic describe(ls_item_name+".coltype")
	ls_cls = classname(la_item_value)
	choose case lower(mid(ls_coltype,1,4))
		case 'char'  //-->string
			if not (ls_cls = 'string') then continue
		case 'deci'/*decimal*/,'numb'/*number*/,'long','ulon'/*ulong*/,'real'
			if not (ls_cls = 'string' or &  					  ls_cls = 'decimal' or &  					  ls_cls = 'double' or & 					  ls_cls = 'integer' or & 					  ls_cls = 'long' or &
					  ls_cls = 'unsignedinteger' or &
					  ls_cls = 'unsignedlong' or &
					  ls_cls = 'real') then continue
			if ls_cls = 'string' then //自动类型转换 尝试将字符串转换成数字 mxl 20200326
				ls_value = la_item_value
				la_item_value = _to_number(ls_value)
			end if
		case 'date','time' // date datetime time
			if not (ls_cls = 'string') then continue
			ls_value = la_item_value
			if ls_coltype = 'date' then
				la_item_value = _to_date(ls_value)
			elseif ls_coltype = 'datetime' then
				la_item_value = _to_datetime(ls_value)
			elseif ls_coltype = 'time' then
				la_item_value = _to_time(ls_value)
			end if
		case else
			continue
	end choose
	data.dynamic setitem(ll_row,ls_item_name,la_item_value)
next

return ll_row
end function

public function long exportdata (string item_name, any data);any la_list[]
any la_value
long ll_count,i
n_json ljson
long ll_export

la_value = getitem(item_name)
ll_count = upperbound(la_value)
if ll_count < 0 then
	la_list[1] = la_value
	ll_count = 1
else
	la_list = la_value
end if

data.dynamic setredraw(false)
for i = 1 to ll_count
	yield()
	if not classname(la_list[i]) = classname(this) then continue
	ljson = la_list[i]
	ljson.exportdatarow(data)
	ll_export += 1
next
data.dynamic setredraw(true)

return ll_export

end function

private function integer _parse_json (n_json ajson);string ls_item_name
any la_value,la_list[]
char lc_name[],lc_empty[]
long i

_skip()
do while idx < jsonlen
	if jsonc[idx] = '}' then return 0
	if jsonc[idx] <> '"' then return -1
	ls_item_name = ''
	
	idx += 1
	i = 0
	lc_name = lc_empty
	do until jsonc[idx] = '"'
		i ++
		lc_name[i] = jsonc[idx]
		idx += 1
	loop
	ls_item_name = lc_name
	
	_skip()
	if jsonc[idx] <> ':' then return -1
	
	_skip()
	if _parse_value(la_value) < 0 then return -1
	
	ajson.setitem(ls_item_name,la_value)
	
	_skip()
	if jsonc[idx] = ',' then
		_skip()
	elseif jsonc[idx] = '}' then
		return 0
	end if
loop

return 0
end function

private function date _to_date (string s);date ld
string ls_year,ls_month,ls_day

setnull(ld)
if len(s) <> len(date_format) then return ld
ls_year = mid(s,pos(date_format,'yyyy'),4)
ls_month = mid(s,pos(date_format,'mm'),2)
ls_day = mid(s,pos(date_format,'dd'),2)
if not (isnumber(ls_year) and isnumber(ls_month) and isnumber(ls_day)) then return ld
ld = date(integer(ls_year),integer(ls_month),integer(ls_day))
if string(ld,date_format) <> s then setnull(ld)

return ld
end function

private function time _to_time (string s);time lt
string ls_hour,ls_minute,ls_second

setnull(lt)
if len(s) <> len(time_format) then return lt
ls_hour = mid(s,pos(time_format,'hh'),2)
ls_minute = mid(s,pos(time_format,'mm'),2)
ls_second = mid(s,pos(time_format,'ss'),2)
if not (isnumber(ls_hour) and isnumber(ls_minute) and isnumber(ls_second)) then return lt
lt = time(integer(ls_hour),integer(ls_minute),integer(ls_second))
if string(lt,time_format) <> s then setnull(lt)

return lt
end function

private function datetime _to_datetime (string s);datetime ldt
date ld
time lt
string ls_year,ls_month,ls_day
string ls_hour,ls_minute,ls_second

setnull(ldt)
if len(s) <> len(datetime_format) then return ldt
ls_year = mid(s,pos(date_format,'yyyy'),4)
ls_month = mid(s,pos(date_format,'mm'),2)
ls_day = mid(s,pos(date_format,'dd'),2)
ls_hour = mid(s,pos(time_format,'hh'),2)
ls_minute = mid(s,lastpos(time_format,'mm'),2)
ls_second = mid(s,pos(time_format,'ss'),2)


if not (isnumber(ls_year) and isnumber(ls_month) and isnumber(ls_day) and isnumber(ls_hour) and isnumber(ls_minute) and isnumber(ls_second)) then return ldt
ld = date(integer(ls_year),integer(ls_month),integer(ls_day))
lt = time(integer(ls_hour),integer(ls_minute),integer(ls_second))
ldt = datetime(ld,lt)
if string(ldt,datetime_format) <> s then setnull(ldt)

return ldt
end function

public function long getlistjson (string item_name, ref n_json rjson[]);any la_value,la_list[]
long i

la_value = getitem(item_name)
if upperbound(la_value) < 0 then return -1

la_list = la_value
for i = 1 to upperbound(la_list)
	if upperbound(la_list[i]) >= 0 then return -1
	if isnull(la_list[i]) then return -1
	if classname(la_list[i]) <> classname(this) then return -1
	rjson[i] = la_list[i]
next

//rjson = la_list
return upperbound(rjson[])
end function

public function any getitempath (string item_path);any la,la_value,la_list_get[],la_list_set[]
n_json ljson_value
long i,ll_len
char lc[]
string ls_item_expression,ls_next_path

lc =item_path
ll_len = upperbound(lc)
if ll_len <= 0 then return la

i = 1
if lc[i] <> '/' then return la

i += 1
do until lc[i] = '/'
	ls_item_expression = ls_item_expression + lc[i]
	i += 1
	if i > ll_len then exit
loop

la_value = getitemexp(ls_item_expression)
if i > ll_len then return la_value
ls_next_path = mid(item_path,i)

if upperbound(la_value) >= 0 then
	la_list_get = la_value
	for i = 1 to upperbound(la_list_get)
		if classname(la_list_get[i]) = classname(this) then
			ljson_value = la_list_get[i]
			la_list_set[i] = ljson_value.getitempath(ls_next_path)
		else
			la_list_set[i] = la
		end if
	next
	return la_list_set
else
	if classname(la_value) = classname(this) then
		ljson_value = la_value
		return ljson_value.getitempath(ls_next_path)
	else
		return la
	end if
end if

return la
end function

private function integer _parse_expression (string expression, ref st_name_exp rst_name_exp);char lc[]
string ls_item_name,ls_idx_begin,ls_idx_end
long ll_idx_begin,ll_idx_end
long i = 1
if not match(expression,'.+\[.+\]$') then return -1
lc = expression
do until lc[i] = '['
	ls_item_name = ls_item_name + lc[i]
	i += 1
loop

i += 1
do until lc[i] = ':' or lc[i] = ']'
	ls_idx_begin = ls_idx_begin + lc[i]
	i += 1
loop
if ls_idx_begin = '' then ls_idx_begin = '1'
if not isnumber(ls_idx_begin) then return -1
ll_idx_begin = long(ls_idx_begin)
if lc[i] = ':' then
	i += 1
	do until lc[i] = ']'
		ls_idx_end = ls_idx_end + lc[i]
		i += 1
	loop
	if ls_idx_end = '' then ls_idx_end = '0'
	if not isnumber(ls_idx_end) then return -1
	ll_idx_end = long(ls_idx_end)
	if ll_idx_end > 0 and ll_idx_end < ll_idx_begin then return -1
	rst_name_exp.islist = true
else
	ll_idx_end = ll_idx_begin
	rst_name_exp.islist = false
end if

rst_name_exp.name = ls_item_name
rst_name_exp.idx_begin = ll_idx_begin
rst_name_exp.idx_end = ll_idx_end
return 0
end function

public function any getitemexp (string item_expression);any la_value,la_item_value
any la_list_get[],la_list_set[]
long i
st_name_exp lst_name_exp

setnull(la_item_value)
if _parse_expression(item_expression,lst_name_exp) < 0 then return getitem(item_expression)

la_value = getitem(lst_name_exp.name)
if isnull(la_value) then return la_item_value
if upperbound(la_value) < max(lst_name_exp.idx_begin,lst_name_exp.idx_end) then return la_item_value
la_list_get = la_value
if lst_name_exp.isList then
	if lst_name_exp.idx_end = 0 then lst_name_exp.idx_end = upperbound(la_list_get)
	for i = 1 to lst_name_exp.idx_end - lst_name_exp.idx_begin + 1
		la_list_set[i] = la_list_get[lst_name_exp.idx_begin + i - 1]
	next
	la_item_value = la_list_set
else
	la_item_value = la_list_get[lst_name_exp.idx_begin]
end if
	
return la_item_value
end function

public function integer rename (string item_name, string new_name);int li_idx

li_idx = _get_idx(item_name)
if li_idx < 0 then return -1

item_list[li_idx].name = new_name
_regenerate_items_idx()

return li_idx
end function

private function integer _trans_list (ref any value[]);long i
any la_value

for i = 1 to upperbound(value)
	la_value = value[i]
	_trans_value(la_value)
	value[i] = la_value
next

return 0
end function

private function integer _trans_value (ref any value);any la_value

if upperbound(value) >= 0 then 
	_trans_list(value)
	return 0
end if

if isnull(value) then return 0
choose case classname(value)
	case classname(this)
		la_value = value
	case 'string'
		la_value = value
	case 'integer','unsignedinteger','long','unsignedlong','decimal','double','real'
		la_value = value
	case 'boolean'
		la_value = value
	case 'date'
		la_value = string(value,date_format)
	case 'time'
		la_value = string(value,time_format)
	case 'datetime' 
		la_value = string(value,datetime_format)
	case else
		setnull(la_value)
end choose

value = la_value
return 0
end function

public function integer parse (string s);reset()
jsonstr = s
jsonc = s
jsonlen = upperbound(jsonc)

_skip()
if jsonc[idx] <> '{' then return -1
if _parse_json(this) < 0 then return -1

return 0
end function

private function boolean _check_spc (character c);
if c=' ' or c='~r' or c='~n' or c='~t' or c='~b' or c='~f' then return true
return false
end function

public function long getkeys (ref string keys[]);long i
string ls_keys[]

for i = 1 to upperbound(item_list)
	ls_keys[i] = item_list[i].name
next

keys = ls_keys
return upperbound(keys)
end function

public function integer _get_data_col (any data, ref st_data_col data_col[]);
int li_colcount
long i,j,p1,p2
string ls_tag,ls_attr_name
string ls_col_visible //mxl 20200313
any la_value

if upperbound(data) >= 0 then return -1
choose case data.dynamic typeof()
	case DataWindow!,DataStore!
	case else
		return -1
end choose

li_colcount = integer(data.dynamic describe("datawindow.column.count"))
for i = 1 to li_colcount
	ls_tag = data.dynamic describe("#"+string(i)+".tag")
	p1 = pos(ls_tag,'@attr(')
	if p1 > 0 then
		p1 += 6
		p2 = pos(ls_tag,')',p1)
		ls_attr_name = mid(ls_tag,p1,p2 - p1)
		if ls_attr_name = 'null' then continue
	else
		ls_attr_name = ''
	end if
	
	ls_col_visible = data.dynamic describe("#"+string(i)+".visible")
	if ls_col_visible = '0' then continue //列属性为隐藏则不导出 mxl 20200313
	
	j += 1
	
	data_col[j].colname = data.dynamic describe("#"+string(i)+".name")
	data_col[j].coltype = data.dynamic describe("#"+string(i)+'.coltype')
	if isnull(ls_attr_name) or ls_attr_name='' then ls_attr_name = data_col[j].colname
	data_col[j].attrname = ls_attr_name
next


return 0
end function

private function integer _trans_data_row (any data, long row, st_data_col data_col[], ref st_item rst_item[]);
long i,ll_rowcount
any la_value

ll_rowcount = data.dynamic rowcount()
if row > ll_rowcount then return -1

for i = 1 to upperbound(data_col)
	
choose case lower(left(data_col[i].coltype,4))
		case 'char'	//string
			la_value = data.dynamic getitemstring(row,data_col[i].colname)
			if isnull(la_value) then la_value = ''
		case 'deci'/*decimal*/
			la_value = data.dynamic getitemdecimal(row,data_col[i].colname)
		case 'numb'/*number*/,'long','ulon'/*ulong*/,'real'
			la_value = data.dynamic getitemnumber(row,data_col[i].colname)
		case 'date'
			if data_col[i].coltype = 'date' then
				la_value = string(data.dynamic getitemdate(row,data_col[i].colname),date_format)
			else //datetime
				la_value = string(data.dynamic getitemdatetime(row,data_col[i].colname),datetime_format)
			end if
			if isnull(la_value) then la_value = ''
		case 'time'
			la_value = string(data.dynamic getitemtime(row,data_col[i].colname),time_format)
			if isnull(la_value) then la_value = ''
		case else
			setnull(la_value)
	end choose
	rst_item[i].name = data_col[i].attrname
	rst_item[i].value = la_value
next

return upperbound(rst_item)
end function

public function integer extend (n_json ajson);
st_item extend_list[]
int li_idx
int i

extend_list = ajson.item_list
for i = 1 to upperbound(extend_list)
	li_idx = _get_idx(extend_list[i].name)

	if li_idx < 0 then 
		li_idx = upperbound(item_list)+1
		item_list[li_idx] = extend_list[i]
		items_idx += extend_list[i].name+':'+string(li_idx)+'|'
	else
		item_list[li_idx].value = extend_list[i].value
	end if
next

return 0
end function

public function string stringify ();char lc_empty[]

idx = 0
jsonc = lc_empty

_stringify_json(this,1)

return jsonc
end function

public subroutine _stringify_json (n_json ajson, integer level);int i
string ls_tab

ajson._fill_jsonc('{')

if pretty_stringify then ls_tab = fill('~t',level - 1)

for i = 1 to upperbound(item_list)
	if pretty_stringify then
		ajson._fill_jsonc('~r~n~t')
		ajson._fill_jsonc(ls_tab)
	end if
	
	ajson._fill_jsonc('"')
	ajson._fill_jsonc(_trans_name(item_list[i].name))
	ajson._fill_jsonc('":')
	
	_stringify_value(ajson,item_list[i].value,level)
	
	if i < upperbound(item_list) then
		ajson._fill_jsonc(',')
	end if
next

if pretty_stringify then
	ajson._fill_jsonc('~r~n')
	ajson._fill_jsonc(ls_tab)
end if

ajson._fill_jsonc('}')

return
end subroutine

public subroutine _stringify_list (n_json ajson, any value[], integer level);long i

ajson._fill_jsonc('[')

for i = 1 to upperbound(value)
	_stringify_value(ajson,value[i],level)
	if i < upperbound(value) then
		ajson._fill_jsonc(',')
	end if
next

ajson._fill_jsonc(']')

return



end subroutine

public subroutine _stringify_value (n_json ajson, any value, integer level);string ls_value
n_json ljson
char lc_tmp[]
long i

if upperbound(value) >= 0 then
	_stringify_list(ajson,value,level)
elseif classname(value) = classname(this) then
	ljson = value
	ljson.item_name_style = item_name_style
	ljson.pretty_stringify = pretty_stringify
	ljson._stringify_json(ajson,level + 1)
else
	if isnull(classname(value)) then
		ajson._fill_jsonc('null')
	else
		choose case classname(value)
			case 'string'
				ajson._fill_jsonc('"')
				lc_tmp = string(value)
				for i = 1 to upperbound(lc_tmp)
					if asc(lc_tmp[i]) > 127 then
						//防止汉字GBK编码后半部分包含\等特殊符号 MXL 20200326
						ajson._fill_jsonc(lc_tmp[i] + lc_tmp[i + 1])
						i ++
						continue
					end if
					choose case lc_tmp[i]
						case '\'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\')
							if i < upperbound(lc_tmp) then //防止数组越界 MXL 20200326
								if lc_tmp[i + 1] = 'u' then continue
							end if
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\')
						case '"'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\' + lc_tmp[i])
						case '~r'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\r')
						case '~n'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\n')
						case '~t'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\t')
						case '~f'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\f')
						case '~b'
							ajson._fill_jsonc('\b')
						case else
							ajson._fill_jsonc(lc_tmp[i])
					end choose
				next
				ajson._fill_jsonc('"')
			case else
				ajson._fill_jsonc(string(value))
		end choose
	end if
end if

return 

end subroutine

public subroutine _fill_jsonc (string s);char lc[]
long i

lc = s
for i = 1 to upperbound(lc)
	idx ++
	jsonc[idx] = lc[i]
next
end subroutine

public function integer setsql (string item_name, string sql);datastore lds_data

if _sql_to_ds(sql,lds_data) < 0 then return -1

return setdata(item_name,lds_data)
end function

public function integer setsqlrow (string sql, long row);datastore lds_data

if _sql_to_ds(sql,lds_data) < row then return -1

return setdatarow(lds_data,row)
end function

public function boolean hasitem (string item_name);return _get_idx(item_name) > 0
end function

public function integer setsqlrow (string item_name, string sql, long row);datastore lds_data

if _sql_to_ds(sql,lds_data) < row then return -1

return setdatarow(item_name,lds_data,row)
end function

public function integer setsqlrow (string item_name, string sql, long begin_row, long end_row);datastore lds_data

if _sql_to_ds(sql,lds_data) < end_row then return -1

return setdatarow(item_name,lds_data,begin_row,end_row)
end function

public function long _sql_to_ds (string sql, ref datastore ds);string ls_syntax
string ls_err

ls_syntax = SQLCA.SyntaxFromSQL(sql,'Style(Type=Grid)',ls_err)
if len(ls_err) > 0 then return -1

ds = create datastore
ds.create(ls_syntax,ls_err)
if len(ls_err) > 0 then return -1

ds.settransobject(SQLCA)
ds.retrieve()

return ds.rowcount()
end function

private function decimal _to_number (string s);//新增功能：将字符串转换成数字 mxl 20200326
dec ldc

setnull(ldc)
if not (isnumber(s)) then return ldc
ldc = dec(s)

return ldc
end function

end on

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_dzdmsb()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_table	
// 	value	string	as_tjlxh	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN 		日期: 2022.01.17    28271    获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//====================================================================

IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM' Or Upper(as_table) = 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN //wangyi 20200319 诊断单独拿出来获取
	ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz_jb.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
	ELSE
		RETURN '无'
	END IF
END IF

ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsbmc (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_dzdmsbmc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取医保名称
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_table	
// 	value	string	as_tjlxh	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.17    28271  获取医保名称
//====================================================================

IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find,ll_jlxh
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] > '' THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find]
	ELSE
		String ls_dmmc
		CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
			CASE 'GY_KSDM'
				ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
				SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'MZ_KS'
				SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'YK_YPSX'
				SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		END CHOOSE
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tname[ll_find] = Upper(as_table)
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tjlxh[ll_find] = as_tjlxh
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] = ls_dmmc
		RETURN ls_dmmc
	END IF
ELSE
	CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
		CASE 'GY_KSDM'
			ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
			SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'MZ_KS'
			SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'YK_YPSX'
			SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE else
			ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	END CHOOSE
	If ISNULL(ls_dmmc) THEN ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	RETURN ls_dmmc
END IF

end function

public subroutine of_get_zhxx (ref str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl astr_yb_grjbxx);//表 6 输出-基本信息（节点标识：baseinfo）
//1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
//2	psn_cert_type	人员证件类型	字符型	6	Y	Y	
//3	certno	证件号码	字符型	50		Y	
//4	psn_name	人员姓名	字符型	50		Y	
//5	gend	性别	字符型	6	Y	Y	
//6	naty	民族	字符型	3	Y		
//7	brdy	出生日期	日期型				yyyy-MM-dd
//8	age	年龄	数值型	4,1		Y	
//9	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	
//当年账户余额和历年账户余额将通过exp_content（字段扩展）进行返回，返回的信息将以字符类型的JSON串格式放到exp_content字段中，其中JSON串字段定义说明如下：crtYearBalc：当年账户余额calYearBalc：历年账户余额

This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'baseinfo')
astr_yb_grjbxx.grbh = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_no', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.psn_cert_type = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_cert_type', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.certno = This.uf_getstring_in('certno', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.sfzh = This.uf_getstring_in('certno', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.brxm = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_name', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.gend = Integer(This.uf_getstring_in('gend', 1))
astr_yb_grjbxx.naty = This.uf_getstring_in('naty', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.brdy = This.uf_getdate_in('brdy', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.age = This.uf_getDecimal_in('age', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.exp_content = This.uf_getstring_in('exp_content', 1)
astr_yb_grjbxx.dnzhye = 0.00
astr_yb_grjbxx.lnzhye = 0.00
astr_yb_grjbxx.mzsfxs = 1
astr_yb_grjbxx.zysfxs = 1
IF astr_yb_grjbxx.gend = 2  THEN
	astr_yb_grjbxx.sysfxs = 1
ELSE
	astr_yb_grjbxx.sysfxs = 0
END IF
IF astr_yb_grjbxx.exp_content > '' THEN
	sailjson ljson_exp
	ljson_exp = Create sailjson
	ljson_exp.parse_sb( astr_yb_grjbxx.exp_content)
	Any la_zhye
	la_zhye = ljson_exp.getattribute( 'crtYearBalc')
	IF IsNull(la_zhye) Or Not IsNumber(String(la_zhye))   THEN
		astr_yb_grjbxx.dnzhye = 0.00
	ELSE
		astr_yb_grjbxx.dnzhye = ljson_exp.getattribute( 'crtYearBalc')
	END IF
	la_zhye = ljson_exp.getattribute( 'calYearBalc')
	IF IsNull(la_zhye) Or Not IsNumber(String(la_zhye))  THEN
		astr_yb_grjbxx.lnzhye = 0.00
	ELSE
		astr_yb_grjbxx.lnzhye = ljson_exp.getattribute( 'calYearBalc')
	END IF
	//	astr_yb_grjbxx.lnzhye = ljson_exp.getattribute( 'calYearBalc')
END IF
//表 7 输出-参保信息列表（节点标识insuinfo）
//1	balc	余额	数值型	16,2		Y	
//2	insutype	险种繢AT*
	字符型	6	Y	Y	
//3	psn_type	人员类别	字符型	6	Y	Y	
//4	psn_insu_stas	人员参保状态	字符型	6	Y		
//5	psn_insu_date	个人参保日期	日期型				
//6	paus_insu_date	暂停参保日期	日期型				
//7	cvlserv_flag	公务员标志	字符型	3	Y	Y	
//8	insuplc_admdvs	参保地医保区划	字符型	6		Y	
//9	emp_name	单位名称	字符型	200	
Long ll_count,ll_row
ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'insuinfo')
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].balc = This.uf_getdecimal_in( 'balc',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].insutype = This.uf_getstring_in( 'insutype',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].psn_type = This.uf_getstring_in( 'psn_type',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].psn_insu_stas = This.uf_getstring_in( 'psn_insu_stas',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].psn_insu_date = This.uf_getdate_in( 'psn_insu_date',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].paus_insu_date = This.uf_getdate_in( 'paus_insu_date',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].cvlserv_flag = This.uf_getstring_in( 'cvlserv_flag',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].insuplc_admdvs = This.uf_getstring_in( 'insuplc_admdvs',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[ll_row].emp_name = This.uf_getstring_in( 'emp_name',ll_row)
	NEXT
END IF

// 暂时以第1条参保信息为基准
// 2022.01.20  CJN  28271  此处默认将参保信息第1行的数据作为本次参保数据
IF UpperBound(astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx) > 0 THEN
	astr_yb_grjbxx.insutype = astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[1].insutype
	astr_yb_grjbxx.psn_type = astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[1].psn_type
	astr_yb_grjbxx.cvlserv_flag = astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[1].cvlserv_flag
	astr_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm = astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_cbxx[1].insuplc_admdvs
	IF Left(astr_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm, 4) = Left(is_yljgxzqh, 4) THEN
		astr_yb_grjbxx.sydbz = 0
	ELSE
		astr_yb_grjbxx.sydbz = 1
	END IF
END IF
//表 8 输出-身份信息列表（节点标识：idetinfo）
//序号	参数代码	参数名称	参数类型	参数长度	代码标识	是否非空	说明
//1	psn_idet_type	人员身份类别	字符型	3	Y	Y	
//2	psn_type_lv	人员类别等级	字符型	3	Y		详见残疾等级字典
//3	memo	备注	字符型	500			
//4	begntime	开始时间	日期时间型			Y	
//5	endtime	结束时间	日期时间型				

ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'idetinfo')
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_sfxx[ll_row].psn_idet_type = This.uf_getstring_in( 'psn_idet_type',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_sfxx[ll_row].psn_type_lv = This.uf_getstring_in( 'psn_type_lv',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_sfxx[ll_row].memo = This.uf_getstring_in( 'memo',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_sfxx[ll_row].begntime = This.uf_getdatetime_in( 'begntime',ll_row)
		astr_yb_grjbxx.str_zhyl_sfxx[ll_row].endtime = This.uf_getdatetime_in( 'endtime',ll_row)
	NEXT
END IF


end subroutine

public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlx, ref string as_zzddm, ref string as_zzdmc, ref string as_zdms, ref string asarr_zddms[], ref string asarr_zdmcs[], ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_zy_zdxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取住院病人诊断信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh         住院号 	
// 	value    	integer	ai_zdlx        诊断类型：1-住院诊断，2-出院诊断
// 	reference	string	as_zzddm     	主诊断代码
// 	reference	string	as_zzdmc     	主诊断名称
// 	reference	string	as_zdms      	病情描述
// 	reference	string	asarr_zddms[]  疾病代码列表
// 	reference	string	asarr_zdmcs[]	疾病名称列表
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//         -1-失败；1-成功
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.17    28271  获取住院病人诊断信息
//====================================================================
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create u_datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

// 检索数据，并根据ai_zdlx过滤诊断类型
IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "ZDLB asc,PXXH ASC")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF
String ls_zdlb_filter
IF ai_zdlx=1 Then
	Select to_char(wm_concat(dmsb)) into :ls_zdlb_filter From XTGL.GY_DMZD Where dmlb=22 and dmsb>0 and dmmc like '%入院%' Using sqlca;
	IF sqlca.sqlcode<>0 THen
		as_error = "获取入院诊断类别失败：["+String(sqlca.sqlCode)+"]" + sqlca.sqlErrText
		return -1
	END IF
	IF isnull(ls_zdlb_filter) or Trim(ls_zdlb_filter)="" THen
		ls_zdlb_filter = "2,9,10,11"
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_zdlx=2 Then
	Select to_char(wm_concat(dmsb)) into :ls_zdlb_filter From XTGL.GY_DMZD Where dmlb=22 and dmsb>0 and dmmc like '%出院%' Using sqlca;
	IF sqlca.sqlcode<>0 THen
		as_error = "获取出院诊断类别失败：["+String(sqlca.sqlCode)+"]" + sqlca.sqlErrText
		return -1
	END IF
	IF isnull(ls_zdlb_filter) or Trim(ls_zdlb_filter)="" THen
		ls_zdlb_filter = "3,4,15,16,19,20"
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = '出入院诊断类型传入有误：' + String(ai_zdlx)
	return -1
END IF
ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter(" (zdlb in("+ls_zdlb_filter+")) ")
ids_zy_ryzd.filter()
// 获取诊断数据
Long ll_row, ll_rowCount, ll_zds
ll_rowCount = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
if ii_zymz = 1 and ll_rowCount = 0 then
	ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter("")
	ids_zy_ryzd.filter()
	ll_rowCount = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
end if

ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "ZDLB asc,PXXH ASC")
ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
IF ll_rowCount=0 Then
	IF ai_zdlx=1 Then
		as_error = "入院诊断未填写，请联系医生填写！"
		return -1
	ELSE
//		as_error = "出院诊断未填写，请联系医生填写！"
//		return -1
//		ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter("")
//		ids_zy_ryzd.filter()
		ls_zdlb_filter = "2,9,10,11"
		ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter(" (zdlb in("+ls_zdlb_filter+")) ")
		ids_zy_ryzd.filter()		
		ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "ZDLB asc,PXXH ASC")
		ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
		ll_rowCount = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
		IF ll_rowCount>0 Then
			IF ii_jbbd = 2 THEN
				as_zzddm = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[1]
			ELSEIF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
				as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
			ELSE
				as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
			END IF
			//	as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
			as_zzdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
			as_zdms = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
			IF isnull(as_zzddm) or Trim(as_zzddm)="" or as_zzddm="无" Then
				as_error = "【" + as_zzdmc + "】诊断编码未对照，请联系医保处对照！"
				return -1
			END IF
			
			For ll_zds=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
				IF ii_jbbd = 2 THEN
					asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[ll_zds]
				ELSEIF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
					asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_zds]))
				ELSE
					asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_zds]))
				END IF
				IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds] = ''
				asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
				as_zdms = as_zdms +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
				IF isnull(asArr_zddms[ll_zds]) or Trim(asArr_zddms[ll_zds])="" or asArr_zddms[ll_zds]="无" Then
					as_error = "【" + asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] + "】诊断编码未对照，请联系医保处对照！"
					return -1
				END IF
			Next
		END IF
	END IF
ELSEIF ll_rowCount>0 Then
	IF ii_jbbd = 2 THEN
		as_zzddm = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[1]
	ELSEIF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
		as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	ELSE
		as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	END IF
//	as_zzddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[1]))
	as_zzdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	as_zdms = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	IF isnull(as_zzddm) or Trim(as_zzddm)="" or as_zzddm="无" Then
		as_error = "【" + as_zzdmc + "】诊断编码未对照，请联系医保处对照！"
		return -1
	END IF
	
	For ll_zds=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
		IF ii_jbbd = 2 THEN
			asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[ll_zds]
		ELSEIF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
			asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_zds]))
		ELSE
			asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD', String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.code[ll_zds]))
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds] = ''
		asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
		as_zdms = as_zdms +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
		IF isnull(asArr_zddms[ll_zds]) or Trim(asArr_zddms[ll_zds])="" or asArr_zddms[ll_zds]="无" Then
			as_error = "【" + asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] + "】诊断编码未对照，请联系医保处对照！"
			return -1
		END IF
	Next
ELSE
	as_error = "出入院诊断数据窗口检索或过滤失败！请重进程序！"
	return -1
END IF

IF as_zzdmc = '' Or IsNull(as_zzdmc) THEN
	as_error = '主诊断名称为空！主诊断代码：' + String(as_zzddm)
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Lenw(as_zdms)>=1000 THEN
	as_zdms = of_midstring(as_zdms, 1000)
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_dzdmsb()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string 	as_table	
// 	value	string 	as_dmlb 	
// 	value	integer	ai_dmsb 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//====================================================================

IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+String(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function integer of_insert_bscfymx (long al_zyh, string as_jzid, ref string as_msg);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_insert_bscfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 插入医保不上传项目明细到费用明细上传表中
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long    	al_zyh   	
// 	value    	string  	as_jzid	
// 	reference	String  	as_msg   	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2021.12.31    27471  28141  28271  插入医保不上传项目明细到费用明细上传表中
//====================================================================
Long ll_row, ll_rowCOunt, ll_insert,ll_gbbj = 0,ll_ypcd
Dec{4} ldc_zfbl
ll_rowCOunt = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
String ls_YLJGMLBM
str_gbbj_tsmx lstr_gbbj_tsmx
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	lstr_gbbj_tsmx.tsywlsh = ''
	lstr_gbbj_tsmx.zyh = al_zyh
	lstr_gbbj_tsmx.JSCS = 0
	lstr_gbbj_tsmx.MXZDH = as_jzid
END IF
IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 And ll_rowCOunt > 0 THEN
	ids_ybfymx_zy.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_zy.Reset()
	
	FOR ll_row = ll_rowCOunt To 1 Step -1
		IF gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row], ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row], ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row], Ref as_msg) > 0 Or ids_zyfymx.Object.spbz[ll_row] = -9 THEN
			//干部保健
			IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
				IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN
					ll_ypcd = 0
					IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 0, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row], ldc_zfbl, as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
				ELSE
					ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
					IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 1, ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row], ldc_zfbl, as_msg) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
				END IF
				IF ldc_zfbl > 0 THEN
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = Round((ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]) * ldc_zfbl,2)
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf = lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf + ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
					ids_zyfymx.Object.spbz[ll_row] = 9
					ll_gbbj ++
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.tsywlsh = ''
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlx[ll_gbbj] = 'ZY'
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.YWLSH[ll_gbbj] = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.mxlsh[ll_gbbj] = ll_ypcd
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.xmxh[ll_gbbj] = ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.zfje[ll_gbbj] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
					lstr_gbbj_tsmx.zfbl[ll_gbbj] = ldc_zfbl
				END IF
			END IF
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_zy.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.JZID[ll_insert] = as_jzid // 就诊ID
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.zyh[ll_insert] = al_zyh // 住院号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY' // 业务类型：住院默认为'ZY'
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]) // 费用明细流水号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.YZXH[ll_row]) // 医嘱号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.JFRQ[ll_row] // 费用发生时间
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN
				ls_YLJGMLBM = "F" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + "#0"
			ELSE
				ls_YLJGMLBM = "Y" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]) + "#" + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row])
			END IF
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_YLJGMLBM // 医药机构目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] // 明细项目费用总额
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.FYSL[ll_row] // 数量
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ids_zyfymx.Object.FYDJ[ll_row] // 单价
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZTBZ[ll_insert] = 9 // 状态标志：不上传明细的状态标志为9
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.yyspbz[ll_insert] = '0'
			ids_zyfymx.DeleteRow(ll_row)
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ids_ybfymx_zy.Update() = 1 THEN
		IF ll_gbbj > 0 THEN
			This.of_insert_tsmx(lstr_gbbj_tsmx)
			IF ids_gbbjmx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			ELSE
				as_msg = '上传明细保存成功，干部托收保存失败ids_gbbjmx:' + ids_gbbjmx.is_error
				ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		as_msg = "不上传明细保存失败：" + ids_ybfymx_zy.is_error
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_cf (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_zy_fymx_cf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 材料超限拆分
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  材料超限拆分
//====================================================================

//复制u_ybjk_new_his.of_zy_fymx_cf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_fylj_cg, ldc_fylj_cl
Decimal{2} ldc_zflj_cq, ldc_zflj_cg, ldc_zflj_cl //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

idc_zgxe_cq = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CQDXLJZGXE", "30000", "分类编码为CQ的褼AT* 接貌牧系ハ罾奂谱罡呦薅 "))
idc_zgxe_cg = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CGDXLJZGXE", "20000", "分类编码为CG的医用材料单项累计最高限额"))
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then idc_zgxe_cl = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_CLLJZGXE", "40000", "分类编码为CL的医用材料累计最高限额"))    // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  获取CL材料最高限额

//Long ll_brxz, ll_tgdw
//SELECT brxz, tgdw Into :ll_brxz, :ll_tgdw From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using gtrans_temp_mssql;
//IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
//	as_error = "该病人礑AT*
牟伪Ｐ灾驶袢∈О堋
" //	RETURN -1 //END IF  //IF ll_brxz = 6024 And ll_tgdw = 3003 THEN
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_LXBRCWF", "55", "离休病人床位费记账金额")) //离休病人床位费记账55元
//ELSE
//	idc_zgxe_cwf = Double(gf_getpara(0, "YB_PTBRCWF", "45", "普通病人床位费记账金额")) //普通病人床位费记账45元
//END IF

//拆分CQ类医用材料费用。先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，单项累计最高限额为3万。
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cq_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的CQ类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CQ类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cq_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cq - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

	case "住院结算撤销"

	case "ind] = ldc_zflj_cg 				ELSE 					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje 					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
