					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cg = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl)  THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
						ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cg - ldc_fylj_cg) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cg = ldc_fylj_cg + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
						
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zjje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cg = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
						ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cg > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cg
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cg = ldc_zflj_cg + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cg_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cg
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cg.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cg = lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round((ldc_fylj_cg + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cg
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cg = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cg
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  拆分CL类医用材料费用
IF ii_YBCLCFQY=1 Then
	//拆分CL类医用材料费用。单价在200元以上的，先由参保人个人自理一定比例后，再按基本医疗保险规定支付，累计最高限额为4万。
	u_datastore lds_fymx_cl //未上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
	lds_fymx_cl = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymx_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cl_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新增BM字段
	lds_fymx_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	ll_count = lds_fymx_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)

	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl //已上传明细未结算的CL类的住院费用明细
		lds_fymxsc_cl = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_syd' //bm, fyje（CL类已累计的费用限额，(1-zfbl)*zjje）  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 新增BM字段，并对BM字段进行GroupBy
		lds_fymxsc_cl.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
		u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cl_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的、CG类的有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf = Create u_datastore
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_cl_tf_syd'  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  d_yb_zyfymx_cl 强制自费金额减去优惠金额
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
		lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
		
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ls_bm = lds_fymx_cl.Object.bm[ll_row]
			ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
			ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
			ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
			ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
			ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zjje[ll_row]
			ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
			li_spbz = lds_fymx_cl.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
			IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0         // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ldc_xelj = ldc_zjje * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)  
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
						ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
					END IF
					// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//					ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//					IF IsNull(ldc_fylj_cl) THEN
//						ldc_fylj_cl = 0
//						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
//					END IF
					IF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) < ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cl.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
//						ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fysl[ll_row]
//						ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cl.Object.fydj[ll_row]
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							ldc_cfje = (idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//							IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//							END IF
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
							ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
							IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cg.InsertRow( 0 )
								lds_fymxsc_cg.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
							END IF
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					ELSEIF Abs(idc_zgxe_cl - ldc_fylj_cl) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_fydj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
						ldc_fylj_cl = ldc_fylj_cl + ldc_xelj
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
					ELSE
						ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
						IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限强制自费'
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
							END IF
						ELSE
							as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
							RETURN -1
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
				IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
					ELSE
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zjje
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
				ELSE
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.RowCount() + 1)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ldc_zflj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ELSE
						ldc_zflj_cl = 0
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//						ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.InsertRow(0)
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
//						lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cl
					END IF
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						IF ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|限额控制,退费先自费'
							ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_zjje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zfje
							lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
						ELSE
							IF ldc_zflj_cl > 0.01 * ldc_fydj * ldc_zfbl THEN
								ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
								IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
									ls_bz = ''
								END IF
								lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
								
								ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cl
								ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//								IF ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl <> Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2) THEN  // 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  新增算法
//									ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 1)
//								END IF
								ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
								ldc_zflj_cl = ldc_zflj_cl + ldc_cfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
								lds_fymxsc_cl_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cl
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
								lds_fymx_cf.object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + string(ldc_jlxh)
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//								ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
//								lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
								lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计(1-zfbl)*zjje
								
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  修改后算法
								ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cl.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cl.RowCount() + 1)
								IF ll_find > 0 THEN
									ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find]
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cl
								ELSE
									ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cl.InsertRow(0)
									ldc_fylj_cl = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_zjje), 2)
									lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cl
								END IF
								// 2021.11.23  CJN  27374  原算法
//								ldc_fylj_cl = lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1]
//								ldc_fylj_cl = Round((ldc_fylj_cl + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje)), 2)
//								lds_fymxsc_cl.Object.fyje[1] = ldc_fylj_cl
							END IF
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF

//拆分床位费。床位费超过限额部分强制自费。普通病人记账45元，离休病人记账55元。离休配偶算在普通病人中。
//u_datastore lds_fymx_cwf
//lds_fymx_cwf = Create u_datastore
//lds_fymx_cwf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cwf'
//lds_fymx_cwf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
//ll_cwfmxnum = lds_fymx_cwf.Retrieve(al_zyh, idc_zgxe_cwf)
//IF ll_cwfmxnum > 0 THEN
//	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_cwfmxnum
//		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cwf.Object.zjje[ll_row]
//		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cwf.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
//		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cwf.Object.fysl[ll_row]
//		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cwf.Object.fydj[ll_row]
//		ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
//		IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
//			ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
//			IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
//				ls_bz = ''
//			END IF
//			lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
//			ldc_cfje = idc_zgxe_cwf
//			ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_fydj, 2)
//			ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //床位费限额部分记账，spbz = 0
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
//			
//			ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1) //床位费超过限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
//			lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = ls_bz + '|超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh)
//		ELSE
//			as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
//			RETURN -1
//		END IF
//		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_cwfmxnum),Integer(ll_row /ll_cwfmxnum * 100))
//	NEXT
//END IF

gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF lds_fymx_cf.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	as_error = "住院费用明细zy_fymx保存失败。" + lds_fymx_cf.is_error
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_fycxcf (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_zy_fymx_fycxcf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 费用超限拆分
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  费用超限拆分
//====================================================================

//wangyi 20200820 指定费用超限拆分of_zy_fymx_fycxcf
String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl, ldc_fyxe, ldc_yhje, ldc_yhdj, ldc_yhcfje
Decimal{4} ldc_fydj
Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_zflj_cq //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_row, ll_find, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

//拆分限额超限费用。限额设置取自GY_YLSF_KZ.zycxzfxe
u_datastore lds_fymx_cq //未上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
lds_fymx_cq = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_fycxcf_syd' //jlxh, fyxh, fysl, fydj, zjje, spbz, bm, zfbl0, fyxe。按照jfrq的日期，spbz（9->8->0），jlxh排序
lds_fymx_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
ll_count = lds_fymx_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)

IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq //已上传明细未结算的限额控制住院费用明细
	lds_fymxsc_cq = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_syd' //bm, fyje（该bm已累计的费用限禗AT*
(1-zfbl)*zjje）
	lds_fymxsc_cq.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	u_datastore lds_fymxsc_cq_tf //已上传明细的、未结算的、spbz = 9的限额控制费用有退过费的住院费用金额累计。fyxh, qzzfje
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf = Create u_datastore
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymxsc_fycxcf_tf_syd'
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.SetTransObject(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
	
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ldc_fyxe = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxe[ll_row]
		ls_bm = lds_fymx_cq.Object.bm[ll_row]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fyxh[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fysl[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = lds_fymx_cq.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zjje[ll_row]
		ldc_zfbl = lds_fymx_cq.Object.zfbl0[ll_row]
		li_spbz = lds_fymx_cq.Object.spbz[ll_row] //审批标志
		ldc_yhje = lds_fymx_cq.Object.yhje[ll_row]
		ldc_yhdj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) / ldc_fysl //计算加上优惠金额
		IF ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN //总计金额为正。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ldc_xelj = (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje) * (1 - ldc_zfbl)
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN //已上传的费用已有该bm的限额累计金额
					ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_fylj_cq = 0
				END IF
				IF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) And Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) < ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //加上该笔费用超过最高限额，对这笔费用进行拆分
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
						ldc_cfje = (ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq)/(1 - ldc_zfbl)
						ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
						ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje //未超过最高限额部分记账，spbz = 0
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0
//						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_cfje
						ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * ldc_yhcfje
						IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
							lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
						END IF
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq //记账部分限额累计
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh //超过最高限额部分强制自费，spbz = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				ELSEIF Abs(ldc_fyxe - ldc_fylj_cq) >= ldc_fysl * ldc_yhdj * (1 - ldc_zfbl) THEN //没有超过最高限额，对限额进行累计
					ldc_fylj_cq = ldc_fylj_cq + ldc_xelj
					IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow( 0 )
						lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.bm[ll_find] = ls_bm
					END IF
					lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
				ELSE
					ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
					IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限强制自费', 100)
						
						//自费部分累计金额
						ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
						ELSE
							ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje
						END IF
					ELSE
						as_error = "找不到需要拆分的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
						RETURN -1
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE //总计金额为负。spbz <> 9时，先计算这笔之前强制自费累计金额，够的部分自费，不够的部分自动。
			IF li_spbz = 9 THEN //强制自费，累计该bm的zjje
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
					ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_insert] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_insert] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
			ELSE
				ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Find( "fyxh = " + String(ll_fyxh), 1, lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.RowCount() + 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ldc_zflj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find]
				ELSE
					ldc_zflj_cq = 0
					ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.InsertRow(0)
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.fyxh[ll_find] = ll_fyxh
					lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
				END IF
				ll_findmx = lds_fymx_cf.Find("jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh), 1, lds_fymx_cf.RowCount())
				IF ll_findmx > 0 THEN
					IF ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje >= 0 THEN
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用限额控制,退费先自费', 100)
						ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的zjje
						lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
					ELSE
						IF ldc_zflj_cq > 0.01 * ldc_yhdj * ldc_zfbl THEN
							ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx]
							IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
								ls_bz = ''
							END IF
							lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(ll_findmx, ll_findmx, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, ll_findmx + 1, Primary!)
							
							ldc_cfje = 0 - ldc_zflj_cq
							ldc_cfsl = Truncate(ldc_cfje / ldc_yhdj, 2)
							ldc_cfje = Round(ldc_fydj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							ldc_yhcfje = Round(ldc_yhdj * ldc_cfsl, 2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx] = ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 9
							ldc_zflj_cq = ldc_zflj_cq + ldc_yhcfje //强制自费，累计该fyxh的拆分金额
							lds_fymxsc_cq_tf.Object.qzzfje[ll_find] = ldc_zflj_cq
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(gtrans_temp_mssql, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_jlxh
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_zjje - ldc_cfje
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.fysl[ll_findmx + 1] = ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx + 1] = 0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.yhje[ll_findmx + 1] = Round(ldc_yhje / ldc_fysl * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl),2)
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[ll_findmx] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + '|指定限额费用超限拆分,关联jlxh:' + String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_fysl - ldc_cfsl) * ldc_yhdj), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
						ELSE //强制自费累计金额为0
							lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[ll_findmx] = 0 //spbz = 0 的部分累计该bm的(1-zfbl)*zjje
							
							ll_find = lds_fymxsc_cq.Find( "bm = '" + ls_bm + "'", 1, lds_fymxsc_cq.RowCount() + 1)
							IF ll_find > 0 THEN
								ldc_fylj_cq = lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find]
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round((ldc_fylj_cq + (1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_find] = ldc_fylj_cq
							ELSE
								ll_insert = lds_fymxsc_cq.InsertRow(0)
								ldc_fylj_cq = Round(((1 - ldc_zfbl) * (ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje)), 2)
								lds_fymxsc_cq.Object.fyje[ll_insert] = ldc_fylj_cq
							END IF
							
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = "誅AT* 也坏叫枰�强制自费的住院费用明细。jlxh = " + String(ldc_jlxh)
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		gf_waiting('正在拆分费用明细...' + String(ll_row) + '/' + String(ll_count),Integer(ll_row /ll_count * 100))
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
IF lds_fymx_cf.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
	as_error = "住院费用明细zy_fymx保存失败。" + lds_fymx_cf.is_error
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(gtrans_temp_mssql)
END IF

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_sc (long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_zy_fymx_sc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院费用明细上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	        	long    	al_zyh  	
// 	        	integer 	ai_jscs 	
// 	        	datetime	adt_zzrq	
// 	ref     	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  住院费用明细上传（实际上传接口）

	GOTO Error

	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE

	END IF
END IF

IF Date(adt_zzrq) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	SetNull(adt_zzrq)

IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	
RETURN  -1

// 检索需要上传的费用明细数据

		ids_zyfymx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)

	END IF
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
ids_zyfymx.SetFilter("")
ids_zyfymx.Filter()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh, ai_jscs, adt_zzrq, li_yepb)
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_error = "检索费用明细失败：" + ids_zyfymx.is_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
//ii_mxts = 1
String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_gerenbh // 个人编号

String ls_fymxlsh, ls_yfylsh // 费用明细流水号、原费用流水号

END IF

// 获取 开单科室编码、开单科室名称
//ls_kdksbm = String(ll_brks)

	// 苍南、平阳、台州由于妇科产科病人混住，所以必须根据准生证号是否维护来判断是否属于生育住院

str_gbbj_tsmx lstr_gbbj_tsmx,lstr_gbbj_null
Long ll_gbbj

	IF This.uf_gbbj_ini( as_error) < 0 THEN GOTO Error

// 初始化zhyb_fymxsc表 20230904转移到——ZY表
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_zy) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_zy = Create u_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_zy.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)

		ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_zyhis'
	ELSE
		ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_his'
	END IF
ELSE
	If (ii_zyqy_qy = 1 Or ii_zyqy_br = 1) And ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject <> 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_zyhis' THEN
		ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_zyhis'
	ELSEIF ii_zyqy_br = 0 And ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject <> 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_his' THEN
		ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_his'
	END IF
END IF
ids_ybfymx_zy.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)

// 2021.12.31  CJN  27471  优先将医保不上传费用插入zhyb_fymxsc表中
IF This.of_insert_bscfymx( al_zyh, ls_jzid, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
ids_ybfymx_zy.Reset()
ids_zyfymx.RowsDiscard(1, ids_zyfymx.DeletedCount(), DELETE!) // 无视本次删除的数据，避免因为update()而导致数据库里数据被删除
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_error = ids_zyfymx.is_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF  ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF
// 由于智慧医保在未成功上传收费明细的前提下，不能上传退费明细，因此需要先将所有收费明细进行上传
ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl>=0) ")
ids_zyfymx.Filter()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl<0) ")
	ids_zyfymx.Filter()
	ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		lb_uploadTFMX = True
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF
//HW 2023/08/11 测试 增加苯丙酮尿症 诊断判断
//String ls_zdmc
//Long ll_index
//SELECT to_char(wm_concat(a.zdmc)),count(1) INTO :ls_zdmc,:ll_index FROM  ZY_RYZD a ,GY_XTCS_N B 
//				WHERE B.XTSB=79 AND B.CSMC='BBTNZZD' AND a.ZYH = :al_zyh And a.zdlb  In (2,9,10,11) AND A.ZDXH = B.CSDM Using itran_sqlca;
//************************************************************************//
// 开始明细上传
DO
	IF lb_uploadTFMX THEN

			This.uf_send_add_in('dscg_tkdrug_flag', '0', ll_add_row) // 出院带药标志
			This.uf_send_add_in('matn_fee_flag', ls_SYFYBZ, ll_add_row) // 生育费用标志
			This.uf_send_add_in('memo', ls_memo, ll_add_row) // 备注
			This.uf_send_add_in('comb_no', '', ll_add_row) // 组套编号
			This.uf_send_add_in('exp_content', ls_expContent, ll_add_row) // 字段扩展
			
			// 获取 自负比例，并计算自理金额
			ldc_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
			IF IsNull(ldc_zfbl) THEN ldc_zfbl = 1.0000
			IF ldc_zfbl <> 1 THEN
				ldc_zfje = 0.00
				ldc_zlje = ldc_zjje * ldc_zfbl
			ELSE
				ldc_zfje = ldc_zjje
				ldc_zlje = 0.00
			END IF
			ldc_hjzf = ldc_zfje + ldc_zlje
			
			// 插入费用明细上传表
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_zy.InsertRow(0)
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.JZID[ll_insert] = ls_jzid // 就诊ID
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh // 住院号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY' // 业务类型：住院默认为'ZY'
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = ls_fymxlsh // 费用明细流水号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = ls_yfylsh // 原费用流水号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = ls_yzh // 医嘱号
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = ldt_fyfssj // 费用发生时间
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_ylmlbm // 医疗目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_yljgmlbm // 医药机构目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje // 明细项目费用总额
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YYSPBZ[ll_insert] = ls_YYSPBZ // 医院审批标志
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SYFYBZ[ll_insert] = ls_SYFYBZ // 生育费用标志
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = ls_memo // 备注（耗材需要在memo字段上传省码）
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZTBZ[ll_insert] = 0 // 状态标志
			ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.EXPCONT[ll_insert] = string(ldc_yzzh) //医嘱组号
			ll_row++
		LOOP
		gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
		
		
		
		// 发送报文
		IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error, "") THEN
			IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			ll_Retcount = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'result')
			IF ll_Retcount < 0 THEN
				as_error = "【医保端】住院明细上传成功，但获取医保返回内容为空，请联系信息科处理。住院号码：" + ls_zyhm
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			FOR ll_ret = 1 To ll_Retcount Step 1
				
				ls_feedetl_sn = uf_getstring_in("feedetl_sn", ll_ret) // 费用明细流水号
				
				ll_find_sc = ids_ybfymx_zy.Find("YWLSH='" + ls_feedetl_sn + "'",1,999999)
				IF ll_find_sc > 0 THEN
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.DJSXJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("pric_uplmt_amt", ll_ret) // 定价上限金额
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("selfpay_prop", ll_ret) // 自付比例
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.QZFJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("fulamt_ownpay_amt", ll_ret) // 全自费金额
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.CXJJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("overlmt_amt", ll_ret) // 超限价金额
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XXZFUJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("preselfpay_amt", ll_ret) // 先行自付金额
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FHZCFWJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("inscp_scp_amt", ll_ret) // 符合政策范围金额
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chrgitm_lv", ll_ret) // 收费项目等级
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLSFXMLB[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("med_chrgitm_type", ll_ret) // 医疗收费项目类别
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.JBYWBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("bas_medn_flag", ll_ret) // 基本药物标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YBTPYPBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("hi_nego_drug_flag", ll_ret) // 医保谈判药品标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ETYYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chld_medc_flag", ll_ret) // 儿童用药标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.MLTXBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("list_sp_item_flag", ll_ret) // 目录特项标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XZSYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("lmt_used_flag", ll_ret) // 限制使用标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZBBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("drt_reim_flag", ll_ret) // 直报标志
					ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] + ' R:' + uf_getstring_in("memo", ll_ret) // 备注					
					// 回写 zy_fymx 的 zfje 和 zfbl
					ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find("JLXH="+ls_feedetl_sn+"", 1, 999999)
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.QZFJE[ll_find_sc] + ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.CXJJE[ll_find_sc] + ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XXZFUJE[ll_find_sc] // 全自费金额+超限价金额+先行自付金额 → 自付金额
						ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] // 自付比例   → 自付比例
					END IF
				ELSE
					as_error = "【医保端】住院明细上传成功，但获取医保返回费用明细流水号在上传表中找不到，请联系信息科处理。住院号码：" + ls_zyhm + " 费用明细流水号：" + ls_feedetl_sn
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			NEXT
			IF ids_ybfymx_zy.Update() = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1 THEN
				COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
				IF ll_gbbj > 0 THEN
					This.of_insert_tsmx(lstr_gbbj_tsmx)
					IF ids_gbbjmx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
						COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
					ELSE
						as_error = '上传明细保存成功，干部托收保存失败ids_gbbjmx:' + ids_gbbjmx.is_error
						ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
						GOTO Error
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE
				as_error = "【医保端】住院明细上传成功，但更新本地费用表失败：费用明细上传表ids_ybfymx_zy:["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + ids_ybfymx_zy.is_error + " 住院费用明细表ids_zyfymx:["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" +ids_zyfymx.is_error
				ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		END IF
	LOOP
	
	
	// 查看还有没有剩余的负明细需要上传（能否跳出循环，完全取决于该步骤）
	IF lb_uploadTFMX = True THEN
		EXIT
	ELSE
		ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl<0) ")
		ids_zyfymx.Filter()
		ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
		IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
			lb_uploadTFMX = True
		ELSE
			EXIT
		END IF
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE True

RETURN 1

Error:
as_error = "[2301-住院费用明细上传]出错：" + as_error
gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)

RETURN -1





end functionistr_yb_zhxx

public function integer uf_zy_crycx (integer ai_cxlx, long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_crycx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 出入院撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer	ai_cxlx  1-入院撤销；2-出院撤销
// 	value    	long   	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  出入院撤销
//====================================================================

IF ai_cxlx <> 1 And ai_cxlx <> 2 THEN
	as_error = "撤销类型有误：" + String(ai_cxlx)
	GOTO Error
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 入院撤销之前做一次明细撤销
IF ai_cxlx = 1 THEN
	This.uf_zy_delfymx( al_zyh, '0000', Ref as_error)
END IF

String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_grbh // 人员编号
String ls_expContent ,ls_cbdybqh

// 获取住院基本信息
SELECT YBJZBH Into :ls_jzid From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应病人的医保就诊ID：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
	as_error = "医保就诊ID为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 人员编号
SELECT GRBH,CBDYBQH Into :ls_grbh,:ls_cbdybqh From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_jzid Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应病人的入院登记信螪AT* " + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = "个人编号为空，请重新读卡！"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
	ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	
	IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
		as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 籇AT*
 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF ai_cxlx = 1 THEN
	This.uf_send_init('2404')
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('2405')
END IF
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号

IF ai_cxlx = 2 THEN
	This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展（仅出院撤销）
END IF
// 更新 医保电子凭证使用次数
//	IF ls_jzpzlx='1' THEN
//		gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca, istr_yb_zhxx.str_yb_grjbxx.sfzh ,istr_yb_zhxx.str_yb_grjbxx.cbdxzqh, ls_dzpzlp)
//	END IF
// 发送报文
IF Not uf_send(Ref as_error, '') = True THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
long ll_count

// 成功后回写HIS
IF ai_cxlx = 1 THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error  = "【医保端】入院撤销成功，但更新住院登记明细失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	select count(1) into :ll_count from JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC  Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	if ll_count > 0 then
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	end if
	IF ii_zyqy_qy > 0 THEN 
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
//	DELETE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_cxlx = 2 THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 2 Using itran_sqlca;
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error  = "【医保端】出院撤销成功，但更新住院登记明细失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
RETURN 1

Error:
IF ai_cxlx = 1 THEN
	as_error = "[2404-入院撤销]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF ai_cxlx = 2 THEN
	as_error = "[2405-出院撤销]出错：" + as_error
ELSE
	as_error = "[出入院撤销]出错：" + as_error
END IF
RETURN -1

end function

public function integer uf_zy_cybl (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_cybl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 出院办理
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  出院办理
//====================================================================

IF IsNull(al_zyh) Or al_zyh = 0 THEN
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
if THIS.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 then
	as_error = is_error
	GOTO Error	
end if
//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_grbh // 个人编号
String ls_xzlx // 险种类型
DateTime ldt_bqcysj // 出院时间
String ls_bzbm, ls_bzmc, ls_ssczdm, ls_ssczmc // 病种编码、病种名称、手术操作代码、手术操作名称
String ls_jhsyfwzh, ls_sylb, ls_jhsysslb, ls_wybz, ls_zcbz, ls_yzs, ls_tc, ls_tes // 生育类别、计划生育手术类别、晚育标志、早产标志、孕周数、胎次、胎儿数
DateTime ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ // 计划生育手术或生育日期
String ls_bybfzbz = '0' // 伴有并发症标志：0-否，1-是
String ls_cyksbm, ls_cyksmc,ls_ybksbm // 出院科室编码、出院科室名称
String ls_lyfs = '1' // 离院方式：1-医嘱离院、2-医嘱转院、3-医嘱转社区卫生服务机构/乡镇卫生院、4-非医嘱离院、5-非医嘱离院、9-其他
String ls_expContent // 字段扩展

Long ll_cyfs,ll_cur, ll_upperBound
String ls_brch, ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_zzyssfzh, ls_CBDYBQH,ls_ysgjbm
String ls_zzddm, ls_zzdmc, ls_cyzdms,ls_yllb,ls_yllb_js
String lsArr_zddms[], lsArr_zdmcs[]
DateTime ldt_maxJFRQ
integer li_jslb
// 获取住院基本信息
SELECT   YBJZBH,       BRKS,      BQCYSJ,     BRCH,     CYFS,     ZZYS
	INTO :ls_jzid, :ls_cyksbm, :ldt_bqcysj, :ls_brch, :ll_cyfs, :ls_ysbm
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人基本信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_bqcysj) THEN ldt_bqcysj = gf_Server_Date()
IF IsNull(ls_brch) THEN ls_brch = ''
IF IsNull(ll_cyfs) THEN ll_cyfs = 0
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = '医保就诊ID为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cyksbm) Or Trim(ls_cyksbm) = '' THEN
	as_error = '出院科室编码为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ysbm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm) = '' THEN
	as_error = "主治医生编码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 zy_fymx 中最大的jfrq（未考虑中结）。 如果zy_fymx.jfrq和zy_brry_kz.bqcysj同天且时间比出院时间迟，则使用最大的jfrq作为出院时间
SELECT Max(jfrq) INTO :ldt_maxJFRQ
	FROM BQXT.ZY_FYMX
	WHERE ZYH = :al_zyh AND jscs = 0
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ldt_maxJFRQ) THEN ldt_maxJFRQ = ldt_bqcysj
IF Date(ldt_maxJFRQ) = Date(ldt_bqcysj) And transaction
创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:
as_zydjjylsh
找不到对应的病人信息:
ldt_maxJFRQ > ldt_bqcysj THEN
	ldt_bqcysj = ldt_maxJFRQ
END IF

// 获取 参保地医保区划、险种类型、个人编号、病种编码、手术操作代码、生育类别、计划生育服务证号、计划生育手术类别、晚育标志、孕周数、胎次、胎儿数、早产标志、计划生育手术或生育日期
SELECT     CBDYBQH,     XZLX,     GRBH,     BZBM,     SSCZDM,     sylb,     JHSYFWZH,     JHSYSSLB,     WYBZ,     YZS,     TC,     TES,     ZCBZ,      JHSYSSSYRQ,yllb
	INTO :ls_CBDYBQH, :ls_xzlx, :ls_grbh, :ls_bzbm, :ls_ssczdm, :ls_sylb, :ls_jhsyfwzh, :ls_jhsysslb, :ls_wybz, :ls_yzs, :ls_tc, :ls_tes, :ls_zcbz, :ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ,:ls_yllb
	FROM JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND ZYH = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人登记信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF IsNull(ls_xzlx) Or ls_xzlx = "" THEN
	as_error = "险种类型为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or ls_grbh = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or ls_grbh = "" THEN
		as_error = "个人编号为空，请重新读卡！"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_CBDYBQH) Or Trim(ls_CBDYBQH) = "" THEN
	ls_CBDYBQH = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	
	IF IsNull(ls_CBDYBQH) Or Trim(ls_CBDYBQH) = "" THEN
		as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_xzlx) THEN ls_bzbm = ""
IF IsNull(ls_ssczdm) THEN ls_ssczdm = ""
IF IsNull(ls_jhsyfwzh) THEN ls_jhsyfwzh = ""
IF IsNull(ls_sylb) THEN ls_sylb = ""
IF IsNull(ls_jhsysslb) THEN ls_jhsysslb = ""
IF IsNull(ls_wybz) THEN ls_wybz = ""
IF IsNull(ls_zcbz) THEN ls_zcbz = ""

IF IsNull(ls_tc) THEN ls_tc = ""

IF IsNull(ls_zcbz) THEN ls_zcbz = ""

//如果选择结算类别的 > 0，医保登记和实际的结算类别是否一致

	GOTO Error

	IF li_jslb > 0 THEN
		SELECT BZBM Into :ls_yllb_js From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = 5883 And dmsb = :li_jslb Using itran_sqlca;
		//hw 2023/08/04
		IF ls_yllb_js = "22" THEN  
			ls_yllb_js = "21"
			ls_expContent = "22"
		END IF

			as_error = "病人医保登记的医疗类别和选择的结算类别对应的医疗类别不一致：" + ls_yllb + '---' + ls_yllb_js
			GOTO Error
		end if

		as_error = "病人医保登记的医疗类别为“新冠住院”和选择的结算类别不一致，请核对。" 
		GOTO Error 
	ELSEIF ls_yllb = '52' THEN 
		if Integer(ls_tes) <= 0 then //HW 2023/10/05
			SELECT to_char(COUNT(1)) INTO :ls_tes FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY WHERE ZYH = :al_zyh USING itran_sqlca;
		end if
	END IF
END IF

// 获取 病种名称
//ls_bzmc

//ls_ssczmc

// ls_bybfzbz

	as_error = ls_ysgjbm
	RETURN -1

			RETURN -1

		ls_ysbm = ls_ysgjbm
	END IF
END IF

// 获取 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF


This.uf_send_init('2402')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致

ELSE

ll_upperBound = UpperBound(lsArr_zddms)

		This.uf_send_add_in('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid, ll_cur) // 就诊ID
		This.uf_send_add_in('psn_no', ls_grbh, ll_cur) // 人员编号

			This.uf_send_add_in('maindiag_flag', '1', ll_cur) // 主诊断标志：'0'-否；'1'-是
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add_in('maindiag_flag', '0', ll_cur)
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_srt_no', String(ll_cur), ll_cur) // 诊断排序号
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_code', lsArr_zddms[ll_cur], ll_cur) // 诊断代码

public function integer uf_zy_ryxxbg (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_ryxxbg()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 入院信息变更
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  入院信息变更
//====================================================================

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_grbh // 人员编号
String ls_lxrxm, ls_lxdh // 联系人姓名、联系电话
DateTime ldt_kssj, ldt_jssj // 开始时间、结束时间
String ls_jzpzlx // 就诊凭证类型
String ls_yllb,ls_yllb_y,ls_bzxx // 医疗类别：默认为21-普通住院
String ls_zyhm // 住院号
String ls_blhm // 病历号
String ls_brch // 入院床位
String ls_zzysbm, ls_zzysxm  ,ls_ysbm_gjm // 主治医生编码、主诊医生姓名
String ls_zzddm, ls_zzdmc, ls_ryzdms // 住院主诊断代码、住院主诊断名称、入院诊断描述
String ls_ryksbm, ls_ryksmc // 入院科室编码、入院科室名称
String ls_bzbm, ls_bzmc, ls_ssczdm, ls_ssczmc // 病种编码、病种名称、手术睤AT*
僮鞔�码、手术操作名�

String ls_jhsyfwzh // 计划生育服务证号
String ls_sylb, ls_jhsysslb, ls_wybz, ls_zcbz // 生育类别、计划生育手术类别、晚育标志、早产标志
String ls_yzs, ls_tc, ls_tes // 孕周数、胎次、胎儿数
DateTime ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ // 计划生育手术或生育日期
String ls_bzlx // 病种类型
String ls_expContent // 字段扩展
Date ld_jhsysssyrq

Long ll_count
String ls_zzyssfzh, ls_jtdh, ls_cbdybqh, ls_brbq, ls_dmmc
String lsArr_zddms[], lsArr_zdmcs[]
Long ll_cur, ll_upperBound
Integer li_jslb
// 获取 住院基本信息
SELECT   YBJZBH,       BRKS,    BQRYSJ,     BRCH,      lxrm,     lxdh,     jtdh,     bahm,       zzys,    BQCYSJ,     BRBQ
	INTO :ls_jzid, :ls_ryksbm, :ldt_kssj, :ls_brch, :ls_lxrxm, :ls_lxdh, :ls_jtdh, :ls_blhm, :ls_zzysbm, :ldt_jssj, :ls_brbq
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人基本信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_jssj) THEN ldt_jssj =  gf_Server_Date()
IF IsNull(ls_lxrxm) THEN ls_lxrxm = ''
IF IsNull(ls_blhm) THEN ls_blhm = ''
IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) Or Trim(ls_lxdh) = '' THEN
	ls_lxdh = ls_jtdh
	IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) THEN ls_lxdh = ''
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_kssj) Or Date(ldt_kssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	as_error = '病区入院时间为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
	as_error = '医保就诊ID为空，请确认病人是否正确医保登记！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_zzysbm) Or Trim(ls_zzysbm) = "" THEN
	as_error = '主治医生编码为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ryksbm) Or Trim(ls_ryksbm) = "" THEN
	as_error = "入院科室编码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_brch) Or Trim(ls_brch) = "" THEN
	as_error = "床位号码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF


// 获取 住院登记信息
SELECT     CBDYBQH,     GRBH,     JZPZLX,   DJZYHM,     BZBM,     SSCZDM,     JHSYFWZH,    SYLB,   JHSYSSLB,    WYBZ,    ZCBZ,   YZS,   TC,   TES,   JHSYSSSYRQ,     BZLX,yllb,BZXX
	INTO :ls_cbdybqh, :ls_grbh, :ls_jzpzlx, :ls_zyhm, :ls_bzbm, :ls_ssczdm, :ls_jhsyfwzh, :ls_sylb, :ls_jhsysslb, :ls_wybz, :ls_zcbz, :ls_yzs, :ls_tc, :ls_tes, :ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ, :ls_bzlx,:ls_yllb_y,:ls_bzxx
	FROM JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND zyh = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人住院登记信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = '人员编号为空，请重新刷卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzpzlx) Or Trim(ls_jzpzlx) = '' THEN
	ls_jzpzlx = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JZPZLX
	IF IsNull(ls_jzpzlx) THEN ls_jzpzlx = '02'
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = '' THEN
	ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBdxzqhdm
	
	IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
		as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_bzbm) THEN ls_bzbm = ""
IF IsNull(ls_ssczdm) THEN ls_ssczdm = ""
IF IsNull(ls_jhsyfwzh) THEN ls_jhsyfwzh = ""
IF IsNull(ls_sylb) THEN ls_sylb = ""
IF IsNull(ls_jhsysslb) THEN ls_jhsysslb = ""
IF IsNull(ls_wybz) THEN ls_wybz = ""
IF IsNull(ls_zcbz) THEN ls_zcbz = ""
IF IsNull(ls_yzs) THEN ls_yzs = ""
IF IsNull(ls_tc) THEN ls_tc = ""
IF IsNull(ls_tes) THEN ls_tes = ""
IF IsNull(ls_bzlx) THEN ls_bzlx = ""
IF IsNull(ls_zyhm) THEN ls_zyhm = ""
IF IsNull(ls_bzxx) THEN ls_bzxx = ""
ls_yllb = ''
//如果选择结算类别的 > 0，以这个为准（优先级最高）
SELECT jslb Into :li_jslb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取医保结算医疗类别：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
ELSE
	IF li_jslb > 0 THEN
		SELECT BZBM Into :ls_yllb From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = 5883 And dmsb = :li_jslb Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
// 获取 医疗类别：21-普通住院，52-职工生育住院，71-家庭病床，9933-虳AT*

IF ls_yllb > '' THEN
ELSE
	ls_yllb = '21'
	// 获取 医疗类别：21-普通住院，52-职工生育住院，71-家庭病床，9933-透析治疗
	If (Pos(is_fcbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 And ls_yllb <> '52') THEN // 生育住院
		// 苍南、平阳、台州由于妇科产科病人混住，所以必须根据分娩方式是否维护来判断是否属于生育住院
		IF Pos(base_info.Hospital,'苍南') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'平阳') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'台州') > 0 THEN
			SELECT nvl(FMFS,'') Into :ls_sylb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = "获取分娩方式失败：["+String(itran_sqlca)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			IF ls_sylb > '0' THEN
				ls_yllb = '52'
			ELSE
				ls_sylb = ''
			END IF
			
			// 如果是保胎，则走普通住院
			SELECT dmmc Into :ls_dmmc From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = '2635' And dmsb = :ls_sylb Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And ls_dmmc > '' THEN
				IF Pos(ls_dmmc, "保胎") > 0 THEN
					ls_sylb = ''
					ls_yllb = '21'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			// 如果根据分娩方式找不到，则根据准生证号再判断一次
			IF ls_yllb <> '52' THEN
				SELECT Count(*) Into :ll_count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
				IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And ll_count > 0 THEN
					ls_yllb = '52'
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			//			ls_yllb = '52' //hw 2023/06/02 注释
			//hw 2023/06/02 增加本院生育登记
			SELECT nvl(FMFS,'') Into :ls_sylb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = "获取分娩方式失败：["+String(itran_sqlca)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			IF ls_sylb > '0' THEN
				ls_yllb = '52'
			ELSE
				ls_sylb = ''
			END IF
			
			// 如果是保胎，则走普通住院
			SELECT dmmc Into :ls_dmmc From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = '2635' And dmsb = :ls_sylb Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And ls_dmmc > '' THEN
				IF Pos(ls_dmmc, "保胎") > 0 THEN
					ls_sylb = ''
					ls_yllb = '21'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			// 如果根据分娩方式找不到，则根据准生证号再判断一次
			IF ls_yllb <> '52' THEN
				SELECT Count(1) Into :ll_count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
				IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And ll_count > 0 THEN
					ls_yllb = '52'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		
		//	IF ls_yllb='52' Then
		//		ls_ylrylb = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_type  	
		//		IF Pos(ls_ylrylb, '14')=1 or Pos(ls_ylrylb, '15')=1 or Pos(ls_ylrylb, '16')=1 Then  // 居民的生育医疗类别为2106
		//			ls_yllb = '2106'
		//		END IF
		//	END IF
		
		// 温州的生育按项目结算，医疗类别不能传入52-生育住院，而是直接使用21-普通住院
		IF ii_zhyb_sybxtscl = 1 THEN
			ls_sylb = ''
			ls_yllb = '21'
		END IF
	ELSEIF Pos(is_xtbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 And Left(ls_cbdybqh,4) = '3303' THEN // 血透病区
		ls_yllb = '9933'
	ELSEIF Pos(is_lgks, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 THEN // 留观病区
		IF ii_jzlgms = 1 and date(ldt_kssj) > id_jzqyrq THEN //急诊留观走门诊还是住院 modify by sxl 2024.06.25
			as_error = '急诊留观应走门诊结算，登记有误，请联系信息中心!'
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			ls_yllb = '210104'
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN ls_yllb = '21'
IF ii_jzlgms = 1 And  ls_yllb = '21' and  date(ldt_kssj) > id_jzqyrq THEN
	ll_count = 0
	ll_count = of_lgzy(1,ldt_kssj,al_zyh,itran_sqlca)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		ls_yllb = '210104'
	END IF
END IF
//hw 2023/06/02 生育类别需要
IF ls_ ids_zyfymx:
yllb = '52' THEN
	Date ld_csrq
	Dec ldc_age,ldc_id
	String ls_cbzd
	Integer li_pos_zhou,li_pos_yun
	// 生育类别
	ls_sylb = of_get_dzdmsb("ZHYL_SYLB", ls_sylb)
	IF IsNull(ls_sylb) Or Trim(ls_sylb) = '无' Or Trim(ls_sylb) = "" THEN
		as_error = "生育住院必须填写生育类别，请联系医生填写分娩方式或检查填写是否正确！"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	
	// 生育日期
	SELECT Min(CSRQ) Into :ld_jhsysssyrq From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_YE Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	
	// 晚育标志
	ldc_age = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.age
	IF IsNull(ldc_age) Or ldc_age < 1 THEN
		ldc_age = Year(Today()) - Year(ld_csrq)
	END IF
	IF ldc_age > 24 THEN
		ls_wybz = '1'
	ELSE
		ls_wybz = '0'
	END IF
	
	// 孕周
	ldc_id = al_zyh * 100
	SELECT JG Into :ls_cbzd From YSZ1.E_ZYBLNRL1 Where ID = :ldc_id And DM = '4601' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF Trim(ls_cbzd) > "" THEN
		li_pos_zhou = Posw(ls_cbzd, "周+")
		IF li_pos_zhou > 0 THEN
			ls_yzs = Midw(ls_cbzd, li_pos_zhou - 2, 2)
			IF IsNumber(ls_yzs) = False THEN
				ls_yzs = ""
			END IF
		ELSE
			li_pos_yun = Posw(ls_cbzd, "孕")
			IF Mod(li_pos_yun, 2) > 0 THEN
				li_pos_yun++
			END IF
			li_pos_zhou = Posw(ls_cbzd, "周", li_pos_yun)
			IF li_pos_zhou - li_pos_yun = 2 THEN
				ls_yzs = Midw(ls_cbzd, li_pos_yun, 2)
				IF IsNumber(ls_yzs) = False THEN
					ls_yzs = ""
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	
	// 早产标志
	IF Integer(ls_yzs) > 0 And Integer(ls_yzs) < 37 THEN
		ls_zcbz = "1"
	ELSE
		ls_zcbz = "0"
	END IF
END IF

// 获取 主治医生编码、主诊医生姓名
IF of_get_ygxm(ls_zzysbm, Ref ls_zzysxm, Ref ls_zzyssfzh, True,Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取主诊医生姓名失败：" + as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_zzysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
			as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_zzysbm = ls_ysbm_gjm
	END IF
END IF
// 获菵AT*
 入院诊断描述、入院主诊断代码、入院主诊断名称
IF This.of_get_zy_zdxx( al_zyh, 1, Ref ls_zzddm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_ryzdms, Ref lsArr_zddms, Ref lsArr_zdmcs, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '诊断获取失败！' + as_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

// 获取 入院科室编码、入院科室名称
ls_ryksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM', ls_ryksbm)
ls_ryksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM',ls_ryksbm)
// 获取 病种名称
// ls_bzmc 

// 获取 手术操作名称
// ls_ssczmc

// 获取 字段扩展
//hw 2023/08/04
IF ls_yllb = "22" THEN
	ls_yllb = "21"
	ls_expContent = "22"
END IF
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
This.uf_send_init('2403')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('adminfo')
This.uf_send_add_in('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid, 1) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add_in('psn_no', ls_grbh, 1) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add_in('coner_name', ls_lxrxm, 1) // 联系人姓名
This.uf_send_add_in('tel', ls_lxdh, 1) // 联系电话
This.uf_send_add_in('begntime', ldt_kssj, 1) // 开始时间
This.uf_send_add_in('endtime', ldt_jssj, 1) // 结束时间
This.uf_send_add_in('mdtrt_cert_type', ls_jzpzlx, 1) // 就诊凭证类型
This.uf_send_add_in('med_type', ls_yllb, 1) // 医疗类别
This.uf_send_add_in('ipt_otp_no', ls_zyhm, 1) // 住院号
This.uf_send_add_in('medrcdno', ls_blhm, 1) // 病历号

This.uf_send_add_in('atddr_no', ls_zzysbm, 1) // 主治医生编码
This.uf_send_add_in('chfpdr_name', ls_zzysxm, 1) // 主诊医生姓名
This.uf_send_add_in('adm_diag_dscr', ls_ryzdms, 1) // 入院诊断描述
This.uf_send_add_in('adm_dept_codg', ls_ryksbm, 1) // 入院科室编码
This.uf_send_add_in('adm_dept_name', ls_ryksmc, 1) // 入院科室名称
This.uf_send_add_in('adm_bed', ls_brch, 1) // 入院床位
This.uf_send_add_in('dscg_maindiag_code', ls_zzddm, 1) // 住院主诊断代码
This.uf_send_add_in('dscg_maindiag_name', ls_zzdmc, 1) // 住院主诊断名称
This.uf_send_add_in('main_cond_dscr', '', 1) // 主要病情描述
This.uf_send_add_in('dise_codg', ls_bzbm, 1) // 病种编码
This.uf_send_add_in('dise_name', ls_bzmc, 1) // 病种名称
This.uf_send_add_in('oprn_oprt_code', ls_ssczdm, 1) // 手术操作代码
This.uf_send_add_in('oprn_oprt_name', ls_ssczmc, 1) // 手术操作名称
This.uf_send_add_in('fpsc_no', ls_jhsyfwzh, 1) // 计划生育服务证号
This.uf_send_add_in('matn_type', ls_sylb, 1) // 生育类别
This.uf_send_add_in('birctrl_type', ls_jhsysslb, 1) // 计划生育手术类别
This.uf_send_add_in('latechb_flag', ls_wybz, 1) // 晚育标志
This.uf_send_add_in('geso_val', ls_yzs, 1) // 孕周数
This.uf_send_add_in('fetts', ls_tc, 1) // 胎次
This.uf_send_add_in('fetus_cnt', ls_tes, 1) // 胎儿数
This.uf_send_add_in('pret_flag', ls_zcbz, 1) // 早产标志
IF IsNull(ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ) Or Date(ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	This.uf_send_add_in('birctrl_matn_date', '', 1)
ELSE
	This.uf_send_add_in('birctrl_matn_date', Date(ldt_JHSYSSSYRQ), 1) // 计划生育手术或生育日期
END IF
This.uf_send_add_in('dise_type_code', ls_bzlx, 1) // 病种类型
This.uf_send_add_in('exp_content', ls_expContent, 1) // 字段扩展


// 入院诊断信息列表
This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('diseinfo')
ll_upperBound = UpperBound(lsArr_zddms)
IF ll_upperBound > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_upperBound Step 1
		This.uf_send_add_in('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid, ll_cur) // 就诊ID
		This.uf_send_add_in('psn_no', ls_grbh, ll_cur) // 人员编号
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_type', '1', ll_cur) // 诊断类别：'1'-入院诊断；'2'-出院诊断
		IF ll_cur = 1 THEN
			This.uf_send_add_in('maindiag_flag', '1', ll_cur) // 主诊断标志：'0'-否；'1'-是
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_add_in('maindiag_flag', '0', ll_cur)
		END IF
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_srt_no', String(ll_cur), ll_cur) // 诊断排序号
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_code', lsArr_zddms[ll_cur], ll_cur) // 诊断代码
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_name', lsArr_zdmcs[ll_cur], ll_cur) // 诊断名称
		This.uf_send_add_in('adm_cond', '', ll_cur) // 入院病情
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_dept', ls_ryksbm, ll_cur) // 诊断科室
		This.uf_send_add_in('dise_dor_no', ls_zzysbm, ll_cur) // 诊断医生编码
		This.uf_send_add_in('dise_dor_name', ls_zzysxm, ll_cur) // 诊断医生姓名
		This.uf_send_add_in('diag_time', ldt_kssj, ll_cur) // 诊断时间
	NEXT
END IF
// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send( Ref as_error, '') THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 成功后回写HIS
String ls_czddip
ls_czddip = This.of_geT_ip( )
IF ls_yllb <> ls_yllb_y THEN
	ls_bzxx = ls_bzxx + base_info.UserID + 'Y-YLLB:' +ls_yllb_y + '【' + String(gf_server_date(),'yyyymmdd hh:mm') +'】'
	IF Len(ls_bzxx) > 500 THEN ls_bzxx = of_midstring(ls_bzxx,500)
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	SET KSSJ = :ldt_kssj, JSSJ = :ldt_jssj, YLLB = :ls_yllb, BLH = :ls_blhm, ZZYSBM = :ls_zzysbm, RYKSYYBM = :ls_ryksbm,
	RYCW = :ls_brch, ZZDDM = :ls_zzddm, CZDDIP = :ls_CZDDIP, BZXX = :ls_bzxx, SYLB = :ls_sylb, WYBZ = :ls_wybz, YZS = :ls_yzs, ZCBZ = :ls_zcbz,
	JHSYSSSYRQ = :ld_jhsysssyrq
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND ZYH = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
// AND ZTBZ in ( 1,2)
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】入院登记信息变更成功，但更新入院登记明细失败，错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	GOTO Error
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2403-入院信息变更]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1


end function

public 
function integer uf_czy_qrqc (date ad_qdrq, string as_czybm, long ai_qrqc, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date   	ad_qdrq 	签到日期
// 	value    	string 	as_czybm	操作员编码
// 	value    	string 	ai_qrqc 	1 签入  2签出
// 	reference	integer	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2022.01.19
//====================================================================
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_error = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Date ld_qdrq,ld_qcrq
DateTime ldt_qdsj,ldt_qtsj,ldt_qdrq_temp,ldt_qcrq_temp
String ls_ip,ls_mac,ls_dqbm
Long ll_rec,ll_cwts
Int li_ztbz
//获取IP,mac
ls_ip = of_get_ip()
ls_mac = of_getmac()

IF ai_qrqc = 1 THEN //签入
	ld_qdrq = ad_qdrq
	SELECT qrsj,ztbz,qdbh Into :ldt_qdrq_temp,:li_ztbz,:ls_dqbm From (select qrsj,ztbz,qdbh from  jkxt.zhyb_czy_qrqc Where  czybm = :as_czybm  Order By jlxh Desc) where rownum=1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0  THEN
		IF DaysAfter(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),Date(ld_qdrq)) >= 1  THEN //最近一次签到跨天
			IF li_ztbz = 1 THEN //跨天未签退 则先签退
				is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
				This.uf_send_init('9002')
				istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
				This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('signOut')
				This.uf_send_add_in('sign_no',ls_dqbm,1)
				This.uf_send_add_in('opter_no',as_czybm,1)
				IF This.uf_send(as_error,'') THEN
				ELSE
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				IF This.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
					as_error = '操作员隔天签退失败'+This.uf_getstring('err_msg')
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				ll_cwts = This.uf_Getstring_mxnr('signoutoutb')
				FOR ll_rec = 1 To ll_cwts
					ldt_qtsj = This.uf_getdatetime_in('sign_time',ll_rec)
				NEXT
				gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				UPDATE jkxt.zhyb_czy_qrqc  Set qcsj = :ldt_qtsj,ztbz = 0 Where  czybm = :as_czybm  And qrsj = :ldt_qdrq_temp  Using itran_sqlca;
				IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
					as_error = '更新签退时间失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
					gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
					RETURN -1
				ELSE
					gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		IF DaysAfter(Date(ldt_qdrq_temp),Date(ld_qdrq)) = 0  THEN //最近一次签到没跨天
			IF li_ztbz = 0 THEN //说明已签退，继续进行当日签到
			ELSE //已签到,再调用该函数时,则给实例变量赋直
				is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
				RETURN 1
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	This.uf_send_init('9001')
	istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('signIn')
	This.uf_send_add_in('opter_no',as_czybm,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('mac',ls_mac,1)
	This.uf_send_add_in('ip',ls_ip,1)
	IF This.uf_s
end(as_error,'') THEN
	ELSE
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF This.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '操作员签到失败！'+This.uf_getstring('err_msg')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ll_cwts = This.uf_Getstring_mxnr('signinoutb')
	FOR ll_rec = 1 To ll_cwts
		ls_dqbm = This.uf_getstring_in('sign_no',ll_rec)
		ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime_in('sign_time',ll_rec)
	NEXT
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	INSERT Into jkxt.zhyb_czy_qrqc(czybm,qrsj,ztbz,qdbh) Values (:as_czybm,:ldt_qdsj,1,:ls_dqbm) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	RETURN 1
ELSE //签退
	ld_qcrq = ad_qdrq
	SELECT qrsj,ztbz,qdbh Into :ldt_qdrq_temp,:li_ztbz,:ls_dqbm From (select qrsj,ztbz,qdbh from  jkxt.zhyb_czy_qrqc Where  czybm = :as_czybm  Order By jlxh Desc) where rownum=1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0  THEN
		IF li_ztbz=0  THEN //最近一次签到已签退
		ELSE
			This.uf_send_init('9002')
			istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm//20220130
			is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
			This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('signOut')
			This.uf_send_add_in('sign_no',ls_dqbm,1)
			This.uf_send_add_in('opter_no',as_czybm,1)
			IF This.uf_send(as_error,'') THEN
			ELSE
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF This.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '操作员签退失败'+This.uf_getstring('err_msg')
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			ll_cwts = This.uf_Getstring_mxnr('signoutoutb')
			FOR ll_rec = 1 To ll_cwts
				ldt_qtsj = This.uf_getdatetime_in('sign_time',ll_rec)
			NEXT
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			UPDATE jkxt.zhyb_czy_qrqc  Set qcsj = :ldt_qtsj,ztbz = 0 Where  czybm = :as_czybm  And qrsj = :ldt_qdrq_temp  Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '更新签退时间失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	return 1
END IF
















end function

public function integer of_get_ybgrbh (string as_knsj, ref string as_ybgrbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_ybgrbh()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取本地医保人员编号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 睤AT*
:
// 	value    	string	as_knsj  	
// 	reference	String	as_ybgrbh	
// 	reference	string	as_error 	      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//        -1-失败；1-成功
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  获取本地医保人员编号
//====================================================================

String ls_ybgrbh

ls_ybgrbh = as_ybgrbh
IF isnull(ls_ybgrbh) Then ls_ybgrbh=''
IF Trim(ls_ybgrbh)>'' Then return 1

IF isnull(as_knsj) or Trim(as_knsj)='' Then
	as_error = "卡号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

Select GRBH into :ls_ybgrbh From JKXT.YB_BRJBXX where YB_BRJBXX.KNSJ=:as_knsj Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取本地医保人员编号失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+")"+itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF

as_ybgrbh = ls_ybgrbh
return 1

Error:
as_error = "获取本地医保病人基本信息失败：" + as_error
return -1
end function

public function integer of_get_xzlx (ref string as_xzlx, string as_yllb, string as_rylb, string as_gwybz, string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_xzlx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取险种类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	String	as_xzlx
// 	value    	string	as_yllb 	 医疗类别：21-普通住院，22-外伤住院，23-转外诊治住院，24-急诊转住院，25-异地住院，26-单病种住院，28-日间手术，52-生育住院，92-其他住院，......
// 	value    	string	as_rylb 	 人员类别：11-在职，1101-职工在职，1102-公务员在职，......  12-退休，1202-职工退休，1202-公务员退休，......  13-离休，......  14-居民（未成年），......  15-居民（成年），......
// 	value    	string	as_gwybz  公务员标志：0-否，1-是，......
// 	reference	String	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN 		日期: 2022.01.20    28271  获取险种类型
//====================================================================

// 险种类型：
// 	310	职工基本医疗保险
// 	31003	医疗保险个人账户（用人单位）
// 	312	农民工住院医疗	
// 	320	公务员医疗补助	
//		321	公务员医疗补助（市直统发）	
//		323	公务员医疗补助（市直非统发）
//		330	大额医疗费用补助
//		331	二次补助	
//		340	离休人员医疗保障	
//		350	一至六级残废军人医疗补助
//		370	企业补充医疗保险
//		360	老红军医疗保障
//		380	新型农村合作医疗
//		390	城乡居民基本医疗保险
//		39901	劳模医疗保障
//		39902	补充百分之十医疗
//		39903	城乡居民补充医疗保险
//		39904	建国前老工人医疗保险
//		39905	二乙医疗保险
//		39906	意外伤害医疗保险
//		391	城镇居民基本医疗保险
//		392	城乡居民大病医疗保险
//		399	其他特殊人员医疗保障
//		410	长期照护保险
//		510	生育保险
//		520	公务员生育

IF as_yllb='52' Then  // 生育住院
	IF as_gwybz>'0' or as_rylb='1102' or as_rylb='1202' or as_rylb='1114' Then
		as_xzlx = '520'
	ELSE
		as_xzlx = '510'
	END IF
ELSE
	IF as_gwybz>'0' or as_rylb='1102' or as_rylb='1202' or as_rylb='1114' Then
		as_xzlx = '320'
	ELSE
		as_xzlx = '310'
	END IF
END IF

IF isnull(as_xzlx) or Trim(as_xzlx)='' Then 
	as_xzlx = '310'
END IF
	
return 1

end function
