public function boolean uf_ifyb (long al_data, string as_lx);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_ifyb()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:是否医保性质
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	long  	al_data	
// 	value	string	as_lx  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================

if uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 then
	return false
end if
Integer li_ybpb = 0
CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_lx)
	CASE 'ZYH'
		SELECT YBPB INTO :li_ybpb FROM ZY_BRRY, GY_BRXZ
			Where ZY_BRRY.BRXZ = GY_BRXZ.BRXZ And ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'BRXZ','JSLX'
		SELECT YBPB Into :li_ybpb From GY_BRXZ Where BRXZ = :al_data using itran_sqlca;
	CASE 'JSDW'
		
END CHOOSE

RETURN li_ybpb = 1

end function

public function integer of_get_gjbm (string as_bmlx, string as_ybbm, ref string as_gjbm);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_gjbm = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_gjm = '',ls_gjm_temp,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,ls_dzgh
ls_gjm_temp = as_gjbm
IF as_bmlx = 'YSBM' THEN
	IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
		IF of_get_ygxm(as_ybbm,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,True,as_gjbm) < 0 THEN
			as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败：' + as_gjbm
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	Long ll_find,ll_find_dz
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+as_ybbm+"'",1,99999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ls_dzgh =  ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
		IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN //如果有对照取对照，没有就取本身
			ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+ls_dzgh+"'",1,99999)
			IF ll_find_dz >  0 THEN
				ll_find = ll_find_dz
				as_ybbm = ls_dzgh
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_gjm = Trim(ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find])
		IF IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN ls_gjm = ''
	ELSE
		IF of_get_ygxm(as_ybbm,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,True,as_gjbm) < 0 THEN
			as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败：' + as_gjbm
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+as_ybbm+"'",1,99999)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败2：' + as_ybbm
				RETURN -1
			else
				ls_dzgh =  ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
				IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN //如果有对照取对照，没有就取本身
					ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+ls_dzgh+"'",1,99999)
					IF ll_find_dz >  0 THEN
						ll_find = ll_find_dz
						as_ybbm = ls_dzgh
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_gjm = ''
	END IF
	
	IF ls_gjm = '' Or IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN
		SELECT gjybdm Into :ls_gjm From xtgl.gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
			as_gjbm = as_ybbm + '，获取国家码失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			IF IsNull(ls_gjm) Or ls_gjm = '' THEN
				ls_gjm = 'NULL'
				as_gjbm = ''
				//					as_gjbm = as_ybbm + '，未维护对应的国家码！'
				//					RETURN 0
			ELSE
				as_gjbm = Trim(ls_gjm)
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find] = Trim(ls_gjm)
	ELSE
		IF ls_gjm = 'NULL' Or ls_gjm = '' Or IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN
			as_gjbm = ''
		ELSE
			as_gjbm = Trim(ls_gjm)
		END IF
	END IF
	//ELSEIF as_bmlx = 'SFXM' THEN
	//	IF Left(as_ybbm,1) = '1' Or as_ybbm = '2' THEN
	//		SELECT GJYPBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_ypml Where zxbzbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	ELSEIF Left(as_ybbm,1) = '6' THEN
	//		SELECT GJYBBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_clml Where zxtymbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	ELSE
	//		SELECT GJYBBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_zlml Where zxtymbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	END IF
	//	IF ls_gjm > '' THEN
	//		as_gjbm = ls_gjm
	//		RETURN 1
	//	ELSEif ls_gjm_temp > '' then
	//		as_gjbm = ls_gjm_temp
	//		RETURN 0
	//	else
	//		as_gjbm =   '取不到对应的国家编码(' + as_ybbm + ")"
	//		RETURN -1
	//	END IF
ELSE
	as_gjbm = '未定义的类型：' + as_bmlx
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

gf_relativedatetime

gf_getpara

gf_midstring
gf_waiting
=================================================
DateTime ldt_return
integer li_Hour,li_Minute,li_Second,li_month,li_year,li_day
Time lt_time
Date ld_date

lt_time = time(adt_datetime)
ld_date = date(adt_datetime)

li_Hour = Hour(lt_time)
li_Minute = Minute(lt_time)
li_Second = Second(lt_time)

CHOOSE CASE as_type
	CASE 'HOUR'
		li_day = Truncate ( ai_value / 24, 0 )
		
		ldt_return = datetime(RelativeDate(ld_date,-li_day),lt_time)
		
		li_Second = (ai_value - (li_day * 24)) * 60
		ldt_return = gf_relativedatetime('MINUTE',ldt_return,li_Second)
		return ldt_return
	case 'MINUTE'
		
		ai_value = ai_value * 60
		if ai_value > 0 then 
			if ai_value > li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second then
				ld_date = RelativeDate(ld_date,-1)
				ai_value = ai_value - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second)
				lt_time = time("23:59:59")
				ai_value = ai_value - 1
			end if
		else
			if abs(ai_value) > (24 * 3600 ) - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second) then
				ld_date = RelativeDate(ld_date,1)
				ai_value = ai_value + (24 * 3600 ) - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second)
				lt_time = time("00:00:00")
				ai_value = ai_value + 1
			end if
		end if
		lt_time = RelativeTime(lt_time,-ai_value)
	CASE 'MONTH'
		ai_value = - ai_value
		li_year = Truncate( ai_value / 12,0)
		ai_value = mod(ai_value,12)
		
		li_month = month(date(adt_datetime))
		li_day = day(date(adt_datetime))
		
		li_month = li_month + ai_value
		
		if li_month > 12 then
			li_month = li_month - 12
			li_year ++
		end if
		if li_month <= 0 then
			li_month = 12 + li_month
			li_year --
		end if
		
		
		li_year = year(date(adt_datetime)) + li_year
		string ls_temp
		ls_temp = string(li_year) + "." + string(li_month) + "." + string(li_day)
		do while not IsDate(ls_temp) 
			li_day = li_day - 1
			ls_temp = string(li_year) + "." + string(li_month) + "." + string(li_day )
		loop
		
		ld_date = date(ls_temp)
		lt_time = time(00:00:00)
END	CHOOSE

ldt_return = DateTime(ld_date,lt_time)

RETURN ldt_return

end function

public function integer of_update_tsjl (string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, integer ai_jscs, string as_ywly, string as_ywlsh, decimal adc_tsje, string as_ybywh, string as_mxzdh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_ybjk_new_his.of_insert_tsjl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:插入干部保健虳AT*

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_brbm 	
// 	value    	decimal	ad_zyh  	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jscs 	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywly 	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_tsje	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlsh	
// 	value    	string 	as_ybywh	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2017.03.21
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_kssj
ldt_kssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_sysdatetime),-1))
IF IsNull(as_brbm) THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSJL SET ztbz = 1,YBYWH = :as_ybywh,tszje = :adc_tsje
		WHERE TSSJ >= :ldt_kssj AND ZYH = :ad_zyh AND JSCS = :ai_jscs AND YWLY = :as_ywly AND YWLSH = :as_ywlsh and mxzdh = :as_mxzdh
		Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSJL SET ztbz = 1,YBYWH = :as_ybywh,tszje = :adc_tsje
		WHERE TSSJ >= :ldt_kssj AND BRBM = :as_brbm AND YWLY = :as_ywly AND YWLSH = :as_ywlsh and mxzdh = :as_mxzdh
		Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF ad_zyh > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ztbz = 1,JSCS = :ai_jscs,TSYWH = :as_ywlsh Where ZYH = :ad_zyh And JSCS = 0  And MXZDH = :as_mxzdh And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ztbz = 1 Where TSYWH = :as_ywlsh And MXZDH = :as_mxzdh And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = '更新干部保健托收明细失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = '更新干部保健托收记录失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1






end function

public function integer of_update_tsjl_tp (datetime adt_kssj, datetime adt_jssj, string as_ybywh, decimal adc_tsje, string as_tjylsh, string as_jsfl, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_update_tsjl_tp()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	datetime	adt_kssj 	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jssj 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ybywh 	
// 	value    	decimal 	adc_tsje 	
// 	value    	string  	as_tjylsh	
// 	value    	string  	as_jsfl  	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.22
//====================================================================

UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSJL  Set ZTBZ = 2 Where  TSSJ >= :adt_kssj And TSSJ <= :adt_jssj And YBYWH = :as_ybywh And ZTBZ = 1   Using itran_sqlca ;
if as_jsfl = 'YF' THEN
	INSERT INTO JKXT.JS_TSJL
				 (  TSSJ,     BRBM,   ZYH,   JSCS,  YWLY, mxzdh, TSZJE,    YWLSH,   YBYWH,   ZTBZ ,GBBZ,JMBL,JSFL)
		SELECT sysdate,BRBM,  ZYH,  JSCS,  YWLY, '-' || mxzdh, :adc_tsje, YWLSH,  :as_tjylsh, 3,GBBZ,JMBL,JSFL
		FROM JKXT.JS_TSJL
		WHERE  TSSJ >= :adt_kssj AND TSSJ <= :adt_jssj AND YBYWH = :as_ybywh AND ZTBZ IN (1,2)
		Using itran_sqlca ;
ELSE
	INSERT INTO JKXT.JS_TSJL
				 (  TSSJ,     BRBM,   ZYH,   JSCS,  YWLY, mxzdh, TSZJE,    YWLSH,   YBYWH,   ZTBZ ,GBBZ,JMBL,JSFL)
		SELECT sysdate,BRBM,  ZYH,  JSCS,  YWLY, mxzdh, :adc_tsje, YWLSH,  :as_tjylsh, 3,GBBZ,JMBL,JSFL
		FROM JKXT.JS_TSJL
		WHERE  TSSJ >= :adt_kssj AND TSSJ <= :adt_jssj AND YBYWH = :as_ybywh AND ZTBZ IN (1,2)
		Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows >= 1 THEN
	//	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = 2 Where  TSSJ >= :adt_kssj And TSSJ <= :adt_jssj And YBYWH = :as_ybywh And ZTBZ = 1   Using itran_sqlca ;
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF


RETURN 1
end function

public function integer uf_get_brxz (string as_cbrlb, ref long al_brxz, ref long al_tgdw);IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_temp
SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'ZHYL_GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :as_cbrlb Using itran_sqlca ;

IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	al_brxz = Long(Mid(ls_temp,1,4))
	al_tgdw = Long(Mid(ls_temp,5,4))
	RETURN 1
ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
	if Left(as_cbrlb,2) = 'GB' then
		as_cbrlb = Left(as_cbrlb,4)
	else
		as_cbrlb = Left(as_cbrlb,2)
	end if
	SELECT TJLXH Into :ls_temp From XTGL.GY_DMZD_DZ Where TNAME = 'ZHYL_GY_TGDW' And DMSB = :as_cbrlb Using itran_sqlca ;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		al_brxz = Long(Mid(ls_temp,1,4))
		al_tgdw = Long(Mid(ls_temp,5,4))
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF

RETURN -1

end function

public function integer uf_get_tsdz (integer ai_yplx, long al_ypxh, long al_ypcd, datetime adt_jfrq, ref string as_ybbm, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.Declare Instance Variables()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:特殊对照
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer 	ai_yplx 	
// 	value    	long    	al_ypxh 	
// 	value    	long    	al_ypcd 	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jfrq	
// 	reference	string  	as_ybbm 	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_sql
IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz) THEN
	ids_yb_tsdz = Create U_datastore
	ids_yb_tsdz.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " SELECT FYLX,FYXH,YBZXBH,KSSJ,JSSJ,YPCD,'' AS GJYBBM FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ WHERE FYLX IN (0,1) "
	IF ids_yb_tsdz.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'特殊对照'对象失败("+ids_yb_tsdz.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
String ls_filter_tsdz
Long ll_Find_tsdz,ll_tscount
IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN // 药品
	ls_filter_tsdz = "#1 = 1 AND #2 = " + String(al_ypxh) + " AND #6 = " + String(al_ypcd)
ELSE // 费用
	ls_filter_tsdz = "#1 = 0 AND #2 = " + String(al_ypxh)
END IF

IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz_temp) THEN
	ids_yb_tsdz_temp = Create U_datastore
	ids_yb_tsdz_temp.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	ids_yb_tsdz_temp.DataObject = "d_tsdz_fyxh"
END IF
ll_Find_tsdz = ids_yb_tsdz.Find(ls_filter_tsdz, 1, 9999999)
IF ll_Find_tsdz <= 0 THEN
	ids_yb_tsdz_temp.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
	ll_tscount = ids_yb_tsdz_temp.Retrieve(ai_yplx, al_ypxh)
	IF ll_tscount < 0 THEN
		as_error = ids_yb_tsdz_temp.is_error
		RETURN -1
	ELSEIF ll_tscount > 0 THEN
		ids_yb_tsdz_temp.RowsCopy(1, ll_tscount, Primary!, ids_yb_tsdz, 1, Primary!)
	ELSE
		RETURN 0
	END IF
END IF

ls_filter_tsdz = ls_filter_tsdz + " AND #4 <= datetime('" + String(adt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss')
ls_filter_tsdz = ls_filter_tsdz +  "') and #5 >= datetime('" +  String(adt_jfrq,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss') + "')"
ll_Find_tsdz = ids_yb_tsdz.Find(ls_filter_tsdz,1,999999)
IF ll_Find_tsdz > 0 THEN
	as_ybbm = ids_yb_tsdz.Object.#3[ll_Find_tsdz]
	RETURN ll_Find_tsdz
END IF
RETURN 0





end function

public function integer uf_jyzf (datetime adt_jssj, string as_jylx, string as_grbh, string as_jyjslsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_jyzf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 冲正交易（作废交易）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jssj  	
// 	value    	string  	as_jylx   	
// 	value    	string  	as_grbh   	
// 	value    	string  	as_jyjslsh	
// 	reference	string  	as_error 
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  冲正交易（作废交易）
//====================================================================

//如果是门诊结算交易2207,2207a,as_error需要传入对应的JZID ADD BY SXL 20220211
//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm,ls_jzid,ls_tmp
ls_jzid = as_error
as_error = ''
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF


// 可冲正的交易包括：【2102A】药店结算、【2103】药店结算撤销、【2207A】门诊结算、【2208】门诊结算撤销、【2304A】住院紻AT*
2305】住院结算撤销、【2401】入院办理
//String ls_jylxs = ",2102A,2103,2207A,2208,2304A,2305,2401,2102,2207,2304,"

IF IsNull(as_jylx) Or Trim(as_jylx) = '' THEN
	as_error = '需要冲正的【交易编号】为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_grbh) Or Trim(as_grbh) = '' THEN
	as_error = '冲正交易所需的【人员编号】为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_jyjslsh) Or Trim(as_jyjslsh) = '' THEN
	as_error = '冲正交易所需的【原发送方报文ID/医疗机构结算ID】为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
//IF Pos(ls_jylxs, ","+as_jylx+",") <= 0 THEN
//	as_error = "冲正的交易编号有误：" + as_jylx
//	GOTO Error
//END IF

This.uf_send_init( '2601')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
IF Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm) > ""  THEN
	istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致
END IF

This.uf_send_add('psn_no', as_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('omsgid', as_jyjslsh) // 原发送方报文ID
This.uf_send_add('oinfno', as_jylx) // 原交易编号

// 发送报文
IF Not uf_send(Ref as_error, '') = True THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 成功后回写HIS
IF IsNull(adt_jssj) Or Date(adt_jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	adt_jssj  = DateTime(Date(gf_server_date()))
END IF
IF as_jylx = '2401' THEN
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where JYLSH = :as_jyjslsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollBack_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	This.of_jsmx_zf(as_jylx, adt_jssj, as_jyjslsh, Ref as_error)
	
	String ls_ywlsh = '0000',ls_ywlx,ls_fph
	Long ll_zyh
	IF as_jylx = '2207A' Or as_jylx = '2207' THEN
		//作废交易同时撤销明细和挂号
		SELECT ywlx,ywlsh,fph Into :ls_ywlx,:ls_ywlsh,: ls_fph From JKXT.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :adt_jssj - 3 And jssj <= :adt_jssj + 3 And JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ = -2 Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ls_ywlsh > '' THEN
			IF ls_ywlx <> 'GH' Or IsNull(ls_ywlx) THEN ls_ywlx = ''
			IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
				SELECT zyh Into :ll_zyh From zy_brry,JKXT.zhyb_ghxx Where zy_brry.zyhm = zhyb_ghxx.brbm And JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
				This.uf_zymz_delfymx( ll_zyh, '0000', as_error)
			ELSE
				This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid, ls_ywlsh, as_grbh, as_error)
				This.uf_mz_ghcx( as_grbh, ls_jzid, ls_ywlx +ls_ywlsh , adt_jssj,as_error)
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
				SELECT zyh Into :ll_zyh From zy_brry,JKXT.zhyb_ghxx Where zy_brry.zyhm = zhyb_ghxx.brbm And JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
				This.uf_zymz_delfymx( ll_zyh, '0000', as_error)
			ELSE
				This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid, '0000', as_grbh, as_error)
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSEIF as_jylx = '2304' THEN
		SELECT ZYH Into :ll_zyh From JKXT.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :adt_jssj - 3 And jssj <= :adt_jssj + 3 And JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ = -2 and jylsh = :as_jyjslsh order by jylsh desc Using itran_sqlca;
		if ll_zyh >= 0 then uf_zy_crycx( 2, ll_zyh, ls_tmp)
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1

Error:
as_error = "[2601-冲正交易]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1

end function

public function integer of_get_expcontent (ref string as_return, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_expcontent()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取 exp_content-字段扩展
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	
// 	reference	string	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271  获取 exp_content-字段扩展
//====================================================================

//HW 门诊外伤
sailJson ljson_expContent
ljson_expContent = Create sailJson

// 非省异地
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.sydbz = 0 THEN
	
	//是否启用门诊外伤 HW 2023/09/05
	IF ii_mzws = 1 THEN
		// 门诊外伤标志为2表示签了无第三方责任书
		IF as_return = '2' THEN
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("insutype", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype)
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "0") //涉及第三方责任标志
		ELSEIF as_return = '1' THEN //门诊外伤标志为1表示未签了无第三方责任书
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("insutype", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype)
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "1") //未签无第三方责任书
		ELSEIF  as_return = '22' THEN
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
			ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "0") //涉及第三方责任标志
		END IF
		as_return = ljson_expContent.getformatjson("")
		
		IF IsValid(ljson_expContent) THEN Destroy(ljson_expContent)
	ELSE
		as_return = ""
	END IF
	
	RETURN 1
END IF

// 省异地
// 2023/09/05 注释
//sailJson ljson_expContent
//ljson_expContent = Create SailJson

ljson_expContent.setAttribute("psn_cert_type", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type) // 人员证件类型
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("certno", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno) // 证件号码
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("psn_name", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm) // 人员姓名
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("psn_type", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_type) // 人员类别
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("insutype", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype) // 险种类型
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("cvlserv_flag", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cvlserv_flag) // 公务员标志
ljson_expContent.setAttribute("card_sn", istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm ) // 卡识别码

// 门诊外伤标志为2表示签了无第三方责任书
IF as_return = '2' THEN
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "0") //涉及第三方责任标志
ELSEIF as_return = '1' THEN //门诊外伤标志为1表示未签了无第三方责任书
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "1") //未签无第三方责任书
ELSEIF as_return = '22' THEN //住院外伤
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("trum_flag", "1") // 外伤标志
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("rel_ttp_flag", "0") //涉及第三方责任标志
	as_return = ""
END IF

as_return = ljson_expContent.getformatjson("")

IF IsValid(ljson_expContent) THEN Destroy(ljson_expContent)

IF IsNull(as_return) Or Trim(as_return) = "" THEN
	as_error = "省异地病人扩展字段内容不能为空！"
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_update_ghxx (integer ai_gxlx, str_zhyl_ghxx astr_zhyl_ghxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_update_ghxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:更新挂号信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_jsjylsh    	
// 	value    	str_zhyb_ghxx	astr_zhyb_ghxx	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================

DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_end
ldt_curr = astr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF ai_gxlx = 0 THEN
	ldt_curr = of_relativetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,2)
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX  SET ZTBZ = 1,JZID = :astr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID
		Where JYSJ  >= :ldt_curr And JYLSH = :astr_zhyl_ghxx.JYLSH Using  itran_sqlca ;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN 0
	ELSE
		as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_gxlx = 1 THEN
	ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_curr),3),Time(ldt_curr)) //of_relativetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,-36)
	ldt_curr = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_curr),-3),Time(ldt_curr))
	if ii_zymz = 1 then
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX  SET ZTBZ = -1,bzxx = '作废' || :is_jylsh,ZFSJ = SYSDATE
			Where KSSJ  >= :ldt_curr And KSSJ <= :ldt_end And JZID = :astr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID And ZTBZ = 1 Using  itran_sqlca ;
	else
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX  SET ZTBZ = -1,bzxx = '作废' || :is_jylsh,ZFSJ = SYSDATE
			Where JYSJ  >= :ldt_curr And JYSJ <= :ldt_end And JZID = :astr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID And ZTBZ = 1 Using  itran_sqlca ;
	end if
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN 0
	ELSE
		as_error = itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 作废更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF


end function

public function integer of_get_expcontent (string as_ywlx, string as_jzid, string as_brbm, long al_zyh, ref string as_return, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_expcontent()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取 exp_content-字段扩展（数据库中已有数据时使用）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_ywlx  	
// 	value    	String	as_jzid  	
// 	value    	string	as_brbm  	
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh   	
// 	reference	string	as_return	
// 	reference	string	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271  获取 exp_content-字段扩展（数据库中已有数据时使用）
//====================================================================

Integer li_sydyz
String ls_zjlx, ls_sfzh, ls_brxm, ls_lyrylb, ls_xzlx, ls_gwybz, ls_jzpzbh,ls_shbzksbm

IF as_ywlx='ZY' Then
	Select     SYDBZ,     ZJLX,     ZJHM,     BRXM,     YLRYLB,     XZLX,     GWYBZ,     JZPZBH
	  into :li_sydyz, :ls_zjlx, :ls_sfzh, :ls_brxm, :ls_lyrylb, :ls_xzlx, :ls_gwybz, :ls_jzpzbh
	  From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	 Where JZID=:as_jzid and ZYH=:al_zyh
	 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
		as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+")" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	END IF
	select zhbz into :ls_shbzksbm from zy_brry where  ZYH=:al_zyh  Using itran_sqlca; 
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.sydbz = li_sydyz
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = ls_zjlx
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno = ls_sfzh
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm = ls_brxm
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_type = ls_lyrylb
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype = ls_xzlx
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cvlserv_flag = ls_gwybz
	IF isnull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) or Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh)="" Then
		istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh = ls_jzpzbh
	END IF
	if isnull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm) or Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm)=""  then
		istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm = ls_shbzksbm
	end if
ELSEIF as_ywlx='MZ' Then
	
ELSE
	as_error = "业务类型有误：" + as_ywlx
	goto Error
END IF

IF This.of_get_expcontent( ref as_return, ref as_error)<0 Then
	goto Error
END IF

return 1

Error:
IF as_ywlx='MZ' Then 
	as_error = "门诊省异地病人 " + as_error
ELSEIF as_ywlx='ZY' Then
	as_error = "住院省异地病人 " + as_error
END IF
as_error = "获取扩展字段失败：" + as_error
return -1
end function

public subroutine of_reset_jsxx (ref str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_reset_jsxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 重置结算信息结构体
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  重置结算信息结构体
//====================================================================

datetime ldt_null
setnull(ldt_null)
astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj = ldt_null
astr_zhyl_jsxx.jsid = ''
str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl  lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl_null
astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl_null
end subroutine

public function integer of_insert_jymx (string as_brbm, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, string as_fplsh, string as_ywly, string as_jydd, string as_jyjslx, string as_tsmxbzdm, string as_jzxlh, str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_insert_jymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 本地插入医保结算明细表
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string         	as_brbm     	
// 	value    	long           	al_zyh      	
// 	value    	integer        	ai_jscs     	
// 	value    	string         	as_fplsh    	
// 	value    	string         	as_ywly     	
// 	value    	string         	as_jydd     	
// 	value    	string         	as_jyjslx   	
// 	value    	string         	as_tsmxbzdm 	
// 	value    	string         	as_jzxlh    	
// 	value    	str_zhyl_jsxx		astr_zhyl_jsxx
// 	reference	string         	as_error    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  本地插入医保结算明细表
//====================================================================
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF al_zyh = 0 And as_brbm > '' THEN
	IF as_brbm > '' THEN

public function integer uf_cx_dyjc (string as_yllb, datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_bzbm, string as_bzmc, string as_ssczdm, string as_ssmc, string as_sylb, string as_jhsylb, ref str_zhyl_dyxsmx astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[], ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_cx_dyjc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:2001根据个人信息检查该人员在一段时间内的待遇享受情况。
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string         	as_yllb           	
// 	value    	string         	as_bzbm           	
// 	value    	string         	as_bzmc           	
// 	value    	string         	as_ssczdm         	
// 	value    	string         	as_ssmc           	
// 	value    	string         	as_sylb           	
// 	value    	string         	as_jhsylb         	
// 	reference	str_zhyl_dyxsmx	astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[]	
// 	reference	string         	as_return         	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================
//节点标识：data 
//按病种结算病种目录代码(bydise_setl_list_code)、
//门诊慢特病病种目录代码(opsp_dise_cod)、
//日间手术病种目录代码(daysrg_dise_list_code)		
//2001根据个人信息检查该人员在一段时间内的待遇享受情况。
Date ld_now
ld_now = Date(gf_Server_date())
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,base_info.UserID , 1, as_return) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_exp_content
SetNull(adt_end)
IF  This.of_get_expcontent( ls_exp_content,as_return) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init( '2001')
This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'insutype', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype) //2	insutype	险种类型	字符型	6	Y	Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'fixmedins_code', is_yljgdm) //3	fixmedins_code	定点医药机构编号	字符型	12		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'med_type',as_yllb) //4	med_type	医疗类别	字符型	6	Y	Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'begntime', adt_begin) //5	begntime	开始时间	日期时间型			Y	yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
This.uf_send_add( 'endtime', adt_end) //6	endtime	结束时糄AT*
	日期时间型				yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
This.uf_send_add( 'dise_codg', as_bzbm) //7	dise_codg	病种编码	字符型	30			按照标准代码填写：
This.uf_send_add( 'dise_name', as_bzmc) //8	dise_name	病种名称	字符型	500	
This.uf_send_add( 'oprn_oprt_code', as_ssczdm) //9	oprn_oprt_code	手术操作代码	字符型	30			日间手术病种时必填
This.uf_send_add( 'oprn_oprt_name', as_ssmc) //10	oprn_oprt_name	手术操作名称	字符型	500
This.uf_send_add( 'matn_type', as_sylb) //11	matn_type	生育类别	字符型	6	Y		
This.uf_send_add( 'birctrl_type', as_jhsylb) //12	birctrl_type	计划生育手术类别	字符型	6	Y		
This.uf_send_add( 'exp_content', ls_exp_content) //13	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	
IF This.uf_send( as_return, '') THEN
	Long ll_row,ll_count
	ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr('trtinfo')
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].grbh = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_no', ll_row) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].dyjclx = This.uf_getstring_in('trt_chk_type', ll_row) //2	trt_chk_type	待遇检查类型	字符型	6	Y	Y	
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].jjzflx = This.uf_getstring_in('fund_pay_type', ll_row) //3	fund_pay_type	基金支付类型	字符型	6	Y	Y	
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].jjkxdyxzbz = This.uf_getstring_in('trt_enjymnt_flag', ll_row) //4	trt_enjymnt_flag	基金款项待遇享受标志	字符型	3	Y	Y	
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].ksrq = This.uf_getdate_in('begndate', ll_row) //5	begndate	开始日期	日期型			Y	
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].jsrq = This.uf_getdate_in('enddate', ll_row) //6	enddate	结束日期	日期型				
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].dyjcjg = This.uf_getstring_in('trt_chk_rslt', ll_row) //7	trt_chk_rslt	待遇检查结果	字符型	500			返回不享受待遇原因。
			astr_zhyl_dyxsmx[ll_row].zdkz = This.uf_getstring_in('exp_content', ll_row) //8	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	
		NEXT
	ELSE
		as_return = '没有查询该参保人待遇享受情况'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_get_jzxlh (ref string as_jzxlh, ref string as_error);Decimal{0} ll_Value
Long ll_Count
Long ll_Retry
//判断事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

Process_Begin:
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

UPDATE GY_IDENTITY SET VALUE = VALUE + 1
	Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN // update失败，判断是否存在记录
	SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_Count > 0 THEN // 记录碊AT*
嬖诩绦鴘pdate(最多三次)
		ll_Retry ++
		IF ll_Retry >= 3 THEN
			as_error = '获取序列号出错：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		ELSE
			Gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
			GOTO Process_Begin
		END IF
	ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
		INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
			Values ('ZHYB_JZXLH',1101,1101,1) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN 
			as_error = '插入序列号出错：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		end if
		ll_Value = 1101
		GOTO Process_Success
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_Count > 0 THEN
	ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
		INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
			Values ('ZHYB_JZXLH',1101,1,1) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN 
			as_error = '插入序列号出错2：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		end if
		ll_Value = 1101
		GOTO Process_Success
	END IF
END IF

SetNull(ll_Value)
SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
	Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	
IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN GOTO Process_Error
IF ll_Value < 1101 THEN GOTO Process_Error

Process_Success:
gf_Commit_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
as_jzxlh = String(ll_Value)
RETURN 1

Process_Error:
gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer of_update_jsmx (string as_jylsh, str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_update_jsmx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 本地更新医保结算明细表
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_jsjylsh    	
// 	value    	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx	
// 	reference	string       	as_error    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  本地更新医保结算明细表
//====================================================================

DateTime ldt_curr,ldt_jssj
ldt_curr = gf_server_date()
u_dataStore lds_jsmxkz
ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',ldt_curr,2)
if ldt_jssj > astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj and date(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj) >= date(2000,1,1) then
	ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj,2)
end if
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh,ls_ywlx,ls_bzxx
integer li_jscs
Dec{0} ld_zyh,ld_jllsh
//获取病人编码或住院号
SELECT jlxh,brbm,zyh,ywlsh,ywlx,jscs INTO :ld_jllsh,:ls_brbm,:ld_zyh,:ls_ywlsh,:ls_ywlx,:li_jscs FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	WHERE JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh And JZID = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID And ROWNUM = 1  Using itran_sqlca ;

Long ll_i, ll_upperBound, ll_find

// 构建 结算明细基金分项 更新表
lds_jsmxkz = Create u_dataStore
lds_jsmxkz.DataObject = "d_zhyb_jsmxkz"
lds_jsmxkz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF lds_jsmxkz.Retrieve(as_jylsh, astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端�拷崴愠晒Γ�但检索结算明细基金分项表失败� " + lds_jsmxkz.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_bzxx = of_midstring(astr_zhyl_jsxx.exp_content,300)
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

// 1.更新 费用明细上传表
IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 then
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ+1 Where JZID = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9) Using itran_sqlca;
else
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ+1 Where JZID = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9) Using itran_sqlca;
end if
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】结算成功，但更新费用明细上传表失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
//	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ld_zyh > 0 THEN //modify by sxl 2015-3-10 住院预结信息中增加ztbz用于区分是否已经结算了
	UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Set ZTBZ = :li_jscs Where zyh = :ld_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
// 2.更新 结算明细表
//UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Set ZTBZ = 1, JSLSH = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JSID Where JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh And JZID = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID Using itran_sqlca;
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	Set JSLSH = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JSID, 
		 YLRYLB = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_type,
		 GWYBZ = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cvlserv_flag,
		 XZLX = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.xzlx,
		 YLFZE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.ylfze,
		 QZFJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.qzfje,
		 CXJZFFY = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.CXJZFFY,
		 XXZFUJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.XXZFJE,
		 FHZCFWJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.fhzcfwje,
		 SJZFQFX = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.SJZFQFX,
		 JBYLBXTCJJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbylbxtcjj,
		 JBYLBXTCJJZFBL = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbylbxtcjjbl,
		 GWYYLBZZJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.gwyylbzzj,
		 QYBCYLBXJJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.qybcylbxjj,
		 JMDBBXZJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jmdbbxzj,
		 ZGDEYLFYBZJJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.zgdeylfybz,
		 YLJZJJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.YLJZJJ,
		 YYFDJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.YYFDJE,
		 QTZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.QTZC,
		 JJZFZE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JJZFZE,
		 GRFDZJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.GRFDZJE,
		 GRZHZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.grzhzc,
		 GRXJZC = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.grxjzc,
		 YE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.YE,
		 GRZHGJZFJE = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.grzhgjzfje,
		 QSJBJG = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbjg,
		 QSFS = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.QSFS,
		 QSLB = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.QSLB,
		 ZTBZ = 1 ,
		 bzxx = :ls_bzxx
 Where JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh And JZID = :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN //Not (itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1)
	as_error = "【医保端】结算成功，更新结算明细表失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
//	RETURN -1
else
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF

// 3.更新 结算明细基金分项表
//UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX_KZ SET ZTBZ=1, JSLSH=:astr_zhyl_jsxx.JSID Where JYLSH=:as_jylsh and JZID=:astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID Using itran_sqlca ;  // 原先的更新语句
ll_upperBound = UpperBound(astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx)
IF ll_upperBound > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_upperBound Step 1
		IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].JSGCXX) THEN astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].JSGCXX = ''
		IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflx) THEN astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflx = ''
		IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflxmc) THEN astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflxmc = ''
		ll_find = lds_jsmxKZ.Find(" (JJZFLX='"+astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflx+"' and JJZFLXMC='"+astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflxmc+"' and JSGCXX='"+astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].JSGCXX+"') ", 1, lds_jsmxKZ.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 0 THEN
			CONTINUE;
		ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
			ll_find = lds_jsmxKZ.InsertRow(0)
		END IF
	
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JZID[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JSLSH[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.JSID
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.jjzflx[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflx
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.FHZCFWJE[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].FHZCFWJE
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.BCKZFXEJE[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].BCKZFXEJE
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JJZFJE[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].JJZFJE
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.jjzflxmc[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].jjzflxmc
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JSGCXX[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_i].JSGCXX
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.ZTBZ[ll_find] = 1
		lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JYLSH[ll_find] = as_jylsh
		if not isnull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj ) and date(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj ) > date(2000,1,1) then
			lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JSSJ[ll_find] = astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj
		else
			lds_jsmxKZ.Object.JSSJ[ll_find] = ldt_curr
		end if
	NEXT
END IF
IF lds_jsmxKZ.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】结算成功，更新基金分项表失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + lds_jsmxKZ.is_error + " 更新列:" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
//	RETURN -1
END IF

IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	IF This.of_update_tsjl( ls_brbm, ld_zyh,li_jscs, ls_ywlx, ls_ywlsh, astr_zhyl_jsxx.gbbjzf,astr_zhyl_jsxx.JSid, astr_zhyl_jsxx.jzid,as_error) < 0 THEN
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)


RETURN 0
end function

public function integer uf_ryddbacx (string as_dysbmxlsh, string as_grbh, string as_bzxx, ref string as_error, boolean ab_returnerror);//====================================================================

// 	value    	string 	as_bzxx       	
// 	reference	string 	as_error      	
// 	value    	boolean	ab_returnerror		 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返籇AT*
:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  人员定点备案撤销
//====================================================================

IF isnull(as_dysbmxlsh) or Trim(as_dysbmxlsh)="" Then
	as_error = "待遇申报明细流水号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
	goto Error
END IF

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF isnull(as_bzxx) Then as_bzxx=""
IF Lenw(as_bzxx)>500 Then
	as_error = "撤销原因超过500字，请简略内容！(当前"+String(Lenw(as_bzxx))+"字)"
	goto Error
END IF

this.uf_send_init('2506')
this.uf_send_add('trt_dcla_detl_sn', as_dysbmxlsh)  // 待遇申报明细流水号
this.uf_send_add('psn_no', as_grbh)						 // 人员编号
this.uf_send_add('memo', as_bzxx)					    // 备注


// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error, "") Then
	goto Error
END IF
	

// 成功后回写HIS
// 若 2505-人员定点备案 医保单边成功，调用该函数进行冲正交易时，只需医保端成功即可
IF ab_returnError=False Then
	return 1
END IF

IF Trim(as_bzxx)>"" Then
	as_bzxx = "||撤销原因：" + as_bzxx
END IF

// 1.优先更新状态，若事务出错需要返回错误
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
Update JKXT.ZHYB_RYDDBAMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where DYSBLSH = :as_dysbmxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode=0 Then
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】人员备案撤销成功，但更新人员备案明细表失败，请联系信息科处理。错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollBack_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	goto Error
END IF

// 2.再更新备注信息，若事务出错则无视
Update JKXT.ZHYB_RYDDBAMX Set BZXX=BZXX||:as_bzxx Where DYSBLSH=:as_dysbmxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode=0 Then
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
ELSE
	gf_rollBack_transaction(itran_sqlca)
END IF
	


return 1

Error:
as_error = "[2506-人员定点备案撤销] " + as_error
return -1

end function

public function integer uf_ryddba (string as_ywlx, string as_mzzygrbm, string as_baywsqlx, date ad_ksrq, date ad_jsrq, string as_bzxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_ryddba()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 人员定点备案
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlx    	
// 	value    	string  	as_mzzygrbm	 病人编码/住院号码
// 	value    	string  	as_baywsqlx  业务申请类型：01-门诊慢特病登记、13-生育备案登记、......
// 	value    	date  	ad_ksrq    	
// 	value    	date  	ad_jsrq    	
// 	value    	string  	as_bzxx    	
// 	reference	string  	as_error   	 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  人员定点备案
//====================================================================

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_ywlx) or Trim(as_ywlx)="" Then
	as_error = "业务类型为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(as_mzzygrbm) or Trim(as_mzzygrbm)="" Then
	as_error = "病人编码/住院号码为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(as_baywsqlx) or Trim(as_baywsqlx)="" Then
	as_error = "备案业务申请类型为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ad_ksrq) or ad_ksrq<Date(2000,1,1) Then
	as_error = "开始时间为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ad_jsrq) or ad_jsrq<Date(2000,1,1) Then
	as_error = "结束时间为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF as_ywlx<>'MZ' AND as_ywlx<>'ZY' Then
	as_error = "业务类型有误：" + as_ywlx
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(as_bzxx) Then as_bzxx=""
IF Lenw(as_bzxx)>500 Then
	as_error = "备注信息超过500字，请简略内容！(当前"+String(Lenw(as_bzxx))+"字)"
	goto Error
END IF

String ls_grbh           // 人员编号
String ls_lxdh, ls_lxdz  // 联系电话、联系地址
String ls_ddpxh='01'     // 定点排序号
String ls_dysbmxlsh      // 待遇申报明细流水号

String ls_zyhm, ls_brbm
Long ll_count, ll_zyh

// 获取 门诊/住院基本信息
IF as_ywlx='MZ' Then
	ls_brbm = as_mzzygrbm
	Select MZ_BRDA.yddh, MZ_BRDA.lxdz, YB_BRJBXX.GRBH
     into 	  :ls_lxdh,     :ls_lxdz,       :ls_grbh
     From MZXT.MZ_BRDA, JKXT.YB_BRJBXX
    Where MZ_BRDA.BRBM=:ls_brbm and MZ_BRDA.JZKH=YB_BRJBXX.KNSJ(+)
    Using itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_ywlx='ZY' Then
	ls_zyhm = as_mzzygrbm
	Select ZY_BRRY.lxdh, ZY_BRRY.lxdz, ZHYB_ZYDJMX.GRBH, ZY_BRRY.ZYH
     into     :ls_lxdh,     :ls_lxdz,         :ls_grbh, 		:ll_zyh
     From BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ, JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
    Where ZY_BRRY.ZYHM=:ls_zyhm AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH=ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH AND ZY_BRRY_KZ.YBJZBH=ZHYB_ZYDJMX.JZID(+)
    Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取门诊/住院基本信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+")" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_lxdh) Then ls_lxdh=""
IF isnull(ls_lxdz) Then ls_lxdz=""
IF isnull(ls_grbh) or Trim(ls_grbh)="" Then
	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	IF isnull(ls_grbh) or Trim(ls_grbh)="" Then
		as_error = "人员编号为空！请重新读卡！"
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

// 获取定点排序号
// ls_ddpxh

this.uf_send_init('2505')
this.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)					// 人员编号
this.uf_send_add('tel', ls_lxdh)						// 联系电话
this.uf_send_add('addr', ls_lxdz)					// 联系地址
this.uf_send_add('biz_appy_type', as_baywsqlx)	// 业务申请类型
this.uf_send_add('begndate', ad_ksrq)				// 开始日期
this.uf_send_add('enddate', ad_jsrq)				// 结束日期
this.uf_send_add('agnter_name', '')				   // 代办人姓名
this.uf_send_add('agnter_cert_type', '')		   // 代办人证件类型
this.uf_send_add('agnter_certno', '')				// 代办人证件号码
this.uf_send_add('agnter_tel', '')					// 代办人联系方式
this.uf_send_add('agnter_addr', '')					// 代办人联系地址
this.uf_send_add('agnter_rlts', '')					// 代办人关系
this.uf_send_add('fix_srt_no', ls_ddpxh)			// 定点排序号
this.uf_send_add('fixmedins_code', is_yljgdm)	// 定点医药机构编号
this.uf_send_add('fixmedins_name', is_yljgmc)	// 定点医药机构名称
this.uf_send_add('memo', as_bzxx)					// 备注



// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error, '') Then
	goto Error
END IF
	
// 成功后回写HIS
ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'result')
IF ll_count<=0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】人员备案办理成功，但获取医保返回内容为空，请联系信息科处理。"
	goto Error
ELSEIF ll_count>1 THen
	as_error = "【医保端】人员备案办理成功，但获取医保返回内容存在多条，请联系信息科处理。"
	goto Error
END IF

ls_dysbmxlsh = This.uf_getstring_in('trt_dcla_detl_sn', ll_count)  // 待遇申报明细流水号
IF isnull(ls_dysbmxlsh) or Trim(ls_dysbmxlsh)='' Then
	as_error = "【医保端】人员备案办理成功，但获取待遇申报明细流水号为空，请联系信息科处理。"
	goto Error
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
Select Count(1) into :ll_count From JKXT.ZHYB_RYDDBAMX Where (brbm=:as_mzzygrbm or zyh=:as_mzzygrbm) and DYSBLSH=:ls_dysbmxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
IF ll_count>0 Then
	Update JKXT.ZHYB_RYDDBAMX
		Set YWLX=:as_ywlx, YWSQLX=:as_baywsqlx, KSRQ=:ad_ksrq, JSRQ=:ad_jsrq, DDPXH=:ls_ddpxh, BZXX=:as_bzxx, ZTBZ=1
	 Where DYSBLSH=:ls_dysbmxlsh
	 Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	Insert into JKXT.ZHYB_RYDDBAMX(      DYSBLSH,     YWLX,     GRBH,     BRBM,     ZYH,       YWSQLX,     KSRQ,     JSRQ,     DDPXH,     BZXX, ZTBZ)
									Values(:ls_dysbmxlsh, :as_ywlx, :ls_grbh, :ls_brbm, :ll_zyh, :as_baywsqlx, :ad_ksrq, :ad_jsrq, :ls_ddpxh, :as_bzxx,    1)
	Using itran_sqlca;
END IF

IF itran_sqlca.sqlCode=0 Then
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】人员备案办理成功，但新增\更新人员备案明细表失败，请联系信息科处理。错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	goto Error_ybRollBack
END IF
	


return 1


Error_ybRollBack:
String ls_bzxx_temp, ls_error_temp
// 调用“2506-人员定点备案撤销”，作废本次备案
IF This.uf_ryddbacx(ls_dysbmxlsh, ls_grbh, ls_bzxx_temp, ref ls_error_temp, False)<0 Then
	as_error = as_error + ls_error_temp
END IF


Error:
IF as_ywlx='MZ' Then
	as_error = "[2505-人员定点备案] 病人编码：" + as_mzzygrbm + " " + as_error
ELSEIF as_ywlx='ZY' Then
	as_error = "[2505-人员定点备癉AT* 竇 住院号码：" + as_mzzygrbm + " " + as_error
ELSE
	as_error = "[2505-人员定点备案] " + as_error
END IF

return -1

end function

public function integer of_zy_fymx_gbbjcwcf (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_ybjk_new_his.of_zy_fymx_gbbjcwcf
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 将干部保健病人的床位费根据限额进行拆分
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long        al_zyh  住院号
//		reference   string      error
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	zbq		日期: 2021.05.11
//====================================================================


//一、正厅、副厅级保健对象住院享受双人病房待遇。
//每日床位费报销限额如下：
//学院路院区、康复院区：90元/日； 
//龙湾院区、瓯江口院区：180元/日。
//二、重点保健对象+“副省标准报销”的保健对象住院时可享受单人病房待遇。
//每日床位费报销限额为500元/日。
if this.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 then
	as_error = '干保床位限额控制：' + is_error
	return -1
end if
Int  li_count,li_ssyy,li_maxdatarow,i,li_datarow
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_yzxh,ll_fysl
String ls_name,ls_value,ls_brch,ls_bjdx,ls_dataname,ls_jlxh,ls_xe,ls_sfzh,ls_Brxm,ls_GBBJ_CWFXE,ls_cwxe[]
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_zfje

String ls_bm, ls_bz
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_fysl, ldc_zfbl, ldc_xelj, ldc_cfje, ldc_cfsl, ldc_fyxe, ldc_yhje, ldc_yhdj, ldc_yhcfje

Decimal{2} ldc_fylj_cq, ldc_zflj_cq //强制自费部分的zjje累计，用于检验负金额是否拆分
Decimal{0} ldc_jlxh
Long ll_fyxh,ll_bjdx,ll_brbq
Integer li_spbz
Decimal{0} ll_mxnum, ll_findmx, ll_count, ll_insert, ll_cwfmxnum

u_datastore lds_fymx_cf //用于住院费用明细zy_fymx的拆分和提交。
lds_fymx_cf = Create u_datastore
lds_fymx_cf.DataObject = 'd_yb_zyfymx_cf'
lds_fymx_cf.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ll_mxnum = lds_fymx_cf.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_mxnum = 0 THEN // 没有未结算的明细
	RETURN 0
END IF

SELECT brxm,sfzh,brch,brbq Into :ls_Brxm,:ls_sfzh,:ls_brch,:ll_brbq From zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or IsNull(ls_Brxm) THEN
	as_error = "取干部保健个人信息失败"
	RETURN -1
END IF
SELECT count(1) Into :ll_bjdx From mzxt.cw_yhzc_kz Where zclsh = 47 And lxbm = :ls_sfzh And brxm = :ls_Brxm And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
//存在数值为重点保健对象+“窪AT*
笔”曜急ㄏ


//SELECT brch Into: ls_brch From zy_cwsz Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT count(fjhm) Into:li_count From zy_cwsz Where fjhm In (SELECT fjhm From zy_cwsz Where brch = :ls_brch) Group By fjhm Using itran_sqlca;
//等于1时 为单人房
IF li_count < 0 THEN
	as_error = "取干部保健床位性质失败"
	RETURN -1
END IF

ls_GBBJ_CWFXE = (gf_GetPara(0,"GBBJ_CWFXE","500,180,90","干部保健床位费限额"))
ll_count = gf_splitparm(ls_GBBJ_CWFXE,ls_cwxe[])
IF ll_count < 0 THEN
	as_error = "取干部床位费限制金额失败"
	RETURN -1
END IF

lds_fymx_cf.SetFilter("fyxh=2455")
lds_fymx_cf.Filter()

IF lds_fymx_cf.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	FOR i = 1 To lds_fymx_cf.RowCount()
		ldc_zjje = lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i]
		ldc_jlxh = lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[i]
		IF ll_bjdx > 0 THEN //ll_bjdx >0 '重点保健对象+“副省标准报销”'
			IF li_count = 1 THEN
				IF ldc_zjje > Dec(ls_cwxe[1]) THEN
					ldc_zfje = Dec(ldc_zjje - Dec(ls_cwxe[1]))
					ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i]
					IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
						ls_bz = ''
					END IF
					lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(i, i, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, i + 1, Primary!)
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[1])
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[1])
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i] = lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i]*lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfbl[i]
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[1]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
					
					ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(itran_sqlca, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[i+1] = ldc_jlxh
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.fyxh[i+1] = 2456
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.fymc[i+1] = '床位补费'
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i+1] = ldc_zfje
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[i+1] = 9
					lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[1]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
					i++
					
				ELSE
					CONTINUE;
				END IF
				
			END IF
			
		ELSE //ll_bjdx <0 '正厅、副厅级保健对象' 
			IF li_count = 1 Or li_count = 2  THEN //单人房双人房都按照双人房最高限额报销
				SELECT ssyy Into:li_ssyy From gy_ksdm Where ksdm = :ll_brbq Using itran_sqlca;
//				In(SELECT ksdm From zy_cwsz Where brch = :ls_brch) Using itran_sqlca;
				//2学院西路 3儿童 4龙湾 5瓯江口 6南浦 7康复病区 8叶同仁 9台州 11龙湾康复院区
				IF li_ssyy <= 0 THEN
					as_error = "取所属医訢AT* "
					RETURN -1
				END IF
				IF li_ssyy = 2 Or li_ssyy = 11 THEN
					IF ldc_zjje > Dec(ls_cwxe[3]) THEN
						ldc_zfje = Dec(ldc_zjje -Dec(ls_cwxe[3]) )
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(i, i, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, i + 1, Primary!)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[3])
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[3])
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i] = lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i]*lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfbl[i]
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[3]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(itran_sqlca, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[i+1] = ldc_jlxh
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fyxh[i+1] = 2456
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fymc[i+1] = '床位补费'
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[i+1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[3]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						i++
					ELSE
						CONTINUE;
					END IF
				ELSEIF li_ssyy = 4 Or li_ssyy = 5 THEN
					IF ldc_zjje > Dec(ls_cwxe[2]) THEN
						ldc_zfje = Dec(ldc_zjje -Dec(ls_cwxe[2]) )
						ls_bz = lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i]
						IF IsNull(ls_bz) THEN
							ls_bz = ''
						END IF
						lds_fymx_cf.RowsCopy(i, i, Primary!, lds_fymx_cf, i + 1, Primary!)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[2])
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i] = Dec(ls_cwxe[2])
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i] = lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i]*lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfbl[i]
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i + 1] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[2]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						
						ldc_jlxh = gf_get_max(itran_sqlca, "ZY_FYMX", 1)
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.jlxh[i+1] = ldc_jlxh
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fyxh[i+1] = 2456
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fymc[i+1] = '床位补费'
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.fydj[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zjje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.zfje[i+1] = ldc_zfje
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.spbz[i+1] = 9
						lds_fymx_cf.Object.bz[i] = gf_midstring(ls_bz + "|干部保健床位费分为限额:"+ls_cwxe[2]+",自费金额:"+String(ldc_zfje)+",关联jlxh:"+ String(ldc_jlxh), 100)
						i++
					ELSE
						CONTINUE;
					END IF
				END IF
				
			END IF
			
		END IF
		
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		IF lds_fymx_cf.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			as_error = "住院费用明细zy_fymx保存失败。" + lds_fymx_cf.is_error
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
		
	NEXT
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF






end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 病区用住院登记
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_jls_datavalue
ls_datatype
ls_recieve
li_datarow
zbh 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271    病区用住院登记
//====================================================================

//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_count
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jsrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch //,ls_kssj

// 取 住院基本信息
SELECT     KNXX,     BRKS,      RYRQ,     ZYHM,     BRCH,     BAHM,     ZZYS,      JSRQ
  INTO :ls_knsj, :ll_ksdm, :ldt_ryrq, :ls_zyhm, :ls_brch, :ls_bahm, :ls_ysbm, :ldt_jsrq
  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY 
 Where ZYH=:al_zyh 
 Using sqlca;
IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
	END IF
END IF

RETURN uf_zydj(ref ls_knsj, ll_ksdm, al_zyh, ldt_ryrq, ls_zyhm, ls_brch, ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, '1', ref as_jzbh, ref as_error)

end function

public function boolean of_receive_data_yd (string as_xxtlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);TRY
	//返回数据的判断
	IF IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '' THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson //lsjson2,lsjson_a
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson.parse_sb(as_xxt)
	//分解社保直接返回的消息体
	ids_receive_in.Reset()
	ids_receive.Reset()
	ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
	
	
	Int li_jdcount,li_jd,li_row,li_rec
	Decimal li_datavalue
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr
	Any lany_return[],la_data
	Boolean lb_xht = False,lb_exists
	
//   lsjson2 = lsjson.getattribute('output')
	//li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count_data(is_xxtlx,'YD') //data部分无循环
	li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD')
	IF li_jdcount > 0 THEN
		FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount
			ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd )
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				lb_xht = True
			ELSE
//				IF Not IsValid(lsjson_a) THEN
//					lsjson_a = lsjson.getattribute( 'data')
//				END IF
				li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
				la_data = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname,lb_exists) 
				if not lb_exists then
					setnull(ls_datavalue)
				else
					IF isnull(la_data) Then
						IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
							ls_datavalue = ''
						else
							ls_datavalue = of_numformat(0,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
						end if
					ELSE						
						IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
							ls_datavalue = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname)
	//						ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
	//						ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
	//						ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
						ELSE
							ls_datavalue = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname)
							li_datavalue = dec(ls_datavalue)
							ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
	//						ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
	//						ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
	//						ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
					  END IF
					end if
				end if
				ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
				ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
				ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF lb_xht THEN li_rec = of_receivein_data(as_xxtlx,lsjson,as_return)
		if li_rec = -1 then 
			return false
		end if
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
RETURN True
end function

public function string of_replace_sb (string as_string);
/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"\",'\\\\')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'"','\"')
Long	ll_pos ,ll_len,ll_pos1,ll_pos2
String ls_find
ll_pos1 = posw(as_string,'\\\\')
ll_pos2 = posw(as_string,'\"')
IF ll_pos1 > 0 Or ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
	IF ll_pos1 = 0 THEN
		ls_find = '\"'
		ll_len = 1
		DO
			IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, 1 )
			ELSE
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
			END IF
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos,Lenw(ls_find),'"')
			END IF
		LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
	ELSE
		ll_pos = 0
		ls_find = '\\\\'
		ll_len = 1
		DO
			IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, 1 )
			ELSE
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
			END IF
			ll_pos1 = ll_pos
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos,Lenw(ls_find),'\')
				IF ll_pos2 > 0 And ll_pos1 > ll_pos2 THEN
					DO
						IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
							as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos2,2,'"')
						END IF
						ll_pos2 = Posw(as_string , '\"', ll_pos2 + 1 )						
					LOOP WHILE ll_pos2 > 0 and ll_pos2 < ll_pos
				END IF
				ll_pos2 = posw(as_string,'\"' , ll_pos + ll_len)
			END IF
		LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
		IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
			DO
				IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
					as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos2,Lenw(ls_find),'"')
				END IF
				ll_pos2 = Posw(as_string , '\"', ll_pos2 + 1 )
			LOOP WHILE ll_pos2 > 0
		END IF
	END IF
END IF



RETURN as_string




end function

public function boolean uf_send_zj (string as_xxlx, string as_json, ref string as_output);Integer li_ret,li_xhxh
String ls_jylsh,ls_datetime
DateTime ldt_server

SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval,to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),sysdate Into :li_xhxh,:ls_datetime,:ldt_server From dual Using itran_sqlca;

ls_jylsh = is_yljgdm + ls_datetime + Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)

IF IsNull(as_json) Or as_json = '' THEN
	as_output = '消息体类型为空'
	RETURN False
END IF

TRY
	ib_sz = False
	Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_recieve,ls_mxnr,ls_jmc, ls_temp
	Long ll_xhcs
	Boolean lb_xhcs
	
	ls_send = as_json
	
	gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ Upper(as_xxlx)+']发送序列ID:' + ls_jylsh +'  发送:'+ls_send )
	
	//加密
	ls_jmc = Space(1024)
	li_ret = ZJ_Hmac_SM3( is_yljgdm, is_secret,'', ls_send, ls_jmc)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_output = ls_jmc
		RETURN False
	END IF
	//post 发送
	ls_recieve = Space(1024 * 32)
	li_ret = This.uf_post_zj(as_xxlx, ls_send,ls_jmc, ls_recieve)
	gf_sblog('c:\sblog','接口号：['+ Upper(as_xxlx)+']发送序列ID:' + ls_jylsh +'  返回:'+ls_recieve )
	DEBUGBREAK()
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		as_output = ls_recieve
		RETURN False
	ELSE
		as_output = ls_recieve
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_output = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY

return true
end function

public function integer uf_post_zj (string as_xxlx, string as_send, string as_jmc, ref string as_return);Integer li_ret
String ls_url_post
IF Not IsValid(in_commontoolsoap) THEN
	soapconnection ln_soapconn
	ln_soapconn = Create soapconnection
	ls_url_post = is_url_post + '?WSDL'
	li_ret = ln_soapconn.CreateInstance(in_commontoolsoap, "commontoolsoap",is_url_post)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '创建连接POST,WEBS失败!URL=' + is_url_post + " ret=" + String(li_ret)
		IF IsValid(ln_soapconn) THEN Destroy ln_soapconn
		RETURN -5
	END IF
END IF
DEBUGBREAK()
TRY
	String ls_url_send,ls_jkdz,ls_hearder,ls_temp
	blob lb_return
	as_return = Space(10240 * 10)
//	ls_jkdz = This.of_get_jklx_mxsm( 'JKDZ', 'QQ', as_xxlx)
	SELECT MXSM INTO :ls_jkdz FROM JKXT.YB_JKLXMX WHERE YBFL='ZHYL' AND JKLX='JKDZ' AND MXNR = :as_xxlx USING itran_sqlca;
	IF ls_jkdz > '' THEN
	ELSE
		as_return = as_xxlx + '获取对应的接緿AT* 诘刂烦龃恚 '
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_url_send = 'http://' + is_url + ls_jkdz
	IF Pos(as_jmc,":") > 0 THEN
		as_jmc = Mid(as_jmc,Pos(as_jmc,":"))
	END IF
	ls_hearder = '{"ContentType":"application/json","x-ca-key":"'+is_yljgdm+'","x-ca-signature":"'+as_jmc+'"}'
	li_ret =  in_commontoolsoap.dohttpmethodsep( ls_url_send,'Post',as_send, ls_hearder, "application/json-patch+json",as_return)
//	lb_return = blob(as_return)
//	lb_return = ToAnsi(as_return)
//	ls_temp = string(lb_return)	
//	long ll_UTF8_size
//long ll_Unicode_Byte_size, ll_Unicode_size
//setnull(lblb null)
//1l UTF8 size = len(ablb UTF8)
////获取转换后需要的内存空间1l Unicode wchar size = MultiByteTowidechar(cp UTf8, 0, ablb UTF8, 1l UTF8 size, lblb null, @)if ll Unicode wchar size <1 thenreturn 
//end if
//1l Unicode Byte size =ll Unicode wchar size *2ablb Unicode =blob(space(ll Unicode Byte size))
////开始转换11 unicode wchar size = MultiByteTowidechar(cp uTf8, 0, ablb UTF8, 1l UTF8 size, ablb Unicode, ll unicode Byte size)if 1l Unicode wchar size < 1 thenreturn 0
//end if
//return ll Unicode Byte size	
	
	is_post_return = as_return
	//	gf_sblog('c:\sblog',"url_send:  " + ls_url_send + 'asend: ' + as_send + 'hearder:' + ls_hearder)
	//	{"Method":"Post","Url":"http://202.202.3.58:8088/api/DiagScreen/DiagroomCallNum","Data":"{'diagroomid':'LB-8','mode':'0'}","Header":"application/json","ContentType":"application/json"}
	RETURN li_ret
Catch (Throwable err) // 异常捕捉
	as_return = "调用POST失败：" + err.Text  + ' URL=' + is_url_post + " input=" + as_send
	RETURN -4
END TRY
RETURN 1
end function

private function string of_numformat (decimal ad_datavalue, string as_datatype);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_numformat()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据decimal数据格式类型，返回指定格式的字符串
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	decimal	ad_datavalue	指定的数值
// 	value	string 	as_datatype 	指定的数值格式('da','db','dc','dd')				
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.8.3
//====================================================================
Integer li_1 = 0
String ls_format
//'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg'
//,'dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
IF IsNull(ad_datavalue) THEN RETURN ''
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'da','db','df','dj','dk','dl','dn' //，2位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.00')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.00')
		END IF
	CASE 'de','dg' //3位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dd','dh','di' //4位小数
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0000')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0000')
		END IF
	CASE 'dc'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0.0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0.0')
		END IF
	CASE 'dm'
		IF ad_datavalue < 0 THEN
			RETURN '-'+String(Abs(ad_datavalue),'0')
		ELSE
			RETURN String(ad_datavalue,'0')
		END IF
END CHOOSE



end function

	If (Pos(is_fcbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 And ls_yllb <> '52') Or (as_rylx = '12' Or as_rylx = '15') THEN // 生育住院
		// 苍南、平阳、台州由于妇科产科病人混住，所以必须根据分娩方式是否维护来判断是否属于生育住院
		//		IF Pos(base_info.Hospital,'苍南') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'平阳') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'台州') > 0 THEN
		IF Pos(base_info.Hospital,'平阳') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'台州') > 0 THEN
			SELECT nvl(FMFS,'') Into :ls_sylb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = "获取分娩方式失败：["+String(atr_trans.SQLCode)+"]" + atr_trans.SQLErrText
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			IF ls_sylb > '0' THEN
				ls_yllb = '52'
			ELSE
				ls_sylb = ''
			END IF
			// 如果是保胎，则走普通住院
			SELECT dmmc Into :ls_dmmc From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = '2635' And dmsb = :ls_sylb Using atr_trans;
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 And ls_dmmc > '' THEN
				IF Pos(ls_dmmc, "保胎") > 0 THEN
					ls_sylb = ''
					ls_yllb = '21'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			// 如果根据分娩方式找不到，则根据准生证号再判断一次
			IF ls_yllb <> '52' THEN
				ll_count = 0
				SELECT Count(1) Into :ll_count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					ls_yllb = '52'
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			//			ls_yllb = '52' //hw 2023/05/30 注释
			//本部也需要生育住院登记 使用其他三个医院判断方法
			SELECT nvl(FMFS,'') Into :ls_sylb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = "获取分娩方式失败：["+String(atr_trans.SQLCode)+"]" + atr_trans.SQLErrText
				GOTO Error
			END IF
			IF ls_sylb > '0' THEN
				ls_yllb = '52'
			ELSE
				ls_sylb = ''
			END IF
			// 如果是保胎，则走普通住院
			SELECT dmmc Into :ls_dmmc From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb = '2635' And dmsb = :ls_sylb Using atr_trans;
			IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 And ls_dmmc > '' THEN
				IF Pos(ls_dmmc, "保胎") > 0 THEN
					ls_sylb = ''
					ls_yllb = '21'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			// 如果根据分娩方式找不到，则根据准生证号再判断一次
			IF ls_yllb <> '52' THEN
				ll_count = 0
				SELECT Count(1) Into :ll_count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					ls_yllb = '52'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		// 温州的生育按项目结算，医疗类别不能传入52-生育住院，而蔇AT*
21-普通住院
		IF ii_zhyb_sybxtscl = 1 THEN
			ls_sylb = ''
			ls_yllb = '21'
		END IF
	ELSEIF Pos(is_xtbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 And Left(ls_cbdybqh,4) = '3303' THEN // 血透病区 20230110医保局回复暂时支持温州，不支持其他地区
		ls_yllb = '9933'
	ELSEIF Pos(is_lgks, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0 THEN // 留观病区
		IF ii_jzlgms = 1 and  date(adt_ryrq) > id_jzqyrq  THEN
			as_error = '急诊留观应走门诊结算，登记有误，请联系信息中心!'
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			ls_yllb = '210104'
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN  ls_yllb = '21'
// modify by sxl 20240625如果普通住院时24小时内有急诊留观记录那么走急诊住院210104
IF ii_jzlgms = 1 And  ls_yllb = '21'  and  date(adt_ryrq) > id_jzqyrq THEN
	ll_count = 0
	ll_count = of_lgzy(1,adt_ryrq,al_zyh,atr_trans)
	if ll_count > 0 then
		ls_yllb = '210104'
	end if
END IF
// 获取 住院号
// 用于计数，解决住院号码撤销登记不能用问题2017-6-13
SELECT jsdh Into :ll_jsdh From BQXT.ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 And ll_jsdh >= 1 THEN
	ll_jsdh = ll_jsdh + 1
	as_zyhm = as_zyhm + "-" + String(ll_jsdh)
END IF

// 获取 病历号
IF IsNull(as_blhm) THEN as_blhm = ''

// 获取 主治医生编码、主诊医生姓名
ls_zzysbm = as_ysbm
IF of_get_ygxm(ls_zzysbm, Ref ls_zzysxm, Ref ls_zzyssfzh, True,Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取主诊医生姓名失败：" + as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_zzysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
			as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_zzysbm = ls_ysbm_gjm
	END IF
END IF
// 获取 入院科室编码、入院科室名称
ls_ryksbm = String(al_ksdm)
IF Trim(ls_ryksbm) = '' Or IsNull(al_ksdm) Or al_ksdm = 0 THEN
	as_error = '取不到对应的科室，请确认是否分配主治医生！'
	GOTO Error
END IF

//ls_ryksbm =

// 获取 入院诊断描述、入院主诊断代码、入院主诊断名称、入院诊断代码列表、入院诊断名称列表
IF This.of_get_zy_zdxx( al_zyh, 1, Ref ls_zzddm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_ryzdms, Ref lsArr_zddms, Ref lsArr_zdmcs, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '诊断获取失败！' + as_error
	RETURN -1

IF IsNull(ls_bzmc) THEN ls_bzmc = ''

IF IsNull(ls_ssczdm) THEN ls_ssczdm = ''
IF IsNull(ls_ssczmc) THEN ls_ssczmc = ''
// 获取 险种类型、计划生育服务证号、生育类别、计划生育手术类别、晚育标志、孕周数、胎次、胎儿数、早产标志、计划生育手术或生育日期
If (ls_yllb = '52' Or ls_yllb = '2106') THEN
	// 险种类型
	//	ls_xzlx = '510' // 生育保险	
	// 生育类别
	ls_sylb = of_get_dzdmsb("ZHYL_SYLB", ls_sylb)
	IF IsNull(ls_sylb) Or Trim(ls_sylb) = '无' Or Trim(ls_sylb) = "" THEN
		as_error = "生育住院必须填写生育类别，请联系医生填写分娩方式或检查填写是否正确！"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	
	// 生育日期
	SELECT Min(CSRQ) Into :ld_JHSYSSSYRQ From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_YE Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
	
	// 晚育标志
	ldc_age = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.age
	IF IsNull(ldc_age) Or ldc_age < 1 THEN
		ldc_age = Year(Today()) - Year(ld_csrq)
	END IF
	IF ldc_age > 24 THEN
		ls_wybz = '1'
	ELSE
		ls_wybz = '0'
	END IF
	
	// 孕周
	ldc_id = al_zyh * 100
	SELECT JG Into :ls_cbzd From YSZ1.E_ZYBLNRL1 Where ID = :ldc_id And DM = '4601' Using atr_trans;
	IF Trim(ls_cbzd) > "" THEN
		li_pos_zhou = Posw(ls_cbzd, "周+")
		IF li_pos_zhou > 0 THEN
			ls_yzs = Midw(ls_cbzd, li_pos_zhou - 2, 2)
			IF IsNumber(ls_yzs) = False THEN
				ls_yzs = ""
			END IF
		ELSE
			li_pos_yun = Posw(ls_cbzd, "孕")
			IF Mod(li_pos_yun, 2) > 0 THEN
				li_pos_yun++
			END IF
			li_pos_zhou = Posw(ls_cbzd, "周", li_pos_yun)
			IF li_pos_zhou - li_pos_yun = 2 THEN
				ls_yzs = Midw(ls_cbzd, li_pos_yun, 2)
				IF IsNumber(ls_yzs) = False THEN
					ls_yzs = ""
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	
	// 早产标志
	IF Integer(ls_yzs) > 0 And Integer(ls_yzs) < 37 THEN
		ls_zcbz = "1"
	ELSE
		ls_zcbz = "0"
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jhsyfwzh) THEN ls_jhsyfwzh = ''
