INSERT INTO JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX(     JZID,        GRBH,       ZYH,       XZLX,       DJSJ,       JZPZLX,     JZPZBH,         YLLB,   DJZYHM,       BLH,     ZZYSBM,  RYKSYYBM, 	RYCW,       ZZDDM,      BZBM,       BZLX,     SSCZDM,     JHSYFWZH,		   SYLB,     JHSYSSLB,     WYBZ,       YZS,         TC,       TES,       ZCBZ, 	JHSYSSSYRQ,     CBDYBQH,     CZYID,     CZDDIP,       ZTBZ,        SYDBZ,       ZJLX,         ZJHM,     BRXM,     GWYBZ,     YLRYLB,	   JYLSH, 		 KSSJ, 	ZYCSXL,	ZYQBNDYBFLJ,	ZYQBNDDBHGFLJ,	ZYQBNDGBHGFLJ)
	VALUES( :as_jzid,    :ls_grbh,   :al_zyh,   :ls_xzlx,   :ldt_now,   :ls_jzpzlx, :ls_jzpzbh,     :ls_yllb, :as_zyhm,  :as_blhm, :ls_ZZYSBM,  :ls_ryksbm, 	:as_cwhm,   :ls_zzddm,  :ls_bzbm,   :ls_bzlx, :ls_ssczdm, :ls_jhsyfwzh,   :ls_sylb, :ls_jhsysslb, :ls_wybz,   :ls_yzs,     :ls_tc,   :ls_tes,   :ls_zcbz, 	:ld_JHSYSSSYRQ, :ls_cbdybqh, :ls_czyid, :ls_CZDDIP,          1,    :li_sydbz,   :ls_zjlx,     :ls_zjhm, :ls_brxm, :ls_gwybz, :ls_ylrylb, :is_jylsh,	:adt_ryrq, 	:ldc_zycs,	:ldc_ybzflj,	:ldc_dbzflj,	:ldc_gbhgflj)
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】入院办理成功，但新增入院登记明细失败，请联系信息科处理。住院号码："+as_zyhm+" 错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
	GOTO Error_ybRollBack
END IF

// 2.如果曾经有登记过的记录，则作废
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 1 And JZID <> :as_jzid Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】入院办理成功，但作废原入院登记明细失败，请联系信息科处理。住院号码："+as_zyhm+" 错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
	GOTO Error_ybRollBack
END IF


// 2.更新 BQXT.ZY_BRRY.JSDH
IF ab_commit THEN
	gf_begin_transaction(atr_trans)
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = :ll_jsdh Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
	IF ab_commit THEN
		IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
	END IF
ELSE
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = 1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
END IF

// 3.更新ZY_BRRY_KZ.YBJZBH，并删除住院预结信息和作废上传的费用明细
INSERT Into BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ("ZYH","YBJZBH") Values(:al_zyh,:as_jzid) Using atr_trans;
UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Set YBJZBH = :as_jzid Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
	IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF ab_commit THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
	ELSE
		as_error = "【医保端】入院办理成功，但删除医保预结信息失败，请联系信息科处理。住院号码："+as_zyhm+" 错误信息：["+String(atr_trans.SQLCode)+"]"+atr_trans.SQLErrText
		IF ab_commit THEN
			gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)
			GOTO Error_ybRollBack
		END IF
	END IF
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC  Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using atr_trans;
	END IF
	IF ii_zyqy_qy >= 1 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using atr_trans;
	END IF
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 Using atr_trans;
	IF ab_commit THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】入院办理成功，但更新病人就诊ID失败，请联系信息科处理。住院号码："+as_zyhm+" 错误信息：["+String(atr_trans.SQLCode)+"]"+atr_trans.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(atr_trans)
	GOTO Error_ybRollBack
END IF

RETURN 1


Error_ybRollBack:
DateTime ldt_temp
String ls_error_jyzf
// 调用“交易作废”，作废本次入院办理
IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_temp, '2401', ls_grbh, is_jylsh, Ref ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN
	as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf
END IF


Error:
as_error = "[2401-入院办理]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer uf_zydj (ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, datetime adt_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 病区住院登记最终入口
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string  	as_knsj 	
// 	value    	long    	al_ksdm 	
// 	value    	long    	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_ryrq	
// 	value    	string  	as_zyhm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_cwhm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_bahm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ysbm 	
// 	reference	string  	as_jzbh 	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271  病区住院登记最终入緿AT*

//====================================================================

//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF

CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

RETURN uf_zydj(ref as_knsj, al_ksdm, al_zyh, adt_Ryrq, as_zyhm, as_cwhm, as_bahm, as_ysbm, as_rylx, ref as_JZbh, ref as_error, ref gtrans_temp_mssql, True)


end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, string as_dmmc);//取对照表GY_DMZD中的，不同DMLB的，DMMC的医保对照
//如 药品的剂型 ml 获取对应的医保对照信息
IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and Upper(dmmc) ='"+Upper(as_dmmc)+"'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb_jbbm (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM' or  Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_JBBM_SYD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]

ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function integer uf_mz_mxcx (string jzid, string sfpch, string grbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_mz_mxcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:【2205】门诊费用明细信息撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	jzid  	
// 	value    	string	sfpch	
// 	value    	string	grbh    	
// 	reference	string	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.26
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_now
String ls_czybm
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now),is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
String ls_expcontent
IF This.of_get_expcontent( ls_expcontent, as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
This.uf_send_init( '2205')
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_id', jzid) //mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'chrg_bchno', sfpch) //chrg_bchno	收费批次号	字符型	30		Y	传入"0000"删除所有未结算明细
This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', grbh) //psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'exp_content', ls_expcontent) //exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	
IF Not uf_send(as_error,'') THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//如果撤销成功，更新对应表
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_tfcl (string as_ywlx, string as_jsid, string as_jydd, datetime adt_yjyjssj, ref str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_tfcl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 门诊/住院结算撤销（退费）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_ywlx         // 业务类型
// 	value    	string       	as_jsid         // 原交易的结算ID
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd         // 交易地点
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_yjyjssj     // 原交易的交易时间
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx
// 	reference	string       	as_error    
//====================================================================
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  门诊/住院结算撤销（退费）
//====================================================================

String ls_jzid,ls_grbh,ls_expContent // 就诊ID ,人员编号,字段扩展

Long ll_zyh
String ls_sfybm, ls_cbdybqh,ls_ywlx,ls_jsfl,ls_gbbjdx
DateTime ldt_now
Dec{2} ldc_gbbjzf,ldc_bscje

ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "创建临时事务失败！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
DateTime ldt_jssj_00,ldt_jssj_end
ldt_jssj_00 = DateTime(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_yjyjssj), -1 ))
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_yjyjssj), 1 ),Time(adt_yjyjssj))
SELECT TSZJE,JSFL,gbbz Into :ldc_gbbjzf,:ls_jsfl,:ls_gbbjdx From JKXT.JS_TSJL Where TSSJ >= :ldt_jssj_00 And TSSJ <= :ldt_jssj_end And YBYWH = :as_jsid And ZTBZ In (1,2) Using itran_sqlca	;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
	as_error =  '获取干部保健托收信息失败:' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_gbbjzf) THEN ldc_gbbjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ls_jsfl) THEN ls_jsfl = ''
IF IsNull(ls_gbbjdx) THEN ls_gbbjdx = '0'
// 操作员签到
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or  base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 8 THEN
	ls_sfybm = is_zyzz
ELSE
	ls_sfybm = is_mzzz
END IF
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm ,  1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 就诊ID
IF as_ywlx <> 'GH' THEN
	SELECT   JZID,     GRBH,       ZYH,   CBDXZQH,  YWLX ,  NVL(BSCJE,0)
		INTO :ls_jzid, :ls_grbh, :ll_zyh, :ls_cbdybqh,:ls_ywlx,  :ldc_bscje
		FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
		WHERE JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj - 3 AND  JSSJ < :adt_yjyjssj + 3 AND  JSLSH = :as_jsid
		Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "获取原结算明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
		as_error = "原结算明细的就诊ID为空！结算ID：" + as_jsid
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
		ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
		
		IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
			as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
			GOTO Error
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	ls_jzid = astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID

global subroutine gf_sblog (string as_path, string as_txt);String ls_filename

FileClose(ll_fileno)
end subroutine

		IF astr_zhyl_jsxx.ywlsh > ' ' THEN
			IF This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid, astr_zhyl_jsxx.ywlsh, ls_grbh, ls_expContent) < 0 THEN
				gf_sblog("c:\sblog",ls_jzid + "明细撤销失败:" + ls_expContent)
			END IF
		END IF
		IF This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid, '0000', ls_grbh, ls_expContent) < 0 THEN
			gf_sblog("c:\sblog",ls_jzid + "0000明细撤销失败:" + ls_expContent)
		END IF
		//挂号撤销
		IF ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
			This.uf_mz_ghcx( ls_grbh, ls_jzid, 'GH' + astr_zhyl_jsxx.ywlsh,adt_yjyjssj, ls_expContent)
		ELSE
			This.uf_mz_ghcx( ls_grbh, ls_jzid, astr_zhyl_jsxx.ywlsh,adt_yjyjssj, ls_expContent)
		END IF
	ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
		// 住院结算撤销后，自动调用出院撤销和费用明细撤销
		IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
			This.uf_zymz_delfymx( ll_zyh, '0000', Ref as_error)
		ELSE
			This.uf_zy_crycx( 2, ll_zyh, Ref as_error)
			This.uf_zy_delfymx( ll_zyh, '0000', Ref as_error)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1

Error:
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	as_error = "[2208-门诊结算撤销]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
	as_error = "[2202-门诊挂号撤销]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	as_error = "[2305-住院结算撤销]出错：" + as_error
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_ywlx) THEN as_ywlx = ''
	as_error = "[结算撤销]出错：[YWLX='"+as_ywlx+"']" + as_error
END IF
RETURN -1

end function

public function integer of_update_jymx_tp (string as_ywlx, string as_jsid, string as_jydd, datetime adt_yjyjssj, str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_update_jymx_tp()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 退费成功后更新医保结算明细表
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_jsid         原交易的结算ID       	
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd         交易地点 	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_yjyjssj     原交易的结算时间 	
// 	value    	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx    	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.25    28271  退费成功后更新医保结算明细表
//====================================================================

String ls_jzid
DateTime ldt_curr, ldt_yjyjssj_end

ldt_curr = gf_server_date()
as_jydd = gf_midstring(as_jydd,20)

IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jssj
Long ll_row,ll_count
ls_jssj = String(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_yjyjssj), -1 ),'yyyymmdd')
ldt_yjyjssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_yjyjssj),1),Time(23:59:59))
adt_yjyjssj = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_yjyjssj),-1))
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

// 1.更新费用明细上传表的状态
IF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN // 建议退费成功直接做明细撤销,门诊一个就诊ID对应多张发票，退只退其中一张，不适合做这种处理
	SELECT JZID Into :ls_jzid From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj And JSSJ <= :ldt_yjyjssj_end And JSLSH = :as_jsid  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但查询原收费就诊ID失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		//	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca) //select 不用回滚
		//	RETURN -1
	END IF
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From  JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In (1,10)  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ - 1 Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In (1,10) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	ll_count = 0
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From  JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In (1,10)   Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ - 1 Where JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In (1,10) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 Or itran_sqlca.SQLNRows <= 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但更新费用明细上传状态失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca) //状态置失败，但是退费已经成功，jsmx仍然需要处理
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
END IF

// 2.更新对应收费结算明细的状态
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX  Set ZTBZ = 2 Where JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj And JSSJ <= :ldt_yjyjssj_end And JSLSH = :as_jsid  Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但更新原收费明细状态失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	RETURN -1
END IF

// 3.更新对应收费结算明细扩展的状态
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX_KZ  Set ZTBZ = 2 Where JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj And JSSJ <= :ldt_yjyjssj_end And JSLSH = :as_jsid  Using itran_sqlca ;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但更新原收费明细基金分项状态失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	RETURN -1
END IF

// 4.插入退费明细
INSERT INTO JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	(   JSSJ,		JYQDLSH,		YWLX,   JYLSH,	GRBH,   BRBM,	ZYH,	JSCS,	JZPZLX, 	YLRYLB,    GWYBZ,  YLLB,	XZLX,	BZBM,	CBDXZQH,	JSLSH,	JYDD, 	YLFZE,	QZFJE,	CXJZFFY,	XXZFUJE,	FHZCFWJE,	SJZFQFX, 	JBYLBXTCJJZC,	JBYLBXTCJJZFBL,	GWYYLBZZJZC,	QYBCYLBXJJZC,	JMDBBXZJZC,
	ZGDEYLFYBZJJZC,	YLJZJJZC,	YYFDJE,	QTZC,	JJZFZE,	GRFDZJE,	GRZHZC,	GRXJZC,
	YE,	GRZHGJZFJE,  YLJGJSID,	QSJBJG,	QSFS,	QSLB,	YWLSH,	ZTBZ,	JZID,
	SCRYYLBZJJZC,	RYCBGXID,	JSLB,	BCQFX,	FPH,	DNZHYE,	LNZHYE,GBBJDX,GBBJMS,JRYFDX,BSCJE)
	SELECT :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj,  :is_jyzqh,	YWLX,	:is_jylsh,	GRBH,    BRBM,   ZYH,    JSCS,	JZPZLX,
	YLRYLB,  GWYBZ,	YLLB,	XZLX,	BZBM,	CBDXZQH,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.jsid ,:as_jydd,
	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.ylfze,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.qzfje,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.CXJZFFY,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.XXZFJE,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.fhzcfwje,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.SJZFQFX,
	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbylbxtcjj,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbylbxtcjjbl,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.gwyylbzzj,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.qybcylbxjj,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.jmdbbxzj,
	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.zgdeylfybz,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.YLJZJJ,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.YYFDJE, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.QTZC, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.JJZFZE, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.GRFDZJE,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.GRZHZC,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.GRXJZC,
	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.YE,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.grzhgjzfje,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.fsbwid, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jbjg,	QSFS,	QSLB,  YWLSH,  3,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID,
	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.hifdm_pay,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.psn_insu_rlts_id,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.setl_type,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.crt_dedc,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.invono,	:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.dnzhye,	:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.lnzhye,GBBJDX,GBBJMS,JRYFDX,:astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje
	FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	WHERE JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj AND JSSJ <= :ldt_yjyjssj_end AND JSLSH = :as_jsid AND ztbz IN (1,2) // add ztbz in (1,2)，去对应的正记录
	Using itran_sqlca ;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
	// 5.插入退费明细基金分项
	ll_count = UpperBound(astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			INSERT INTO JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX_KZ
				(	JSLSH,	JZID,	JYLSH,	JJZFLX,	FHZCFWJE, 				BCKZFXEJE, JJZFJE, JJZFLXMC, 				JSGCXX, JSSJ,	ZTBZ)
				VALUES(:astr_zhyl_jsxx.jsid,	:astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID, :is_jylsh, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].jjzflx, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].fhzcfwje, 				:astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].BCKZFXEJE, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].JJZFJE, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].JJZFLXMC, 				:astr_zhyl_jsxx.str_zhyl_jjfx[ll_row].JSGCXX, :astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj,	3 )
				Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但插入退费明细基金分项失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  ' 更新列：' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1'  Or istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JRYFDX = '1' THEN //
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JRYFDX = '1' THEN
			of_update_tsjl_tp( adt_yjyjssj, ldt_yjyjssj_end, as_jsid, astr_zhyl_jsxx.gbbjzf,astr_zhyl_jsxx.jsid,'YF' ,as_error)
		ELSE
			of_update_tsjl_tp( adt_yjyjssj, ldt_yjyjssj_end, as_jsid, astr_zhyl_jsxx.gbbjzf,astr_zhyl_jsxx.jsid,'GB' ,as_error)
		END IF
	END IF
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN 0
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但插入退费明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	RETURN -1
END IF

// 由于台州经常反馈会有医保端成功，HIS也成功的结算数据，但是在医保结算明细表中却缺失对应的数据，因此这里默认返回-1
as_error = "【医保端】退费成功，但插入退费明细异常返回：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  ' 更新列：' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
RETURN -1

end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_zyxx (string as_grbh, datetime adt_kssj, datetime adt_jssj, ref str_zhyl_zyxx astr_zhyl_zyxx[], ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx_zyxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 查询病人的在院信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_grbh         	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_kssj        	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_jssj        	
// 	reference	str_zhyl_zyxx	astr_zhyl_zyxx[]	
// 	reference	string       	as_error       
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.29    28271  查询睤AT*
∪说脑谠盒畔

//====================================================================

//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_Count, ll_row
String ls_cbdybqh

IF isnull(as_grbh) or Trim(as_grbh)='' Then
	as_error = "个人编号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(adt_kssj) or Date(adt_kssj)<Date(2000,1,1) Then
	adt_kssj = DateTime(Today())
END IF
IF isnull(adt_jssj) or Date(adt_jssj)<Date(2000,1,1) Then
	adt_jssj = DateTime(Date(3000,1,1))
END IF

ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm



this.uf_send_init('5303')

istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh  // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

this.uf_send_add('psn_no', as_grbh)		// 人员编号
this.uf_send_add('begntime', adt_kssj) // 开始时间
this.uf_send_add('endtime', adt_jssj)	// 结束时间


// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error, "") Then
	goto Error
END IF

// 成功后回写结构体
ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr('data')
IF ll_Count=0 Then
	return 1
END IF
FOR ll_row=1 To ll_count Step 1
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].mdtrt_id = This.uf_getstring_in('mdtrt_id', ll_row)  			  // 就诊ID
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].psn_no = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_no', ll_row)  				  // 人员编号
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].psn_cert_type = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_cert_type', ll_row)  // 人员证件类型
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].certno = This.uf_getstring_in('certno', ll_row)  				  // 证件号码
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].psn_name = This.uf_getstring_in('psn_name', ll_row)  			  // 人员姓名
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].gend = This.uf_getstring_in('gend', ll_row)  						  // 性别
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].brdy = This.uf_getdate_in('brdy', ll_row)  						  // 出生日期
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].age = This.uf_getDecimal_in('age', ll_row)   						  // 年龄
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].insutype = This.uf_getstring_in('insutype', ll_row)  			  // 险种类型
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].begndate = This.uf_getdate_in('begndate', ll_row)  				  // 开始日期
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].FRE*
med_type = This.uf_getstring_in('med_type', ll_row)  			  // 医疗类别
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].ipt_otp_no = This.uf_getstring_in('ipt_otp_no', ll_row)  		  // 住院/门诊号
	astr_zhyl_zyxx[ll_row].out_flag = This.uf_getstring_in('out_flag', ll_row)  			  // 异地标志
NEXT


return 1

Error:
as_error = "[5303-在院信息查询] " + as_error
return -1
end function

uf_send_add_in
feedetl_sn
fee_ocur_time
med_list_codg
bilg_dr_codg
bilg_dept_codg
hosp_appr_flag
med_list_name
tcmdrug_used_way
__set_attribute_item
' and YWLSH=  and getrow() <>   and ( xmlsh <>   and xmlsh <>  7000000000000001
9000000000000001
rx_circ_flag
sin_dos_dscr
allSelfFlag
堾yxmywlsh
堾mzfymxlsh
【2204】ids_ybfymx_sc:
as_knsj) = 15 THEN
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = '02'
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh = as_knsj
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.sfzh = as_knsj
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm = ''
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = '01'
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno = as_knsj
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	RETURN '02'
ELSEIF Left(as_knsj, 6) = 'YBDZPZ' or posw(as_knsj,"|") > 0 THEN
	String ls_ret[]
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = '01'
	if Left(as_knsj, 6) = 'YBDZPZ' then as_knsj = Mid(as_knsj,7)
	IF of_splitparm( as_knsj, ls_ret, "|") >= 5 THEN
		//身份凭证信息(姓名|证件类型|证件号码|令牌)
		as_knsj = ls_ret[1] + "|" + ls_ret[2]+ "|" + ls_ret[3]+ "|" + ls_ret[4]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM = ls_ret[5]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.YBDZPZ = ls_ret[4]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = ls_ret[2]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.sfzh = ls_ret[3]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno = ls_ret[3]
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm = ls_ret[1]
	ELSE
		as_error = '医保电子凭证信息传入错误'
		RETURN ''
	END IF
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.YBDZPZ
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm = ''
	RETURN '01'
ELSE
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = '03'
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type
	IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type) Or astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = '' THEN
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type = '01'
	END IF
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm
	ls_kh = Right(as_knsj, 9)
	ls_sbm = Mid(as_knsj, 1, Len(as_knsj)-9)
	IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM) Or astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM = '' THEN
		astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.CBDXZQHDM = Left(as_knsj,6)
	END IF
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh = ls_kh
	astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
	RETURN '03'
END IF
RETURN ''



end function

public function integer uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc (string as_jylx, string as_yyjgjzid, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// Event: u_zhyl_his.uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Description:自费病人门诊就医信息上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Arguments:
// 	value    	string 	as_jylx    	
// 	value    	stringf	as_yyjgjzid	
// 	reference	string 	as_error   	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Returns:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Author:	gqj		Date: Feb 14,2022
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
//	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Modify History:
//
//====================================================================


//参数定义
string ls_error
string ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_blhm,ls_hzhm,ls_gddh,ls_yddh,ls_lxdz,ls_fmlxdz,ls_expcontent
string ls_yllb,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_bqms,ls_ysbm,ls_bzbm,ls_bzmc,ls_pjhm,ls_pjdm,ls_ysxm,ls_yssfzh
String ls_zdbm[],ls_zdmc[],ls_zdmc1,ls_zjlx,ls_zdysbm_gjm,ls_brly
long ll_brxb,ll_brmz,ll_days
date ld_csny,ld_now
Decimal{1} ldc_age
Decimal{0} ldc_jzlsh,ldc_ywlsh
u_datastore lds_sfmx,lds_ghxx
DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end,ldt_null,ldt_jzsj
//参数定义2
long ll_rowcount,ll_count,ll_index,ll_index2,ll_insert,ll_find
string ls_ywlx,ls_temp,ls_memo,ls_dzpj_jylsh,ls_jzkh
U_datastore lds_zfbrjyxxsc,lds_zfbrjyxxsczd,lds_zfbrjyxxscmx//上传数据存储表
string ls_fplshgl,ls_yhms,ls_bz,ls_error_temp,ls_pjjym
integer li_tpxh,li_fpzf,li_gfje,li_ret,li_syzd 
datetime ldt_kpsj,ldt_now
long ll_ckf_fyxh,ll_blf_fyxh
str_zfbrjson lstr_zfbrjson//部分备注信息所需的数据

//获取最初的发票流水号
IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	SELECT COUNT(1),Min(firstfplsh) Into :ll_count,:ls_fplshgl From  MZ_TPXX Where Y_FPLSH = :as_yyjgjzid;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN//若不是最后一次的发票则不进行上传处理
		ls_error = '需要传入最后一次发票流水号!'
		goto Error
	ELSE
		SELECT firstfplsh,TPXH Into :ls_fplshgl,:li_tpxh From MZ_TPXX Where NEWFPLSH = :as_yyjgjzid;
		IF li_tpxh = 1 THEN //发票重打
			SELECT Y_FPLSH Into :ls_fplshgl From MZ_TPXX Where firstfplsh = :ls_fplshgl And TPXH = 0 Order By TPRQ;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				ls_fplshgl = as_yyjgjzid
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_fplshgl) Or ls_fplshgl = '' THEN
		ls_fplshgl = as_yyjgjzid
	END IF
END IF

//若已有成功申报的信息则不再进行申报
select count(*) into :ll_count from jkxt.zhyb_zfbrjyxxsc where ywlx = :as_jylx and yyjgjzid = :as_yyjgjzid and ztbz = 1;
If ll_count > 0 Then return 1

//参数初始化
setnull(ldt_null)
ldt_now = gf_server_date()

//创建临时事务
this.uf_send_init( '4205')
IF this.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	ls_error = "临时事务创建失败"
	GOTO Error
END IF
ll_ckf_fyxh = Long(gf_getpara(5, 'CKFYXH', '11645', '磁卡费用序号'))
ll_blf_fyxh = Long(gf_getpara(5, 'BLFYXH', '11646', '病历费用序号'))

IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	//加载收费明细
	lds_sfmx = Create u_datastore
	IF lds_sfmx.createfromsql("select brbm, ywlx, ywlsh, sfsj from mzxt.mz_sfmx where fplsh = '" + ls_fplshgl + "'") < 0 THEN
		ls_error = "收费明细对象创建失败。"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	lds_sfmx.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
	ll_rowcount = lds_sfmx.retrieve()
	IF ll_rowcount <= 0 Then
		ls_error = "收费明细为空。"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSEIF as_jylx = 'GH' THEN
	//加訢AT*

	lds_ghxx = Create u_datastore
	IF lds_ghxx.createfromsql("select brbm, ghlsh, ghrq, ksbm from mzxt.mz_ghxx where ghlsh = '" + as_yyjgjzid + "'") < 0 THEN
		ls_error = "挂号信息对象创建失败。"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	lds_ghxx.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
	ll_rowcount = lds_ghxx.retrieve()
	IF ll_rowcount <= 0 Then
		ls_error = "挂号信息为空。"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

//创建对象--数据上传
IF IsValid(lds_zfbrjyxxsc) = False THEN
	lds_zfbrjyxxsc = Create U_datastore
	lds_zfbrjyxxsc.setworktrans( this.itran_sqlca)
	lds_zfbrjyxxsc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zfbrjyxxscjl_yyjgjzid'
END IF
lds_zfbrjyxxsc.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
lds_zfbrjyxxsc.Reset( )
IF IsValid(lds_zfbrjyxxsczd) = False THEN
	lds_zfbrjyxxsczd = Create U_datastore
	lds_zfbrjyxxsczd.setworktrans( this.itran_sqlca)
	lds_zfbrjyxxsczd.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zfbrjyxxsczdjl_yyjgjzid'
END IF
lds_zfbrjyxxsczd.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
lds_zfbrjyxxsczd.Reset( )
IF IsValid(lds_zfbrjyxxscmx) = False THEN
	lds_zfbrjyxxscmx = Create U_datastore
	lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.setworktrans( this.itran_sqlca)
	lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zfbrjyxxscmxjl_yyjgjzid'
END IF
lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.Reset( )
//创建对象--慢特病
IF IsValid(ids_zhyl_mxbdz) = False THEN
	ids_zhyl_mxbdz = Create U_datastore
	ids_zhyl_mxbdz.DataObject = 'd_zhyl_mxbdz'
	ids_zhyl_mxbdz.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
	ids_zhyl_mxbdz.Retrieve( )
END IF
IF IsValid(ids_zhyl_tsbdz) = False THEN
	ids_zhyl_tsbdz = Create U_datastore
	ids_zhyl_tsbdz.DataObject = 'd_zhyl_tsbdz'
	ids_zhyl_tsbdz.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
	ids_zhyl_tsbdz.Retrieve( )
END IF
IF IsValid(ids_zhyl_gwymbdz) = False THEN
	ids_zhyl_gwymbdz = Create U_datastore
	ids_zhyl_gwymbdz.DataObject = 'd_zhyl_gwymbdz'
	ids_zhyl_gwymbdz.SetTransObject(this.itran_sqlca)
	ids_zhyl_gwymbdz.Retrieve( )
END IF

//数据获取
IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	ls_brbm = lds_sfmx.object.brbm[1]
ELSEIF as_jylx = 'GH' THEN
	ls_brbm = lds_ghxx.object.brbm[1]
END IF
SELECT mz_brda.brxm,mz_brda.sfzh,mz_brda.blhm,mz_brda.hzhm,mz_brda.brxb,mz_brdakz.brmz,mz_brda.csny,mz_brda.gddh,mz_brda.yddh,mz_brda.lxdz,mz_brda.fmlxdz,mz_brda.jzkh
	Into :ls_brxm,:ls_sfzh,:ls_blhm,:ls_hzhm,:ll_brxb,:ll_brmz,:ld_csny,:ls_gddh,:ls_yddh,:ls_lxdz,:ls_fmlxdz,:ls_jzkh
	From mzxt.mz_brda,mzxt.mz_brdakz
	Where mz_brda.brbm = mz_brdakz.brbm and mz_brda.BRBM = :ls_brbm Using this.itran_sqlca;
IF this.itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	ls_error = '获取病人信息失败：' + this.itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + 'sqlcode:' + String(this.itran_sqlca.SQLCode)
	GOTO Error
END IF
lstr_zfbrjson.csny = ld_csny
ls_zjlx = '01'
ld_now = Today()
ll_days = DaysAfter (Date(ld_csny), Date(ld_now) )//出生的天数
ldc_age = truncate(ll_days/365,1)
//获取就诊信息
IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	ll_count = lds_sfmx.rowcount()
	For ll_index = 1 to ll_count
		ldc_ywlsh = lds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_index]
		ls_ywlx = lds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_index]
		IF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' Then
			SELECT jzlsh,ksbm,ysbm Into :ldc_jzlsh,:ls_ksbm,:ls_ysbm from mz_yjk1 Where yjlsh = :ldc_ywlsh Using this.itran_sqlca;
		ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'CF' Then
			SELECT jzlsh,ksbm,ysbm Into :ldc_jzlsh,:ls_ksbm,:ls_ysbm from mz_cfk Where cflsh = :ldc_ywlsh Using this.itran_sqlca;
		END IF
		IF ldc_jzlsh <> 0 AND NOT IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) THEN EXIT
	NEXT
	select kpsj into :ldt_begin from mzxt.mz_fpk where fplsh = :ls_fplshgl Using this.itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_jylx = 'GH' THEN
	ldt_begin = lds_ghxx.object.ghrq[1]
	ls_ksbm = lds_ghxx.object.ksbm[1]
	select jzlsh,ysbm into :ldc_jzlsh,:ls_ysbm from mzxt.mz_jzxx where ghlsh = :as_yyjgjzid and brbm = :ls_brbm order by jzsj desc Using this.itran_sqlca;
	IF this.itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
		ldc_jzlsh = 0
		ls_ysbm = '9999'
	END IF
END IF
ldt_end = ldt_begin
IF NOT IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) AND ldc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
	select jzsj into :ldt_jzsj from mzxt.mz_jzxx where jzlsh = :ldc_jzlsh and brbm = :ls_brbm and rownum = 1 using this.itran_sqlca;
	select brbs into :ls_bqms from mzxt.mz_bljl where jzlsh = :ldc_jzlsh and brbm = :ls_brbm using this.itran_sqlca;
ELSE//若没有就诊流水号
	ldt_jzsj = ldt_begin
END IF
if len(ls_bqms) > 1000 then ls_bqms = this.of_midstring(ls_bqms,1000)
//获取科室信息
ls_ksmc = this.of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'MZ_KS',ls_ksbm )
//诊断信息
li_ret = this.of_get_mz_zdxx( ls_yllb, ldc_jzlsh, ls_ysbm, ls_zdbm, ls_zdmc, ls_zdmc1,li_syzd)
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
//	IF li_ret = -2 THEN
//		ls_error = '根据医保相关规定，' + ls_zdmc1 + ' 诊断下开的所有项目不能医保结算！！'
//	ELSE
//		ls_error = '获取诊断失败：' + String(ldc_jzlsh)
//	END IF
   ls_error = ls_zdmc1
	GOTO Error
END IF
If upperbound(ls_zdbm) > 0 Then
	ls_bzbm = ls_zdbm[1]
	ls_bzmc = ls_zdmc[1]
END IF
//设置医疗类别
IF as_jylx = 'GH' Then
	ls_yllb = '12' //挂号
ELSE
	//先进行慢特病判断
	ll_count = UpperBound(ls_zdbm)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_count
			IF ids_zhyl_gwymbdz.find("dmsb = '" + ls_zdbm[ll_index] + "'", 1, ids_zhyl_gwymbdz.rowcount()) > 0 Then//慢性病
				ls_yllb = '14'
			ELSEIF ids_zhyl_tsbdz.find("dmsb = '" + ls_zdbm[ll_index]  + "'", 1, ids_zhyl_tsbdz.rowcount()) > 0 Then//特殊病
				ls_yllb = '140201'
			END IF
			IF ls_yllb = '14' Then EXIT//若既有慢性病又有特殊病优先选取慢性病
		NEXT
	END IF
	//没有值的默认普通门诊
	IF isnull(ls_yllb) or ls_yllb = '' Then
		ls_yllb = '11'//普通门诊
	END IF
END IF
//电子票据信息
//IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
//	SELECT jylsh Into :ls_dzpj_jylsh From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = 'MZ' and jylsh like :ls_fplshgl || '%' And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) order by tjsj desc using this.itran_sqlca;
//ELSEIF as_jylx = 'GH' THEN
//	SELECT jylsh Into :ls_dzpj_jylsh From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = 'GH' and jylsh like :as_yyjgjzid || '%' And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) order by tjsj desc using this.itran_sqlca;
//END IF
ls_brly = as_jylx
IF ls_brly = 'SF' THEN ls_brly = 'MZ'
SELECT jylsh Into :ls_dzpj_jylsh from (select * From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = :ls_brly and jylsh like :as_yyjgjzid || '%' And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) order by tjsj desc) where ROWNUM <= 1 using this.itran_sqlca;
IF uf_get_dzpj(ls_dzpj_jylsh,ls_pjhm,ls_pjdm,ls_pjjym,ls_error) < 0 Then
	GOTO Error
END IF
//扩展信息
//IF this.of_get_expcontent( ls_expcontent, ls_error) < 0 THEN
//	GOTO Error
//END IF
//获取医生信息
IF this.of_get_ygxm( ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_yssfzh, true,ls_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF this.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ls_zdysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
	ls_error = '获取医生国家码失败：' + ls_zdysbm_gjm
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_zdysbm_gjm) or ls_zdysbm_gjm = '' Then ls_zdysbm_gjm = '000000'
//加载收费明细数据
dec{0} ldc_cflsh[],ldc_yjlsh[]
long ll_cflsh_index = 0,ll_yjlsh_index = 0
boolean lb_skip_ywlsh
//处理费用详细信息
IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	IF IsValid(ids_zfbrmzfymx) = False THEN
		ids_zfbrmzfymx = create datastore
		ids_zfbrmzfymx.dataobject = 'd_mz_sfmx_mxsc'
		ids_zfbrmzfymx.settransobject( this.itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	//获取开票时间
	SELECT KPSJ,fpzf,gfje INTO :ldt_kpsj,:li_fpzf,:li_gfje From MZ_FPK Where fplsh = :as_yyjgjzid using this.itran_sqlca;
	IF li_gfje = 1 THEN
		ls_yhms = '2'
	ELSE
		ls_yhms = '1'
	END IF
	If ls_fplshgl <> as_yyjgjzid Then//若不是最初的fplsh
		SELECT KPSJ INTO :ldt_kpsj From MZ_FPK Where fplsh = :ls_fplshgl using this.itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		IF li_fpzf = 9  THEN
			SELECT KPSJ Into :ldt_kpsj From mz_cfk Where fplsh = :as_yyjgjzid And rownum = 1 using this.itran_sqlca;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				SELECT KPSJ Into :ldt_kpsj From mz_yjk1 Where fplsh = :as_yyjgjzid And rownum = 1 using this.itran_sqlca;
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//加载数据
	ll_count = lds_sfmx.rowcount()
	For ll_index = 1 to ll_count
		ldc_ywlsh = lds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_index]
		ls_ywlx = lds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_index]
		lb_skip_ywlsh = false
		IF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN//医技
			For ll_index2 = 1 To upperbound(ldc_yjlsh)
				if ldc_yjlsh[ll_index2] = ldc_ywlsh Then lb_skip_ywlsh = true
			NEXT
			IF lb_skip_ywlsh Then continue
			ll_yjlsh_index++
			ldc_yjlsh[ll_yjlsh_index] = ldc_ywlsh
		ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN//处方
			For ll_index2 = 1 To upperbound(ldc_cflsh)
				if ldc_cflsh[ll_index2] = ldc_ywlsh Then lb_skip_ywlsh = true
			NEXT
			IF lb_skip_ywlsh Then continue
			ll_cflsh_index++
			ldc_cflsh[ll_cflsh_index] = ldc_ywlsh
		END IF
	NEXT
	IF ll_cflsh_index = 0 THEN ldc_cflsh[1] = -1
	IF ll_yjlsh_index = 0 THEN ldc_yjlsh[1] = -1
	ids_zfbrmzfymx.retrieve(ldc_cflsh,ldc_yjlsh)
	//处理不上传费用
	For ll_index = 1 to ids_zfbrmzfymx.rowcount()
		If ids_zfbrmzfymx.object.xmlsh[ll_index] = ll_ckf_fyxh or ids_zfbrmzfymx.object.xmlsh[ll_index] = ll_blf_fyxh Then
			ids_zfbrmzfymx.DeleteRow( ll_index )
			ll_index --
			continue
		END IF
		IF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' Then//医技
			ll_find = gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( 0, long(ids_zfbrmzfymx.object.xmlsh[ll_index]), 0, Ref ls_error)
			IF ll_find < 0 THEN GOTO Error
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ids_zfbrmzfymx.DeleteRow( ll_index )
				ll_index --
				continue
			END IF
		ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN//处方
			ll_find = gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( 1, long(ids_zfbrmzfymx.object.xmlsh[ll_index]), long(ids_zfbrmzfymx.object.cdlsh[ll_index]), Ref ls_error)
			IF ll_find < 0 THEN GOTO Error
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				ids_zfbrmzfymx.DeleteRow( ll_index )
				ll_index --
				continue
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	//更新收费明细中的数据

		IF string(ids_zfbrmzfymx.Object.cfm[ll_index]) = '9' THEN //自费使用
			lstr_zfbrjson.spbz = '2'
		ELSE
			li_kzpb = 0
			IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
				SELECT KZYP Into :li_kzpb From YK_TYPK Where ypxh = :ll_xmlsh Using this.itran_sqlca;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
				SELECT kzpb Into :li_kzpb From GY_YLSF_KZ Where FYXH = :ll_xmlsh Using this.itran_sqlca;
				IF li_kzpb = 3 THEN li_kzpb = 0 //kzpb，3为全院提醒不需要审批
			END IF
			IF li_kzpb > 0 And li_kzpb <> 7 THEN //需审批
				IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
					select spjg into :ll_spjg from (select * FROM BQXT.YB_SPKZ WHERE YB_SPKZ.MZHM = :ls_brbm AND ypxh = :ll_xmlsh AND yplx > 0 order by sprq desc) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1;
				ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
					select spjg into :ll_spjg from (select * FROM BQXT.YB_SPKZ WHERE YB_SPKZ.MZHM = :ls_brbm AND ypxh = :ll_xmlsh AND yplx = 0 order by sprq desc) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1;
				END IF
				IF ll_spjg = 1 THEN//自费
					lstr_zfbrjson.spbz = '2'
				ELSE//公费
					lstr_zfbrjson.spbz = '1'
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		//干部保健
		of_zfbr_gbbj_spbz(ls_ywlx,ll_xmlsh,lstr_zfbrjson,ls_brbm)

		lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.object.YWLX[ll_insert] = as_jylx

		this.uf_send_add_in('prodname', ls_prodname, ll_index)// 商品名

		this.uf_send_add_in('sin_dos_dscr', ls_ycjl, ll_index)// 单次剂量描述
		lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.object.SYPCMS[ll_insert] = ls_sypc
		this.uf_send_add_in('used_frqu_dscr', ls_sypc, ll_index)// 使用频次描述
		lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.object.ZQTS[ll_insert] = dec(ll_yyts)
		this.uf_send_add_in('prd_days', dec(ll_yyts), ll_index)// 周期天数
		lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.object.YYTJMS[ll_insert] = ls_yytj
		this.uf_send_add_in('medc_way_dscr', ls_yytj, ll_index)// 用药途径描述

	ll_count = ids_zfbrmzghmx.rowcount()
	IF ll_count <= 0 Then
		ls_error = "无挂号明细信息!"
		goto Error
	END IF
	For ll_index = 1 to ll_count
		//详细数据获取
		ls_prodname = ids_zfbrmzghmx.Object.fymc[ll_index]
		ll_xmlsh =  ids_zfbrmzghmx.Object.fyxh[ll_index]
		ldt_fyfssj = lds_ghxx.object.ghrq[1]
		//操作一
		ls_kdksbm = string(ids_zfbrmzghmx.object.ksbm[ll_index])
		ls_kdysbm = string(ids_zfbrmzghmx.object.ysbm[ll_index])
		IF isnull(ls_kdysbm) or ls_kdysbm = '' Then
			ls_kdysbm = string(ids_zfbrmzghmx.object.sfybm[ll_index])
		END IF
		ls_sdksbm = string(ids_zfbrmzghmx.object.jzks[ll_index])
		ls_sdysbm = string(ids_zfbrmzghmx.object.jzys[ll_index])
		ls_sdb = 'MZ_KS'
		ls_kdb = 'MZ_KS'
		IF isnull(ls_kdksbm) or ls_kdksbm = '' Then
			select ksdm into :ls_kdksbm from gy_ygdm where ygdm = :ls_kdysbm Using this.itran_sqlca;
			ls_kdb = 'GY_KSDM'
		END IF
		//操作二
		ll_find = this.of_Get_jbxx( 0, ll_xmlsh, 0, 'MZ', ldt_fyfssj, ls_xmzxbh_ts, li_tsdz, ls_error)
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			ls_yljgmlbm = String(this.ids_ylsf.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_find])
			ls_ylmlbm = String(this.ids_ylsf.Object.YLMLBM[ll_find])
			ls_memo = String(this.ids_ylsf.Object.MEMO[ll_find])
			IF isnull(ls_memo) Then ls_memo=''
		END IF

//		ls_temp_data = ls_kdksbm
		lds_zfbrjyxxscmx.object.KDKSBM[ll_insert] = ls_kdksbm

		IF IsNull(ls_temp_data) Or ls_temp_data = '无' THEN ls_temp_data = ''

ELSE

	IF uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc_send_success(lds_zfbrjyxxsc,lds_zfbrjyxxsczd,lds_zfbrjyxxscmx,ls_error) < 0 Then

		this.uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc_deleteqb(as_jylx,as_yyjgjzid,ls_temp,true)
		goto Error
	END IF
	this.uf_dzjspz(as_jylx,as_yyjgjzid,0,ls_dzpj_jylsh,ls_temp)
	if isvalid(lds_sfmx) then destroy lds_sfmx
	if isvalid(lds_ghxx) then destroy lds_ghxx
	if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxsc) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxsc
	if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxsczd) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxsczd
	if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxscmx) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxscmx
	//结束
	return 1
ELSE//调用医保接口失败
	//删除数据
	this.uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc_deleteqb(as_jylx,as_yyjgjzid,ls_temp,true)
	//结束
	goto Error
END IF

//报错
Error:
if isvalid(lds_sfmx) then destroy lds_sfmx
if isvalid(lds_ghxx) then destroy lds_ghxx
if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxsc) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxsc
if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxsczd) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxsczd
if isvalid(lds_zfbrjyxxscmx) then destroy lds_zfbrjyxxscmx
as_error = "[4205-自费病人门诊就医信息上传]出错：" + ls_error
gf_applog("类型:" + as_jylx + ",号码:" + as_yyjgjzid + ",错误:" + as_error)
return -1
end function

public function integer of_get_ghjzid (integer ai_jslx, string as_brbm, string as_ghsf, string as_ghlsh, string as_jydd, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_ghjzid()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:2201 门诊挂号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string           	as_brbm       	
// 	value    	string           	as_ghlsh      	
// 	value    	string           	as_jydd       	
// 	value    	str_yb_mzsfqq_new	astr_yb_mzsfqq	
// 	reference	string           	as_jzbh       	
// 	reference	string           	as_return     	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.20
//====================================================================
idt_sysdatetime = gf_server_date()
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(idt_sysdatetime),base_info.UserID , 1, as_return) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
		ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	ELSE
		ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	END IF
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(idt_sysdatetime),ls_czybm , 1, as_return) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(idt_jzkssj) THEN
	idt_jzkssj = DateTime(RelativeDate ( Date(idt_sysdatetime),li_ghyxts * -1 ))
END IF
as_jzbh = ''
String ls_ysbm,ls_ksbm,ls_ybksbm,ls_ysxm,ls_ksmc,ls_sfzh,ls_expContent,ls_ysbm_gjm
ls_ysbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm
IF IsNull(ls_ysbm) Or ls_ysbm = '' THEN
	IF as_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		ls_ysbm = is_ghks_ys
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = is_ghks_ys
	ELSE
		as_return = '传入开单医生为空！'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//	ls_ysbm = '000000'
	//	ls_ysxm = '未知'
	//	ls_ysbm_gjm = '000000'
END IF

IF This.of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_sfzh,True,as_return) < 0 THEN
	as_return = ls_ysbm + '获取医生姓名失败：' +as_return
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
			as_return = '医生国糄AT* 衣肟眨�请联系医保科� '
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			ls_ysbm_gjm = ls_ysbm
			as_return = '医生国家码空，取医生代码！'
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//32177 技师国家码不能进行医保结算交易 
IF ii_jsybjskz >= 1 And Left(ls_ysbm_gjm,2) = 'HJ' THEN
	as_return = '技师国家码暂不能进行医保结算交易，请做自费结算！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//--------------
//END IF
ls_ksbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
		SELECT ksdm Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT zyks Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_return = '科室为空！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
//因异地一次结算一次就诊ID,所以这里本异地一刀切，一次结算都做一次挂号，就诊上传。预结算，确认结算
String ls_xlh, ls_ywlsh_temp
IF IsNull( astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) Or Trim(astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) = '' Or astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = '-1' Or Upper(astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) = 'NULL' THEN
	IF This.of_get_jzxlh(ls_xlh,as_return) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'FEYFP' + ls_xlh
	as_ghlsh =  'FEYFP' + ls_xlh

	IF as_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		as_ghlsh = 'GH' + astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
	ELSE
		as_ghlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
		SELECT max(ywlsh) INTO :ls_ywlsh_temp FROM JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX
			Where JYSJ >= :idt_jzkssj  And BRBM = :as_brbm And  ZTBZ = 1 And  ywlsh Like :as_ghlsh || '%'  Using itran_sqlca ;
		IF ls_ywlsh_temp > '' THEN
			Integer li_js
			IF as_ghlsh <> ls_ywlsh_temp THEN
				IF Pos(ls_ywlsh_temp,'-') > 0 THEN
					li_js = Integer(Mid(ls_ywlsh_temp,Pos(ls_ywlsh_temp,'-') + 1))
					li_js = li_js + 1
				END IF
			ELSE
				li_js = 1
			END IF
			as_ghlsh = as_ghlsh + '-' + String(li_js)
			astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = as_ghlsh
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
SELECT JZID INTO :as_jzbh FROM JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_jzkssj  And BRBM = :as_brbm And  ZTBZ = 1 And  ywlsh = :as_ghlsh Order By JYSJ Desc Using itran_sqlca ;
str_zhyl_ghxx lstr_zhyl_ghxx
IF as_jzbh > '' THEN
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.JZID = as_jzbh
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	//2023/09/05 HW 门诊外伤就诊
	Integer li_mzws
	This.uf_send_init('2201')
	istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm

		IF IsNull(lstr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj) Or Date(lstr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj) = Date('1900-01-01') THEN

	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ghlsh = as_ghlsh

	if ii_zymz = 1 then
		if li_mzws = 2 then ls_expContent = '2'
	else
		SELECT MZWSBZ INTO :li_mzws FROM MZXT.MZ_JZXX WHERE JZLSH = :astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh USING itran_sqlca;	
		ls_expContent = String(li_mzws)
	end if
	IF This.of_get_expcontent( Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_return) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF

		ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM',ls_ksbm)
		IF IsNull(ls_ybksbm) Or ls_ybksbm = '' Or ls_ybksbm = 'NULL'  Or ls_ybksbm = '无' THEN
			ls_ybksbm = ls_ksbm

			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
		IF IsNull(ls_ybksbm) Or ls_ybksbm = '' Or ls_ybksbm = 'NULL'  Or ls_ybksbm = '无' THEN
			ls_ybksbm = ls_ksbm
			ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
		ELSE
			ls_ksmc = This.of_get_dmmc('caty',ls_ybksbm)
		END IF
		IF ls_ksmc = '' Or IsNull(ls_ksmc) THEN
			as_return = '【2201】获取科室名称失败：' + ls_ksbm
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.KSBM = ls_ybksbm
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ksmc = ls_ksmc
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ysbm = ls_ysbm_gldrr_yjlsh

	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ysxm = ls_ysxm
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ybkb = ls_ybksbm
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.jylsh = is_jylsh
	lstr_zhyl_ghxx.zdkz = ls_expContent
	This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh ) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'insutype',lstr_zhyl_ghxx.xz ) //2	insutype	险种类型	字符型	6	Y	Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'begntime', lstr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj  ) //3	begntime	开始时间	日期时间型			Y	挂号时间 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
	This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_cert_type', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx ) //4	mdtrt_cert_type	就诊凭证类型	字符型	3	Y	Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_cert_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh ) //5	mdtrt_cert_no	就诊凭证编号	字符型	50		Y	就诊凭证类型为"01"时填写电子凭证令牌，为"02"时填写身份证号，为"03"时填写社会保障卡卡号
	IF ib_ydzf THEN
		This.uf_send_add( 'ipt_otp_no','YDZF' +  lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ghlsh ) //6	ipt_otp_no	住院/门诊号	字符型	30		Y	院内唯一流水
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add( 'ipt_otp_no',lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ghlsh ) //6	ipt_otp_no	住院/门诊号	字符型	30		Y	院内唯一罝AT*

	END IF
	This.uf_send_add( 'atddr_no', ls_ysbm_gjm ) //7	atddr_no	医师编码	字符型	30		Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'dr_name', lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ysxm ) //8	dr_name	医师姓名	字符型	50		Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'dept_code', ls_ybksbm) //lstr_zhyl_ghxx.KSBM ) //9	dept_code	科室编码	字符型	30		Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'dept_name', lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ksmc ) //10	dept_name	科室名称	字符型	100		Y	
	This.uf_send_add( 'caty', lstr_zhyl_ghxx.ybkb ) //11	caty	科别	字符型	10	Y	Y

	IF ai_jslx <> 0 Or (ib_ydzf And ai_jslx = 0) THEN
		IF This.of_insert_ghxx( as_brbm,as_ghlsh,as_jydd, lstr_zhyl_ghxx, as_return) < 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	//移动支付不做交易，因为即使传过去，移动支付接口还是会生成新的
	IF ib_ydzf THEN
		as_jzbh = ''
		RETURN 1
	END IF
	IF This.uf_send( as_return, '') THEN
		as_jzbh = This.uf_getstring( 'mdtrt_id')
		lstr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID = as_jzbh
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.JZID = as_jzbh
		IF ai_jslx <> 0 Or (ib_ydzf And ai_jslx = 0) THEN
			IF This.of_update_ghxx(0,lstr_zhyl_ghxx,as_return) < 0 THEN
				as_return = '更新就诊ID失败。' + as_return
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		//1	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	医保返回唯一流水

		//4	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000
	ELSE
		as_return = '2201挂号失败:' + as_return
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1
end function

public subroutine uf_dgzfmzjyxxsc_totalupdate (string as_brbm, datetime adt_kpsj, ref datastore ads_mzfymx, string as_yhms);//====================================================================
//更新门诊费用明细
//====================================================================

//参数定义
long ll_row
string ls_ywlx,ls_czybm
Dec{0} ldc_ywlshgl,ldc_ywlsh,ldc_mxxh,ldc_lshgl
Dec{2} ldc_jzje,ldc_zfje,ldc_yhje,ldc_ytsl

//逻辑处理
FOR ll_row = 1 To ads_mzfymx.rowcount()
	
	//初始化数据
	ls_ywlx = ads_mzfymx.object.ywlx[ll_row]
	ldc_ywlsh = ads_mzfymx.object.ywlsh[ll_row]
	ldc_mxxh = ads_mzfymx.Object.mxxh[ll_row]
	ldc_ytsl = 0
	ldc_jzje = 0
	ldc_zfje = 0
	ldc_yhje = 0
	
	//更新数据
	IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN //处方
		SELECT cfgl Into :ldc_ywlshgl From mz_cfk Where cflsh = :ldc_ywlsh;
		IF ldc_ywlshgl > 0 THEN
			SELECT sum(mz_cfmx.sl * mz_cfmx.fs ),sum(jzje),sum(zfje),sum(nvl(yhje,0)) INTO :ldc_ytsl,:ldc_jzje,:ldc_zfje,:ldc_yhje FROM mz_cfmx,mz_cfk
				WHERE mz_cfmx.cflsh = mz_cfk.cflsh AND mz_cfk.brbm = :as_brbm AND
				mz_cfk.kpsj >= :adt_kpsj AND mz_cfk.fplsh > '0' AND mz_cfk.cfgl = :ldc_ywlsh AND
				mz_cfk.cflsh <> :ldc_ywlsh And mz_cfmx.xh = :ldc_mxxh ;
			IF IsNull(ldc_ytsl) THEN ldc_ytsl = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_jzje) THEN ldc_jzje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_zfje) THEN ldc_zfje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
			ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_row] + ldc_ytsl
			IF as_yhms = '2' THEN
				ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] + ( ldc_jzje + ldc_zfje + ldc_yhje)
			ELSE
				ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] + ( ldc_jzje + ldc_zfje)
			END IF
			ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] + ldc_zfje
			ads_mzfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row] + ldc_yhje
		END IF

(nvl(MZ_YJK1.yhje,0)) INTO :ldc_ytsl,:ldc_jzje,:ldc_zfje ,:ldc_yhje
					FROM MZ_YJK1 WHERE MZ_YJK1.KPSJ >= :adt_kpsj AND  mz_yjk1.brbm = :as_brbm AND
					mz_yjk1.fplsh > '0' And mz_yjk1.yjlshgl = :ldc_ywlsh And mz_yjk1.yjlsh <> :ldc_ywlsh ;
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ldc_ytsl) THEN ldc_ytsl = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_jzje) THEN ldc_jzje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_zfje) THEN ldc_zfje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
			ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_row] + ldc_ytsl
			IF as_yhms = '2' THEN
				ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] + ( ldc_jzje + ldc_zfje + ldc_yhje)
			ELSE
				ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] + ( ldc_jzje + ldc_zfje)
			END IF
			ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] + ldc_zfje
			ads_mzfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row] = ads_mzfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row] + ldc_yhje
		END IF
	END IF
	
NEXT

FOR ll_row = 1 To ads_mzfymx.rowcount()
	//若数量小于0则直接进行删除
	IF ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_row] <= 0 Then
		ads_mzfymx.DeleteRow( ll_row )
		ll_row --
	END IF
NEXT
end subroutine

public function integer uf_gbbj_ini (ref string as_error);IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
Long ll_ret
string ls_sql
//排除zfpb的控制，因为可能传明细的时候是作废，那么干保的强制自费就没有判断进去了
ls_sql = "Select fyxh,zfbl,0 as fylx From gy_fyjy Where brxz = "+STRING(il_gbbjxz)+" And zfbl = 100 "
ls_sql += " Union All Select ypxh,zfbl,1 as fylx From gy_ypjy Where brxz = "+string(il_gbbjxz)+" And zfbl = 100 "
ls_sql += " Union All Select fyxh,100,0 From gy_ylsf Where fyxh Not In (Select fyxh From gy_fyjy Where brxz = "+string(il_gbbjxz)+" )  " //And zfpb = 0
ls_sql += " Union All Select ypxh,100,1 From yk_typk Where ypxh Not In (Select ypxh From gy_ypjy Where brxz = "+string(il_gbbjxz)+" )  "//And zfpb = 0

IF IsValid(ids_gbbj) = False THEN
	ids_gbbj = Create u_datastore
	ids_gbbj.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_gbbj.createfromsql(  ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '创建干部保健比例对象失败：' + ids_gbbj.is_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
ids_gbbj.SetTransObject( itran_sqlca)
ll_ret = ids_gbbj.Retrieve( )
IF ll_ret < 0 THEN 
	as_error = '获取干部保健比例失败：' + ids_gbbj.is_error
	RETURN -1
end if
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_get_gbbjzf (integer ai_fylx, long al_fyxh, ref decimal adc_zfbl, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_ybjk_new_his.of_get_gbbjzf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer	ai_fylx   	
// 	value    	long   	al_fyxh   	
// 	reference	decimal	adc_gbbjzf	
// 	reference	string 	as_error  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2017.03.21
//====================================================================
IF IsValid(ids_gbbj) = False THEN
	IF  uf_gbbj_ini(as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
END IF
Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_gbbj.Find( "fylx = " + String(ai_fylx) + " and fyxh = " + String(al_fyxh), 1, ids_gbbj.RowCount())
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	adc_zfbl = ids_gbbj.Object.zfbl[ll_find] / 100
ELSE
	adc_zfbl = 0.00
END IF
RETURN 1



end function

public function integer of_get_zygbbjzf (decimal ad_zyh, string as_mxzdh, ref decimal adc_gbbjzf, ref string as_error);Dec{2} ldc_gbbjzf
SELECT sum(zfje) Into :ldc_gbbjzf From jkxt.js_tsmx Where zyh = :ad_zyh And mxzdh = :as_mxzdh And  jscs = 0 And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取住院干部保健托收金额失败：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
	RETURN -1
END IF
adc_gbbjzf = ldc_gbbjzf
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_insert_tsjl (string as_brbm, decimal ad_zyh, integer ai_jscs, string as_ywly, decimal adc_tsje, string as_ywlsh, string as_mxzdh, string as_gbdxbz, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_ybjk_new_his.of_insert_tsjl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:插入干部保健托收记录
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_brbm 	
// 	value    	decimal	ad_zyh  	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jscs 	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywly 	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_tsje	
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlsh	
// 	value    	string 	as_ybywh	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2017.03.21
//====================================================================
IF Date(idt_sysdatetime) < Date(2000,1,1)  THEN
	idt_sysdatetime = gf_Server_date()
END IF
INSERT INTO JKXT.JS_TSJL
	(     TSSJ,          BRBM,    ZYH,    JSCS,   YWLY,   TSZJE,    YWLSH, ZTBZ,MXZDH,GBBZ)
	VALUES (:idt_sysdatetime,:as_brbm,:ad_zyh,:ai_jscs,:as_ywly,:adc_tsje,:as_ywlsh,0,:as_mxzdh,:as_gbdxbz)
	Using itran_sqlca ;
	
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows = 1 THEN
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	as_error = '插入干部保健托收记录失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public subroutine of_insert_tsmx (str_gbbj_tsmx astr_gbbj_tsmx);//IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
IF IsValid(ids_gbbjmx) = False THEN
	ids_gbbjmx = Create u_datastore
	ids_gbbjmx.DataObject = 'd_gbbj_tsmx'
END IF
ids_gbbjmx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_gbbjmx.reset( )
Long ll_insert,ll_count,ll_row
string ls_tsywlsh
ls_tsywlsh = astr_gbbj_tsmx.tsywlsh
ll_count = UpperBound(astr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlx)
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ll_insert = ids_gbbjmx.InsertRow(0)
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlx[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.BRBM[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.BRBM
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.ZYH
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.JSCS[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.JSCS
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.tsywh[ll_insert] = ls_tsywlsh
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.mxzdh[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.mxzdh
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlsh[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.mxlsh[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.mxlsh[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.xmxh[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.xmxh[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.zfje[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.zfje[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = astr_gbbj_tsmx.zfbl[ll_row]
	ids_gbbjmx.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
NEXT
end subroutine

public function integer uf_zhcx_tmb (string as_grbh, ref str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx_tmb()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:5.5.3.1 【5301】人员慢特病备案查询
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_grbh  
// 	reference	str_zhyl_tmbdj		astr_zhyl_tmbdj
// 	reference	string	as_return	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.24
//====================================================================
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 79 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
END IF
str_zhyl_tmbdj lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[]
This.uf_send_init('5301')
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', as_grbh) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型
IF This.uf_send( as_return, '') THEN
	Long ll_row,ll_count
	Date ld_begin,ld_end,ld_now
	ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
	ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'feedetail')
	//10	门慢门特病种11	门诊慢性病12	门诊特殊疾病20按病种结算病种 9944罕见病 30	日间手术病种40	疾病诊断病种50	中医日间病房病种99	其他病种99011	城乡居民两病9902	急危重症
	//990201	城乡居民重大疾病9903	床日付费病种9904	重特大疾病住院病种990401	特药病99041	疑难病种9905	重特大疾病门诊病种9906	血透病种9947 家庭病床病种9951	两病门诊病种9969
	//两病病种9979	三四级手术99911	重特大疾病病种99912	门诊两病病种99920	居民单病种99930	职工单病种99931	城乡居民生育病种99936	分级诊疗病种
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm = This.uf_getstring_in( 'opsp_dise_code', ll_row) //opsp_dise_code	门慢门特病种目录代码
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc = This.uf_getstring_in( 'opsp_dise_name', ll_row) //opsp_dise_name	门慢门特病种名称			
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].begndate = This.uf_getdate_in( 'begndate', ll_row) //begndate	开始日期
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].enddate = This.uf_getdate_in( 'enddate', ll_row) //enddate	结束日期
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content = This.uf_getstring_in( 'exp_content', ll_row) //exp_content	字段扩展
			IF lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content  > '' THEN
				sailjson ls_json
				ls_json = Create sailjson
				ls_json.parse( lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content)
//				1	diseTypeCode	门慢特病种类别代码	字符型	30
//				2	diagCode	门慢门特诊断代码	字符型	20
//				3	diagName	门慢门特诊断名称	字符型	100
				Boolean lb_exists
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diseTypeCode', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diseTypeCode = ls_json.getattribute( 'diseTypeCode')
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diagCode', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagCode = ls_json.getattribute( 'diagCode')
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diagName', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN
					lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagName = ls_json.getattribute( 'diagName')
					IF (IsNull(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) Or Trim(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) = '') AND lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagName >' ' THEN
						lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc = lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagName
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			IF (IsNull(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) Or Trim(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) = '')  THEN
				Select BZXX INTO :lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc From XTGL.GY_DMZD_JK Where JKLX = 'ZHYL' And DMLB In ('MXBDZ','TSBDZ','GWYMB') AND DMJC= :lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm AND ROWNUM = 1 USING itran_sqlca;				 
			END IF
			//不在有效时间范围内的那么排除
			ld_begin = lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].begndate
			ld_end = lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].enddate
			IF IsNull(ld_end) Or ld_end = Date(1900,1,1) THEN ld_end = Date(3000,1,1)
			IF ld_begin > ld_now Or ld_end < ld_now THEN
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj = lstr_zhyl_tmbdj
			IF Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) Or (ii_ksmtbqy = 1 And Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) <> Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) ) THEN
				CHOOSE CASE lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diseTypeCode
					CASE '12'
						astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbsfxs = 1
						IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
							CONTINUE
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE '10' //10	门慢门特病种(公务员慢病)
						//modify 2023.02.22温州市本地10公务员慢病走慢病,异地当特殊病处理
						IF  Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = '3303' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbsfxs = 1
							IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbsfxs = 1
							IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						END IF
					CASE '11' //门诊慢性病
						//异地慢病病人
						//modify 2023.02.22温州市本地除了10公务员慢病走慢病，11走普通，异地11走140104
						IF  Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = '3303' THEN CONTINUE
						astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbsfxs = 1
						IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
							CONTINUE
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE '9944'
						astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbsfxs = 1
						IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
							CONTINUE
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE ELSE
						//现先支持特慢病，其他后续有需要再整改  跨省因为没有对应的病种类别，默认到特殊病先
						IF ii_ksmtbqy = 1 And Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) <> Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbsfxs = 1
							IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						END IF
				END CHOOSE
			END 
IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		as_return = '该人员无慢特病备案'
		RETURN 0
	END IF
ELSE
	as_return = '【5301】人员慢特病备案查询失败：' + as_return
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1






end function

public subroutine of_judge_dcsc1tfy (ref boolean ab_dcsc1t);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_judge_dcsc1tfy()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 用于判断本次明细上传是否包含多条只能单次1条的费用
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	boolean	ab_dcsc1t	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.03.06    28271  用于判断本次明细上传是否包含多条只能单次1条的费用
//====================================================================

Long ll_row, ll_rowCount
String ls_fyxh
Long ll_count = 0
ll_rowCount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()

IF ll_rowCount <= 0 THEN RETURN

FOR ll_row = ll_rowCount To 1 Step -1
	
	IF ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN // 费用
		ls_fyxh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])
		
		IF Pos(is_DCSC1TFYXH, ','+ls_fyxh+',') > 0 THEN
			ll_count++
			IF ll_count > 1 THEN
				ab_dcsc1t = False
				ids_zyfymx.DeleteRow(ll_row)
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	
NEXT

IF ll_count = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl[1] > 0 THEN
	ab_dcsc1t = False
END IF



end subroutine

public function integer of_mz_mxsc (string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_bzdm, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, string as_czybm, string as_yllb, ref decimal adc_fyze, ref decimal adc_gbbjzf, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_mz_mxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:2204门诊费用明细信息上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string           	as_brbm       	
// 	value    	integer          	ai_jslx       	
// 	value    	string           	as_jylx       	
// 	reference	str_yb_mzsfqq_new	astr_yb_mzsfqq	
// 	value    	string           	as_yllb       	
// 	reference	decimal          	adc_fyze      	
// 	reference	string           	as_error      	

//1、fontcharset
righttoleft
__set_attribute_item
+selectionchanged
fontcharset
raggedright
selectedtab
tabtextcolor
tabbackcolor
picturename
picturemaskcolor
交易输入费用明细为多行数据，交易输出为多行数据；
//2、同一收费批次的费用明细，应尽量一次全部上传，一次只能上传一个收费批次；
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer   返回  
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================
//【2204】门诊费用明细信息上传
IF ai_jslx = 2 THEN RETURN 0
String ls_expcontent
//hw 2023/09/05 门诊外伤
Integer li_mzws

SELECT MZWSBZ INTO :li_mzws FROM MZXT.MZ_JZXX WHERE JZLSH = :astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh USING itran_sqlca;
ls_expcontent = String(li_mzws)
IF This.of_get_expcontent( ls_expcontent, as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_ghsf,ls_cbdxzqh,ls_error,ls_fplsh,ls_xlh
ls_cbdxzqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
DateTime ldt_now
ldt_now = gf_server_date()

ls_ghsf = Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
IF ls_ghsf = 'SF' Or ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型不对:'+ls_ghsf
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_rowcount,ll_count_ret,li_gbbj_insert
ll_rowcount = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount <= 0 THEN
	as_error = '【2204】交易费用明细无数据!FPLSH:' + astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
	RETURN -1
END IF
//发票流水号增加序列取值，对于预结算，可能会存在用过了不能再用
IF IsNull( astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) Or Trim(astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) = '' THEN
	IF This.of_get_jzxlh(ls_xlh,as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'FEYFP' + ls_xlh
END IF
ls_fplsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
String ls_ksmc,ls_yllb,ls_gdbbz,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh,ls_gjybbm,ls_bzbm,ls_ysbm_gjm,ls_ybksbm,ls_sypc,ls_ybsypc
ls_yllb = as_yllb
ls_bzbm = as_bzdm
//科室
ls_ksbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	SELECT zyks Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_error = '【2204】科室为空！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
IF IsNull(ls_ybksbm) Or ls_ybksbm = '' Or ls_ybksbm = 'NULL'  Or ls_ybksbm = '无' THEN
	as_error = '【2204】门诊科室（'+ls_ksbm+'）未医保对照，请联系医保科完成对照！'
	RETURN -1
	ls_ybksbm = ls_ksbm
	ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
ELSE
	ls_ksmc = This.of_get_dmmc( 'caty',ls_ybksbm)
END IF
IF ls_ksmc = '' Or IsNull(ls_ksmc) THEN
	as_error = '【2204】获取科室名称失败：' + ls_ksbm
	RETURN -1
END IF
//医生
ls_ysbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm
IF IsNull(ls_ysbm) Or ls_ysbm = '' THEN
	IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		ls_ysbm = is_ghks_ys
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = is_ghks_ys
	ELSE
		as_error = '传入开单医生为空'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
IF of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm,ls_ysxm,ls_yszh,True,as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = ls_ysxm
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm)  < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
			as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科�'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			ls_ysbm_gjm = ls_ysbm
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//END IF
str_gbbj_tsmx lstr_gbbj_tsmx
li_gbbj_insert = 0
//费用明细列表（节点标识：feedetail）
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_his'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset( )
//费用明细列表
Dec{0} ldc_ywlsh,ldc_ywmxxh,ldc_ghlsh
Dec{2} ldc_ylfyze,ldc_fysl,ldc_gbbjzf = 0.00,ldc_bscje = 0.00,ldc_ycyl
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_zfbl
Integer li_cyts,li_tsdz,li_sczs,li_scrow,li_left,li_right,li_ret,li_danff=-1
String ls_mxxh,ls_ywlx,ls_jzid,ls_xmzxbh_ts,ls_yyspbz,ls_dfybz,ls_yyxmbh,ls_ycjl,ls_syfybz = '0',ls_yytj = '',ls_memo,ls_bscmx,ls_data[]
Long ll_find,ll_insert,ll_find1,ll_mxtop,ll_mxscxh,ll_mxjs
boolean lb_dfbz = true
ls_jzid =  astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzid
ldc_ghlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.GHLSH
adc_fyze = 0.00
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' And as_jylx <> 'TJ' THEN
	//干部保健初始化
	IF uf_gbbj_ini(as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
END IF
