				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("selfpay_prop", ll_row) //6	selfpay_prop	自付比例	数值型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.QZFJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("fulamt_ownpay_amt", ll_row) //7	fulamt_ownpay_amt	全自费金额	数值型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.CXJJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("overlmt_amt", ll_row) //8	overlmt_amt	超限价金额	数值型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XXZFUJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("preselfpay_amt", ll_row) //9	preselfpay_amt	先行自付金额	数值型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FHZCFWJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("inscp_scp_amt", ll_row) //10	inscp_scp_amt	符合政策范围金额	数值型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chrgitm_lv", ll_row) //11	chrgitm_lv	收费项目等级	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLSFXMLB[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("med_chrgitm_type", ll_row) //12	med_chrgitm_type	医疗收费项目类别	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.JBYWBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("bas_medn_flag", ll_row) //13	bas_medn_flag	基本药物标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YBTPYPBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("hi_nego_drug_flag", ll_row) //14	hi_nego_drug_flag	医保谈判药品标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ETYYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chld_medc_flag", ll_row) //15	chld_medc_flag	儿童用药标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MLTXBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("list_sp_item_flag", ll_row) //16	list_sp_item_flag	目录特项标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.XZSYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("lmt_used_flag", ll_row) //17	lmt_used_flag	限制使用标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ZBBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("drt_reim_flag", ll_row) //18	drt_reim_flag	直报标志	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] = ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] + ' R:' + uf_getstring_in("memo", ll_row) //19	memo	备注	字符型
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.expcont[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("exp_content", ll_row) //20	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型
				ll_find = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Find("ywlsh = "+ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlsh[ll_find_sc] +" and mxxh = " + ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert],1,99999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					IF astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] <>  ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] THEN
						ldc_zfje = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_find] * ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc]
						astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc]
						astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = ldc_zfje
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
			IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
				COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
			ELSE
				as_error = 'ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
				ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		ELSE
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset( )
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_get_gbbjdx (integer ai_gx, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_get_gbbjdx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer	ai_gx    	0 当天有效 1表里取
// 	reference	string 	as_return	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.03.07
//====================================================================

IF ii_gbbjqy = 1 THEN
	This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( )
	String ls_district,ls_gbbjdx
	Long ll_return
	IF ai_gx = 0 THEN
		SELECT DISTRICT Into :ls_district From  MZXT.MZ_WZFLXX Where sfzh = :istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno And ydlx = 0 And ydlxms = '老干部'  And gxsj > Sysdate - 1 Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT DISTRICT Into :ls_district From  MZXT.MZ_WZFLXX Where sfzh = :istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno And ydlx = 0 And ydlxms = '老干部'  Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_district) Or ls_district = '' THEN
		IF Not IsValid(in_wsfl_wz) THEN
			in_wsfl_wz = Create n_wsfl_wz
		END IF
		str_wsfl_fyxx lstr_brxx,lstr_return
		//判断是否是优抚人员
		lstr_brxx.as_brxm = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm
		lstr_brxx.as_sfzh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno
		lstr_brxx.as_brbm = ''
		lstr_brxx.ai_flag = 0
		ll_return = in_wsfl_wz.uf_get_ydry( lstr_brxx, lstr_return)
		IF  ll_return > 0 THEN //是优待人员的，就去取优惠信息
			IF lstr_return.ai_ydlx  = 0 And lstr_return.as_ydlx_mc = '老干部' THEN //0是干部保健其他不是
				ls_district = lstr_return.as_district //获取对应的地区描述
			ELSE
				RETURN 0
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_return = lstr_return.as_err
			RETURN 0
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_district = Trim(ls_district)
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjms = ls_district
	SELECT DMSB Into :ls_gbbjdx From xtgl.gy_dmzd_jk Where  jklx = 'YB' And dmlb = '35' And DMSB <> '-9999' And dmmc = :ls_district Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '获取干部保健编码失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_sblog("c:\sblog",string(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno) + '--' + as_return)
		RETURN 0
	END IF
	//	IF ls_gbbjdx >= '1' And ls_gbbjdx <= '7' THEN	
	IF IsNull(ls_gbbjdx) Or Trim(ls_gbbjdx) = '' THEN 
		ls_gbbjdx = '2'
	END IF
	istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz = ls_gbbjdx
	IF ls_gbbjdx >= '1' THEN RETURN 1
END IF
RETURN 0
end function

public 
function integer uf_zy_jscl (integer ai_jsbz, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, integer ai_jslx, string as_fplsh, string as_jydd, ref str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_jscl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院预结算、住院结算
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer        ai_jsbz  0-预结算；1-结算        	
// 	value    	long         	al_zyh        	
// 	value    	integer      	ai_jscs       	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_zzrq 
// 	value    	integer      	ai_jslx 
// 	value    	string       	as_fplsh      	
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd       	
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271    住院预结算、住院结算
//====================================================================

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ai_jsbz <> 0 And ai_jsbz <> 1 THEN
	as_error = "结算标志有误：" + String(ai_jsbz)
	GOTO Error
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF This.of_get_zyqy( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 确认结算之前，做一次出院办理
IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	IF This.uf_zy_cybl( al_zyh, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		// 如果出院办理返回的报错是“已经是出院状态”，说明已经出院办理过，直接进入结算，不失败
		IF Pos(as_error, "已经是出院状态") <= 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
			//			goto Error
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

String ls_ybkh,ls_sbm,ls_lp
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_scjssj
SetNull(ldt_scjssj)
String ls_grbh // 人员编号
String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_jzpzlzx, ls_jzpzbh // 就诊凭证类型、就诊凭证编号
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje // 医疗费用总额
String ls_grjsfs = '01' // 个人结算方式：默认01-按项目结算
String ls_grzhsybz = '1' // 个人账户使用标志：默认1-是
String ls_xzlx // 险种类型
String ls_cbdxzqh // 参保地医保区划
String ls_fphm // 发票号
String ls_ztjsbz = '0' // 中途结算标志：：默认0-否
Decimal{2} ldc_qzfje, ldc_cxjje, ldc_xxzfje, ldc_fhzcfwje,ldc_gbbjzf // 全自费金额、超限价金额、先行自付金额、先行自付金额、干部保健支付
DateTime ldt_cysj // 出院时间
String ls_bzbm // 病种编码
String ls_jzpzsbm // 就诊凭证识别码
String ls_expContent // 字段扩展

Integer li_yepb
String ls_zyhm, ls_yllb, ls_cbdybqh
Long ll_ybscmxCount, ll_bsccont
String ls_ret[]

IF ii_myjsflqy = 1 THEN
	li_yepb = 0
ELSE
	li_yepb = -1
END IF

// 获取 住院基本信息
SELECT     ZYHM,     YBKH,    ZHBZ, MZJCODE,   YBJZBH,    BQCYSJ
	INTO :ls_zyhm, :ls_ybkh, :ls_sbm,  :ls_lp, :ls_jzid, :ldt_cysj
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院基本信息失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
SELECT Max(ZZRQ) Into :ldtuf_send_init
uf_send_add_in_mxnr
feedetl_sn
uf_send_add_in
371406*20224195509194613
chrg_bchno
rx_circ_flag
fee_ocur_time
2021-05-24
med_list_codg
XJ01CAA040A001010102699
medins_list_codg
det_item_fee_sumamt
sin_dos_dscr
used_frqu_dscr
medc_way_dscr
bilg_dept_codg
bilg_dept_name
bilg_dr_codg
bilg_dr_name
acord_dept_codg
acord_dept_name
orders_dr_code
orders_dr_name
hosp_appr_flag
tcmdrug_used_way
etip_hosp_dscg_tkdrug_flag
matn_fee_flag
exp_content
ids_send_in
dataname = "datacount"
ids_send_in
堾datamxnr
__get_attribute_item
_scjssj From ZY_ZYJS Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZFPB = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ldt_scjssj) Or Date(ldt_scjssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_scjssj = ldt_ryrq
END IF

IF IsNull(ai_jscs) Or ai_jscs < 0 THEN
	as_error = '结算次数有误！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_zyhm) Or Trim(ls_zyhm) = '' THEN
	as_error = '住院号码为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = '就诊ID为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF


// 获取 住院登记明细
SELECT     GRBH,      JZPZLX,     JZPZBH,     XZLX,     CBDYBQH,     YLLB,     BZBM,     CBDYBQH
	INTO :ls_grbh, :ls_jzpzlzx, :ls_jzpzbh, :ls_xzlx, :ls_cbdxzqh, :ls_yllb, :ls_bzbm, :ls_cbdybqh
	FROM JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND ZYH = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = '' THEN
	as_error = "人员编号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_xzlx) Or Trim(ls_xzlx) = '' THEN
	as_error = "险种类型为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdxzqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdxzqh) = '' THEN
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN  ls_yllb = '21'
IF IsNull(ls_bzbm) THEN ls_bzbm = ''
// 获取 医疗费用总额
// 2022.01.19  CJN  28271  TEMP  相关表需要修改
// 2021.11.25  CJN  27471  剔除医保不上传费用（jkxt.zhyb_fymxsc_syd.ztbz=9）； 获取医保不上传费用的总金额
ll_ybscmxCount = 0
SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_ybscmxCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And (nvl(yepb,0) = :li_yepb Or -1 = :li_yepb) And nvl(yepb,0) <> 9 Using itran_sqlca;
IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 THEN
	// 获取医保不上传费用的总金额
	IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
		SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhids_structre
Upper(jklx)=' ' and Upper(jkfl)=' 'and Upper(mxsm)=' yl_jsxx.bscfyje,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And JSCS = 0 And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From JKXT.zhyb_fymxsc_zy Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9) Using itran_sqlca; 	ELSE
		SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And JSCS = 0 And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From JKXT.zhyb_fymxsc Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
IF ll_ybscmxCount > 0 THEN
ELSE
	SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_ybscmxCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And (nvl(yepb,0) = :li_yepb Or -1 = :li_yepb) And nvl(yepb,0) <> 9 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 THEN
		IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
			SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje ,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From JKXT.zhyb_fymxsc_zy Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9) Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje ,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From JKXT.zhyb_fymxsc Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9) Using itran_sqlca;
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_zjje) THEN ldc_zjje = 0.00
IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje) THEN astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje = 0.00
IF IsNull(ll_ybscmxCount) THEN ll_ybscmxCount = 0
IF IsNull(ll_bsccont) THEN ll_bsccont = 0
ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje
ll_ybscmxCount = ll_ybscmxCount - ll_bsccont
IF ai_jsbz = 1 And ldc_zjje = 0 THEN
	This.uf_zy_crycx( 2, al_zyh, Ref as_error) // 自动出院办理撤销
	This.uf_zy_delfymx( al_zyh, '0000', Ref as_error) // 自动删除明细
	as_error = "病人无医保费用，请撤销登记转自费结算！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF ll_ybscmxCount = 0 THEN
	as_error = '无结算数据'
	RETURN 0
END IF

// 获取 就诊凭证类型、就诊凭证编号
If (Not IsNull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JZPZLX)) And Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JZPZLX) > "" THEN
	ls_jzpzlzx = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.JZPZLX
END IF
IF ls_jzpzlzx = '01' THEN // 如果是凭证登记的病人，则使用zy_brry.MZJCODE作为凭证令牌
	ls_jzpzbh = ls_lp
END IF
IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) And Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) > "" THEN
	ls_jzpzbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzpzlzx) Or Trim(ls_jzpzlzx) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊凭证类型为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzpzbh) Or Trim(ls_jzpzbh) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊凭证编号为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 个人结算方式
// ls_grjsfs
IF IsNull(ls_grjsfs) Or Trim(ls_grjsfs) = "" THEN ls_grjsfs = '01'
IF IsNull(ls_grzhsybz) Or Trim(ls_grzhsybz) = "" THEN ls_grzhsybz = '1'
IF ai_jscs > 1 THEN
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm + "D" + String(ai_jscs)
ELSE
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm
END IF
// 中途结算标志

IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	ls_ztjsbz = '1'
ELSE
	ls_ztjsbz = '0'
END IF
IF ls_ztjsbz = '1' THEN
	ldt_cysj = adt_zzrq // 如果是中结，则使用中结日期
END IF

// 获取 全自费金额、超限价金额、先行自付金额、先行自付金额
// ldc_qzfje, ldc_cxjje, ldc_xxzfje, ldc_fhzcfwje

//hw 2023/08/08
Integer li_jslb
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.sydbz <> 0 THEN
	SELECT JSLB Into :li_jslb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF li_jslb = 2 THEN
		ls_expContent = "22"
	END IF
END IF
// 获取 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	This.uf_send_init('2303A') // 预结算
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('2304A') // 确认结算
END IF

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_type', ls_jzpzlzx) // 就诊凭证类型
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_no', ls_jzpzbh) // 就诊凭证编号
This.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt', ldc_zjje) // 医疗费总额
This.uf_send_add('psn_setlway', ls_grjsfs) // 个人结算方式：01-按项目结算，02-按定额结算，09-其他，990104-按限额
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('acct_used_flag', ls_grzhsybz) // 个人账户使用标志：0-否，1-是
This.uf_send_add('insutype', ls_xzlx) // 险种类型
This.uf_send_add('insuplc_admdvs', ls_cbdxzqh) // 参保地医保区划
This.uf_send_add('mdtrtarea_admvs', is_yljgxzqh) // 就医地医保区划
This.uf_send_add('invono', ls_fphm) // 发票号
This.uf_send_add('mid_setl_flag', ls_ztjsbz) // 中途结算标志：0-否，1-是
This.uf_send_add('fulamt_ownpay_amt', '') // 全自费金额
This.uf_send_add('overlmt_selfpay', '') // 超限价金额
This.uf_send_add('preselfpay_amt', '') // 先行自付金额
This.uf_send_add('inscp_scp_amt', '') // 符合政策范围金额
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_sn', ls_jzpzsbm) // 就诊凭证识别码
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	// 预结算字段
	IF IsNull(ldt_cysj) Or Date(ldt_cysj) <= Date(2000,1,1) THEN
		This.uf_send_add('dscgTime', '')
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('dscgTime', ldt_cysj) // 出院时间
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('dise_codg', ls_bzbm) // 病种编码
END IF

IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	IF of_get_zygbbjzf(al_zyh,ls_jzid,ldc_gbbjzf,as_error) < 0 THEN 	GOTO Error
END IF

IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	ls_yllb = astr_zhyl_jsxx.YLLB // 医疗类别以实际结算结果返回的为准
	IF This.of_insert_jymx('', al_zyh, ai_jscs, ls_fphm, 'ZY', as_jydd, ls_yllb, '', ls_zyhm, astr_zhyl_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error, '') THEN
	IF Pos(as_error, "出院时间不可早于费用发生时间") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "请删除明细后重传明细！"
	END IF
	IF Pos(as_error, "该参保人在相同时间段存在与已登记就诊日期交叉") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "该参保人住院期间在门诊使用过该医保卡就诊，本次住院请撤销医保登记自费结算！"
	END IF
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
IF UpperBound(ls_ret) >= 3 And ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	gf_update_suf_send_init
uf_send_add_in_mxnr

This.of_reset_jsxx(Ref astr_zhyl_jsxx)
This.of_get_ybjsxx(ai_jsbz+10, Ref astr_zhyl_jsxx) // 解析并存储医保返回的结算金额明细
IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj) Or  Date(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN // 测试时发现医保返回的结算时间经常为空，若为空则使用本地服务器时间
	astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj = gf_server_date()
END IF
astr_zhyl_jsxx.gbbjzf = ldc_gbbjzf
IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	IF This.of_update_jsmx(is_jylsh, astr_zhyl_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		//		as_error = '【医保端】结算成功，但更新本地结算明细表失败：' + as_error
		GOTO Error_ybRollBack
	END IF
END IF
istr_zhyl_jsxx = astr_zhyl_jsxx


IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
RETURN 1

Error_ybRollBack:
DateTime ldt_temp
String ls_error_jyzf
// 调用“交易作废”，作废本次结算，并撤销本次出院办理
IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_temp, '2304', ls_grbh, is_jylsh, Ref ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf
IF This.uf_zy_crycx( 2, al_zyh, Ref ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf

Error:
IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	as_error = "[2303A-住院预结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	as_error = "[2304A-住院结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSE
	as_error = "[住院预结算/结算]出错：" + as_error
END IF

RETURN -1


end function

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, string as_fymxlsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_delfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院费用明细撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_fymxlsh	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.23    28271  住院费用明细撤销
//====================================================================

IF isnull(al_zyh) or al_zyh=0 Then
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_fymxlsh) or Trim(as_fymxlsh)="" Then
	as_fymxlsh = "0000"
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_JZID  ,ls_grbh ,ls_expContent ,ls_cbdybqh // 就诊ID,人员编号,字禗AT*

// 获取 就诊ID
Select YBJZBH into :ls_jzid
  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH=:al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取就诊ID失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_jzid) or Trim(ls_jzid)="" Then
	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

// 获取 人员编号
Select     GRBH,     CBDYBQH
  into :ls_grbh, :ls_cbdybqh
  From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX 
 Where JZID=:ls_jzid
 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_grbh) or Trim(ls_grbh)="" Then
	as_error = "人员编号不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_cbdybqh) or Trim(ls_cbdybqh)="" Then 
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，不能删除明细，请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	goto Error
END IF

// 获取 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, ref ls_expContent, ref as_error)<0 Then
	goto Error
END IF


This.uf_send_init('2302')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm             			// 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh         // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('feedetl_sn', as_fymxlsh)      // 费用明细流水号：传入"0000"时删除全部
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid)           // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)             // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent)  // 字段扩展


// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error, '') Then
	// 由于测试时明细撤销时发现，没有做明细上传且直接做明细撤销会返回这个报错，因此这里做特殊处理
	IF Pos(as_error, "根据传来的参数在费用明细表中未查询到任何有效相关的记录") <= 0 And Pos(as_error, "费用明细信息不符合撤销要求") <= 0  THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF as_fymxlsh="0000" Then
	DELETE From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ=0  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但删除住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	if ii_zyqy_qy > 0 then 
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	end if
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
	
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Set MXBS=MXBS-1  Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ=0 and JSRQ=(SELECT Max(JSRQ) From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where zyh=:al_zyh And ztbz = 0) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但更新住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	IF ii_zyqy_br > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	end if
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1


Error:
as_error = "[2302-住院费用明细撤销]出错：" + as_error
return -1


end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_xs (string as_knsj, datetime adt_kssj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx_xs()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:显示账户信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_knsj 	
// 	value    	dateTime	adt_kssj	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.25
//====================================================================
Date ld_now
String ls_czybm
ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 79 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.knsj = as_knsj
String ls_jzpzlx
ls_jzpzlx = This.of_get_jzpzlx( as_knsj, lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl,Ref as_error)
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = ls_jzpzlx
IF ls_jzpzlx > ' ' THEN
	This.uf_send_init('1101')
	This.istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	IF lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm > ' ' THEN
		istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_type', ls_jzpzlx) //mdtrt_cert_type	就诊凭证类型	字符型	3	Y	Y	
	This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) //mdtrt_cert_no	就诊凭证编号	字符型	50		Y	就诊凭证类型为"01"时填写电子凭证令牌，为"02"时填写身份证号，为"03"时填写社会保障卡卡号
	This.uf_send_add('card_sn', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm) //card_sn	卡识别码	字符型	32			就诊凭证类型为"03"时必填
	IF isnull(adt_kssj) or Date(adt_kssj)<=Date(2000,1,1) Then
		This.uf_send_add('begntime', '') 
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('begntime', adt_kssj) //begntime	开始时间	日期时间型				获取历史参保信息时传入
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('psn_cert_type', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type) //psn_cert_type	人员证件类型	字符型	6	Y		
	This.uf_send_add('certno', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno ) //certno	证件号码	字符型	50		Y	
	This.uf_send_add('psn_name', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm ) //psn_name	人员姓名	字符型	50		Y	
	IF uf_s
end(Ref as_error, '') THEN
		istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.knsj = as_knsj
		of_get_zhxx(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl)
		// ADD by sxl 增加特慢病是否享受判断
		IF This.uf_zhcx_tmb( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh , istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl, as_error) > 0 THEN
		END IF
		//判断是否干部保健并确认地区对象
		String ls_error
		IF uf_get_gbbjdx(0,ls_error) <= 0 THEN
			istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz = '0'
			istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjms =''
		END IF
		OpenWithParm(w_yb_jbxx_xs,'1')
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		as_error = "[1101-人员基本信息获取]出错：" + as_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = "[1101-人员基本信息获取]出错：无就诊凭证类型！"
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

// 返回:  integer

as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx, 3)
IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
	ls_yllb = '12' //挂号
ELSEIF ls_ghsf = 'TJ' THEN
	ls_yllb = '9107'
ELSEIF ls_yllb = 'SY' THEN
	ls_yllb = '51'
ELSE
	ls_yllb = '11' // 普通门诊
	IF as_jylx = 'TSB' THEN
		ls_yllb = '140201'
	ELSEIF as_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
		ls_yllb = '14'  // 门诊慢特病  对应公务员慢病
	ELSEIF as_jylx = 'HJB' THEN 
		ls_yllb = '140401'  // 门诊罕见病
	ELSEIF as_jylx = "BBTNZ" THEN //HW 2023/12/20 BBTNZ
		ls_yllb = "991702"  
	END IF
END IF
IF ii_ksmtbqy = 1 And  Left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) <> Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) THEN
	IF ls_yllb = '140201' Or ls_yllb = '140104'  THEN ls_yllb = '14'   //
END IF
// 获取 诊断信息集合
ldc_jzlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.jzlsh
If (IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0) And ldc_ghlsh > 0 THEN
	SELECT jzlsh Into :ldc_jzlsh From mzxt.mz_jzxx Where ghlsh = :ldc_ghlsh Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF this.of_get_mz_zdxx( ls_yllb, ldc_jzlsh, astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ysbm, ref ls_zddm[], ref ls_zdmc[], ref ls_zdms, ref li_syzd)<0 Then
	as_error = "获取门诊诊断失败:" + ls_zdms
	goto Error
END IF
ll_upperBound = UpperBound(ls_zddm)
IF ll_upperBound>0 Then
	// 就诊时间暂时先这样取，之后要改
	Select JZSJ into :ldt_jzsj From MZXT.MZ_JZXX Where JZLSH=:ldc_jzlsh Using sqlca;
	IF isnull(ldt_jzsj) or Date(ldt_jzsj)<Date(2000,1,1) Then
		ldt_jzsj = ldt_now
	END IF
	For ll_i=1 to ll_upperBound Step 1
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].dise_id = String(ldc_jzlsh)	// 诊断标识
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].inout_dise_type = ''  		// 出入诊断类别
		IF ll_i=1 Then
			lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].maindise_flag = '1'  		// 主诊断标志
		ELSE
			lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].maindise_flag = '0'  		// 主诊断标志
		END IF
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].dias_srt_no = String(ll_i)	// 诊断排序号
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].dise_codg = ls_zddm[ll_i]	// 诊断(疾病)编码
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].dise_name = ls_zdmc[ll_i]	// 诊断(疾病)名称
		lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[ll_i].dise_date = ldt_jzsj			// 诊断日期
	Next
END IF

// 获取 医师标识
ls_ysbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ysbm
IF IsNull(ls_ysbm) Or ls_ysbm = '' THEN
	ls_ysbm = '000000'
	ls_ysxm = '未知'
	ls_ysbm_gjm = '000000'
	ls_ygjb = ''
ELSE
	IF this.of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm, ref ls_ysxm, ref ls_sfzh,true, ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		as_error = ls_ysxm
		goto Error
	END IF
	IF this.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ref ls_ysbm_gjm)  < 0 THEN		
		as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
		goto Error
	END IF
	
	// 获取 医生职称：231-主任医师、232-副主任医师、233-主诊医师、234-医师、235-医士
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+ls_ysbm+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find>0 Then
		ls_ygjb = String(ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_find])
	END IF
	CHOOSE CASE ls_ygjb
		CASE '201'
			ls_ygjb = '231'
		CASE '202'
			ls_ygjb = '232'
		CASE '203'
			ls_ygjb = '233'
		CASE '204'
			ls_ygjb = '234'
		CASE '205'
			ls_ygjb = '235'
		CASE ELSE
			ls_ygjb = '233'
	END CHOOSE
END IF

// 获取 入院科室标识、入院科室名称、出院科室标识、出院科室名称
ls_ksbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ksbm
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_error = "科室编码为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
ls_ksmc = this.of_get_dzdmsbmc('MZ_KS', ls_ksbm)
IF isnull(ls_ksmc) or ls_ksmc <= '' THEN
	as_error = '未找到对应的科室名称 MZ_KS ' + ls_ksbm
	goto Error
END IF

// 获取 处方信息集合
ll_rowcount = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowCount>0 and astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.dataObject<>'d_gh_ghfy' Then
	For ll_i=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
		ls_ywlx = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
		ls_ywlsh = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.ywlsh[ll_i])
		ls_mxxh = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.mxxh[ll_i])
		ls_ypzh = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.ypzh[ll_i])
		IF isnull(ls_ypzh) then ls_ypzh=""
		ll_fyxh = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_i]
		ll_ypcd = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.cdlsh[ll_i]
		
		ldc_dj = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmdj[ll_i]
		ldc_sl = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmsl[ll_i]
		ldc_zjje = astr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ads_mzfymx.Object.zjje[ll_i]
		
		// 处方(医嘱)标识
		IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' Then
			ls_rx_id = ls_ywlx + ls_ywlsh + "#" + ls_mxxh
		ELSE
			ls_rx_id = ls_ywlx + ls_ywlsh + "#" + ls_mxxh
		END IF
		
		
		IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' Then  
			// 处方
			ll_find = This.of_get_jbxx(1, ll_fyxh, ll_ypcd, 'MZ', ldt_now,  ref ls_xmzxbh_ts, ref li_tsdz, ref as_error)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN goto Error
			
			ls_gjybbm = String(ids_typk.Object.YLMLBM[ll_find]) 
			ls_memo = String(ids_typk.Object.memo[ll_find])
			ls_yljgmlbm = String(ids_typk.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_find])
			ls_mllb = String(ids_typk.Object.mllb[ll_find])
			ls_sflb = String(ids_typk.Object.sflb[ll_find])
			ls_ybmlmc = String(ids_typk.Object.ybmlmc[ll_find])
			ls_ybmldj = String(ids_typk.Object.ybmldj[ll_find])
			ls_fymc = String(ids_typk.Object.YPMC[ll_find])
		ELSE  
			// 医技
			ll_find = this.of_get_jbxx(0, ll_fyxh, 0, 'MZ', ldt_now, ref ls_xmzxbh_ts, ref li_tsdz, ref as_error)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN goto Error
			
			ls_gjybbm = String(ids_ylsf.Object.YLMLBM[ll_find])
			ls_memo = String(ids_ylsf.Object.memo[ll_find])
			ls_yljgmlbm = String(ids_ylsf.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_find])
			ls_mllb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.mllb[ll_find])
			ls_sflb = String(ids_ylsf.Object.sflb[ll_find])
			ls_ybmlmc = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ybmlmc[ll_find])
			ls_ybmldj = String(ids_ylsf.Object.ybmldj[ll_find])
			ls_fymc = String(ids_ylsf.Object.FYMC[ll_find])
		END IF
		
		
		
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].rx_id = ls_rx_id				//	1	rx_id						处方(医嘱)标识			字符型	50			Y	处方(医嘱)记录唯一ID，就是费用肈AT*
飨傅牧魉��

		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].rxno = ls_ywlsh					//	2	rxno						处方号					字符型	20			Y	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].grpno = ls_ypzh					//	3	grpno						组编号					字符型	20			
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].long_drord_flag = '0'			//	4	long_drord_flag		是否为长期医嘱			字符型	3			Y	[1=是,0=否]
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_type = ls_mllb  		//	5	hilist_type				目录类别					字符型	3		Y	Y	参考字典list_type
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].chrg_type = ls_sflb 			//	6	chrg_type				收费繢AT*
					字符型	3		Y	Y	参考字典MED_CHRGITM_TYPE
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_bhvr = '1'  				//	7	drord_bhvr				医嘱行为					字符型	3		Y	Y	参考字典drord_bhvr：1-出院带药、2-转床、3-观察医嘱
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_code = ls_gjybbm		//	8	hilist_code				医保目录代码			字符型	20			Y	国家统一标准编码，取费用明细表的hilist_code
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_name = ls_ybmlmc  	//	9	hilist_name				医保目录名称			字符型	50			Y	国家统一标准名称，取费用明细表的hilist_name
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_dosform = ''			//	10	hilist_dosform			医保目录(药品)剂型	字符型	50				国家统一标准药品剂型
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_lv = ls_ybmldj 		//	11	hilist_lv				医保目录等级			字符型	3			Y	取字典：hilist_lv：1-甲类、2-乙类、3-丙类
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_pric = ldc_dj  		//	12	hilist_pric				医保目录价格			数值型	16,2		Y	取费用明细表的pric（即本院单价）
		SetNull(lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].lv1_hosp_item_pric)	//	13	lv1_hosp_item_pric	一级医院目录价格		数值型	16,2			（可以传空，但是不能传0）
		SetNull(lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].lv2_hosp_item_pric)	//	14	lv2_hosp_item_pric	二级医院目录价格		数值型	16,2			（可以传空，但是不能传0）			
		SetNull(lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].lv3_hosp_item_pric)	//	15	lv3_hosp_item_pric	三级医院目录价格		数值型	16,2			（可以传空，但是不能传0）		
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hilist_memo = ls_memo			//	16	hilist_memo				医保目录备注			字符型	200	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hosplist_code = ls_yljgmlbm	//	17	hosplist_code			医院腄AT*
			字符型	20			Y	取费用明细的medins_list_codg
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hosplist_name = ls_fymc		//	18	hosplist_name			医院目录名称			字符型	50			Y	取费用明细的medins_list_name
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].hosplist_dosform = ""			//	19	hosplist_dosform		医院目录(药品)剂型	字符型	20	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].cnt = ldc_sl						//	20	cnt						数量						数值型	6,2		Y	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].pric = ldc_dj					//	21	pric						单价						数值型	16,2		Y	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].sumamt = ldc_zjje				//	22	sumamt					总费用					数值型	16,2		Y	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].ownpay_amt = ldc_zjje			//	23	ownpay_amt				自费金额					数值型	16,2		Y	
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].selfpay_amt = 0.00				//	24	selfpay_amt				自付金额					数值型	16,2		Y
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].spec = ''							//	25	spec						规格						字符型	100		Y	例如:0.25g×12片/盒
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].spec_unt = ''					//	26	spec_unt					数量单位					字符型	20			Y	例如：盒
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_begn_date = ldt_now	//	27	drord_begn_date		医嘱开始日期			日期型				Y	格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
		SetNull(lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_stop_date) 	//	28	drord_stop_date		医嘱停止日期			日期型					格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_dept_codg = ls_ksbm	//	29	drord_dept_codg		下达医嘱的科室标识	字符型	30			Y	药店就传LD-99
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_dept_name = ls_ksmc	//	30	drord_dept_name		下达医嘱科室名称		字符型	50			Y	药店就传LD-99
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_dr_codg = ls_ysbm		//	31	drord_dr_codg			开处方(医嘱)医生标识	字符型	30			Y	药店就传LD-99
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_dr_name = ls_ysxm		//	32	drord_dr_name			开处方(医嘱)医生姓名	字符型	30			Y	药店就传LD-99
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].drord_dr_profttl = ls_ygjb	//	33	drord_dr_profttl		开处方(医嘱)医职称	字符型	3		Y	Y	参考字典DR_PROFTTL
		lstr_fsi_order_dtos[ll_i].curr_drord_flag = '1'			//	34	curr_drord_flag		是否当前处方(医嘱)	字符型	3			Y	本次处方(医嘱)标记[1=是,0=否]
	Next
END IF


IF this.uf_sqszfx( ls_cfcj, ls_jzid, ls_yllb, ldt_jzsj, ldt_jzsj, lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[], ls_ysbm_gjm, ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc, ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc, lstr_fsi_order_dtos[], ref as_error)<0 Then
	goto Error
END IF

return 1

Error:
as_error = "[3102-明细审核事中分析服务]出错：" + as_error
return -1
end function

public function integer uf_sqfx_mz (string as_brbm, string as_ghlsh, string as_ysbm, string as_ksbm, string as_jzid, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_szfx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 事前分析
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	integer	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.04.28    29959  事前分析
//====================================================================

If ii_sqszfxqy=0 THen return 1

Long ll_find
Decimal{0} ldc_ghlsh
String ls_cfcj, ls_yllb, ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_sfzh, ls_ysbm_gjm, ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc
String ls_ygjb, ls_jzid, ls_jydd
DateTime ldt_jzsj
str_yb_mzsfqq_new lstr_yb_mzsfqq_new
str_fsi_diagnose_dtos lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[]
str_fsi_order_dtos lstr_fsi_order_dtos[]


// 获取 触发场景
ls_cfcj = '1'

// 获取 开始时间、结束时间（门诊默认为当前时间）
ldt_jzsj = gf_server_date()

// 获取 就诊ID
lstr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ysbm = as_ysbm
lstr_yb_mzsfqq_new.ksbm = as_ksbm
IF as_jzid>"" Then
	ls_jzid = as_jzid
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq_new.jzid = ls_jzid
ELSEIF This.of_get_ghjzid( 0, as_brbm, 'GH', as_ghlsh, ls_jydd, ref lstr_yb_mzsfqq_new, ref ls_jzid, ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

// 获取 医疗类别 12-挂号
ls_yllb = '12'


// 获取 医师标识
ls_ysbm = as_ysbm
IF IsNull(ls_ysbm) Or ls_ysbm = '' THEN
	ls_ysbm = '000000'
	ls_ysxm = '未知'
	ls_ysbm_gjm = '000000'
	ls_ygjb = ''
ELSE
	IF this.of_get_ygxm(ls_ysbm, ref ls_ysxm, ref ls_sfzh, true,ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		as_error = ls_ysxm
		goto Error
	END IF
	IF this.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ref ls_ysbm_gjm)  < 0 THEN		
		as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
		goto Error
	END IF
	
	// 获取 医生职称：231-主任医师、232-副主任医师、233-主诊医师、234-医师、235-医士
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+ls_ysbm+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find>0 Then
		ls_ygjb = String(ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_find])
	END IF
	CHOOSE CASE ls_ygjb
		CASE '201'
			ls_ygjb = '231'
		CASE '202'
			ls_ygjb = '232'
		CASE '203'
			ls_ygjb = '233'
		CASE '204'
			ls_ygjb = '234'
		CASE '205'
			ls_ygjb = '235'
		CASE ELSE
			ls_ygjb = '233'
	END CHOOSE
END IF




// 获取 入院科室标识、入院科室名称、出院科室标识、出院科室名称
ls_ksbm = as_ksbm
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_error = "科室编码为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
ls_ksmc = this.of_get_dzdmsbmc('MZ_KS', ls_ksbm)
IF isnull(ls_ksmc) or ls_ksmc <= '' THEN
	as_error = '未找到对应的科室名称 MZ_KS ' + ls_ksbm
	goto Error
END IF

IF this.uf_sqszfx( ls_cfcj, ls_jzid, ls_yllb, ldt_jzsj, ldt_jzsj, lstr_fsi_diagnose_dtos[], ls_ysbm_gjm, ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc, ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc, lstr_fsi_order_dtos[], ref as_error)<0 Then
	goto Error
END IF

return 1

Error:
as_error = "[3101-明细审核事前分析服务]出错：" + as_error
return -1
end function

public function integer uf_zy_zfbrscwc (long al_zyh, string as_zyhm, integer ai_jscs, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_zfbrscwc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 自费病人就诊以及费用明细上传完成
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long   	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string 	as_zyhm 	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jscs 	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.05.10    30167  自费病人就诊以及费用明细上传完成
//====================================================================

IF isnull(al_zyh) or al_zyh=0 Then
	as_error = "住院号不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_zyhm) or Trim(as_zyhm)="" Then
	as_error = "住院号码不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(ai_jscs) or ai_jscs=0 Then
	as_error = "结算次数不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF


//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_wcbz='1',ls_yyjgjzid


this.uf_send_init('4203')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm					// 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
ls_yyjgjzid = string(al_zyh) + 'D' + string(ai_jscs)

// 自费病人就诊信息										//	序号	参数代码					参数名称				参数类型	参数长度	代码标识	是否必填	说明
this.uf_send_add('fixmedins_mdtrt_id', ls_yyjgjzid)	//	1		fixmedins_mdtrt_id	医药机构就诊ID		字符型	30						Y			机构生成内唯一就诊流水
this.uf_send_add('fixmedins_code', is_yljgdm)	//	2		fixmedins_code			定点医药机构编号	字符型	30						Y	
this.uf_send_add('cplt_flag', ls_wcbz)				//	3		cplt_flag				完成标志				字符型	6						Y			费用明细和就诊信息上传完成后修改完成标志




// 发送报文
IF NOT uf_send(ref as_error, '') Then
	goto Error
END IF


String ls_sqlCode, ls_sqlErrText
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
Update JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSC Set ZTBZ=1 Where YWLX='ZY' and YYJGJZID=:ls_yyjgjzid and jscs=:ai_jscs and ztbz=0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlCode<>0 Then
	ls_sqlCode = String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)
	ls_sqlErrText = itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	gf_rollback_transacti
on(itran_sqlca)
	as_error = '更新ZFBRJYXXSC失败：['+ls_sqlCode+']' + ls_sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
Update JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSCZD Set ZTBZ=1 Where YWLX='ZY' and YYJGJZID=:ls_yyjgjzid and jscs=:ai_jscs and ztbz=0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlCode<>0 Then
	ls_sqlCode = String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)
	ls_sqlErrText = itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	as_error = '更新ZFBRJYXXSCZD失败：['+ls_sqlCode+']' + ls_sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
Update JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSCMX Set ZTBZ=1 Where YWLX='ZY' and YYJGJZID=:ls_yyjgjzid and jscs=:ai_jscs and ztbz=0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlCode<>0 Then
	ls_sqlCode = String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)
	ls_sqlErrText = itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	as_error = '更新ZFBRJYXXSCMX失败：['+ls_sqlCode+']' + ls_sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)


return 1

Error:
as_error = "[4203-自费病人就诊以及费用明细上传完成]出错：" + as_error
return -1

end function

public function integer of_get_yxmywlsh (string as_yzh, string as_fymc, string as_yljgmlbm, string as_yyspbz, decimal adc_fysl, decimal adc_fydj, ref string as_yfylsh, ref datetime adt_yxmfyfssj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_yxmywlsh()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取原收费明细流水号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_yzh         医嘱号
// 	value    	String 	as_fymc        费用名称
// 	value    	string 	as_yljgmlbm	   医疗机构目录编码（本院编码）
// 	value    	string 	as_yyspbz  	   医院审批标志
// 	value    	decimal	adc_fysl   	   数量
// 	value    	decimal	adc_fydj   	   单价
// 	reference	string 	as_yfylsh  	   对应收费项目的费用流水号
// 	reference	dateTime	adt_yxmfyfssj  对应收费项目的计费日期
// 	reference	string 	as_error   	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl   日期: 2022.02.27      
//====================================================================

String ls_filter,ls_jzid,ls_fyrq
Dec{0} ldc_zyh
Long ll_rowCount, ll_find
DateTime ldt_fyrq
ldt_fyrq = adt_yxmfyfssj
ls_fyrq = String(ldt_fyrq,'YYYY-MM-DD')
SetNull(adt_yxmfyfssj)

// 根据本地的药品/费用序号，数量进行升序，先把数量小的退了
ids_zysfjl_sc.SetSort(" YLJGMLBM, SL ")
ids_zysfjl_sc.Sort()
// 1.先根据医嘱号取获取
ls_filter = " YLJGMLBM='"+as_yljgmlbm+"' and YYSPBZ='"+as_yyspbz+"' and SL>="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+" and DJ="+String(adc_fydj)
//ls_filter = " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and YLJGMLBM='"+as_yljgmlbm+"' and YYSPBZ='"+as_yyspbz+"' and SL>="+String(adc_fysl * - 1)+" and DJ="+String(adc_fydj)
ids_zysfjl_sc.SetFilter(ls_filter)
ids_zysfjl_sc.Filter()
ll_rowCount = ids_zysfjl_sc.RowCount()
ll_find = 0
IF ll_rowCount > 0 THEN
	ldc_zyh = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jzid = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.jzid[1]
	//根据医嘱号+费用日期取是否有符合
	IF as_yzh > ' ' THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+")  and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'", 1, ll_rowCount)
		IF ll_find = 0 THEN
			ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL>"+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+")  and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'", 1, ll_rowCount)
		END IF
	END IF
	//根据医嘱号取是否有符合
	IF ll_find = 0 And as_yzh > ' ' THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
		IF ll_find = 0 THEN
			ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL>"+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
		END IF
	END IF
	//仅根据费用日期取是否有符合+数量等于大于
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+")  and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'", 1, ll_rowCount)
	END IF
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL>"+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+")  and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'", 1, ll_rowCount)
	END IF
	//根据费用日期无则取数量相等大于
	IF as_yzh > ' ' And ll_find = 0 THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
		IF ll_find = 0 THEN
			ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " YZH='"+as_yzh+"' and (SL>"+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
	END IF
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL>"+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
	END IF
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		// 如果有同一条医嘱下，有可退数量
		//	as_yfylsh = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_find] 
		as_yfylsh = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_find] // 将该条的业务流水号作为这条退费对应的收费业务流水号返回
		IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
			SELECT FYFSSJ Into :adt_yxmfyfssj From JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And jzid = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 0 And YWLSH = :as_yfylsh Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			SELECT FYFSSJ Into :adt_yxmfyfssj From JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Where zyh = :ldc_zyh And jzid = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 0 And YWLSH = :as_yfylsh Using itran_sqlca;
		END IF
		//		adt_yxmfyfssj = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_find]  									 // 将对应收费业务的计费日期返回		
		ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_find] = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_find] - Abs(adc_fysl) // 对应数量减去
		IF ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_find] = 0.00 THEN ids_zysfjl_sc.DeleteRow(ll_find) // 如果数量减到0，则删除本条可退记录
		ids_zysfjl_sc.SetSort("")
		ids_zysfjl_sc.Sort()
		ids_zysfjl_sc.SetFilter("")
		ids_zysfjl_sc.Filter()
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_error = "【医疗机构目录编码：" + as_yljgmlbm + "，费用名称："+as_fymc+"】 无可退数量！"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

// 2.如果根据医嘱号找不到（医嘱号可能为空），那就直接找可退数量
//ls_filter = " (YLJGMLBM='"+as_yljgmlbm+"') and (YYSPBZ='"+as_yyspbz+"') and (SL>0) and (DJ="+String(adc_fydj)+") "
//ids_zysfjl_sc.SetFilter(ls_filter)
//ids_zysfjl_sc.Filter()
//ll_rowCount = ids_zysfjl_sc.RowCount()
//IF ll_rowCount > 0 THEN
//	ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'",  1, ll_rowCount)
//	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
//		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL>="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") and fyrq = '" + ls_fyrq + "'",  1, ll_rowCount)
//	END IF
//	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
//		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
//	END IF
//	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
//		ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find( " (SL>="+String(Abs(adc_fysl))+") ", 1, ll_rowCount)
//	END IF
//	
//	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
//		// 有可退数量
//		//		as_yfylsh = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_find]

public function integer of_judge_dcsc1tfy2 (long al_fyxh);//====================================================================

:  integer

end function

public function integer uf_zhcx (string as_knsj, datetime adt_kssj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 人员基本信息获取
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_knsj 	
// 	value	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.17    1101 人员基本信息获取
//====================================================================
//mdtrt_cert_type	就诊凭证类型	字符型	3	Y	Y	
//mdtrt_cert_no	就诊凭证编号	字符型	50		Y	就诊凭证类型为"01"时填写电子凭证令牌，为"02"时填写身份证号，为"03"时填写社会保障卡卡号
//card_sn	卡识别码	字符型	32			就诊凭证类型为"03"时必填
//begntime	开始时间	日期时间型				获取历史参保信息时传入
//psn_cert_type	人员证件类型	字符型	6	Y		
//certno	证件号码	字符型	50		Y	
//psn_name	人员姓名	字符型	50		Y	
Date ld_now
String ls_czybm
ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6  Or base_info.syscode = 79 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.knsj = as_knsj
String ls_jzpzlx
ls_jzpzlx = This.of_get_jzpzlx( as_knsj, lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl,Ref as_error)
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = ls_jzpzlx
IF ls_jzpzlx > ' ' THEN
	This.uf_send_init('1101')
	This.istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	IF lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm > ' ' THEN
		istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_type', ls_jzpzlx)
	This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_cert_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh)
	
This.uf_send_add('card_sn', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzksbm)
	IF Date(adt_kssj) > Date(2000,1,1) THEN
		This.uf_send_add('begntime', adt_kssj)
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('begntime', '')
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('psn_cert_type', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_cert_type)
	This.uf_send_add('certno', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno )
	This.uf_send_add('psn_name', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm )
	
	IF uf_send(Ref as_error, '') THEN
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = '01'  THEN
			gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno ,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm ,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.ybdzpz )
		END IF
		of_get_zhxx(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl)
		// ADD by sxl 增加特慢病是否享受判断
		IF This.uf_zhcx_tmb( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh , istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl, as_error) > 0 THEN
		END IF
		//判断是否干部保健并确认地区对象
		String ls_error
		IF uf_get_gbbjdx(0,ls_error) <= 0 THEN
			istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz = '0'
			istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjms = ''
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx = '01'  THEN
			gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno ,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm ,istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.ybdzpz )
		END IF
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN
			as_error = '错误信息为空！'
		END IF
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = '无就诊凭证类型！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
RETURN 1

Error:
as_error = "[1101-人员基本信息获取]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer uf_mz_jzxx (integer ai_jslx, string as_brbm, string as_jzid, decimal adc_jzlsh, string as_ysbm, string as_ksbm, ref string as_yllb, string as_czybm, ref string as_bzbm, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_mz_jzxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:【2203A】门诊就诊信息上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	       	string 	as_brbm  	
// 	       	string 	as_jzid  	
// 	       	decimal	adc_jzlsh	
// 	ref      string 	as_yllb  	
// 	ref    	string   as_bzbm  	
// 	ref    	string   as_return	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_jzsj,ldt_now
String ls_bzbm,ls_bzmc,ls_bqms,ls_expcontent,ls_ysxm,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm,ls_sfzh,ls_ysbm_gjm,ls_ybksbm,ls_id
IF This.uf_set_instance( as_return) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
SELECT bzbm Into :ls_bzbm From JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And jzid = :as_jzid And czsj > sysdate - :li_ghyxts And ztbz = 1 Order By czsj Desc  Using itran_sqlca;
IF ls_bzbm > '' THEN
	IF IsNull(as_bzbm) Or as_bzbm = '' THEN as_bzbm = ls_bzbm
	RETURN 1
END IF
//if ldc_jzlsh
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF adc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
	IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
		SELECT ZZYS,BQRYSJ,BRKS Into :ls_ysbm,:ldt_jzsj,:ls_ksbm From ZY_BRRY,ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :adc_jzlsh And ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT ysbm,jzsj,jzks Into :ls_ysbm,:ldt_jzsj,:ls_ksbm From mzxt.mz_jzxx Where jzlsh = :adc_jzlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '获取就诊信息失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + 'sqlcode:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		//非当天的取当天date
		IF ii_zymz = 0 THEN
			IF Date(ldt_jzsj) <> Date(ldt_now) THEN
				ldt_jzsj = DateTime(Date(ldt_now))
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
		SELECT Id  Into :ls_id From  ysz1.e_zyblbcllb Where blid = :adc_jzlsh * 100 And lx = '1' And gsdm = '0012' Using itran_sqlca;
		SELECT nr Into :ls_bqms From ysz1.e_zyblbclnr Where Id = :ls_id And dmid = '211' Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT brbs Into :ls_bqms From mzxt.mz_bljl Where jzlsh = :adc_jzlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_ysbm = as_ysbm
	ls_ksbm = as_ksbm
	ldt_jzsj = ldt_now
	ls_bqms = '健康查体'
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
		SELECT ksdm Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT zyks Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_return = '科室为空！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
	ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM',ls_ksbm)
ELSE
	ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ybksbm) Or ls_ybksbm = '' Or ls_ybksbm = 'NULL'  Or ls_ybksbm = '无' THEN
	ls_ybksbm = ls_ksbm
END IF
//-------------------------
IF Len(ls_bqms) > 1000 THEN
	ls_bqms = of_midstring(ls_bqms,1000)
END IF
IF This.of_get_ygxm( ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_sfzh,True, as_return) < 0 THEN
	as_return = '【2203A】获取医生基本信息失败：' + as_return
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_ysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
	as_return = '【2203A】获取医生国家码失败：' + ls_ysbm_gjm
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
			as_return = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			ls_ysbm_gjm = ls_ysbm
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF This.of_get_expcontent( Ref ls_expcontent, Ref as_return) < 0 THEN
	as_return = '【2203A】'+ as_return
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_bzbm = ''
ls_bzmc = ''
IF as_bzbm > '' THEN ls_bzbm = as_bzbm
IF ls_bzbm > '' THEN
	SELECT OPSP_DISE_NAME Into :ls_bzmc From JKXT.OPSP_DISE_LIST_B Where  OPSP_DISE_CODE  = :ls_bzbm Using itran_sqlca;
END IF

String ls_zdbm[],ls_zdmc[],ls_zdmc1
Long ll_row ,ll_count,ll_find
Integer li_ret,li_syzd = 0,li_count_jz = 0
String ls_zzdbm,ls_zzdmc,ls_zzdms,ls_error
IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
	li_ret = This.of_get_zy_zdxx( adc_jzlsh, 2, Ref  ls_zzdbm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_zzdms, Ref ls_zdbm, Ref ls_zdmc, Ref ls_zdmc1 )
ELSE
	li_ret = This.of_get_mz_zdxx( as_yllb, adc_jzlsh, ls_ysbm, ls_zdbm, ls_zdmc,ls_zdmc1,li_syzd)
END IF
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	//	IF li_ret = -2 THEN //wangyi 20200612 医保结算--自费诊断控制
	//		as_return = '根据医保相关规定，' + ls_zdmc1 + ' 诊断下开的所有项目不能医保结算！！'
	//	ELSE
	//		as_return = '获取诊断失败：' + String(adc_jzlsh)
	//	END IF
	as_return = '【2203A】' + ls_zdmc1
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF li_syzd = 0 And as_yllb = '51' THEN //没有生育诊断，那么按照普通门诊收费 20220829
	as_yllb = '11'
END IF
IF li_ret = 2 And ii_xgmzsfqy = 1 THEN
	as_yllb = '1102'
END IF

//普通慢病,zan
IF ii_zymz = 0 and  ii_ptmxbqy = 1 And as_yllb = '11' and left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,2) ='33' AND pos(is_cbd_bzptmb,',' +istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm+',') = 0 THEN
	IF IsValid(ids_zhyl_mxbdz) = False THEN
		ids_zhyl_mxbdz = Create U_datastore
		ids_zhyl_mxbdz.DataObject = 'd_zhyl_mxbdz'
		ids_zhyl_mxbdz.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
		ids_zhyl_mxbdz.Retrieve( )
	END IF	
	IF UpperBound(ls_zdbm) > 0 THEN	
		ll_find = ids_zhyl_mxbdz.Find( "dmsb = '" +ls_zdbm[1]+"'", 1, 999999)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			as_yllb = '140104'
			ls_bzbm = ids_zhyl_mxbdz.Object.dmjc[ll_find]
			ls_bzmc = ids_zhyl_mxbdz.Object.bzxx[ll_find]
			as_bzbm = ls_bzbm
		END IF
	END IF	
END IF
//判断你是否为急诊门诊
IF as_yllb = '11'  And adc_jzlsh > 0 And ii_jzsfqy = 1 AND ii_zymz = 0 and pos(is_cbd_jzbqy,left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4)) = 0 THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :li_count_jz From mzxt.mz_jzxx m,mzxt.mz_ghhzbm g Where m.jzlsh = :adc_jzlsh And m.jzlb = g.hzbm And g.pjzbz = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF li_count_jz > 0 THEN
		as_yllb = '13'
	END IF
END IF
//IF as_bzmc > '' THEN ls_bzmc = as_bzmc
This.uf_send_init('2203A')
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'mdtrtinfo') //就诊信息（节点标识：mdtrtinfo）
This.uf_send_add_in( 'mdtrt_id', as_jzid, 1) //1	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add_in( 'psn_no', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, 1) //2	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add_in( 'med_type', as_yllb, 1) //3	med_type	医疗类别	字符型	6	Y	Y	
This.uf_send_add_in( 'begntime', ldt_jzsj, 1) //4	begntime	开始时间	日期时间型			Y	就诊时间
This.uf_send_add_in( 'main_cond_dscr', ls_bqms, 1) //5	main_cond_dscr	主要病情描述	字符型	1000			
This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_codg', ls_bzbm, 1) //6	dise_codg	病种编码	字符型	30		Y	按照标准疾病编码填写
This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_name', ls_bzmc, 1) //7	dise_name	病种名称	字符型	500			
This.uf_send_add_in( 'birctrl_type', '', 1) //8	birctrl_type	计划生育手术类别	字符型	6	Y		生育门誅AT*

This.uf_send_add_in( 'birctrl_matn_date', '', 1) //9	birctrl_matn_date	计划生育手术或生育日期	日期型				生育门诊按需录入，yyyy-MM-dd
//Select bzxx From MZ_YCBZJL Where  bzlb = '预产期';
IF as_yllb = '51' THEN
	IF ls_zdmc1 > ' ' THEN
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'matn_type', ls_zdmc1, 1)
	ELSE
		ls_zdmc1 = '7'
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'matn_type', '7', 1) //10	matn_type	生育类别	字符型	6	Y
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_zdmc1 = ''
	This.uf_send_add_in( 'matn_type', '', 1) //10	matn_type	生育类别	字符型	6	Y	
END IF
This.uf_send_add_in( 'geso_val', '', 1) //11	geso_val	孕周数	数值型	2	MZXT."MZ_YCFCJL"  		
This.uf_send_add_in( 'exp_content', ls_expcontent, 1) //12	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	

ll_count = UpperBound(ls_zdbm)
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	IF ls_bzbm = '' THEN
		ls_bzbm = ls_zdbm[1]
		as_bzbm = ls_bzbm
		ls_bzmc = ls_zdmc[1]
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_codg', ls_bzbm, 1) //6	dise_codg	病种编码	字符型	30		Y	按照标准疾病编码填写
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_name', ls_bzmc, 1) //7	dise_name	病种名称	字符型	500	
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'diseinfo') //诊断信息（节点标识：diseinfo）
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_type', '1', ll_row) //1	diag_type	诊断类别	字符型	3	Y	Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_srt_no', ll_row, ll_row) //2	diag_srt_no	诊断排序号	数值型	2		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_code', ls_zdbm[ll_row], ll_row) //3	diag_code	诊断代码	字符型	20		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_name', ls_zdmc[ll_row], ll_row) //4	diag_name	诊断名称	字符型	100		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_dept', ls_ybksbm, ll_row) //5	diag_dept	诊断科室	字符型	50		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_dor_no', ls_ysbm_gjm, ll_row) //6	dise_dor_no	诊断医生编码	字符型	30		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'dise_dor_name', ls_ysxm, ll_row) //7	dise_dor_name	诊断医生姓名	字符型	50		Y	
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'diag_time', ldt_jzsj, ll_row) //8	diag_time	诊断时间	日期时间型			Y	yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
		This.uf_send_add_in( 'vali_flag', 1, ll_row) //9	vali_flag	有效标志	字符型	3	Y	Y	
	NEXT
ELSE
	as_return = '【2203A】门诊就诊信息上传：诊断信息为空。'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ai_jslx <> 0 THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX Where BRBM = :as_brbm And jzid = :as_jzid And czsj > sysdate - 3 And ztbz = 0	Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_count = 0 THEN
		INSERT INTO JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX
			(BRBM,   JZSJ,    JZID,     YLLB,    BQMS,     BZBM,   BZMC,JHSYSSLB,JHSYSSRQ,SYLB,YZS,ZDKZ,GHLSH,JZLSH,ZTBZ,CZSJ, 			GRBH , CBXZQH ,  XZLX   , RYLB  )
			VALUES (:as_brbm,:ldt_jzsj,:as_jzid,:as_yllb,:ls_bqms,:ls_bzbm,:ls_bzmc,'','',:ls_zdmc1,0,'',0,:adc_jzlsh,0,sysdate, 			:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh,:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype,:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.psn_type  )
			Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLNRows <> 1 THEN
			as_return = '【2203A】门诊就诊信息上传：插入就诊失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using  itran_sqlca;
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			COMMIT Using  itran_sqlca;
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF This.uf_send( as_return, '') THEN
	IF ai_jslx <> 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX Set ztbz = 1 Where BRBM = :as_brbm And jzid = :as_jzid And czsj > sysdate - 3 And ztbz = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_return = '【2203A】门诊就诊信息上传：更新失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using  itran_sqlca;
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			COMMIT Using  itran_sqlca;
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx (string as_ywlx, decimal adc_jzlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm[], ref string as_zdmc[], ref string as_zdms, ref integer ai_syzd);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_mz_zdxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取门诊诊断
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlx  	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_jzlsh	
// 	value    	string 	as_ysbm  	
// 	reference	string 	as_zddm[]	
// 	reference	string 	as_zdmc  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================
Boolean lb_zfzd,lb_xgmz = False //判断是否全部为自费诊断
as_zdms = ''
ai_syzd = 0
IF as_ywlx = 'TJ' THEN
	as_zdms = '暂不支持体检医保结算'
	RETURN -2
ELSE
	IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
		ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
		ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_mz_zdxx_jzlsh'
	END IF
	ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
	IF adc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
		IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(adc_jzlsh) < 0 THEN
			as_zdms = '获取诊断信息失败JZ：' + String(adc_jzlsh)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	ELSE
		ids_mz_zdxx.Reset( )
	END IF
	Long ll_row,ll_count,ll_zdlsh,ll_find
	Integer li_syyz = 0,li_pos1,li_pos2
	Dec{1} ldc_pxxh = -1
	String ls_zddm,ls_zdmc,ls_zfzdmc = '' ,ls_zdhz
	Boolean lb_first = False
	ll_count = ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
	lb_zfzd = True
	IF ll_count >= 1 And adc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_row]
			ls_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
			IF ii_xgmzsfqy = 1 And Left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm ,2) = Left(is_yljgxzqh,2) THEN
				IF Pos(is_xgzd,',' +String(ll_zdlsh)+',') > 0 THEN
					lb_xgmz = True
				END IF
			END IF
			IF ids_zfzd.Find("srdm='" + String(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999) > 0 And lb_zfzd THEN
				IF ls_zfzdmc > ' ' THEN
					ls_zfzdmc = ls_zfzdmc + ', '+ ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
				ELSE
					ls_zfzdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
				END IF
				//modify by sxl 20211210:ii_zfzdqy 0不启用,1启用,2只启用收费3只启用体检'
				//				lb_zfzd = True
				//				IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 THEN
				//					as_zdms = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
				//					RETURN -2
				//				END IF
			ELSE //只要有非自费诊断那么就可以走医保
				IF lb_zfzd And ll_row <> 1 THEN
					lb_first = True
				END IF
				lb_zfzd = False
			END IF
			IF ii_jbbd = 2 THEN
				ls_zddm = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.ICD10[ll_row]
			ELSEIF ii_jbbd = 1 THEN
				ls_zddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
			ELSE
				ls_zddm = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM_SYD',String(ll_zdlsh))
			END IF
			//			as_zddm[ll_row] = of_get_dzdmsb('GY_JBBM',String(ll_zdlsh))
			IF lb_first THEN //如果第一个主诊断是譊AT*
苑颜锒希�那么换成非自费诊�

				as_zddm[ll_row] = as_zddm[1]
				as_zdmc[ll_row] = as_zdmc[1]
				as_zddm[1] = ls_zddm
				as_zdmc[1] = ls_zdmc
			ELSE
				as_zddm[ll_row] = ls_zddm
				as_zdmc[ll_row] = ls_zdmc
			END IF
			IF ii_symzqy >= 1 And as_ywlx = '51' THEN //增加诊断判断是否走生育门诊 //And ai_syzd = 0 
				ll_find = ids_syzd.Find("srdm='" + String(ll_zdlsh) + "'",1,999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					//控制是否有生育类别					
					IF ldc_pxxh = -1 Or ldc_pxxh > ids_syzd.Object.pxxh[ll_find] THEN
						IF Trim(ids_syzd.Object.bzbm[ll_find]) = '' Or IsNull(ids_syzd.Object.bzbm[ll_find]) THEN
							as_zdms = ls_zdmc + "（" + String(ll_zdlsh) + '），该生育诊断未维护对应的生育类别。若已维护请退出重进再试。'
							RETURN -1
						ELSE
							as_zdms = ids_syzd.Object.bzbm[ll_find]
						END IF
						IF Pos(is_sylb_yzkz,','+as_zdms+',') > 0 THEN
							IF li_syyz = 0 THEN
								ls_zdhz = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdhz[ll_row]
								li_pos1 = Pos(ls_zdhz,'孕')
								li_pos2 = Pos(ls_zdhz,'周')
								IF li_pos1 > 0 And li_pos2 > 0 And li_pos2 > li_pos1 THEN
									li_syyz = Abs(Integer(Mid(ls_zdhz,li_pos1 + 2,li_pos2 - li_pos1 - 2)))
								ELSE
									as_zdms = ls_zdmc + "（" + String(ll_zdlsh) + '），该生育诊断需要知悉病人孕周，请联系医生录入。'
									RETURN -1
								END IF
							END IF
							CHOOSE CASE li_syyz
								CASE Is < 16
									as_zdms = '51'
								CASE  16 To 27
									as_zdms = '331'
								CASE Is >= 28
									as_zdms = '332'
								CASE ELSE
									as_zdms = '51'
							END CHOOSE
						END IF
						ldc_pxxh =  ids_syzd.Object.pxxh[ll_find]
						ai_syzd = 1
						IF ll_row <> 1 THEN //如果为生育诊断，那么将生育诊断和第一个互换，将生育诊断作为主诊断
							as_zddm[ll_row] = as_zddm[1]
							as_zdmc[ll_row] = as_zdmc[1]
							as_zddm[1] = ls_zddm
							as_zdmc[1] = ls_zdmc
						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		lb_zfzd = False
		as_zddm[1] = is_mricd10
		as_zdmc[1] = is_mrzdmc
		as_zdms = is_mrzdmc
	END IF
END IF
//开多个诊断带自费也要按医保收费(只要有一个不是自费诊断，那么就可以走医保)
IF ii_zfzdqy <> 1 And ii_zfzdqy <> 2 And lb_zfzd THEN
	as_zdms = '根据医保相关规定，' + ls_zfzdmc + ' 诊断下开的所有项目不能医保结算！'
	//	as_zdms = '病人诊断均为自费诊断:' + ls_zfzdmc
	RETURN -2
END IF
IF lb_xgmz THEN
	RETURN 2
END IF
//IF Len(as_zdmc) > 300 THEN as_zdmc = of_midstring1(as_zdmc,300)
RETURN 1




end function

END IF

public function boolean uf_receive_yd (string as_brbm, string as_fplsh, string as_tsid, string as_xxtlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_receive_yd()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	as_brbm  病人编码	
// 	value    	string	as_fplsh 	发票号
// 	value    	string	as_tsid  	推动id
// 	value    	string	as_xxtlx 	消息体类型
// 	value    	string	as_xxt   	消息体
// 	reference	string	as_return	返回
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.09.28
//====================================================================

IF Not ib_ydzf THEN
	as_return = '非移动支付，不可调用此函数'
	RETURN False
END IF
IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_return = is_error
	RETURN False
END IF
String ls_yllb,ls_bzdm,ls_grbh,ls_cbdxzqh,ls_sfzh,ls_ywlx,ls_ywlsh
Integer li_ztbz
ls_ywlsh = 'YDZF' + as_tsid
SELECT GRBH,CBDXZQH,BZDM,BRKH,TSLX,ztbz INTO :ls_grbh,:ls_cbdxzqh,:ls_bzdm,:ls_sfzh,:ls_ywlx,:li_ztbz
	From jkxt.zhyb_ydzfts Where brbm = :as_brbm And tsid = :as_tsid And ztbz >= 3 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_return = as_tsid + '获取推送信息失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN False
END IF
IF li_ztbz >= 7 THEN
	as_return = as_tsid + '已完成结算'
	RETURN False
END IF

public subroutine of_get_ybjsxx_yd (integer ai_jslx, ref str_zhyl_jsxx astr_yb_jsxx, ref str_ydzf_jsxx astr_ydzf_jsxx);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_ybjsxx() ORG003
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取医保返回的结算信息--移动支付
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value    	integer      	ai_jslx   门诊：0-预结算，1-，2-确认结算
//                                         住院：10-预结算，11-确认结算，12-结算撤销(退费)
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_yb_jsx
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.23
//====================================================================
//
//SailJson lJson_jsgcxx
//String ls_jsgcxx

// 1.优先获取所有接口共有的字段（目前共25个字段）
astr_yb_jsxx.jzid = This.uf_getstring( 'mdtrt_id') //1	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.jssj = This.uf_getdatetime( 'setl_time') //13	setl_time	结算时间	日期时间型			Y	
IF IsNull(astr_yb_jsxx.jssj) Or Date(astr_yb_jsxx.jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN astr_yb_jsxx.jssj = gf_server_date()

astr_yb_jsxx.ylfze = This.uf_getdecimal( 'medfee_sumamt') //16	medfee_sumamt	医疗费总额	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.qzfje = This.uf_getdecimal( 'fulamt_ownpay_amt') //17	fulamt_ownpay_amt	全自费金额	数值型	16,2		Y
astr_yb_jsxx.cxjzffy = This.uf_getdecimal( 'overlmt_selfpay') //18	overlmt_selfpay	超限价自费费用	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.xxzfje = This.uf_getdecimal( 'preselfpay_amt') //19	preselfpay_amt	先行自付金额	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.fhzcfwje = This.uf_getdecimal( 'inscp_scp_amt') //20	inscp_scp_amt	符合政策范围金额	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.sjzfqfx = This.uf_getdecimal( 'act_pay_dedc') //21	act_pay_dedc	实际支付起付线	数值型	16,2			
astr_yb_jsxx.jbylbxtcjj = This.uf_getdecimal( 'hifp_pay') //22	hifp_pay	基本医疗保险统筹基金支出	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.jbylbxtcjjbl = This.uf_getdecimal( 'pool_prop_selfpay') //23	pool_prop_selfpay	基本医疗保险统筹基金支付比例	数值型	5,4		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.gwyylbzzj = This.uf_getdecimal( 'cvlserv_pay') //24	cvlserv_pay	公务员医疗补助资金支出	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.qybcylbxjj = This.uf_getdecimal( 'hifes_pay') //25	hifes_pay	企业补充医疗保险基金支出	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.jmdbbxzj = This.uf_getdecimal( 'hifmi_pay') //26	hifmi_pay	居民大病保险资金支出	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.zgdeylfybz = This.uf_getdecimal( 'hifob_pay') //27	hifob_pay	职工大额医疗费用补助基金支出	数值型	16,2		Y	
astr_yb_jsxx.yljzjj = This.uf_getdecimal( 'maf_pay') //28	maf_pay	医疗救助基金支出	数值型	16,2		Y

public function integer of_get_ygxm (string as_ygdm, ref string as_ygxm, ref string as_sfzh, boolean ab_dz, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_ygxm()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取员工姓名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_ygdm 	
// 	reference	string 	as_ygxm 	
// 	reference	string 	as_sfzh 	
// 	value    	boolean	ab_dz   //TRUE取对照的员工信息，false取传入工号信息	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.29
//====================================================================

uf_connect_sqlca_temp()
IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm,sfzh,'' as gjybdm,ygjb,'' as DZGH from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		as_ygxm = "创建'ygdm'对象失败("+ids_ygdm.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
END IF

Long ll_find, ll_ygjb,ll_find_dz,ll_insert,ll_ygjb_dz
String ls_ygxm, ls_sfzh,ls_dzgh,ls_ygxm_dz, ls_sfzh_dz
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+as_ygdm+"'", 1, 999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	ls_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	ls_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find]
	ls_dzgh = ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
ELSE
	SELECT ygxm, sfzh, ygjb Into :ls_ygxm, :ls_sfzh, :ll_ygjb From XTGL.GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = as_ygdm + "获取员工信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN  -1
	END IF
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find] = ls_sfzh
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_find] = ll_ygjb
	SELECT csz Into :ls_dzgh From XTGL.gy_xtcs_n Where XTSB = 0 and  CSDM = 'ZHYB_KDYSDZ' And CSMC = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN
		ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find] = ls_dzgh
	ELSE
		//		ids_ygdm.Object.DZGH[ll_find] = 'NULL'
	END IF
END IF

//如果有对照工号，判断是否有值，有就取没有插入；获取对照人的姓名和蒁AT*

IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN	
	ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+ls_dzgh+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find_dz > 0 And ab_dz THEN
		ls_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find_dz]
		ls_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find_dz]
	ELSE
		SELECT ygxm, sfzh, ygjb Into :ls_ygxm_dz, :ls_sfzh_dz, :ll_ygjb_dz From XTGL.GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :ls_dzgh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = as_ygdm + "获取员工信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN  -1
		END IF
		ll_insert = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_insert] = ls_dzgh
		ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_insert] = ls_ygxm_dz
		ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh_dz
		ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_insert] = ll_ygjb_dz
		IF ab_dz THEN
			ls_ygxm = ls_ygxm_dz
			ls_sfzh = ls_sfzh_dz
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

as_ygxm = ls_ygxm
as_sfzh = ls_sfzh
//as_dzgh = ls_dzgh

RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_jsmx_zf (string as_jylx, datetime adt_jysj, string as_jylsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_jsmx_zf()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 冲正结算类交易后，对本地结算明细表进行作废
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_jylx 	 【2102A】药店结算、【2103】药店结算撤销、【2207A】门诊结算、【2208】门诊结算撤销、【2304A】住院结算、【2305】住院结算撤销、【2401】入院办理
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jysj	
// 	value    	string  	as_jylsh	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.21    28271  冲正结算类交易后，对本地结算明细表进行作废
//====================================================================

IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

String ls_jzid
DateTime ldt_juf_set_instance
of_constructor
ids_dmzd_jk
u_datastore
itran_sqlca
setworktrans
 SELECT JLXH,DMLB,DMSB,DMMC,DMJC FROM XTGL.GY_DMZD_JK WHERE JKLX = 'ZHYL'
createfromsql
创建'发药方式'对象失败( settransobject ids_dmzd_dz ssj ldt_jssj = gf_relativedatetime('HOUR',adt_jysj,24)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

IF as_jylx = '2207A' Or as_jylx = '2207' Or as_jylx = '2304A' Or as_jylx = '2304' THEN // 冲正 结算类 交易
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】冲正交易成功，但作废本地结算明细失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX_KZ Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JYLSH = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】冲正交易成功，但作废本地结算明细基金分项失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	
	
	// 住院结算回滚时，需要把已结算的明细回滚到未结算的状态
	IF as_jylx = '2304A' Or as_jylx = '2304' THEN
		dec{0} ldc_zyh
		integer li_jscs
		SELECT JZID,ZYH,JSCS Into :ls_jzid,:ldc_zyh,:li_jscs From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ-1 Where zyh =:ldc_zyh and  JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In(1,10) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ii_zyqy_qy > 0 THEN
			UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = ZTBZ-1 Where zyh =:ldc_zyh and  JZID = :ls_jzid And ZTBZ In(1,10) Using itran_sqlca;		
		END IF
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 Or itran_sqlca.SQLNRows <= 0 THEN
			as_error = "【医保端】冲正交易成功，但更新费用明细上传状态失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  " 更新列：" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		ELSE
			UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX SET ZTBZ = 0,JSCS = 0 WHERE ZYH =:ldc_zyh AND JSCS = :li_jscs AND MXZDH = :ls_jzid AND ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
	END IF
	
	RETURN 1
	
ELSEIF as_jylx = '2208' Or as_jylx = '2305' THEN // 冲正 撤销类 交易（不知道怎么处理HIS，暂时先处理成和结算类冲正一样的效果）
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JSSJ >= :ldt_jssj And JYLSH = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】冲正交易成功，但作废本地结算明细失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX_KZ Set ZTBZ = -2 Where JYLSH = :as_jylsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】冲正交易成功，但作废本地结算明细基金分项失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText +  '更新列:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLNRows)
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	
	RETURN 1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer of_zymz_fymx_sc (long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_zymz_fymx_sc()

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	SZX		日期: 2022.10.27    28271  住院费用按门诊明细上传（实际上传接口）

	GOTO Error

	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN

	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), ls_czybm, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF Date(adt_zzrq) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	SetNull(adt_zzrq)
END IF
IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN  -1
END IF
String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_gerenbh // 个人编号
String ls_yllb = '21' // 医疗类别
