String ls_SYFYBZ // 生育费用标志：0-否、1-是
String ls_expContent // 字段扩展
String ls_feedetl_sn // 费用明细流水号（返回）
Long ll_mxtop, ll_add_row, ll_row, ll_insert, ll_ret, ll_find_t, ll_find_sc, ll_cwts, ll_find, ll_Retcount, ll_clbm, ll_brks, ll_fyxh, ll_ypcd, ll_Count,ll_yhly
Integer li_tsdz, li_yplx, li_dcsc1tfysl,li_cypb,li_jslb
Dec{0} ldc_yzxh, ldc_jfjlxh
Dec{2} ldc_yhje, ldc_zfje, ldc_zlje, ldc_hjzf
Dec{4} ldc_zfbl
DateTime ldt_jsrq, ldt_bqrysj //wangyi 20191012 如果JFRQ比入院时间还要前面，就传入院时间
DateTime ldt_fyfssj_y, ldt_bqcysj // 如果JFRQ比出院时间还要迟，那就传入出院时间
String ls_zzysbm, ls_kdyssfzh, ls_cbd, ls_fyxh, ls_ypxh, ls_ypcd, ls_xmzxbh_ts, ls_zyhm, ls_gjybbm_ts, ls_JFJLXH, ls_spbz, ls_cllx, ls_cbdybqh, ls_find, ls_fymc, ls_memo, ls_clbm, ls_brbq
//Boolean lb_uploadTFMX = False // 用于标志本次上传是否为负明细上传
Boolean lb_fcbq = False
String ls_ycjl,ls_sypc,ls_yytj,ls_ybsypc
// 获取住院基本信息（就诊ID）
SELECT     BRKS,       ZZYS,   YBJZBH,      BQRYSJ,     ZYHM,     BRBQ,      BQCYSJ,      JSRQ,cypb,ZY_BRRY_KZ.jslb
	INTO :ll_brks, :ls_zzysbm, :ls_jzid, :ldt_bqrysj, :ls_zyhm, :ls_brbq, :ldt_bqcysj, :ldt_jsrq,:li_cypb,:li_jslb
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取病人基本信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF li_cypb = 0 THEN RETURN 0

IF IsNull(ll_brks) Or ll_brks = 0 THEN
	as_error = '病人无所属科室，不能上传明细！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_zzysbm) Or Trim(ls_zzysbm) = '' THEN
	as_error = '主治医师为空，不能上传明细！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_bqrysj) Or Date(ldt_bqrysj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	as_error = '入院时间为空，不能上传明细！'
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 检索需要上传的费用明细数据
Integer li_yepb = -1
IF ii_myjsflqy = 1 THEN li_yepb = 0
Long ll_rowcount
IF IsValid(ids_zyfymx) = False THEN
	ids_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	ids_zyfymx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_zyfymx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sc'
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
ids_zyfymx.SetFilter("")
ids_zyfymx.Filter()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.Retrieve(al_zyh, ai_jscs, adt_zzrq, li_yepb)
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_error = "检索费用明细失败：" + ids_zyfymx.is_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF

IF IsNull(ldt_jsrq) Or Date(ldt_jsrq) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_jsrq = ldt_bqrysj
END IF
// 如果曾经中结过，那么病区入院时间修改为结算时间
IF ldt_jsrq > ldt_bqrysj THEN
	ldt_bqrysj = ldt_jsrq
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_bqcysj) Or Date(ldt_bqcysj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_bqcysj = DateTime(Date(2099,12,31))
END IF
// 获取 个人编号、医疗类别
SELECT GRBH,CBDXZQH,JZID Into :ls_gerenbh,:ls_cbdybqh,:ls_jzid From jkxt.zhyb_ghxx Where brbm = :ls_zyhm And ywlsh Like  :ls_zyhm || '%'  And ztbz = 1  Using itran_sqlca;
//Select GRBH,YLLB,CBDYBQH into :ls_gerenbh,:ls_yllb,:ls_cbdybqh From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX Where JZID=:ls_jzid Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取病人医保登记信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = '就诊ID为空，不能上传明细！请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_gerenbh) Or Trim(ls_gerenbh) = "" THEN
	as_error = '个人编号为空，不能上传明细，请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，不能上传明细，请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN
	ls_yllb = '21'
END IF
// 获取 开单科室编码、开单科室名称
//ls_kdksbm = String(ll_brks)
ls_kdksbm = This.of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM', String(ll_brks))
ls_kdksmc = This.of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'GY_KSDM', String(ll_brks))

IF IsNull(ls_kdksbm) Or Trim(ls_kdksbm) = '' Or ls_kdksbm = '无' THEN
	as_error = '科室(' + String(ll_brks)+' ' + ls_kdksmc + ') 未做医保对照，请联系医保科完成对照。'
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 获取 字段扩展
IF li_jslb = 2 THEN ls_expContent  = '2'
IF This.of_get_expcontent( 'MZ', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 获取 病人是否妇产病区（医疗类别非生育住院52、2106时，用于判断生育费用标志）
If (Pos(is_fcbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',') > 0) And (ls_yllb <> '52' Or ls_yllb <> '2106') THEN
	// 苍南、平阳、台州由于妇科产科病人混住，所以必须根据准生证号是否维护来判断是否属于生育住院
	IF Pos(base_info.Hospital,'苍南') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'平阳') > 0 Or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'台州') > 0 THEN
		SELECT Count(1) Into :ll_Count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 And ll_Count > 0 THEN
			lb_fcbq = True
		END IF
	ELSE
		lb_fcbq = True
	END IF
END IF

//干部保健
str_gbbj_tsmx lstr_gbbj_tsmx,lstr_gbbj_null
Long ll_gbbj

IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	IF This.uf_gbbj_ini( as_error) < 0 THEN GOTO Error
END IF
// 初始化zhyb_fymxsc表
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_zy) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_zy = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_zy.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_zy.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_his'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_zy.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
U_datastore lds_tfmx
lds_tfmx = Create U_datastore
lds_tfmx.DataObject = ids_zyfymx.DataObject
lds_tfmx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)

// 2021.12.31  CJN  27471  优先将医保不上传费用插入zhyb_fymxsc表中
IF This.of_insert_bscfymx( al_zyh, ls_jzid, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
ids_ybfymx_zy.Reset()
ids_zyfymx.RowsDiscard(1, ids_zyfymx.DeletedCount(), DELETE!) // 无视本次删除的数据，避免因为update()而导致数据库里数据被删除
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_error = ids_zyfymx.is_error
	GOTO Error
ELSEIF  ll_rowcount = 0 THEN
	RETURN 1
END IF

// 由于智慧医保在未成功上传收费明细的前提下，不能上传退费明细，因此需要先将所有收费明细进行上传
ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl_sc<0) ")
ids_zyfymx.Filter()
ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ids_zyfymx.RowsCopy(1, ids_zyfymx.RowCount(),primary!, lds_tfmx, 1, primary!)
END IF
ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl_sc>0) ")
ids_zyfymx.Filter()
ids_zyfymx.SetSort("fysl_sc")
ids_zyfymx.Sort( )
lds_tfmx.SetSort("fysl_sc")
lds_tfmx.Sort( )
FOR ll_row = 1 To lds_tfmx.RowCount( )
	IF lds_tfmx.Object.fysl[ll_row] > 0 THEN CONTINUE
	IF lds_tfmx.Object.yplx[ll_row] = 0 THEN
		ls_yljgmlbm = 'F'+String(lds_tfmx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])+'#0'
	ELSE
		ls_yljgmlbm = 'Y'+String(lds_tfmx.Object.fyxh[ll_row])+'#'+String(lds_tfmx.Object.ypcd[ll_row])
	END IF
	ll_find = 0
	IF lds_tfmx.Object.yzxh[ll_row] > 0  And Not IsNull(lds_tfmx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]) THEN
		IF lds_tfmx.Object.spbz[ll_row] = 9 Or lds_tfmx.Object.spbz[ll_row] = 1 THEN //先根据yzxh查询，没有再根据fyxh等查询
			ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find("yzxh="+String(lds_tfmx.Object.yzxh[ll_row]) + " and (fysl >= -("+String(lds_tfmx.Object.fysl[ll_row])+") and fysl_sc>= -("+String(lds_tfmx.Object.fysl[ll_row])+")) and (spbz = 9 or spbz = 1) and yplx="+String(lds_tfmx.Object.yplx[ll_row]) ,1,9999999999)
		ELSE

		// 获取 费用名称、药品类型、费用序号、药品产地等基本信息
		ls_fymc = ids_zyfymx.Object.fymc[ll_row]
		li_yplx = ids_zyfymx.Object.yplx[ll_row]
		ll_fyxh = ids_zyfymx.Object.fyxh[ll_row]

		IF IsNull(ls_fymc) THEN ls_fymc = ''
		// 判断是否为单次上传1条费用
		IF This.of_judge_dcsc1tfy2(ll_fyxh) > 0 THEN
			li_dcsc1tfysl++
			IF li_dcsc1tfysl > 1 THEN EXIT;
			// 超过1条时，跳出本次循环，直接上传本次费用明细
		END IF
		// 获取 费用明细流水号
		ls_fymxlsh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row])
		// 获取 医嘱号
		ls_yzh = String(ids_zyfymx.Object.yzxh[ll_row])
		IF IsNull(ls_yzh) Or ls_yzh = '0' THEN ls_yzh = ""
		ldc_yzxh = 0
		IF ls_yzh <> ''  THEN ldc_yzxh = Dec(ls_yzh)
		// 获取 费用发生时间
		// wangyi 20191012 如果JFRQ比入院时间还要前面，就传入院时间
		ldt_fyfssj = ids_zyfymx.Object.jfrq[ll_row]
		IF ldt_fyfssj < ldt_bqrysj THEN
			ldt_fyfssj = ldt_bqrysj
		ELSEIF ldt_fyfssj > ldt_bqcysj THEN
			ldt_fyfssj = ldt_bqcysj // 如果JFRQ比出院时间还迟，就传出院时间
		END IF
		// 获取 明细项目费用总额、数量、单价

		ldc_yhje = ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje_sc[ll_row]
		ldc_fysl = ids_zyfymx.Object.fysl_sc[ll_row]
		ldc_fydj = ids_zyfymx.Object.fydj[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ldc_zjje) THEN ldc_zjje = 0.00
		IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0.00
		IF IsNull(ldc_fysl) THEN ldc_fysl = 0.0000
		IF IsNull(ldc_fydj) THEN ldc_fydj = 0.0000
		ldc_fydj_yh = ldc_fydj
		IF ldc_yhje <> 0.00 THEN
			ll_yhly = 0
			ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - ldc_yhje
			ldc_fydj = ldc_zjje / ldc_fysl
			SELECT yhly Into :ll_yhly From BQXT.zy_zyyh Where fy_jlxh = :ls_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
			IF ll_yhly <> 69 THEN
				ldc_fydj_yh = ldc_fydj
			END IF
		END IF

		// ids_zyfymx.Object.SPBZ[ll_row]：1、9-自费；2、8-公费

		IF ls_YYSPBZ = '1' Or ls_YYSPBZ = '9' THEN

		ELSE

		END IF

				ls_yljgmlbm = 'F'+String(ll_fyxh)+'#0'

				IF IsNull(ls_yytj) Or ls_yytj = '' THEN ls_yytj = '无'
				uf_send_add_in('medc_way_dscr',ls_yytj,ll_add_row) //17	medc_way_dscr	用药途径描述	字符型	200	
			ELSE
				uf_send_add_in('rx_circ_flag','0',ll_add_row) //7	rx_circ_flag	外购处方标志	字符型	3	Y	Y			   
				uf_send_add_in('sin_dos_dscr','1',ll_add_row) //14	sin_dos_dscr	单次剂量描述	字符型	200			
				uf_send_add_in('used_frqu_dscr','62',ll_add_row) //15	used_frqu_dscr	使用频次描述	字符型	200			
				uf_send_add_in('prd_days',1,ll_add_row) //16	prd_days	周期天数	数值型	4,2			
				uf_send_add_in('medc_way_dscr','无',ll_add_row) //17	medc_way_dscr	用药途径描述	字符型	200
			END IF
		END IF
		IF	IsNull(ls_ylmlbm) Or Trim(ls_ylmlbm) = '' THEN
			IF li_yplx = 0 THEN // 费用
				IF ls_cllx = 'GZ' THEN
					as_error = "高值耗材未维护国家码(费用序号：" + String(ll_fyxh)+"，材料编码："+String(ll_clbm)+", 费用名称："+ls_fymc+")，请联系医保科处理!！"
				ELSE
					as_error = "费用未维护国家码(费用序号：" + String(ll_fyxh)+", 费用名称："+ls_fymc+")，请联系医保科处理!！"
				END IF
			ELSE // 药品
				as_error = "药品未维护国家码(药品序号：" + String(ll_fyxh)+", 药品产地："+String(ll_ypcd)+", 药品名称："+ls_fymc+")，请联系医保科处理!！"
			END IF
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		
		// 获取 开单医生编码、开单医师姓名
		// 使用zy_fymx的ysgh ，为空则取主治医生
		ls_kdysbm = ids_zyfymx.Object.ysgh[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ls_kdysbm) Or ls_kdysbm = '' THEN
			ls_kdysbm = ls_zzysbm
		END IF
		IF This.of_get_ygxm( ls_kdysbm, Ref ls_kdysmc, Ref ls_kdyssfzh, True,Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		// add by sxl 2022.7.19需要获取医生国家码
		IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_kdysbm, ls_ysgjbm) < 0 THEN
			as_error = ls_ysgjbm
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			IF IsNull(ls_ysgjbm) Or Trim(ls_ysgjbm) = '' THEN
				IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
					as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
					RETURN -1
				ELSE
					as_error = '医生国家码空，取医生代码！'
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_kdysbm = ls_ysgjbm
			END IF
		END IF
		
		//干部保健
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
			IF li_yplx = 0 THEN
				ll_ypcd = 0
				IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 0, ll_fyxh, ldc_zfbl, as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			ELSE
				ll_ypcd = ids_zyfymx.Object.ypcd[ll_row]
				IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 1, ll_fyxh, ldc_zfbl, as_error) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF ldc_zfbl > 0 THEN
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] = ldc_zfbl
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row] = Round((ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_row] - ids_zyfymx.Object.yhje[ll_row]) * ldc_zfbl,2)
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf = lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf + ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				ids_zyfymx.Object.spbz[ll_row] = 9
				ll_gbbj ++
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.tsywlsh = ''
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlx[ll_gbbj] = 'ZY'
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlsh[ll_gbbj] = ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.mxlsh[ll_gbbj] = ll_ypcd
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.xmxh[ll_gbbj] = ll_fyxh
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.zfje[ll_gbbj] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				lstr_gbbj_tsmx.zfbl[ll_gbbj] = ldc_zfbl
			END IF
		END IF
		//-------------
		
		// 获取 生育费用标志（暂时设定为职工生育住院-52、居民生育住院-2106时，所有费用都算作生育费用）
		IF ls_yllb = '52' Or ls_yllb = '2106' THEN
			ls_SYFYBZ = '1'
		ELSEIF lb_fcbq = True THEN
			ls_SYFYBZ = '1'
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_SYFYBZ) Or ls_SYFYBZ <> '1' THEN ls_SYFYBZ = '0'
		uf_send_add_in('feedetl_sn',ls_fymxlsh,ll_add_row) //1	feedetl_sn	费用明细流水号	字符型	30		Y	单次就诊内唯一
		uf_send_add_in('mdtrt_id',ls_jzid,ll_add_row) //2	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('psn_no', ls_gerenbh, ll_add_row) //3	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('chrg_bchno',ls_zyhm,ll_add_row) //4	chrg_bchno	收费批次号	字符型	30		Y	同一收费批次号病种编号必须一致
		uf_send_add_in('dise_codg','',ll_add_row) //5	dise_codg	病种编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写,按病种结算病种目录代码(bydise_setl_list_code)、门诊慢特病病种目录代码(opsp_dise_cod)
		uf_send_add_in('rxno',String(ls_yzh),ll_add_row) //6	rxno	处方篋AT*
	字符型	30			外购处方时，传入外购处方的处方号；非外购处方，传入医药机构处方号
		uf_send_add_in('fee_ocur_time', ldt_fyfssj, ll_add_row) //8	fee_ocur_time	费用发生时间	日期时间型			Y	yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
		uf_send_add_in('med_list_codg', ls_ylmlbm, ll_add_row) //9	med_list_codg	医疗目录编码	字符型	50		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('medins_list_codg', ls_yljgmlbm, ll_add_row) //10	medins_list_codg	医药机构目录编码	字符型	150		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('det_item_fee_sumamt', ldc_zjje, ll_add_row) //11	det_item_fee_sumamt	明细项目费用总额	数值型	16,2		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('cnt', ldc_fysl, ll_add_row) //12	cnt	数量	数值型	16,4		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('pric', ldc_fydj, ll_add_row) //13	pric	单价	数值型	16,6		Y			
		uf_send_add_in('bilg_dept_codg', ls_kdksbm, ll_add_row) //18	bilg_dept_codg	开单科室编码	字符型	30		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('bilg_dept_name', ls_kdksmc, ll_add_row) //19	bilg_dept_name	开单科室名称	字符型	100		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('bilg_dr_codg', ls_kdysbm, ll_add_row) //20	bilg_dr_codg	开单医生编码	字符型	30		Y	按照标准编码填写
		uf_send_add_in('bilg_dr_name', ls_kdysmc, ll_add_row) //21	bilg_dr_name	开单医师姓名	字符型	50		Y	
		uf_send_add_in('acord_dept_codg', '', ll_add_row) //22	acord_dept_codg	受单科室编码	字符型	30			
		uf_send_add_in('acord_dept_name', '', ll_add_row) //23	acord_dept_name	受单科室名称	字符型	100			
		uf_send_add_in('orders_dr_code', '', ll_add_row) //24	orders_dr_code	受单医生编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写
		uf_send_add_in('orders_dr_name', '', ll_add_row) //25	orders_dr_name	受单医生姓名	字符型	50				
		uf_send_add_in('hosp_appr_flag', ls_YYSPBZ, ll_add_row) //26	hosp_appr_flag	医院审批标志	字符型	3	Y	Y	
		uf_send_add_in('tcmdrug_used_way', '', ll_add_row) //27	tcmdrug_used_way	中药使用方式	字符型	1	复方	2	单方
		uf_send_add_in('etip_flag', '', ll_add_row) //28	etip_flag	外检标志	字符型	3	Y		
		uf_send_add_in('etip_hosp_code', '', ll_add_row) //29	etip_hosp_code	外检医院编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写
		uf_send_add_in('dscg_tkdrug_flag', '', ll_add_row) //30	dscg_tkdrug_flag	出院带药标志	字符型	3	Y		
		uf_send_add_in('matn_fee_flag', ls_SYFYBZ, ll_add_row) //31	matn_fee_flag	生育费用标志	字符型	6	Y		
		uf_send_add_in('comb_no', '', ll_add_row) //32	comb_no	组套编号	字符型	3			
		uf_send_add_in('exp_content', ls_expContent, ll_add_row) //33	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000			
		uf_send_add_in('memo', ls_memo, ll_add_row) //			34	memo	备注	字符型	500
		uf_send_add_in('init_feedetl_sn', ls_yfylsh, ll_add_row) // 原费用流水号				
		// 获取 自负比例，并计算自理金额
		ldc_zfbl = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
		IF IsNull(ldc_zfbl) THEN ldc_zfbl = 1.0000
		IF ldc_zfbl <> 1 THEN
			ldc_zfje = 0.00
			ldc_zlje = ldc_zjje * ldc_zfbl
		ELSE
			ldc_zfje = ldc_zjje
			ldc_zlje = 0.00
		END IF
		ldc_hjzf = ldc_zfje + ldc_zlje
		
		// 插入费用明细上传表
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_zy.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.JZID[ll_insert] = ls_jzid // 就诊ID
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZYH[ll_insert] = al_zyh // 住院号
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = 'ZY' // 业务类型：住院默认为'ZY'
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = ls_fymxlsh // 费用明细流水号
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = ls_yfylsh // 原费用流水号
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = ls_yzh // 医嘱号
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = ldt_fyfssj // 费用发生时间
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_ylmlbm // 医疗目录编码
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_yljgmlbm // 医药机构目录编码
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_zjje // 明细项目费用总额
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.yyspbz[ll_insert] = ls_YYSPBZ // 医院审批标志
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SYFYBZ[ll_insert] = ls_SYFYBZ // 生育费用标志
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = ls_memo // 备注（耗材需要在memo字段上传省码）
		ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0 // 状态标志
		
		ll_row++
	LOOP
	gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
	
	
	// 发送报文
	IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error, "") THEN
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		GOTO Error
	ELSE
		ll_Retcount = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'result')
		IF ll_Retcount < 0 THEN
			as_error = "【医保端】住院明细上传成功，但获取医保返回内容为空，请联系信息科处理。住院号码：" + ls_zyhm
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		FOR ll_ret = 1 To ll_Retcount Step 1
			
			ls_feedetl_sn = uf_getstring_in("feedetl_sn", ll_ret) // 费用明细流水号
			
			ll_find_sc = ids_ybfymx_zy.Find("YWLSH='" + ls_feedetl_sn + "'",1,999999)
			IF ll_find_sc > 0 THEN
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.DJSXJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("pric_uplmt_amt", ll_ret) // 定价上限金额
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("selfpay_prop", ll_ret) // 自付比例
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.QZFJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("fulamt_ownpay_amt", ll_ret) // 全自费金额
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.CXJJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("overlmt_amt", ll_ret) // 超限价金额
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XXZFUJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("preselfpay_amt", ll_ret) // 先行自付金额
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.FHZCFWJE[ll_find_sc] = uf_getdecimal_in("inscp_scp_amt", ll_ret) // 符合政策范围金额
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chrgitm_lv", ll_ret) // 收费项目等级
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YLSFXMLB[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("med_chrgitm_type", ll_ret) // 医疗收费项目类别
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.JBYWBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("bas_medn_flag", ll_ret) // 基本药物标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.YBTPYPBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("hi_nego_drug_flag", ll_ret) // 医保谈判药品标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ETYYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("chld_medc_flag", ll_ret) // 儿童用药标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.MLTXBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("list_sp_item_flag", ll_ret) // 目录特项标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XZSYBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("lmt_used_flag", ll_ret) // 限制使用标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.ZBBZ[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("drt_reim_flag", ll_ret) // 直报标志
				ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.BZXX[ll_find_sc] + ' R:' + uf_getstring_in("memo", ll_ret) // 备注
				
				// 回写 zy_fymx 的 zfje 和 zfbl
				ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find("JLXH="+ls_feedetl_sn+"", 1, 999999)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.QZFJE[ll_find_sc] + ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.CXJJE[ll_find_sc] + ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.XXZFUJE[ll_find_sc] // 全自费金额+超限价紻AT*
+先行自付金额 → 自付金额
					ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = ids_ybfymx_zy.Object.zfbl[ll_find_sc] // 自付比例   → 自付比例
					IF ids_zyfymx.Object.tjlxh[ll_find] > 0 THEN
						ll_find_t = lds_tfmx.Find( "tjlxh = " + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_find]), 1, 999999)
						DO WHILE ll_find_t > 0
							lds_tfmx.Object.zfbl[ll_find_t] = ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] // 自付比例
							IF ll_find_t >= lds_tfmx.RowCount() THEN
								ll_find_t = 0
							ELSE
								ll_find_t = lds_tfmx.Find( "tjlxh = " + String(ids_zyfymx.Object.jlxh[ll_find]), ll_find_t + 1, 999999)
							END IF
						LOOP
					END IF
				END IF
			ELSE
				as_error = "【医保端】明细上传成功，但获取医保返回费用明细流水号在上传表中找不到，请联系信息科处理。住院号码：" + ls_zyhm + " 费用明细流水号：" + ls_feedetl_sn
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF ids_ybfymx_zy.Update() = 1 And ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1  THEN //And lds_tfmx.Update() = 1
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
			IF ll_gbbj > 0 THEN
				This.of_insert_tsmx(lstr_gbbj_tsmx)
				IF ids_gbbjmx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
				ELSE
					as_error = '上传明细保存成功，干部托收保存失败ids_gbbjmx:' + ids_gbbjmx.is_error
					ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = "【医保端】明细上传成功，但更新本地费用表失败：~r~n明细上传表ids_ybfymx_zy:" + ids_ybfymx_zy.is_error + "~r~n费用明细表ids_zyfymx:" +ids_zyfymx.is_error
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
			GOTO Error
		END IF
	END IF
LOOP

//部分退负数明细回写对应正明细的比例
Boolean lb_bft = False
IF lds_tfmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ids_zyfymx.SetFilter( 'fysl_sc < 0 ')
	ids_zyfymx.Filter( )
	FOR ll_row = 1 To lds_tfmx.RowCount()
		ldc_jfjlxh = lds_tfmx.Object.jlxh[ll_row]
		ll_find = ids_zyfymx.Find('jlxh = ' + String(ldc_jfjlxh),1,9999)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			IF ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] <> lds_tfmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row] THEN
				lb_bft = True
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find] = lds_tfmx.Object.zfbl[ll_row]
				ids_zyfymx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = Round(ids_zyfymx.Object.zjje[ll_find] * ids_zyfymx.Object.zfbl[ll_find],2)
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
	IF lb_bft THEN
		IF ids_zyfymx.Update() = 1  THEN //And lds_tfmx.Update() = 1
			COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
			as_error = "ZYH" +String(al_zyh) + "费用明细表退比例回写错误ids_zyfymx:" +ids_zyfymx.is_error
			gf_sblog('c:\sblog' , "ZYH" +String(al_zyh) + "费用明细表退比例回写错误ids_zyfymx:" +ids_zyfymx.is_error)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

IF IsValid(lds_tfmx) THEN Destroy lds_tfmx
// 查看还有没有剩余的负明细需要上传（能否跳出循环，完全取决于该步骤）
//IF lb_uploadTFMX = True THEN
//	EXIT
//ELSE
//	ids_zyfymx.SetFilter(" (fysl<0) ")
//	ids_zyfymx.Filter()
//	ll_rowcount = ids_zyfymx.RowCount()
//	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
//		lb_uploadTFMX = True
//	ELSE
//		EXIT
//	END IF
//END IF
//
//LOOP WHILE True
RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2204-住院费用转门诊明细上传]出错：" + as_error
gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
IF IsValid(lds_tfmx) THEN Destroy lds_tfmx
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer uf_zymz_jscl (integer ai_jsbz, long al_zyh, integer ai_jscs, datetime adt_zzrq, integer ai_jslx, string as_fplsh, string as_jydd, ref str_zhyl_jsxx astr_zhyl_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zymz_jscl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院按门诊预结算、住院按门诊结算
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer        ai_jsbz  0-预结算；1-结算        	
// 	value    	long         	al_zyh        	
// 	value    	integer      	ai_jscs       	
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_zzrq 
// 	value    	integer      	ai_jslx 
// 	value    	string       	as_fplsh      	
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd       	
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx	
// 	reference	string       	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	SZX		日期: 2022.10.27    28271    住院按门诊预结算、住院按门诊结算
//====================================================================

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF ai_jsbz <> 0 And ai_jsbz <> 1 And ai_jsbz <> 2 THEN
	as_error = "结算标志有误：" + String(ai_jsbz)
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF This.of_get_zyqy( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5  THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), ls_czybm, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
//
//// 确认结算之前，做一次出院办理
//IF ai_jsbz=1 Then
//	IF this.uf_zy_cybl( al_zyh, ref as_error)<0 Then
//		// 如果出院办理返回的报错是“已经是出院状态”，说明已经出院办理过，直接进入结算，不失败
//		IF Pos(as_error, "已经是出院状态")<=0 Then
//			goto Error
//		END IF
//	END IF
//END IF

String ls_ybkh,ls_sbm,ls_lp
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_scjssj
SetNull(ldt_scjssj)
String ls_grbh // 人员编号
String ls_jzid // 就诊ID
String ls_jzpzlzx, ls_jzpzbh // 就诊凭证类型、就诊凭证编号
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje // 医疗费用总额
String ls_grjsfs = '01' // 个人结算方式：默认01-按项目结算
String ls_grzhsybz = '1' // 个人账户使用标志：默认1-是
String ls_xzlx // 险种类型
String ls_cbdxzqh // 参保地医保区划
String ls_fphm // 发票号
String ls_ztjsbz = '0' // 中途结算标志：：默认0-否
Decimal{2} ldc_qzfje, ldc_cxjje, ldc_xxzfje, ldc_fhzcfwje,ldc_gbbjzf // 全自费金额、超限价金额、先行自付金额、先行自付金额、干部保健支付
DateTime ldt_cysj // 出院时间
String ls_bzbm // 病种编码
String ls_jzpzsbm // 就诊凭证识别码
String ls_expContent // 字段扩展

Integer li_yepb,li_cypb,li_jslb
String ls_zyhm, ls_yllb, ls_cbdybqh
Long ll_ybscmxCount, ll_bsccont
String ls_ret[]

IF ii_myjsflqy = 1 THEN
	li_yepb = 0
ELSE
	li_yepb = -1
END IF

// 获取 住院基本信息
SELECT     ZYHM,     YBKH,    ZHBZ, MZJCODE,   YBJZBH,    BQCYSJ,cypb,ZY_BRRY_KZ.jslb
	INTO :ls_zyhm, :ls_ybkh, :ls_sbm,  :ls_lp, :ls_jzid, :ldt_cysj,:li_cypb,:li_jslb
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院基本信息失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF

SELECT Max(ZZRQ) Into :ldt_scjssj From ZY_ZYJS Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZFPB = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ldt_scjssj) Or Date(ldt_scjssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_scjssj = ldt_ryrq
END IF
ls_jzid = ''
SELECT GRBH,CBDXZQH,JZID,xzlx,PZLX,PZHM Into :ls_grbh,:ls_cbdxzqh,:ls_jzid,:ls_xzlx,:ls_jzpzlzx, :ls_jzpzbh From jkxt.zhyb_ghxx Where brbm = :ls_zyhm And ywlsh Like  :ls_zyhm || '%'  And ztbz = 1  Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院门诊登记挂号失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ai_jscs) Or ai_jscs < 0 THEN
	as_error = '结算次数有误！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_zyhm) Or Trim(ls_zyhm) = '' THEN
	as_error = '住院号码为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = '就诊ID为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF


// // 获取 住院登记明细
//Select     GRBH,      JZPZLX,     JZPZBH,     XZLX,     CBDYBQH,     YLLB,     BZBM,     CBDYBQH
//  into :ls_grbh, :ls_jzpzlzx, :ls_jzpzbh, :ls_xzlx, :ls_cbdxzqh, :ls_yllb, :ls_bzbm, :ls_cbdybqh
//  From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
// Where JZID=:ls_jzid and ZYH=:al_zyh
// Using itran_sqlca;

IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = '' THEN
	as_error = "人员编号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_xzlx) Or Trim(ls_xzlx) = '' THEN
	as_error = "险种类型为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdxzqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdxzqh) = '' THEN
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN  ls_yllb = '21'
IF IsNull(ls_bzbm) THEN ls_bzbm = ''
// 获取 医疗费用总额
ll_ybscmxCount = 0
SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_ybscmxCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And (nvl(yepb,0) = :li_yepb Or -1 = :li_yepb)  And nvl(yepb,0) <> 9 Using itran_sqlca;
IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 THEN
	IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
		SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From jkxt.zhyb_fymxsc_zy Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9 and nvl(yyspbz,'0') <> '-1' ) Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = 0 ) And ((JFRQ <= :adt_zzrq Or :adt_zzrq Is Null) Or (JLXH In (SELECT glxh From BQXT.zy_fymx_kz kz Where kz.ZYH = :al_zyh))) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From jkxt.zhyb_fymxsc Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9 and nvl(yyspbz,'0') <> '-1' ) Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
IF ll_ybscmxCount > 0 THEN
ELSE
	SELECT Count(1),SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ll_ybscmxCount,:ldc_zjje From ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And (nvl(yepb,0) = :li_yepb Or -1 = :li_yepb)  And nvl(yepb,0) <> 9 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ii_YBBSCFYQY = 1 THEN
		// 获取医保不上传费用的总金额		
		IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
			SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje ,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From jkxt.zhyb_fymxsc_zy Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9 and nvl(yyspbz,'0') <> '-1') Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
			SELECT SUM(ZJJE-nvl(yhje,0)),count(1) Into :astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje ,:ll_bsccont From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where ZYH = :al_zyh And (JSCS = :ai_jscs) And zjje <> nvl(yhje,0) And JLXH In (SELECT ywlsh From jkxt.zhyb_fymxsc Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ywlx = 'ZY' And JZID = :ls_jzid And ztbz = 9 and nvl(yyspbz,'0') <> '-1') Using itran_sqlca;
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_zjje) THEN ldc_zjje = 0.00
IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje) THEN astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje = 0.00
IF IsNull(ll_ybscmxCount) THEN ll_ybscmxCount = 0
IF IsNull(ll_bsccont) THEN ll_bsccont = 0
ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - astr_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje
ll_ybscmxCount = ll_ybscmxCount - ll_bsccont
IF ai_jsbz = 1 And ldc_zjje = 0 THEN
	//	this.uf_zy_crycx( 2, al_zyh, ref as_error) 		 // 自动出院办理撤销
	This.uf_zymz_delfymx( al_zyh, '0000', Ref as_error) // 自动删除明细
	as_error = "病人无医保费用，请撤销登记转自费结算！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF ll_ybscmxCount = 0 THEN
	as_error = '无结算数据'
	RETURN 0
END IF

// 获取 就诊凭证类型、就诊凭证编号
If (Not IsNull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx)) And Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx) > "" THEN
	ls_jzpzlzx = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.jzpzlx
END IF
IF ls_jzpzlzx = '01' THEN // 如果是凭证登记的病人，则使用zy_brry.MZJCODE作为凭证令牌
	ls_jzpzbh = ls_lp
END IF
IF Not IsNull(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) And Trim(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh) > "" THEN
	ls_jzpzbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.shbzkkh
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzpzlzx) Or Trim(ls_jzpzlzx) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊凭证类型为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzpzbh) Or Trim(ls_jzpzbh) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊凭证编号为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 个人结算方式
// ls_grjsfs
IF IsNull(ls_grjsfs) Or Trim(ls_grjsfs) = "" THEN ls_grjsfs = '01'

// 获取 个人账户使用标志
// ls_grzhsybz
IF IsNull(ls_grzhsybz) Or Trim(ls_grzhsybz) = "" THEN ls_grzhsybz = '1'

// 获取 发票号
IF ai_jscs > 1 THEN
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm + "D" + String(ai_jscs)
ELSE
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm
END IF

// 获取 中途结算标志
// ls_ztjsbz
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	ls_ztjsbz = '1'
ELSE
	ls_ztjsbz = '0'
END IF

// 获取 出院时间
IF ls_ztjsbz = '1' THEN
	ldt_cysj = adt_zzrq // 如果是中结，则使用中结日期
END IF

// 获取 全自费金额、超限价金额、先行自付金额、先行自付金额
// ldc_qzfje, ldc_cxjje, ldc_xxzfje, ldc_fhzcfwje

// 获取 就诊凭证识别码
// ls_jzpzsbm

// 获取 字段扩展=
IF li_jslb = 2 THEN ls_expContent = '2'
IF This.of_get_expcontent('MZ', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

//if as_fplsh = '' or isnull(as_fplsh) then as_fplsh = ls_zyhm
as_fplsh = ls_zyhm
IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	This.uf_send_init('2206A') // 预结算
	istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdxzqh
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('2207A') // 确认结算
	istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
END IF
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
ls_yllb = '11' //普通门诊

//hw 2023/03/02 特慢病医疗类别判断
Integer li_lgbz,li_tmbpb
li_lgbz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_zymz(al_zyh)
SELECT TMBPB Into :li_tmbpb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
IF li_lgbz = 1 And li_tmbpb > 0 THEN
	SELECT yllb,bzbm Into :ls_yllb,:ls_bzbm From jkxt.ZHYB_MZJZXX Where brbm = :ls_zyhm Using sqlca;
END IF

This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', ls_grbh ) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_cert_type', ls_jzpzlzx ) //2	mdtrt_cert_type	就诊凭证类型	字符型	3	Y	Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_cert_no', ls_jzpzbh) //3	mdtrt_cert_no	就诊凭证编号	字符型	50		Y	就诊凭证类型为"01"时填写电子凭证令牌，为"02"时填写身份证号，为"03"时填写社会保障卡卡号
This.uf_send_add( 'med_type', ls_yllb ) //4	med_type	医疗繢AT*
	字符型	6	Y	Y	'11' //普通门诊
This.uf_send_add( 'medfee_sumamt', ldc_zjje ) //5	medfee_sumamt	医疗费总额	数值型	16,2		Y	

This.uf_send_add( 'psn_setlway', '01' ) //6	psn_setlway	个人结算方式 01	按项目结算	02	按定额结算09	其他	990104	按限额
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_id', ls_jzid  ) //7	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	
This.uf_send_add( 'chrg_bchno', as_fplsh ) //8	chrg_bchno	收费批次号	字符型
This.uf_send_add( 'acct_used_flag', '1' ) //9	acct_used_flag	个人账户使用标志	字符型
This.uf_send_add( 'insutype', ls_xzlx ) //10	insutype	险种类型	字符型
This.uf_send_add( 'exp_content', ls_expContent ) //11	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000			
This.uf_send_add( 'pub_hosp_rfom_flag', '0' ) //12	pub_hosp_rfom_flag	公立医院改革标志	字符型

IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN //确认仅有
	This.uf_send_add( 'invono', as_fplsh ) //11	invono	发票号	字符型	20			
	//根据预结算返回填入
	This.uf_send_add( 'fulamt_ownpay_amt', ''  ) //12	fulamt_ownpay_amt	全自费金额	数值型	16,2	
	This.uf_send_add( 'overlmt_selfpay', '' ) //13	overlmt_selfpay	超限价金额	数值型	16,2			
	This.uf_send_add( 'preselfpay_amt', '' ) //14	preselfpay_amt	先行自付金额	数值型	16,2			
	This.uf_send_add( 'inscp_scp_amt', '' ) //15	inscp_scp_amt	符合政策范围金额	数值型	16,2	
	
END IF

IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	IF of_get_zygbbjzf(al_zyh,ls_jzid,ldc_gbbjzf,as_error) < 0 THEN 	GOTO Error
END IF

IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	ls_yllb = astr_zhyl_jsxx.yllb // 医疗类别以实际结算结果返回的为准
	IF This.of_insert_jymx('', al_zyh, ai_jscs, ls_fphm, 'ZYMZ', as_jydd, ls_yllb, '', ls_zyhm, astr_zhyl_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error, '') THEN
	IF Pos(as_error, "出院时间不可早于费用发生时间") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "请删除明细后重传明细！"
	END IF
	IF Pos(as_error, "该参保人在相同时间段存在与已登记就诊日期交叉") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "该参保人住院期间在门诊使用过该医保卡就诊，本次住院请撤销医保登记自费结算！"
	END IF
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
IF UpperBound(ls_ret) >= 3 And ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	gf_update_sycs(itran_sqlca, ls_ret[3], ls_cbdxzqh, ls_lp)
END IF
This.of_reset_jsxx(Ref astr_zhyl_jsxx)

This.of_get_ybjsxx(ai_jsbz + 1, Ref astr_zhyl_jsxx) // 解析并存储医保返回的结算金额明细

IF IsNull(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj) Or  Date(astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN // 测试时发现医保返回的结算时间经常为空，若为空则使用本地服务器时间
	astr_zhyl_jsxx.jssj = gf_server_date()
END IF
astr_zhyl_jsxx.gbbjzf = ldc_gbbjzf
IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	IF This.of_update_jsmx(is_jylsh, astr_zhyl_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '【医保端】结算成功，但更新本地结算明细表失败：' + as_error
		GOTO Error_ybRollBack
	END IF
END IF
istr_zhyl_jsxx = astr_zhyl_jsxx


IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
RETURN 1

Error_ybRollBack:
DateTime ldt_temp
String ls_error_jyzf
// 调用“交易作废”，作废本次结算，并撤销本次出院办理

IF This.uf_jyzf(ldt_temp, '2207A',  ls_grbh,is_jylsh, ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN
	as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf
END IF

Error:

IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	as_error = "[2206A-住院门诊预结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	as_error = "[2207A-住院门诊结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSE
	as_error = "[住院预结算/结算]出错：" + as_error
END IF

RETURN -1


end function

public function integer uf_zymz_zydj (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, ref string as_error, long al_zyh);
IF astr_yb_mzsfqq.yktdy > 0 THEN
	ib_ydzf = True
	RETURN This.uf_ydzf_jscl( as_knsj, as_brbm, ai_jslx, as_jylx,as_jydd, astr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error)
END IF
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

DateTime ldt_now
String ls_czybm
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6  THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now),ls_czybm , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
String ls_fplsh,ls_expcontent,ls_jzid,ls_ghlsh,ls_fplsh_y
Dec{0} ldc_jzlsh,ldc_ghlsh
//挂号获取就诊ID
astr_yb_mzsfqq.ghlsh = Dec(al_zyh)
astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh = Dec(al_zyh)

ls_ghlsh = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ghlsh)
ls_fplsh_y = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
//IF ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1 THEN
//	IF This.of_get_ghjzid( ai_jslx,as_brbm, Left(as_jylx,2),ls_ghlsh,as_jydd, astr_yb_mzsfqq, ls_jzid, as_error) < 0 THEN
//		RETURN -1
//	END IF
//ELSE
//	ls_jzid = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_zhyl_jsxx.jzid
//END IF

//上传就诊信息
String ls_yllb,ls_bzbm,ls_ghsf,ls_tmbmc = '' //,ls_ksmc
//ls_ksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc( 'MZ_KS',astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm ) //科室
//IF ls_ksmc <= '' THEN
//	as_error = '未找到对应的科室名称 MZ_KS ' +astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
//mz_ycfcjl
//医疗类别
//11	普通门诊	12	挂号 13	急诊	51	生育门诊
//门诊挂号：12；普通门诊：11；门诊慢性病：140104；门诊特殊病种(丙肝合并到门诊特殊病种)：140201
//罕见病：140401；苯丙酮尿症合并到罕见病：140401；体检：9107；职工生育门诊：51。（职工生育类业务险种类型默认传入"510"）
//留观后续有住院医保结算代码2403，无住院传13急诊
ls_bzbm = ''
ls_ghsf = Left(as_jylx,2)
as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)                                      
Integer li_lgbz,li_tmbpb,li_cypb,li_jslb,li_cyqx
Long ll_brbq
DateTime ldt_bqcysj
li_lgbz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_zymz(al_zyh)
SELECT TMBPB,TMBBZ,bqcysj,JSLB,cyqx  Into :li_tmbpb,:ls_bzbm,:ldt_bqcysj,:li_jslb,:li_cyqx From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT brbq,cypb Into :ll_brbq,:li_cypb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_jslb = -2 THEN
	as_error = '为外伤病人并且存在第三方责任，不能做医保登记！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
	ls_yllb = '12' //挂号
ELSEIF ls_ghsf = 'TJ' THEN
	ls_yllb = '9107'
ELSEIF ls_ghsf = 'SY' THEN
	ls_yllb = '11'
	IF This.of_syqypd(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm) > 0 THEN
		ls_yllb = '51'
	END IF
ELSEIF li_lgbz = 1 And li_tmbpb > 0 THEN //hw 2023/03/02 hw 增加
	IF li_tmbpb = 1 THEN
		ls_yllb = '140201'
	ELSEIF li_tmbpb = 2 THEN
		ls_yllb = '14'
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_yllb = '11' //普通门诊
	IF as_jylx = 'TSB' THEN
		ls_yllb = '140201'
		ls_bzbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.tsbxmdm
	ELSEIF as_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
		//		14	门诊慢特病  对应公务员慢病
		ls_yllb = '14'
		//	140104	门诊慢病	
		//		ls_yllb = '140104'
		ls_bzbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.mxbxmdm
	ELSEIF as_jylx = 'HJB' THEN //140401	门诊罕见病
		ls_yllb = '140401'
		ls_bzbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.BZDM
	END IF
	IF ls_yllb = '11'  And This.of_syqypd(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm  ) > 0 THEN
		ls_yllb = '51'
		ls_bzbm = ''
	END IF
	IF ii_ksmtbqy = 1 And  Left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) <> Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) THEN
		IF ls_yllb = '140201' Or ls_yllb = '140104' THEN ls_yllb = '14'
	END IF
END IF
Long ll_count,ll_row
String ls_tmbbz
IF ii_jzlgms = 1 And Pos(is_lgks,',' + String(ll_brbq) + ',') > 0 And ll_brbq <> il_yzybq THEN //留观(排矰AT* )后续有住院走2403，没有走13
	IF li_cypb = 0 THEN
		as_error = '【留观病区】请先办理出院再做医保登记'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ldt_bqcysj) Or Date(ldt_bqcysj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
		as_error = '病区出院时间为空或有误'
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	//出院去向为转病区 或转手术室，并且出院24小时内有普通病区的入院记录则走急诊留观2403
	ls_yllb = '13'
	IF li_cyqx = 1 Or li_cyqx = 5 THEN
		ls_yllb = '2403'
	ELSE
		ll_count = 0
		ll_count = of_lgzy(2,ldt_bqcysj,al_zyh,itran_sqlca)
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			ls_yllb = '2403'
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ls_yllb = '13' And UpperBound(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj) > 0 AND ii_jzlgmtbkz = 1 THEN
		//慢特病判断			
		ll_count = 0
		FOR ll_row = 1 To UpperBound(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj)
			ls_tmbbz = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
			IF ls_tmbbz > ' ' THEN
				SELECT count(1) INTO :ll_count FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd_jk g, bqxt.zy_ryzd  z,xtgl.gy_jbbm j
					WHERE g.jklx = 'ZHYL' AND g.DMLB IN ('TSBDZ','GWYMBDZ')
					And g.dmjc = :ls_tmbbz And z.ZYH = :al_zyh And z.zdxh = j.code And j.icd10 = g.dmsb  Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF ll_count > 0  THEN EXIT
		NEXT
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			as_error = '病人有慢特病备案，并且存在诊断符合慢特病，病人需自费结算后去医保局报销'
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
//医保挂号操作
IF ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	IF This.of_get_ghjzid( ai_jslx,as_brbm, Left(as_jylx,2),ls_ghlsh,as_jydd, astr_yb_mzsfqq, ls_jzid, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_jzid = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_zhyl_jsxx.jzid
END IF

ldc_jzlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh
ldc_ghlsh = Dec(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ghlsh)
//外伤标志
IF li_jslb = 2 THEN ls_expcontent = "2"
IF This.of_get_expcontent( ls_expcontent, as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
//门诊就诊信息上传
If (ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1) And ls_ghsf <> 'GH' THEN
	IF This.uf_mz_jzxx( ai_jslx,as_brbm,ls_jzid,ldc_jzlsh,astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm,astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm,ls_yllb,ls_czybm,ls_bzbm ,as_error) < 0  THEN
		Error:
		String ls_error
		This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, ls_jzid, astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh,DateTime(Date(ldt_now)), ls_error)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF ls_bzbm = '' THEN ls_bzbm = istr_zhyl_jsxx.bzbm
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_zymz_ghcx (string as_mzyh, ref string as_error, string as_zyhm);

//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zymz_ghcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:[2202-门诊挂号撤销]
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_grbh 	
// 	value    	string  	as_jzid 	
// 	value    	string  	as_mzyh 	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jssj	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	szx		日期: 2022.10.21
//====================================================================
IF IsNull(as_mzyh) Or Trim(as_mzyh) = "" THEN
	as_error = "住院/门诊号为空"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "创建临时事务失败！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
string ls_jzid,ls_grbh,ls_brbm,ls_ywlsh
datetime ldt_kssj
SELECT JZID,grbh,kssj,ywlsh INTO :ls_jzid,:ls_grbh,:ldt_kssj,:ls_ywlsh FROM JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX
	Where  BRBM = :as_zyhm And  ZTBZ = 1 And  ywlsh like :as_zyhm || '%' Order By JYSJ Desc Using itran_sqlca ;
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
	as_error = "就诊ID为空"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH	
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = "人员编号为空"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
String ls_sfybm,ls_expContent,ls_cbdybqh
DateTime ldt_now
ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
// 操作员签到
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or  base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 8 THEN
	ls_sfybm = is_zyzz
ELSE
	ls_sfybm = is_mzzz
END IF
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm ,  1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF This.of_get_expcontent( ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN // 退费时，需要取原收费的扩展字段
	GOTO Error
END IF

ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm


This.uf_send_init('2202')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_sfybm
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参盌AT*


This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
This.uf_send_add('ipt_otp_no', as_mzyh) // 	住院/门诊号	字符型
// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(as_error,'' ) THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 成功后回写HIS
str_zhyl_ghxx lstr_zhyl_ghxx
lstr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj = ldt_kssj
lstr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID = ls_jzid
IF This.of_update_ghxx( 1, lstr_zhyl_ghxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '接口作废矰AT* 晒Γ�更新失败� ' + as_error
END IF

RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2202-门诊挂号撤销]出错：" + as_error

RETURN -1
end function

public function integer uf_zymz_delfymx (long al_zyh, string as_fymxlsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zymz_delfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院费用明细按门诊撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_fymxlsh	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	SZX		日期: 2022.11.01    28271  住院费用明细按门诊撤销
//====================================================================
if this.of_get_zyqy( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 then
	GOTO Error 
end if
IF isnull(al_zyh) or al_zyh=0 Then
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_fymxlsh) or Trim(as_fymxlsh)="" Then
	as_fymxlsh = "0000"
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 or base_info.syscode = 5  THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), ls_czybm, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_JZID        // 就诊ID
String ls_grbh        // 人员编号
String ls_expContent  // 字段扩展
string ls_zyhm
String ls_cbdybqh

//// 获取 就诊ID
//Select YBJZBH
//  into :ls_jzid
//  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
// Where ZYH=:al_zyh
// Using itran_sqlca;
//IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
//	as_error = "获取就诊ID失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
//	goto Error
//END IF
//IF isnull(ls_jzid) or Trim(ls_jzid)="" Then
//	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空！"
//	goto Error
//END IF

//// 获取 人员编号
//Select     GRBH,     CBDYBQH
//  into :ls_grbh, :ls_cbdybqh
//  From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX 
// Where JZID=:ls_jzid
// Using itran_sqlca;
SELECT ZYHM INTO :ls_zyhm from zy_brry where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取住院号码失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
 select GRBH,CBDXZQH,JZID into :ls_grbh,:ls_cbdybqh,:ls_jzid
  from jkxt.zhyb_ghxx where brbm = :ls_zyhm and ywlsh like  :ls_zyhm || '%'  and ztbz = 1  Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_jzid) or Trim(ls_jzid)="" Then
	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_grbh) or Trim(ls_grbh)="" Then
	as_error = "人员编号不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_cbdybqh) or Trim(ls_cbdybqh)="" Then 
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，不能删除明细，请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	goto Error
END IF

// 获取 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('MZ', ls_jzid, '', al_zyh, ref ls_expContent, ref as_error)<0 Then
	goto Error
END IF


This.uf_send_init('2205')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm             			// 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh         // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

//This.uf_send_add('feedetl_sn', as_fymxlsh)      // 费用明细流水号：传入"0000"时删除全部
//This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid)           // 就诊ID
//This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)             // 人员编号
//This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent)  // 字段扩展

This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) //mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'chrg_bchno', as_fymxlsh) //chrg_bchno	收费批次号	字符型	30		Y	传入"0000"删除所有未结算明细
This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', ls_grbh) //psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'exp_content', ls_expContent) //exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000	

// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error, '') Then
	// 由于测试时明细撤销时发现，没有做明细上传且直接做明细撤销会返回这个报错，因此这里做特殊处理
	IF Pos(as_error, "根据传来的参数在费用明细表中未查询到任何有效相关的记录")<=0  and Pos(as_error, "费用明细信息不符合撤销要求")<=0  Then
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF as_fymxlsh="0000" Then
	DELETE From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ=0  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但删除住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	if ii_zyqy_br = 1 then
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	else
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	end if
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_FYMX SET ZFJE = ZJJE - NVL(YHJE,0) ,ZFBL = 1 WHERE  ZYH = :al_zyh And JSCS = 0  Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Set MXBS=MXBS-1  Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ=0 and JSRQ=(SELECT Max(JSRQ) From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where zyh=:al_zyh And ztbz = 0) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但更新住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	if ii_zyqy_br = 1 then
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_FYMX SET ZFJE = ZJJE - NVL(YHJE,0) ,ZFBL = 1 WHERE  ZYH = :al_zyh And JSCS = 0 and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1


Error:
as_error = "[2205-住院费用明细按门诊撤销]出错：" + as_error
return -1
end function

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, string as_jzid, string as_fymxlsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_delfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:住院费用明细撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh    	
// 	value    	string	as_jzid   	
// 	value    	string	as_fymxlsh	
// 	reference	string	as_error  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2023.01.28
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(al_zyh) Or al_zyh = 0 THEN
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF IsNull(as_jzid) Or Trim(as_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空!"
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF IsNull(as_fymxlsh) Or Trim(as_fymxlsh) = "" THEN
	as_fymxlsh = "0000"
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
if this.of_get_zyqy( al_zyh, as_error) <0 then
	return -1
end if
//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
if this.of_get_zyqy( al_zyh, as_error) < 0 then
	GOTO Error
end if

String ls_JZID  ,ls_grbh ,ls_expContent ,ls_cbdybqh // 就诊ID,人员编号,字段扩展
ls_JZID = as_jzid
// 获取 人员编号
SELECT     GRBH,     CBDYBQH
	INTO :ls_grbh, :ls_cbdybqh
	From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX	Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID  Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 字段扩展
IF This.of_get_expcontent('ZY', ls_JZID, '', al_zyh, Ref ls_expContent, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

This.uf_send_init('2302')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('feedetl_sn', as_fymxlsh) // 费用明细流水号：传入"0000"时删除全部
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_JZID) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error, '') THEN
	// 由于测试时明细撤销时发现，没有做明细上传且直接做明细撤销会返回这个报错，因此这里做特殊处理 //as_fymxlsh = "0000" And 
	IF Pos(as_error, "根据传来的参数在费用明细表中未查询到任何有效相关的记录") <= 0 And Pos(as_error, "费用明细信息不符合撤销要求") <= 0  THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF as_fymxlsh = "0000" THEN
	IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_ZY Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZIll_rowcount
ls_gerenbh
ls_fymxlsh
ldt_fyfssj
ls_yljgmlbm
ldc_fydj_yh
ls_expcontent
ls_feedetl_sn
ll_add_row
ll_find_yz
ll_find_sc
ll_retcount
li_dcsc1tfysl
ldc_jfjlxh
ldt_bqrysj
ldt_fyfssj_y
ldt_bqcysj
ls_kdyssfzh
ls_xmzxbh_ts
ls_gjybbm_ts
ls_cbdybqh
lb_uploadtfmx
lstr_gbbj_tsmx
lstr_gbbj_null
D And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端"+string(ii_zyqy_br)+"】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	
ELSE
	IF ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC_zy Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) And YWLSH = :as_fymxlsh   Using itran_sqlca;
	ELSE
		UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) And YWLSH = :as_fymxlsh   Using itran_sqlca;
	end if
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端"+string(ii_zyqy_br)+"】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		//	goto Error
	END IF
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2302-住院费用明细撤销]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1




end function

		as_error = '检索智慧医保自费上传诊断信息加载失败'
		li_return_code = -1
		goto js
	END IF
	lds_jyxxsczd.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
	//电子票据信息

ELSE
	//智慧医保上传信息
	ls_sql = " select zhyb_zfbrjyxxsc.ryxm,zhyb_zfbrjyxxsc.zjhm from jkxt.zhyb_zfbrjyxxsc " +&

				" where zhyb_zfbrjyxxsczd.ywlx = '" + as_ywlx + "' and zhyb_zfbrjyxxsczd.yyjgjzid = '" + as_yyjgjzid + "' " + &
				" and zhyb_zfbrjyxxsczd.ztbz = 1 "
	IF lds_jyxxsczd.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = '检索智慧医保自费上传诊断信息加载失败'

//	ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
//		SELECT jylsh,pjhm,pjdm Into :ls_jylsh,:ls_pjhm,:ls_pjdm From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = 'GH' and jylsh = :as_yyjgjzid And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) using itran_sqlca;
//	END IF
END IF
//数据插入--基本信息

	ljson.setattribute( 'YWLX', as_ywlx)//业务类型
	ljson.setattribute( 'YYJGJZID', as_yyjgjzid)//医药机构就诊id

	ljson.setattribute( 'ZJHM', lds_jyxxsc.object.#2[1])//证件号码
END IF
//数据插入--诊断
//ll_rowcount = lds_jyxxsczd.retrieve()

		//进行数据更新
		ljson_data.parse( ls_output )

		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		IF as_ywlx = 'ZY' Then//住院病人
			Update JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSC Set DZPJSCLSH = :ls_sclsh Where YWLX = :as_ywlx and YYJGJZID = :as_yyjgjzid and jscs = :al_jscs and ztbz = 1 Using itran_sqlca;

public function integer of_get_zfbrjson (string as_field, ref string as_return, ref string as_error, str_zfbrjson astr_zfbrjson);//====================================================================
//获取自费病人就医信息json数据
//====================================================================
//参数定义与初始化
sailJson ljson_expContent
long ll_day
datetime ldt_now
string ls_return,ls_null
setnull(ls_null)
ljson_expContent = Create SailJson

//数据填充
IF upper(as_field) = 'MEMO' Then//备注
	IF isnull(astr_zfbrjson.sm) or astr_zfbrjs
on.sm = '' Then astr_zfbrjson.sm = ls_null
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("mcs_prov_code", astr_zfbrjson.sm) //耗材省码
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("hosp_appr_flag", astr_zfbrjson.spbz) //医院审批标志0-无须审批、1-审批通过、2-审批不通过
//	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("reim_flag", '1') //医保报销标志
ELSEIF upper(as_field) = 'EXP_CONTENT' Then//扩展字段
	ldt_now = gf_server_date()
	ll_day = daysafter(date(astr_zfbrjson.csny),date(ldt_now))
	IF ll_day > 28 Then
		ljson_expContent.setAttribute("nwb_flag", '0') //新生儿标志:0否1是并且使用父母身份证2是使用本人身份证
	ELSE
		ljson_expContent.setAttribute("nwb_flag", '2') //新生儿标志:0否1是并且使用父母身份证2是使用本人身份证
	END IF
	ljson_expContent.setAttribute("ownpay_type", '1') //自费类型
END IF

//结束
as_return = ljson_expContent.getformatjson("")
IF isValid(ljson_expContent) Then Destroy(ljson_expContent)
return 1
end function

public subroutine of_zfbr_gbbj_spbz (string as_ywlx, long al_xmlsh, ref str_zfbrjson lstr_zfbrjson, string as_brbm);//参数定义
dec{2} ldc_zfbl
string ls_error
long ll_brxz
str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl

//获取干部保健标志
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl = lstr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
SELECT JSLB,BRXM,SFZH INTO :ll_brxz,:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.brxm,:istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.certno
	From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz = '0'
IF ll_brxz = il_gbbjxz And ii_gbbjqy = 1 THEN
	This.uf_get_gbbjdx(1, ls_error)
END IF

//设置审批标志
IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' THEN
	ldc_zfbl = 0
	IF as_ywlx = 'YJ' THEN
		IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 0, al_xmlsh, ldc_zfbl, ls_error) < 0 THEN RETURN
	ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
		IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 1, al_xmlsh, ldc_zfbl, ls_error) < 0 THEN RETURN
	END IF
	IF ldc_zfbl > 0 THEN
		lstr_zfbrjson.spbz = '2'
	END IF
END IF
end subroutine

public function integer uf_zy_zfbrfymxsc (long al_zyh, string as_zyhm, integer ai_jscs, ref string as_error, ref string as_dzpj_jylsh);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_zfbrfymxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 自费病人住院费用明细信息上传
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long		al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string 	as_zyhm 	
// 	value    	integer	ai_jscs 	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.05.07    30167  自费病人住院费用明细信息上传
//====================================================================

IF isnull(al_zyh) or al_zyh=0 Then
	as_error = "住院号不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_zyhm) or Trim(as_zyhm)="" Then
	as_error = "住院号码不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(ai_jscs) or ai_jscs=0 Then
	as_error = "结算次数不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF


//使用临时事务
IF uf_set_instance(ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_yllb, ls_sql, ls_fymc, ls_yljgmlbm, ls_xmzxbh_ts, ls_ylmlbm, ls_cllx, ls_clbm, ls_fymxlsh, ls_ylsfxmlb, ls_ybmlmc, ls_fyks, ls_fyksmc
String ls_ysgh, ls_ysxm, ls_yssfzh, ls_brbq, ls_sylb, ls_dmmc, ls_ysbm_gjm,ls_memo,ls_YYSPBZ,ls_bz,ls_error,ls_fyks_gjm
Long ll_count, ll_rowcount, ll_i, ll_fyxh, ll_ypcd, ll_Find, ll_clbm, ll_insert
Integer li_yplx, li_tsdz, li_xmlx,li_fyxm
DateTime ldt_fyfssj, ldt_now,ldt_begin,ldt_end
Decimal{2} ldc_zjje, ldc_yhje
Decimal{6} ldc_fydj
Decimal{4} ldc_fysl
date ld_csny
Decimal{2} ldc_fyze_zfjzxx
string ls_yllb_zfjzxx
u_dataStore lds_zyfymx, lds_zfbrjyxxscmx
str_zfbrjson lstr_zfbrjson
ldc_fyze_zfjzxx = 0

ldt_now = gf_server_date()

// 获取 住院基本信息
Select brbq,csny into :ls_brbq,:ld_csny From BQXT.ZY_BRRY Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取住院基本信息失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
lstr_zfbrjson.csny = ld_csny

// 获取 医疗类别：21-普通住院，52-职工生育住院，71-家庭病床，9933-透析治疗
IF Pos(is_fcbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',')>0 and ls_yllb<>'52' Then  // 生育住院
	// 苍南、平阳、台州由于妇科产科病人混住，所以必须根据分娩方式是否维护来判断是否属于生育住院
	IF Pos(base_info.Hospital,'苍南')>0 or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'平阳')>0 or Pos(base_info.Hospital,'台州')>0 Then
		SELECT nvl(FMFS,'') Into :ls_sylb From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH=:al_zyh Using itran_sqlca; 
		IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
			as_error = "获取分娩方式失败：["+String(itran_sqlca)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
			goto Error
		END IF
		IF ls_sylb>'0' Then
			ls_yllb = '52'
		ELSE
			ls_sylb = ''
		END IF
		
		// 如果是保胎，则走普通住院
		Select dmmc into :ls_dmmc From xtgl.gy_dmzd Where dmlb='2635' and dmsb=:ls_sylb Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.sqlCode=0 and ls_dmmc>'' Then
			IF Pos(ls_dmmc, "保胎")>0 THen
				ls_sylb = ''
				ls_yllb = '21'
			END IF
		END IF
		
		// 如果根据分娩方式找不到，则根据准生证号再判断一次
		IF ls_yllb<>'52' Then
			Select Count(*) into :ll_Count From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ2 Where zyh=:al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode=0 and ll_Count>0 Then
				ls_yllb='52'
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_yllb='52'
	END IF
	
	// 温州的生育按项目结算，医疗类别不能传入52-生育住院，而是直接使用21-普通住院
	IF ii_zhyb_sybxtscl=1 Then 
		ls_sylb=''
		ls_yllb='21' 
	END IF
ELSEIF Pos(is_xtbq, ','+String(ls_brbq)+',')>0 Then  // 血透病区
	ls_yllb = '9933'
END IF
IF isnull(ls_yllb) or Trim(ls_yllb)="" Then ls_yllb='21'

// 检薉AT*
餍枰�上传的费用明细数�

IF IsValid(lds_zyfymx) = False THEN
	lds_zyfymx = Create U_datastore
	lds_zyfymx.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)

	ls_sql = " Select JLXH, YPLX, FYXH, YPCD, XMLX, FYMC, JFRQ, FYSL, FYDJ, ZJJE, FYKS, YSGH, NVL(YHJE,0) AS YHJE,SPBZ,FYXM,SRGH" +&
				"   From BQXT.ZY_FYMX" +&
				"  Where ZYH=" + String(al_zyh) +&
				"    AND JSCS=" + String(ai_jscs) +&
				" Order by FYXH, YPCD, FYSL DESC "
	IF lds_zyfymx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象蔇AT* ("+lds_zyfymx.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
lds_zyfymx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
ll_rowcount = lds_zyfymx.Retrieve()
IF ll_rowcount < 0 THEN
	as_error = "检索费用明细失败：" + lds_zyfymx.is_error
	goto Error
ELSEIF ll_rowCount=0 Then
	return 1
END IF

For ll_i=ll_rowCount to 1 Step -1
	// 删除不上传的明细
	IF lds_zyfymx.Object.YPLX[ll_i]=0 THen
		IF gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( 0, lds_zyfymx.Object.FYXH[ll_i], 0, Ref as_error)>0 Then 	
			lds_zyfymx.deleteRow(ll_i)
			ll_rowCount --
			continue;
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF gu_ybjk_public.of_judge_bscxm( 1, lds_zyfymx.Object.FYXH[ll_i], lds_zyfymx.Object.YPCD[ll_i], Ref as_error)>0 Then 	
			lds_zyfymx.deleteRow(ll_i)
			ll_rowCount --
			continue;
		END IF
	END IF
	
	// 合并项目费用（去除退费项目）
	ls_fymxlsh = String(lds_zyfymx.Object.JLXH[ll_i])
	ll_fyxh = lds_zyfymx.Object.FYXH[ll_i]		
	ll_ypcd = lds_zyfymx.Object.YPCD[ll_i]	
	ll_find = lds_zyfymx.find("( FYXH="+String(ll_fyxh)+" ) and ( YPCD="+String(ll_ypcd)+" ) and ( JLXH<>"+ls_fymxlsh+" )", 1, ll_rowCount)
	IF ll_find>0 Then
		lds_zyfymx.Object.FYSL[ll_find] = lds_zyfymx.Object.FYSL[ll_find] + lds_zyfymx.Object.FYSL[ll_i]
		lds_zyfymx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] = lds_zyfymx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] + lds_zyfymx.Object.ZJJE[ll_i]
		lds_zyfymx.Object.YHJE[ll_find] = lds_zyfymx.Object.YHJE[ll_find] + lds_zyfymx.Object.YHJE[ll_i]
		lds_zyfymx.deleteRow(ll_i)
		ll_rowCount --
	ELSE
		IF lds_zyfymx.Object.FYSL[ll_i]=0 Then
			lds_zyfymx.deleteRow(ll_i)
			ll_rowCount --
		END IF
	END IF
Next
ll_rowcount = lds_zyfymx.rowCount( )
IF ll_rowCount=0 Then
	return 1
END IF

	if isvalid(ljson) Then Destroy ljson
	if isvalid(ljson_data) Then Destroy ljson_data
	return li_return_code
end function

public function integer of_syqypd (string as_ksbm);//Select * From gy_xtcs Where csmc = 'CKYBMZQY' Or csmc = 'SYMZZKS' Or csmc = 'CKYBSYXZCDQ' Or csmc = 'CKYBSYXZCCBR' Or csmc = 'CKZFMZZKS'
IF ii_symzqy >= 1 And istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gend = 2  THEN
	//生育专科控制
	IF is_syks > ' ' and is_syks <> ',,' THEN //如果为空不受专科控制
		IF Pos(is_syks,',' + as_ksbm + ',') = 0 THEN
			RETURN 0
		END IF
	END IF
	//诊断获取需二次判断：险种+地区判断
	IF Pos(is_syxz,',' + istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.insutype+ ',') > 0  Or is_syxz = 'QB'  Or is_syxz = ',QB,' THEN
		//生育门诊启用：0-关闭；1-本地；2-省内异地；3-全部地区
		IF ii_symzqy = 1 THEN
			IF  Left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = Left(is_yljgxzqh,4)  THEN
				RETURN 1
			END IF
		ELSEIF ii_symzqy = 2 THEN
			IF  Left(istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,2) = Left(is_yljgxzqh,2)  THEN
				RETURN 1
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
		//		ls_yllb = '51'
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 0



end function

		lsjson.setattribute('rxno',String(ldc_ywlsh)) //6	rxno	处方号	字符型	30			外购处方时，传入外购处方的处方号；非外购处方，传入医药机构处方号
		lsjson.setattribute('fee_ocur_time',String(ldt_now,'yyyymmddhhmmss')) //8	fee_ocur_time	费用发生时间	日期时间型			Y	yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
		lsjson.setattribute('med_list_codg',ls_gjybbm) //9	med_list_codg	医疗目录编码	字符型	50		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('medins_list_codg',ls_yyxmbh) //10	medins_list_codg	医药机构目录编码	字符型	150		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('det_item_fee_sumamt',String(ldc_ylfyze,'0.00')) //11	det_item_fee_sumamt	明细项目费用总额	数值型	16,2		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('cnt',String(ldc_fysl)) //12	cnt	数量	数值型	16,4		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('pric',String(ldc_fydj)) //13	pric	单价	数值型	16,6		Y			
		lsjson.setattribute('bilg_dept_codg',ls_ybksbm) //18	bilg_dept_codg	开单科室编码	字符型	30		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('bilg_dept_name',ls_ksmc) //19	bilg_dept_name	开单科室名称	字符型	100		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('bilg_dr_codg',ls_ysbm_gjm) //20	bilg_dr_codg	开单医生编码	字符型	30		Y	按照标准编码填写
		lsjson.setattribute('bilg_dr_name',ls_ysxm) //21	bilg_dr_name	开单医师姓名	字符型	50		Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('acord_dept_codg','') //22	acord_dept_codg	受单科室编码	字符型	30			
		lsjson.setattribute('acord_dept_name','') //23	acord_dept_name	受单科室名称	字符型	100			
		lsjson.setattribute('orders_dr_code','') //24	orders_dr_code	受单医生编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写
		lsjson.setattribute('orders_dr_name','') //25	orders_dr_name	受单医生姓名	字符型	50			
		//			lsjson.setattribute('orders_dr_code',ls_ysbm_gjm) //24	orders_dr_code	受单医生编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写
		//			lsjson.setattribute('orders_dr_name',ls_ysxm) //25	orders_dr_name	受单医生姓名	字符型	50			
		lsjson.setattribute('hosp_appr_flag',ls_yyspbz) //26	hosp_appr_flag	医院审批标志	字符型	3	Y	Y	
		lsjson.setattribute('tcmdrug_used_way',ls_dfybz) //27	tcmdrug_used_way	中药使用方式	字符型	1	复方	2	单方
		lsjson.setattribute('etip_flag','0') //28	etip_flag	外检标志	字符型	3	Y		
		lsjson.setattribute('etip_hosp_code','0') //29	etip_hosp_code	外检医院编码	字符型	30			按照标准编码填写
		lsjson.setattribute('dscg_tkdrug_flag','0') //30	dscg_tkdrug_flag	出院带药标志	字符型	3	Y		
		lsjson.setattribute('matn_fee_flag',ls_syfybz) //31	matn_fee_flag	生育费用标志	字符型	6	Y		
		//		lsjson.setattribute('comb_no',String(ldc_ywlsh)) //32	comb_no	组套编号	字符型	3			
		lsjson.setattribute('exp_content',ls_expcontent) //33	exp_content	字段扩展	字符型	4000			
		lsjson.setattribute('memo',ls_memo) //			34	memo	备注	字符型	500
		//		额外
		lsjson.setattribute('drord_no', String(ldc_ywlsh)) //drord_no	医嘱号	
		lsjson.setattribute('prod_barc','') //prod_barc	商品条形编码				
		lsjson.setattribute('item_name',ls_xmmc) //item_name	项目名称				
		lsjson.setattribute('invo_item_no','') //invo_item_no	发票项目编码					
		lsjson.setattribute('hi_item','Y') //hi_item	是否医保项目  Y 为“是” N 为“否”	 //bsc还需要再处理
		lsjson.setattribute('item_emp',ls_fydw) //item_emp	项目单位
		as_data[ll_mxjs] = lsjson.getformatjson( '')
		
		// 插入费用明细上传表
		ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
		IF isnull(ls_jzid ) then
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = ls_jzid 
		else
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = ls_fplsh // 就诊ID
		end if
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.brbm[ll_insert] = as_brbm // 住院号
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = ls_ywlx // 业务类型：
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywlsh) // 费用明细流水号
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywmxxh) // 原费用流水号
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = ls_fplsh // 医嘱号
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = ldt_now // 费用发生时间
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_gjybbm // 医疗目录编码
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_yyxmbh // 医药机构目录编码
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze // 明细项目费用总额
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YYSPBZ[ll_insert] = ls_yyspbz // 医院审批标志
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SYFYBZ[ll_insert] = ls_syfybz // 生育费用标志
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = ls_mxxh
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = ls_memo
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0
	
END IF
NEXT
if ids_ybfymx_sc.rowcount( ) > 0 then
	IF ids_ybfymx_sc.Update() = 1 THEN
		COMMIT Using itran_sqlca ;
	ELSE
		as_error = '保存上传明细失败ids_ybfymx_sc:' + ids_ybfymx_sc.is_error
		ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca ;
		gf_sblog("c:\sblog\ydzf" ,'tsid:' + ls_fplsh + "~r~n" + as_error)
//		RETURN -1
	END IF
end if
//gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...',-1)
RETURN 1





end function

public function integer of_mz_bscxm (integer ai_jslx, string as_jzid, string as_brbm, string as_ghfs, ref datastore ads_datasource, string as_fplsh, datetime adt_fsrq, ref decimal adc_bscje, ref decimal adc_gbbj, ref long ai_gbbj_insert, ref str_gbbj_tsmx astr_gbbj_tsmx, ref string as_data_zf[], ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_mz_bscxm()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:门诊不上传明细处理
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer  	ai_jslx       	
// 	value    	string   	as_ghfs       	
// 	value    	datastore	ads_datasource	
// 	reference	string   	as_return    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.05.15
//====================================================================
//门诊不上传ii_ybmzbscqy = 1和不上传+明细拆分不启用ii_YBBSCCFQY = 0才调用这里
IF ii_ybmzbscqy = 1  And ii_YBBSCCFQY = 0 THEN
	//IF base_info.UserID <> '209134' And base_info.UserID <> '196019'  THEN RETURN 1
ELSE
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF ads_datasource.RowCount() <= 0 THEN RETURN 1
String ls_sql, ls_yplx, ls_fyxh
Long ll_rowCount, ll_find,ll_fyxh,ll_ypcd,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_bsc = 0,ll_bscCount
// 医保不上传费用dataStore 初始化
IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_bscfy) THEN
	ids_yb_bscfy = Create U_dataStore
	ids_yb_bscfy.setWorkTrans(itran_sqlca)
	//	ls_sql = "SELECT CSDM, 0 as YPLX,Y.FYDW As DW,Y.FYMC As XMMC FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N N,XTGL.GY_YLSF Y WHERE N.CSMC='YB_BSCFY' AND N.CSZ='1' And N.CSDM = TO_CHAR(Y.FYXH) Union All " +&
	ls_sql = "SELECT CSDM, 0 as YPLX FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N WHERE CSMC='YB_BSCFY' AND CSZ='1' Union All " +&
		"SELECT CSDM, 1 as YPLX FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N WHERE CSMC='YB_BSCYP' AND CSZ='1'  "
	IF ids_yb_bscfy.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_return = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_yb_bscfy.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		ids_yb_bscfy.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
		ids_yb_bscfy.Retrieve()
	END IF
END IF
ll_bscCount = ids_yb_bscfy.RowCount()
IF ll_bscCount <= 0 THEN RETURN 0

ll_rowCount = ads_datasource.RowCount()
IF ll_rowCount <= 0 THEN RETURN 0
adc_bscje = 0.00
String ls_ywlx,ls_return = '',ls_xmmc,ls_dw,ls_data_zf[]
Dec{2} ldc_ylfyze,ldc_fysl,ldc_bscje = 0.00,ldc_gbbjzf = 0.00
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_zfbl
Dec{0} ldc_ywlsh,ldc_ywmxxh
sailjson lsjson
lsjson = Create sailjson
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowCount
	ll_fyxh = ads_datasource.Object.XMLSH[ll_cur]
	IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
		ls_ywlx = 'GH'
		ls_yplx = '0'
		ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh)
		//		ldc_ywlsh = Dec(as_fplsh)
		//		ldc_ywmxxh = ll_cur
	ELSE
		ll_ypcd = ads_datasource.Object.CDLSH[ll_cur]
		ls_ywlx = ads_datasource.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
		//		ldc_ywlsh = ads_datasource.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		//		ldc_ywmxxh = ads_datasource.Object.mxxh[ll_cur]
		IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
			ls_yplx = '1'
			ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh) + '#' + String(ll_ypcd)
		ELSE
			ls_yplx = '0'
			ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh)
		END IF
	END IF
	ll_find = ids_yb_bscfy.Find(" (CSDM='"+ls_fyxh+"' and YPLX="+ls_yplx+") ", 1, ll_bscCount)
	//对应的不上传明细的zfbl记得处理成1
	ls_xmmc = ads_datasource.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		IF ib_ydzf THEN
			lsjson.SetNull( )
			IF ii_ydzf_fgbqy = 0 THEN
				as_return = ls_xmmc + '为自费项目:' + '医保移动支付暂不支持自费项目结算'
				RETURN -1
			END IF
		END IF
		ll_bsc = ll_bsc + 1
		ls_return = ls_return + String(ll_cur) + ','
		//		ls_dw = ids_yb_bscfy.Object.#3[ll_find]
		IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
			ldc_fysl = 1
			ldc_fydj = Round(ads_datasource.Object.zjje[ll_cur],2)
		else
			ldc_fysl = ads_datasource.Object.xmsl[ll_cur]
			ldc_fydj = ads_datasource.Object.xmdj[ll_cur]
		end if
		ldc_ylfyze =  Round(ads_datasource.Object.zjje[ll_cur],2)
		ldc_bscje = ldc_bscje + ldc_ylfyze
		IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
			ldc_ywlsh = Dec(as_fplsh)
			ldc_ywmxxh = ll_cur
		ELSE
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_datasource.Object.YWLSH[ll_cur]
			ldc_ywmxxh = ads_datasource.Object.mxxh[ll_cur]
			//			ls_xmmc = ads_datasource.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		END IF
		//干部保健根据zfbl判断是自费还是报销处理
		IF istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.gbbjdxbz >= '1' And as_ghfs <> 'TJ' THEN
			IF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' Or ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
				IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 0, ll_fyxh, ldc_zfbl, as_return) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
				IF This.of_get_gbbjzf( 1, ll_fyxh, ldc_zfbl, as_return) < 0 THEN RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF ldc_zfbl > 0 THEN
				ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ldc_zfbl
				ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_cur] = Round(ldc_ylfyze * ldc_zfbl,2)
				ldc_gbbjzf = ldc_gbbjzf + Round(ldc_ylfyze * ldc_zfbl,2) //ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				ads_datasource.Object.SPBZ[ll_cur] = 9
				IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
					ai_gbbj_insert ++
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.gbbjzf = ldc_gbbjzf
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.tsywlsh = as_fplsh
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.brbm = as_brbm
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.ywlx[ai_gbbj_insert] = ls_ywlx
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.YWLSH[ai_gbbj_insert] = ldc_ywlsh
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.mxlsh[ai_gbbj_insert] = ldc_ywmxxh
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.xmxh[ai_gbbj_insert] = ll_fyxh
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.zfje[ai_gbbj_insert] = Round(ldc_ylfyze * ldc_zfbl,2) //ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_row]
					astr_gbbj_tsmx.zfbl[ai_gbbj_insert] = ldc_zfbl
				END IF
			ELSE
				ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = ldc_zfbl
				ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_cur] = Round(ldc_ylfyze * ldc_zfbl,2)
			END IF
		ELSE //非干保都做自费处理		
			IF ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] <> 1 THEN
				ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = 1
				ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_cur] = ldc_ylfyze
			END IF
		END IF
		IF ib_ydzf THEN
			//			自费费用列表明细othfeelist 
			lsjson.setattribute('item_name',of_midstring(ls_xmmc,200)) //			item_name 项目名称String 200 Y
			lsjson.setattribute('det_item_fee_sumamt',String(ldc_ylfyze,'0.00')) //	det_item_fee_sumamt  明细项目费用总额String 18 Y  det_item_fee_sumamt = pric* cnt，需保留两位小数
			lsjson.setattribute('pric',String(ldc_fydj,'0.0000')) //	pric 项目单价String 18 Y
			lsjson.setattribute('cnt',String(ldc_fysl)) //	cnt 项目数量String 18 Y
			lsjson.setattribute('item_dscr','') //	item_dscr 项目说明String 200 N
			ls_data_zf[ll_bsc] = lsjson.getformatjson( '')
		END IF
		IF ai_jslx = 1 Or ib_ydzf THEN
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
			IF IsNull(as_jzid) THEN
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = as_fplsh // 就诊ID
			ELSE
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = as_jzid // 就诊ID
			END IF
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.brbm[ll_insert] = as_brbm // 住院号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = ls_ywlx // 业务类型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywlsh) // 费用明细流水号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywmxxh) // 原费用流水号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = as_fplsh // 医嘱号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = adt_fsrq // 费用发生时间
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] =  '' // 医疗目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_fyxh // 医药机构目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze // 明细项目费用总额
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YYSPBZ[ll_insert] = '0' // 医院审批标志
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SYFYBZ[ll_insert] = '0' // 生育费用标志
			IF ib_ydzf THEN
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = 'YDZF' + as_fplsh + '+' + String(ll_cur)
			ELSE
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = as_fplsh + '+' + String(ll_cur)
			END IF
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = '不上传明细'
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 9
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = 1 //6	selfpay_prop	自付比例	数值型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.QZFJE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze //7	fulamt_ownpay_amt	全自费金额	数值型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_insert] = '03' //11	chrgitm_lv	收费项目等级	字符型
			//				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLSFXMLB[ll_find_sc] = uf_getstring_in("med_chrgitm_type", ll_row) //12	med_chrgitm_type	医疗收费项目类别	字符型
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
adc_bscje = ldc_bscje
if ib_ydzf then
	as_data_zf = ls_data_zf
end if
IF ls_return > ''  THEN
	as_return = ',' + ls_return
	IF Not ib_ydzf THEN
		adc_gbbj = ldc_gbbjzf
		//全部为不上传明细
		IF ll_bsc = ll_rowCount THEN
			String ls_error
			IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
				This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, as_jzid, 'GH' + as_fplsh,DateTime(Date(adt_fsrq)), ls_error)
			ELSE
				This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, as_jzid, as_fplsh,DateTime(Date(adt_fsrq)), ls_error)
			END IF
			
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset( )
			RETURN 2
		ELSE
			RETURN 1
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 0


end function

return 1

public function integer of_handle_zyfymx_sfjl_sc (long al_zyh, string as_jzid, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_handle_zyfymx_sfjl_sc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:ids_zysfjl_sc表检索后，初步对表数据进行处理，以获得有可退数量的业务流水号
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_jzid 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.02.27    28271    ids_zysfjl_sc表检索后，初步对表数据进行处理，以获得有可退数量的业务流水号
//====================================================================

IF IsValid(ids_zysfjl_sc) = False THEN
	ids_zysfjl_sc = Create u_datastore
	ids_zysfjl_sc.setworktrans(itran_sqlca)
	IF ii_zyqy_qy = 1 or ii_zyqy_br = 1 THEN
		ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_zyhz'
	ELSE
		ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_hz'
	END IF
ELSE
	IF (ii_zyqy_qy = 1 or ii_zyqy_br = 1) And ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject <> 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_zyhz' THEN
		ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_zyhz'
	ELSEIF ii_zyqy_br = 0 And ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject <> 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_hz' THEN
		ids_zysfjl_sc.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_zyfymx_sfjl_hz'
	END IF
END IF
ids_zysfjl_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF ids_zysfjl_sc.Retrieve(al_zyh, as_jzid) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "检索已上传收费记录失败：" + ids_zysfjl_sc.is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_row, ll_rowCount, ll_find
Dec ldc_sl
String ls_yxmywlsh, ls_find

ll_rowCount = ids_zysfjl_sc.RowCount()
IF ll_rowCount <= 0 THEN RETURN 1

FOR ll_row = ll_rowCount To 1 Step -1
	
	ldc_sl = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_row]
	
	IF ldc_sl >= 0 THEN CONTINUE;
	
	// 根据退费记录，去寻找原业务流水号，并将数量减掉
	ls_yxmywlsh = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_row]
	ll_find = ids_zysfjl_sc.Find(" (YWLSH='"+ls_yxmywlsh+"') ", 1, ll_rowCount)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_find] = ids_zysfjl_sc.Object.SL[ll_find] + ldc_sl // ldc_sl为负数，故用+
	END IF
	
	// 剔除本条退费明细
	ids_zysfjl_sc.DeleteRow(ll_row)
	
NEXT
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_dzjspz_ch (string as_ywlx, string as_yyjgjzid, long al_jscs, string as_jylsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================

public function string uf_get_dzpjjylsh (string as_jylx, string as_yyjgjzid);//获取电子票据的交易流水号

IF ls_brly = 'SF' Then ls_brly = 'MZ'
IF ls_brly = 'ZY' Then
	SELECT jylsh Into :ls_dzpj_jylsh From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = :ls_brly and jylsh = :as_yyjgjzid And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) order by tjsj desc using this.itran_sqlca;

	SELECT jylsh Into :ls_dzpj_jylsh from (select * From bqxt.gy_dzpj Where brly = :ls_brly and jylsh like :as_yyjgjzid || '%' And (zfpb = 0 Or zfpb = -1) order by tjsj desc) where ROWNUM <= 1 using this.itran_sqlca;
END IF
return ls_dzpj_jylsh
end function
