IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	SELECT COUNT(1),Min(firstfplsh) Into :ll_count,:ls_fplshgl From  MZ_TPXX Where Y_FPLSH = :as_yyjgjzid;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN//若不是最后一次的发票则不进行上传处理
		ls_error = '需要传入最后一次发票流水号!'
		goto Error
	ELSE
		SELECT firstfplsh,TPXH Into :ls_fplshgl,:li_tpxh From MZ_TPXX Where NEWFPLSH = :as_yyjgjzid;
		IF li_tpxh = 1 THEN //发票重打
			SELECT Y_FPLSH Into :ls_fplshgl From MZ_TPXX Where firstfplsh = :ls_fplshgl And TPXH = 0 Order By TPRQ;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				ls_fplshgl = as_yyjgjzid
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_fplshgl) Or ls_fplshgl = '' THEN
		ls_fplshgl = as_yyjgjzid
	END IF
END IF

//若数据库不存在有效数据则直接返回删除成功
datetime ldt_scsj
IF as_jylx = 'SF' THEN
	select kpsj into :ldt_begin from mzxt.mz_fpk where fplsh = :ls_fplshgl Using this.itran_sqlca;
ELSEIF as_jylx = 'GH' THEN
	select ghrq into :ldt_begin from mzxt.mz_ghxx where ghlsh = :as_yyjgjzid Using this.itran_sqlca;
END IF
select count(1) into :ll_zdbrjyxxsc_count from JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSC where ywlx = :as_jylx and yyjgjzid = :as_yyjgjzid and kssj >= :ldt_begin and ztbz = 1 Using this.itran_sqlca;
IF ll_zdbrjyxxsc_count = 0 Then
	return 1
else

		update JKXT.ZHYB_ZFBRJYXXSC set ztbz = -1,memo = :ls_memo where ywlx = :as_jylx and yyjgjzid = :as_yyjgjzid and ztbz = 1 Using this.itran_sqlca;

public function boolean uf_fy_zfcx (integer ai_ywlx, long al_fyxh, long al_ypcd);//查询药品-费用是否要求自费
//ai_ywlx 1.全部，2.门诊，3.住院
Integer li_count

IF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :li_count FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ WHERE ZFBZ IN (1,2) AND FYXH = :al_fyxh AND YPCD = :al_ypcd AND JSSJ > SYSDATE USING sqlca;
	
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 3 THEN 
	
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :li_count FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ WHERE ZFBZ IN (1,3) AND FYXH = :al_fyxh AND YPCD = :al_ypcd AND JSSJ > SYSDATE USING sqlca;
	
ELSE 
	
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :li_count FROM JKXT.YB_TSDZ WHERE ZFBZ IN (1,2,3) AND FYXH = :al_fyxh AND YPCD = :al_ypcd AND JSSJ > SYSDATE USING sqlca;
	
END IF

IF li_count >= 1 THEN 
	
	Return True
ELSE 
	
	Return False
END IF
end function

				ELSEIF Pos(ls_zyqbnddbhgfljdm,ls_lbdm) > 0 THEN 
					ldc_dbzflj = ldc_dbzflj + ldc_ljz
				ELSEIF Pos(ls_zyqbndgbhgfljdm,ls_lbdm) > 0 THEN 
					ldc_gbhgflj = ldc_gbhgflj + ldc_ljz 
				END IF
				
			next 
		end if
	ELSE
		IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
		as_error = "[5206-人员累计信息查询]" + ls_cxrq + "时间段出错：" + as_error
	END IF
	
NEXT 

istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.zycsxl = ldc_zycs + 1 //住院次数算上本次 所以查询累计后的值 +1
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.zyqbndybflj = ldc_ybzflj
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.zyqbnddbhgflj = ldc_dbzflj
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.zyqbndgbhgflj  = ldc_gbhgflj
gf_waiting("获取病人住院前累计信息...", -1)
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_mz_jzbjy (decimal adc_jlxh, string as_czybm, ref string as_return);// 描述:【2203A】门诊就诊信息上传（补）

，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================
//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function date uf_getdate_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.data
type[li_find]
	if ls_datatype = 'd' then
		ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if

return date(left(ls_datavalue,10))
end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.Find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'", 1, ids_receive.RowCount())
IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDDHHMMSS--YYYYMMDDHH24MISS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF Not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,11,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,13,2)
			END IF
			//			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))		
			
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_original (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime_original()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为datetime类型)，返回发送时的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

//====================================================================


int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
datetime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_send_old.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'", 1, ids_send_old.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_send_old.object.datatype[li_find]
	choose case ls_datatype
//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		case 'dt'//日期格式为YYYYMMDD/HHNNSS/
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDDHHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_send_old.object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE				
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,11,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,13,2)
//				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))		
		case else
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			setnull(ldt_datavalue)
			return ldt_datavalue
	end choose
else
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ldt_datavalue)
	return ldt_datavalue
end if

end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal (string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'", 1, ids_receive.rowcount())
if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')')
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public subroutine uf_send_add (string as_name, date ad_datavalue);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send_add()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	datetime   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_row,li_len[],li_index
datetime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
li_index = of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_name)
if li_index = 0 then 
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
else
	//插入要发送的数据

	li_row = ids_send.find("dataname = '"+as_name+"'",1,ids_send.rowcount())

	ids_send.object.dataname[li_row] = as_name
	ids_send.object.datavalue[li_row] = string(ad_datavalue,'yyyymmdd')
end if
end subroutine

public subroutine uf_send_init (string as_xxtlx);//====================================================================
// 函数: uf_send_init()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	指明消息体类型，并清空datastore里的数据
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx	消息体类型
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.1.18
//====================================================================
ib_init_success = True
Int li_xhxh
DateTime ldt_server
String ls_datetime
ljson_send = Create sailjson
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
END IF
SELECT JKXT.SEQ_SYB_BWID_PXXH.Nextval,to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),sysdate Into :li_xhxh,:ls_datetime,:ldt_server From dual Using itran_sqlca;
if isnull(ls_datetime) or ls_datetime = '' or itran_sqlca.sqlcode <> 0 then
	if isnull(ls_datetime) then ls_datetime  =''
	is_error = '获取发送序列ID失败:' + string(itran_sqlca.sqlcode ) +  itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext + 'datetime:' + ls_datetime
	is_init_errormessage = is_error
	ib_init_success = False
	RETURN
end if
//is_jylsh = is_yljgdm + String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+String(Now(),'hhmmss')+Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
is_jylsh = is_yljgdm + ls_datetime + Right('0000'+String(li_xhxh),4)
is_xxtlx = as_xxtlx
ids_send.Reset()
ids_send_in.Reset()
ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
ids_structre.SetFilter( '')
ids_structre.Filter( )
istr_jytsrx.infno = is_xxtlx //1 infno 交易编号字符型4 Y 交易编号详见接口列表
istr_jytsrx.msgid = is_jylsh //2 msgid 发送方报文ID 字符型30 Y   协议机构编号+时间(14)+ 顺序号(4)时间格式：yyyyMMddHHmmss不可重复
istr_jytsrx.recer_sys_code = 'GXYTH' //3 recer_sys_code 接收方系统代码字符型10 Y用于多套系统接入，区分不同系统使用。一期建设默认传入“GXYTH”
istr_jytsrx.infver = is_bbh //4 infver 接口版本号字符型6 Y例如：“V1.0”，版本号由社保下发接口开发手册版本号为准。【需要设置参数】
//6 opter 经办人字符型30 Y 按要求传入经办人/终端编号
IF IsNull(base_info.UserID) Or base_info.UserID = '' or base_info.UserID ='9999' THEN
	istr_jytsrx.opter_type = '2'
	istr_jytsrx.opter = '9999'
ELSE
	istr_jytsrx.opter = base_info.UserID 
	istr_jytsrx.opter_type = '1' //5 opter_type 经办人类别字符型3 Y Y 1-经办人；2-自助终端；3-移动终端
END IF
//7 opter_name 经办人姓名字符型50 Y按要求传入经办人姓名/终端名称
IF IsNull(base_info.username) Or base_info.username = '' THEN
	SELECT YGXM Into :istr_jytsrx.opter_name From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :istr_jytsrx.opter Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	istr_jytsrx.opter_name = base_info.username 
END IF
IF IsNull(istr_jytsrx.opter_name) Or istr_jytsrx.opter_name = '' THEN
	istr_jytsrx.opter_name ='未知姓名'
end if
istr_jytsrx.inf_time = ldt_server //8 inf_time 交易时间  日期时间型20 Y 时间格式：yyyyMMddHHmmss
istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_code = is_yljgdm //9 fixmedins_code 协议机构编号字符型12 Y
istr_jytsrx.sign_no = is_jyzqh //10 sign_no 签到流水号字符型40 Y通过签到【9001】交易获取，除签到交易外不可为空。
istr_jytsrx.idfi_mode = '1'//11 idfi_mode 识别方式字符型3 Y 1- 实体社保卡；2-电子社保卡；3-身份证；暂时不支持身份证，后续会扩展



end subroutine

private function string of_numformat (datetime adt_datavalue, string as_datatype);

IF IsNull(adt_datavalue) THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF
CHOOSE CASE as_datatype
	CASE 'dta' //格式YYYY-MM-DD HHMMSS
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS')
		
	CASE 'dtb' //格式YYYY-MM-DD
		RETURN String(adt_datavalue,'YYYYMMDD')
		
	CASE ELSE
		RETURN ''
END CHOOSE



end function

public subroutine uf_send_add_in (string as_name, date ad_datavalue, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: uf_send_add_in()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	添加发送的内容
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string			as_name 	字段名
// 	value	date   	ad_datavalue	字段值
//    value long     al_row 行
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Long li_row
Int li_len[]
DateTime ldt_data

//返回对应的字段位置
//if of_get_index(is_xxtlx,'JG',as_name) = 0 then 
//	messagebox('信息窗口','字段名【'+as_name+'】非法')
//else
//插入要发送的数据

li_row = ids_send_in.Find("dataname = '"+as_name+"' and datarow="+String(al_row) +" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'",1,ids_send_in.RowCount())

uf_send_add_in_count(is_mxnr,al_row)
//end if

end subroutine

private function integer of_get_index (string as_jklx, string as_jkfl, string as_name);//====================================================================
// 函数: of_get_index()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	获取字段名所在的位置
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:	
// 	value	string	as_xxtlx   		消息体类型
// 	value	string	as_name	字段名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//====================================================================
ids_structre.SetFilter( "")
ids_structre.Filter( )
Long ll_find

ll_find = ids_structre.Find("Upper(jklx)='" + Upper(as_jklx) + "' and Upper(jkfl)='" + Upper(as_jkfl) + "' and Upper(mxnr)='" + Upper(as_name) + "'",1,999999)

IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_structre.Object.pxxh[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN 0
END IF
end function

public function date uf_getdate_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdate()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date类型)，返回接收到的值date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  date
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

//日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD
Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	IF ls_datatype = 'dtb' THEN
		ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
		IF Len(ls_datavalue) = 8 THEN
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回date类型('+as_name+')')
		SetNull(ls_datavalue)
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('字段名不存在('+as_name+')' + "行:" +String(al_row))
	SetNull(ls_datavalue)
END IF

RETURN Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10))

end function

public function datetime uf_getdatetime_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为date或datetime类型)，返回接收到的值datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	XUMS		日期: 2011.7.20
//====================================================================

Int li_find
String ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
DateTime ldt_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.Find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +String(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.RowCount())

IF li_find > 0 THEN
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_find]
	CHOOSE CASE ls_datatype
	//		case 'dt' //日期格式为YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
	//			ls_datavalue = trim(ids_receive.object.datavalue[li_find])
	//			return datetime(date(left(ls_datavalue,10)),time(right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dta' //日期格式为YYYYMMDDHHNNSS
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			IF not IsNumber ( Mid(ls_datavalue,5,1) ) THEN
				ls_datavalue = mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,6,2) + "-" + mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + " " + mid(ls_datavalue,12,2) + ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,15,2)+ ":" + mid(ls_datavalue,18,2)
			ELSE
				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,9,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,11,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,13,2)
//				ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2) + " " + Mid(ls_datavalue,10,2) + ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,12,2)+ ":" + Mid(ls_datavalue,14,2)
			END IF
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)),Time(Right(ls_datavalue,8)))
		CASE 'dtb' //日期格式为YYYYMMDD
			ls_datavalue = Trim(ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_find])
			ls_datavalue = Mid(ls_datavalue,1,4) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,5,2) + "-" + Mid(ls_datavalue,7,2)
			RETURN DateTime(Date(Left(ls_datavalue,10)))
		CASE ELSE
			gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回datetime类型('+as_name+')')
			SetNull(ls_datavalue)
			SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
			RETURN ldt_datavalue
	END CHOOSE
ELSE
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	SetNull(ldt_datavalue)
	RETURN ldt_datavalue
END IF



end function

public function decimal uf_getdecimal_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getdecimal()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为decimal)，返回接受到的值decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  decimal
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sz		日期: 2009.06.17
//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue
li_find = ids_receive_in.find("Upper(dataname) = '"+Upper (as_name)+"' and datarow=" +string(al_row)+" and datamxnr='"+is_mxnr+"'", 1, ids_receive_in.rowcount())

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]
	if ls_datatype >= 'da' and ls_datatype < 'dz' then
		ls_datavalue = ids_receive_in.object.datavalue[li_find]
	else
		gf_sblogmsg('数据类型不匹配,该函数只返回decimal类型('+as_name+')' +ls_datatype )
		setnull(ls_datavalue)
	end if
else
	gf_sblogmsg('消息体类型:'+is_xxtlx+'返回的数据,字段名不存在('+as_name+')')
	setnull(ls_datavalue)
end if
return dec(ls_datavalue)
end function

public function string uf_getstring_in (string as_name, long al_row);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_getstring()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据指定的字段名称(该字段必须为string)，返回string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_name

// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

//====================================================================

int li_find
string ls_datatype,ls_datavalue

if li_find > 0 then
	ls_datatype = ids_receive_in.object.datatype[li_find]

end function

public function boolean of_if_char (string as_string);Integer li_ds = 0,i
String ls_end

FOR i = 1 To Len(as_string)
	ls_end = Mid(as_string,i,1)
	IF Asc(ls_end) >= 33 And Asc(ls_end) <= 122 THEN li_ds ++
NEXT

IF Mod(li_ds,2) = 1 THEN
	RETURN False
ELSE
	RETURN True
END IF


end function

public function string of_midstring (string as_string, integer ai_len);
as_string = midw(mid(as_string,1,ai_len),1,ai_len)
RETURN as_string

end function

public function integer uf_get_psamid (ref string as_psamid);//====================================================================
//获取PSAM卡ID
//====================================================================
is_psamid = '100'
return 1
IF is_psamid > '' THEN
	as_psamid = is_psamid
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , 10)
	icc_config licc_config
	Long ll_hand
	Int li_ret
	SetNull(ll_hand)
	as_psamid = Space(38)

	li_ret = SIReaderInit(licc_config,ll_hand)
	IF li_ret <> 0 THEN
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	li_ret = SIGetPsamID(ll_hand,Ref  as_psamid)
	IF li_ret = 0 THEN
		is_psamid = as_psamid
		
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		
		RETURN 1
	ELSE
		as_psamid = Space(38)
		
		SIGetErrMessage (li_ret, as_psamid)
		SIReaderPowerOff(ll_hand)
		is_psamid = '00'
		gf_waiting("正在读取PSAM卡号...." , -1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
END IF

end function

public function integer of_splitparm (string as_parmstring, ref string as_parm[], string as_char);//功能：将以','作为分隔符的string型参数串as_parmstring分解成独立参数并放入变长数组
//      as_parm[](by ref)中.用于在窗口间传递多个参数
//参数：as_parmstring：以'as_char'作分隔符的多参数组成的字符串(要求原始的string型独立参数内不得含
//                     有','字符
//      as_parm[]：存放分解后的独立参数
//返回值：成功，返回变量个数；否则，返回 -1
Integer li_finger,li_start = 1,li_counter
IF as_parmstring = "" THEN RETURN -1
li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
DO WHILE li_finger > 0
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,li_finger - li_start)
	li_start = li_finger + 1
	li_finger = Posw(as_parmstring,as_char,li_start)
LOOP
IF li_start <= Lenw(as_parmstring) THEN
	li_counter ++
	as_parm[li_counter] = Midw(as_parmstring,li_start,Lenw(as_parmstring) - li_start +1)
END IF

RETURN li_counter

end function

public function integer uf_set_instance (ref string as_error);
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF
CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;
IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	gf_sblogmsg(as_error)
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

itran_sqlca = gtrans_temp_mssql
ibase_info = base_info


RETURN 1




end function

public function string of_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

Long		ll_pos ,ll_len

IF as_str = '' Or IsNull(as_str)Or	as_find = as_replace THEN RETURN as_str

ll_len = Lenw(as_replace)
ll_pos = 0
DO
	IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	END IF
	IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
		as_str = Replacew(as_str,ll_pos,Lenw(as_find),as_replace)
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
RETURN as_str


end function

public function string of_replace_string (string as_string);//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'^','&caret;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'|','&brvbar;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'~~','&tilde;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'$$','&dollar;')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"'",'')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"\",'\\\\')
as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'"','\"')
RETURN as_string

end function

li_mxnr_sl = 0
li_start = 1
li_jdnum = of_get_sendin_mxnr_count() //节点数
FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdnum
	ls_xmsm[li_jd] = of_get_sendin_mxnr(li_jd) //获取节点
	ids_send_in.SetFilter("")
	ids_send_in.Filter()
	ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+ls_xmsm[li_jd]+"'",1,9999999)
	li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'QQ' ,ls_xmsm[li_jd]) //36 11
	li_mxnr_sl += li_bound
	li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
	FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count
		lsjson2[ll_row] = Create sailjson
		FOR li_i = li_start To li_mxnr_sl
			ls_dataname = 	This.of_get_sendin_mc( as_jklx, 'QQ',li_i)
			ls_datavalue = This.of_get_sendin_value(ls_dataname,ll_row)
			lsjson2[ll_row].setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
		NEXT
		ls_data[ll_row] = lsjson2[ll_row].getformatjson('')
	NEXT
	li_start = li_mxnr_sl +1 //第二个节点 在第一个节点的最大pxxh 开始
	IF of_get_xhcs(as_jklx,'QQ',ls_xmsm[li_jd]) THEN //判断是否是数组
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], ls_data)
		ib_sz = True
	ELSE
		lsjson.setattribute(ls_xmsm[li_jd], lsjson2[1])
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN  lsjson




end function

end function

public function boolean of_get_sendin (string as_jklx, ref sailjson as_json, ref string as_msg, string as_mxnr);Integer li_bound,li_i,li_count
Long ll_find,ll_row,ll_num
String ls_dataname,ls_dataformat,ls_datavalue,ls_data[]
Dec ldc_datavalue
as_msg = ''
sailjson ls_json,ls_json_exp_content
ls_json = Create sailjson
ls_json_exp_content = Create sailjson
IF ids_send_in.RowCount() <= 0 THEN
	as_msg = ''
	RETURN True
END IF
ll_num = ids_send_in.Find("dataname='datacount' and datamxnr='"+as_mxnr+"'",1,9999999)
IF ll_num <= 0  THEN
	as_msg = '找不到明细内容【'+as_mxnr+'】的datacount行'
	RETURN False
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count( as_jklx, 'JG' )
li_count = ids_send_in.Object.datarow[ll_num]
//串联所有的消息体
FOR ll_row = 1 To li_count
	ls_json.SetNull()
	FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
		ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_mc[li_i]
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) // ls_format[li_i]
		//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
		ll_find = ids_send_in.Find("datamxnr='"+as_mxnr+"'" + " and dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"' and datarow =" +String(ll_row), 1, ids_send_in.RowCount())
		IF ll_find < 1 THEN
			as_msg = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】行:' + String(ll_row)
			RETURN False
		END IF
		ids_send_in.Object.DataType[ll_find] = ls_dataformat
		ls_datavalue = ids_send_in.Object.datavalue[ll_find]
		IF li_count=1 and isnull(ls_datavalue) Then continue;
		if  ls_dataformat = 'json' then
		else
			ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
		end if	
		ls_dataformat = This.of_get_jklx_format( as_jklx, 'JG',li_i ) //ls_format[li_i]
		CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
			CASE 's','d','dt','json'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
			CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
				IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN
					ls_datavalue = '0'
				ELSE
					ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
				END IF
		END CHOOSE
		IF ls_dataformat = 'json' and ls_datavalue>"" THEN
			ls_json_exp_content.parse_sb(ls_datavalue)
			ls_json.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_json_exp_content)
		ELSE
			ls_json.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
		END IF
	NEXT
	ls_data[ll_row] = ls_json.getformatjson('')
	
	IF of_Get_xhcs(is_xxtlx,'QQ',as_mxnr) THEN //of_Get_xhcs(as_jklx,'JG') THEN
		ib_sz = True
		as_json.setattribute(as_mxnr, ls_data)
	ELSE
		as_json.setattribute(as_mxnr, ls_json)
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN True





end function

public function boolean of_receive_data (string as_xxtlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);TRY
	//返回数据的判断
	IF IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '' THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson,lsjson2,lsjson_a,lsjson_a2
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson.parse_sb(as_xxt)
	Int li_jdcount,li_jd,li_row,li_rec
	Decimal li_datavalue
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr
	Any lany_return[]
	Boolean lb_xht = False,lb_xhcs
	Long ll_xhcs
	//分解社保直接返回的消息体
	ids_receive_in.Reset()
	ids_receive.Reset()
	ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
	li_rec = of_receive_head(lsjson,as_return)
	IF li_rec < 0 THEN
		IF li_rec = -2 THEN
			as_return = as_xxt
		END IF
		RETURN False
	END IF
	IF This.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
		as_return = '医保交易失败！'+This.uf_getstring('err_msg')
		RETURN False
	END IF
	
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',1 ) = '无' THEN //接口没有返回值
		RETURN True
	END IF
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mxcd(as_xxtlx,'YD',1 ) = -1 THEN //接口没有节点
		lany_return = lsjson.getattribute('output')
		IF UpperBound(lany_return) > 0 THEN
			IF Not IsValid(lsjson2) THEN
				lsjson2 = Create sailjson
				lsjson2.setattribute( This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(as_xxtlx, 'YD', 1), lany_return)
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_return = '无返回数据!'
			RETURN False
		END IF
	ELSE
		lsjson2 = lsjson.getattribute('output')
	END IF
	//li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count_data(is_xxtlx,'YD') //data部分蜠AT*

	li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD')
	IF li_jdcount > 0 THEN
		FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount
			ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd )
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				lb_xht = True
			ELSE
				lb_xhcs = False
				ll_xhcs = 0
				lb_xhcs = of_get_xhcs_value(as_xxtlx, 'YD', This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd), ll_xhcs)
				IF Not lb_xhcs THEN ll_xhcs = 0
				IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
					IF Not IsValid(lsjson_a2) THEN
						lsjson_a2 = lsjson2
					END IF
				ELSE
					IF Not IsValid(lsjson_a) THEN
						lsjson_a = lsjson2.getattribute( 'data')
					END IF
				END IF
				li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
				IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
					IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
						ls_datavalue = lsjson_a2.getattribute(ls_dataname)
					ELSE
						ls_datavalue = lsjson_a.getattribute(ls_dataname)
					END IF
				ELSE
					IF ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
						li_datavalue = lsjson_a2.getattribute(ls_dataname)
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
					ELSE
						li_datavalue = lsjson_a.getattribute(ls_dataname)
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
					END IF
				END IF
				ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
				ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
				ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF lb_xht THEN li_rec = of_receivein_data(as_xxtlx,lsjson2,as_return)
		IF li_rec = -1 THEN
			RETURN False
		END IF
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
RETURN True

end function

public function string of_get_ip ();String ls_computer,ls_ip
Blob{4} lb_hostaddress
//获取IP
GetHost(ls_computer, lb_hostaddress)
ls_ip = String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,1,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,2,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,3,1)))) + "."
ls_ip += String(Asc(String(BlobMid(lb_hostaddress,4,1))))

return ls_ip
end function

public function string of_getmac ();//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl.of_getmac()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取本机mac地址
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//====================================================================
string ls_mac
int li_pos 
ls_mac = getlocalmac()
li_pos = pos(ls_mac,':',1)
do while li_pos>0
	ls_mac = replace(ls_mac,li_pos,1,"-")
	li_pos = pos(ls_mac,':',li_pos+1)
loop
return ls_mac
end function

end function

public function integer of_receivein_data (string as_xxtlx, sailjson as_xxt, ref string as_return);Int li_row,li_i,li_jd,li_xh,li_mxnr_sl,li_jdcount,li_start, li_upperBound
decimal li_datavalue
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr,ls_jdname,ls_jgdm,ls_classname
sailjson lsjson[], lJson_data
Any lany_return[], laArr_data[],la_data
boolean lb_exists

li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(is_xxtlx,'YD')
FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount //节点数
	ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
	ls_mxnr = This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
	//加一条明细条数
	li_start = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
	ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_start] = '0'
	ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = 0
	ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_start] = 'datacount'
	ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_start] = ls_mxnr
	//
	IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN //不为data的节点
		IF of_get_xhcs(is_xxtlx,'YD',ls_mxnr) THEN //是数组
		   if ib_ydzf then
				la_data = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr,lb_exists)
				IF Not lb_exists THEN
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			end if
			ls_classname= classname(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr))  //20220130zbq
			if isnull(ls_classname) then 
				as_return='无返回数据'
				return -1
			end if
			lany_return = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr)
			ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			li_mxnr_sl = This.of_get_jklx_count(ls_jgdm,'JG') //获取节点内的参数数量
			FOR li_xh = 1 To UpperBound(lany_return) //循环数组内的次数
				ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = li_xh
				lsjson[li_xh] = lany_return[li_xh]
				FOR li_i = 1 To li_mxnr_sl
					li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
					ls_jdname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i )
					IF This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
						
						ls_datavalue = String(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname))
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(ls_datavalue))
					ELSE
						IF isnull(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname)) Then
							setnull(li_datavalue)
						ELSE
							li_datavalue = Dec(lsjson[li_xh].getattribute(ls_jdname))
						END IF
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(li_datavalue))
					END IF
				NEXT
			NEXT
		ELSE //不是数组
			ls_classname= classname(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr))  //gqj
			if isnull(ls_classname) then continue
			lsjson[li_jd] = as_xxt.getattribute(ls_mxnr)
			ls_jgdm = This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			li_mxnr_sl = This.of_get_jklx_count(ls_jgdm,'JG')
			ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_start] = 1
			FOR li_i = 1 To li_mxnr_sl
				li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
				ls_jdname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i )
				IF This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ),2) = 'dt' THEN
					ls_datavalue = String(lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname))
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
					ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
				//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(ls_datavalue))
				ELSEIF This.of_get_jklx_format( ls_jgdm,'JG',li_i ) = 'json' Then
					IF this.of_get_xhcs(ls_jgdm, 'JG') THen  // json数组
						li_upperBound = lsjson[li_jd].getArray(ls_jdname, ref laArr_data)
						IF li_upperBound>0 Then
							For li_xh=1 to li_upperBound Step 1
								IF li_xh<>1 Then li_row = ids_receive_in.InsertRow(0)
								lJson_data = laArr_data[li_xh]
								IF isnull(lJson_data) Then
									ls_datavalue = ''
								ELSE
									ls_datavalue = lJson_data.getformatjson('')
								END IF
								ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
								ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
								ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
								ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
								ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = li_xh
							Next
						END IF
					ELSE
						lJson_data = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)
						IF isnull(lJson_data) Then
							ls_datavalue = ''
						ELSE
							ls_datavalue = lJson_data.getformatjson('')
						END IF
						ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
						ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
						ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
						ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
						ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
					END IF
				ELSE
					IF isnull(lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)) Then
						setnull(li_datavalue)
					ELSE
						li_datavalue = lsjson[li_jd].getattribute(ls_jdname)
					END IF
					ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i))
					ids_receive_in.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_jdname
					ids_receive_in.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
					ids_receive_in.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(ls_jgdm, 'JG', li_i)
					ids_receive_in.Object.datamxnr[li_row] = ls_mxnr
					ids_receive_in.Object.datarow[li_row] = 1
				//	MessageBox(ls_jdname,String(li_datavalue))
				END IF
			NEXT
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer of_receive_head (sailjson as_xxt, ref string as_return);Int li_row,li_bound,li_i,li_datavalue
String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue
Any lany_rec
Boolean lb_exists

//infcode	紻AT*

//inf_refmsgid	接收方报文 ID： 接收方返回 ，接收方系统区划代码(6)+时间(14)+流水号(10)  时间格式： yyyyMMddHHmmss
//refmsg_time	接收报文时间   格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS
//respond_time	响应报文时间   格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS
//err_msg	错误信息    交易失败状态下，业务返回的错误信息
//warn_msg	提示信息		交易成功状态下，业务返回的提示信息
//output	交易输出
lany_rec = as_xxt.getattribute('infcode',lb_exists)
IF Not lb_exists THEN
	RETURN -2
END IF
IF String(lany_rec) <> '0' THEN //Or as_xxt.getattribute('infcode') = ''
	as_return = String(as_xxt.getattribute('err_msg'))
	RETURN -1
END IF
li_bound = of_get_jklx_count('0000','YD')
FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
	li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
	ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc( '0000','YD',li_i )
	IF ls_dataname = '' Or IsNull(ls_dataname) THEN
		as_return = "0000应答不存在序号为"+String(li_i)+"的mxnr"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	IF This.of_get_jklx_format( '0000','YD',li_i ) = 's' THEN
		ls_datavalue = String(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname))
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( '0000', 'YD',li_i )
		//MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(ls_datavalue))
	ELSE
		li_datavalue = Dec(as_xxt.getattribute(ls_dataname))
		ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
		ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = String(li_datavalue)
		ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format( '0000', 'YD',li_i )
		//MessageBox(ls_dataname,String(li_datavalue))
	END IF
	IF ls_dataname = 'infcode' And li_datavalue <> 0 THEN
		as_return = String(as_xxt.getattribute('err_msg'))
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
NEXT
RETURN 1




end function

public function boolean of_receive_data_yd (string as_xxtlx, string as_xxt, ref string as_return);TRY
	//返回数据的判断
	IF IsNull(as_xxt) Or Trim(as_xxt) = '' THEN
		as_return = '医保没有返回数据'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson //lsjson2,lsjson_a
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson.parse_sb(as_xxt)
	//分解社保直接返回的消息体
	ids_receive_in.Reset()
	ids_receive.Reset()
	ids_receive_mxnr.Reset()
	
	
	Int li_jdcount,li_jd,li_row,li_rec
	Decimal li_datavalue
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_mxnr
	Any lany_return[],la_data
	Boolean lb_xht = False,lb_exists
	
//   lsjson2 = lsjson.getattribute('output')
	//li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count_data(is_xxtlx,'YD') //data部分无循环
	li_jdcount = This.of_get_jklx_count(as_xxtlx,'YD')
	IF li_jdcount > 0 THEN
		FOR li_jd = 1 To li_jdcount
			ls_dataname  = This.of_get_jklx_mc(as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd )
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				lb_xht = True
			ELSE
				li_row = ids_receive.InsertRow(0)
				la_data = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname,lb_exists) 
				if not lb_exists then
					setnull(ls_datavalue)
				else
					IF isnull(la_data) Then
						IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
							ls_datavalue = ''
						else
							ls_datavalue = of_numformat(0,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))
						end if
					ELSE						
						IF This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ) = 's' Or Left(This.of_get_jklx_format( as_xxtlx,'YD',li_jd ),2) = 'dt' THEN
							ls_datavalue = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname)
						ELSE
							ls_datavalue = lsjson.getattribute(ls_dataname)
							li_datavalue = dec(ls_datavalue)
							ls_datavalue = of_numformat(li_datavalue,This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd))

					  END IF
					end if
				end if
				ids_receive.Object.dataname[li_row] =  ls_dataname
				ids_receive.Object.datavalue[li_row] = ls_datavalue
				ids_receive.Object.DataType[li_row] = This.of_get_jklx_format(as_xxtlx, 'YD', li_jd)
			END IF
		NEXT
		IF lb_xht THEN li_rec = of_receivein_data(as_xxtlx,lsjson,as_return)
		if li_rec = -1 then 
			return false
		end if
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
RETURN True
end function

public function string of_replace_sb (string as_string);
/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,"\",'\\\\')
//as_string = of_replacestr(as_string,'"','\"')
Long	ll_pos ,ll_len,ll_pos1,ll_pos2
String ls_find
ll_pos1 = posw(as_string,'\\\\')
ll_pos2 = posw(as_string,'\"')
IF ll_pos1 > 0 Or ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
	IF ll_pos1 = 0 THEN
		ls_find = '\"'
		ll_len = 1
		DO
			IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, 1 )
			ELSE
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
			END IF
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos,Lenw(ls_find),'"')
			END IF
		LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
	ELSE
		ll_pos = 0
		ls_find = '\\\\'
		ll_len = 1
		DO
			IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, 1 )
			ELSE
				ll_pos = Posw(as_string , ls_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
			END IF
			ll_pos1 = ll_pos
			IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
				as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos,Lenw(ls_find),'\')
				IF ll_pos2 > 0 And ll_pos1 > ll_pos2 THEN
					DO
						IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
							as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos2,2,'"')
						END IF
						ll_pos2 = Posw(as_string , '\"', ll_pos2 + 1 )						
					LOOP WHILE ll_pos2 > 0 and ll_pos2 < ll_pos
				END IF
				ll_pos2 = posw(as_string,'\"' , ll_pos + ll_len)
			END IF
		LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
		IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
			DO
				IF ll_pos2 > 0 THEN
					as_string = Replacew(as_string,ll_pos2,Lenw(ls_find),'"')
				END IF
				ll_pos2 = Posw(as_string , '\"', ll_pos2 + 1 )
			LOOP WHILE ll_pos2 > 0
		END IF
	END IF
END IF



RETURN as_string




end function

public function boolean uf_send (ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 函数: u_ybjk.uf_send()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:	根据uf_get_structore里的顺序，把datastore里的值串起来，并发送出去
//			如果该字段为数值型，如果没有传递过来值，腄AT*
0
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string	as_return	错误信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	gsbx		日期: 2024.07.16
//====================================================================
//在这里判断初始化是否成功uf_send_init
IF ib_init_success = False THEN
	as_return = is_init_errormessage
	RETURN False
END IF
IF IsNull(is_xxtlx) Or is_xxtlx = '' THEN
	as_return = '消息体类型为空'
	RETURN False
END IF
TRY
	ib_sz = False
	Int li_i,li_bound,li_find
	String ls_dataname,ls_datavalue,ls_dataformat,ls_send,ls_recieve,ls_mxnr, ls_temp
	Long ll_xhcs
	Boolean lb_xhcs
	sailjson ls_json_exp_content
	ls_json_exp_content = Create sailjson
	ls_send = ''
	IF Not IsValid(ljson_send) THEN
		ljson_send = Create sailjson
	END IF
	ljson_send.SetNull( )
	ljson_send.setattribute('infno', Upper(istr_jytsrx.infno) )
	ljson_send.setattribute('msgid', istr_jytsrx.msgid )
	ljson_send.setattribute('Recer_sys_code', istr_jytsrx.recer_sys_code )//接收方系统代码（用于多套系统接入 ，区分不同系统使用。一期建设默认传入“GXYTH”）
	ljson_send.setattribute('infver', istr_jytsrx.infver )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter_type', istr_jytsrx.opter_type )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter', istr_jytsrx.opter  )
	ljson_send.setattribute('opter_name', istr_jytsrx.opter_name)
	ljson_send.setattribute('inf_time', String(istr_jytsrx.inf_time,'yyyymmddhhmmss')) //时间格式：yyyyMMddHHmmss
	ljson_send.setattribute('fixmedins_code', istr_jytsrx.fixmedins_code)
	IF is_xxtlx = '9001'  THEN
		istr_jytsrx.sign_no = ''
	ELSE
		istr_jytsrx.sign_no = is_jyzqh
	END IF
	ljson_send.setattribute('sign_no', istr_jytsrx.sign_no)
	ljson_send.setattribute('idfi_mode', istr_jytsrx.idfi_mode)
	//以下拼接报文是12 input
	Integer li_ret 
	li_bound = This.of_get_jklx_count( is_xxtlx, 'QQ')
	IF li_bound = 0 THEN
		as_return = '【' + is_xxtlx + '】未维护对应的接口明细'
		RETURN False
	END IF
	sailjson lsjson ,lsjson_data
	lsjson = Create sailjson
	lsjson_data = Create sailjson
	//串联所有的消息体
	IF This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', 1) = '无' THEN //5101
	ELSE
		FOR li_i = 1 To li_bound
			ls_dataname = This.of_get_jklx_mc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
			IF ls_dataname = '循环体' THEN
				ls_mxnr = This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i)
				IF of_get_sendin( This.of_get_jklx_jgdm(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i),lsjson, as_return,ls_mxnr) = False THEN
					RETURN False
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_dataformat =  This.of_get_jklx_format(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i) //ls_format[li_i]
				//判断是否缺指定位置的字段
				li_find = ids_send.Find( "dataname = '"+ls_dataname+"'", 1, ids_send.RowCount())
				IF li_find < 1 THEN
					IF ls_dataformat = 'da' Or ls_dataformat = 'db' Or ls_dataformat = 'dc' Or ls_dataformat = 'dd' Or ls_dataformat = 'de' Or &
						ls_dataformat = 'df' Or ls_dataformat = 'dg' Or ls_dataformat = 'dh' Or ls_dataformat = 'di' Or ls_dataformat = 'dj' Or &
						ls_dataformat = 'dk' Or ls_dataformat = 'dl' Or ls_dataformat = 'dm' Or ls_dataformat = 'dn' THEN
						li_find = ids_send.InsertRow(0)
						ids_send.Object.dataname[li_find] = ls_dataname
						ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find] = '0'
					ELSE
						as_return = '找不到字段名【'+ls_dataname+'】'
						RETURN False
					END IF
				END IF
				ids_send.Object.DataType[li_find] = ls_dataformat
				ls_datavalue = ids_send.Object.datavalue[li_find]
				
				IF  ls_dataformat = 'json' Or ls_dataformat = 'jsons' THEN
				ELSE
					if is_xxtlx = '3202' and ls_dataname = 'file_qury_no' then
					else
						ls_datavalue = of_replace_string(ls_datavalue)
					end if
				END IF
				
				CHOOSE CASE ls_dataformat
					CASE 's','d','dt','json'
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
					CASE 'da','db','dc','dd','de','df','dg','dh','di','dj','dk','dl','dm','dn'
						ls_datavalue = of_numformat(Dec(ls_datavalue),ls_dataformat)
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = '0'
					CASE ELSE
						IF IsNull(ls_datavalue) THEN ls_datavalue = ''
				END CHOOSE
				lb_xhcs = of_get_xhcs_value(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', This.of_get_jklx_oldmc(is_xxtlx, 'QQ', li_i), ll_xhcs)
				IF lb_xhcs And ll_xhcs = -1 THEN
					lsjson.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
				ELSE
					IF ls_dataformat = 'json' And ls_datavalue > "" THEN
						ls_json_exp_content.parse_sb(ls_datavalue)
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_json_exp_content)
					ELSEIF ls_dataformat = 'jsons' THEN
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, "")
						ls_temp = ls_datavalue
					ELSE
						lsjson_data.setattribute(ls_dataname, ls_datavalue)
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF lsjson_data.getformatjson('') = '{}' THEN
	ELSE
		lsjson.setattribute( 'data',lsjson_data)
	END IF
	
	ljson_send.setattribute( 'input',lsjson)
	IF ib_sz THEN
		ls_send = ljson_send.getformatjson('',True)
	ELSE
		ls_send = ljson_send.getformatjson('')
	END IF	
//	// JSON 数组暂时使用
//	IF is_xxtlx = '3101' Or is_xxtlx = '3102' THEN
//		Integer li_pos
//		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, "patient_dtos")
//		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, ":", li_pos)
//		ls_send = Left(ls_send, li_pos) + ls_temp + Right(ls_send, Len(ls_send) - (li_pos+2))
//		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, "rule_ids")
//		li_pos = Pos(ls_send, ":", li_pos)
//		ls_send = Left(ls_send, li_pos) + "null" + Right(ls_send, Len(ls_send) - (li_pos+2))
//	END IF	
	is_send = ls_send
	IF IsValid(lsjson) THEN  Destroy lsjson
	IF IsValid(lsjson_data) THEN Destroy lsjson_data
	IF IsNull(ls_send) Or ls_send = '' THEN
		as_return = '发送的消息体为空'
		RETURN False
	END IF	
	gf_sblog('c:\gslog','接口号：['+ Upper(is_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  发送:'+ls_send )
	ls_recieve = Space(1024 * 32)
	li_ret = Si_Busi(ls_send,ls_recieve)	//	成功：返回 0  ；  失败 ：非 0
	gf_sblog('c:\gslog','接口号：['+ Upper(is_xxtlx)+']发送序列ID:' + is_jylsh +'  返回:'+ls_recieve )
	IF li_ret <> 0  or isnull(li_ret) THEN
		as_return = ls_recieve
		RETURN False
	END IF
Catch(runtimeerror er2)
	as_return = er2.Text
	RETURN False
END TRY
//把当前发送的内容转移掉
ids_send_old.Reset()
ids_send.RowsCopy( 1, ids_send.RowCount(), primary!, ids_send_old, 1, primary!)
RETURN of_receive_data(is_xxtlx,ls_recieve,as_return)
end function

public function boolean of_gs_init (ref string as_error);String ls_InData
Integer li_ret
gf_waiting("工伤初始化。。。。。。",10)
is_init_date = String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')
ls_InData = Space(3000)
gf_waiting("工伤初始化。。。。。。",30)
li_ret = Si_INIT(ref ls_InData)
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	gf_waiting("工伤初始化错误：",-1)
	as_error = '工伤初始化错误：' + ls_InData
	RETURN False
END IF

return true


end function

public function string of_get_dmmc (string as_dmlb, string as_dmsb);//====================================================================

//--------------------------------------------------------------------

// 	string	as_dmsb	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.18
//====================================================================
long ll_find

ll_find = ids_dmzd_jk.find("dmlb='" + as_dmlb + "' and dmsb = '" +as_dmsb + "'",1,999999)
if ll_find > 0 then
	return ids_dmzd_jk.object.dmmc[ll_find]
else
	return '无'
end if
end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsb (string as_table, string as_dmlb, integer ai_dmsb);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_dzdmsb()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string 	as_table	
// 	value	string 	as_dmlb 	
// 	value	integer	ai_dmsb 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.18    28271  获取 GY_DMZD_ZD表 中的对照结果
//====================================================================

IF Upper(as_table) <> 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and dmlb=" + String(as_dmlb) + " and dmsb ="+String(ai_dmsb),1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmsb_dz[ll_find]
ELSE
	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

IF ll_find > 0 THEN

	RETURN '无'
END IF

end function

public function string of_get_dzdmsbmc (string as_table, string as_tjlxh);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_dzdmsbmc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取医保名称
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_table	
// 	value	string	as_tjlxh	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.17    28271  获取医保名称
//====================================================================

IF Upper(as_table) = 'GY_DMZD' THEN
	RETURN ''
END IF

Long ll_find,ll_jlxh
ll_find = ids_dmzd_dz.Find("Upper(tname)='" + Upper(as_table) + "' and Upper(tjlxh)='" + Upper(as_tjlxh) + "'",1,999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	IF ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] > '' THEN
		RETURN ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find]
	ELSE
		String ls_dmmc
		CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
			CASE 'GY_KSDM'
				ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
				SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'MZ_KS'
				SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
			CASE 'YK_YPSX'
				SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		END CHOOSE
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tname[ll_find] = Upper(as_table)
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.tjlxh[ll_find] = as_tjlxh
		ids_dmzd_dz.Object.dmmc[ll_find] = ls_dmmc
		RETURN ls_dmmc
	END IF
ELSE
	CHOOSE CASE Upper(as_table)
		CASE 'GY_KSDM'
			ll_jlxh = long(as_tjlxh)
			SELECT KSMC Into :ls_dmmc From GY_KSDM Where KSDM = :ll_jlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'MZ_KS'
			SELECT mc Into :ls_dmmc From mz_ks Where ksbm = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE 'YK_YPSX'
			SELECT SXMC Into :ls_dmmc From YPXT.YK_YPSX Where YPSX = :as_tjlxh Using itran_sqlca;
		CASE else
			ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	END CHOOSE
	If ISNULL(ls_dmmc) as_yyjgjzid
ljson_data
li_return_code
ll_rowcount
in_wscommon
n_wscommon
uf_connect_sqlca_temp
临时事务创建失败
setattribute
getformatjson
QueryBillInfo
uf_doaction
elec_billno_code
getattribute
elec_bill_code
elec_bill_chkcode
istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl
is_yljgxzqh

dd_zhyb_dwcy

THEN ls_dmmc = 'NULL'
	RETURN ls_dmmc
END IF

end function

public function integer of_get_gjbm (string as_bmlx, string as_ybbm, ref string as_gjbm);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_gjbm = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_gjm = '',ls_gjm_temp,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,ls_dzgh
ls_gjm_temp = as_gjbm
IF as_bmlx = 'YSBM' THEN
	IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
		//IF of_get_ygxm(as_ybbm,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,True,as_gjbm) < 0 THEN
		//	as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败：' + as_gjbm
		//	RETURN -1
		//END IF
	END IF
	Long ll_find,ll_find_dz
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+as_ybbm+"'",1,99999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ls_dzgh =  ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
		IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN //如果有对照取对照，没有就取本身
			ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+ls_dzgh+"'",1,99999)
			IF ll_find_dz >  0 THEN
				ll_find = ll_find_dz
				as_ybbm = ls_dzgh
			END IF
		END IF
		ls_gjm = Trim(ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find])
		IF IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN ls_gjm = ''
	ELSE
		//IF of_get_ygxm(as_ybbm,ls_ygxm,ls_sfzh,True,as_gjbm) < 0 THEN
		//	as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败：' + as_gjbm
			//RETURN -1
		//ELSE
			ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+as_ybbm+"'",1,99999)
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				as_gjbm = '获取医师信息失败2：' + as_ybbm
				RETURN -1
			else
				ls_dzgh =  ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
				IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN //如果有对照取对照，没有就取本身
					ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm = '"+ls_dzgh+"'",1,99999)
					IF ll_find_dz >  0 THEN
						ll_find = ll_find_dz
						as_ybbm = ls_dzgh
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
	//	END IF
		ls_gjm = ''
	END IF
	
	IF ls_gjm = '' Or IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN
		SELECT gjybdm Into :ls_gjm From xtgl.gy_ygdm_kz Where ygdm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 And itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 100 THEN
			as_gjbm = as_ybbm + '，获取国家码失败：' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			IF IsNull(ls_gjm) Or ls_gjm = '' THEN
				ls_gjm = 'NULL'
				as_gjbm = ''
				//					as_gjbm = as_ybbm + '，未维护对应的国家码！'
				//					RETURN 0
			ELSE
				as_gjbm = Trim(ls_gjm)
			END IF
		END IF
		ids_ygdm.Object.gjybdm[ll_find] = Trim(ls_gjm)
	ELSE
		IF ls_gjm = 'NULL' Or ls_gjm = '' Or IsNull(ls_gjm) THEN
			as_gjbm = ''
		ELSE
			as_gjbm = Trim(ls_gjm)
		END IF
	END IF
	//ELSEIF as_bmlx = 'SFXM' THEN
	//	IF Left(as_ybbm,1) = '1' Or as_ybbm = '2' THEN
	//		SELECT GJYPBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_ypml Where zxbzbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	ELSEIF Left(as_ybbm,1) = '6' THEN
	//		SELECT GJYBBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_clml Where zxtymbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	ELSE
	//		SELECT GJYBBM Into:ls_gjm From JKXT.yb_zlml Where zxtymbm = :as_ybbm Using itran_sqlca;
	//	END IF
	//	IF ls_gjm > '' THEN
	//		as_gjbm = ls_gjm
	//		RETURN 1
	//	ELSEif ls_gjm_temp > '' then
	//		as_gjbm = ls_gjm_temp
	//		RETURN 0
	//	else
	//		as_gjbm =   '取不到对应的国家编码(' + as_ybbm + ")"
	//		RETURN -1
	//	END IF
ELSE
	as_gjbm = '未定义的类型：' + as_bmlx
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function long of_get_jbxx (integer ai_yplx, long al_ypxh, long al_ypcd, string as_ywlx, datetime adt_jfrq, ref string as_xmzxbh_ts, ref integer ai_tsdz, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_jbxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer 	ai_yplx     	
// 	value    	long    	al_ypxh     	
// 	value    	long    	al_ypcd     	
// 	value    	string  	as_ywlx     	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jfrq    	
// 	reference	string  	as_xmzxbh_ts	
// 	reference	integer 	ai_tsdz     	
// 	reference	string  	as_error    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  long
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.20
//====================================================================

as_xmzxbh_ts = ''
ai_tsdz = 0
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_sql
IF Not IsValid(ids_typk) THEN
	ids_typk = Create U_datastore
	ids_typk.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,'' as GJYBBM,YK_TYPK.YPJL,YK_TYPK.JLDW,YK_TYPK.YFGG,YK_TYPK.BFGG,"+&
		" YK_TYPK.BFDW,YK_TYPK.YFDW,YK_TYPK.ZJPB,YK_TYPK.TYPE,YK_TYPK.ZXDW,YK_TYPK.KZYP,0 AS LBTSDZ,0 AS YPCD,0 AS TSDZ,0 as wgyp,'' as YLMLBM,'' as YLJGMLBM,'' AS MEMO,'' AS MLLB,'' AS SYFYBZ," +&
		" to_date('1900-01-01','yyyy/mm/dd') AS MLKSRQ, to_date('2099-12-31','yyyy/mm/dd') AS MLJSRQ, '' as SFLB, '' as ybmlmc, '' as ybmldj, '' as YPMC "+&
		" FROM YPXT.YK_TYPK "
	IF ids_typk.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'药品信息'对象失败("+ids_typk.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
IF Not IsValid(ids_ylsf) THEN
	ids_ylsf = Create U_datastore
	ids_ylsf.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ls_sql = " SELECT FYXH,GJYBBM,fymc,fydw,FYGB,0 AS KZPB,0 AS TSDZ,0 AS LBTSDZ,0 as wgyp,'' as YLMLBM,'' as YLJGMLBM,'' AS MEMO,'' AS MLLB,'' AS SYFYBZ," +&
				" to_date('1900-01-01','yyyy/mm/dd') AS MLKSRQ, to_date('2099-12-31','yyyy/mm/dd') AS MLJSRQ, '' as SFLB, '' as ybmlmc, '' as ybmldj " +&
				"FROM GY_YLSF  "
	IF ids_ylsf.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_error = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_ylsf.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
// //--------特殊对照--类别------------------------------------------
//IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_tsdz_lb) THEN
//	ids_yb_tsdz_lb = Create U_datastore
//	ids_yb_tsdz_lb.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)

Long ll_find,ll_Find_tsdz = 0,ll_count_sl
Integer li_tsdz = 0,li_tsdz_lb = 0
DateTime ldt_brnl,ldt_lnnl,ldt_brnl_6
Date ld_mlksrq, ld_mljsrq
String ls_gjybbm = '',ls_ypmc, ls_yljgmlbm, ls_ylmlbm, ls_temp
String ls_mllb, ls_memo, ls_syfybz, ls_sflb, ls_ybmlmc, ls_ybmldj
IF ai_yplx > 0 THEN //药品
	ll_find = ids_typk.Find(" (ypxh="+String(al_ypxh)+") and (ypcd="+String(al_ypcd)+") and (mlksrq<=date('"+String(Date(adt_jfrq),"yyyy-mm-dd")+"') and date('"+String(Date(adt_jfrq),"yyyy-mm-dd")+"')<=mljsrq)",1,9999999)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ls_gjybbm = ids_typk.Object.GJYBBM[ll_find]
	ELSE
		Long ll_ypxh,ll_ypcd
		Integer li_zjpb,li_type,li_kzyp,li_wlyp = 0
		Dec{3} ldc_ypjl
		String ls_jldw,ls_yfgg,ls_bfgg,ls_bfdw,ls_yfdw,ls_zxdw
		//AND YK_YPCD.ZFPB=0
		SELECT YK_TYPK.YPXH,YPJL,JLDW,YFGG,BFGG,BFDW,YFDW,ZJPB,TYPE,ZXDW,KZYP,YK_YPCD.YPCD,YK_YPCD.GJYPBM,YPMC
			INTO :ll_ypxh,:ldc_ypjl,:ls_jldw,:ls_yfgg,:ls_bfgg,:ls_bfdw,:ls_yfdw,:li_zjpb,:li_type,:ls_zxdw,:li_kzyp,:ll_ypcd,:ls_gjybbm,:ls_ypmc
			From YPXT.YK_TYPK,YPXT.YK_YPCD Where YK_TYPK.YPXH = :al_ypxh And YK_YPCD.YPXH = YK_TYPK.YPXH And YK_YPCD.YPCD = :al_ypcd and YK_TYPK.ZFPB=0 Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			IF IsNull(ls_gjybbm) THEN ls_gjybbm = ''
			IF Trim(ls_gjybbm) = ''  THEN
				as_error =  ls_ypmc + ':药品未维护对应的国家码，请联系药库维护！' + String(al_ypxh) + "#" + String(al_ypcd)
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			
			//获取医疗机构目录编码&&医疗目录编码
			ls_yljgmlbm = "Y"+String(ll_ypxh)+"#"+String(ll_ypcd)
			SELECT MED_LIST_CODG, MEMO, LIST_TYPE, begndate, enddate Into :ls_ylmlbm, :ls_memo, :ls_mllb, :ld_mlksrq, :ld_mljsrq From JKXT.ZHYB_MLSB 
			Where FIXMEDINS_HILIST_ID = :ls_yljgmlbm And zfpb = 0 and :adt_jfrq >=BEGNDATE and :adt_jfrq <=ENDDATE Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 100 THEN
				as_error = "药品信息未上报(药品序号：" + String(al_ypxh)+", 药品产地："+String(ll_ypcd)+", 药品名称："+ls_ypmc+")，请联系药库上报！"
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				as_error = "取不到药品上报信息(药品序号：" + String(al_ypxh)+", 药品产地："+String(ll_ypcd)+", 药品名称："+ls_ypmc+")" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			IF isnull(ls_memo) then ls_memo = ''
			IF isnull(ls_mllb) Then ls_mllb=''
			IF isnull(ld_mlksrq) Then ld_mlksrq = Date(1900,1,1)
			IF isnull(ld_mljsrq) Then ld_mljsrq = Date(2099,12,31)
			
			// 获取 生覦AT*
�费用标志、开始时间、结束时�

			Select MATN_USED_FLAG, MED_CHRGITM_TYPE, HILIST_NAME, CHRGITM_LV INTO :ls_syfybz, :ls_sflb, :ls_ybmlmc, :ls_ybmldj From JKXT.HILIST_B Where HILIST_CODE=:ls_ylmlbm Using itran_sqlca;
			IF isnull(ls_syfybz) Then ls_syfybz='0'
			IF isnull(ls_sflb) Then ls_sflb=''
			IF isnull(ls_ybmlmc) Then ls_ybmlmc=''
			IF isnull(ls_ybmldj) Then ls_ybmldj=''
			
			SELECT wlyp Into :li_wlyp From YPXT.yk_typk_kz Where YPXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
			IF IsNull(li_wlyp) THEN li_wlyp = 0
			//			SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz From JKXT.YB_TSDZ Where FYLX = 1 And FYXH = :al_ypxh and (ypcd = 0 or ypcd = :al_ypcd) Using itran_sqlca;
			//			SELECT count(1) Into :li_tsdz_lb From JKXT.YB_TSDZ_LB Where FYLX = 1  And FYXH = :al_ypxh Using itran_sqlca;
			ll_find = ids_typk.InsertRow(0)
			ids_typk.Object.YPXH[ll_find] = ll_ypxh
			ids_typk.Object.YPJL[ll_find] = ldc_ypjl
			ids_typk.Object.JLDW[ll_find] = ls_jldw
			ids_typk.Object.YFGG[ll_find] = ls_yfgg
			ids_typk.Object.BFGG[ll_find] = ls_bfgg
			ids_typk.Object.YFDW[ll_find] = ls_yfdw
			ids_typk.Object.BFDW[ll_find] = ls_bfdw
			ids_typk.Object.ZJPB[ll_find] = li_zjpb
			ids_typk.Object.Type[ll_find] = li_type
			ids_typk.Object.ZXDW[ll_find] = ls_zxdw
			ids_typk.Object.KZYP[ll_find] = li_kzyp
			ids_typk.Object.YPCD[ll_find] = ll_ypcd
			ids_typk.Object.GJYBBM[ll_find] = ls_gjybbm
			ids_typk.Object.wgyp[ll_find] = li_wlyp
			ids_typk.Object.YLMLBM[ll_find] = ls_ylmlbm
			ids_typk.Object.YLJGMLBM[ll_find] = ls_yljgmlbm
			ids_typk.Object.MEMO[ll_find] = ls_memo
			ids_typk.Object.MLLB[ll_find] = ls_mllb
			ids_typk.Object.SYFYBZ[ll_find] = ls_syfybz
			ids_typk.Object.MLKSRQ[ll_find] = ld_mlksrq
			ids_typk.Object.MLJSRQ[ll_find] = ld_mljsrq
			ids_typk.Object.SFLB[ll_find] = ls_sflb
			ids_typk.Object.YBMLMC[ll_find] = ls_ybmlmc
			ids_typk.Object.YBMLDJ[ll_find] = ls_ybmldj
			ids_typk.Object.YPMC[ll_find] = ls_ypmc
			//ybfl是否需要？
			IF li_tsdz > 0 THEN
				ids_typk.Object.tsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
			
			IF li_tsdz_lb > 0 THEN
				ids_typk.Object.lbtsdz[ll_find] = 1
			END IF
		ELSE
			as_error = '取不到药品基本信息:(ypxh:' + String(al_ypxh)+', ypcd:'+String(al_ypcd)+')' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
	END IF
ELSE //费用

public function integer of_get_jzxlh (ref string as_jzxlh, ref string as_error);Decimal{0} ll_Value
Long ll_Count
Long ll_Retry
//判断事务
IF uf_set_instance(as_error ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

Process_Begin:
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)

UPDATE GY_IDENTITY SET VALUE = VALUE + 1
	Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN // update失败，判断是否存在记录
	SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_Count > 0 THEN // 记录存在继续update(最多三次)
		ll_Retry ++
		IF ll_Retry >= 3 THEN
			as_error = '获取序列号出错：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		ELSE
			Gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
			GOTO Process_Begin
		END IF
	ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
		INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
			Values ('ZHYB_JZXLH',1101,1101,1) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN 
			as_error = '插入序列号出错：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		end if
		ll_Value = 1101
		GOTO Process_Success
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_Count FROM GY_IDENTITY
		Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_Count > 0 THEN
	ELSE // 记录不存在则插入新记录
		INSERT INTO GY_IDENTITY(TNAME,VALUE,ORIGIN_VALUE,INC_VALUE)
			Values ('ZHYB_JZXLH',1101,1,1) Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN 
			as_error = '插入序列号出错2：' + itran_sqlca.sqlerrtext
			GOTO Process_Error
		end if
		ll_Value = 1101
		GOTO Process_Success
	END IF
END IF

SetNull(ll_Value)
SELECT VALUE INTO :ll_Value FROM GY_IDENTITY
	Where TNAME = 'ZHYB_JZXLH' Using itran_sqlca;
	
IF IsNull(ll_Value)      THEN GOTO Process_Error
IF ll_Value < 1101 THEN GOTO Process_Error

Process_Success:
gf_Commit_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
as_jzxlh = String(ll_Value)
RETURN 1

Process_Error:
gf_Rollback_Transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer of_get_mz_zdxx (decimal adc_jzlsh, string as_ysbm, ref string as_zddm[], ref string as_zdmc[], ref string as_zdms);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_mz_zdxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取门诊诊断
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_ywlx  	
// 	value    	decimal	adc_jzlsh	
// 	value    	string 	as_ysbm  	
// 	reference	string 	as_zddm[]	
// 	reference	string 	as_zdmc  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.21
//====================================================================

as_zdms = ''

IF IsValid(ids_mz_zdxx) = False THEN
	ids_mz_zdxx = Create datastore
	ids_mz_zdxx.DataObject = 'd_mz_zdxx_jzlsh'
END IF
ids_mz_zdxx.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
IF adc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
	IF ids_mz_zdxx.Retrieve(adc_jzlsh) < 0 THEN
		as_zdms = '获取诊断信息失败JZ：' + String(adc_jzlsh)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ids_mz_zdxx.Reset( )
END IF
as_zdms = ''
Long ll_row,ll_count,ll_zdlsh
String ls_zddm,ls_zdmc
ll_count = ids_mz_zdxx.RowCount()
IF ll_count >= 1 And adc_jzlsh > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		ll_zdlsh = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdlsh[ll_row]
		ls_zdmc = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.zdmc[ll_row]
		ls_zddm = ids_mz_zdxx.Object.ICD10[ll_row]
		as_zddm[ll_row] = ls_zddm
		as_zdmc[ll_row] = ls_zdmc
		if ll_row > 1 then
			if ll_row =ll_count then
				as_zdms = as_zdms + ls_zddm 
			else
				as_zdms = as_zdms + ls_zddm +'|'
			end if
		end if
	NEXT
ELSE
	as_zddm[1] = is_mricd10
	as_zdmc[1] = is_mrzdmc
	as_zdms = is_mrzdmc
END IF
IF Len(as_zdms) > 500 THEN as_zdms = of_midstring(as_zdms,500)
RETURN 1
end function

public subroutine of_get_ybjsxx (ref str_gs_jsxx astr_gs_jsxx);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_gsbx_his.of_get_ybjsxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

//====================================================================


SailJson lJson_jsgcxx
String ls_jsgcxx

astr_gs_jsxx.mdtrt_id = This.uf_getstring('mdtrt_id')  //mdtrt_id	单据号
astr_gs_jsxx.ylfze = This.uf_getdecimal('medfee_sumamt')//medfee_sumamt	本次医疗费总额
astr_gs_jsxx.tczfje = This.uf_getdecimal('hifp_pay')//hifp_pay	本次统筹支付金额

astr_gs_jsxx.yfhj = This.uf_getdecimal('drug_fee')//drug_fee	药费合计

astr_gs_jsxx.clfhj = This.uf_getdecimal('ms_fee')//ms_fee 材料费合计

public function integer of_get_ygxm (string as_ygdm, ref string as_ygxm, ref string as_sfzh, boolean ab_dz, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_ygxm()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:获取员工姓名
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string 	as_ygdm 	
// 	reference	string 	as_ygxm 	
// 	reference	string 	as_sfzh 	
// 	value    	boolean	ab_dz   //TRUE取对照的员工信息，false取传入工号信息	
// 	reference	string 	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.29
//====================================================================

uf_connect_sqlca_temp()
IF IsValid(ids_ygdm) = False THEN
	ids_ygdm = Create u_datastore
	ids_ygdm.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	IF ids_ygdm.createfromsql("select ygdm,ygxm,sfzh,'' as gjybdm,ygjb,'' as DZGH from gy_ygdm ") < 0 THEN
		as_ygxm = "创建'ygdm'对象失败("+ids_ygdm.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ids_ygdm.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
END IF

Long ll_find, ll_ygjb,ll_find_dz,ll_insert,ll_ygjb_dz
String ls_ygxm, ls_sfzh,ls_dzgh,ls_ygxm_dz, ls_sfzh_dz
ll_find = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+as_ygdm+"'", 1, 999999)
IF ll_find > 0 THEN
	ls_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find]
	ls_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find]
	ls_dzgh = ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find]
ELSE
	SELECT ygxm, sfzh, ygjb Into :ls_ygxm, :ls_sfzh, :ll_ygjb From XTGL.GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = as_ygdm + "获取员工信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN  -1
	END IF
	ll_find = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
	ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_find] = as_ygdm
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find] = ls_ygxm
	ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find] = ls_sfzh
	ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_find] = ll_ygjb
	SELECT csz Into :ls_dzgh From XTGL.gy_xtcs_n Where XTSB = 0 and  CSDM = 'ZHYB_KDYSDZ' And CSMC = :as_ygdm Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN
		ids_ygdm.Object.dzgh[ll_find] = ls_dzgh
	ELSE
		//		ids_ygdm.Object.DZGH[ll_find] = 'NULL'
	END IF
END IF

//如果有对照工号，判断是否有值，有就取没有插入；获取对照人的姓名和身份证
IF ls_dzgh > '' THEN	
	ll_find_dz = ids_ygdm.Find("ygdm='"+ls_dzgh+"'", 1, 999999)
	IF ll_find_dz > 0 And ab_dz THEN
		ls_ygxm = ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_find_dz]
		ls_sfzh = ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_find_dz]
	ELSE
		SELECT ygxm, sfzh, ygjb Into :ls_ygxm_dz, :ls_sfzh_dz, :ll_ygjb_dz From XTGL.GY_YGDM Where YGDM = :ls_dzgh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = as_ygdm + "获取员工信息失败：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			RETURN  -1
		END IF
		ll_insert = ids_ygdm.InsertRow(0)
		ids_ygdm.Object.YGDM[ll_insert] = ls_dzgh
		ids_ygdm.Object.ygxm[ll_insert] = ls_ygxm_dz
		ids_ygdm.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh_dz
		ids_ygdm.Object.ygjb[ll_insert] = ll_ygjb_dz
		IF ab_dz THEN
			ls_ygxm = ls_ygxm_dz
			ls_sfzh = ls_sfzh_dz
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

as_ygxm = ls_ygxm
as_sfzh = ls_sfzh
//as_dzgh = ls_dzgh

RETURN 1
end function
