public function integer of_get_zy_zdxx (long al_zyh, integer ai_zdlx, ref string as_zzddm, ref string as_zzdmc, ref string as_zdms, ref string asarr_zddms[], ref string asarr_zdmcs[], ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_get_zy_zdxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 获取住院病人诊断信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh         住院号 	
// 	value    	integer	ai_zdlx        诊断类型：1-住院诊断，2-出院诊断
// 	reference	string	as_zzddm     	主诊断代码
// 	reference	string	as_zzdmc     	主诊断名称
// 	reference	string	as_zdms      	病情描述
// 	reference	string	asarr_zddms[]  疾病代码列表
// 	reference	string	asarr_zdmcs[]	疾病名称列表
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//         -1-失败；1-成功
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.17    28271  获取住院病人诊断信息
//====================================================================
IF IsValid(ids_zy_ryzd) = False THEN
	ids_zy_ryzd = Create u_datastore
	ids_zy_ryzd.DataObject = 'd_yb_zy_zdxx'
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

// 检索数据，并根据ai_zdlx过滤诊断类型
IF ids_zy_ryzd.Retrieve(al_zyh) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	ids_zy_ryzd.SetSort( "zdlb asc")
	ids_zy_ryzd.Sort( )
END IF
String ls_zdlb_filter
IF ai_zdlx=1 Then
	Select to_char(wm_concat(dmsb)) into :ls_zdlb_filter From XTGL.GY_DMZD Where dmlb=22 and dmsb>0 and dmmc like '%入院%' Using sqlca;
	IF sqlca.sqlcode<>0 THen
		as_error = "获取菵AT* 朐赫锒侠啾鹗О埽篬"+String(sqlca.sqlCode)+"]" + sqlca.sqlErrText
		return -1
	END IF
	IF isnull(ls_zdlb_filter) or Trim(ls_zdlb_filter)="" THen
		ls_zdlb_filter = "2,9,10,11"
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_zdlx=2 Then
	Select to_char(wm_concat(dmsb)) into :ls_zdlb_filter From XTGL.GY_DMZD Where dmlb=22 and dmsb>0 and dmmc like '%出院%' Using sqlca;
	IF sqlca.sqlcode<>0 THen
		as_error = "获取出院诊断类别失败：["+String(sqlca.sqlCode)+"]" + sqlca.sqlErrText
		return -1
	END IF
	IF isnull(ls_zdlb_filter) or Trim(ls_zdlb_filter)="" THen
		ls_zdlb_filter = "3,4,15,16,19,20"
	END IF
ELSE
	as_error = '出入院诊断类型传入有误：' + String(ai_zdlx)
	return -1
END IF
ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter(" (zdlb in("+ls_zdlb_filter+")) ")
ids_zy_ryzd.filter()

// 获取诊断数据
Long ll_row, ll_rowCount, ll_zds
ll_rowCount = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
IF ll_rowCount=0 Then
	IF ai_zdlx=1 Then
		as_error = "入院诊断未填写，请联系医生填写！"
		return -1
	ELSE
		ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter("")
		ids_zy_ryzd.filter()
		ls_zdlb_filter = "2,9,10,11"
		ids_zy_ryzd.setFilter(" (zdlb in("+ls_zdlb_filter+")) ")
		ids_zy_ryzd.filter()
		ll_rowCount = ids_zy_ryzd.RowCount()
		IF ll_rowCount>0 Then
			as_zzddm = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[1]
			as_zzdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
			as_zdms = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])			
			For ll_zds=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
		      asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[ll_zds]
	
				IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds] = ''
				asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
				as_zdms = as_zdms +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
				IF isnull(asArr_zddms[ll_zds]) or Trim(asArr_zddms[ll_zds])="" or asArr_zddms[ll_zds]="无" Then
					as_error = "【" + asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] + "】诊断对应ICD10为空！"
					return -1
				END IF
			Next
		END IF
	END IF
ELSEIF ll_rowCount>0 Then
	as_zzddm = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[1]
	as_zzdmc = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	as_zdms = String(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[1])
	IF isnull(as_zzddm) or Trim(as_zzddm)="" or as_zzddm="无" Then
		as_error = "【" + as_zzdmc + "】诊断对应ICD10为空"
		return -1
	END IF
	
	For ll_zds=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
		asArr_zddms[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.ICD10[ll_zds]
		
		IF IsNull(ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]) THEN ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds] = ''
		asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] = ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
		as_zdms = as_zdms +','+ids_zy_ryzd.Object.Name[ll_zds]
		IF isnull(asArr_zddms[ll_zds]) or Trim(asArr_zddms[ll_zds])="" or asArr_zddms[ll_zds]="无" Then
			as_error = "【" + asArr_zdmcs[ll_zds] + "】诊断对应ICD10为空！"
			return -1
		END IF
	Next
ELSE
	as_error = "出入院诊断数据窗口检索或过滤失败！请重进程序！"
	return -1
END IF

IF as_zzdmc = '' Or IsNull(as_zzdmc) THEN
	as_error = '主诊断名称为空！主诊断代码：' + String(as_zzddm)
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Lenw(as_zdms) >= 500 THEN
	as_zdms = of_midstring(as_zdms, 500)
END IF

RETURN 1


end function

public function datetime of_relativetime (string as_type, datetime adt_datetime, long ai_value);//====================================================================
// Function: gf_relativedatetime()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Description: 用于向上移时间，可用于按小时，按分钟等
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Arguments: 
//		value	string  	as_type     		
//		value	datetime	adt_datetime		
//		value	long 	ai_value    		
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Returns:  datetime
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Author:	Xums		Date: 2005.05.19
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Modify History: 
//	
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_return
integer li_Hour,li_Minute,li_Second,li_month,li_year,li_day
Time lt_time
Date ld_date

lt_time = time(adt_datetime)
ld_date = date(adt_datetime)

li_Hour = Hour(lt_time)
li_Minute = Minute(lt_time)
li_Second = Second(lt_time)

CHOOSE CASE as_type
	CASE 'HOUR'
		li_day = Truncate ( ai_value / 24, 0 )
		
		ldt_return = datetime(RelativeDate(ld_date,-li_day),lt_time)
		
		li_Second = (ai_value - (li_day * 24)) * 60
		ldt_return = gf_relativedatetime('MINUTE',ldt_return,li_Second)
		return ldt_return
	case 'MINUTE'
		
		ai_value = ai_value * 60
		if ai_value > 0 then 
			if ai_value > li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second then
				ld_date = RelativeDate(ld_date,-1)
				ai_value = ai_value - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second)
				lt_time = time("23:59:59")
				ai_value = ai_value - 1
			end if
		else
			if abs(ai_value) > (24 * 3600 ) - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second) then
				ld_date = RelativeDate(ld_date,1)
				ai_value = ai_value + (24 * 3600 ) - (li_Hour * 3600 + li_Minute * 60 + li_Second)
				lt_time = time("00:00:00")
				ai_value = ai_value + 1
			end if
		end if
		lt_time = RelativeTime(lt_time,-ai_value)
	CASE 'MONTH'
		ai_value = - ai_value
		li_year = Truncate( ai_value / 12,0)
		ai_value = mod(ai_value,12)
		
		li_month = month(date(adt_datetime))
		li_day = day(date(adt_datetime))
		
		li_month = li_month + ai_value
		
		if li_month > 12 then
			li_month = li_month - 12
			li_year ++
		end if
		if li_month <= 0 then
			li_month = 12 + li_month
			li_year --
		end if
		
		
		li_year = year(date(adt_datetime)) + li_year
		string ls_temp
		ls_temp = string(li_year) + "." + string(li_month) + "." + string(li_day)
		do while not IsDate(ls_temp) 
			li_day = li_day - 1
			ls_temp = string(li_year) + "." + string(li_month) + "." + string(li_day )
		loop
		
		ld_date = date(ls_temp)
		lt_time = time(00:00:00)
END	CHOOSE

ldt_return = DateTime(ld_date,lt_time)

RETURN ldt_return

end function

public subroutine of_reset_jsxx (ref str_gs_jsxx astr_gs_jsxx);
datetime ldt_null
setnull(ldt_null)
astr_gs_jsxx.jssj = ldt_null
astr_gs_jsxx.mdtrt_id = ''
str_gs_grjbxx  lstr_gs_grjbxx_null
astr_gs_jsxx.astr_gs_grjbxx = lstr_gs_grjbxx_null
end subroutine

public function integer uf_czy_qrqc (date ad_qdrq, string as_czybm, long ai_qrqc, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	date   	ad_qdrq 	签到日期
// 	value    	string 	as_czybm	操作员编码
// 	value    	string 	ai_qrqc 	1 签入  2签出
// 	reference	integer	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl 日期: 2024-8-10
//====================================================================
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp() < 0 THEN
	as_error = '数据库库连接失败:' +itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
DateTime ldt_qdsj,ldt_qtsj,ldt_cur
String ls_dqbm
Int li_ztbz,li_count
Dec{0} ldc_jlxh
ldt_cur = gf_server_date()
IF ai_qrqc = 1 THEN //签入
	QR:
	SELECT JLXH, QRSJ,ZTBZ,QDLSH Into :ldc_jlxh, :ldt_qdsj,:li_ztbz,:ls_dqbm From JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC Where czybm = :as_czybm And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ldc_jlxh > 0  THEN
		IF RelativeDate(Date(ldt_cur), ii_qdyxts) <= Date(ldt_cur)  THEN //最近一次荄AT*

			is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
			This.uf_send_init('9002')
			IF istr_jytsrx.opter <> as_czybm THEN
				istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
			END IF
			IF This.uf_send(as_error) THEN
			ELSE
				as_error = '【9002】签出失败：' + as_error
				RETURN -1
			END IF
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			UPDATE JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC  Set qcsj = sysdate,ZTBZ = 3 Where  JLXH = :ldc_jlxh  Using itran_sqlca;
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
				as_error = '【9002】更新签退时间失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				RETURN -1
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//如果还有未签出则循环签出
	ldc_jlxh = 0
	SELECT count(1) Into :li_count From JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC Where czybm = :as_czybm And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF li_count > 0 THEN GOTO QR
	//全部签出后作签到
	This.uf_send_init('9001')
	IF istr_jytsrx.opter <> as_czybm THEN
		istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
	END IF
	IF Not This.uf_send(as_error) THEN
		as_error = '【9001】签到失败：'  + as_error
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	ls_dqbm = This.uf_getstring('sign_no')
	ldt_qdsj = This.uf_getdatetime('sign_time') //yyyyMMddHHmmss
	gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	INSERT Into JKXT.zhyb_czy_qrqc(czybm,QRSJ,ZTBZ,qdbh) Values (:as_czybm,:ldt_qdsj,1,:ls_dqbm) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '【9001】插入数据失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
	END IF
ELSE //签退
	QC:
	SELECT JLXH,QRSJ,ZTBZ,QDLSH Into :ldc_jlxh,:ldt_qdsj,:li_ztbz,:ls_dqbm From JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC Where  czybm = :as_czybm  And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ldc_jlxh > 0  THEN
		This.uf_send_init('9002')
		IF istr_jytsrx.opter <> as_czybm THEN
			istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
		END IF
		is_jyzqh = ls_dqbm
		IF Not This.uf_send(as_error) THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		
		gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		UPDATE JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC  Set qcsj = sysdate,ZTBZ = 3 Where  JLXH = :ldc_jlxh  Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			as_error = '更新签退时间失败' + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			RETURN -1
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		END IF
		ldc_jlxh = 0
		SELECT count(1) Into :li_count From JKXT.GS_CZY_QRQC Where czybm = :as_czybm And ZTBZ = 1 Using itran_sqlca;
		IF li_count > 0 THEN GOTO QC
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1




end function

public function integer uf_mz_ghcx (string as_grbh, string as_jzid, string as_mzyh, datetime adt_jssj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_mz_ghcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:[2202-门诊挂号撤销]
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_grbh 	
// 	value    	string  	as_jzid 	
// 	value    	string  	as_mzyh 	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_jssj	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.02.24
//====================================================================

IF IsNull(as_jzid) Or Trim(as_jzid) = "" THEN
	as_error = "就诊ID为空"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_mzyh) Or Trim(as_mzyh) = "" THEN
	as_error = "住院/门诊号为空"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_grbh) Or Trim(as_grbh) = "" THEN
	as_grbh =  istr_gs_grjbxx.GRBH	
	IF IsNull(as_grbh) Or Trim(as_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = "人员编号为空"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
String ls_sfybm,ls_expContent,ls_cbdybqh
DateTime ldt_now
ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
// 操作员签到
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or  base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 8 THEN
	ls_sfybm = is_zyzz
ELSE
	ls_sfybm = is_mzzz
END IF
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm ,  1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

ls_cbdybqh =  istr_gs_jsxx.insu_admdvs
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "创建临时事务失败！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

This.uf_send_init('2202')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_sfybm
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', as_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', as_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
This.uf_send_add('ipt_otp_no', as_mzyh) // 	住院/门诊号	字符型
// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(as_error ) THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 成功后回写HIS
str_zhyl_ghxx lstr_zhyl_ghxx
lstr_zhyl_ghxx.kssj = adt_jssj
lstr_zhyl_ghxx.JZID = as_jzid
IF This.of_update_ghxx( 1, lstr_zhyl_ghxx,as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '接口作废成功，更新失败：' + as_error
END IF

RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2202-门诊登记撤销]出错：" + as_error

RETURN -1
end function

public function integer uf_mz_jscl (string as_knsj, string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, string as_jydd, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, ref string as_error);
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
DateTime ldt_now
String ls_czybm,ls_czyxm
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	ls_czyxm = base_info.username
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	SELECT ygxm Into :ls_czyxm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :is_mzzz Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ls_czyxm) Or  ls_czyxm = '' THEN ls_czyxm = '自助结算'
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now),is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF
String ls_fplsh,ls_expcontent,ls_jzid,ls_ghlsh,ls_fplsh_y
Dec{0} ldc_jzlsh,ldc_ghlsh
//挂号获取就诊ID
ls_ghlsh = String(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ghlsh)
ls_fplsh_y = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
//IF ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1 THEN
//	IF This.of_get_ghjzid( ai_jslx,as_brbm, Left(as_jylx,2),ls_ghlsh,as_jydd, astr_yb_mzsfqq, ls_jzid, as_error) < 0 THEN
//		RETURN -1
//	END IF
//ELSE
//	ls_jzid = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_zhyl_jsxx.jzid
//END IF

//上传就诊信息
String ls_yllb,ls_bzbm,ls_ghsf,ls_tmbmc = '' //,ls_ksmc
Integer li_count_jz = 0
ls_bzbm = ''
ls_ghsf = Left(as_jylx,2)
as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
ldc_jzlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh
ldc_ghlsh = Dec(astr_yb_mzsfqq.ghlsh)
If (IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0) And ldc_ghlsh > 0 THEN
	SELECT jzlsh Into :ldc_jzlsh From mzxt.mz_jzxx Where ghlsh = :ldc_ghlsh And ysbm = :astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
	If  (IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0) THEN
		SELECT jzlsh Into :ldc_jzlsh From mzxt.mz_jzxx Where ghlsh = :ldc_ghlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
END IF
//就诊类别	71	工伤门诊  73	工伤康复门诊
ls_yllb = '71' 
If (ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1)  THEN
	IF This.uf_mz_jzxx( ai_jslx,as_brbm,ls_jzid,ldc_jzlsh,astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm,astr_yb_mzsfqq.ksbm,ls_yllb,ls_czybm,ls_bzbm ,as_error) < 0  THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	IF ls_bzbm = '' THEN ls_bzbm = istr_gs_jsxx.bzbm
END IF
Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_qzfje,ldc_cxjje,ldc_xxzfje,ldc_fhje,ldc_gbbjzf,ldc_bscje
Integer li_ret
str_gs_jsxx lstr_gs_jsxx
IF ai_jslx = 0 Or ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	li_ret = This.of_mz_mxsc( as_brbm, ai_jslx, ls_ghsf + as_jylx, astr_yb_mzsfqq,ls_czybm,ls_yllb, ldc_fyze,as_error)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		//		ldc_bscje = astr_yb_mzsfqq.lstr_gs_jsxx.bscfyje
		IF li_ret = 2 THEN
			istr_gs_jsxx = lstr_gs_jsxx
			istr_gs_jsxx.xjzfze = 0.00
			istr_gs_jsxx.ylfze = 0.00
			istr_gs_jsxx.tczfje  = 0.00
			astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_gs_jsxx = istr_gs_jsxx
			RETURN 2
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	//	ldc_bscje = istr_gs_jsxx.bscfyje
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_gbbjzf) THEN ldc_gbbjzf = 0
ls_fplsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	IF ls_fplsh <> ls_fplsh_y THEN
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ls_fplsh_y
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_jslx = 2 THEN
	IF ls_fplsh <> istr_gs_jsxx.sfpch THEN
		ls_fplsh = istr_gs_jsxx.sfpch
	END IF
END IF

//2206A 门诊预结算  2207A 门诊结算 （节点标识：data� ai_jslx 0:预结算（不保存明细）1:预结算（保存明细） 2:结算确认
IF ai_jslx = 2 THEN
	uf_send_init('2207A')
	ls_yllb = istr_gs_jsxx.yllb
	ldc_fyze = istr_gs_jsxx.ylfze
ELSE
	uf_send_init('2206A')
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_yllb) Or Trim(ls_yllb) = "" THEN
	IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		ls_yllb = '12'
	ELSE
		ls_yllb = '11'
	END IF
END IF
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_gs_jsxx.insu_admdvs
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
This.uf_send_add( 'ipt_otp_no', ls_jzid ) //ipt_otp_no	门诊/譊AT*

This.uf_send_add( 'psn_no', istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh ) //1	psn_no	人员编号	字符型	30		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'med_type', ls_yllb ) //4	med_type	医疗类别	字符型	6	Y	Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'medfee_sumamt', ldc_fyze ) //5	medfee_sumamt	医疗费总额	数值型	16,2		Y	
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_id', ls_jzid  ) //7	mdtrt_id	就诊ID	字符型	
This.uf_send_add( 'chrg_bchno', ls_fplsh ) //8	chrg_bchno	收费批次号	字符型		

Dec{2} ldc_jjzf
String ls_error
lstr_gs_jsxx.fsbwid = is_jylsh
IF ai_jslx  = 1 THEN
	lstr_gs_jsxx.sfpch = ls_fplsh
END IF
IF Not uf_send(as_error) THEN
	
	IF ai_jslx = 2 THEN
		as_error = '【2207】' + as_error
		//		This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid,ls_fplsh, istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh , ls_error)
	ELSE
		as_error = '【2206】' + as_error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	//如果结算失败那么撤销对应上传的明细，撤销挂号信息2201
	//	This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid,'0000', istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh , ls_error)
	IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		//		This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, ls_jzid, 'GH' + ls_fplsh,DateTime(Date(ldt_now)), ls_error)
	ELSE
		//		This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, ls_jzid, ls_fplsh,DateTime(Date(ldt_now)), ls_error)
	END IF
	RETURN -1
END IF
lstr_gs_jsxx.yllb = ls_yllb
lstr_gs_jsxx.mzyh = ls_jzid
ldc_jjzf = astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_gs_jsxx.tczfje
This.of_get_ybjsxx(  lstr_gs_jsxx)
lstr_gs_jsxx.bzbm = ls_bzbm
istr_gs_jsxx = lstr_gs_jsxx
astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_gs_jsxx = lstr_gs_jsxx

//确认结算前的预结算，明细做撤销操作
IF ai_jslx = 0 THEN
	//	This.uf_mz_mxcx( ls_jzid,'0000', istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh , as_error)
	IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
		This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh, ls_jzid, 'GH' + ls_fplsh,DateTime(Date(ldt_now)), ls_error)
	ELSE
		This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh, ls_jzid, ls_fplsh,DateTime(Date(ldt_now)), ls_error)
	END IF
END IF
IF ai_jslx = 2 THEN
	IF ldc_jjzf <> lstr_gs_jsxx.tczfje THEN
		as_error = '【2207A】预结算：' + String(ldc_jjzf) + ',结算'+String(lstr_gs_jsxx.tczfje)+'的金额不一致'
		IF This.uf_jyzf(ldt_now, '2207A',  istr_gs_grjbxx.grbh,is_jylsh, ls_error) < 0 THEN
			as_error = as_error + ls_error
		END IF
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_gs_jsxx  = lstr_gs_jsxx
	//	IF This.of_update_jsmx( is_jylsh, istr_gs_jsxx ,ls_error) < 0 THEN
	//		gf_sblog( "c:\sblog" ,'[2207A]更新结算表失败：'+ ls_error)
	//	END IF
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_mz_mxcx (string jzid, string sfpch, string grbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_mz_mxcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:【2205】门诊费用明细信息撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string	jzid  	
// 	value    	string	sfpch	
// 	value    	string	grbh    	
// 	reference	string	as_error 	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.26
//====================================================================
DateTime ldt_now
String ls_czybm
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
IF base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now),is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

This.uf_send_init( '2205')
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_gs_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
This.uf_send_add( 'mdtrt_id', jzid) //ipt_otp_no	门诊/住院流水号
This.uf_send_add( 'chrg_bchno', "") //rxno	处方号	Y	传入"0000"删除所有未结算明细
This.uf_send_add( 'feedetl_sn', "") //feedetl_sn	处方流水号
IF Not uf_send(as_error) THEN
	RETURN -1
ELSE
	//如果撤销成功，更新对应表
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer uf_tfcl (string as_ywlx, string as_jsid, string as_jydd, datetime adt_yjyjssj, ref str_gs_jsxx astr_gs_jsxx, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_tfcl()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 门诊/住院结算撤销（退费）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string       	as_ywlx         // 业务类型
// 	value    	string       	as_jsid         // 原交易的结算ID
// 	value    	string       	as_jydd         // 交易地点
// 	value    	datetime     	adt_yjyjssj     // 原交易的交易时间
// 	reference	str_zhyl_jsxx	astr_zhyl_jsxx
// 	reference	string       	as_error    
//====================================================================
// 返回:  integer
//====================================================================

String ls_jzid,ls_grbh,ls_expContent // 就诊ID ,人员编号,字段扩展

Long ll_zyh
String ls_sfybm, ls_cbdybqh,ls_ywlx,ls_jsfl,ls_gbbjdx
DateTime ldt_now
Dec{2} ldc_gbbjzf,ldc_bscje

ldt_now = gf_Server_date()
IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = "创建临时事务失败！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
DateTime ldt_jssj_00,ldt_jssj_end
ldt_jssj_00 = DateTime(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_yjyjssj), -1 ))
ldt_jssj_end = DateTime(RelativeDate ( Date(adt_yjyjssj), 1 ),Time(adt_yjyjssj))

// 操作员签到
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or  base_info.syscode = 6 THEN
	ls_sfybm = base_info.UserID
ELSEIF base_info.syscode = 8 THEN
	ls_sfybm = is_zyzz
ELSE
	ls_sfybm = is_mzzz
END IF
IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( Date(ldt_now), ls_sfybm ,  1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 就诊ID
IF as_ywlx <> 'GH' THEN
	SELECT   JZID,     GRBH,       ZYH,   CBDXZQH,  YWLX ,  NVL(BSCJE,0)
		INTO :ls_jzid, :ls_grbh, :ll_zyh, :ls_cbdybqh,:ls_ywlx,  :ldc_bscje
		FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
		WHERE JSSJ >= :adt_yjyjssj - 3 AND  JSSJ < :adt_yjyjssj + 3 AND  JSLSH = :as_jsid
		Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "获取原结算明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
		as_error = "原结算明细的就诊ID为空！结算ID：" + as_jsid
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
		ls_cbdybqh = istr_gs_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm
		
		IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
			as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
			GOTO Error
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_cbdybqh = astr_gs_jsxx.insu_admdvs
	ls_jzid = astr_gs_jsxx.mzyh
	ls_grbh = istr_gs_grjbxx.GRBH
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_gs_grjbxx.GRBH
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = "人员编号为空，请重新刷卡！"
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
If (IsNull(ll_zyh) Or ll_zyh = 0) And as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	as_error = "原结算明细的住院号为空！结算ID：" + as_jsid
	GOTO Error
END IF


istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_sfybm
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
IF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
	This.uf_send_add('ipt_otp_no', as_jsid) // 	住院/门诊号	字符型
ELSE
	This.uf_send_add('setl_id', as_jsid) // 结算ID
END IF


// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(as_error) THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

//IF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
//	str_zhyl_ghxx lstr_zhyl_ghxx

public function integer uf_zhcx (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 人员基本信息获取
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value	string	as_knsj 	
// 	value	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  string
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2024.08.07    1101 人员基本信息获取
//====================================================================

Date ld_now
String ls_czybm,ls_czyxm
ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6  Or base_info.syscode = 79 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	ls_czyxm = base_info.username
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	ls_czyxm = '自助结算'
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

str_gs_grjbxx lstr_gs_grjbxx
lstr_gs_grjbxx.knsj = as_knsj

This.uf_send_init('1101')
IF This.istr_jytsrx.opter <> ls_czybm THEN
	This.istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	This.istr_jytsrx.opter_name = ls_czyxm
END IF

IF uf_send(Ref as_error) THEN
	of_get_zhxx(istr_gs_grjbxx)
ELSE
	GOTO Error
END IF
RETURN 1

Error:
as_error = "[1101-人员基本信息获取]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1

end function

protected function integer uf_zhcx_xs (string as_knsj, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx_xs()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:显示账户信息
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string  	as_knsj 	
// 	value    	dateTime	adt_kssj	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.01.25
//====================================================================
Date ld_now
String ls_czybm,ls_czyxm
ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
IF base_info.syscode = 5 Or base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 79 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	ls_czyxm = base_info.username
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,base_info.UserID , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_mzzz
	ls_czyxm = '自助结算'
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc( ld_now,is_mzzz , 1, as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
END IF

str_gs_grjbxx lstr_gs_grjbxx
istr_gs_grjbxx = lstr_gs_grjbxx
lstr_gs_grjbxx.knsj = as_knsj

This.uf_send_init('1101')
if This.istr_jytsrx.opter <> ls_czybm then
	This.istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	this.istr_jytsrx.opter_name = ls_czyxm
end if

IF uf_send(Ref as_error) THEN
	lstr_gs_grjbxx.knsj = as_knsj
	of_get_zhxx(lstr_gs_grjbxx)
	istr_gs_grjbxx = lstr_gs_grjbxx
	OpenWithParm(w_yb_jbxx_xs,'1')
	RETURN 1
ELSE
	IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
	as_error = "[1101-人员基本信息获取]出错：" + as_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1


end function

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, string as_jzid, string as_fymxlsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_delfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:住院费用明细撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh    	
// 	value    	string	as_jzid   	
// 	value    	string	as_fymxlsh	
// 	reference	string	as_error  	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2023.01.28
//====================================================================


IF IsNull(al_zyh) Or al_zyh = 0 THEN
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF IsNull(as_jzid) Or Trim(as_jzid) = '' THEN
	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空!"
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF IsNull(as_fymxlsh) Or Trim(as_fymxlsh) = "" THEN
	as_fymxlsh = "0000"
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF


String ls_JZID  ,ls_grbh ,ls_expContent ,ls_cbdybqh // 就诊ID,人员编号,字段扩展
ls_JZID = as_jzid
// 获取 人员编号
SELECT     GRBH,     CBDYBQH
	INTO :ls_grbh, :ls_cbdybqh
	From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX	Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID  Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF

This.uf_send_init('2302')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('feedetl_sn', as_fymxlsh) // 费用明细流水号：传入"0000"时删除全部
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_JZID) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent) // 字段扩展
// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error) THEN
	// 由于测试时明细撤销时发现，没有做明细上传且直接做明细撤销会返回这个报错，因此这里做特殊处理 //as_fymxlsh = "0000" And 
	IF Pos(as_error, "根据传来的参数在费用明细表中未查询到任何有效相关的记录") <= 0 And Pos(as_error, "费用明细信息不符合撤销要求") <= 0  THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF as_fymxlsh = "0000" THEN
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where zyh = :al_zyh And JZID = :ls_JZID And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) And YWLSH = :as_fymxlsh   Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
		//	goto Error
	END IF
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2302-住院费用明细撤销]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1




end function

public function integer uf_zy_delfymx (long al_zyh, string as_fymxlsh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_delfymx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院费用明细撤销
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	string	as_fymxlsh	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.23    28271  住院费用明细撤销
//====================================================================

IF isnull(al_zyh) or al_zyh=0 Then
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

IF isnull(as_fymxlsh) or Trim(as_fymxlsh)="" Then
	as_fymxlsh = "0000"
END IF

IF uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF

//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, ref as_error)<0 THEN
		goto Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_JZID  ,ls_grbh ,ls_expContent ,ls_cbdybqh // 就诊ID,人员编号,字段扩展
// 获取 就诊ID
Select YBJZBH into :ls_jzid
  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH=:al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取就诊ID失癉AT* 埽篬"+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_jzid) or Trim(ls_jzid)="" Then
	as_error = "就诊ID不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF

// 获取 人员编号
Select     GRBH,     CBDYBQH
  into :ls_grbh, :ls_cbdybqh
  From JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX 
 Where JZID=:ls_jzid
 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.sqlcode<>0 Then
	as_error = "获取住院登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.sqlcode)+"]" + itran_sqlca.sqlErrText
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_grbh) or Trim(ls_grbh)="" Then
	as_error = "人员编号不能为空！"
	goto Error
END IF
IF isnull(ls_cbdybqh) or Trim(ls_cbdybqh)="" Then 
	as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，不能删除明细，请检查病人是否成功医保登记！'
	goto Error
END IF

This.uf_send_init('2302')

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm             			// 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh         // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('feedetl_sn', as_fymxlsh)      // 费用明细流水号：传入"0000"时删除全部
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid)           // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)             // 人员编号
This.uf_send_add('exp_content', ls_expContent)  // 字段扩展


// 发送报文
IF NOT This.uf_send(ref as_error) Then
	// 由于测试时明细撤销时发现，没有做明细上传且直接做明细撤销会返回这个报错，因此这里做特殊处理
	IF Pos(as_error, "根据传来的参数在费用明细表中未查询到任何有效相关的记录") <= 0 And Pos(as_error, "费用明细信息不稤AT* �合撤销要� ") <= 0  THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

// 成功后回写HIS
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF as_fymxlsh="0000" Then
	DELETE From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ=0  Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但删除住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh And ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
	
ELSE
	UPDATE JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Set MXBS=MXBS-1  Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ=0 and JSRQ=(SELECT Max(JSRQ) From JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX Where zyh=:al_zyh And ztbz = 0) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但更新住院预结信息失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
   UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ=-1 Where ZYH=:al_zyh and ZTBZ in(0,9,-2) and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode<>0 THEN
		as_error = "【医保端】费用明细撤销成功，但作废费用明细上传表数据失败：("+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+")" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	//	goto Error
	END IF
	
	UPDATE JKXT.JS_TSMX Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And JSCS = 0 and YWLSH=:as_fymxlsh Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1


Error:
as_error = "[2302-住院费用明细撤销]出错：" + as_error
return -1


end function

public function integer uf_zy_ryxxbg (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_gsbx_his.uf_zy_ryxxbg()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:登记信息变更
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2024.08.12
//====================================================================


//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_jzid,ls_grbh, ls_lxdh // 就诊ID
string ls_ryksbm,ls_brch,ls_blhm,ls_zzysbm,ls_zyhm,ls_bzbm,ls_bzxx,ls_zzddm,ls_zzdmc,ls_ryzdms,ls_ryksmc
DateTime ldt_kssj, ldt_jssj // 开始时间、结束时间
Long ll_count
String ls_zzyssfzh, ls_jtdh, ls_cbdybqh, ls_brbq, ls_dmmc
String lsArr_zddms[], lsArr_zdmcs[]

// 获取 住院基本信息
SELECT   YBJZBH,       BRKS,    BQRYSJ,     BRCH,     lxdh,     jtdh,     bahm,       zzys,    BQCYSJ,     BRBQ
	INTO :ls_jzid, :ls_ryksbm, :ldt_kssj, :ls_brch,  :ls_lxdh, :ls_jtdh, :ls_blhm, :ls_zzysbm, :ldt_jssj, :ls_brbq
	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY, BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ
	WHERE ZY_BRRY.ZYH = :al_zyh AND ZY_BRRY.ZYH = ZY_BRRY_KZ.ZYH
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人基本信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_jssj) THEN ldt_jssj =  gf_Server_Date()

IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) Or Trim(ls_lxdh) = '' THEN
	ls_lxdh = ls_jtdh
	IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) THEN ls_lxdh = ''
END IF
IF IsNull(ldt_kssj) Or Date(ldt_kssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	as_error = '病区入院时间为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_jzid) Or Trim(ls_jzid) = "" THEN
	as_error = '医保就诊ID为空，请确认病人是否正确医保登记！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_zzysbm) Or Trim(ls_zzysbm) = "" THEN
	as_error = '主治医生编码为空！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ryksbm) Or Trim(ls_ryksbm) = "" THEN
	as_error = "入院科室编码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_brch) Or Trim(ls_brch) = "" THEN
	as_error = "床位号码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF

// 获取 住院登记信息
SELECT     CBDYBQH,     GRBH,     DJZYHM,     BZBM,  yllb,BZXX
	INTO :ls_cbdybqh, :ls_grbh,  :ls_zyhm, :ls_bzbm,:ls_bzxx
	FROM JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND zyh = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "找不到对应的病人住院登记信息：" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	ls_grbh = istr_gs_grjbxx.GRBH
	
	IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
		as_error = '人员编号为空，请重新刷卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = '' THEN
	ls_cbdybqh = istr_gs_grjbxx.CBdxzqhdm
	
	IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
		as_error = '参保地行政区划为空，请重新读卡！'
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_bzbm) THEN ls_bzbm = ""
//IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_zzysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
//	as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
//	RETURN -1
//ELSE
//	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
//		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
//			as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
//			RETURN -1
//		END IF
//	ELSE
//		ls_zzysbm = ls_ysbm_gjm
//	END IF
//END IF
// 获取 入院诊断描述、入院主诊断代码、入院主诊断名称
IF This.of_get_zy_zdxx( al_zyh, 1, Ref ls_zzddm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_ryzdms, Ref lsArr_zddms, Ref lsArr_zdmcs, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '诊断获取失败！' + as_error
	RETURN -1
END IF

// 获取 入院科室编码、入院科室名称
ls_ryksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM', ls_ryksbm)
ls_ryksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM',ls_ryksbm)

This.uf_send_init('2203')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('ipt_otp_no', ls_zyhm)//ipt_otp_no	门诊/住院流水号
This.uf_send_add('adm_time', ldt_kssj)//adm_time	门诊/住院入院时间：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh)//psn_no	个人唯一识别码
This.uf_send_add('adm_diag_dscr', ls_bzbm)//adm_diag_dscr	诊断疾病编码
This.uf_send_add('adm_dept_name', ls_ryksmc)//wardarea_name	病区名称
This.uf_send_add('adm_dept_codg', ls_ryksbm)//adm_dept_codg	科室编码
This.uf_send_add('adm_bed', ls_brch)//adm_bed	床位号
This.uf_send_add('atddr_no', ls_zzysbm)//atddr_no	医生编码
This.uf_send_add('tel', ls_lxdh)//tel	病人联系电话


// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send( Ref as_error) THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 成功后回写HIS
String ls_czddip
ls_czddip = This.of_geT_ip( )
ls_bzxx = ls_bzxx + '【' + String(gf_server_date(),'yyyymmdd hh:mm') +'】' + ls_czddip
IF Len(ls_bzxx) > 500 THEN ls_bzxx = of_midstring(ls_bzxx,500)

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
UPDATE JKXT.ZHYB_ZYDJMX
	SET KSSJ = :ldt_kssj, JSSJ = :ldt_jssj, ZZYSBM = :ls_zzysbm, RYKSYYBM = :ls_ryksbm, RYCW = :ls_brch, ZZDDM = :ls_zzddm, CZDDIP = :ls_CZDDIP, BZXX = :ls_bzxx
	WHERE JZID = :ls_jzid AND ZYH = :al_zyh
	Using itran_sqlca;
// AND ZTBZ in ( 1,2)
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "【医保端】入院登记信息变更成功，但更新入院登记明细失败，错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	GOTO Error
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
RETURN 1
Error:
as_error = "[2203-入院信息变更]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1


end function

public function integer uf_zydj (string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, datetime adt_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_blhm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzid, ref string as_error, ref transaction atr_trans, boolean ab_commit);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_gsbx_his.Script - uf_zydj ( string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, datetime adt_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_blhm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzid, ref string as_error, ref transaction atr_trans, boolean ab_commit )  retur()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string     	as_knsj  	
// 	value    	long       	al_ksdm  	
// 	value    	long       	al_zyh   	
// 	value    	datetime   	adt_ryrq 	
// 	value    	string     	as_zyhm  	
// 	value    	string     	as_cwhm  	
// 	value    	string     	as_blhm  	
// 	value    	string     	as_ysbm  	
// 	value    	string     	as_rylx  	
// 	reference	string     	as_jzid  	
// 	reference	string     	as_error 	
// 	reference	transaction	atr_trans	
// 	value    	boolean    	ab_commit	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  (none)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2024.08.13
//====================================================================

IF uf_set_instance(as_error) < 0 THEN
	
RETURN -1
END IF
IF IsNull(al_zyh) Or al_zyh = 0 THEN
	as_error = "住院号为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(adt_ryrq) Or Date(adt_ryrq) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	as_error = "入院时间为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_ysbm) Or Trim(as_ysbm) = '' THEN
	as_error = "主治医生编码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
IF IsNull(as_zyhm) Or Trim(as_zyhm) = '' THEN
	as_error = "住院号码为空！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
//签到同时获取交易周期号
String ls_czybm,ls_czyxm
IF base_info.syscode = 6 Or base_info.syscode = 5 THEN
	ls_czybm = base_info.UserID
	ls_czyxm = base_info.username
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), base_info.UserID, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	ls_czybm = is_zyzz
	ls_czyxm = '自助结算'
	IF This.uf_czy_qrqc(Today(), is_zyzz, 1, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF

String ls_grbh, ls_lxdh,ls_zzysbm // 人员编号
String ls_ryzdms,ls_ryksbm, ls_ryksmc ,ls_zzddm, ls_zzdmc,ls_bzbm, ls_bzmc // 入院诊断描述  // 入院科室编码、入院科室名称 // 住院主诊断代码、住院主诊断名称
String lsArr_zddms[], lsArr_zdmcs[] // 入院诊断代码列表、入院诊断名称列表
String ls_cbdybqh,ls_yllb // 参保地医保区划
Long  ll_jsdh, ll_count,ll_brbq
String ls_zzyssfzh, ls_jtdh, ls_zjlx, ls_zjhm, ls_brxm
DateTime ldt_now
Date ld_csrq
IF This.uf_get_mzyh( as_error) < 0 THEN
	RETURN -1
END IF
as_jzid = as_error
as_error = ''
SELECT Count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.GS_DJXX Where zyh = :al_zyh And ztbz = 1 Using atr_trans;
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	as_error = "已有医保有效登记明细，请勿重复登记！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 获取 人员编号
ls_grbh = istr_gs_grjbxx.GRBH
IF IsNull(ls_grbh) Or Trim(ls_grbh) = "" THEN
	as_error = "个人编号为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 获取 参保地医保区划
ls_cbdybqh = istr_gs_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm
IF IsNull(ls_cbdybqh) Or Trim(ls_cbdybqh) = "" THEN
	as_error = "参保地医保区划为空，请重新读卡！"
	GOTO Error
END IF
// 获取 联系人姓名、联系电话
SELECT    LXDH,      JTDH,     CSNY,     BRBQ, JSDH INTO :ls_lxdh,  :ls_jtdh, :ld_csrq, :ll_brbq,:ll_jsdh
	From BQXT.ZY_BRRY	Where ZY_BRRY.zyh = :al_zyh	Using atr_trans;
IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) THEN ls_lxdh = ''
IF IsNull(ls_jtdh) THEN ls_jtdh = ''
IF Trim(ls_lxdh) = '' THEN ls_lxdh = ls_jtdh
// 获取 病历号
IF IsNull(as_blhm) THEN as_blhm = ''
if isnull(ll_jsdh) then ll_jsdh = 0
ll_jsdh ++
ls_zzysbm = as_ysbm
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN as_zyhm = as_zyhm +'-' + string(ll_jsdh)
//72	工伤住院  74	工伤康复住院
as_rylx = '72'
//IF of_get_ygxm(ls_zzysbm, Ref ls_zzysxm, Ref ls_zzyssfzh, True,Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
//	as_error = "获取主诊医生姓名失败：" + as_error
//	GOTO Error
//END IF
//
//IF This.of_get_gjbm( 'YSBM', ls_zzysbm, ls_ysbm_gjm) < 0 THEN
//	as_error = ls_ysbm_gjm
//	RETURN -1
//ELSE
//	IF IsNull(ls_ysbm_gjm) Or Trim(ls_ysbm_gjm) = '' THEN
//		IF ii_ysqzgjm = 1 THEN
//			as_error = '医生国家码空，请联系医保科！'
//			RETURN -1
//		END IF
//	ELSE
//		ls_zzysbm = ls_ysbm_gjm
//	END IF
//END IF
// 获取 入院科室编码、入院科室名称
ls_ryksbm = String(al_ksdm)
IF Trim(ls_ryksbm) = '' Or IsNull(al_ksdm) Or al_ksdm = 0 THEN
	as_error = '取不到对应的科室，请确认是否分配主治医生！'
	GOTO Error
END IF
ls_ryksmc = of_get_dzdmsbmc('GY_KSDM', ls_ryksbm)
ls_ryksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_GY_KSDM',ls_ryksbm)
//ls_ryksbm = 
// 获取 入院床位
IF IsNull(as_cwhm) THEN as_cwhm = ''
// 获取 入院诊断描述、入院主诊断代码、入院主诊断名称、入院诊断代码列表、入院诊断名称列表
IF This.of_get_zy_zdxx( al_zyh, 1, Ref ls_zzddm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_ryzdms, Ref lsArr_zddms, Ref lsArr_zdmcs, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
	as_error = '诊断获取失败！' + as_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
// 获取 病种编码、病种名称
IF IsNull(ls_bzbm) THEN ls_bzbm = ''
IF IsNull(ls_bzmc) THEN ls_bzmc = ''
This.uf_send_init('2201')
istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdybqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致
This.uf_send_add('ipt_otp_no', as_jzid) //1	ipt_otp_no	肈AT*
/住院流水号
This.uf_send_add('med_type', as_rylx) //2	med_type	就诊类别
This.uf_send_add('adm_time', adt_ryrq) //3	adm_time	门诊/住院入院时间 YYYYMMDDHH24MISS
This.uf_send_add('adm_diag_dscr', ls_zzddm) //4	adm_diag_dscr	诊断疾病编码
This.uf_send_add('adm_dept_name', ls_ryksmc) //5	wardarea_name	病区名称
This.uf_send_add('adm_dept_codg', ls_ryksbm) //6	adm_dept_codg	科室编码
This.uf_send_add('adm_bed', as_cwhm) //7	adm_bed	床位号
This.uf_send_add('atddr_no', ls_zzysbm) //8	atddr_no	医生盌AT*

This.uf_send_add('tel', ls_lxdh) //9	tel	病人联系电话
This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) //10	psn_no	个人唯一识别码
This.uf_send_add('ipt_no', as_zyhm) //11	ipt_no	住院号
This.uf_send_add('qualification_id', as_zyhm)//12	qualification_id	工伤医疗费资格 审核信息 ID
//插入登记信息
INSERT INTO JKXT.GS_DJXX(ZYH,MZYH,XLID,	JZLB,		RYSJ,		ZDBM,		BRBQ,		BQKS,			BRCH,		YSBM,			LXDH,GRSBM,ZYHM,DWSBM,        SHID,ZTBZ,CZSJ,CZGH )
VALUES( :al_zyh,:as_jzid,:is_jylsh,:as_rylx,:adt_ryrq,:ls_zzddm,:ll_brbq,:ls_ryksbm,:as_cwhm,:ls_zzysbm,:ls_lxdh,:ls_grbh,,:as_zyhm,:istr_gs_grjbxx.dwwysbm,  	    '',0,sysdate,base_info.userid)	
	 Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	as_error = "工伤新增登记明细失败：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
	GOTO Error
END IF

IF Not uf_send(Ref as_error) THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

UPDATE JKXT.GS_DJXX Set ZTBZ = 1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ = 0 And MZYH = :as_jzid Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	COMMIT Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	as_error = "【医保端】入院办理成功，但作废原入院登记明细失败，请联系信息科处理。住院号码："+as_zyhm+" 错误信息：["+String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)+"]"+itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	ROLLBACK Using itran_sqlca;
	GOTO Error_ybRollBack
END IF
// 2.更新 BQXT.ZY_BRRY.JSDH
IF ab_commit THEN
	gf_begin_transaction(atr_trans)
END IF
IF ll_jsdh > 1 THEN
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = :ll_jsdh Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
	IF ab_commit THEN
		IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
	END IF
ELSE
	UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY Set jsdh = 1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
END IF
// 3.更新ZY_BRRY_KZ.YBJZBH，并删除住院预结信息和作废上传的费用明细
INSERT Into BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ("ZYH","YBJZBH") Values(:al_zyh,:as_jzid) Using atr_trans;
UPDATE BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ Set YBJZBH = :as_jzid Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using atr_trans;
IF atr_trans.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	DELETE From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
	END IF
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.GS_FYMXSC  Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2) Using itran_sqlca;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		UPDATE JKXT.GS_FYMXSC Set ZTBZ = -1 Where ZYH = :al_zyh And ZTBZ In (0,9,-2)  Using itran_sqlca;
	END IF
	IF ab_commit THEN gf_commit_transaction(atr_trans)
END IF
RETURN 1
Error_ybRollBack:
DateTime ldt_temp
String ls_error_jyzf
// 调用“交易作废”，作废本次入院办理
IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_temp, '2201', ls_grbh, is_jylsh, Ref ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN
	as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf
END IF

Error:
as_error = "[2201-入院登记]出错：" + as_error
RETURN -1
end function

public function integer uf_zydj (ref string as_knsj, long al_ksdm, long al_zyh, datetime adt_ryrq, string as_zyhm, string as_cwhm, string as_bahm, string as_ysbm, string as_rylx, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 病区住院登记最终入口
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	reference	string  	as_knsj 	
// 	value    	long    	al_ksdm 	
// 	value    	long    	al_zyh  	
// 	value    	datetime	adt_ryrq	
// 	value    	string  	as_zyhm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_cwhm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_bahm 	
// 	value    	string  	as_ysbm 	
// 	reference	string  	as_jzbh 	
// 	reference	string  	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271  病区住院登记最终入口
//====================================================================

//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
IF IsValid(gtrans_temp_mssql) = True THEN
	IF gtrans_temp_mssql.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN GOTO Process_GetID // 数据库已连接
ELSE
	gtrans_temp_mssql = Create Transaction
	//gtrans_temp_ora = itrans_bq 
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBMS       = sqlca.DBMS
	gtrans_temp_mssql.ServerName = sqlca.ServerName
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Database   = sqlca.Database
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogID      = sqlca.LogID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.LogPass    = sqlca.LogPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.UserID     = sqlca.UserID
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBPass     = sqlca.DBPass
	gtrans_temp_mssql.DBParm     = sqlca.DBParm
	gtrans_temp_mssql.Lock 		 = sqlca.Lock
END IF

CONNECT Using gtrans_temp_mssql ;

IF gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '创建gtrans_temp_mssql事务失败:' + gtrans_temp_mssql.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF
Process_GetID:

RETURN uf_zydj(ref as_knsj, al_ksdm, al_zyh, adt_Ryrq, as_zyhm, as_cwhm, as_bahm, as_ysbm, as_rylx, ref as_JZbh, ref as_error, ref gtrans_temp_mssql, True)


end function

public function integer uf_zydj (long al_zyh, ref string as_jzbh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zydj()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 病区用住院登记
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	long  	al_zyh  	
// 	reference	string	as_jzbh 	
// 	reference	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.22    28271    病区用住院登记
//====================================================================

//根据adt_ryrq是否为空来判别是否取住院数据
String ls_knsj
Long ll_ksdm,ll_count
DateTime ldt_ryrq,ldt_rysj,ldt_jsrq
String ls_zyhm,ls_bahm,ls_ysbm,ls_brch //,ls_kssj

// 取 住院基本信息
SELECT     KNXX,     BRKS,      RYRQ,     ZYHM,     BRCH,     BAHM,     ZZYS,      JSRQ
  INTO :ls_knsj, :ll_ksdm, :ldt_ryrq, :ls_zyhm, :ls_brch, :ls_bahm, :ls_ysbm, :ldt_jsrq
  From BQXT.ZY_BRRY 
 Where ZYH=:al_zyh 
 Using sqlca;
IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = '找不到对应的病人信息:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
	RETURN -1
END IF

IF Not IsNull(ldt_jsrq) And Date(ldt_jsrq) > Date(2000,1,1) THEN
	ldt_ryrq = ldt_jsrq
ELSE
	SELECT BQRYSJ Into :ldt_rysj From ZY_BRRY_KZ Where ZYH = :al_zyh Using sqlca;
	IF Not IsNull(ldt_rysj) And sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		ldt_ryrq = ldt_rysj
	END IF
END IF

RETURN uf_zydj(ref ls_knsj, ll_ksdm, al_zyh, ldt_ryrq, ls_zyhm, ls_brch, ls_bahm, ls_ysbm, '1', ref as_jzbh, ref as_error)

end function

public function integer uf_zy_mxsc (long al_zyh, ref string as_error);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.uf_zy_fymxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述: 住院费用明细上传（外部接口，包括2301-住院费用明细上传，2303A住院预结算）
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	    	long	al_zyh	
// 	ref 	string	as_error	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	CJN		日期: 2022.01.19    28271  住院费用明细上传（外部接口，包括2301-住院费用明细上传，2303A住院预结算）
//====================================================================

Long ll_mxbs, ll_count, ll_bscbs,ll_brxz
DateTime ldt_zzrq, ldt_czsj, ldt_scsj, ldt_bqrysj
Dec{2} ld_zjje,ld_xjzfze,ld_jjzfze,ldc_bscje,ldc_gbbjzf = 0
String ls_jydd,ls_mxcllsh,ls_zyhm = '',ls_knsj ,ls_klb
str_zhyl_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
Integer li_ret,li_scbz = 0,li_cypb

IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_error = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
// 同步上传控制
ldt_czsj = gf_server_date()
SELECT SCBZ Into :li_scbz From JKXT.YB_BRJL Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF li_scbz >= 1 And li_scbz <> 3 THEN
	as_error = "正在上传明细，不能同步上传!"
	GOTO Error
END IF
gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	INSERT INTO "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"   (  "ZYH", "SCBZ",   "SCSJ" )
		Values (:al_zyh,   0, :ldt_czsj) Using itran_sqlca ;
END IF
IF li_scbz = 3 THEN
	li_scbz = 2
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 2, SCSJ = :ldt_czsj Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
ELSE
	li_scbz = 1
	UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 1, SCSJ = :ldt_czsj Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)

datastore lds_fymxsc
Long ll_row,ll_count_del
String ls_jlxh,ls_error
lds_fymxsc = Create datastore
lds_fymxsc.DataObject = 'd_fymxsc'

lds_fymxsc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ll_count_del = lds_fymxsc.Retrieve(al_zyh)
IF ll_count_del > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count_del
		ls_jlxh = String(lds_fymxsc.Object.ywlsh[ll_row])
		uf_zy_delfymx( al_zyh, ls_jlxh, Ref ls_error)
	NEXT
END IF
Destroy lds_fymxsc
//获取已经做结算的日艱AT*

SELECT Max(jsrq) Into :ldt_zzrq From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx  Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF IsNull(ldt_zzrq) THEN
		// 未做过结算的则取入院日期
		SELECT nvl(jsrq,ryrq),zyhm Into :ldt_zzrq,:ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			as_error = "获取入院日期失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		SELECT bqrysj Into :ldt_bqrysj From bqxt.zy_brry_kz Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
		IF ldt_bqrysj > ldt_zzrq THEN ldt_zzrq = ldt_bqrysj //三者取其大，入院时间，病区入院时间，上次结算的终止时间（有过中结的）
	ELSE
		ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
	END IF
ELSEIF itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	as_error = "获取上一次结算日期失败：[" + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode) + "]" + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText
	GOTO Error
END IF
ldt_zzrq = DateTime(Date(ldt_zzrq),Time(23:59:59))

//明细上传--医保做预结算
DO WHILE Date(ldt_zzrq) < Date(ldt_czsj)
	IF Date(ldt_zzrq) = Date(ldt_czsj) THEN EXIT
	//提交明细
	li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, Ref as_error)

	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	
	//预结算处理
	IF li_ret >= 0 THEN
		ll_mxbs = 0
		ll_bscbs = 0
			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_mxbs From JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 0 And zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_bscbs From JKXT.ZHYB_FYMXSC Where  ZTBZ = 9 And zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;

		IF ll_mxbs = 0 THEN
			INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(    ZYH,      jsrq,      czsj, mxbs, zjje, xjzfze, jjzfze, ZTBZ, BSCJE, BSCBS)
				VALUES(:al_zyh, :ldt_zzrq, :ldt_czsj,    0, 0.00,   0.00,   0.00,    0,     0,     :ll_bscbs)
				Using itran_sqlca;
		ELSE
		
//				IF uf_zy_jscl( 0, al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, 0, '', ls_jydd, Ref lstr_yb_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
//					GOTO Error
//				END IF
			//获取对应支付情况         
			IF IsNull(lstr_yb_jsxx.gbbjzf) THEN lstr_yb_jsxx.gbbjzf = 0
			ld_zjje = lstr_yb_jsxx.ylfze
			ld_xjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.grxjzc
			ld_jjzfze = lstr_yb_jsxx.jjzfze + lstr_yb_jsxx.grzhzc // 本院的基金支付总额 = 医保返回的基金支付总额 + 个人账户支出
			ldc_bscje = lstr_yb_jsxx.bscfyje // 不上传金额
			
			//判断是否已经预结算过
			SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.yb_zyyjxx Where zyh = :al_zyh And jsrq = :ldt_zzrq And ZTBZ = 0 Using itran_sqlca;
			gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				UPDATE JKXT.yb_zyyjxx SET czsj = :ldt_czsj, mxbs = :ll_mxbs, zjje = :ld_zjje, xjzfze = :ld_xjzfze, jjzfze = :ld_jjzfze, BSCJE = :ldc_bscje, BSCBS = :ll_bscbs
					WHERE ZYH = :al_zyh AND jsrq = :ldt_zzrq AND ZTBZ = 0
					Using itran_sqlca;
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO JKXT.YB_ZYYJXX(    ZYH,      jsrq,      czsj,     mxbs,     zjje,     xjzfze,     jjzfze, ZTBZ,      BSCJE,     BSCBS)
					VALUES(:al_zyh, :ldt_zzrq, :ldt_czsj, :ll_mxbs, :ld_zjje, :ld_xjzfze, :ld_jjzfze,    0, :ldc_bscje, :ll_bscbs)
					Using itran_sqlca;
			END IF
			IF itran_sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)
			ELSE
				gf_rollback_transaction(itran_sqlca)
				as_error =  "预结算成功，插入yb_zyyjxx失败:zyh=" + String(al_zyh) + "zzrq:" + String(ldt_zzrq) + "mxbs:" + String(ll_mxbs) + "zjje:" + String(ld_zjje) +"xjzfze:" + String(ld_xjzfze) + "jjzfze:" + String(ld_jjzfze)  + itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	IF li_scbz = 2 THEN
		IF RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),30) < Date(ldt_czsj) THEN
			ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),30),Time(23:59:59))
		ELSEIF RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),15) < Date(ldt_czsj) THEN
			ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),15),Time(23:59:59))
		ELSEIF RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),7) < Date(ldt_czsj) THEN
			ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),7),Time(23:59:59))
		ELSE
			ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
		END IF
	ELSE
		ldt_zzrq = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_zzrq),1),Time(23:59:59))
	END IF
LOOP

SetNull(ldt_zzrq)
li_ret = of_zy_fymx_sc(al_zyh, 0, ldt_zzrq, Ref as_error)

IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh And SCBZ <> 2 Using itran_sqlca;
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)

RETURN li_ret
Error:
IF ls_zyhm = '' THEN
	SELECT zyhm Into :ls_zyhm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using itran_sqlca;
	IF IsNull(ls_zyhm) THEN ls_zyhas_yyjgjzid
as_dzpj_jylsh
ls_dzpj_jylsh
ls_reimflag
m = ''
END IF
as_error = "zyh：" + String(al_zyh) + "zyhm：" + ls_zyhm + " " +as_error

gf_begin_transaction(itran_sqlca)
UPDATE "JKXT"."YB_BRJL"  Set SCBZ = 0 Where zyh = :al_zyh And SCBZ <> 2  Using itran_sqlca;
gf_commit_transaction(itran_sqlca)

RETURN -1



end function

IF ll_ybscmxCount = 0 THEN
	as_error = '无结算数据'
	RETURN 0
END IF

IF ai_jscs > 1 THEN
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm + "D" + String(ai_jscs)
ELSE
	ls_fphm = ls_zyhm
END IF
// 中途结算标志

IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
	ls_ztjsbz = '1'
ELSE
	ls_ztjsbz = '0'
END IF
IF ls_ztjsbz = '1' THEN
	ldt_cysj = adt_zzrq // 如果是中结，则使用中结日期
END IF

IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	This.uf_send_init('2206') // 预结算
ELSE
	This.uf_send_init('2207') // 确认结算
END IF

istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm // 修改Header中的"opter"，以确保操作员和其签到流水号一致
istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = ls_cbdxzqh // 修改Header中的"insuplc_admdvs"，以确保参保地一致

This.uf_send_add('psn_no', ls_grbh) // 人员编号

This.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt', ldc_zjje) // 医疗费总额
This.uf_send_add('mdtrt_id', ls_jzid) // 就诊ID
This.uf_send_add('insuplc_admdvs', ls_cbdxzqh) // 参保地医保区划
This.uf_send_add('invono', ls_fphm) // 发票号
IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	// 预结算字段
	IF IsNull(ldt_cysj) Or Date(ldt_cysj) <= Date(2000,1,1) THEN
		This.uf_send_add('dscgTime', '')
	ELSE
		This.uf_send_add('dscgTime', ldt_cysj) // 出院时间
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add('dise_codg', ls_bzbm) // 病种编码
END IF


IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	ls_yllb = astr_gs_jsxx.YLLB // 医疗类别以实际结算结果返回的为准
//	IF This.of_insert_jymx('', al_zyh, ai_jscs, ls_fphm, 'ZY', as_jydd, ls_yllb, '', ls_zyhm, astr_gs_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
//		GOTO Error
//	END IF
END IF

// 发送报文
IF Not This.uf_send(Ref as_error) THEN
	IF Pos(as_error, "出院时间不可早于费用发生时间") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "请确认出院时间或者删除明细！"
	END IF
	IF Pos(as_error, "该参保人在相同时间段存在与已登记就诊日期交叉") > 0 THEN
		as_error += "该参保人住院期间在门诊使用过该医保卡就诊，本次住院请撤销医保登记自费结算！"
	END IF
	GOTO Error
END IF

This.of_reset_jsxx(Ref astr_gs_jsxx)
This.of_get_ybjsxx(astr_gs_jsxx) // 解析并存储医保返回的结算金额明细
IF IsNull(astr_gs_jsxx.jssj) Or  Date(astr_gs_jsxx.jssj) < Date(2000,1,1) THEN // 测试时发现医保返回的结算时间经常为空，若为空则使用本地服务器时间
	astr_gs_jsxx.jssj = gf_server_date()
END IF
IF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
//	IF This.of_update_jsmx(is_jylsh, astr_gs_jsxx, Ref as_error) < 0 THEN
//		GOTO Error_ybRollBack
//	END IF
END IF
istr_gs_jsxx = astr_gs_jsxx


IF IsNull(as_error) THEN as_error = 'NULL'
RETURN 1

//Error_ybRollBack:
DateTime ldt_temp
String ls_error_jyzf
// 调用“交易作废”，作废本次结算，并撤销本次出院办理
IF This.uf_jyzf( ldt_temp, '2304', ls_grbh, is_jylsh, Ref ls_error_jyzf) < 0 THEN as_error = as_error + ls_error_jyzf

Error:
IF ai_jsbz = 0 THEN
	as_error = "[2206-住院预结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSEIF ai_jsbz = 1 THEN
	as_error = "[2207-住院结算]出错：" + as_error
ELSE
	as_error = "[住院预结算/结算]出错：" + as_error
END IF

RETURN -1


end function

public function integer uf_get_mzyh (ref string as_return);IF This.uf_connect_sqlca_temp( ) < 0 THEN
	as_return = is_error
	RETURN -1
END IF
String ls_datetime,ls_jylsh
Integer li_xhxh
SELECT JKXT.SEQ_GS_JYLSH.Nextval,to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmddhh24miss'),sysdate Into :li_xhxh,:ls_datetime From dual Using itran_sqlca;

IF IsNull(ls_datetime) Or ls_datetime = '' Or itran_sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
	IF IsNull(ls_datetime) THEN ls_datetime  = ''
	as_return = 'GS获取门住院序列ID失败:' + String(itran_sqlca.SQLCode ) +  itran_sqlca.SQLErrText + 'datetime:' + ls_datetime
	RETURN -1
END IF

ls_jylsh =  ls_datetime + Right('000000'+String(li_xhxh),6)
as_return = ls_jylsh
RETURN 1


end function

		//非当天的取当天date

	ls_ksbm = as_ksbm
	ldt_jzsj = idt_sysdatetime

//IF This.of_get_ygxm( ls_ysbm, ls_ysxm, ls_sfzh,True, as_return) < 0 THEN

SELECT nvl(yddh,gddh) Into :ls_lxdh From mzxt.MZ_bRDA Where BRBM = :as_brbm Using itran_sqlca;
IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) THEN ls_lxdh = ''
ls_bzbm = ''
ls_bzmc = ''
//IF ii_zymz = 1 THEN
//	li_ret = This.of_get_zy_zdxx( adc_jzlsh, 2, Ref  ls_zzdbm, Ref ls_zzdmc, Ref ls_zzdms, Ref ls_zdbm, Ref ls_zdmc, Ref ls_zdmc1 )

//END IF

	IF ls_bzbm = '' THEN
		ls_bzbm = ls_zdbm[1]
		as_bzbm = ls_bzbm
		ls_bzmc = ls_zdmc[1]

	as_return = "【2201】获取门住院号失败：" + as_jzid
	RETURN -1

	istr_jytsrx.opter = ls_czybm
	istr_jytsrx.opter_name = ls_czyxm

public function integer of_mz_mxsc (string as_brbm, integer ai_jslx, string as_jylx, ref str_yb_mzsfqq_new astr_yb_mzsfqq, string as_czybm, string as_yllb, ref decimal adc_fyze, ref string as_error);
//====================================================================
// 事件: u_gsbx_his.of_mz_mxsc()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述://1、交易输入费用明细为多行数据，交易输出为多行数据；
//2、同一收费批次的费用明细，应尽量一次全部上传，一次只能上传一个收费批次；
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	string           	as_brbm       	
// 	value    	integer          	ai_jslx       	
// 	value    	string           	as_jylx       	
// 	reference	str_yb_mzsfqq_new	astr_yb_mzsfqq	
// 	value    	string           	as_czybm      	
// 	value    	string           	as_yllb       	
// 	reference	decimal          	adc_fyze      	
// 	reference	string           	as_error      	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
//【2204】处方明细信息上传
IF ai_jslx = 2 THEN RETURN 0
//Integer li_mzws
//SELECT MZWSBZ INTO :li_mzws FROM MZXT.MZ_JZXX WHERE JZLSH = :astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh USING itran_sqlca;
//ls_expcontent = String(li_mzws)

String ls_ghsf,ls_cbdxzqh,ls_error,ls_fplsh,ls_xlh
ls_cbdxzqh = istr_gs_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm
DateTime ldt_now
ldt_now = gf_server_date()

ls_ghsf = Mid(as_jylx,1,2)
IF ls_ghsf = 'SF' Or ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
	as_jylx = Mid(as_jylx,3)
ELSE
	as_error = '交易类型睤AT* :'+ls_ghsf
	RETURN -1
END IF

Long ll_rowcount,ll_count_ret
ll_rowcount = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount <= 0 THEN
	as_error = '【2204】交易费用明细无数据!FPLSH:' + astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
	RETURN -1
END IF
//发票流水号增加序列取值，对于预结算，可能会存在用过了不能再用
IF IsNull( astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) Or Trim(astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh) = '' THEN
	IF This.of_get_jzxlh(ls_xlh,as_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'FEYFP' + ls_xlh
END IF
ls_fplsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh
String ls_yllb,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm,ls_ybksbm,ls_sypc
ls_yllb = as_yllb
ls_ksbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM
ls_ysbm = astr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	SELECT zyks Into :ls_ksbm From xtgl.gy_ygdm Where ygdm = :ls_ysbm Using itran_sqlca;
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN
	as_error = '【2204】科室为空！'
	RETURN -1
END IF
ls_ybksbm = of_get_dzdmsb('ZHYL_MZ_KS',ls_ksbm)
IF IsNull(ls_ybksbm) Or ls_ybksbm = '' Or ls_ybksbm = 'NULL'  Or ls_ybksbm = '无' THEN
	as_error = '【2204】门诊科室（'+ls_ksbm+'）未医保对照，请联系医保科完成对照！'
	RETURN -1
	ls_ybksbm = ls_ksbm
END IF

//费用明细列表（节点标识：feedetail）
IF IsValid(ids_ybfymx_sc) = False THEN
	ids_ybfymx_sc = Create U_datastore
	ids_ybfymx_sc.setworktrans( itran_sqlca)
	ids_ybfymx_sc.DataObject = 'd_gs_fymxsc_his'
END IF
ids_ybfymx_sc.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca)
ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset( )
//费用明细列表
Dec{0} ldc_ywlsh,ldc_ywmxxh,ldc_ghlsh
Dec{2} ldc_ylfyze,ldc_fysl,ldc_gbbjzf = 0.00,ldc_bscje = 0.00,ldc_ycyl
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_zfbl
Integer li_cyts,li_tsdz,li_sczs,li_scrow,li_left,li_right,li_ret,li_danff = -1
//String ls_mxxh,ls_ywlx,ls_jzid,ls_xmzxbh_ts,ls_yyspbz,ls_dfybz,ls_yyxmbh,ls_ycjl,ls_syfybz = '0',ls_yytj = '',ls_memo,ls_bscmx,ls_data[]
String ls_mxxh,ls_ywlx,ls_jzid,ls_gjybbm,ls_yyspbz,ls_dfybz,ls_xmzxbh_ts,ls_memo,ls_ycjl,ls_bscmx
Long ll_find,ll_insert,ll_find1,ll_mxtop,ll_mxscxh,ll_mxjs
Boolean lb_dfbz = True
ls_jzid =  astr_yb_mzsfqq.jzid
ldc_ghlsh = astr_yb_mzsfqq.GHLSH
adc_fyze = 0.00

// add by sxl 处理不上传明细
li_ret = This.of_mz_bscxm( ai_jslx, ls_jzid, as_brbm, ls_ghsf, astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, ls_fplsh, ldt_now, ldc_bscje,ls_bscmx)
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	as_error = "处理不上传明细失败：" + ls_bscmx
	RETURN -1
ELSE //如果全部为不上传明细，则return 2 add by sxl 20230330
	IF li_ret = 2 THEN
		adc_fyze = ldc_bscje
		astr_yb_mzsfqq.str_zhyl_jsxx.bscfyje = ldc_bscje
		RETURN 2
	END IF
END IF


IF ll_rowcount > ii_mxts THEN
	li_sczs =  Ceiling((ll_rowcount) / ii_mxts )
ELSE
	li_sczs = 1
END IF
FOR li_scrow = 1 To li_sczs
	This.uf_send_init( '2204')
	istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = istr_gs_grjbxx.cbdxzqhdm
	IF istr_jytsrx.opter <> as_czybm THEN
		istr_jytsrx.opter = as_czybm
	END IF
	This.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( 'feedetail')
	IF li_scrow * ii_mxts  > ll_rowcount THEN
		ll_mxtop = ll_rowcount
	ELSE
		ll_mxtop = li_scrow * ii_mxts
	END IF
	ll_mxjs = 0 //排除不上传，如果剩余只有不上传，那么直接返回true
	FOR ll_mxscxh =  (li_scrow - 1 ) * ii_mxts + 1  To ll_mxtop
		gf_waiting('正在上传医保明细...' + String(ll_mxscxh) + '/' + String(ll_rowcount),Integer(ll_mxscxh /ll_rowcount * 100))
		IF posw( ls_bscmx,',' +String(ll_mxscxh)+ ',') > 0 THEN //modify by sxl 判断是否为不上传明细
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			ll_mxjs ++
		END IF
		ls_dfybz = ''
		ls_yyspbz = '0'
		IF ls_ghsf = 'GH' THEN
			ls_ywlx = 'GH'
			ls_mxxh = ls_fplsh + '+' + String(ll_mxscxh)
			ll_find = This.of_Get_jbxx( 0, astr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Object.xmlsh[ll_mxscxh], 0,'MZ', ldt_now,ls_xmzxbh_ts, li_tsdz, as_error)

public function integer of_mz_bscxm (integer ai_jslx, string as_jzid, string as_brbm, string as_ghfs, ref datastore ads_datasource, string as_fplsh, datetime adt_fsrq, ref decimal adc_bscje, ref string as_return);//====================================================================
// 事件: u_zhyl_his.of_mz_bscxm()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:门诊不上传明细处理
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	value    	integer  	ai_jslx       	
// 	value    	string   	as_ghfs       	
// 	value    	datastore	ads_datasource	
// 	reference	string   	as_return    	
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  integer
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2022.05.15
//====================================================================
//门诊不上传ii_ybmzbscqy = 1和不上传+明细拆分不启用ii_YBBSCCFQY = 0才调用这里
IF ii_ybmzbscqy = 1  And ii_YBBSCCFQY = 0 THEN
ELSE
	RETURN 1
END IF
IF ads_datasource.RowCount() <= 0 THEN RETURN 1
String ls_sql, ls_yplx, ls_fyxh
Long ll_rowCount, ll_find,ll_fyxh,ll_ypcd,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_bsc = 0,ll_bscCount
// 医保不上传费用dataStore 初始化
IF Not IsValid(ids_yb_bscfy) THEN
	ids_yb_bscfy = Create U_dataStore
	ids_yb_bscfy.setWorkTrans(itran_sqlca)
	//	ls_sql = "SELECT CSDM, 0 as YPLX,Y.FYDW As DW,Y.FYMC As XMMC FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N N,XTGL.GY_YLSF Y WHERE N.CSMC='YB_BSCFY' AND N.CSZ='1' And N.CSDM = TO_CHAR(Y.FYXH) Union All " +&
	ls_sql = "SELECT CSDM, 0 as YPLX FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N WHERE CSMC='YB_BSCFY' AND CSZ='1' Union All " +&
		"SELECT CSDM, 1 as YPLX FROM XTGL.GY_XTCS_N WHERE CSMC='YB_BSCYP' AND CSZ='1'  "
	IF ids_yb_bscfy.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
		as_return = "创建'费用信息'对象失败("+ids_yb_bscfy.is_error+")!"
		RETURN -1
	ELSE
		ids_yb_bscfy.SetTransObject(itran_sqlca )
		ids_yb_bscfy.Retrieve()
	END IF
END IF
ll_bscCount = ids_yb_bscfy.RowCount()
IF ll_bscCount <= 0 THEN RETURN 0

ll_rowCount = ads_datasource.RowCount()
IF ll_rowCount <= 0 THEN RETURN 0
adc_bscje = 0.00
String ls_ywlx,ls_return = '',ls_xmmc,ls_dw,ls_data_zf[]
Dec{2} ldc_ylfyze,ldc_fysl,ldc_bscje = 0.00,ldc_gbbjzf = 0.00
Dec{4} ldc_fydj,ldc_zfbl
Dec{0} ldc_ywlsh,ldc_ywmxxh
sailjson lsjson
lsjson = Create sailjson
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowCount
	ll_fyxh = ads_datasource.Object.XMLSH[ll_cur]
	IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
		ls_ywlx = 'GH'
		ls_yplx = '0'
		ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh)
		//		ldc_ywlsh = Dec(as_fplsh)
		//		ldc_ywmxxh = ll_cur
	ELSE
		ll_ypcd = ads_datasource.Object.CDLSH[ll_cur]
		ls_ywlx = ads_datasource.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
		//		ldc_ywlsh = ads_datasource.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		//		ldc_ywmxxh = ads_datasource.Object.mxxh[ll_cur]
		IF ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
			ls_yplx = '1'
			ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh) + '#' + String(ll_ypcd)
		ELSE
			ls_yplx = '0'
			ls_fyxh = String(ll_fyxh)
		END IF
	END IF
	ll_find = ids_yb_bscfy.Find(" (CSDM='"+ls_fyxh+"' and YPLX="+ls_yplx+") ", 1, ll_bscCount)
	//对应的不上传明细的zfbl记得处理成1
	ls_xmmc = ads_datasource.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ll_bsc = ll_bsc + 1
		ls_return = ls_return + String(ll_cur) + ','
		//		ls_dw = ids_yb_bscfy.Object.#3[ll_find]
		IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
			ldc_fysl = 1
			ldc_fydj = Round(ads_datasource.Object.zjje[ll_cur],2)
		ELSE
			ldc_fysl = ads_datasource.Object.xmsl[ll_cur]
			ldc_fydj = ads_datasource.Object.xmdj[ll_cur]
		END IF
		ldc_ylfyze =  Round(ads_datasource.Object.zjje[ll_cur],2)
		ldc_bscje = ldc_bscje + ldc_ylfyze
		IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
			ldc_ywlsh = Dec(as_fplsh)
			ldc_ywmxxh = ll_cur
		ELSE
			ldc_ywlsh = ads_datasource.Object.YWLSH[ll_cur]
			ldc_ywmxxh = ads_datasource.Object.mxxh[ll_cur]
			//			ls_xmmc = ads_datasource.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		END IF
		IF ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] <> 1 THEN
			ads_datasource.Object.zfbl[ll_cur] = 1
			ads_datasource.Object.zfje[ll_cur] = ldc_ylfyze
		END IF
		
		IF ai_jslx = 1 THEN
			ll_insert = ids_ybfymx_sc.InsertRow(0)
			IF IsNull(as_jzid) THEN
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = as_fplsh // 就诊ID
			ELSE
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = as_jzid // 就诊ID
			END IF
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.brbm[ll_insert] = as_brbm // 住院号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = ls_ywlx // 业务类型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywlsh) // 费用明细流水号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywmxxh) // 原费用流水号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = as_fplsh // 医嘱号
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = adt_fsrq // 费用发生时间
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] =  '' // 医疗目录编码
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze // 明细项目费用总额
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YYSPBZ[ll_insert] = '0' // 医院审批标志
			IF ib_ydzf THEN
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = 'YDZF' + as_fplsh + '+' + String(ll_cur)
			ELSE
				ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = as_fplsh + '+' + String(ll_cur)
			END IF
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = '不上传明细'
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 9
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.zfbl[ll_insert] = 1 //6	selfpay_prop	自付比例	数值型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.QZFJE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze //7	fulamt_ownpay_amt	全自费金额	数值型
			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SFXMDJ[ll_insert] = '03' //11	chrgitm_lv	收费项目等级	字符型
			
			
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.jzid[ll_insert] = ls_jzid // 就诊ID
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.brbm[ll_insert] = as_brbm // 住院号
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlx[ll_insert] = ls_ywlx // 业务类型：
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ywlsh[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywlsh) // 费用明细流水号
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YXMYWLSH[ll_insert] = String(ldc_ywmxxh) // 原费用流水号
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YZH[ll_insert] = ls_fplsh // 医嘱号
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYFSSJ[ll_insert] = ldt_now // 费用发生时间
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YLMLBM[ll_insert] = ls_gjybbm // 医疗目录编码
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.FYZE[ll_insert] = ldc_ylfyze // 明细项目费用总额
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.SL[ll_insert] = ldc_fysl // 数量
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.DJ[ll_insert] = ldc_fydj // 单价
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.YYSPBZ[ll_insert] = ls_yyspbz // 医院审批标志
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.MZFYMXLSH[ll_insert] = ls_mxxh
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.BZXX[ll_insert] = ls_memo
//			ids_ybfymx_sc.Object.ztbz[ll_insert] = 0		
			
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT
adc_bscje = ldc_bscje
IF ls_return > ''  THEN
	as_return = ',' + ls_return
	//全部为不上传明细
	IF ll_bsc = ll_rowCount THEN
		String ls_error
		IF as_ghfs = 'GH' THEN
//				This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, as_jzid, 'GH' + as_fplsh,DateTime(Date(adt_fsrq)), ls_error)
		ELSE
//				This.uf_mz_ghcx( istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.grbh, as_jzid, as_fplsh,DateTime(Date(adt_fsrq)), ls_error)
		END IF
		
		ids_ybfymx_sc.Reset( )
		RETURN 2
	ELSE
		RETURN 1
	END IF
END IF
RETURN 0

RETURN 1

end function

call super::create

end on

public function integer of_lgzy (integer ai_lglx, datetime adt_bqcrjsj, long al_zyh, transaction atran_sqlca);String ls_brbm,ls_pid,ls_pid_brbm
SELECT brbm,pid Into :ls_brbm,:ls_pid From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :al_zyh Using atran_sqlca;
IF ls_brbm > ' ' THEN
	SELECT pid Into :ls_pid_brbm From mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using atran_sqlca;
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_pid_brbm) Or Trim(ls_pid_brbm) = '' THEN ls_pid_brbm = ls_pid
//没有pid对应brbm也没有pid那么就返回
IF IsNull(ls_pid)  Or Trim(ls_pid) = '' Or IsNull(ls_pid_brbm) Or Trim(ls_pid_brbm)  = ''  THEN RETURN 0
//普通病区入院前24小时是否有留观的出院记录，有则走急诊住院否则普通住院,排除床管
Long ll_count = 0
IF ai_lglx = 1 THEN //普通病区判断是否有留观住院
	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count
		FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY B,BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ K
		WHERE B.ZYH = K.ZYH AND instr(:is_lgks,','||to_char(B.BRBQ) ||',') > 0 AND B.CYPB >= 0 AND B.CYPB <= 9 AND B.BRBQ <> :il_yzybq
		And K.BQCYSJ <= :adt_bqcrjsj + 0.25 And K.BQCYSJ >= :adt_bqcrjsj - 1 And (B.pid = :ls_pid Or B.pid = :ls_pid_brbm) Using atran_sqlca;
	//pid对应的brbm
	//IF ll_count = 0 THEN
	//	SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count
	//	FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY B,BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ K
	//		WHERE B.ZYH = K.ZYH AND instr(:is_lgks,','||to_char(B.BRBQ) ||',') > 0 AND B.CYPB >= 0 AND B.CYPB <= 9 AND B.BRBQ <> :il_yzybq
	//		AND K.BQCYSJ <= :adt_bqrjsj + 0.25 AND K.BQCYSJ >= :adt_bqrjsj - 1 AND
	//		B.brbm In (SELECT mz_brda.brbm From mz_brda Where mz_brda.pid = :ls_pid_brbm Or mz_brda.pid = :ls_pid ) Using atran_sqlca;
	//END IF
ELSEIF ai_lglx = 2 THEN //留观判断是否有后续住院
	 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count
		FROM BQXT.ZY_BRRY B,BQXT.ZY_BRRY_KZ K
		WHERE B.ZYH = K.ZYH AND B.BRBQ in (select ksdm from xtgl.gy_ksdm where rypb = 0) AND B.CYPB >= 0 AND B.CYPB <= 9 AND B.BRBQ <> :il_yzybq
		And K.BQRYSJ >= :adt_bqcrjsj - 0.25 And K.BQRYSJ <= :adt_bqcrjsj + 1 And (B.pid = :ls_pid Or B.pid = :ls_pid_brbm) 
		AND K.BQRYSJ is not null Using atran_sqlca;
END IF
RETURN ll_count



end function

public function integer uf_zhcx_tmb7014 (string as_grbh, ref str_yb_grjbxx_zhyl astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl, ref string as_return);//====================================================================

str_zhyl_tmbdj lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[]

IF This.uf_send( as_return, '') THEN

	Date ld_begin,ld_end,ld_now
	ld_now = Date(gf_server_date())
	ll_count = This.uf_getstring_mxnr( 'feedetail')
	//10	门慢门特病种11	门诊慢性病12	门诊特殊疾病20按病种结算病种 9944罕见病 30	日间手术病种40	疾病诊断病种50	中医日间病房病种99	其他病种99011	城乡居民两病9902	急危重症

	//1	opsp_dise_code	门慢门特病种目录代码	字符型	30

//3	diag_code	门慢门特疾病诊断代码	字符型	30
