	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm = This.uf_getstring_in( 'opsp_dise_code', ll_row) //opsp_dise_code	门慢门特病种目录代码
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc = This.uf_getstring_in( 'opsp_dise_name', ll_row) //opsp_dise_name	门慢门特病种名称			
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].begndate = This.uf_getdate_in( 'begndate', ll_row) //begndate	开始日期
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].enddate = This.uf_getdate_in( 'enddate', ll_row) //enddate	结束日期
			lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content = This.uf_getstring_in( 'exp_content', ll_row) //exp_content	字段扩展
			IF lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content  > '' THEN
				sailjson ls_json
				ls_json = Create sailjson
				ls_json.parse( lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].exp_content)
//				1	diseTypeCode	门慢特病种类别代码	字符型	30
//				2	diagCode	门慢门特诊断代码	字符型	20
//				3	diagName	门慢门特诊断名称	字符型	100
				Boolean lb_exists
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diseTypeCode', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diseTypeCode = ls_json.getattribute( 'diseTypeCode')
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diagCode', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagCode = ls_json.getattribute( 'diagCode')
				ls_json.getattribute( 'diagName', lb_exists)
				IF lb_exists THEN
					lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagName = ls_json.getattribute( 'diagName')
					IF (IsNull(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) Or Trim(lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc) = '') AND lstr_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].diagName >' ' THEN

						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE '10' //10	门慢门特病种(公务员慢病)

						IF  Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = '3303' THEN

								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbsfxs = 1
							IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						END IF
					CASE '11' //门诊慢性病
						//异地慢病病人
						//modify 2023.02.22温州市本地除了10公务员慢病走慢病，11走普通，异地11走140104
						IF  Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) = '3303' THEN CONTINUE
						astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbsfxs = 1
						IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
							CONTINUE
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.mxbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE '9944'
						astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbsfxs = 1
						IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
							CONTINUE
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
						END IF
						IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm) = '' THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						ELSE
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.hjbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
						END IF
					CASE ELSE
						//现先支持特慢病，其他后续有需要再整改  跨省因为没有对应的病种类别，默认到特殊病先
						IF ii_ksmtbqy = 1 And Left(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm,4) <> Left(is_yljgxzqh,4) THEN
							astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbsfxs = 1
							IF Pos(';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm +';',';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm + ';') > 0 THEN
								CONTINUE
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbbzdm
							END IF
							IF IsNull(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) Or Trim(astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm) = '' THEN
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							ELSE
								astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm = astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.tsbdmsm + ';' + astr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.str_zhyl_tmbdj[ll_row].tmbmc
							END IF
						END IF
				END CHOOSE
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		as_return = '该人员无慢特病备案'
		RETURN 0
	END IF
ELSE
	as_return = '【5301】人员慢特病备案查询失败：' + as_return
	RETURN -1
END IF
RETURN 1






end function
